<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
  Hustler's Logbook: one self-contained, offline-capable web app (PWA).

  HOW THIS FILE IS ORGANISED (search for the CAPITALISED banner comments):
    1. <head>      manifest + icons, fonts.css (this app's own typefaces: Space Grotesk headings, Space Grotesk text), theme colour.
    2. <style>     the look. Colours are tokens (--bg, --ink, --accent ...); the COMFORT BLOCK at the end tunes
                   spacing, the iPhone notch and iPhone field size.
    3. <script>    the app. Main sections, in order: LOGBOOK config (name, palette, wording), DATA STORAGE,
                   TIMETABLE (time -> box), BOXES, pages, SETTINGS, HOME, ROUTER, FIRST-RUN SETUP.
    4. Extra scripts at the very end: POLISH (stops the redraw jitter, timetable quick-fill, Clean product rotation),
                   SETUP STEPS (the first-run flow), TEST MODE (switch to a separate test copy of your data).

  DATA: everything lives in this browser's localStorage under STORAGE_KEY. Test mode uses STORAGE_KEY + '-test',
  so your real data is never touched. Use Settings > Backup to move data between phones.
  This file is produced by the build scripts; change those rather than hand-editing where you can.
-->

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#FAFAF7">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="192x192" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Hustler's">
<title>Hustler's Logbook</title>
<script>
/* Set theme before first paint to avoid a flash of the wrong mode.
   Stored separately from the main app DB so it's cheap to read here. */
(function(){
  try{
    var saved = localStorage.getItem('hustlers-logbook-theme');
    var theme = saved || 'light';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    /* The actual colour values live in window.LOGBOOK.brand (see the
       config block at the end of <head>); this early pass only needs to
       set the data-theme attribute before first paint. */
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>

<style>
:root{
  /* Hustler's Logbook brand palette (red / black / off-white paper)
     rendered with Locket/Strava-style shape language: soft elevation,
     generous radii, spring motion — recolored to match the source PDF.
     Light is the default; [data-theme="dark"] overrides below. */
  --bg:#FAFAF7;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;
  --surface-2:#F3EFE9;
  --ink:#151312;
  --ink-soft:#57524C;
  --muted:#7C756B;
  --line:#EAE5DC;
  --accent:#C81212;
  --accent-ink:#FFFFFF;
  --accent-soft:#FCE1E1;
  --green:#1E9E63;
  --green-soft:#DCF5E9;
  --amber:#E8A426;
  --red:#E5171B;
  --on-ink:#FFFFFF;
  --on-ink-soft:rgba(255,255,255,0.62);
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px rgba(21,19,18,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(21,19,18,0.04);
  --shadow-md:0 8px 24px rgba(21,19,18,0.08), 0 2px 6px rgba(21,19,18,0.04);
  --shadow-lg:0 16px 40px rgba(21,19,18,0.16), 0 4px 10px rgba(21,19,18,0.06);
  --r-lg:24px;
  --r-md:18px;
  --r-sm:14px;
  --r-pill:999px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.34,1.2,.64,1);
  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --font-display:'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  /* Home hero gradient stops. Overridden per-brand from the config
     block at the end of <head>; these are the stock fallbacks. */
  --hero-from:#F5323A;
  --hero-via:var(--accent);
  --hero-to:#B71014;
}

[data-theme="dark"]{
  /* Same red accent, inverted to a warm near-black paper so it still
     reads as "the logbook", not a generic dark SaaS panel.
     Every pairing below is tuned to clear WCAG AA (4.5:1) at minimum. */
  --bg:#141110;
  --surface:#221E1B;
  --surface-2:#302A26;
  --ink:#FBF8F3;
  --ink-soft:#D6CEC3;
  --muted:#A79E92;
  --line:#443C35;
  --accent:#FF6B6E;
  --accent-ink:#141110;
  --accent-soft:#4E1F21;
  --green:#5CDBA0;
  --green-soft:#1B4632;
  --amber:#F2C05C;
  --red:#FF6B6E;
  --on-ink:#141110;
  --on-ink-soft:rgba(20,17,16,0.62);
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.24);
  --shadow-md:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.36), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.24);
  --shadow-lg:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.48), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  --hero-from:#C2262C;
  --hero-via:#A81B20;
  --hero-to:#7A1114;
}
[data-theme="dark"] body{ background:var(--bg); }
[data-theme="dark"] .home-hero::after{ background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); }
[data-theme="dark"] .page-tile .tile-name{ color:#FFFFFF; }
[data-theme="dark"] ::placeholder{ color:#8B8175; opacity:1; }
*{box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
body{
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--ink);
  min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh;
  overscroll-behavior-y:none;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
html.sheet-open, body.sheet-open{ overflow:hidden; overscroll-behavior:none; touch-action:none; }
body.sheet-open{ position:fixed; width:100%; }
button{font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer;}
input,textarea{font-family:inherit;}
::selection{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent);}
::placeholder{ color:var(--muted); opacity:1; }

button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset:2px;
}
.textline:focus, .freewrite:focus, textarea:focus{
  outline:none;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent);
}

/* ---------- Splash / loading screen ---------- */
#app-splash{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:999;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px;
  background:var(--bg);
  transition:opacity .45s var(--ease-out), visibility .45s;
}
#app-splash.hide{ opacity:0; visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none; }
.splash-mark{
  width:72px; height:72px; border-radius:22px; background:var(--accent); color:#fff;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:splashPop .5s var(--ease);
}
@keyframes splashPop{ from{ transform:scale(0.7); opacity:0; } to{ transform:scale(1); opacity:1; } }
.splash-title{
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink);
  animation:fadeIn .5s var(--ease-out) .1s both;
}
.splash-spinner{
  width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%;
  border:2.5px solid var(--line); border-top-color:var(--accent);
  animation:splashSpin .7s linear infinite;
  margin-top:6px;
}
@keyframes splashSpin{ to{ transform:rotate(360deg); } }

/* ---------- App shell ---------- */
#app{
  max-width:520px;
  margin:0 auto;
  min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh;
  background:var(--bg);
  position:relative;
  padding-bottom:calc(112px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
}

/* ---------- Top bar ---------- */
.topbar{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40;
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) 16px 12px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
}
.topbar .back{
  background:var(--surface); border:none; color:var(--ink);
  font-size:14px; font-weight:600; padding:9px 14px 9px 10px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.topbar .back:active{ transform:scale(0.94); }
.topbar .back svg{width:18px;height:18px;}
.topbar .title{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  flex:1;
  text-align:center;
}
.topbar .spacer{width:60px;}
.topbar-right{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.topbar .date-pill{
  font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft);
  background:var(--surface); padding:7px 12px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill); letter-spacing:0.01em;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.theme-toggle{
  width:34px; height:34px; border:none; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-soft);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), background .15s, color .15s;
}
.theme-toggle:active{ transform:scale(0.88) rotate(-12deg); }
.hero-toggle{
  position:absolute; top:18px; right:18px; z-index:2;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color:#fff; box-shadow:none;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
}
.hero-toggle:active{ background:rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

/* ---------- Home ---------- */
.home-hero{
  margin:2px 16px 0;
  background:linear-gradient(155deg, var(--hero-from) 0%, var(--hero-via) 55%, var(--hero-to) 100%);
  color:var(--accent-ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:24px 22px 22px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.home-hero::after{
  content:''; position:absolute; top:-60px; right:-60px; width:200px; height:200px;
  background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.16) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.home-hero .brand{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-size:12.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:0.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  opacity:0.85;
  margin:0 0 8px;
}
.home-hero .headline{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-size:26px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.15;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  margin:0 0 20px;
  max-width:280px;
}
.day-quote{
  font-size:13px; font-weight:500; opacity:0.92; margin:16px 0 0; max-width:300px; line-height:1.45;
  position:relative; z-index:1;
}

.week-strip{
  display:flex; gap:8px; padding:18px 16px 4px; overflow-x:auto;
  scrollbar-width:none;
}
.week-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }
.week-day{
  flex:1;
  min-width:34px;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:none;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  padding:9px 4px 8px;
  text-align:center;
  cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), background .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
.week-day:active{ transform:scale(0.93); }
.week-day .dow{ font-size:9.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em;}
.week-day .dnum{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:15px; font-weight:800; margin-top:3px; color:var(--ink);}
.week-day .dots{ display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:2px; margin-top:5px; min-height:5px;}
.week-day .dot{ width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent);}
.week-day.today{ background:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); }
.week-day.today .dow{ color:var(--on-ink-soft); }
.week-day.today .dnum{ color:var(--on-ink); }
.week-day.today .dot{ background:var(--accent); }
.week-day.selected:not(.today){ box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent), var(--shadow-sm); }

.week-strip-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:18px 12px 4px; }
.week-strip-row .week-strip{ padding:0; flex:1; gap:5px; }
.jump-date-btn{
  flex-shrink:0; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-soft); border:none;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.jump-date-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.92); }
.jump-date-btn svg{ width:18px; height:18px; }

.clock-strip{
  width:calc(100% - 32px);
  margin:14px 16px 0;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:var(--surface);
  color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  text-align:left;
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), box-shadow .15s var(--ease-out);
}
.clock-strip:active{ transform:scale(.985); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
.clock-time-wrap{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; flex-shrink:0; }
.clock-dot{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
.clock-time{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:13px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); white-space:nowrap; }
.clock-divider{ width:1px; height:22px; background:var(--line); flex-shrink:0; }
.clock-task{ flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.35; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.clock-strip > svg{ flex-shrink:0; color:var(--muted); }

.nextup-card{
  margin:14px 16px 0; padding:16px 18px; background:var(--surface);
  border-radius:var(--r-md); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  border:1.5px solid var(--accent);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px;
}
.nextup-eyebrow{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:var(--accent);
}
.nextup-eyebrow svg{ width:13px; height:13px; }
.nextup-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:18px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin-top:3px; }
.nextup-sub{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.nextup-btn{
  margin-top:12px; align-self:flex-start; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink);
  border:none; border-radius:var(--r-pill); padding:10px 18px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.nextup-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.95); }
.nextup-btn svg{ width:14px; height:14px; }
.nextup-alldone{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:2px 0;
}
.nextup-alldone .ok-badge{
  width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green-soft); color:var(--green);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
}
.nextup-alldone .ok-badge svg{ width:18px; height:18px; }

.ring-wrap{ position:relative; width:64px; height:64px; flex-shrink:0; }
.ring-wrap svg{ width:64px; height:64px; transform:rotate(-90deg); }
.ring-wrap .ring-track{ fill:none; stroke:rgba(255,255,255,0.28); stroke-width:7; }
.ring-wrap .ring-fill{ fill:none; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:7; stroke-linecap:round; transition:stroke-dashoffset .6s var(--ease-out); }
.ring-wrap .ring-center{
  position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800; color:var(--accent-ink);
}

/* Smaller ring variant used inside the light week-summary card
   (as opposed to the dark hero gradient the base .ring-wrap was
   built for) — accent-colored fill on a neutral track instead of
   white-on-red. */
.ring-wrap-sm{ width:52px; height:52px; }
.ring-wrap-sm svg{ width:52px; height:52px; }
.ring-wrap-sm .ring-track{ stroke:var(--surface-2); }
.ring-wrap-sm .ring-fill{ stroke:var(--accent); }
.ring-center-sm{ color:var(--ink) !important; font-size:12.5px !important; }

.section-label{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  padding:22px 16px 12px;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.section-label .sub{ font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0; }

.page-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px;
  padding:0 16px;
}
.page-tile{
  background:var(--surface);
  border:none;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:16px 16px 15px;
  text-align:left;
  position:relative;
  min-height:112px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), box-shadow .15s var(--ease-out);
}
.page-tile:active{ transform:scale(0.96); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
.page-tile.done{ box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); }
.page-tile .tile-top{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;}
.page-tile .tile-icon{
  width:38px; height:38px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.page-tile.done .tile-icon{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); }
.page-tile .tile-icon svg{ width:20px; height:20px; }
.page-tile .tile-name{
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:1.2; margin-top:12px;
}
.page-tile .tile-status{
  font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; font-weight:600;
}
.page-tile.done .tile-status{ color:var(--green); }
.page-tile .check-badge{
  position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px;
  width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--green); color:#fff;
  display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(30,158,99,0.4);
}
.page-tile.done .check-badge{ display:flex; }
.page-tile.setup-tile{ min-height:96px; }
.page-tile.setup-tile .tile-icon{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); }

.lane-note{
  margin:14px 16px 0; padding:14px 16px;
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.5; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.lane-note .lni{
  width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:11px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
}
.lane-note b{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:13px; font-weight:800; display:block; margin-bottom:2px; letter-spacing:-0.01em;}

/* ---------- Generic page canvas ---------- */
.page-body{ padding:16px; }
.field-card{
  background:var(--surface);
  border:none;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:18px;
  margin-bottom:12px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.field-card .fc-label{
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin-bottom:10px; color:var(--ink);
}
.field-card .fc-hint{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:-6px; margin-bottom:12px; line-height:1.4; }

/* ============================================================
   WEEK SUMMARY CARD — "graph of the week" on Home
   ============================================================ */
.week-summary-card{
  margin:14px 16px 4px;
  padding:16px 16px 14px;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.week-summary-ringrow{ display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:10px; margin-bottom:14px; }
.week-summary-ringrow .streak-box{
  background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-sm); padding:10px 13px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; flex:1;
}
.week-summary-ringrow .streak-box .num{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; line-height:1; font-size:20px; color:var(--ink); }
.week-summary-ringrow .streak-box .lbl{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; }
.week-summary-divider{ height:1px; background:var(--line); margin:0 0 14px; }
.week-summary-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px; cursor:pointer; }
.week-summary-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.week-summary-chev{ color:var(--muted); display:flex; }
.week-summary-body{ display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:14px; cursor:pointer; }
.week-summary-body:active, .week-summary-head:active{ opacity:0.7; }
.wk-bars{ display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0; }
.wk-bar-col{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; width:16px; }
.wk-bar-track{ height:36px; width:8px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; }
.wk-bar-fill{ width:100%; border-radius:4px; background:var(--accent-soft); transition:height .5s var(--ease-out); }
.wk-bar-fill.is-today{ background:var(--accent); }
.wk-bar-fill.is-anchor{ background:var(--ink); }
.wk-bar-fill.future{ background:var(--line); opacity:0.6; }
.wk-bar-dow{ font-size:9px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; }
.wk-bar-dow.is-today{ color:var(--accent); }
.wk-bar-dow.is-anchor{ color:var(--ink); }
.week-summary-stats{ display:flex; flex:1; justify-content:space-around; gap:6px; border-left:1px solid var(--line); padding-left:14px; }
.week-summary-stats .wk-stat{ text-align:center; }
.week-summary-stats .wk-stat .v{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.week-summary-stats .wk-stat .l{ font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.02em; margin-top:2px; }

/* ============================================================
   FOCUS CARD — "what the timetable says right now", expanded
   inline on Home. Same surface language as the week-summary
   card above it (border + shadow-sm), but the header uses the
   accent dot from the old clock-strip so the two still read as
   part of one system.
   ============================================================ */
.focus-card{
  margin:12px 16px 4px;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.focus-head{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:13px 16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.focus-time-wrap{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; flex-shrink:0; }
.focus-time{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:13px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); white-space:nowrap; }
.focus-task{ flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.focus-tt-link{ border:0; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--muted); width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
.focus-tt-link:active{ transform:scale(0.9); }

.focus-card-title-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:14px 16px 0; }
.focus-card-title{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink); }
.focus-card-body{ padding:14px 16px 16px; }
.focus-card-body .field-card:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }

.focus-idle{ padding:32px 20px 26px; text-align:center; }
.focus-idle-quote{
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:20px; font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.35;
}
.focus-idle-map-link{
  margin:18px auto 0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); background:var(--surface-2);
  border:none; border-radius:var(--r-pill); padding:9px 14px; max-width:100%;
}
.focus-idle-map-link span{ overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.focus-idle-map-link:active{ transform:scale(.97); }

/* "Everything else" collapsible — everything that isn't the
   time-anchored focus card lives behind one tap so the focus
   card is genuinely the thing the eye lands on. */
.home-rest-toggle{
  width:calc(100% - 32px); margin:14px 16px 0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:13px 16px; background:none; border:1px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-md); color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; font-size:13px;
}
.home-rest-toggle:active{ opacity:0.7; }
.home-rest-chev{ display:flex; transition:transform .2s var(--ease-out); }
.home-rest-chev.open{ transform:rotate(90deg); }
.home-rest-body{ display:none; }
.home-rest-body.open{ display:block; }

/* ============================================================
   READING / LIBRARY
   ============================================================ */
.lib-current-card{
  margin:0 0 16px;
  padding:16px;
  background:var(--surface-2);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.lib-current-top{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:12px; }
.lib-current-kicker{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--muted); }
.lib-archive-link{ border:0; background:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:var(--accent); padding:4px 0; }
.lib-current-stats{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; }
.lib-current-stats > div{ text-align:center; flex:1; }
.lib-current-stats .v{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.lib-current-stats .l{ font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:2px; }
.finish-book-btn{
  width:100%; margin-top:6px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px;
  padding:14px; border-radius:var(--r-sm); border:1px solid var(--green);
  background:var(--green-soft); color:var(--green); font-weight:800; font-size:14px;
  transition:transform .14s var(--ease);
}
.finish-book-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }

.lib-book-grid{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.lib-book-card{
  padding:14px 15px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.lib-book-current{ border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent) inset, var(--shadow-sm); margin-bottom:6px; }
.lib-book-top{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; }
.lib-book-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14.5px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:1.3; }
.lib-book-author{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.lib-book-stats{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:6px; margin-top:12px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.lib-book-stats > div{ text-align:center; flex:1; }
.lib-book-stats .v{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:15px; }
.lib-book-stats .l{ font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:2px; }
.lib-book-finished-on{ margin-top:10px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; }
.lib-continue-btn{
  width:100%; margin-top:12px; padding:10px; border-radius:12px; border:0;
  background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); font-weight:800; font-size:13px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px;
}
.lib-continue-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.lib-delete-btn{ border:0; background:none; color:var(--muted); padding:4px; flex-shrink:0; }
.lib-newbook-link{ border:0; background:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; color:var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; padding:4px 0 18px; }
.crow-done-toggle{ border:0; background:none; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; padding:10px 2px 2px; }
.lib-empty-current{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:18px 16px; margin-bottom:16px;
  background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-md); color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.lib-empty-current b{ display:block; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:2px; }

/* Confirm sheets (finish book / delete / start new) */
.confirm-body{ padding:4px 4px 6px; }
.confirm-body p{ font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0 0 18px; }
.confirm-danger-btn{
  width:100%; padding:14px; border:0; border-radius:var(--r-sm); background:var(--red); color:#fff;
  font-weight:800; font-size:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; margin-bottom:8px;
}
.confirm-danger-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.confirm-cancel-btn{ width:100%; padding:14px; border:0; border-radius:var(--r-sm); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; }
.confirm-cancel-btn:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }


textarea.freewrite, textarea.growfield{
  width:100%; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:var(--bg);
  padding:12px 14px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; resize:vertical; min-height:72px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm); color:var(--ink);
  transition:border-color .15s;
}
textarea.freewrite:focus, textarea.growfield:focus, input.textline:focus{ outline:none; border-color:var(--accent); }
input.textline{
  width:100%; border:none; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line); background:transparent;
  padding:9px 2px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink);
  transition:border-color .15s;
}
input.numline{
  border:none; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line); background:transparent;
  padding:6px 2px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; width:74px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink);
  transition:border-color .15s;
}
input.numline:focus{ outline:none; border-color:var(--accent); }

/* Tap-checklist rows */
.check-row{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;
  padding:12px 2px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.check-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.checkbox{
  width:26px; height:26px; border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:var(--bg);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), background .15s, border-color .15s;
}
.checkbox:active{ transform:scale(0.88); }
.checkbox svg{ width:15px; height:15px; opacity:0; transform:scale(0.6); transition:opacity .15s, transform .15s;}
.checkbox.checked{ background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); }
.checkbox.checked svg{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); stroke:var(--accent-ink); }
.check-row .crow-text{ flex:1; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; }
.check-row.struck .crow-text{ text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--muted); }
.check-row input.textline{ border-bottom:none; font-weight:500; }
.check-row input.textline:disabled, .check-row button.pill:disabled{ opacity:0.55; }

/* Star / scale tappers */
.scale-row{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:4px; }
.scale-dot{
  flex:1; height:38px; border:none; border-radius:11px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700;
  transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s, color .15s;
}
.scale-dot:active{ transform:scale(0.9); }
.scale-dot.active{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); }
.scale-dot.active.red{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }

/* Segmented tapper (mood / status pills) */
.pill-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
.pill{
  padding:10px 16px; border:none; border-radius:var(--r-pill); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft);
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700;
  transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s, color .15s;
}
.pill:active{ transform:scale(0.94); }
.pill.active{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); }
.pill.active.red{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }
.pill.active.green{ background:var(--green); color:#fff; }

/* Stepper / counter */
.counter-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; }
.counter-btn{
  width:42px; height:42px; border:none; border-radius:14px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink);
  font-size:20px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.counter-btn:active{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); transform:scale(0.9); }
.counter-val{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:26px; font-weight:800; min-width:74px; text-align:center; }
.counter-input{
  border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); padding:4px 0;
  flex:1; min-width:0;
}
.counter-input:focus{ outline:none; }
.counter-row{ position:relative; }
.counter-suffix{ font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin-left:-8px; }

/* Table-like repeaters */
.log-table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px; }
.log-table th{
  text-align:left; font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.03em; color:var(--muted);
  padding:0 6px 10px 0; font-weight:700;
}
.log-table td{ padding:9px 6px 9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:middle; }
.log-table input{
  width:100%; border:none; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface-2);
  font-size:13px; padding:7px 6px; font-weight:600; border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; color:var(--ink);
}
.log-table input:focus{ outline:none; background:var(--surface-2); }
.log-table input:disabled{ opacity:0.55; color:var(--muted); }
.log-table .rm-row{ width:22px; height:22px; border:none; background:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:16px; }

/* Disappearing checked items — Apple Reminders style. Applied to
   both <tr> log rows (exercise log) and .check-row (bucket list,
   dashboard objectives, etc.). The row briefly shows its checked
   state, then collapses height/opacity/margin together so
   whatever's below slides up into the gap, then render() drops it
   from the DOM entirely once the animation finishes. */
tr.row-completing, .check-row.row-completing{
  animation: rowComplete .26s var(--ease-out) forwards;
  overflow:hidden;
}
@keyframes rowComplete{
  0%{ opacity:1; }
  40%{ opacity:0.3; }
  100%{ opacity:0; transform:scale(0.97); max-height:0; padding-top:0; padding-bottom:0; margin:0; }
}
tr.row-completing td{ padding-top:0; padding-bottom:0; transition:padding .22s var(--ease-out) .04s; }

/* Load-a-preset row above the exercise/reading-style tables */
.preset-load-row{ display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:12px; }

/* Bottom-sheet preset picker rows (workout, and reused by the book
   library picker) */
.preset-pick-row{
  width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;
  background:var(--surface-2); border:none; border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:13px 14px; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink);
  transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s;
}
.preset-pick-row:active{ transform:scale(0.98); background:var(--accent-soft); }
.preset-pick-name{ font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; }
.preset-pick-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }

/* Preset builder (Workout Presets setup page) exercise rows */
.preset-ex-row{ display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px; }
.preset-ex-row input.textline{ flex:1; border-bottom:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:9px; padding:8px 10px; font-size:13px; }
.preset-ex-row input.numline{ border:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:9px; padding:8px 6px; font-size:13px; text-align:center; }
.add-row-btn{
  margin-top:12px; width:100%; padding:12px; border:none; border-radius:var(--r-sm); background:var(--surface-2);
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px;
  transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s;
}
.add-row-btn:active{ background:var(--line); transform:scale(0.97); }

.progress-track{ height:16px; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-pill); position:relative; overflow:hidden; margin-top:10px;}
.progress-fill{ height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #F5323A, var(--accent)); border-radius:var(--r-pill); transition:width .4s var(--ease-out); }
.progress-track .ptxt{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); }

.timeline-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:60px 1fr auto; gap:10px; padding:11px 0 0; align-items:center; }
.timeline-row .t-label{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted); }
.timeline-row input.textline{ font-size:13.5px; border-bottom:none; padding:7px 10px; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; }
.timeline-row.filled input.textline{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); }
.tt-remove-btn{ width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-2); border:none; color:var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
.tt-remove-btn:active{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 18%, var(--surface-2)); color:var(--red); }
.tt-focus-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:60px 1fr; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:6px 0; }
.tt-focus-row:last-of-type{ padding-bottom:11px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.tt-focus-lbl{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap; }
.tt-focus-row select{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface-2); border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:7px 9px; width:100%; }
.tt-focus-row input.textline{ font-size:12.5px; }
.tt-add-row{ display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; margin-top:16px; }
.tt-add-time{
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface-2);
  border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:10px; flex-shrink:0; width:118px;
}

.save-toast{
  position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); transform:translate(-50%,20px);
  background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); padding:12px 22px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700;
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .25s var(--ease-out), transform .25s var(--ease-out); z-index:200;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.save-toast.show{ opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0); }
.save-toast svg{ width:15px; height:15px; color:var(--accent); }

.lane-picker{ padding:16px; }
.lane-card{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;
  background:var(--surface); border:none; border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:15px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), box-shadow .15s;
}
.lane-card:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.lane-card .lane-glyph{
  width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:15px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800;
}
.lane-card .lane-info{ flex:1; }
.lane-card .lane-name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.lane-card .lane-desc{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.35; }
.lane-card.selected{ box-shadow:0 0 0 2.5px var(--accent), var(--shadow-md); }
.lane-card.selected .lane-glyph{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }

/* ---------- Onboarding ---------- */
.onboard-screen{
  min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  background:var(--bg);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}
.onboard-top{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)) 18px 4px;
  min-height:20px;
}
.onboard-back{
  width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-2); border:none; color:var(--ink);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.onboard-skip{
  background:none; border:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; padding:8px 4px;
}
.onb-progress{ display:flex; gap:6px; padding:14px 24px 6px; }
.onb-seg{ flex:1; height:4px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--line); transition:background .25s var(--ease); }
.onb-seg.filled{ background:var(--accent); }

.onboard-body{ flex:1; padding:8px 24px 20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:0; }
.onboard-hero{ align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; flex:1; }
.onboard-mark{
  width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:20px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:20px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.onb-eyebrow{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:8px; }
.onb-title{
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:28px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.08; letter-spacing:-0.02em;
  margin:0 0 8px;
}
.onb-sub{ font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; margin:0 0 18px; }
.onb-scroll{ flex:1; overflow-y:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; min-height:0; }
.onb-preview{ margin-top:24px; text-align:left; width:100%; max-width:280px; }
.onb-preview-row{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft);
  padding:9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.onb-preview-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.onb-preview-num{
  width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink);
  font-size:11px; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
}

.onboard-actions{ padding:12px 24px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.onboard-cta{
  width:100%; padding:17px; border:none; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink);
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:16px; font-weight:800;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), opacity .15s;
}
.onboard-cta:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.onboard-cta:disabled{ opacity:0.4; box-shadow:none; }
.onboard-ghost{
  width:100%; padding:14px; border:none; background:none; color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;
}

.onb-radio-card{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; width:100%; text-align:left;
  background:var(--surface); border:1.5px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:15px;
  margin-bottom:10px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease), border-color .15s;
}
.onb-radio-card:active{ transform:scale(0.98); }
.onb-radio-card.selected{ border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); }
.onb-radio-card .lane-glyph{
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:13px; font-weight:800;
}
.onb-radio-card.selected .lane-glyph{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }
.onb-radio-card .lane-info{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
.onb-radio-card .lane-name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.onb-radio-card .lane-desc{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.35; }
.onb-radio{
  width:21px; height:21px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--line); flex-shrink:0;
  transition:border-color .15s, background .15s;
}
.onb-radio.checked{ border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3.5px var(--surface); }

.onb-tt-list{ }
.onb-tt-row{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.onb-tt-time{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); width:52px; flex-shrink:0; }
.onb-tt-input{
  flex:1; border:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:9px; padding:9px 11px;
  font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink);
}
.onb-tt-input:focus{ outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent); }
.onb-focus-row{ padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.onb-focus-top{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.onb-focus-task{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.onb-focus-select{
  width:100%; border:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:9px; padding:9px 11px;
  font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink);
}
.onb-bucket-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:7px 0; }
.onb-obj-num{
  width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent);
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}

.preset-card{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; width:100%; text-align:left;
  background:var(--surface); border:none; border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:16px;
  margin-bottom:10px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.preset-card:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.preset-icon{
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.preset-info{ flex:1; }
.preset-name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
.preset-desc{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.35; }

.empty-note{ text-align:center; padding:48px 24px; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; }

.month-tag{
  display:inline-block; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em;
  color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); padding:5px 11px; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.locked-banner{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:var(--green-soft); border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:16px;
}
.locked-icon{
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); color:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.locked-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink); }
.locked-sub{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.locked-item-row{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:10px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:13.5px;
}
.locked-item-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.muted-inline{ color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; flex-shrink:0; }
.strike{ text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--muted); }
.locked-tile{ opacity:0.75; }
.locked-tile .tile-icon{ background:var(--green-soft); color:var(--green); }

.seg-control{
  display:flex; gap:4px; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  padding:4px; margin:12px 16px 6px;
}
.seg-control button{
  flex:1; border:none; background:none; padding:9px 0; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.seg-control button.active{ background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }

.month-nav{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 16px 10px; }
.month-nav button{ width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-2); border:none; color:var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.month-nav button svg{ width:16px; height:16px; }
.month-nav-label{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }

/* A 2-way segmented control for the Tracker's Month/Year switch.
   This used to be a horizontally-scrolling pill row built for 4
   tabs of uneven width (Overview/Bucket List/Income/Goals); with
   only Month and Year left, that same markup read as an
   accidentally-narrow row with dead space on the right rather than
   a deliberate control. A fixed-width, equal-split segmented
   control is the correct shape for exactly two mutually exclusive
   choices, and doesn't need the scroll affordance at all. */
.tracker-tabs{
  display:flex; gap:3px; margin:0 16px 14px; padding:3px;
  background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-pill);
}
.tracker-tab{
  flex:1; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted);
  background:transparent; border:none; border-radius:calc(var(--r-pill) - 3px);
  padding:9px 14px; transition:color .15s, background .15s, transform .12s var(--ease);
}
.tracker-tab:active{ transform:scale(.97); }
.tracker-tab.active{ color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
.assist .tracker-tab{ font-size:14.5px; padding:12px 14px; }

.heat-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); }
.heat-cell{
  aspect-ratio:1; border:none; border-radius:7px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--ink);
}
.heat-cell.lvl0{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--muted); }
.heat-cell.lvl1{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); }
.heat-cell.lvl2{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, var(--accent-soft)); color:#fff; }
.heat-cell.lvl3{ background:var(--accent); color:#fff; }
.heat-cell.future{ background:none; color:var(--line); }
.heat-legend{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; justify-content:flex-end; margin-top:10px; font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); }
.heat-legend .heat-cell{ border-radius:3px; }

/* Value heatmap ("dh" = day heatmap) — a calendar grid shaded by a
   day's own number rather than by 0/1/2-3/4+ activity buckets like
   the Consistency heatmap above. This is the general-purpose version:
   any day-series (steps, pages, dollars, priorities cleared) can be
   drawn as a grid instead of a bar chart. Deliberately its own class
   family, not a reuse of .heat-cell — that one is fixed to 4 levels
   tied to --accent, and this one takes a per-metric colour and a
   5-step scale computed from that metric's own range for the month,
   the same way a token-usage or contribution graph shades by the
   actual busiest day rather than a hardcoded ceiling. */
.dh-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:4px;
}
.dh-cell{
  aspect-ratio:1; min-height:0; border:none; border-radius:6px;
  font-size:10px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface-2);
}
.dh-cell.dh-empty{ background:none; }
.dh-cell.dh-future{ background:none; color:var(--line); }
.dh-cell.dh-0{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--muted); }
/* Levels 1-4 are painted inline per chart (style="background:...")
   since the colour itself varies by metric — steps and dollars don't
   share a hue — only the *lightness ramp* is fixed here, four fixed
   mix ratios of that colour against the card surface so every metric
   gets the same visual step size regardless of which colour it uses. */
.dh-legend{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:12px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); }
.dh-legend .dh-chip{ width:13px; height:13px; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0; }
.dh-legend-scale{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px; }
.assist .dh-cell{ font-size:11.5px; border-radius:8px; }

/* Year heatmap ("yh") — twelve mini month-calendars, laid out in a
   single CSS grid whose column count changes by breakpoint (3 on
   phone, up to 6 on desktop — see the media queries below). This
   replaced an earlier two-layout version: a phone grid plus a
   separate "continuous strip" for desktop built with a flex row of
   fixed-width month-bands. That flex row's total natural width
   (~710px for 12 months) was WIDER than the card holding it even at
   a comfortable desktop width (~688px), because flex sizes itself
   from its children's content, not from the container. Past a
   certain viewport it forced the whole page to scroll sideways and
   pushed the bottom nav out of its dock — a real, confirmed layout
   break, not a sizing preference. A CSS grid has no equivalent
   failure mode: every column's width is a fraction of the actual
   container width, always, so this cannot overflow regardless of
   viewport or how many months there are. */
.yh-year-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:14px 8px;
}
.yh-month-name{ font-size:10px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.03em; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:center; }
.yh-month-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:1.5px; }
.yh-cell{
  width:100%; aspect-ratio:1; border:none; border-radius:2.5px; padding:0;
  background:var(--surface-2); min-height:0;
}
.yh-cell.yh-empty{ background:none; pointer-events:none; }
.yh-cell.yh-future{ background:none; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 70%, transparent); pointer-events:none; }
.yh-cell.yh-0{ background:var(--surface-2); }
/* Press feedback on every heatmap cell type, month or year. On a
   touch device :hover never fires, so this — not the month grid's
   existing hover-only outline — is what actually tells someone
   these tiny squares are tappable buttons rather than a static
   image. Applies to .dh-cell (single-month heatmap) too, which
   previously had no feedback of any kind. */
.dh-cell:not(.dh-empty):not(.dh-future):active,
.heat-cell:not(.heat-cell-empty):not(.future):active,
.yh-cell:not(.yh-empty):not(.yh-future):active{
  transform:scale(.88); transition:transform .1s var(--ease);
}
.assist .yh-year-grid{ gap:18px 10px; }
.assist .yh-month-name{ font-size:11.5px; }
.assist .yh-month-grid{ gap:2px; }

.history-list{ padding:0 16px; }
.hist-item{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:14px; border-radius:var(--r-md); cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--surface); margin-bottom:10px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.hist-item:active{ transform:scale(0.97); }
.hist-item .hist-date{ width:48px; flex-shrink:0; text-align:center; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:12px; padding:8px 0; }
.hist-item .hist-date .dd{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:18px; font-weight:800; line-height:1; }
.hist-item .hist-date .mo{ font-size:9.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; margin-top:2px; }
.hist-item .hist-body{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
.hist-item .hist-pages{ font-size:13px; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.hist-item .hist-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px; }
.hist-item .chev{ width:16px; height:16px; color:var(--muted); flex-shrink:0; }

.bottom-tabs{
  position:fixed; bottom:14px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  width:calc(100% - 32px); max-width:488px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 82%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
  display:flex; z-index:50; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  padding:6px;
  margin-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}
.bottom-tabs button{
  flex:1; background:none; border:none; color:var(--on-ink-soft); padding:10px 4px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:3px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  transition:color .2s, background .2s;
}
.bottom-tabs button.active{ color:var(--on-ink); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-ink) 12%, transparent); }
.bottom-tabs button svg{ width:20px; height:20px; }

.gap-block{ height:24px; }

.two-col{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; }
.stat-mini{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); padding:14px 16px; border-radius:var(--r-md); }
.stat-mini .sv{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:20px; font-weight:800; }
.stat-mini .sl{ font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--on-ink-soft); margin-top:3px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.03em; }

/* page transition */
#app.route-anim > *:not(.bottom-tabs):not(.save-toast){ animation:pageIn .3s var(--ease-out); }
@keyframes pageIn{
  from{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); }
  to{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *{ animation-duration:0.01ms !important; transition-duration:0.01ms !important; }
}

@media (max-width:400px){
  .home-hero .headline{ font-size:23px; }
}

/* ---------- Modal / bottom sheet ---------- */
.sheet-backdrop{
  position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(10,8,7,0.5); z-index:90;
  display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center;
  animation:fadeIn .2s var(--ease-out);
}
.sheet{
  background:var(--bg); width:100%; max-width:520px; border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;
  padding:8px 16px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  max-height:min(82vh,720px); overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden;
  overscroll-behavior:contain; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  touch-action:pan-y; scrollbar-gutter:stable;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:sheetUp .25s var(--ease-out);
}
@keyframes sheetUp{ from{ transform:translateY(24px); opacity:0.6; } to{ transform:translateY(0); opacity:1; } }
.sheet-grabber{ width:36px; height:4px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--line); margin:6px auto 14px; }
.sheet-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:18px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0 2px 14px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
.sheet-close{ width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); border:none; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.sheet-close svg{ width:15px; height:15px; }

.cal-head{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:0 2px 10px; }
.cal-eyebrow{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:3px; }
.cal-selected-label{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:16px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.015em; color:var(--ink); }
.cal-today-chip{ border:none; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); border-radius:var(--r-pill); padding:8px 11px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap; }
.cal-nav{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; padding:4px 0 12px; }
.cal-nav-btn{ width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); flex-shrink:0; }
.cal-nav-btn:active{ transform:scale(.93); background:var(--surface-2); }
.cal-monthyear-btn{
  flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px; min-width:0;
  border:none; background:none; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:15px; font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink); padding:8px 4px; border-radius:12px;
}
.cal-monthyear-btn:active{ background:var(--surface-2); }
.cal-monthyear-caret{ transform:rotate(90deg); color:var(--muted); flex-shrink:0; transition:transform .18s var(--ease-out); }
.cal-period-selectors{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 0 12px; animation:fadeIn .15s var(--ease-out); }
.cal-period-select{
  appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink);
  border-radius:12px; padding:9px 28px 9px 11px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:12.5px;
  font-weight:800; min-width:0; outline:none; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  background-image:linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--muted) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg, var(--muted) 50%, transparent 50%);
  background-position:calc(100% - 12px) 50%,calc(100% - 8px) 50%; background-size:4px 4px,4px 4px; background-repeat:no-repeat;
}
.cal-period-select:focus{ border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.cal-month-select{ flex:1; max-width:150px; }
.cal-year-select{ width:96px; }
.cal-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:4px; margin-bottom:12px;
  touch-action:pan-y; overscroll-behavior:contain;
  user-select:none;
}
.cal-dow{ text-align:center; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; padding-bottom:5px; }
.cal-day{
  aspect-ratio:1; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:14px; color:var(--ink);
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px;
  position:relative; transition:transform .12s var(--ease), background .15s, color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
.cal-day:not(.cal-day-empty):active{ transform:scale(.91); }
.cal-day:not(.selected):not(.cal-day-empty):hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
.cal-day-empty{ pointer-events:none; }
.cal-day .cdot{ width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); position:absolute; bottom:5px; }
.cal-day.today{ box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent); }
.cal-day.today .cdot{ bottom:4px; }
.cal-day.selected{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); }
.cal-day.selected .cdot{ background:var(--accent); }
.cal-day.is-adjacent{ color:var(--muted); }
.cal-footer{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding-top:2px; }
.cal-footer-note{ font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.35; }
.cal-today-btn{ flex-shrink:0; border:none; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); border-radius:var(--r-pill); padding:10px 13px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; }

.settings-section{ margin:0 2px 22px; }
.settings-heading{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; color:var(--muted); padding:0 2px 8px; }
.settings-row{
  width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px;
  background:var(--surface); border:none; border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:8px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); text-align:left; transition:transform .15s var(--ease);
}
.settings-row:active{ transform:scale(0.98); }
.settings-row .sr-name{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.005em; color:var(--ink); }
.settings-row .sr-desc{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.4; }
.settings-row .sr-ico{
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:11px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
}
.settings-row .sr-ico svg{ width:16px; height:16px; }

/* ---------- Test-mode time override (tester build only) ---------- */
.test-badge{
  display:inline-block; margin-left:8px; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800;
  text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0;
}
.test-time-card{ background:var(--surface); border-radius:var(--r-md); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); padding:16px; }
.test-time-row{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:10px; }
.test-time-display{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.03em; }
.test-time-value{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:20px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink); }
.test-time-slider{ width:100%; accent-color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; }
.test-jump-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.test-jump-chip{
  border:none; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  padding:6px 10px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700;
}
.test-jump-chip.active{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }
.settings-row.danger .sr-name{ color:var(--red); }
.settings-row.danger .sr-ico{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--red); }

.confirm-actions{ display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:6px; }
.confirm-actions button{ flex:1; padding:13px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; border:none; }
.confirm-cancel{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); }
.confirm-danger{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; }

.copy-yday-btn{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft);
  border:none; border-radius:var(--r-pill); padding:8px 13px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.copy-yday-btn svg{ width:13px; height:13px; }
</style>

<style>
/* ---------- Product polish pass ---------- */
:root{
  --r-xl:28px;
  --ring-track:rgba(255,255,255,.24);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%, color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-soft) 26%,transparent), transparent 32%),var(--bg);}
#app{padding-bottom:calc(128px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));}
.topbar{padding-top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));}
.topbar .title{font-size:15px;}
.home-hero{margin-top:8px;padding:22px 20px 20px;border-radius:30px;}
.home-hero .headline{font-size:25px;max-width:340px;}
.week-summary-ringrow{gap:8px;}
.week-summary-ringrow .streak-box{padding:9px 11px;}
.week-strip-row{padding:14px 14px 2px;gap:8px;}
.week-strip-row .week-strip{gap:7px;overflow:visible;}
.week-day{min-width:38px;padding:9px 4px 7px;border-radius:15px;}
.week-day.today{background:var(--ink);}
.week-day.selected:not(.today){box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent),var(--shadow-sm);}
.week-day .dots{margin-top:6px;}
.jump-date-btn{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;}
.today-chip{border:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 14px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}
.today-chip:active{transform:scale(.96);}
.today-chip svg{width:13px;height:13px;}

.nextup-card{margin-top:12px;padding:15px 16px;border-radius:20px;}
.nextup-btn{padding:10px 16px;}
.section-label{padding:20px 16px 10px;}
.page-grid{gap:10px;}
.page-tile{min-height:118px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 70%,transparent);border-radius:20px;padding:15px;overflow:hidden;}
.page-tile .tile-icon{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;}
.page-tile .tile-name{font-size:14px;}
.page-tile .tile-status{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.page-tile.done{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--green) 28%,var(--line));}
.page-tile::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto -20px -30px auto;width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-soft) 75%,transparent),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;}
.field-card{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 65%,transparent);border-radius:20px;}
.settings-row{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 62%,transparent);padding:15px 16px;}
.bottom-tabs{bottom:10px;width:calc(100% - 24px);max-width:500px;padding:5px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 96%,transparent);}
.bottom-tabs button{padding:10px 4px;}
.sheet-backdrop{backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);}
.sheet{border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 70%,transparent);}
.cal-nav{padding-bottom:10px;}
.cal-nav .cal-month{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface-2);}
.cal-day{border-radius:14px;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .14s,color .14s;}
.cal-day:not(.cal-day-empty):active{transform:scale(.9);}
.cal-day.selected{box-shadow:0 3px 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 20%,transparent);}
.cal-day.today:not(.selected){box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent);}

/* Tracker: compress repeated cards into a cleaner dashboard rhythm. */
.tracker-kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;padding:0 16px 12px;}
.tracker-kpi{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px 15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.tracker-kpi .v{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.tracker-kpi .l{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-top:3px;}

/* Accessibility + effortless-use layer. The default remains compact, while
   Assist Mode deliberately favors larger targets, simpler grouping, and less
   precision-dependent interaction. */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{touch-action:pan-y;}
button,input,textarea,select{min-height:44px;}
button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;}
.app-skip{position:fixed;left:12px;top:12px;z-index:500;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-ink);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;transform:translateY(-140%);transition:transform .18s var(--ease-out);box-shadow:none;visibility:hidden;}
.app-skip:focus{transform:translateY(0);visibility:visible;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;}
#app{outline:none;}
[aria-label],[title]{ }
.cal-day:focus-visible,.week-day:focus-visible,.page-tile:focus-visible,.bottom-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;}
.checkbox{cursor:pointer;}

.assist-toggle{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(88px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));z-index:70;width:52px;height:52px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 75%,transparent);border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transition:transform .15s var(--ease),background .15s,color .15s,opacity .28s var(--ease-out);}
.assist-toggle:active{transform:scale(.92);}
.assist-toggle.active{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent);}
.assist-toggle::after{content:'Assist Mode';position:absolute;right:56px;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-ink);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(5px);transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s;}
.assist-toggle:focus-visible::after,.assist-toggle:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}

.assist .home-hero .day-quote{display:none;}
.assist .home-hero{padding-bottom:18px;}
.assist .week-strip-row{padding-top:16px;}
.assist .week-day{min-width:46px;min-height:64px;padding:11px 5px 9px;}
.assist .jump-date-btn{width:48px;height:48px;}
.assist .section-label{font-size:17px;padding-top:24px;}
.assist .page-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px;}
.assist .page-tile{min-height:86px;padding:17px 18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:50px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
.assist .page-tile .tile-top{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;}
.assist .page-tile .tile-icon{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:15px;}
.assist .page-tile > div:last-child{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;}
.assist .page-tile .tile-name{font-size:16px;}
.assist .page-tile .tile-status{font-size:12.5px;margin-top:5px;}
.assist .page-tile .check-badge{top:50%;right:16px;transform:translateY(-50%);width:30px;height:30px;}
.assist .field-card{padding:20px;border-radius:22px;}
.assist .fc-label{font-size:16px;}
.assist .fc-hint{font-size:13px;}
.assist .pill{min-height:50px;padding:12px 18px;font-size:14px;}
.assist .scale-dot{min-height:48px;font-size:14px;}
.assist .counter-btn{width:50px;height:50px;}
.assist .counter-val{font-size:29px;min-width:84px;min-height:50px;}
.assist input.textline,.assist input.numline,.assist textarea.freewrite,.assist textarea.growfield{font-size:16px;}
.assist textarea.freewrite,.assist textarea.growfield{min-height:110px;}
.assist .check-row{padding:15px 2px;gap:14px;}
.assist .checkbox{width:32px;height:32px;border-width:2.5px;border-radius:10px;}
.assist .check-row .crow-text{font-size:16px;}
.assist .bottom-tabs{bottom:8px;padding:7px;}
.assist .bottom-tabs button{min-height:58px;padding:12px 4px;font-size:11.5px;}
.assist .bottom-tabs button svg{width:23px;height:23px;}
.assist .assist-toggle{bottom:104px;width:54px;height:54px;}
.assist .topbar{padding-top:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));padding-bottom:14px;}
.assist .topbar .title{font-size:18px;}
.assist .topbar .back,.assist .theme-toggle{min-height:44px;}
.assist .sheet{max-height:88vh;padding-bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));}
.assist .cal-period-select{min-height:48px;font-size:14px;}
.assist .cal-day{min-height:46px;font-size:14px;}
.assist .cal-footer-note{font-size:12px;}

@media (prefers-contrast: more){
  .page-tile,.field-card,.settings-row,.tracker-kpi{border-width:2px;}
  .muted-inline,.muted,.fc-hint,.tile-status{color:var(--ink-soft);}
}

@media (max-width:380px){
  .assist .page-tile{grid-template-columns:46px 1fr auto;}
}

/* Desktop-ish width gets stronger breathing room without changing mobile rhythm. */

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE SHELL — phone, tablet, desktop
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Everything above this point was written for one width: a
   phone, with #app capped at 520px and centred. On anything
   wider — an iPad, a laptop browser — that meant a phone-width
   column with dead space on both sides. This block is the fix,
   in three tiers:

     - up to 719px  (phone):            unchanged, exactly as shipped
     - 720px-1099px (tablet, portrait
                     or a small laptop): #app widens, page-grid
                     goes to 3 columns, KPIs go to 4
     - 1100px+      (tablet landscape,
                     desktop):           bottom tabs become a
                     persistent side rail; #app stops being a
                     single centred column

   The bottom-tab-bar pattern is a phone idiom — thumb reach on a
   one-handed device. On an iPad in landscape or a desktop window,
   a floating pill parked at the bottom of a 1400px-tall viewport
   reads as a mistake, not a nav bar. Past 1100px it moves to a
   fixed left rail instead. Nothing about the underlying routing
   changes — renderBottomNav's markup is reused as-is and just
   repositioned by CSS; see the JS section below for the one
   structural addition (a body class) that makes that possible.
   ============================================================ */

@media (min-width:720px){
  body{ background-attachment:fixed; }
  #app{
    max-width:640px;
    box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  }
  .page-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
  .assist .page-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
  .tracker-kpi-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); }
  .lib-book-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
  /* Year heatmap gets more grid columns once there's room — still
     the exact same grid, never a different layout, so this can only
     ever redistribute the 12 months more widely, never overflow. */
  .yh-year-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); }
  /* Sheets no longer need to touch the viewport edge on a wide
     canvas — floating them reads as a dialog, which is what they
     are, instead of a phone action-sheet stretched onto glass. */
  .sheet-backdrop{ padding-bottom:24px; }
  .sheet{ border-radius:24px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
}

@media (min-width:1100px){
  html{ overflow-y:scroll; }
  /* Real flex layout, not calc() guesses. The rail and #app are
     laid out as actual siblings inside .app-shell (see the JS
     section for the wrapper this requires) so the rail's position
     is however flexbox places it, not a `left: 50% - half of a
     guessed #app width - rail width` formula.
     That formula is exactly what caused the bug this replaces: at
     any viewport from 1100px up to ~1180px, `50% - 360px - 220px`
     goes negative and pushes the entire rail off the left edge of
     the screen — while the same breakpoint has just hidden the
     bottom tab bar. The result was both navs disappearing at once,
     which is the "expanded the tab and navigation disappeared
     entirely" bug: an 11" iPad in landscape (1194px) and a huge
     range of ordinary desktop/split-view widths sit inside that
     dead zone. Flex layout has no dead zone to sit inside — the
     rail is always exactly as wide as it declares itself and
     always immediately left of #app, at every width from here up. */
  .app-shell{
    display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center;
    min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh; gap:0;
  }
  #app{ max-width:720px; margin:0; }
  .side-rail{ display:flex; position:sticky; top:0; }
  .bottom-tabs{ display:none; }
  .assist-toggle{ position:fixed; left:24px; right:auto; bottom:24px; }
  .yh-year-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); }
}

/* Persistent left rail — the desktop/landscape-tablet replacement
   for .bottom-tabs. Built from the same nav items so the two can
   never drift apart; see renderSideRail in the JS section. It's
   `display:none` below 1100px and swapped on above, rather than
   being two independently-maintained nav components.
   `position:sticky` (set in the 1100px block above) plus a real
   flex slot in .app-shell — not `position:fixed` with a computed
   `left` — so its position always follows from actual layout,
   never from a guess about where #app happens to sit. */
.side-rail{
  display:none;
  width:220px; flex-shrink:0;
  height:100vh; height:100dvh; align-self:flex-start;
  flex-direction:column; gap:2px; padding:28px 14px; overflow-y:auto;
}
.side-rail-brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 10px 22px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); }
.side-rail-brand .mark{ width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:9px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
.side-rail button{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:13px;
  font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); background:none; border:none;
  text-align:left; min-height:44px;
}
.side-rail button svg{ flex-shrink:0; width:19px; height:19px; }
.side-rail button.active{ background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
.side-rail button:hover{ color:var(--ink); }
.side-rail-spacer{ flex:1; }
.side-rail .assist-toggle-rail{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:13px;
  font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); background:none; border:1px solid var(--line);
  min-height:44px;
}
.side-rail .assist-toggle-rail.active{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); border-color:var(--accent); }

@media (max-width:1099px){
  .side-rail{ display:none !important; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Tablet/desktop pointer support. Everything above this file was
   authored for touch: no hover states existed anywhere, and
   nothing distinguished a mouse from a finger. `hover: hover`
   only matches devices that actually have a hover-capable
   pointer, so a touchscreen tablet in this same breakpoint range
   doesn't get a permanent "hover" look stuck on the last-tapped
   element.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .page-tile:hover{ box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); transform:translateY(-1px); }
  .settings-row:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
  .heat-cell:not(.heat-cell-empty):not(.future):hover{ outline:1.5px solid var(--ink-soft); outline-offset:1px; }
  .week-day:not(.today):hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
  .bottom-tabs button:hover{ color:var(--ink); }
  button:hover{ cursor:pointer; }
  button:disabled:hover{ cursor:not-allowed; }
}

/* Large-format phones/small tablets in landscape land at exactly
