   this awkward width — wide enough that the 2-column page grid
   looks sparse, not wide enough for the 3-column tablet layout.
   Splitting it out rather than lowering the 720px breakpoint,
   because 720px in portrait is a deliberate "this is basically a
   tablet" cutoff and shouldn't move. */
@media (min-width:620px) and (max-width:719px) and (orientation:landscape){
  #app{ max-width:600px; }
  .page-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
}

/* ============================================================
   TRACKER CHART SYSTEM
   Every chart is a plain inline <svg> built by the functions in
   the CHART TOOLKIT section of the script — no library, no
   canvas. The rules the whole system follows:
     - Every chart names its own units, in the header.
     - Every axis is labelled with real numbers.
     - Every chart carries a stat strip (total / avg / best) so
       the numbers are readable even if the shape isn't.
     - Category colour is never the only signal: legends always
       repeat the label, the count and the percentage.
   ============================================================ */

/* Categorical series palette. Kept as its own ramp (not the brand
   accent alone) so a 5-slice mood donut doesn't turn into five
   shades of the same red, and re-declared for dark mode so every
   swatch stays above 4.5:1 on the dark surface. */
:root{
  --ch1:#E5171B; --ch2:#D98111; --ch3:#1E9E63; --ch4:#3B6FE0; --ch5:#7C4DD6; --ch6:#7C756B;
  --grid:color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 85%, transparent);
  --chart-ink:var(--muted);
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --ch1:#FF6B6E; --ch2:#F2C05C; --ch3:#5CDBA0; --ch4:#8FB0FF; --ch5:#C3A6FF; --ch6:#A79E92;
  --grid:color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 90%, transparent);
}

.chart-card{
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 65%,transparent);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:15px 14px 13px;
  margin:0 16px 12px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
}
.chart-head{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-bottom:2px; }
.chart-title{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--ink); }
.chart-unit{
  font-size:10px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em;
  color:var(--muted); background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:var(--r-pill);
  padding:4px 9px; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0;
}
.chart-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.4; margin-top:2px; }

/* Stat strip — the "so what" numbers, always directly above the
   drawing so the chart never has to be decoded to be useful. */
.chart-stats{ display:flex; gap:8px; margin:12px 0 10px; }
.chart-stat{ flex:1; min-width:0; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:13px; padding:9px 10px; }
.chart-stat .v{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:16.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.1; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.chart-stat .l{ font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--muted); margin-top:4px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.chart-stat.pos .v{ color:var(--green); }
.chart-stat.neg .v{ color:var(--red); }

.chart-svg{ display:block; width:100%; height:auto; }
.chart-svg text{ font-family:var(--font-body); }
.chart-axis-label{ font-size:9px; font-weight:700; fill:var(--chart-ink); }
.chart-tick{ font-size:9px; font-weight:700; fill:var(--chart-ink); }
.chart-callout{ font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800; fill:var(--ink); }
.chart-grid-line{ stroke:var(--grid); stroke-width:1; }
.chart-zero-line{ stroke:var(--muted); stroke-width:1.2; }
.chart-avg-line{ stroke:var(--ink-soft); stroke-width:1.2; stroke-dasharray:4 3; opacity:0.75; }

.chart-note{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.45; margin-top:10px; }
.chart-note b{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:700; }
.chart-empty{
  text-align:center; padding:26px 16px; color:var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.5;
  background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:14px;
}

/* Legend — label + count + share on every row, so the chart is
   still readable in greyscale or by someone who can't separate
   two hues. */
.chart-legend{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; margin-top:12px; }
.legend-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 60%,transparent); }
.legend-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
.legend-swatch{ width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:3.5px; flex-shrink:0; }
.legend-label{ flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.legend-val{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--font-display); flex-shrink:0; }
.legend-pct{ font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); width:38px; text-align:right; flex-shrink:0; }

/* Horizontal labelled bars — used for the mood / mental-state
   breakdowns and the objective progress bullets. This is the CSS
   the old .bar-breakdown markup referenced but never had, which
   is why the mood rows used to render as three bare divs with no
   bar in them at all. */
.bar-breakdown{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; }
.bb-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:78px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:9px; }
.bb-label{ font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.bb-track{ height:12px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface-2); overflow:hidden; position:relative; }
.bb-fill{ height:100%; border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent); transition:width .5s var(--ease-out); min-width:3px; }
.bb-count{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); min-width:56px; text-align:right; white-space:nowrap; }
.bb-count .pct{ font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin-left:3px; }
.bb-target{ position:absolute; top:-2px; bottom:-2px; width:2px; background:var(--ink); opacity:.55; border-radius:1px; }

/* Consistency heatmap. The min-height:0 matters: the global
   button{min-height:44px} accessibility rule was overriding
   aspect-ratio:1 and stretching every calendar cell into a
   rectangle on narrow screens. */
.heat-cell{ min-height:0; }
.heat-scale{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:12px; }
.heat-scale-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); }
.heat-scale-chip{ width:13px; height:13px; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0; }

/* Tracker KPI cards get a third line of context under the number. */
.tracker-kpi .s{ font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; margin-top:5px; line-height:1.3; }
.tracker-kpi .v .unit{ font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:0; margin-left:2px; }
.tracker-kpi .delta{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; margin-left:5px; }
.tracker-kpi .delta.up{ color:var(--green); }
.tracker-kpi .delta.down{ color:var(--red); }

@media (prefers-contrast: more){
  .chart-card{ border-width:2px; }
  .chart-axis-label,.chart-tick{ fill:var(--ink-soft); }
  .chart-note,.legend-pct,.bb-count .pct{ color:var(--ink-soft); }
}
.assist .chart-card{ padding:18px 16px 16px; border-radius:22px; }
.assist .chart-title{ font-size:16px; }
.assist .chart-stat .v{ font-size:18px; }
.assist .chart-stat .l{ font-size:10.5px; }
.assist .legend-label,.assist .legend-val{ font-size:14px; }
.assist .bb-label,.assist .bb-count{ font-size:13.5px; }
.assist .bb-row{ grid-template-columns:90px 1fr auto; }
.assist .chart-note{ font-size:13px; }

/* ============================================================
   CUSTOM BOXES — shared styles (same block in every logbook).
   Only uses the palette tokens already defined above, so every
   theme gets contrast-checked colours for free.
   ============================================================ */
.bx-bar{ display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; margin:-2px 0 10px; }
.bx-chip{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-chip svg{ width:13px; height:13px; }
.bx-chip:active{ transform:scale(.95); }

.bx-edit-banner{ background:var(--surface); border:1.5px solid var(--accent); border-radius:20px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.bx-eb-top{ display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; }
.bx-eb-top b{ display:block; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:14px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); }
.bx-eb-top span{ display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.4; margin-top:2px; }
.bx-done{ flex:none; padding:9px 16px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:0; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-eb-name{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin-top:12px; }
.bx-eb-name input{ flex:1; min-width:0; }

.bx-iconbtn{ flex:none; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
.bx-iconbtn:active{ transform:scale(.93); }
.bx-iconbtn.sel{ border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent) inset; }

.bx-fc-edit{ border-style:dashed !important; }
.bx-fc-bar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.bx-fc-bar input{ flex:1; min-width:0; font-weight:700; }
.bx-mini{ display:flex; gap:4px; flex:none; }
.bx-mini button, .bx-x{ width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
.bx-mini button:disabled{ opacity:.35; cursor:default; }
.bx-mini button svg, .bx-x svg{ width:15px; height:15px; }
.bx-type-tag{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; margin:-2px 0 10px; }
.bx-fc-inner{ pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; }
.bx-removed{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:10px; border:1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface-2); }
.bx-removed .nm{ flex:1; min-width:0; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft); text-decoration:line-through; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.bx-removed .tg{ font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); }
.bx-restore{ flex:none; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-size:12.5px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }

.bx-cf .fc-label{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.bx-lab-ico{ display:inline-flex; color:var(--ink-soft); }
.bx-numrow{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.bx-numrow input{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
.bx-empty{ text-align:center; padding:26px 18px; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; border:1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius:20px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.bx-foot{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:6px; }
.bx-danger{ color:var(--red) !important; }

.bx-photo-wrap{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.bx-photo{ width:100%; max-height:340px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:16px; display:block; background:var(--surface-2); }
.bx-photo-btns{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
.bx-photo-btns button{ padding:10px 14px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.bx-photo-btns button svg{ width:14px; height:14px; }
.bx-file{ position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; }

/* toolbox / forms inside sheets */
.bx-type-grid{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
.bx-type{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; text-align:left; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:16px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; width:100%; }
.bx-type:active{ transform:scale(.98); }
.bx-type .ti{ flex:none; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-2); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.bx-type .tn{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14px; }
.bx-type .td{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:1px; }
.bx-form label.bx-l{ display:block; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--muted); margin:14px 2px 6px; }
.bx-form .bx-seg{ display:flex; gap:8px; }
.bx-form .bx-seg button{ flex:1; padding:11px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-form .bx-seg button.on{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); border-color:var(--ink); }
.bx-icon-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); gap:8px; margin-top:8px; }
.bx-icon-grid .bx-iconbtn{ width:100%; height:44px; }
.bx-icon-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.bx-icon-row .txt{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.35; }
.bx-form textarea{ min-height:96px; }
.bx-actions{ display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:18px; }
.bx-actions button{ flex:1; padding:14px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:0; font-weight:800; font-size:14px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-actions .pri{ background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); }
.bx-actions .sec{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); }
.bx-err{ color:var(--red); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; margin-top:8px; min-height:16px; }

/* home + manager */
.bx-add-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; width:calc(100% - 32px); margin:12px 16px 4px; padding:14px; border-radius:18px; border:1.5px dashed var(--line); background:transparent; color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-add-row svg{ width:15px; height:15px; }
.bx-mrow{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:8px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; }
.bx-mrow.off{ opacity:.7; background:var(--surface-2); }
.bx-mrow .mi{ flex:none; width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:13px; background:var(--surface-2); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.bx-mrow .mt{ flex:1; min-width:0; text-align:left; background:none; border:0; padding:0; color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-mrow .mn{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.bx-mrow .md{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; line-height:1.35; }
.bx-meter{ height:8px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface-2); overflow:hidden; margin:8px 0 6px; }
.bx-meter i{ display:block; height:100%; background:var(--accent); }
.bx-note{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; margin:0 2px 14px; }

/* tracker */
.bx-track{ padding-bottom:4px; }
.bx-gallery{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:6px; margin-top:6px; }
.bx-gallery button{ position:relative; padding:0; border:0; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; aspect-ratio:1/1; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-gallery img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
.bx-gallery span{ position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:800; color:#fff; background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.65)); padding:8px 4px 3px; text-align:center; }
.bx-select{ width:100%; padding:12px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font-size:14px; font-family:inherit; margin-bottom:10px; }

/* widget preview (mockup only) */
.bx-wnote{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; padding:12px 14px; border:1.5px dashed var(--accent); border-radius:16px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); font-size:13px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.4; margin-bottom:16px; }
.bx-wnote svg{ flex:none; margin-top:1px; }
.bx-wsec{ margin:0 0 22px; }
.bx-wsec h3{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:15px; font-weight:800; margin:0 2px 4px; }
.bx-wsec p.sub{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 2px 12px; line-height:1.4; }
.bx-wrow{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start; }
.bx-wcap{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin:6px 2px 0; }
.bx-widget{ position:relative; border-radius:24px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); padding:14px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--ink); }
.bx-w-s{ aspect-ratio:1/1; width:min(100%,164px); }
.bx-w-m{ aspect-ratio:2.3/1; width:min(100%,360px); }
.bx-widget .wh{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:0; }
.bx-widget .wi{ flex:none; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.bx-widget .wn{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; line-height:1.15; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; }
.bx-widget .ws{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.3; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.bx-widget .wq{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; line-height:1.3; color:var(--ink); overflow:hidden; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:3; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; }
.bx-widget .wbig{ font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:34px; letter-spacing:-.03em; line-height:1; }
.bx-widget .wbig small{ font-size:15px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; margin-left:2px; }
.bx-widget .wl{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); }
.bx-widget .wcols{ display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-end; }
.bx-widget .wcols > div{ min-width:0; }
.bx-widget .wsplit{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex:1; min-height:0; }
.bx-widget .wsplit .l{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; }
.bx-widget .wsplit .r{ flex:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:2px; min-width:58px; }
.bx-widget .wkv{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.35; }
.bx-widget .wkv span:first-child{ color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.bx-widget .wkv span:last-child{ font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; }
.bx-wheat{ display:flex; gap:3px; align-items:flex-end; height:34px; }
.bx-wheat i{ flex:1; min-width:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--surface-2); }
.bx-wheat i.on{ background:var(--accent); }
.bx-wring{ position:relative; width:54px; height:54px; }
.bx-wring svg{ width:54px; height:54px; transform:rotate(-90deg); }
.bx-wring .t{ fill:none; stroke:var(--surface-2); stroke-width:6; }
.bx-wring .f{ fill:none; stroke:var(--accent); stroke-width:6; stroke-linecap:round; }
.bx-wring b{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; font-family:var(--font-display); }
.bx-seg2{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin:0 0 12px; }
.bx-seg2 button{ padding:9px 16px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
.bx-seg2 button.on{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-ink); border-color:var(--ink); }

/* Assist Mode — bigger targets, same as the rest of the app */
.assist .bx-chip{ min-height:48px; padding:12px 18px; font-size:14px; }
.assist .bx-done{ min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; font-size:14.5px; }
.assist .bx-iconbtn{ width:52px; height:52px; }
.assist .bx-mini button, .assist .bx-x{ width:48px; height:48px; }
.assist .bx-restore{ min-height:46px; }
.assist .bx-type{ padding:15px 16px; }
.assist .bx-form .bx-seg button{ min-height:50px; }
.assist .bx-icon-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); }
.assist .bx-icon-grid .bx-iconbtn{ height:52px; }
.assist .bx-actions button{ min-height:52px; font-size:15px; }
.assist .bx-photo-btns button{ min-height:48px; font-size:14px; }
.assist .bx-add-row{ min-height:56px; font-size:15px; }
.assist .bx-mrow{ padding:15px 16px; }
.assist .bx-seg2 button{ min-height:48px; font-size:14px; }
.assist .bx-gallery{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
.assist .bx-select{ min-height:50px; font-size:16px; }
.assist .bx-fc-bar{ flex-wrap:wrap; }
/* Pre-existing bug (present in the original apps): the Home week strip is wider than a phone
   when the "Today" chip replaces the jump button (any past date) and, in Assist Mode, always.
   It pushed the whole page sideways. Let the seven days share whatever width is left. */
@media (max-width:430px){
  .week-strip-row .week-strip{ min-width:0; }
  .week-day{ min-width:0; flex:1 1 0; }
  .assist .week-strip-row{ padding-left:10px; padding-right:10px; gap:6px; }
  .assist .week-strip-row .week-strip{ gap:4px; }
  .assist .week-day{ padding-left:2px; padding-right:2px; }
}
.assist .bx-s10{ flex-wrap:wrap; }
.assist .bx-s10 .scale-dot{ flex:1 1 17% !important; height:auto !important; min-height:48px; font-size:14px !important; }
@media (max-width:400px){
  .bx-fc-bar{ flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .bx-fc-bar input{ flex:1 1 140px; }
  .bx-icon-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); }
  .bx-widget .wbig{ font-size:30px; }
}
</style>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   LOGBOOK CONFIG — the one block to edit
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Everything that makes this "Hustler's Logbook" rather than
   some other logbook lives here: the name, the wordmark, the
   splash icon, and the full colour palette for both themes.
   Nothing below this block hardcodes a brand string or a brand
   hex — they all read from window.LOGBOOK.

   Why it sits here, after the two <style> blocks: the palette is
   applied by appending a <style> element to <head>, and CSS of
   equal specificity is won by whichever rule comes last. Moving
   this script above the stylesheets would silently disable every
   colour override in it.

   See THEMING.md for ready-made palettes, a checklist for
   re-skinning, and how to fork this into a different kind of
   logbook (study, training, recovery, shop floor...).
   ============================================================ */
window.LOGBOOK = {
  brand: {
    /* Full product name — browser tab, splash, Settings. */
    name: "Hustler's Logbook",
    /* Home-screen name on iOS. Keep it short. */
    shortName: "Hustler's",
    /* Welcome screen headline. Each entry is its own line. */
    nameLines: ["Hustler's", "Logbook"],
    /* The small uppercase line at the top of the Home hero. */
    wordmark: "Hustler's · Logbook",
    /* Which ICONS key to use for the splash + welcome mark. */
    markIcon: 'flag',
    /* Browser/OS chrome colour per theme. */
    themeColorLight: '#FAFAF7',
    themeColorDark: '#151210',
  },

  /* Palette overrides, applied on top of the base stylesheet.
     Any CSS custom property declared in the base :root can be
     overridden here — you do not have to list all of them, only
     the ones you want to change. Leave a map empty to inherit
     the stock look entirely. */
  palette: {
    light: {
      '--bg':'#FAFAF7',
      '--surface':'#FFFFFF',
      '--surface-2':'#F3EFE9',
      '--ink':'#151312',
      '--ink-soft':'#57524C',
      '--muted':'#6B645B',
      '--line':'#EAE5DC',
      '--accent':'#C81212',
      '--accent-soft':'#FCE1E1',
      '--accent-ink':'#FFFFFF',
      '--hero-from':'#D81212',
      '--hero-via':'#C41010',
      '--hero-to':'#A50D0D',
      '--ch1':'#C81212',
      '--ch2':'#8A5F00',
      '--ch3':'#1A7A4C',
      '--ch4':'#2F5FC4',
      '--ch5':'#7B4BC0',
      '--ch6':'#6B645B',
    },
    dark: {
      '--bg':'#141110',
      '--surface':'#221E1B',
      '--surface-2':'#302A26',
      '--ink':'#FBF8F3',
      '--ink-soft':'#D6CEC3',
      '--muted':'#A79E92',
      '--line':'#443C35',
      '--accent':'#FF6B6E',
      '--accent-soft':'#4E1F21',
      '--accent-ink':'#141110',
      '--hero-from':'#FF6B6E',
      '--hero-via':'#F2585C',
      '--hero-to':'#E84A50',
      '--ch1':'#FF6B6E',
      '--ch2':'#F2C05C',
      '--ch3':'#5CDBA0',
      '--ch4':'#8FB0FF',
      '--ch5':'#C3A6FF',
      '--ch6':'#A79E92',
    },
  },
};

/* Apply the config. Runs synchronously so the palette is in place
   before first paint; the DOM-dependent bits wait for the parser
   to reach them. */
(function applyLogbookConfig(){
  var cfg = window.LOGBOOK, B = cfg.brand;
  function block(sel, map){
    var body = Object.keys(map || {}).map(function(k){ return k + ':' + map[k] + ';'; }).join('');
    return body ? sel + '{' + body + '}' : '';
  }
  var css = block(':root', cfg.palette.light) + block('[data-theme="dark"]', cfg.palette.dark);
  if(css){
    var st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'logbook-palette';
    st.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }
  try{ document.title = B.name; }catch(e){}
  var appleTitle = document.querySelector('meta[name="apple-mobile-web-app-title"]');
  if(appleTitle) appleTitle.setAttribute('content', B.shortName);
  var themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  if(themeMeta){
    var dark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
    themeMeta.setAttribute('content', dark ? B.themeColorDark : B.themeColorLight);
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    var el = document.querySelector('.splash-title');
    if(el) el.textContent = B.name;
  });
})();
</script>
<style id="comfort">
/* ============================================================
   COMFORT BLOCK: identical in all 7 apps, placed last so it wins.
   Everything here is about how the app FEELS on a phone. To undo any
   part, delete the rule. Colours and fonts are NOT set here.
   ============================================================ */

/* Space between words. Each typeface draws its space differently, so this is set per app. */
body{word-spacing:.02em;}
input,textarea,select,button{word-spacing:inherit;}   /* form controls ignore body, so pass it down */

/* Stop iPhones enlarging text on their own when you rotate the phone. */
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%;}

/* NOTCH / DYNAMIC ISLAND: push the Home card down by the phone's top inset (0 on phones without one). */
.home-hero{margin-top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));}

/* iPHONE ONLY (that @supports test is true only on iOS): fields under 16px make Safari zoom the page when
   you tap them. Forcing 16px stops the zoom. !important because field sizes are set in many places. */
@supports (-webkit-touch-callout:none){ html body input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=file]):not([type=range]):not([type=color]),html body textarea,html body select{font-size:16px!important;} }

/* FIRST-RUN SETUP: pin the setup screen to the phone's height so the middle scrolls and the button stays put... */
.onboard-screen{height:100vh;height:100dvh;min-height:0;}
/* ...and remove the app's usual bottom padding there, otherwise the whole page scrolls 128px past the screen. */
#app:has(> .onboard-screen){padding:0!important;min-height:0!important;}
/* Welcome screen: centre when short, scroll when tall (a plain centre would clip the top). */
.onboard-hero{overflow-y:auto;justify-content:flex-start;}
.onboard-hero::before,.onboard-hero::after{content:'';flex:1 0 0;}

/* PHONE WIDTHS ONLY */
@media (max-width:619px){
  #app{padding-left:4px;padding-right:4px;}                                  /* 4px more breathing room at the sides */
  .bottom-tabs button{padding:12px 4px 10px;gap:5px;font-size:11px;}         /* roomier bottom bar... */
  .bottom-tabs button svg{width:22px;height:22px;}                           /* ...with slightly bigger icons */
  .assist-toggle{bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));}      /* keep the Assist button clear of the bar */
  .assist .assist-toggle{bottom:calc(112px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="app-skip" href="#app">Skip to main content</a>
<div id="app-splash" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="splash-mark">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="34" height="34" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 5.5C4 4.7 4.7 4 5.5 4H12v16H5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 4 18.5v-13Z"/><path d="M20 5.5c0-.8-.7-1.5-1.5-1.5H12v16h6.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 20 18.5v-13Z"/></svg>
  </div>
  <div class="splash-title">Logbook</div>
  <div class="splash-spinner"></div>
</div>
<div class="app-shell">
  <div id="side-rail-mount"></div>
  <div id="app" tabindex="-1"></div>
</div>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   HUSTLER'S LOGBOOK — data layer
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   BUILD FLAG — false in the normal app, true in the tester
   build. Everything gated on this (the Settings > Test tools
   section, the debug time override) is inert when false; the
   real device clock is always used instead. This is the only
   line that differs between the two shipped files.
   ============================================================ */
window.APP_TEST_MODE = (function(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('hustlers-logbook-v1-mode')==='test'; }catch(e){ return false; } })();

/* Brand strings, read once from the config block at the end of
   <head>. The fallback object is only reached if that block was
   stripped — nothing in the app should ever inline a product name. */
const BRAND = (window.LOGBOOK && window.LOGBOOK.brand) || {
  name:'Logbook', shortName:'Logbook', nameLines:['Logbook'],
  wordmark:'Logbook', markIcon:'flag',
  themeColorLight:'#FAFAF7', themeColorDark:'#151210',
};

/* ============================================================
   DATA STORAGE
   All your data is one object (DB) saved in localStorage under STORAGE_KEY. Test mode swaps the key to STORAGE_KEY + '-test'.
   ============================================================ */
const STORAGE_KEY = 'hustlers-logbook-v1' + (function(){ try{ return localStorage.getItem('hustlers-logbook-v1-mode')==='test' ? '-test' : ''; }catch(e){ return ''; } })();

/* Is persistence actually available? Private-browsing modes and a
   handful of locked-down webviews expose localStorage but throw on
   write, which would mean someone fills in a whole day and loses it
   at reload with no warning. Probed once, surfaced once. */
const STORAGE_OK = (function(){
  try{
    const k = '__lb_probe__';
    localStorage.setItem(k,'1');
    localStorage.removeItem(k);
    return true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
})();
function localDateStr(date = new Date()) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}
const todayStr = () => localDateStr();

/* ============================================================
   LIVE CLOCK STRIP — a small persistent "here's what time it
   is, and here's what your own timetable says you should be
   doing right now" box on Today. Ticks every 30s.
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   TEST-MODE TIME OVERRIDE
   Only meaningful in the "tester" build (window.APP_TEST_MODE
   set true near the top of the script). In the normal shipped
   build this always resolves to the real device clock. Keeping
   the override behind one function means every other piece of
   code — clock strip, focus card, mapping preview — can just
   call nowForApp() and never know or care whether it's live or
   simulated.
   ============================================================ */
const DEBUG_TIME_KEY = 'hustlers-logbook-debug-time';
function getDebugTimeMinutes(){
  if(!window.APP_TEST_MODE) return null;
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DEBUG_TIME_KEY);
    if(raw===null || raw==='') return null;
    const n = parseInt(raw,10);
    if(isNaN(n)) return null;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(24*60-1, n));
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function setDebugTimeMinutes(mins){
  if(!window.APP_TEST_MODE) return;
  try{
    if(mins===null){ localStorage.removeItem(DEBUG_TIME_KEY); }
    else{ localStorage.setItem(DEBUG_TIME_KEY, String(Math.round(mins))); }
  }catch(e){}
}
/* The one clock every focus/timetable feature reads from. Returns
   a real Date in normal mode. In test mode, if an override is set,
   returns a Date pinned to *today's* calendar date but with the
   overridden hour/minute — so the rest of the day-based logic
   (which page is today, streaks, etc.) never has to special-case
   test mode. */
function nowForApp(){
  const real = new Date();
  if(!window.APP_TEST_MODE) return real;
  const mins = getDebugTimeMinutes();
  if(mins===null) return real;
  const d = new Date(real);
  d.setHours(Math.floor(mins/60), mins%60, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

/* Timetable blocks are fully custom now — the person can add a
   block at any hour/half-hour they want (10am, 10:30pm, 1am,
   whatever), delete ones they don't use, and there's no fixed
   "one slot per hour" grid underneath anymore. Blocks are just
   sorted by time-of-day. TIME_STEP_MIN controls the granularity
   offered when adding a new block (30 min).
   normalizeTimetableBlocks() used to force-fit blocks into a
   fixed hourly array; now it just de-dupes exact time clashes,
   drops anything malformed, and keeps the array time-sorted —
   still safe to call anywhere the old code expected "the current
   clean list of blocks". */
const TIME_STEP_MIN = 30;
function normalizeTimetableBlocks(){
  const raw = Array.isArray(DB.timetable && DB.timetable.blocks) ? DB.timetable.blocks : [];
  const byTime = new Map();
  raw.forEach(block=>{
    if(!block || typeof block !== 'object') return;
    const time = normalizeTimeStr(block.time);
    if(!time) return;
    if(!byTime.has(time)){
      byTime.set(time, { time, task: typeof block.task === 'string' ? block.task : '' });
    }
  });
  const normalized = Array.from(byTime.values()).sort((a,b)=> timeStrToMinutes(a.time)-timeStrToMinutes(b.time));
  const changed = raw.length !== normalized.length || raw.some((b,i)=>{
    const n = normalized[i];
    return !b || !n || normalizeTimeStr(b.time) !== n.time || (typeof b.task === 'string' ? b.task : '') !== n.task;
  });
  if(changed){
    DB.timetable.blocks = normalized;
    saveDB();
  }
  return normalized;
}
// "HH:MM" in, "HH:MM" out (zero-padded, minutes snapped to the
// day). Accepts the old '18:00+' catch-all from data saved before
// this rework and folds it to 18:00 so nobody's existing timetable
// silently vanishes. Returns null for anything unsalvageable.
function normalizeTimeStr(time){
  if(typeof time !== 'string') return null;
  if(time === '18:00+') return '18:00';
  const m = time.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
  if(!m) return null;
  let h = parseInt(m[1],10), mi = parseInt(m[2],10);
  if(isNaN(h)||isNaN(mi)) return null;
  h = ((h % 24) + 24) % 24;
  mi = Math.max(0, Math.min(59, mi));
  return `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(mi).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
function timeStrToMinutes(time){
  const t = normalizeTimeStr(time);
  if(!t) return 0;
  const [h,m] = t.split(':').map(Number);
  return h*60+m;
}
function minutesToTimeStr(mins){
  mins = ((Math.round(mins) % 1440) + 1440) % 1440;
  return `${String(Math.floor(mins/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(mins%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
function fmtBlockTime(time){
  return minutesToClockLabel(timeStrToMinutes(time));
}
// The block whose range covers `date` — the last block at or
// before the current time (wrapping to the latest block of all if
// we're before the earliest one, since that means we're still in
// "yesterday's last block" territory, e.g. an 11pm block covering
// past midnight).
function currentTimetableSlotIndex(date = nowForApp()){
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  if(!blocks.length) return -1;
  const mins = date.getHours()*60 + date.getMinutes();
  let idx = -1;
  for(let i=0;i<blocks.length;i++){
    if(timeStrToMinutes(blocks[i].time) <= mins) idx = i;
  }
  return idx === -1 ? blocks.length-1 : idx;
}
function renderClockStrip(){
  const now = nowForApp();
  const timeLabel = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'});
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  const idx = currentTimetableSlotIndex(now);
  const current = blocks[idx];
  const task = current && current.task ? current.task : '';
  const hasAnyTask = blocks.some(b=>b.task && b.task.trim());
  return `
    <button class="clock-strip" onclick="openPage('timetable')" aria-label="Open timetable">
      <div class="clock-time-wrap">
        <div class="clock-dot"></div>
        <div class="clock-time">${esc(timeLabel)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clock-divider"></div>
      <div class="clock-task">${task ? esc(task) : (hasAnyTask ? 'Nothing scheduled for this hour' : 'Set up your timetable')}</div>
      ${icon('chevright',15)}
    </button>
  `;
}

/* ============================================================
   FOCUS CARD — "what the timetable says right now", expanded.
   Sits on Home just below the week-summary card. Looks up which
   page (if any) the current time slot is mapped to, and inlines
   that page's FULL interactive body — no tap-through needed. If
   nothing is mapped to this hour, shows a big idle-time hero with
   a rotating/custom quote instead, and lets the person map a page
   to the slot right from here.
   Only meaningful for today — a past or future selected date has
   no "right now", so renderHome() only calls this when isToday.
   ============================================================ */
function renderFocusCard(dateStr){
  const now = nowForApp();
  const timeLabel = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'});
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  const idx = currentTimetableSlotIndex(now);
  const slot = blocks[idx];
  const time = slot ? slot.time : null;
  const task = slot && slot.task ? slot.task : '';
  const mappedId = time ? getSlotMapping(time) : null;
  const mappedMeta = mappedId ? focusPageMeta(mappedId) : null;

  const header = `
    <div class="focus-head">
      <div class="focus-time-wrap">
        <div class="clock-dot"></div>
        <div class="focus-time">${esc(timeLabel)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="focus-task">${task ? esc(task) : 'Nothing scheduled for this hour'}</div>
      <button class="focus-tt-link" onclick="openPage('timetable')" aria-label="Open timetable">${icon('clock',13)}</button>
    </div>
  `;

  // Nothing mapped to this slot (or no valid mapping target available
  // right now, e.g. Business Lane mapped but no lane picked yet) —
  // show the big idle hero instead of a half-empty page.
  const laneUnavailable = mappedId==='lane' && !DB.lane;
  if(!mappedId || laneUnavailable || !mappedMeta){
    const quote = time ? idleQuoteFor(time, dateStr) : IDLE_QUOTES[0];
    return `
      <div class="focus-card">
        ${header}
        <div class="focus-idle">
          <div class="focus-idle-quote">"${esc(quote)}"</div>
          ${time ? `
            <button class="focus-idle-map-link" onclick="${laneUnavailable?"openPage('lane')":"openPage('timetable')"}">
              <span>${icon('grid',13)} ${laneUnavailable ? 'Choose your '+esc(bxBoxMeta('lane').name)+' first, then it shows up here' : 'Nothing linked to this hour — set it up in Timetable'}</span>
              ${icon('chevright',14)}
            </button>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  let bodyHtml = ''; bxCtxBegin(mappedId, dateStr);
  if(mappedId==='dashboard') bodyHtml = dashboardBody(dateStr);
  else if(mappedId==='workout') bodyHtml = workoutBody(dateStr);
  else if(mappedId==='journal') bodyHtml = journalBody(dateStr);
  else if(mappedId==='reading') bodyHtml = readingBody(dateStr);
  else if(mappedId==='lane') bodyHtml = laneLogBody(dateStr) || '';

  return `
    <div class="focus-card">
      ${header}
      <div class="focus-card-title-row">
        <div class="focus-card-title">${icon(pageIconFor(mappedId),16)} ${esc(mappedMeta.name)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="focus-card-body">${bxFocusBody(mappedId, dateStr, bodyHtml)}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}
function pageIconFor(pageId){
  const found = CORE_PAGES.find(p=>p.id===pageId);
  return found ? found.icon : 'clock';
}


/* Canonical empty shape. loadDB() always returns an object that has
   every one of these keys — never a partial object — so no other
   function in the app ever has to guard against a missing field. */
function emptyDB(){
  return { days:{}, lane:null, streak:0, lastLogDate:null, timetable:{ blocks:[], mapping:{}, idleQuotes:{} }, monthly:{}, setupMeta:{}, onboarded:false, library:{ currentBookId:null, books:{} }, workoutPresets:{}, trash:[], unlocked:false };
}
/* Takes anything claiming to be a logbook DB — a load from
   localStorage, or a .json file someone just imported — and hands
   back an object that has every key emptyDB() promises.
   This used to live inside loadDB(), which meant "Restore from
   backup" (handleImportFile) assigned the parsed file onto DB
   raw: restoring a backup taken before library/trash/monthly
   existed threw on the very next render. Both paths go through
   here now. */
function normalizeDB(parsed){
  if(!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) parsed = {};
  // Merge onto a fresh default shape instead of trusting the stored
  // object's shape directly — this is what actually prevents a
  // half-written or older-schema save from ever locking someone
  // out of onboarding or wiping their timetable.
  const base = emptyDB();
  const merged = Object.assign(base, parsed);
  if(!merged.days || typeof merged.days !== 'object') merged.days = {};
  if(!merged.timetable || typeof merged.timetable !== 'object') merged.timetable = {};
  if(!Array.isArray(merged.timetable.blocks)) merged.timetable.blocks = [];
  if(!merged.timetable.mapping || typeof merged.timetable.mapping !== 'object') merged.timetable.mapping = {};
  if(!merged.timetable.idleQuotes || typeof merged.timetable.idleQuotes !== 'object') merged.timetable.idleQuotes = {};
  if(!merged.monthly || typeof merged.monthly !== 'object') merged.monthly = {};
  if(!merged.setupMeta || typeof merged.setupMeta !== 'object') merged.setupMeta = {};
  if(typeof merged.onboarded !== 'boolean') merged.onboarded = false;
  if(typeof merged.streak !== 'number' || isNaN(merged.streak)) merged.streak = 0;
  if(!merged.library || typeof merged.library !== 'object') merged.library = { currentBookId:null, books:{} };
  if(!merged.library.books || typeof merged.library.books !== 'object') merged.library.books = {};
  if(merged.library.currentBookId === undefined) merged.library.currentBookId = null;
  if(!merged.workoutPresets || typeof merged.workoutPresets !== 'object' || Array.isArray(merged.workoutPresets)) merged.workoutPresets = {};
  if(!Array.isArray(merged.trash)) merged.trash = [];
  if(typeof merged.unlocked !== 'boolean') merged.unlocked = false;
  return merged;
}
function loadDB(){
  let parsed = null;
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if(raw) parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  }catch(e){ parsed = null; }
  return normalizeDB(parsed);
}
/* ============================================================
   SAVING
   Writes DB to localStorage. Returns true/false so callers (like importing a backup or adding a picture) can undo themselves if the phone's storage is full.
   ============================================================ */
function saveDB(){
  try{
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(DB));
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    // Storage full or blocked (private browsing, quota) — surface it
    // rather than silently losing the entry the person just made.
    flashSaved("Couldn't save — storage may be full");
    return false;
  }
}
let DB = loadDB();
if(!DB.days) DB.days = {};
if(DB.lane === undefined) DB.lane = null;
if(DB.onboarded === undefined) DB.onboarded = false;
if(!Array.isArray(DB.trash)) DB.trash = [];

/* ============================================================
   TRASH — each checklist-style box (right now: the Workout
   exercise log, per day, and the Bucket List, per month) has its
   own "recently deleted" bin, opened right from that box — not a
   single shared bin buried in Settings. Deleting a row here never
   destroys it outright; it moves the row's data into DB.trash with
   enough context (kind + which day/month it belongs to) to filter
   it back to just that box's trash, and to put it back exactly
   where it came from. Entries older than TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS are
   purged automatically — trashSweepExpired() runs at the top of
   every trashList() call (and so every trashCount() too, which
   every page checks on render), so expired entries clear out
   without needing a background timer.
   ============================================================ */
const TRASH_KINDS = {
  exercise: { label:'Exercise', icon:'bolt' },
  bucket:   { label:'Bucket goal', icon:'target' },
};
const TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS = 30;
function trashSweepExpired(){
  const cutoff = Date.now() - TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS*24*60*60*1000;
  const before = DB.trash.length;
  DB.trash = DB.trash.filter(t=> t.deletedAt >= cutoff);
  if(DB.trash.length !== before) saveDB();
}
function trashAdd(kind, data, context, summary){
  trashSweepExpired();
  const id = 'tr_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
  DB.trash.unshift({ id, kind, data, context, summary, deletedAt: Date.now() });
  saveDB();
  return id;
}
// Full list, or scoped to one box's trash — pass kind + a matcher
// for the context (e.g. the same day for exercises, the same month
// for bucket goals) so each box only ever shows its own deleted
// items, not everything in the whole app.
function trashList(kind, contextMatch){
  trashSweepExpired();
  let list = DB.trash;
  if(kind) list = list.filter(t=>t.kind===kind);
  if(contextMatch) list = list.filter(t=>contextMatch(t.context));
  return list;
}
function trashCount(kind, contextMatch){ return trashList(kind, contextMatch).length; }
function trashRemoveEntry(id){
  DB.trash = DB.trash.filter(t=>t.id!==id);
  saveDB();
}
function trashEmptyAll(kind, contextMatch){
  const toRemove = new Set(trashList(kind, contextMatch).map(t=>t.id));
  DB.trash = DB.trash.filter(t=>!toRemove.has(t.id));
  saveDB();
  flashSaved('Trash emptied');
  render();
}
// Wrapper so an onclick string (which only has plain kind/contextKey
// strings to work with, not a live matcher function) can still call
// the scoped trashEmptyAll above.
function trashEmptyAllByKey(kind, contextKey){
  const { kind:k, match } = trashMatcherFor(kind, contextKey);
  trashEmptyAll(k, match);
}
// Puts a trashed row back exactly where it was deleted from. Each
// kind knows its own restore target since the context shape differs
// (a dated day's exercise log vs. a month's bucket list).
function trashRestore(id){
  const entry = DB.trash.find(t=>t.id===id);
  if(!entry) return;
  if(entry.kind==='exercise'){
    const p = getPage(entry.context.dateStr,'workout');
    if(!p.exercises) p.exercises = [];
    p.exercises.push({...entry.data, done:false});
  } else if(entry.kind==='bucket'){
    const page = getMonthlyPage('bucket', entry.context.monthKey);
    if(!page.items) page.items = [];
    page.items.push({...entry.data, done:false});
  }
  trashRemoveEntry(id);
  flashSaved('Restored');
  render();
}
function confirmEmptyTrash(kind, contextKey){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Empty trash?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>Permanently deletes everything in this trash. This can't be undone.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="closeSheet(); trashEmptyAllByKey('${kind}','${esc(contextKey)}');">${icon('trash',15)} Empty trash</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function confirmDeleteTrashEntry(id, kind, contextKey){
  const entry = DB.trash.find(t=>t.id===id);
  const name = entry ? (entry.summary || 'this item') : 'this item';
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Delete "${esc(name)}" for good?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>This removes it from the trash permanently — it won't be recoverable after this.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="closeSheet(); trashRemoveEntry('${id}'); reopenTrashSheet('${kind}','${esc(contextKey)}');">${icon('trash',15)} Delete forever</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
// contextKey is a plain string identifying the box's own trash
// ("workout:2026-09-14" or "bucket:2026-09") — trashMatcherFor()
// turns it back into the right kind + matcher pair for trashList().
function trashMatcherFor(kind, contextKey){
  if(kind==='exercise') return { kind, match: (ctx)=> ctx.dateStr===contextKey };
  if(kind==='bucket') return { kind, match: (ctx)=> ctx.monthKey===contextKey };
  return { kind:null, match: ()=>true };
}
function renderTrashSheetBody(kind, contextKey){
  const { kind:k, match } = trashMatcherFor(kind, contextKey);
  const entries = trashList(k, match);
  if(!entries.length){
    return `<div class="empty-note" style="padding:20px 4px;">Nothing here right now.</div>`;
  }
  return entries.map(t=>{
    const meta = TRASH_KINDS[t.kind] || { label:'Item', icon:'trash' };
    return `
    <div class="preset-pick-row" style="cursor:default;">
      <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex:1; min-width:0;">
        ${icon(meta.icon,15)}
        <div style="min-width:0;">
          <div class="preset-pick-name">${esc(t.summary || 'Untitled')}</div>
          <div class="preset-pick-sub">Deleted ${fmtRelativeTime(t.deletedAt)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0;">
        <button class="tt-remove-btn" style="color:var(--green);" onclick="trashRestore('${t.id}')" aria-label="Restore">${icon('undo',14)}</button>
        <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="confirmDeleteTrashEntry('${t.id}','${kind}','${esc(contextKey)}')" aria-label="Delete forever">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
// Opens a box's OWN trash — exercises pass ('exercise', dateStr),
// bucket goals pass ('bucket', monthKey). Everything shown and
// emptied here stays scoped to that one box.
function openTrashSheet(kind, contextKey){
  const { kind:k, match } = trashMatcherFor(kind, contextKey);
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Trash</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body" style="padding-top:0;">
      <p class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 10px;">Kept for ${TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS} days, then removed automatically.</p>
      ${renderTrashSheetBody(kind, contextKey)}
      ${trashCount(k, match) ? `<button class="add-row-btn" style="color:var(--red);" onclick="confirmEmptyTrash('${kind}','${esc(contextKey)}')">${icon('trash',14)} Empty trash</button>` : ''}
    </div>
  `);
}
// Re-renders the same scoped trash sheet in place (used after a
// permanent delete from within the sheet, so it doesn't just close).
function reopenTrashSheet(kind, contextKey){
  openTrashSheet(kind, contextKey);
}

/* ============================================================
   MONTHLY PAGES — Bucket List, Income Streams, and 3 Objectives
   are filled in once a month (per the paper logbook, which
   labels each "month ___"). Each calendar month gets its own
   blank copy, keyed "YYYY-MM", so nothing from a past month is
   ever overwritten — it just becomes part of that month's record.
   Timetable is NOT monthly; it's a standing daily template and
   stays editable anytime.
   ============================================================ */
const monthKeyOf = (dateStr) => dateStr.slice(0,7);
const currentMonthKey = () => monthKeyOf(todayStr());
const yearKeyOf = (dateStr) => dateStr.slice(0,4);
const currentYearKey = () => yearKeyOf(todayStr());
if(!DB.monthly) DB.monthly = {};
// One-time migration: older versions stored these three flat on DB
// with no month attached. Fold whatever's there into the current
// month so upgrading never loses data.
(function migrateFlatMonthlyPages(){
  const legacyKeys = ['bucket','income','objectives'];
  const hasLegacyData = legacyKeys.some(k => DB[k] && Object.keys(DB[k]).length);
  if(!hasLegacyData) return;
  const mk = currentMonthKey();
  if(!DB.monthly[mk]) DB.monthly[mk] = {};
  legacyKeys.forEach(k=>{
    if(DB[k] && Object.keys(DB[k]).length && !DB.monthly[mk][k]){
      DB.monthly[mk][k] = DB[k];
    }
    delete DB[k];
  });
  saveDB();
})();
function getMonthlyPage(pageId, monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  if(!DB.monthly[mk]) DB.monthly[mk] = {};
  if(!DB.monthly[mk][pageId]) DB.monthly[mk][pageId] = {};
  return DB.monthly[mk][pageId];
}
function monthlyPageTouchedAt(pageId, monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  return (DB.monthly[mk] && DB.monthly[mk]._touched && DB.monthly[mk]._touched[pageId]) || null;
}
function touchMonthlyPage(pageId, monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  if(!DB.monthly[mk]) DB.monthly[mk] = {};
  if(!DB.monthly[mk]._touched) DB.monthly[mk]._touched = {};
  DB.monthly[mk]._touched[pageId] = Date.now();
  saveDB();
}
function isMonthlyPageLocked(pageId, monthKey){
  return !!monthlyPageTouchedAt(pageId, monthKey);
}
function monthLabel(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const d = new Date(mk+'-01T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});
}
function monthLabelShort(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const d = new Date(mk+'-01T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long'});
}

/* ============================================================
   MONTHLY SUMMARY — aggregates everything logged in a given
   calendar month into one report: consistency, daily-page
   rollups, business-lane totals, and the three monthly-setup
   pages' committed content.
   ============================================================ */
function daysInMonth(monthKey){
  const [y,m] = monthKey.split('-').map(Number);
  return new Date(y, m, 0).getDate();
}
function datesInMonth(monthKey){
  const n = daysInMonth(monthKey);
  const out = [];
  for(let d=1; d<=n; d++) out.push(`${monthKey}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`);
  return out;
}
/* ============================================================
   TESTER TOOL — RANDOM MONTH FILL
   Only ever called from the tester build's Settings > Test tools
   section (window.APP_TEST_MODE gate lives on the button itself,
   same pattern as the time-override UI above). Backfills a whole
   calendar month with plausible-looking entries across every core
   page, purely so the Monthly Tracker's charts have something to
   show while testing — it is never wired into the real app, so a
   normal user can never trigger it by accident.
   Existing days are left alone by default (skipDays), so running
   it twice — or running it after already logging some real days —
   never overwrites anything you typed by hand.
   ============================================================ */
function rngInt(min,max){ return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min; }
function rngPick(arr){ return arr[rngInt(0,arr.length-1)]; }
function rngFieldValue(label){
  // Guess a sensible fake value from the field's own label, so a
  // lane's random data still looks like the kind of thing that
  // field asks for, rather than the same generic string everywhere.
  const isMoney = /\$/.test(label);
  const isCount = /hour|rate|session|order|customer|job|mileage|item|unit|view|follower|reach|reps|set/i.test(label);
  if(isMoney) return String(rngInt(20,400));
  if(isCount) return String(rngInt(1,60));
  return rngPick(['Usual spot','Regular client','Same as last time','Quick session','—']);
}
/* ============================================================
   TEST DATA
   Fills one month with random entries. Used by Test mode's 'Fill a year of random data'.
   ============================================================ */
function randomFillMonth(monthKey, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const skipLoggedDays = opts.skipLoggedDays !== false; // default true
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const dates = datesInMonth(mk).filter(ds => ds <= todayDs); // never seed future days
  const moods = DASHBOARD_MOODS;
  const journalStates = JOURNAL_STATES;
  const exerciseNames = ['Squat','Bench Press','Deadlift','Pull-up','Row','Overhead Press','Plank','Lunge'];
  let daysFilled = 0;

  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    if(skipLoggedDays && dayHasAny(ds)) return;
    // Not every day gets every page filled — real logging is patchy,
    // and a solid block of 100%-everything every day would make the
    // charts look artificial rather than like real usage.
    const doDashboard = Math.random() < 0.85;
    const doWorkout = Math.random() < 0.6;
    const doReading = Math.random() < 0.7;
    const doJournal = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const doLane = !!DB.lane && Math.random() < 0.65;
    if(!doDashboard && !doWorkout && !doReading && !doJournal && !doLane) return;

    if(doDashboard){
      const p = getPage(ds,'dashboard');
      p.mood = rngPick(moods);
      p.rating = rngInt(3,10);
      p.obj1 = 'Ship the thing'; p.obj2 = 'Move the body'; p.obj3 = 'Read a bit';
      p.checks = { o1: Math.random()<0.7, o2: Math.random()<0.7, o3: Math.random()<0.7 };
      p.win = 'Made real progress on something that mattered.';
      markTouched(ds,'dashboard');
    }
    if(doWorkout){
      const p = getPage(ds,'workout');
      p.type = rngPick(WORKOUT_TYPES);
      p.steps = rngInt(2000,14000);
      p.calories = rngInt(150,700);
      p.sleep = (rngInt(11,17)/2); // 5.5–8.5h
      p.exercises = Array.from({length: rngInt(2,5)}, ()=>({
        name: rngPick(exerciseNames), sets:String(rngInt(2,5)), reps:String(rngInt(5,15)), weight:String(rngInt(10,120)), done:true
      }));
      // The three 1-5 scales were never seeded, so anything driven
      // by them looked permanently empty in the tester build.
      p.energy = rngInt(2,5); p.soreness = rngInt(1,4); p.recovery = rngInt(2,5);
      markTouched(ds,'workout');
    }
    if(doReading){
      const book = libEnsureCurrentBook();
      const p = getPage(ds,'reading');
      p.title = book.title || 'Untitled book';
      p.author = book.author || '';
      p.pagesToday = rngInt(5,40);
      p.baselinePage = book.pageCurrent || 0;
      p.pageFrom = p.baselinePage + p.pagesToday;
      p.pageTotal = book.pageTotal || 0;
      p.minutes = rngInt(10,60);
      p.rating = rngInt(5,10);
      markTouched(ds,'reading');
      libSyncFromReadingLog(ds);
    }
    if(doJournal){
      const p = getPage(ds,'journal');
      p.mood = rngPick(journalStates);
      p.oneword = rngPick(['Momentum','Grind','Clarity','Patience','Focus']);
      p.grat1 = 'Test data'; p.grat2 = 'Test data'; p.grat3 = 'Test data';
      p.freewrite = 'Test data — generated for graph preview.';
      markTouched(ds,'journal');
    }
    if(doLane){
      const conf = LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane];
      const p = getPage(ds,'lane');
      conf.fields.forEach(([key,label])=>{ p[key] = rngFieldValue(label); });
      conf.scales.forEach(([key])=>{ p[key] = rngInt(2,5); });
      markTouched(ds,'lane');
    }
    daysFilled++;
  });

  saveDB();
  render();
  flashSaved(`Filled ${daysFilled} day${daysFilled===1?'':'s'} with test data`);
  return daysFilled;
}
// Wipes every core page for every day in the month — the undo for
// randomFillMonth. Left available for whenever a tester wants a
// clean slate again without touching setup pages (lane choice,
// timetable, bucket list, library) or other months.
function clearMonthData(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const dates = datesInMonth(mk);
  let cleared = 0;
  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    if(DB.days[ds]){ delete DB.days[ds]; cleared++; }
  });
  recomputeStreak();
  saveDB();
  render();
  flashSaved(`Cleared ${cleared} day${cleared===1?'':'s'} of test data`);
}

/* ============================================================
   SHARED VOCABULARIES
   The mood words, journal states and workout types used to be
   re-typed inside dashboardBody / journalBody / workoutBody /
   randomFillMonth as four separate array literals. That meant the
   Tracker had no reliable way to colour or order them, and adding
   a mood in one place silently left the others behind. One list
   each, used everywhere.
   ============================================================ */
const DASHBOARD_MOODS = ['Fired up','Steady','Tired','Stressed','Low'];
const JOURNAL_STATES  = ['Clear','Motivated','Content','Restless','Anxious','Overwhelmed'];
const WORKOUT_TYPES   = ['Strength','Cardio','Mobility','Sport','Rest day'];
/* Fixed colour per word so a mood keeps the same colour from one
   month to the next — assigning by rank would repaint the chart
   every time the ordering changed. */
const MOOD_COLORS = {
  'Fired up':'var(--ch3)', 'Steady':'var(--ch4)', 'Tired':'var(--ch2)',
  'Stressed':'var(--ch1)', 'Low':'var(--ch6)',
};
const MIND_COLORS = {
  'Clear':'var(--ch4)', 'Motivated':'var(--ch3)', 'Content':'var(--ch5)',
  'Restless':'var(--ch2)', 'Anxious':'var(--ch1)', 'Overwhelmed':'var(--ch6)',
};

function laneValueForDay(dateStr){
  // Pulls a single "money moved today" number out of whatever
  // shape that day's business-lane log happens to be.
  // Order matters: net profit is the truer number for lanes that
  // record both (Dropshipping, Reselling), and it's checked with
  // an explicit isFinite rather than `a || b`, because the old
  // `parseFloat(revenue) || parseFloat(netprofit)` fell through to
  // the next field any time revenue was a legitimate 0.
  const d = DB.days[dateStr];
  if(!d || !d.pages || !d.pages.lane) return 0;
  const p = d.pages.lane;
  if(Array.isArray(p.trades) && p.trades.length){
    return p.trades.reduce((s,t)=> s + (parseFloat(t.pnl)||0), 0);
  }
  const net = parseFloat(p.netprofit);
  if(isFinite(net)) return net;
  const rev = parseFloat(p.revenue);
  if(isFinite(rev)) return rev;
  return 0;
}

function computeMonthSummary(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const dates = datesInMonth(mk);
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const elapsedDates = dates.filter(ds => ds <= todayDs);

  let daysLogged = 0, ratingSum=0, ratingCount=0, workoutCount=0, pagesReadSum=0;
  let minutesSum=0, readingDays=0, stepsSum=0, sleepSum=0, sleepCount=0, journalCount=0;
  let prioritiesSet=0, prioritiesDone=0, perfectPriorityDays=0, zeroPriorityDays=0;
  const moodCount = {};          // Daily Dashboard mood check-in
  const mindCount = {};          // Journal mental state — a separate question
  const workoutTypeCount = {};
  let bestStreak=0, curStreak=0;
  const heat = {};          // dateStr -> 0..N pages logged
  const laneTrend = [];     // [{date,value}] days with a lane entry
  const ratingTrend = [];   // [{date,value}] days with a rating
  const readingTrend = [];  // [{date,value}] pages read per day
  const stepsTrend = [];    // [{date,value}] steps per day
  const priorityTrend = []; // [{date,value}] 0-3 priorities ticked

  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    const day = DB.days[ds];
    const isElapsed = ds <= todayDs;
    const logged = day ? Object.values(day.pages).filter(p=>p._touched).length : 0;
    heat[ds] = logged;
    if(logged>0){
      if(isElapsed) daysLogged++;
      curStreak++;
      if(curStreak>bestStreak) bestStreak=curStreak;
    } else {
      curStreak=0;
    }
    if(day && day.pages){
      const dash = day.pages.dashboard;
      if(dash && dash._touched){
        if(dash.rating){ ratingSum += (+dash.rating); ratingCount++; ratingTrend.push({date:ds, value:+dash.rating}); }
        if(dash.mood) moodCount[dash.mood] = (moodCount[dash.mood]||0)+1;
        // Only count priorities that were actually written down —
        // a blank line can't be "not done".
        const titles = [dash.obj1, dash.obj2, dash.obj3];
        const set = titles.filter(t=>t && String(t).trim()).length;
        if(set){
          const checks = dash.checks || {};
          const done = ['o1','o2','o3'].filter((k,i)=> titles[i] && String(titles[i]).trim() && checks[k]).length;
          prioritiesSet += set;
          prioritiesDone += done;
          if(done === set && set === 3) perfectPriorityDays++;
          if(done === 0) zeroPriorityDays++;
          priorityTrend.push({date:ds, value:done});
        }
      }
      const wo = day.pages.workout;
      if(wo && wo._touched){
        workoutCount++;
        if(wo.type) workoutTypeCount[wo.type] = (workoutTypeCount[wo.type]||0)+1;
        if(+wo.steps){ stepsSum += (+wo.steps||0); stepsTrend.push({date:ds, value:+wo.steps}); }
        if(+wo.sleep){ sleepSum += (+wo.sleep||0); sleepCount++; }
      }
      const rd = day.pages.reading;
      if(rd && rd._touched){
        if(rd.pagesToday){ pagesReadSum += (+rd.pagesToday||0); readingDays++; readingTrend.push({date:ds, value:+rd.pagesToday}); }
        if(rd.minutes) minutesSum += (+rd.minutes||0);
      }
      const jr = day.pages.journal;
      if(jr && jr._touched){
        journalCount++;
        if(jr.mood) mindCount[jr.mood] = (mindCount[jr.mood]||0)+1;
      }
      if(day.pages.lane && day.pages.lane._touched){
        laneTrend.push({date:ds, value:laneValueForDay(ds)});
      }
    }
  });

  const pickExtreme = (arr, cmp) => arr.length ? arr.reduce((a,b)=> cmp(b.value, a.value) ? b : a) : null;
  const topMood = Object.keys(moodCount).sort((a,b)=>moodCount[b]-moodCount[a])[0] || null;
  const laneTotal = laneTrend.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.value,0);
  const monthlyBucket = getMonthlyPage('bucket', mk);
  const monthlyIncome = getMonthlyPage('income', mk);
  const monthlyObjectives = getMonthlyPage('objectives', mk);

  // Previous month's hit rate, so "Consistency" can say whether
  // this month is actually better or worse instead of showing a
  // bare percentage with nothing to compare it to. Computed
  // inline (not via a recursive call) to avoid looping forever.
  let prev = null;
  const [py, pm] = mk.split('-').map(Number);
  const prevDate = new Date(py, pm-2, 1);
  const prevKey = `${prevDate.getFullYear()}-${String(prevDate.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  const prevDates = datesInMonth(prevKey).filter(ds=>ds<=todayDs);
  if(prevDates.length){
    const prevLogged = prevDates.filter(ds=>dayHasAny(ds)).length;
    prev = { monthKey:prevKey, daysElapsed:prevDates.length, daysLogged:prevLogged };
  }

  return {
    monthKey: mk,
    daysElapsed: elapsedDates.length,
    daysInMonth: dates.length,
    daysLogged,
    bestStreak,
    avgRating: ratingCount ? (ratingSum/ratingCount) : null,
    workoutCount,
    workoutTypeCount,
    stepsSum, stepsTrend,
    sleepSum, sleepCount,
    pagesReadSum, readingDays, minutesSum,
    readingBest: pickExtreme(readingTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    journalCount,
    prioritiesSet, prioritiesDone, perfectPriorityDays, zeroPriorityDays,
    prioritiesPct: prioritiesSet ? Math.round((prioritiesDone/prioritiesSet)*100) : 0,
    priorityTrend,
    topMood,
    moodCount,
    mindCount,
    heat,
    laneTrend,
    laneTotal,
    laneDays: laneTrend.length,
    laneNegDays: laneTrend.filter(x=>x.value<0).length,
    laneBest: pickExtreme(laneTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    ratingTrend,
    ratingBest: pickExtreme(ratingTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    ratingWorst: pickExtreme(ratingTrend, (b,a)=>b<a),
    readingTrend,
    prev,
    bucket: monthlyBucket,
    income: monthlyIncome,
    objectives: monthlyObjectives,
    bucketLocked: isMonthlyPageLocked('bucket', mk),
    incomeLocked: isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk),
    objectivesLocked: isMonthlyPageLocked('objectives', mk),
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   YEAR SUMMARY — aggregates the 12 months' own computeMonthSummary
   results into one year-level report, rather than re-walking
   DB.days for a second, separately-maintained set of totals. Any
   fix to how a metric is counted (rating, priorities, lane value,
   whatever) only ever needs to happen in computeMonthSummary — the
   year view inherits it automatically instead of silently drifting
   out of sync with the month view's numbers, which is exactly the
   kind of bug a hand-rolled parallel aggregation invites.
   ============================================================ */
function computeYearSummary(yearKey){
  const yk = yearKey || currentYearKey();
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const months = [];
  for(let m=1; m<=12; m++){
    months.push(computeMonthSummary(`${yk}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`));
  }

  const sumBy = key => months.reduce((s,ms)=>s+(ms[key]||0),0);
  const flatten = key => months.reduce((arr,ms)=>arr.concat(ms[key]||[]), []);
  const mergeCount = key => months.reduce((out,ms)=>{
    Object.entries(ms[key]||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>{ out[k]=(out[k]||0)+v; });
    return out;
  }, {});

  const heat = {};
  months.forEach(ms => Object.assign(heat, ms.heat));

  const ratingTrend = flatten('ratingTrend');
  const ratingCount = ratingTrend.length;
  const ratingSum = ratingTrend.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0);

  const laneTrend = flatten('laneTrend');
  const laneTotal = laneTrend.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.value,0);

  const priorityTrend = flatten('priorityTrend');
  const prioritiesSet = sumBy('prioritiesSet');
  const prioritiesDone = sumBy('prioritiesDone');

  const readingTrend = flatten('readingTrend');
  const stepsTrend = flatten('stepsTrend');

  const pickExtreme = (arr, cmp) => arr.length ? arr.reduce((a,b)=> cmp(b.value, a.value) ? b : a) : null;

  // Longest streak of the year isn't just the best of the 12
  // per-month bests — a run that spans the Jan 30 -> Feb 3 boundary
  // would be undercounted by every month-scoped bestStreak. Walked
  // once, across the whole year's own heat map, the same way
  // computeMonthSummary walks a single month's.
  let bestStreak = 0, curStreak = 0;
  const yearDates = [];
  for(let m=1; m<=12; m++){
    const mk = `${yk}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    datesInMonth(mk).forEach(ds=>yearDates.push(ds));
  }
  yearDates.forEach(ds=>{
    if((heat[ds]||0) > 0){ curStreak++; if(curStreak>bestStreak) bestStreak=curStreak; }
    else curStreak = 0;
  });

  const daysElapsed = yearDates.filter(ds=>ds<=todayDs).length;
  const daysLogged = yearDates.filter(ds=>ds<=todayDs && (heat[ds]||0)>0).length;

  const monthlyDaysLogged = months.map(ms => ({ monthKey: ms.monthKey, daysLogged: ms.daysLogged, daysElapsed: ms.daysElapsed }));
  const bestMonth = monthlyDaysLogged.filter(m=>m.daysElapsed>0)
    .reduce((best,m)=> (!best || (m.daysLogged/Math.max(1,m.daysElapsed)) > (best.daysLogged/Math.max(1,best.daysElapsed))) ? m : best, null);

  const moodCount = mergeCount('moodCount');
  const mindCount = mergeCount('mindCount');
  const workoutTypeCount = mergeCount('workoutTypeCount');

  let prevYearRate = null;
  const prevYk = String(+yk - 1);
  // Previous year's hit rate for the same number of days-of-year
  // elapsed this year, so a partial current year is compared fairly
  // against the same fraction of last year rather than all 365 days
  // of it.
  {
    const prevDates = [];
    for(let m=1; m<=12; m++) datesInMonth(`${prevYk}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`).forEach(ds=>prevDates.push(ds));
    const dayOfYear = yearDates.filter(ds=>ds<=todayDs).length;
    const comparableDates = prevDates.slice(0, dayOfYear);
    if(comparableDates.length){
      const prevLogged = comparableDates.filter(ds=>dayHasAny(ds)).length;
      prevYearRate = Math.round((prevLogged/comparableDates.length)*100);
    }
  }

  return {
    yearKey: yk,
    months,
    daysElapsed,
    daysInYear: yearDates.length,
    daysLogged,
    bestStreak,
    bestMonth,
    heat,
    avgRating: ratingCount ? (ratingSum/ratingCount) : null,
    ratingTrend,
    ratingBest: pickExtreme(ratingTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    ratingWorst: pickExtreme(ratingTrend, (b,a)=>b<a),
    prioritiesSet, prioritiesDone,
    prioritiesPct: prioritiesSet ? Math.round((prioritiesDone/prioritiesSet)*100) : 0,
    priorityTrend,
    readingTrend,
    pagesReadSum: sumBy('pagesReadSum'),
    readingDays: sumBy('readingDays'),
    minutesSum: sumBy('minutesSum'),
    readingBest: pickExtreme(readingTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    stepsTrend,
    stepsSum: sumBy('stepsSum'),
    workoutCount: sumBy('workoutCount'),
    workoutTypeCount,
    sleepSum: sumBy('sleepSum'),
    sleepCount: sumBy('sleepCount'),
    journalCount: sumBy('journalCount'),
    laneTrend,
    laneTotal,
    laneDays: laneTrend.length,
    laneNegDays: laneTrend.filter(x=>x.value<0).length,
    laneBest: pickExtreme(laneTrend, (b,a)=>b>a),
    moodCount,
    mindCount,
    prevYearRate,
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   WEEK SUMMARY — combined "day progress + this week" card shown
   on Home for every date, not just today. Top half is the ring
   for whichever day is selected plus the running streak/all-time
   counters (those two numbers don't change with the date you're
   viewing — they're always "as of today"). Bottom half is the
   Monday-start 7-day bar chart anchored to whichever week the
   selected date falls in, so scrubbing through history still
   shows the week that day belongs to.
   ============================================================ */
function computeWeekSummary(anchorDs){
  const base = new Date((anchorDs||todayStr())+'T00:00:00');
  const dow = base.getDay();
  const monday = new Date(base); monday.setDate(base.getDate()-((dow+6)%7));
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const days = [];
  let loggedCount=0, pagesSum=0, laneSum=0, ratingSum=0, ratingCount=0;
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const d = new Date(monday); d.setDate(monday.getDate()+i);
    const ds = localDateStr(d);
    const day = DB.days[ds];
    const count = day ? Object.values(day.pages).filter(p=>p._touched).length : 0;
    if(count>0 && ds<=todayDs) loggedCount++;
    if(day && day.pages){
      const rd = day.pages.reading;
      if(rd && rd._touched && rd.pagesToday) pagesSum += (+rd.pagesToday||0);
      const dash = day.pages.dashboard;
      if(dash && dash._touched && dash.rating){ ratingSum += (+dash.rating); ratingCount++; }
      // Gated on _touched and on the day having actually happened —
      // this used to sum every day in the week window, including
      // future days and lane pages that were auto-created but never
      // filled in, so the running total could move on its own.
      const ln = day.pages.lane;
      if(ln && ln._touched && ds<=todayDs) laneSum += laneValueForDay(ds);
    }
    days.push({ ds, count, isFuture: ds>todayDs, isToday: ds===todayDs, isAnchor: ds===(anchorDs||todayDs) });
  }
  return { days, loggedCount, pagesSum, laneSum, avgRating: ratingCount ? ratingSum/ratingCount : null };
}
function renderWeekSummary(anchorDs, ringData){
  const s = computeWeekSummary(anchorDs);
  const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...s.days.map(d=>d.count));
  const dowLetters = ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S'];
  const bars = s.days.map((d,i)=>{
    const h = d.count ? Math.max(10, Math.round((d.count/maxCount)*36)) : 3;
    return `<div class="wk-bar-col">
      <div class="wk-bar-track"><div class="wk-bar-fill ${d.isFuture?'future':''} ${d.isToday?'is-today':''} ${d.isAnchor&&!d.isToday?'is-anchor':''}" style="height:${h}px"></div></div>
      <div class="wk-bar-dow ${d.isToday?'is-today':''} ${d.isAnchor&&!d.isToday?'is-anchor':''}">${dowLetters[i]}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const ringHtml = ringData ? `
    <div class="week-summary-ringrow">
      <div class="ring-wrap ring-wrap-sm" role="img" aria-label="${ringData.doneCount} of ${ringData.total} pages logged ${ringData.isToday?'today':'this day'}">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64">
          <circle class="ring-track" cx="32" cy="32" r="${ringData.R}"/>
          <circle class="ring-fill" cx="32" cy="32" r="${ringData.R}" stroke-dasharray="${ringData.CIRC}" stroke-dashoffset="${ringData.ringOff}"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="ring-center ring-center-sm">${ringData.doneCount}/${ringData.total}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="streak-box">
        <div class="num">${DB.streak}</div>
        <div class="lbl">Day streak</div>
      </div>
      <div class="streak-box">
        <div class="num">${Object.keys(DB.days).filter(d=>dayHasAny(d)).length}</div>
        <div class="lbl">Days logged</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="week-summary-divider"></div>
  ` : '';

  return `
    <div class="week-summary-card">
      ${ringHtml}
      <div class="week-summary-head" onclick="nav('tracker')">
        <div class="week-summary-title">This week</div>
        <div class="week-summary-chev">${icon('chevright',14)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="week-summary-body" onclick="nav('tracker')">
        <div class="wk-bars">${bars}</div>
        <div class="week-summary-stats">
          <div class="wk-stat"><div class="v">${s.loggedCount}/7</div><div class="l">Days logged</div></div>
          <div class="wk-stat"><div class="v">${s.pagesSum}</div><div class="l">Pages read</div></div>
          <div class="wk-stat"><div class="v">${s.avgRating!==null ? s.avgRating.toFixed(1) : '—'}</div><div class="l">Avg rating</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}
function listMonthsWithData(){
  const keys = new Set();
  Object.keys(DB.days).forEach(ds=>{ if(dayHasAny(ds)) keys.add(monthKeyOf(ds)); });
  Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).forEach(mk=>keys.add(mk));
  keys.add(currentMonthKey());
  return Array.from(keys).sort();
}

/* ============================================================
   ASSIST MODE — larger controls + simpler visual density.
   This is intentionally persistent and one tap to toggle.
   ============================================================ */
const ASSIST_KEY = 'hustlers-logbook-assist';
function getAssistMode(){
  try{return localStorage.getItem(ASSIST_KEY)==='1';}catch(e){return false;}
}
function setAssistMode(enabled){
