  const on=!!enabled;
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('assist',on);
  try{localStorage.setItem(ASSIST_KEY,on?'1':'0');}catch(e){}
}
function toggleAssistMode(){
  setAssistMode(!getAssistMode());
  flashSaved(getAssistMode() ? 'Assist Mode on' : 'Assist Mode off');
  render();
}
setAssistMode(getAssistMode());

/* ============================================================
   THEME (light / dark)
   ============================================================ */
const THEME_KEY = 'hustlers-logbook-theme';
function getTheme(){
  return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';
}
function setTheme(theme){
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  try{ localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme); }catch(e){}
  const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  if(meta) meta.setAttribute('content', theme === 'dark' ? BRAND.themeColorDark : BRAND.themeColorLight);
}
function toggleTheme(){
  setTheme(getTheme() === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  flashSaved(getTheme()==='dark' ? 'Dark mode' : 'Light mode');
  render();
}

function getDay(dateStr){
  if(!DB.days[dateStr]) DB.days[dateStr] = { pages:{} };
  return DB.days[dateStr];
}
function getPage(dateStr, pageId){
  const d = getDay(dateStr);
  if(!d.pages[pageId]) d.pages[pageId] = {};
  return d.pages[pageId];
}
function markTouched(dateStr, pageId){
  getPage(dateStr, pageId)._touched = true;
  getPage(dateStr, pageId)._touchedAt = Date.now();
  recomputeStreak();
  saveDB();
}
function pageIsDone(dateStr, pageId){
  const d = DB.days[dateStr];
  return !!(d && d.pages[pageId] && d.pages[pageId]._touched);
}
function dayHasAny(dateStr){
  const d = DB.days[dateStr];
  if(!d) return false;
  return Object.values(d.pages).some(p => p._touched);
}
function recomputeStreak(){
  let streak = 0;
  let d = new Date();
  while(true){
    const ds = localDateStr(d);
    if(dayHasAny(ds)){ streak++; d.setDate(d.getDate()-1); }
    else break;
  }
  DB.streak = streak;
}
recomputeStreak();

/* ============================================================
   SETUP PAGES (bucket/timetable/income/objectives) — these are
   global, not per-day, so they track their own "last edited"
   stamp instead of participating in the daily streak/done count.
   ============================================================ */
if(!DB.setupMeta) DB.setupMeta = {};
function touchSetupPage(pageId){
  DB.setupMeta[pageId] = Date.now();
  saveDB();
}
function setupLastEdited(pageId){
  return DB.setupMeta && DB.setupMeta[pageId] ? DB.setupMeta[pageId] : null;
}
// Bare relative-time phrase ("3d ago", "just now") with no verb
// prefix — callers that need "Updated 3d ago" or "Deleted 3d ago"
// add their own verb, so the same helper works for both without
// producing something like "Deleted Updated 3d ago".
function fmtRelativeTime(ts){
  if(!ts) return 'not set up yet';
  const diffMs = Date.now() - ts;
  const mins = Math.floor(diffMs/60000);
  if(mins < 1) return 'just now';
  if(mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins/60);
  if(hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs/24);
  if(days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
  return `on ${new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'})}`;
}

/* ============================================================
   NEXT UP — one clear next action instead of a wall of tiles.
   Looks at today's core pages in a fixed priority order and
   returns the first one not yet touched, or null if all done.
   ============================================================ */
function computeNextUp(dateStr){
  const pages = pagesList(dateStr);
  for(const p of pages){
    if(!pageIsDone(dateStr, p.id)) return p;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ============================================================
   BACKUP — export/import the whole DB as JSON so switching
   phones or clearing browser data doesn't wipe the logbook.
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   BACKUP (export / import)
   Exports DB as a JSON file; importing restores it exactly and rolls back if the phone cannot store it.
   ============================================================ */
function exportData(){
  const payload = JSON.stringify(DB, null, 2);
  const blob = new Blob([payload], {type:'application/json'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  const stamp = todayStr();
  a.href = url;
  // Slugged from the brand name so a re-skinned build doesn't hand
  // people files named after a product they've never heard of.
  const slug = String(BRAND.name||'logbook').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'') || 'logbook';
  a.download = `${slug}-backup-${stamp}.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
  flashSaved('Backup downloaded');
}
function triggerImport(){
  const input = document.getElementById('import-file-input');
  if(input) input.click();
}
function handleImportFile(fileInput){
  const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    try{
      const parsed = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      if(!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || !('days' in parsed)){
        throw new Error('Not a logbook backup file');
      }
      const keepUnlocked = DB.unlocked === true;   // the store decides entitlement, not a backup file
      const prevDB = DB;
      DB = normalizeDB(parsed);
      DB.unlocked = keepUnlocked;
      recomputeStreak();
      if(!saveDB()){
        DB = prevDB;
        flashSaved('Backup is too large for this device — nothing was changed');
        return;
      }
      flashSaved('Backup restored');
      nav('home');
    }catch(err){
      flashSaved('Could not read that file');
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
  fileInput.value = '';
}

/* ============================================================
   COPY YESTERDAY — carries repetitive fields (session type,
   platform, route, market, etc.) forward one day so a person
   isn't retyping the same setup every single morning.
   ============================================================ */
function copyFromYesterday(dateStr, pageId){
  const d = new Date(dateStr+'T00:00:00');
  d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);
  const prevDs = localDateStr(d);
  const prevDay = DB.days[prevDs];
  if(!prevDay || !prevDay.pages[pageId]){
    flashSaved('Nothing logged yesterday');
    return;
  }
  const prev = prevDay.pages[pageId];
  const cur = getPage(dateStr, pageId);
  Object.keys(prev).forEach(k=>{
    if(k==='_touched' || k==='_touchedAt' || k.indexOf('cf_')===0) return;
    cur[k] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev[k]));
  });
  // Reading Log is special-cased: copying yesterday's title/author
  // is exactly what "copy yesterday" is for, but copying yesterday's
  // PAGE NUMBER and PAGES-READ verbatim would make it look like no
  // progress happened overnight. Instead, carry the book forward to
  // wherever it actually is today (its own bookmark) and start
  // "pages read today" fresh at 0, ready for the auto-add math.
  if(pageId==='reading'){
    const book = libCurrentBook();
    cur.pageFrom = book ? (book.pageCurrent||0) : (cur.pageFrom||0);
    cur.pagesToday = 0;
    cur.baselinePage = +cur.pageFrom || 0;
  }
  markTouched(dateStr, pageId);
  flashSaved('Copied from yesterday');
  render();
}
function hasYesterdayData(dateStr, pageId){
  const d = new Date(dateStr+'T00:00:00');
  d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);
  const prevDs = localDateStr(d);
  const prevDay = DB.days[prevDs];
  return !!(prevDay && prevDay.pages[pageId] && prevDay.pages[pageId]._touched);
}

/* ============================================================
   LIBRARY — the book you're reading persists across days as its
   own record (title, author, total pages, running page count)
   instead of resetting every night. Each day's Reading Log just
   logs *today's* pages/minutes/notes and nudges the shared book
   forward. Finishing a book archives it with its stats and clears
   the slate for the next one.
   ============================================================ */
function libBooks(){ return DB.library.books; }
function libCurrentBook(){
  const id = DB.library.currentBookId;
  return id ? DB.library.books[id] : null;
}
function libEnsureCurrentBook(){
  let book = libCurrentBook();
  if(book) return book;
  const id = 'bk_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
  book = { id, title:'', author:'', pageCurrent:0, pageTotal:0, rating:0,
    status:'reading', startedAt: todayStr(), finishedAt:null, lastLoggedDate:null, bookedDates:{}, dailyPages:{} };
  DB.library.books[id] = book;
  DB.library.currentBookId = id;
  saveDB();
  return book;
}
function libFinishedBooks(){
  return Object.values(DB.library.books)
    .filter(b=>b.status==='finished')
    .sort((a,b)=> (b.finishedAt||'').localeCompare(a.finishedAt||''));
}
function libUpdateCurrentBook(patch){
  const book = libEnsureCurrentBook();
  Object.assign(book, patch);
  saveDB();
  return book;
}
// Called whenever today's Reading Log changes a field — keeps the
// persistent book record (title/author/current page) in sync with
// whatever was just typed. Each book keeps its OWN per-day pages
// ledger (book.dailyPages), separate from the shared day page's
// pagesToday — that's what lets someone switch books mid-day
// without one book's "pages today" clobbering another's total for
// the same date.
function libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  const book = libEnsureCurrentBook();
  if(p.title) book.title = p.title;
  if(p.author) book.author = p.author;
  if(p.pageTotal) book.pageTotal = +p.pageTotal || 0;
  if(p.pageFrom !== undefined && p.pageFrom !== '') book.pageCurrent = +p.pageFrom || 0;
  if(p.rating) book.rating = +p.rating;
  book.bookedDates = book.bookedDates || {};
  book.dailyPages = book.dailyPages || {};
  if(p.pagesToday){
    book.bookedDates[dateStr] = true;
    book.dailyPages[dateStr] = +p.pagesToday || 0;
  }
  book.lastLoggedDate = dateStr;
  saveDB();
}
// Sums straight from the book's own ledger now, so it's accurate
// even when several books were each logged against on the same
// calendar date (switching books mid-day no longer loses anything).
function libPagesReadForBook(book){
  if(!book) return 0;
  if(book.dailyPages){
    return Object.values(book.dailyPages).reduce((s,n)=> s + (+n||0), 0);
  }
  // Fallback for books saved before dailyPages existed.
  const dates = book.bookedDates ? Object.keys(book.bookedDates) : Object.keys(DB.days);
  let sum = 0;
  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    const day = DB.days[ds];
    const rd = day && day.pages && day.pages.reading;
    if(rd && rd._touched && rd.pagesToday) sum += (+rd.pagesToday||0);
  });
  return sum;
}
function libDaysActiveForBook(book){
  if(!book) return 0;
  return book.bookedDates ? Object.keys(book.bookedDates).length : 0;
}
function libFinishCurrentBook(){
  const book = libCurrentBook();
  if(!book) return;
  book.status = 'finished';
  book.finishedAt = todayStr();
  book.pagesReadFinal = libPagesReadForBook(book);
  book.daysActiveFinal = libDaysActiveForBook(book);
  if(!book.pageTotal && book.pageCurrent) book.pageTotal = book.pageCurrent;
  DB.library.currentBookId = null;
  saveDB();
  flashSaved('Book added to your library 🎉');
  render();
}
function libStartNewBook(){
  const old = libCurrentBook();
  if(old) old.status = 'paused';
  DB.library.currentBookId = null;
  const book = libEnsureCurrentBook();
  // Every other library mutation stamps this; without it Settings
  // reported the shelf as untouched right after starting a book.
  touchSetupPage('library');

  const dateStr = todayStr();
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  p.title = '';
  p.author = '';
  p.pageTotal = '';
  p.pageFrom = '';
  p.pagesToday = 0;
  p.baselinePage = 0;
  p.bookId = book.id;

  saveDB();
  render();
}
function libPausedBooks(){
  return Object.values(DB.library.books)
    .filter(b=>b.status==='paused')
    .sort((a,b)=> (b.lastLoggedDate||'').localeCompare(a.lastLoggedDate||''));
}
// Books added ahead of time (title/author only, "want to read")
// that haven't been picked up yet — these show up as pickable
// options in the switch-book sheet before any pages are logged
// against them.
function libToReadBooks(){
  return Object.values(DB.library.books)
    .filter(b=>b.status==='toread')
    .sort((a,b)=> (a.title||'').localeCompare(b.title||''));
}
// Every book that's a valid target to switch reading to right now
// — paused ones you've already started, and ones queued up to
// read — excluding whichever book is already current.
function libSwitchableBooks(){
  const currentId = DB.library.currentBookId;
  return Object.values(DB.library.books)
    .filter(b=> b.id!==currentId && (b.status==='paused' || b.status==='toread'))
    .sort((a,b)=> (b.lastLoggedDate||'').localeCompare(a.lastLoggedDate||''));
}
// Pre-populate the library with a book you have read or plan to
// read, without touching the Reading Log at all. Shows up in the
// picker as "To read" until you actually switch to it and start
// logging pages, at which point it behaves exactly like any other
// paused/current book.
function libAddBookAhead(title, author, pageTotal){
  const t = String(title||'').trim();
  if(!t) return null;
  const id = 'bk_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
  const book = { id, title:t, author:String(author||'').trim(), pageCurrent:0, pageTotal: +pageTotal || 0, rating:0,
    status:'toread', startedAt:null, finishedAt:null, lastLoggedDate:null, bookedDates:{}, dailyPages:{} };
  DB.library.books[id] = book;
  touchSetupPage('library');
  flashSaved(`"${t}" added to your library`);
  render();
  return book;
}
// Switching books mid-day is common (finish one chapter, pick up
// another). Before handing today's page over to the new book, make
// sure anything already logged today stays credited to whichever
// book it was actually logged for — libSyncFromReadingLog already
// wrote it into that book's own dailyPages ledger as it was typed,
// so it's safe here. Then the day's visible fields are reset to the
// new book: "pages read today" starts back at 0 (a fresh book means
// a fresh day of reading, even if today already had entries for the
// old book) while "page you're on" picks up from that book's own
// saved bookmark rather than the outgoing book's.
function libResumeBook(id){
  const book = DB.library.books[id];
  if(!book) return;
  const old = libCurrentBook();
  if(old) old.status='paused';
  book.status = 'reading';
  if(!book.startedAt) book.startedAt = todayStr();
  DB.library.currentBookId = id;
  touchSetupPage('library');

  const dateStr = todayStr();
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  p.title = book.title || '';
  p.author = book.author || '';
  p.pageTotal = book.pageTotal || '';
  // Explicit numeric 0 rather than `book.pageCurrent || ''` — a book
  // that hasn't been started yet has pageCurrent 0, and that should
  // render as an actual 0 (matching pagesToday below), not blank.
  p.pageFrom = book.pageCurrent != null ? book.pageCurrent : '';
  // If this book was already logged against earlier today (switched
  // away and back), keep that count rather than wiping it — only a
  // genuinely fresh book for today starts back at 0.
  p.pagesToday = (book.dailyPages && book.dailyPages[dateStr]) ? book.dailyPages[dateStr] : 0;
  // baselinePage backs out today's already-logged pages from the
  // saved bookmark, so the auto-add math (baseline + pagesToday)
  // lands back on the same page rather than adding today's pages on
  // top of a bookmark that already includes them.
  p.baselinePage = Math.max(0, (+p.pageFrom||0) - (+p.pagesToday||0));
  p.bookId = id;

  nav('page','reading');
}
function libDeleteFinishedBook(id){
  delete DB.library.books[id];
  touchSetupPage('library');
  render();
}
function libTotalPagesRead(){
  return Object.values(DB.library.books).reduce((s,b)=> s + libPagesReadForBook(b), 0);
}

/* ============================================================
   WORKOUT PRESETS — named templates ("Leg Day", "Push Day") the
   person builds once from the Presets page, each holding a list
   of exercises. Loading a preset from the daily Workout Log drops

   otherwise; a preset is just a fast way to fill it.
   A couple of starter templates are suggested (not saved until the
   person taps to add one) so the picker isn't empty on day one.
   ============================================================ */

function workoutPresetList(){

function createWorkoutPreset(name){
  const id = 'wp_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
  DB.workoutPresets[id] = { id, name: name || 'New preset', exercises: [] };

function addWorkoutPresetFromSuggestion(suggestion){
  const id = 'wp_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6);
  DB.workoutPresets[id] = { id, name: suggestion.name, exercises: suggestion.exercises.map(e=>({...e})) };

function updateWorkoutPresetName(id, name){

function deleteWorkoutPreset(id){

function addWorkoutPresetExercise(id){
  const preset = DB.workoutPresets[id];
  if(!preset) return;
  if(!preset.exercises) preset.exercises = [];
  preset.exercises.push({});

}
function updateWorkoutPresetExercise(id, i, key, val){
  const preset = DB.workoutPresets[id];
  if(!preset || !preset.exercises[i]) return;
  preset.exercises[i][key] = val;
  touchSetupPage('workoutPresets');

function removeWorkoutPresetExercise(id, i){
  const preset = DB.workoutPresets[id];
  if(!preset) return;
  preset.exercises.splice(i,1);
  touchSetupPage('workoutPresets');
  render();
}
// Drops every exercise from the preset into today's (or whichever
// date is open) exercise log, appended after anything already
// there rather than replacing it — so loading a preset never
// throws away an exercise the person already logged by hand.
// Loaded exercises always start unchecked, ready to be ticked off
// as the session happens.
function loadWorkoutPreset(dateStr, presetId){
  const preset = DB.workoutPresets[presetId];
  if(!preset) return;
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  if(!p.exercises) p.exercises = [];
  preset.exercises.forEach(e=>{
    p.exercises.push({ name:e.name||'', sets:e.sets||'', reps:e.reps||'', weight:e.weight||'', done:false });
  });
  markTouched(dateStr,'workout');
  flashSaved(`"${preset.name}" loaded`);
  closeSheet();
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   ROUTER
   ============================================================ */
let ROUTE = { view:'home', pageId:null, date:todayStr() };
let SELECTED_DATE = todayStr();
const app = document.getElementById('app');

// Back-navigation history — every real navigation pushes the route
// it's leaving onto this stack, so "Back" (topbar button, or a
// hardware/gesture back on mobile) always returns to wherever the
// person actually came from instead of hardcoding a jump to Home.
// Deliberately in-memory only (not persisted) — a history from a
// past session isn't meaningful to resume into.
let NAV_HISTORY = [];
function nav(view, pageId, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  // Something like switching books calls nav('page','reading') to
  // land back on the same Reading page it's already showing — that
  // isn't a real navigation, just a "refresh to this same place."
  // Pushing history for it would mean Back has to be pressed once
  // per no-op call before it actually leaves the page (the bug this
  // guards against). Only push when the destination genuinely
  // differs from where we already are.
  const isSamePlace = ROUTE.view===view && ROUTE.pageId===pageId;
  if(!opts.isBack && !isSamePlace){
    NAV_HISTORY.push(ROUTE);
  }
  ROUTE = { view, pageId, date: SELECTED_DATE };
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
// The one function every "Back"/"return" affordance should call.
// Pops the last real route off the stack and returns there; if the
// stack is empty (e.g. first screen after launch), Home is a
// reasonable fallback rather than doing nothing.
function navBack(){
  const prev = NAV_HISTORY.pop();
  if(prev){
    nav(prev.view, prev.pageId, { isBack:true });
  } else {
    nav('home', null, { isBack:true });
  }
}

function fmtDateLong(ds){
  const d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{ weekday:'long', month:'long', day:'numeric' });
}
function fmtDateShort(ds){
  const d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{ month:'short', day:'numeric' });
}

/* ============================================================
   TIMETABLE (time -> box)
   Your day is a list of hour blocks. Each block can be LINKED to a box (a page you log in). When that hour arrives, Home shows that box. Hours with nothing linked show an idle quote. First-run setup and the Timetable page both edit this.
   ============================================================ */
const TIMETABLE_SLOTS = ['05:00','06:00','07:00','08:00','09:00','10:00','11:00','12:00','13:00','14:00','15:00','16:00','17:00','18:00'];

/* One-tap starting timetables for onboarding and for "reset to a
   template" on the Timetable page. Each preset still lines up with
   TIMETABLE_SLOTS (hourly 5am–6pm) as a *starting point* — once
   applied, every block is fully free to move, and the person can
   add/remove blocks at any time of day from there. */
const TIMETABLE_PRESETS = [
  { id:'early', name:'Early Riser', desc:'Up before the sun, done by dinner', tasks:[
    'Wake, hydrate, move','Deep work block','Deep work block','Breakfast + plan the day',
    'Main hustle / income work','Main hustle / income work','Lunch break','Admin & follow-ups',
    'Main hustle / income work','Workout','Family / personal time','Dinner',
    'Wind down, light reading','Sleep by 10'
  ]},
  { id:'standard', name:'Standard 9-to-5', desc:'Classic structure around a day job', tasks:[
    'Sleep','Wake, get ready','Commute / morning routine','Day job',
    'Day job','Day job','Lunch break','Day job',
    'Day job','Side hustle block','Dinner + family time','Side hustle block',
    'Wind down','Sleep'
  ]},
  { id:'night', name:'Night Owl', desc:'Slow mornings, work picks up at night', tasks:[
    'Sleep','Sleep','Wake slowly, no rush','Light admin, email',
    'Main hustle / income work','Lunch break','Main hustle / income work','Errands / life admin',
    'Break, recharge','Main hustle / income work','Dinner','Main hustle / income work — peak hours',
    'Wind down','Sleep late'
  ]},
];
function timetablePresetBlocks(presetId){
  const preset = TIMETABLE_PRESETS.find(p=>p.id===presetId);
  return TIMETABLE_SLOTS.map((time,i)=>({ time, task: preset ? (preset.tasks[i]||'') : '' }));
}
function applyTimetablePreset(presetId){
  DB.timetable.blocks = timetablePresetBlocks(presetId);
  touchSetupPage('timetable');
}
function addTimetableBlock(time){
  const t = normalizeTimeStr(time);
  if(!t) return;
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  if(blocks.some(b=>b.time===t)){ flashSaved('Already have a block at that time'); return; }
  blocks.push({ time:t, task:'' });
  DB.timetable.blocks = blocks;
  touchSetupPage('timetable');
  flashSaved('Block added');
  render();
}
function removeTimetableBlock(time){
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks().filter(b=>b.time!==time);
  DB.timetable.blocks = blocks;
  if(DB.timetable.mapping) delete DB.timetable.mapping[time];
  if(DB.timetable.idleQuotes) delete DB.timetable.idleQuotes[time];
  touchSetupPage('timetable');
  saveDB();
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   FOCUS MAPPING — which logbook page correlates with each hour
   of the timetable. This is what turns "the timetable says it's
   workout time" into "put the whole Workout Log front and
   center." Mapping is per time-slot, chosen by the person (in
   onboarding or from the Timetable page), not auto-guessed from
   the freeform task text — the task text is just a label the
   person typed, it doesn't reliably say which page it means.
   ============================================================ */
const FOCUS_PAGES = [
  { id:'workout',  name:'Workout Log' },
  { id:'journal',  name:'Journal' },
  { id:'reading',  name:'Reading Log' },
  { id:'lane',     name:'Business Lane' },
  { id:'dashboard',name:'Daily Dashboard' },
];
function focusPageMeta(id){ return FOCUS_PAGES.find(f=>f.id===id) || null; }
function getSlotMapping(time){
  return (DB.timetable.mapping && DB.timetable.mapping[time]) || null;
}
function setSlotMapping(time, pageId){
  if(!DB.timetable.mapping) DB.timetable.mapping = {};
  if(pageId){ DB.timetable.mapping[time] = pageId; }
  else{ delete DB.timetable.mapping[time]; }
  saveDB();
}

/* Default rotating pool for slots with no page mapped. Picked
   deterministically per slot+day so it doesn't flicker to a new
   line on every re-render, but still varies day to day. A custom
   override in DB.timetable.idleQuotes always wins. */
const IDLE_QUOTES = [
  "Idle? Suspicious.",
  "Recharge. Empires aren't built tired.",
  "Even CEOs nap.",
  "Compounding quietly.",
  "Cash flow can wait one hour.",
  "Sharpen the axe.",
  "Inbox zero? Dream on.",
  "Plan the next move.",
  "Hustle has a lunch break too.",
  "Free hour. Spend it like capital.",
];
/* ============================================================
   IDLE QUOTES
   The line shown for an hour with no box. Picked from this app's own pool, shuffled by date so neighbouring hours never repeat. A quote you type for an hour wins.
   ============================================================ */
function idleQuoteFor(time, dateStr){
  const custom = DB.timetable.idleQuotes && DB.timetable.idleQuotes[time];
  if(custom && custom.trim()) return custom.trim();
  const n = IDLE_QUOTES.length;
  const hash = function(str){ let x = 2166136261; for(const c of String(str)){ x ^= c.charCodeAt(0); x = Math.imul(x, 16777619); } x ^= x >>> 15; x = Math.imul(x, 2246822519); x ^= x >>> 13; return x >>> 0; };
  /* The date shuffles the pool; the slot's place in the day's timetable walks that order,
     so neighbouring idle slots never repeat and a day cycles through every line. Stable per render. */
  const order = IDLE_QUOTES.map(function(_,i){ return i; }); let seed = hash(dateStr||'');
  for(let i=n-1;i>0;i--){ seed = (Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0; const j = seed % (i+1); const t = order[i]; order[i] = order[j]; order[j] = t; }
  const all = Array.from(new Set(((DB.timetable && DB.timetable.blocks)||[]).map(function(b){ return timeStrToMinutes(b.time); }))).sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
  const idx = all.indexOf(timeStrToMinutes(time));
  return IDLE_QUOTES[order[(idx>=0 ? idx : hash(time)) % n]];
}
function setIdleQuote(time, text){
  if(!DB.timetable.idleQuotes) DB.timetable.idleQuotes = {};
  const t = String(text||'').trim();
  if(t){ DB.timetable.idleQuotes[time] = t; }
  else{ delete DB.timetable.idleQuotes[time]; }
  saveDB();
}

  accessibility:'<circle cx="12" cy="4.5" r="1.6"/><path d="M5 8.5h14"/><path d="M12 8.5v5.2"/><path d="M8.5 21l3.5-7.3 3.5 7.3"/>',
  undo:'<path d="M7 8H4V5"/><path d="M4.5 8A8 8 0 1 1 6 17.5"/>',
};
function icon(name, size=20, extra=''){
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${size}" height="${size}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ${extra}>${ICONS[name]||''}</svg>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   ESCAPE HELPER — every piece of user-typed text that gets
   interpolated back into an HTML attribute or text node must
   go through this, or a stray " / < / & breaks the re-render.
   ============================================================ */
function esc(v){
  if(v===null || v===undefined) return '';
  return String(v)
    .replaceAll('&','&amp;')
    .replaceAll('"','&quot;')
    .replaceAll("'",'&#39;')
    .replaceAll('<','&lt;')
    .replaceAll('>','&gt;');
}

/* ============================================================
   SAVE TOAST
   ============================================================ */
let toastTimer=null;
function flashSaved(msg){
  let t = document.querySelector('.save-toast');
  if(!t){
    t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className='save-toast';
    document.body.appendChild(t);
  }
  t.innerHTML = icon('check',14) + '<span>'+(msg||'Logged')+'</span>';
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>t.classList.add('show'));
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'), 1100);
}

/* ============================================================
   RENDER: TOPBAR
   ============================================================ */
function renderTopbar(title, showBack){
  return `
  <div class="topbar">
    ${showBack ? `<button class="back" onclick="navBack()">${icon('chevleft',18)} Back</button>` : `<span class="spacer"></span>`}
    <div class="title">${title}</div>
    <div class="topbar-right">
      <button class="theme-toggle" onclick="toggleTheme()" aria-label="Toggle dark mode">${icon(getTheme()==='dark'?'sun':'moon',15)}</button>
      <div class="date-pill">${fmtDateShort(ROUTE.date)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
/* Single source for the four top-level destinations. Both
   renderBottomNav (phone/tablet-portrait) and renderSideRail
   (tablet-landscape/desktop, see the RESPONSIVE SHELL CSS block)
   build from this, so the two navs can't drift out of sync the
   way they would if the rail had its own copied-and-pasted list. */
const NAV_ITEMS = [
  { id:'home', label:'Today', icon:'home' },
  { id:'tracker', label:'Monthly', icon:'chart' },
  { id:'history', label:'History', icon:'history' },
  { id:'settings', label:'Settings', icon:'gear' },
];
function renderBottomNav(active){
  // The rail can no longer be part of this function's returned
  // string: #app is replaced wholesale on every render() call, but
  // the rail now lives in a sibling mount point (#side-rail-mount,
  // outside #app — see index.html) so flexbox can lay it out as a
  // real sibling of #app instead of a `position:fixed` guess. See
  // the RESPONSIVE SHELL CSS block for why that guess was the bug.
  mountSideRail(active);
  return `<button class="assist-toggle ${getAssistMode()?'active':''}" type="button" onclick="toggleAssistMode()" aria-label="${getAssistMode()?'Turn off':'Turn on'} Assist Mode" aria-pressed="${getAssistMode()}">${icon('accessibility',20)}</button><div class="bottom-tabs bottom-tabs-4">
    ${NAV_ITEMS.map(t=>`<button class="${active===t.id?'active':''}" onclick="nav('${t.id}')">${icon(t.icon,19)}${t.label}</button>`).join('')}
  </div>`;
}
/* Tablet-landscape / desktop nav. Lives in #side-rail-mount, a
   sibling of #app, not inside it — CSS hides it entirely below
   1100px (.side-rail{display:none} + the max-width:1099px
   override) but the markup is always written, so resizing across
   that boundary never needs a re-render to show the right nav.
   Same active/click wiring as the bottom tabs; this is a second
   skin on the same NAV_ITEMS, not a second nav. Written directly
   to its mount rather than returned as a string, since nothing
   else touches #side-rail-mount and re-writing it on every
   renderBottomNav call is cheap and keeps it trivially in sync
   with whichever page is active. */
function mountSideRail(active){
  const mount = document.getElementById('side-rail-mount');
  if(!mount) return;
  mount.innerHTML = `<div class="side-rail">
    <div class="side-rail-brand"><span class="mark">${icon(BRAND.markIcon,16)}</span>${esc(BRAND.shortName||BRAND.name)}</div>
    ${NAV_ITEMS.map(t=>`<button class="${active===t.id?'active':''}" onclick="nav('${t.id}')">${icon(t.icon,19)}${esc(t.label)}</button>`).join('')}
    <div class="side-rail-spacer"></div>
    <button class="assist-toggle-rail ${getAssistMode()?'active':''}" onclick="toggleAssistMode()" aria-pressed="${getAssistMode()}">${icon('accessibility',18)}${getAssistMode()?'Assist Mode on':'Assist Mode'}</button>
  </div>`;
}
/* Views with no bottom nav (single daily pages, reached via
   renderPage — see HANDOFF.md) never call renderBottomNav, so the
   rail from whatever page was open before would otherwise still be
   showing. Called once from render() itself; see the router. */
function clearSideRail(){
  const mount = document.getElementById('side-rail-mount');
  if(mount) mount.innerHTML = '';
}

/* ============================================================
   HOME VIEW
   ============================================================ */
const QUOTES = [
  "Be the energy you want to attract.",
  "Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.",
  "Small logs, compounded daily, become a record you're proud of.",
  "You don't rise to your goals. You fall to your systems.",
  "Log it before you forget why it mattered.",
  "Nobody's coming. Log your own progress.",
];
function quoteForDate(ds){
  let h=0; for(const c of ds) h = (h*31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 9973;
  return QUOTES[h % QUOTES.length];
}

/* ============================================================
   ONBOARDING — a short guided setup, not a wall of choices.
   Pattern: progress bar + "STEP X of Y" + one focused question
   per screen + a persistent bottom CTA that enables once you've
   answered. Every step past Welcome has a real skip path, so the
   laziest route still ends in a fully usable app in one tap.
   Steps: welcome -> lane -> timetable-pick -> timetable-review
          -> bucket -> objectives -> done
   ============================================================ */
/* One list drives the flow, the progress bar AND the "here's what
   we'll do" preview on the welcome screen. Several steps share a
   `group` because Timetable is three screens the person experiences
   as one task — the welcome screen counts groups, the progress bar
   counts screens. The welcome screen used to say "Four quick steps"
   as literal text while the bar drew six segments. */
const ONBOARD_STEPS = [
  { id:'lane',             group:'Pick your business lane' },
  { id:'timetable-pick',   group:'Set your default timetable' },
  { id:'timetable-review', group:'Set your default timetable' },
  { id:'timetable-focus',  group:'Set your default timetable' },
  { id:'bucket',           group:'Write your bucket list' },
  { id:'objectives',       group:'Name 3 objectives' },
];
const ONSTEPS_ORDER = ONBOARD_STEPS.map(s=>s.id);
const ONBOARD_GROUPS = ONBOARD_STEPS.reduce((out,s)=>{ if(!out.includes(s.group)) out.push(s.group); return out; }, []);
const ONBOARD_NUMBER_WORDS = ['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight'];

/* Setup is resumable. The draft is written to its own localStorage
   key on every answer, so closing the tab halfway through the
   timetable review and coming back lands on the same screen with
   the same answers instead of restarting at Welcome. The key is
   deleted the moment setup completes — it is scratch space, not a
   second copy of the DB. */
const ONBOARD_KEY = STORAGE_KEY + '-onboarding';
const ONDRAFT_DEFAULT = () => ({ lane:null, presetId:null, blocks:null, mapping:{}, bucketItems:null, objTitles:['','',''] });
let ONSTEP = 'welcome';
let ONDRAFT = ONDRAFT_DEFAULT();
(function restoreOnboardDraft(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(ONBOARD_KEY);
    if(!raw) return;
    const saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') return;
    if(saved.draft && typeof saved.draft === 'object') ONDRAFT = Object.assign(ONDRAFT_DEFAULT(), saved.draft);
    // Only resume onto a step that still exists — renaming or
    // removing a step shouldn't strand anyone on a blank screen.
    if(saved.step === 'welcome' || ONSTEPS_ORDER.includes(saved.step)) ONSTEP = saved.step;
  }catch(e){ /* corrupt draft: start clean rather than half-restored */ }
})();
function saveOnboardDraft(){
  try{ localStorage.setItem(ONBOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify({ step:ONSTEP, draft:ONDRAFT })); }catch(e){}
}
function clearOnboardDraft(){
  try{ localStorage.removeItem(ONBOARD_KEY); }catch(e){}
}
/* Re-run the walkthrough later (Settings -> Run setup again).
   Deliberately does NOT wipe anything: it starts a fresh draft and
   commits over the top, so someone who just wants to redo their
   timetable doesn't lose a month of logs to do it. */
function restartOnboarding(){
  ONSTEP = 'welcome';
  ONDRAFT = ONDRAFT_DEFAULT();
  DB.onboarded = false;
  saveDB();
  clearOnboardDraft();
  closeSheet();
  render();
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
function confirmRestartOnboarding(){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Run setup again?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>Walks you back through the setup screens. Nothing you've logged is deleted — anything you fill in simply overwrites that one setting when you finish.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" style="background:var(--accent);" onclick="restartOnboarding()">${icon('chevright',15)} Start the walkthrough</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  `);
}

function finishOnboarding(){
  // Commit whatever was actually filled in during the flow. Nothing
  // half-finished gets written — a step only lands in DB if the
  // person reached or passed it.
  if(ONDRAFT.lane) DB.lane = ONDRAFT.lane;
  if(ONDRAFT.blocks) DB.timetable.blocks = ONDRAFT.blocks;
  if(ONDRAFT.mapping && Object.keys(ONDRAFT.mapping).length){
    DB.timetable.mapping = Object.assign({}, DB.timetable.mapping, ONDRAFT.mapping);
  }
  if(ONDRAFT.bucketItems && ONDRAFT.bucketItems.some(it=>it.text && it.text.trim())){
    getMonthlyPage('bucket').items = ONDRAFT.bucketItems;
  }
  if(ONDRAFT.objTitles && ONDRAFT.objTitles.some(t=>t && t.trim())){
    getMonthlyPage('objectives').list = ONDRAFT.objTitles.map(title=>({title}));
  }
  DB.onboarded = true;
  saveDB();
  clearOnboardDraft();
  render();
}
function onboardGoto(step){
  ONSTEP = step;
  saveOnboardDraft();
  render();
}
function onboardStepIndex(){
  return ONSTEPS_ORDER.indexOf(ONSTEP);
}
function onboardBack(){
  const i = onboardStepIndex();
  if(i<=0){ onboardGoto('welcome'); return; }
  onboardGoto(ONSTEPS_ORDER[i-1]);
}
function onboardNext(){
  const i = onboardStepIndex();
  if(i===-1 || i===ONSTEPS_ORDER.length-1){ finishOnboarding(); return; }
  onboardGoto(ONSTEPS_ORDER[i+1]);
}
/* Skipping ONE screen (the CTA reads "Skip this step"). The
   top-right "Skip setup" button is a different action — it calls
   finishOnboarding() and leaves the flow entirely. Both used to
   call this, so the button labelled "Skip setup" only advanced a
   single screen. */
function onboardSkipStep(){ onboardNext(); }
function onboardPickLane(id){
  ONDRAFT.lane = id;
  saveOnboardDraft();
  render();
}
function onboardPickPreset(presetId){
  ONDRAFT.presetId = presetId;
  if(presetId==='blank'){
    ONDRAFT.blocks = [];
  } else {
    ONDRAFT.blocks = timetablePresetBlocks(presetId);
  }
  saveOnboardDraft();
  render();
}
function onboardEditBlock(i,val){
  if(!ONDRAFT.blocks || !ONDRAFT.blocks[i]) return;
  ONDRAFT.blocks[i].task = val;
  // No render() — this fires per keystroke and a full re-render
  // would drop the caret. Persisting is cheap and safe.
  saveOnboardDraft();
}
function onboardSetMapping(time, pageId){
  if(!ONDRAFT.mapping) ONDRAFT.mapping = {};
  if(pageId){ ONDRAFT.mapping[time] = pageId; }
  else{ delete ONDRAFT.mapping[time]; }
  saveOnboardDraft();
  render();
}
function onboardBucketUpdate(i,val){
  if(!ONDRAFT.bucketItems) ONDRAFT.bucketItems = [{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'WANT',text:''}];
  ONDRAFT.bucketItems[i].text = val;
  saveOnboardDraft();
}
function onboardObjUpdate(i,val){
  ONDRAFT.objTitles[i] = val;
  saveOnboardDraft();
}

/* ============================================================
   FIRST-RUN SETUP
   The welcome flow. The steps list (ONBOARD_STEPS) is extended at the bottom of the file by the SETUP STEPS script.
   ============================================================ */
function renderOnboarding(){
  if(ONSTEP==='welcome') return renderOnboardWelcome();
  if(ONSTEP==='lane') return renderOnboardLane();
  if(ONSTEP==='timetable-pick') return renderOnboardTimetablePick();
  if(ONSTEP==='timetable-review') return renderOnboardTimetableReview();
  if(ONSTEP==='timetable-focus') return renderOnboardTimetableFocus();
  if(ONSTEP==='bucket') return renderOnboardBucket();
  if(ONSTEP==='objectives') return renderOnboardObjectives();
}

function onboardShell(opts){
  // opts: { eyebrow, title, sub, body, ctaLabel, ctaEnabled, showSkip, showBack }
  const i = onboardStepIndex();
  const total = ONSTEPS_ORDER.length;
  const segFilled = i<0 ? 0 : i+1;
  const segs = Array.from({length:total}).map((_,idx)=>`<div class="onb-seg ${idx<segFilled?'filled':''}"></div>`).join('');

  app.innerHTML = `
    <div class="onboard-screen">
      <div class="onboard-top">
        ${opts.showBack ? `<button class="onboard-back" onclick="onboardBack()">${icon('chevleft',18)}</button>` : `<span></span>`}
        ${opts.showSkip ? `<button class="onboard-skip" onclick="finishOnboarding()">Skip setup</button>` : `<span></span>`}
      </div>
      <div class="onb-progress">${segs}</div>
      <div class="onboard-body">
        ${opts.eyebrow ? `<div class="onb-eyebrow">${opts.eyebrow}</div>` : ''}
        <h1 class="onb-title">${opts.title}</h1>
        ${opts.sub ? `<p class="onb-sub">${opts.sub}</p>` : ''}
        <div class="onb-scroll">${opts.body}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="onboard-actions">
        <button class="onboard-cta" ${opts.ctaEnabled===false?'disabled':''} onclick="${opts.ctaAction||'onboardNext()'}">${opts.ctaLabel||'Continue'} ${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderOnboardWelcome(){
  app.innerHTML = `
    <div class="onboard-screen">
      <div class="onboard-top">
        <span></span>
        <button class="onboard-skip" onclick="finishOnboarding()">Skip setup</button>
      </div>
      <div class="onboard-body onboard-hero">
        <div class="onboard-mark">${icon(BRAND.markIcon,30)}</div>
        <h1 class="onb-title" style="text-align:center;">${(BRAND.nameLines||[BRAND.name]).map(esc).join('<br>')}</h1>
        <p class="onb-sub" style="text-align:center;">${esc(((ONBOARD_NUMBER_WORDS[ONBOARD_GROUPS.length] || String(ONBOARD_GROUPS.length)).replace(/^./, c=>c.toUpperCase())))} quick step${ONBOARD_GROUPS.length===1?'':'s'}. Skip ${ONBOARD_GROUPS.length===1?'it':'any of them'} — you can fill ${ONBOARD_GROUPS.length===1?'it':'it all'} in later.</p>
        <div class="onb-preview">
          ${ONBOARD_GROUPS.map((g,i)=>`<div class="onb-preview-row"><span class="onb-preview-num">${i+1}</span> ${esc(g)}</div>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="onboard-actions">
        <button class="onboard-cta" onclick="onboardGoto('${ONSTEPS_ORDER[0]}')">${ONDRAFT.lane || ONDRAFT.blocks ? 'Pick up where you left off' : "Let's go"} ${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
        <button class="onboard-ghost" onclick="finishOnboarding()">Skip, take me straight in</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderOnboardLane(){
  const cards = LANES.map(l=>{
    const sel = ONDRAFT.lane===l.id;
    return `<div class="onb-radio-card ${sel?'selected':''}" onclick="onboardPickLane('${l.id}')">
      <div class="lane-glyph">${esc(l.glyph)}</div>
      <div class="lane-info">
        <div class="lane-name">${esc(l.name)}</div>
        <div class="lane-desc">${esc(l.desc)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="onb-radio ${sel?'checked':''}"></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: `Step ${onboardStepIndex()+1} of ${ONSTEPS_ORDER.length}`,
    title: "What are you building?",
    sub: "Pick the hustle you'll log daily. You can switch lanes any time from the Business Lane page.",
    body: cards,
    ctaEnabled: !!ONDRAFT.lane,
    showSkip: true,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

function renderOnboardTimetablePick(){
  const presets = [...TIMETABLE_PRESETS, {id:'blank', name:'Start blank', desc:"Skip the preset — I'll build my own hour by hour", blank:true}];
  const cards = presets.map(p=>{
    const sel = ONDRAFT.presetId===p.id;
    return `<div class="onb-radio-card ${sel?'selected':''}" onclick="onboardPickPreset('${p.id}')">
      <div class="lane-info">
        <div class="lane-name">${esc(p.name)}</div>
        <div class="lane-desc">${esc(p.desc)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="onb-radio ${sel?'checked':''}"></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: `Step ${onboardStepIndex()+1} of ${ONSTEPS_ORDER.length}`,
    title: 'Set your default timetable.',
    sub: "Choose a starting rhythm. You'll be able to tweak every hour on the next screen — and edit it any time from the Timetable page.",
    body: cards,
    ctaLabel: ONDRAFT.presetId ? 'Continue' : 'Skip this step',
    ctaAction: ONDRAFT.presetId ? 'onboardNext()' : 'onboardSkipStep()',
    ctaEnabled: true,
    showSkip: true,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

function renderOnboardTimetableReview(){
  // `[]` is truthy, so "Start blank" used to land here and draw an
  // empty "Make it yours" screen with no rows and no way to add one.
  if(!ONDRAFT.blocks || !ONDRAFT.blocks.length){
    // Nothing to review — move straight on.
    onboardNext();
    return;
  }
  const rows = ONDRAFT.blocks.map((b,i)=>`
    <div class="onb-tt-row">
      <div class="onb-tt-time">${esc(b.time)}</div>
      <input class="onb-tt-input" value="${esc(b.task)}" placeholder="What happens here..." oninput="onboardEditBlock(${i},this.value)">
    </div>`).join('');
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: 'Review',
    title: 'Make it yours.',
    sub: "Edit anything that's not quite right. This becomes your standing daily template.",
    body: `<div class="onb-tt-list">${rows}</div>`,
    ctaLabel: 'Looks good',
    ctaEnabled: true,
    showSkip: false,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

function renderOnboardTimetableFocus(){
  if(!ONDRAFT.blocks || !ONDRAFT.blocks.length){
    // No timetable to attach a page to — nothing to do here.
    onboardNext();
    return;
  }
  const rows = ONDRAFT.blocks.filter(b=>b.task && b.task.trim()).map(b=>{
    const mapped = ONDRAFT.mapping ? ONDRAFT.mapping[b.time] : null;
    return `
    <div class="onb-focus-row">
      <div class="onb-focus-top">
        <div class="onb-tt-time">${esc(b.time)}</div>
        <div class="onb-focus-task">${esc(b.task)}</div>
      </div>
      <select class="onb-focus-select" onchange="onboardSetMapping('${b.time}', this.value || null)">
        <option value="">No linked page</option>
        ${bxFocusPages().map(f=>`<option value="${f.id}" ${f.id===mapped?'selected':''}>${esc(f.name)}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: `Step ${onboardStepIndex()+1} of ${ONSTEPS_ORDER.length}`,
    title: 'Link an hour to a page.',
    sub: "When it's that hour, Home puts the whole page front and center — no digging for it. Only worth doing for hours you'll actually want to log something. Skip any hour that doesn't need one.",
    body: rows ? `<div class="onb-tt-list">${rows}</div>` : `<p class="onb-sub">No hours have a task yet — nothing to link. You can always set this up later from the Timetable page.</p>`,
    ctaLabel: 'Continue',
    ctaEnabled: true,
    showSkip: true,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

function renderOnboardBucket(){
  if(!ONDRAFT.bucketItems) ONDRAFT.bucketItems = [{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'WANT',text:''}];
  const rows = ONDRAFT.bucketItems.map((it,i)=>`
    <div class="onb-bucket-row">
      <span class="pill ${it.tier==='MUST'?'active red':''}" style="padding:5px 9px; font-size:9px; flex-shrink:0;">${esc(it.tier)}</span>
      <input class="onb-tt-input" value="${esc(it.text)}" placeholder="A goal you're chasing..." oninput="onboardBucketUpdate(${i},this.value)">
    </div>`).join('');
  const filled = ONDRAFT.bucketItems.some(it=>it.text && it.text.trim());
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: `Step ${onboardStepIndex()+1} of ${ONSTEPS_ORDER.length}`,
    title: 'Anything you\'re chasing?',
    sub: "Big or small — three lines is enough to start. You can build this out properly any time from Bucket List.",
    body: `<div class="onb-tt-list">${rows}</div>`,
    ctaLabel: filled ? 'Continue' : 'Skip this step',
    ctaAction: filled ? 'onboardNext()' : 'onboardSkipStep()',
    ctaEnabled: true,
    showSkip: true,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

function renderOnboardObjectives(){
  const rows = ONDRAFT.objTitles.map((t,i)=>`
    <div class="onb-bucket-row">
      <span class="onb-obj-num">${i+1}</span>
      <input class="onb-tt-input" value="${esc(t)}" placeholder="Name an objective for this month..." oninput="onboardObjUpdate(${i},this.value)">
    </div>`).join('');
  const filled = ONDRAFT.objTitles.some(t=>t && t.trim());
  onboardShell({
    eyebrow: `Step ${onboardStepIndex()+1} of ${ONSTEPS_ORDER.length}`,
    title: 'Three things. This month.',
    sub: "Name them clearly or they won't happen. Fine to leave blank and set these later from 3 Objectives.",
    body: `<div class="onb-tt-list">${rows}</div>`,
    ctaLabel: filled ? "Let's go" : 'Skip and finish',
    ctaAction: 'finishOnboarding()',
    ctaEnabled: true,
    showSkip: true,
    showBack: true,
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   HOME
   The Today screen: week strip, streak, and the box for the current hour.
   ============================================================ */
function renderHome(){
  const today = todayStr();
  const weekDates = [];
  const baseDate = SELECTED_DATE || today;
  const base = new Date(baseDate+'T00:00:00');
  const dow = base.getDay();
  const monday = new Date(base); monday.setDate(base.getDate() - ((dow+6)%7));
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
    const d = new Date(monday); d.setDate(monday.getDate()+i);
    weekDates.push(localDateStr(d));
  }

  const selDate = SELECTED_DATE;
  const pagesForDate = pagesList(selDate);
  const doneCount = pagesForDate.filter(p=>pageIsDone(selDate,p.id)).length;

  const weekStrip = weekDates.map(ds=>{
    const d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00');
    const isToday = ds===today;
    const isSel = ds===selDate;
    const dayPages = pagesList(ds).filter(p=>pageIsDone(ds,p.id));
    const dots = dayPages.slice(0,4).map(()=>'<span class="dot"></span>').join('');
    return `<div class="week-day ${isToday?'today':''} ${isSel&&!isToday?'selected':''}" onclick="selectDate('${ds}')">
      <div class="dow">${d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'narrow'})}</div>
      <div class="dnum">${d.getDate()}</div>
      <div class="dots">${dots}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const tiles = pagesForDate.map(p=>{
    const done = pageIsDone(selDate, p.id);
    let statusText = done ? doneSummary(selDate, p.id) : p.status();
    // Business Lane: once a lane is picked, tapping the tile should go
    // straight to today's log for it, not back through the picker every time.
    const tapAction = (p.id==='lane' && DB.lane) ? `openLaneLog()` : `openPage('${p.id}')`;
    return `<button class="page-tile ${done?'done':''}" onclick="${tapAction}">
      <div class="check-badge">${icon('check',11)}</div>
      <div class="tile-top">
        <div class="tile-icon">${icon(p.icon,26)}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="tile-name">${esc(p.name)}</div>
        <div class="tile-status">${statusText}</div>
      </div>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');

  const laneInfo = DB.lane ? LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane) : null;

  const setupTiles = SETUP_PAGES.map(p=>{
    let statusText, locked = false;
    if(p.cadence === 'monthly'){
      locked = isMonthlyPageLocked(p.id);
      statusText = locked ? `Done for ${monthLabelShort()}` : p.status();
    } else {
      const ts = setupLastEdited(p.id);
      statusText = ts ? `Updated ${fmtRelativeTime(ts)}` : p.status();
    }
    const openCall = `openPage('${p.id}')`;
    return `<button class="page-tile setup-tile ${locked?'locked-tile':''}" onclick="${openCall}">
      <div class="tile-top">
        <div class="tile-icon">${icon(locked?'check':p.icon,26)}</div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="tile-name">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="tile-status">${statusText}</div>
      </div>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');

  const pct = pagesForDate.length ? doneCount/pagesForDate.length : 0;
  const R = 26, CIRC = 2*Math.PI*R, ringOff = CIRC*(1-pct);

  const nextUp = computeNextUp(selDate);
  const isToday = selDate===today;
  const nextUpHtml = '';   /* the streak suggestion card was removed on request */

  const restOpen = isToday ? !!HOME_REST_OPEN : true;
  const restBody = `
    ${nextUpHtml}

    ${laneInfo ? `` : `
    <div class="lane-note">
      <div class="lni">${icon('briefcase',18)}</div>
      <div><b>No lane picked yet</b>Choose your hustle in "Business Lane" — trading, social media, car wash, dropshipping, freelance, creator, lawn care, or reselling.</div>
    </div>`}

    <div class="section-label">${isToday?"Today's pages":fmtDateShort(selDate)+"'s pages"} <span class="sub">tap to fill</span></div>
    <div class="page-grid">${tiles}</div>
    ${bxAddBoxRow()}

    <div class="section-label">Setup <span class="sub">${SETUP_PAGES.filter(p=>p.cadence==='monthly').length} monthly · ${SETUP_PAGES.filter(p=>p.cadence!=='monthly').length} anytime</span></div>
    <div class="page-grid">${setupTiles}</div>

    ${isToday ? renderClockStrip() : ''}
  `;

  app.innerHTML = `
    <div class="home-hero">
      <button class="theme-toggle hero-toggle" onclick="toggleTheme()" aria-label="Toggle dark mode">${icon(getTheme()==='dark'?'sun':'moon',15)}</button>
      <p class="brand">${esc(BRAND.wordmark)}</p>
      <h1 class="headline">${fmtDateLong(selDate)}</h1>
      <p class="day-quote">"${quoteForDate(selDate)}"</p>
    </div>

    <div class="week-strip-row">
      <div class="week-strip">${weekStrip}</div>
      ${!isToday ? `<button class="today-chip" onclick="selectDate('${today}')" aria-label="Back to today">${icon('history',13)} Today</button>` : `<button class="jump-date-btn" onclick="openDatePicker()" aria-label="Jump to any date">${icon('calendar',18)}</button>`}
    </div>

    ${renderWeekSummary(selDate, { doneCount, total: pagesForDate.length, R, CIRC, ringOff, isToday })}

    ${isToday ? renderFocusCard(selDate) : ''}

    ${isToday ? `
    <button class="home-rest-toggle" onclick="toggleHomeRest()" aria-expanded="${restOpen}">
      <span>${restOpen ? 'Hide everything else' : 'Everything else'}</span>
      <span class="home-rest-chev ${restOpen?'open':''}">${icon('chevright',14)}</span>
    </button>` : ''}
    <div class="home-rest-body ${restOpen?'open':''}">${restOpen ? restBody : ''}</div>

    <div class="gap-block"></div>
    ${renderBottomNav('home')}
  `;
}
let HOME_REST_OPEN = false;
function toggleHomeRest(){
  HOME_REST_OPEN = !HOME_REST_OPEN;
  render();
}

function pagesList(dateStr){
  return CORE_PAGES;
}

function doneSummary(dateStr, pageId){
  const page = getPage(dateStr, pageId);
  switch(pageId){
    case 'dashboard': return page.rating ? `Rated ${page.rating}/10` : 'Logged';
    case 'workout': return page.type ? page.type : 'Logged';
    case 'journal': return page.mood ? page.mood : 'Logged';
    case 'reading': return page.pagesToday ? `${page.pagesToday} pages` : 'Logged';
    case 'lane': return DB.lane ? (LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane)||{}).name : 'Logged';
    case 'bucket': return 'Updated';
    case 'timetable': return 'Updated';
    case 'income': return 'Updated';
    case 'objectives': return 'Updated';
    default: return 'Logged';
  }
}

function selectDate(ds){ SELECTED_DATE = ds; ROUTE.date = ds; render(); requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'auto'})); }
function openPage(id){ nav('page', id); }

/* ============================================================
   HISTORY VIEW
   ============================================================ */
function renderHistory(){
  const dates = Object.keys(DB.days).filter(d=>dayHasAny(d)).sort((a,b)=> b.localeCompare(a));
  const items = dates.map(ds=>{
    const d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00');
    const donePages = pagesList(ds).filter(p=>pageIsDone(ds,p.id));
    return `<div class="hist-item" onclick="selectDate('${ds}'); nav('home')">
      <div class="hist-date">
        <div class="dd">${d.getDate()}</div>
        <div class="mo">${d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short'})}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hist-body">
        <div class="hist-pages">${donePages.map(p=>esc(p.name)).join(', ')}</div>
        <div class="hist-sub">${donePages.length} page${donePages.length===1?'':'s'} logged</div>
      </div>
      <div class="chev">${icon('chevright',16)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Day by day', true)}
    <div class="section-label">Every day you've logged <span class="sub">${dates.length} total</span></div>
    <div class="history-list">
      ${dates.length ? items : `<div class="empty-note">No days logged yet.<br>Go fill in today's pages.</div>`}
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>
    ${renderBottomNav('history')}
  `;
}

/* ============================================================
   CHART TOOLKIT
   Everything the Monthly Tracker draws goes through these
   helpers. Shared rules, so no two charts contradict each other:

     - The x-axis is ALWAYS the whole calendar month (day 1 to the
       last day), never "just the days that happen to have data".
       The old chart rescaled its x-axis to the logged range, so
       three entries on the 1st, 2nd and 3rd stretched across the
       full card and read like a whole month of activity.
     - The y-axis always shows real numbers with real gridlines.
     - Nothing uses preserveAspectRatio="none" (it squashed the
       stroke widths and turned every data dot into an ellipse).
     - Every chart is followed by a stat strip and a plain-English
       note, so the numbers are legible without reading the shape.
     - Colour is never the only carrier of meaning: legends repeat
       the label, the count and the share, and every drawn element
       has a <title> for hover/screen-reader.
   ============================================================ */
const CHART_W = 320;

/* Rounded "nice" axis bounds + tick stops (1 / 2 / 2.5 / 5 / 10
   times a power of ten), so a y-axis reads 0-10-20-30 instead of
   0-8.33-16.67-25. */
function niceScale(min, max, tickCount){
  tickCount = Math.max(2, tickCount || 4);
  if(!isFinite(min)) min = 0;
  if(!isFinite(max)) max = 0;
  if(min === max){
    if(min === 0){ max = 1; }
    else if(min > 0){ min = 0; }
    else { max = 0; }
  }
  const range = (max - min) || 1;
  const rawStep = range / tickCount;
  const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.abs(rawStep) || 1)));
  const norm = rawStep / mag;
  let step;
  if(norm <= 1) step = 1;
  else if(norm <= 2) step = 2;
  else if(norm <= 2.5) step = 2.5;
  else if(norm <= 5) step = 5;
  else step = 10;
  step *= mag;
  const niceMin = Math.floor(min / step) * step;
  const niceMax = Math.ceil(max / step) * step;
  const ticks = [];
  for(let v = niceMin; v <= niceMax + step * 1e-9; v += step) ticks.push(+v.toFixed(10));
  return { min:niceMin, max:niceMax === niceMin ? niceMin + step : niceMax, step, ticks };
}
/* Compact number for axis ticks and stat cards: 1.2k, 18.5k, 3. */
function fmtCompact(n){
  const v = +n || 0;
  const abs = Math.abs(v);
  if(abs >= 1000000) return (v/1000000).toFixed(abs >= 10000000 ? 0 : 1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'M';
  if(abs >= 1000) return (v/1000).toFixed(abs >= 10000 ? 0 : 1).replace(/\.0$/,'') + 'k';
  if(Number.isInteger(v)) return String(v);
  return String(+v.toFixed(1));
}
function fmtMoney(n){
  const v = +n || 0;
  return (v < 0 ? '-$' : '$') + fmtCompact(Math.abs(v));
}
function fmtSigned(n){
  const v = +n || 0;
  return (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtCompact(v);
}
/* Which x-axis day numbers get a printed label. Always includes
   day 1 and the last day of the month so the reader can see the
   chart really does cover the whole month. */
function dayTicks(lastDay){
  const out = [1];
  for(let d = 5; d < lastDay; d += 5) if(d > 1) out.push(d);
  if(out[out.length-1] !== lastDay){
    if(lastDay - out[out.length-1] < 3) out.pop();
    out.push(lastDay);
  }
  return out;
}

/* One card shell for every chart, so spacing, the unit badge, the
   stat strip and the footnote are identical everywhere. */
function chartCard(o){
  const stats = (o.stats && o.stats.length)
    ? `<div class="chart-stats">${o.stats.map(s=>`
        <div class="chart-stat ${s.tone||''}"><div class="v">${s.v}</div><div class="l">${esc(s.l)}</div></div>
      `).join('')}</div>`
    : '';
  return `
    <div class="chart-card">
      <div class="chart-head">
        <div>
          <div class="chart-title">${esc(o.title)}</div>
          ${o.sub ? `<div class="chart-sub">${esc(o.sub)}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${o.unit ? `<div class="chart-unit">${esc(o.unit)}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${stats}
      ${o.body}
      ${o.legend || ''}
      ${o.note ? `<div class="chart-note">${o.note}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;
}
function chartEmpty(text){ return `<div class="chart-empty">${esc(text)}</div>`; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   DAY HEATMAP — calendar-grid alternative to the bar chart, in
   the style of a token-usage or contribution graph: one cell per
   day of the month, shaded by that day's value on a 5-step scale
   (0 = no data, 1-4 = quartiles of this month's own range), not a
   bar's height. Same points shape as renderDaySeriesChart
   ([{date,value}]) and the same monthKey/fmt/color/label options,
   so a chart can switch between the two without reshaping its data.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Shared by both heatmaps below (month grid + year strip): turns
   a colour into the same 4-step lightness ramp, and a list of
   values into quartile break points computed from the data's own
   range rather than a fixed ceiling. Factored out so the year
   strip can't silently drift from the month grid's shading rules
   — same inputs always produce the same 5 levels, whichever chart
   is asking. */
function heatmapRamp(color){
  return [
    null,
    `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 22%, var(--surface-2))`,
    `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 46%, var(--surface-2))`,
    `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 72%, var(--surface-2))`,
    color,
  ];
}
function heatmapLevels(values){
  const sortedVals = [...values].filter(v=>v>0).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const qAt = f => sortedVals.length ? sortedVals[Math.min(sortedVals.length-1, Math.floor(f*(sortedVals.length-1)))] : 0;
  const q1 = qAt(0.25), q2 = qAt(0.5), q3 = qAt(0.75);
  return {
    sortedVals,
    max: sortedVals.length ? sortedVals[sortedVals.length-1] : 0,
    levelFor: v => {
      if(v <= 0) return 0;
      if(v <= q1) return 1;
      if(v <= q2) return 2;
      if(v <= q3) return 3;
      return 4;
    },
  };
}
const HEATMAP_INK_ON_STRONG = ['','var(--ink)','var(--ink)','#fff','#fff'];

function renderDayHeatmap(points, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const mk = opts.monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const n = daysInMonth(mk);
  const fmt = opts.fmt || (v=>fmtCompact(v));
  if(!points || !points.length) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this month yet.');

  const byDate = {};
  points.forEach(p=>{ byDate[p.date] = +p.value || 0; });
  const { sortedVals, max, levelFor } = heatmapLevels(points.map(p=>+p.value||0));
  const color = opts.color || 'var(--accent)';
  const RAMP = heatmapRamp(color);

  const first = new Date(mk+'-01T00:00:00');
  const startOffset = (first.getDay()+6)%7;
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  let cells = '';
  for(let i=0;i<startOffset;i++) cells += `<div class="dh-cell dh-empty"></div>`;
  for(let day=1; day<=n; day++){
    const ds = `${mk}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const isFuture = ds > todayDs;
    const has = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(byDate, ds);
    const v = byDate[ds] || 0;
    const level = has ? levelFor(v) : 0;
    const style = level>0 ? `style="background:${RAMP[level]}; color:${HEATMAP_INK_ON_STRONG[level]};"` : '';
    const label = has ? `${ds}: ${fmt(v)}` : (isFuture ? ds : `${ds}: nothing logged`);
    cells += `<button class="dh-cell dh-${level} ${isFuture?'dh-future':''}" ${style} onclick="${isFuture?'':`selectDate('${ds}'); nav('home')`}" title="${esc(label)}">${day}</button>`;
  }
  const dows = ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S'];
  const legendSteps = [0,1,2,3,4];
  const scaleLabel = sortedVals.length
    ? `${fmt(sortedVals[0])} → ${fmt(max)}`
    : 'no data';

  const ariaSummary = `${esc(opts.label||opts.title||'Daily values')} across ${monthLabel(mk)}, shown as a calendar heatmap: ${points.length} day${points.length===1?'':'s'} logged, from ${sortedVals.length?fmt(sortedVals[0]):'0'} to ${fmt(max)}.`;

  return `<div role="img" aria-label="${esc(ariaSummary)}">
    <div class="dh-grid">${dows.map(d=>`<div class="cal-dow">${d}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div>
    <div class="dh-legend">
      <span>Less</span>
      <span class="dh-legend-scale">${legendSteps.map(l=>`<span class="dh-chip" style="background:${l===0?'var(--surface-2)':RAMP[l]};"></span>`).join('')}</span>
      <span>More</span>
      <span style="margin-left:auto;">${esc(scaleLabel)}</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   YEAR HEATMAP — the "token usage graph" layout: one column per
   week, one row per weekday (Mon top, Sun bottom), continuous
   across the whole year rather than 12 separate month grids. Same
   shading rules as renderDayHeatmap (heatmapRamp/heatmapLevels),
   same points shape, so the two heatmaps can never visually
   disagree about what "level 3" means for the same kind of value.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
function renderYearHeatmap(points, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const yk = opts.yearKey || currentYearKey();
  const fmt = opts.fmt || (v=>fmtCompact(v));
  if(!points || !points.length) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this year yet.');

  const byDate = {};
  points.forEach(p=>{ byDate[p.date] = +p.value || 0; });
  const { sortedVals, max, levelFor } = heatmapLevels(points.map(p=>+p.value||0));
  const color = opts.color || 'var(--accent)';
  const RAMP = heatmapRamp(color);
  const todayDs = todayStr();

  // Twelve mini month-calendars (Mon-start, blank leading/trailing
  // cells) in a CSS grid. One grid, one set of column tracks
  // (repeat(3,1fr) on phone, repeat(6,1fr) from 720px — see the CSS),
  // never a flex row of fixed-width children: a flex row sized by
  // its children's natural width is exactly what produced the
  // previous version's bug — 12 month-bands whose combined natural
  // width (~710px) was wider than the card holding them (~688px)
  // even on a comfortable desktop width, so it either scrolled the
  // whole page sideways or, past a point, forced the card open.
  // Grid tracks are computed from the *container's* width, not the
  // content's, so this cannot happen again regardless of viewport.
  const monthsHtml = Array.from({length:12}, (_,mi)=>{
    const mk = `${yk}-${String(mi+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const n = daysInMonth(mk);
    const first = new Date(mk+'-01T00:00:00');
    const startOffset = (first.getDay()+6)%7;
    let cells = '';
    for(let i=0;i<startOffset;i++) cells += `<div class="yh-cell yh-empty"></div>`;
    for(let day=1; day<=n; day++){
      const ds = `${mk}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;
      const isFuture = ds > todayDs;
      const has = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(byDate, ds);
      const v = byDate[ds] || 0;
      const level = has ? levelFor(v) : 0;
      const style = level>0 ? `style="background:${RAMP[level]}; color:${HEATMAP_INK_ON_STRONG[level]};"` : '';
      const label = has ? `${fmtDateShort(ds)}: ${fmt(v)}` : (isFuture ? fmtDateShort(ds) : `${fmtDateShort(ds)}: nothing logged`);
      cells += `<button class="yh-cell yh-${level} ${isFuture?'yh-future':''}" ${style} onclick="${isFuture?'':`selectDate('${ds}'); nav('home')`}" title="${esc(label)}" aria-label="${esc(label)}"></button>`;
    }
    const trailing = (startOffset + n) % 7;
    if(trailing) for(let i=trailing; i<7; i++) cells += `<div class="yh-cell yh-empty"></div>`;
    return `<div class="yh-month">
      <div class="yh-month-name">${first.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short'})}</div>
      <div class="yh-month-grid">${cells}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const activeDays = sortedVals.length;
  const scaleLabel = sortedVals.length ? `${fmt(sortedVals[0])} → ${fmt(max)}` : 'no data';
  const ariaSummary = `${esc(opts.label||opts.title||'Daily values')} across ${yk}, shown as a year heatmap: ${activeDays} day${activeDays===1?'':'s'} logged, from ${activeDays?fmt(sortedVals[0]):'0'} to ${fmt(max)}. Tap any day to open and log it.`;

  return `<div role="img" aria-label="${esc(ariaSummary)}">
    <div class="yh-year-grid">${monthsHtml}</div>
    <div class="dh-legend">
      <span>Less</span>
      <span class="dh-legend-scale">${[0,1,2,3,4].map(l=>`<span class="dh-chip" style="background:${l===0?'var(--surface-2)':RAMP[l]};"></span>`).join('')}</span>
      <span>More</span>
      <span style="margin-left:auto;">${esc(scaleLabel)}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="chart-note" style="margin-top:8px;">Tap any day to open it on the Daily Dashboard.</div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   MONTH-SERIES CHART — the Year view's equivalent of the day-series
   chart: one x-slot per calendar month (always all 12, Jan-Dec,
   same "show the whole period even when data is sparse" rule as
   renderDaySeriesChart's whole-month x-axis) instead of one per
   day. Used where a day-level line/bar would be too dense to read
   at year scale — currently just the Business lane, which needs
   the same signed zero-baseline handling at year scale that it
   gets at month scale. points: [{monthKey:'YYYY-MM', value}].
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
function renderMonthSeriesChart(points, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const fmt = opts.fmt || (v=>fmtCompact(v));
  const byMonth = {};
  (points||[]).forEach(p=>{ byMonth[p.monthKey] = (byMonth[p.monthKey]||0) + (+p.value||0); });
  const monthKeys = Array.from({length:12}, (_,i)=> `${opts.yearKey}-${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}`);
  const hasAny = monthKeys.some(mk => byMonth[mk] !== undefined);
  if(!hasAny) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this year yet.');

  const W = CHART_W, H = opts.height || 152;
  const padL = 34, padR = 10, padT = 14, padB = 22;
  const plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;

  const values = monthKeys.map(mk => byMonth[mk] || 0);
  let dataMin = Math.min(...values), dataMax = Math.max(...values);
  if(opts.yFrom0 !== false) dataMin = Math.min(0, dataMin);
  const scale = niceScale(dataMin, dataMax, opts.tickCount || 4);

  const xFor = i => padL + ((i + 0.5) / 12) * plotW;
  const yFor = v => padT + (1 - ((v - scale.min) / (scale.max - scale.min))) * plotH;

  const grid = scale.ticks.map(t=>`
    <line class="chart-grid-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${yFor(t).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${yFor(t).toFixed(1)}"/>
    <text class="chart-tick" x="${padL-5}" y="${(yFor(t)+3.2).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end">${esc(fmtCompact(t))}</text>
  `).join('');
  const zeroY = yFor(0);
  const zeroLine = (scale.min < 0 && scale.max > 0)
    ? `<line class="chart-zero-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${zeroY.toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${zeroY.toFixed(1)}"/>` : '';

  const monthInitials = ['J','F','M','A','M','J','J','A','S','O','N','D'];
  const xLabels = monthInitials.map((l,i)=>`<text class="chart-tick" x="${xFor(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H-7}" text-anchor="middle">${l}</text>`).join('');

  const color = opts.color || 'var(--accent)';
  const slot = plotW / 12;
  const bw = Math.max(6, Math.min(22, slot - 6));
  const series = monthKeys.map((mk,i)=>{
    const has = byMonth[mk] !== undefined;
    if(!has) return '';
    const v = byMonth[mk];
    const x = xFor(i) - bw/2;
    const base = (scale.min < 0 && scale.max > 0) ? zeroY : yFor(scale.min);
    const y = v >= 0 ? yFor(v) : base;
    const h = Math.max(1.5, Math.abs(base - yFor(v)));
    const fill = (v < 0) ? 'var(--muted)' : color;
    return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${bw.toFixed(1)}" height="${h.toFixed(1)}" rx="${Math.min(3,bw/2).toFixed(1)}" fill="${fill}"><title>${esc(monthLabelShort(mk))}: ${esc(fmt(v))}</title></rect>`;
  }).join('');

  const loggedMonths = monthKeys.filter(mk => byMonth[mk] !== undefined);
  const ariaSummary = `${esc(opts.label||opts.title||'Monthly values')} across ${opts.yearKey}: ${loggedMonths.length} month${loggedMonths.length===1?'':'s'} with activity.`;

  return `<svg class="chart-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(ariaSummary)}">
    ${grid}
    ${zeroLine}
    ${series}
    <line class="chart-grid-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${(padT+plotH).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${(padT+plotH).toFixed(1)}"/>
    ${xLabels}
  </svg>`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   DAY-SERIES CHART — line or bars, one x-slot per calendar day.
   points: [{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', value:Number}] (sparse is fine)
   opts: { monthKey, type:'line'|'bar', fmt, yFrom0, yMax, avg,
           color, label }
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
function renderDaySeriesChart(points, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const mk = opts.monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const lastDay = daysInMonth(mk);
  const fmt = opts.fmt || (v=>fmtCompact(v));
  if(!points || !points.length) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this month yet.');

  const W = CHART_W, H = opts.height || 152;
  const padL = 34, padR = 10, padT = 14, padB = 22;
  const plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;

  const values = points.map(p=>+p.value || 0);
  let dataMin = Math.min(...values), dataMax = Math.max(...values);
  if(opts.yFrom0 !== false) dataMin = Math.min(0, dataMin);
  if(opts.yMax != null) dataMax = Math.max(dataMax, opts.yMax);
  const scale = niceScale(dataMin, dataMax, opts.tickCount || 4);

  const xFor = d => padL + ((d - 0.5) / lastDay) * plotW;
  const yFor = v => padT + (1 - ((v - scale.min) / (scale.max - scale.min))) * plotH;

  const grid = scale.ticks.map(t=>`
    <line class="chart-grid-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${yFor(t).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${yFor(t).toFixed(1)}"/>
    <text class="chart-tick" x="${padL-5}" y="${(yFor(t)+3.2).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end">${esc(fmtCompact(t))}</text>
  `).join('');

  const zeroY = yFor(0);
  const zeroLine = (scale.min < 0 && scale.max > 0)
    ? `<line class="chart-zero-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${zeroY.toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${zeroY.toFixed(1)}"/>` : '';

  // The caption sits bottom-right, so drop any day tick that would
  // collide with it rather than printing two labels on top of each other.
  const captionX = W - padR - 58;
  const xLabels = dayTicks(lastDay).filter(d=>xFor(d) < captionX).map(d=>`
    <text class="chart-tick" x="${xFor(d).toFixed(1)}" y="${H-7}" text-anchor="middle">${d}</text>
  `).join('');

  const sorted = [...points].sort((a,b)=> a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  const avg = values.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0) / values.length;
  const avgLine = (opts.avg === false) ? '' : `
    <line class="chart-avg-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${yFor(avg).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${yFor(avg).toFixed(1)}"/>
    <text class="chart-tick" x="${W-padR}" y="${(yFor(avg)-4).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end">avg ${esc(fmt(+avg.toFixed(1)))}</text>`;

  const color = opts.color || 'var(--accent)';
  let series = '';

  if(opts.type === 'bar'){
    const slot = plotW / lastDay;
    const bw = Math.max(2.5, Math.min(9, slot - 1.6));
    series = sorted.map(p=>{
      const v = +p.value || 0;
      const x = xFor(+p.date.slice(-2)) - bw/2;
      const base = (scale.min < 0 && scale.max > 0) ? zeroY : yFor(scale.min);
      const y = v >= 0 ? yFor(v) : base;
      const h = Math.max(1.5, Math.abs(base - yFor(v)));
      const fill = (v < 0) ? 'var(--muted)' : color;
      return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${bw.toFixed(1)}" height="${h.toFixed(1)}" rx="${Math.min(2.5,bw/2).toFixed(1)}" fill="${fill}"><title>${esc(fmtDateShort(p.date))}: ${esc(fmt(v))}</title></rect>`;
    }).join('');
  } else {
    const pts = sorted.map(p=>`${xFor(+p.date.slice(-2)).toFixed(1)},${yFor(+p.value||0).toFixed(1)}`);
    const baseY = (scale.min < 0 && scale.max > 0) ? zeroY : yFor(scale.min);
    const area = `${xFor(+sorted[0].date.slice(-2)).toFixed(1)},${baseY.toFixed(1)} ${pts.join(' ')} ${xFor(+sorted[sorted.length-1].date.slice(-2)).toFixed(1)},${baseY.toFixed(1)}`;
    const dots = sorted.map(p=>`
      <circle cx="${xFor(+p.date.slice(-2)).toFixed(1)}" cy="${yFor(+p.value||0).toFixed(1)}" r="2.8"
        fill="${color}" stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="1.4"><title>${esc(fmtDateShort(p.date))}: ${esc(fmt(+p.value||0))}</title></circle>`).join('');
    series = `
      <polygon points="${area}" fill="${color}" opacity="0.13"/>
      <polyline points="${pts.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      ${dots}`;
  }

  const best = sorted.reduce((a,b)=> (+b.value||0) > (+a.value||0) ? b : a, sorted[0]);
  const bestX = xFor(+best.date.slice(-2));
  const bestLabel = `
    <text class="chart-callout" x="${Math.min(W-padR-2, Math.max(padL+16, bestX)).toFixed(1)}" y="${Math.max(9, yFor(+best.value||0) - 7).toFixed(1)}"
      text-anchor="${bestX > W-70 ? 'end' : (bestX < padL+30 ? 'start' : 'middle')}">${esc(fmt(+best.value||0))}</text>`;

  const ariaSummary = `${esc(opts.label || opts.title || 'Daily values')} across ${monthLabel(mk)}: ${points.length} day${points.length===1?'':'s'} logged, average ${fmt(+avg.toFixed(1))}, highest ${fmt(+best.value||0)} on ${fmtDateShort(best.date)}.`;

  return `<svg class="chart-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(ariaSummary)}">
    ${grid}
    ${zeroLine}
    ${series}
    ${avgLine}
    ${opts.showBest === false ? '' : bestLabel}
    <line class="chart-grid-line" x1="${padL}" y1="${(padT+plotH).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W-padR}" y2="${(padT+plotH).toFixed(1)}"/>
    ${xLabels}
    <text class="chart-axis-label" x="${W-padR}" y="${H-7}" text-anchor="end" opacity="0.75">day of month</text>
  </svg>`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   DONUT — part-to-whole for mood / session type. Never shown on
   its own: always paired with a legend carrying label + count +
   share, because slices alone can't be compared accurately.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
function donutArcPath(cx, cy, rOut, rIn, a0, a1){
  const pol = (r,deg)=>{ const rad=(deg-90)*Math.PI/180; return [cx+r*Math.cos(rad), cy+r*Math.sin(rad)]; };
  const large = (a1-a0) > 180 ? 1 : 0;
  const [x0,y0] = pol(rOut,a0), [x1,y1] = pol(rOut,a1);
  const [x2,y2] = pol(rIn,a1),  [x3,y3] = pol(rIn,a0);
