  return `M${x0.toFixed(2)},${y0.toFixed(2)} A${rOut},${rOut} 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(2)},${y1.toFixed(2)} `
       + `L${x2.toFixed(2)},${y2.toFixed(2)} A${rIn},${rIn} 0 ${large} 0 ${x3.toFixed(2)},${y3.toFixed(2)} Z`;
}
/* entries: [{label, count, color}] */
function renderDonut(entries, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  const total = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+e.count,0);
  if(!total) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this month yet.');
  const S = 150, cx = S/2, cy = S/2, rOut = 62, rIn = 40;

  let angle = 0;
  const slices = entries.filter(e=>e.count>0).map(e=>{
    const sweep = (e.count/total) * 360;
    const a0 = angle, a1 = angle + sweep;
    angle = a1;
    const pct = Math.round((e.count/total)*100);
    // A single category would otherwise be a zero-length arc (start
    // angle === end angle) and draw nothing — split it into halves.
    if(sweep >= 359.999){
      return `<path d="${donutArcPath(cx,cy,rOut,rIn,0,180)}" fill="${e.color}"><title>${esc(e.label)}: ${e.count} (${pct}%)</title></path>`
           + `<path d="${donutArcPath(cx,cy,rOut,rIn,180,360)}" fill="${e.color}"></path>`;
    }
    return `<path d="${donutArcPath(cx,cy,rOut,rIn,a0,a1)}" fill="${e.color}" stroke="var(--surface)" stroke-width="1.5"><title>${esc(e.label)}: ${e.count} (${pct}%)</title></path>`;
  }).join('');

  const aria = `${esc(opts.label||'Breakdown')}: ` + entries.filter(e=>e.count>0)
    .map(e=>`${e.label} ${e.count} (${Math.round((e.count/total)*100)}%)`).join(', ');

  return `<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
    <svg class="chart-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${S} ${S}" style="max-width:168px;" role="img" aria-label="${esc(aria)}">
      ${slices}
      <text x="${cx}" y="${cy-2}" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:26px; font-weight:800; fill:var(--ink);">${total}</text>
      <text x="${cx}" y="${cy+14}" text-anchor="middle" class="chart-tick">${esc(opts.centerLabel||'entries')}</text>
    </svg>
  </div>`;
}
function renderLegend(entries){
  const total = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+e.count,0) || 1;
  return `<div class="chart-legend">${entries.filter(e=>e.count>0).map(e=>`
    <div class="legend-row">
      <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:${e.color}"></span>
      <span class="legend-label">${esc(e.label)}</span>
      <span class="legend-val">${e.count}</span>
      <span class="legend-pct">${Math.round((e.count/total)*100)}%</span>
    </div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
/* Horizontal labelled bars — for breakdowns where the ordering
   matters more than the share (mental state), and for progress
   bullets (objectives). */
function renderBarBreakdown(entries, opts){
  opts = opts || {};
  if(!entries.length) return chartEmpty(opts.emptyText || 'Nothing logged this month yet.');
  const max = Math.max(...entries.map(e=>e.count), 1);
  const total = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+e.count,0) || 1;
  return `<div class="bar-breakdown">${entries.map(e=>`
    <div class="bb-row">
      <div class="bb-label" title="${esc(e.label)}">${esc(e.label)}</div>
      <div class="bb-track"><div class="bb-fill" style="width:${Math.max(3,Math.round((e.count/max)*100))}%; background:${e.color||'var(--accent)'};"></div></div>
      <div class="bb-count">${opts.fmt ? esc(opts.fmt(e.count)) : e.count}${opts.hidePct ? '' : `<span class="pct">${Math.round((e.count/total)*100)}%</span>`}</div>
    </div>`).join('')}</div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   MONTH SUMMARY VIEW — one scrollable report per month.
   ============================================================ */
let SUMMARY_MONTH = null;
let SUMMARY_YEAR = null;
function renderHeatmap(monthKey, heat){
  const n = daysInMonth(monthKey);
  const first = new Date(monthKey+'-01T00:00:00');
  const startOffset = (first.getDay()+6)%7;
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  let cells = '';
  for(let i=0;i<startOffset;i++) cells += `<div class="heat-cell heat-cell-empty"></div>`;
  for(let day=1; day<=n; day++){
    const ds = `${monthKey}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const count = heat[ds]||0;
    const level = count===0?0 : count<2?1 : count<4?2 : 3;
    const isFuture = ds > todayDs;
    cells += `<button class="heat-cell lvl${level} ${isFuture?'future':''}" onclick="${isFuture?'':`selectDate('${ds}'); nav('home')`}" title="${ds}: ${count} page${count===1?'':'s'} logged">${day}</button>`;
  }
  const dows = ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S'];
  // The old legend was a bare "Less ... More" ramp, which never said
  // what a shade actually meant. Each step now states its own range.
  const scale = [
    ['lvl0','0 pages'], ['lvl1','1'], ['lvl2','2-3'], ['lvl3','4+'],
  ];
  return `<div class="cal-grid heat-grid">${dows.map(d=>`<div class="cal-dow">${d}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div>
    <div class="heat-scale">
      ${scale.map(([cls,label])=>`<span class="heat-scale-item"><span class="heat-cell heat-scale-chip ${cls}"></span>${esc(label)}</span>`).join('')}
      <span class="heat-scale-item" style="margin-left:auto;">Tap a day to open it</span>
    </div>`;
}

function shiftSummaryMonth(delta){
  const mk = SUMMARY_MONTH || currentMonthKey();
  const [y,m] = mk.split('-').map(Number);
  const d = new Date(y, m-1+delta, 1);
  SUMMARY_MONTH = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  render();
}
function shiftSummaryYear(delta){
  const yk = SUMMARY_YEAR || currentYearKey();
  SUMMARY_YEAR = String(+yk + delta);
  render();
}

/* Monthly Tracker: a pure report on what's already been logged —
   a Month view (day-level charts for whichever month you're on)
   and a Year view (the same shape, one level up). Nothing here is
   filled in on this screen; Bucket List / Income / Objectives are
   standalone pages reached from Home's Setup tiles (see
   PAGE_RENDERERS) precisely so this screen never mixes "things to
   read" with "things to fill in". Tab state is module-level like
   HOME_REST_OPEN — cheap, and it's fine for it to reset on a full
   page reload. */
let TRACKER_PERIOD = 'month';
function setTrackerPeriod(period){
  TRACKER_PERIOD = period;
  render();
}
function renderTracker(){
  const periodTabs = [
    { id:'month', label:'Month' },
    { id:'year',  label:'Year' },
  ];
  const tabBar = `<div class="tracker-tabs">${periodTabs.map(t=>`
    <button class="tracker-tab ${TRACKER_PERIOD===t.id?'active':''}" onclick="setTrackerPeriod('${t.id}')">${esc(t.label)}</button>
  `).join('')}</div>`;

  let nav_, body;
  if(TRACKER_PERIOD === 'year'){
    const yearKey = SUMMARY_YEAR || currentYearKey();
    SUMMARY_YEAR = yearKey;
    const isCurrentYear = yearKey === currentYearKey();
    nav_ = `
      <div class="month-nav">
        <button onclick="shiftSummaryYear(-1)" aria-label="Previous year">${icon('chevleft',16)}</button>
        <div class="month-nav-label">${esc(yearKey)}</div>
        <button onclick="shiftSummaryYear(1)" ${isCurrentYear?'disabled style="opacity:0.3;"':''} aria-label="Next year">${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
      </div>`;
    body = renderTrackerYear(yearKey);
  } else {
    const monthKey = SUMMARY_MONTH || currentMonthKey();
    SUMMARY_MONTH = monthKey;
    const isCurrentMonth = monthKey === currentMonthKey();
    nav_ = `
      <div class="month-nav">
        <button onclick="shiftSummaryMonth(-1)" aria-label="Previous month">${icon('chevleft',16)}</button>
        <div class="month-nav-label">${monthLabel(monthKey)}</div>
        <button onclick="shiftSummaryMonth(1)" ${isCurrentMonth?'disabled style="opacity:0.3;"':''} aria-label="Next month">${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
      </div>`;
    body = renderTrackerOverview(monthKey);
  }

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Tracker', false)}
    ${tabBar}
    ${nav_}
    ${body}
    <div class="gap-block"></div>
    ${renderBottomNav('tracker')}
  `;
}

function renderTrackerOverview(monthKey){
  const s = computeMonthSummary(monthKey);
  const isCurrent = monthKey === currentMonthKey();
  const pct = s.daysElapsed ? Math.round((s.daysLogged/s.daysElapsed)*100) : 0;
  const prevPct = s.prev && s.prev.daysElapsed ? Math.round((s.prev.daysLogged/s.prev.daysElapsed)*100) : null;
  const deltaPct = prevPct===null ? null : pct - prevPct;
  const periodWord = isCurrent ? `${s.daysElapsed} days in so far` : `all ${s.daysInMonth} days`;

  /* ---- 1. Headline KPIs ------------------------------------ */
  const kpis = `
    <div class="tracker-kpi-grid">
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.daysLogged}<span class="unit">/${s.daysElapsed}</span></div>
        <div class="l">Days logged</div>
        <div class="s">${s.daysElapsed - s.daysLogged} missed ${isCurrent?'so far':'this month'}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${pct}<span class="unit">%</span>${deltaPct===null?'':`<span class="delta ${deltaPct>=0?'up':'down'}">${deltaPct>0?'+':''}${deltaPct}</span>`}</div>
        <div class="l">Consistency</div>
        <div class="s">${prevPct===null ? 'No previous month to compare' : `Last month: ${prevPct}%`}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.bestStreak}<span class="unit">d</span></div>
        <div class="l">Longest streak</div>
        <div class="s">Best unbroken run inside ${monthLabelShort(monthKey)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.avgRating!==null? s.avgRating.toFixed(1) : '—'}${s.avgRating!==null?'<span class="unit">/10</span>':''}</div>
        <div class="l">Avg day rating</div>
        <div class="s">${s.ratingTrend.length ? `From ${s.ratingTrend.length} rated day${s.ratingTrend.length===1?'':'s'}` : 'No days rated yet'}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  /* ---- 2. Consistency heatmap ------------------------------ */
  const totalPagesLogged = Object.values(s.heat).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const consistency = chartCard({
    title:'Consistency',
    sub:`One square per day of ${monthLabel(monthKey)}. Shade = how many pages you filled in that day.`,
    unit:'pages / day',
    stats:[
      { v:`${s.daysLogged}/${s.daysElapsed}`, l:'Days logged' },
      { v:`${pct}%`, l:'Hit rate' },
      { v:s.daysLogged ? (totalPagesLogged/s.daysLogged).toFixed(1) : '0', l:'Pages per active day' },
    ],
    body: renderHeatmap(monthKey, s.heat),
    note:`<b>${totalPagesLogged}</b> page entries across <b>${s.daysLogged}</b> day${s.daysLogged===1?'':'s'}, out of ${periodWord}.`,
  });

  /* ---- 3. Day rating trend --------------------------------- */
  const ratingBest = s.ratingBest, ratingWorst = s.ratingWorst;
  const ratingChart = chartCard({
    title:'Day rating',
    sub:'How you scored each day at the end of it, on the Daily Dashboard.',
    unit:'score /10',
    stats:[
      { v: s.avgRating!==null ? s.avgRating.toFixed(1) : '—', l:'Average' },
      { v: ratingBest ? `${ratingBest.value}/10` : '—', l: ratingBest ? `Best · ${fmtDateShort(ratingBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
      { v: ratingWorst ? `${ratingWorst.value}/10` : '—', l: ratingWorst ? `Low · ${fmtDateShort(ratingWorst.date)}` : 'Lowest day' },
    ],
    body: renderDaySeriesChart(s.ratingTrend, {
      monthKey, type:'line', yFrom0:true, yMax:10, tickCount:5, color:'var(--accent)',
      fmt:v=>v+'/10', label:'Day rating',
      emptyText:'No day ratings yet. Rate a day on the Daily Dashboard and it lands here.',
    }),
    note: s.ratingTrend.length
      ? `Rated <b>${s.ratingTrend.length}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'}. Dashed line is the monthly average (<b>${s.avgRating.toFixed(1)}</b>).`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 4. Daily priorities (the 3 objectives per day) ------- */
  const prChart = chartCard({
    title:'Daily priorities',
    sub:'The three priorities you set each morning, and how many you actually ticked off — darker means more cleared.',
    unit:'done / 3',
    stats:[
      { v:`${s.prioritiesDone}/${s.prioritiesSet}`, l:'Priorities cleared' },
      { v:`${s.prioritiesPct}%`, l:'Completion rate' },
      { v:s.perfectPriorityDays, l:'Days at 3 of 3' },
    ],
    body: renderDayHeatmap(s.priorityTrend, {
      monthKey, color:'var(--ch4)',
      fmt:v=>v+' of 3', label:'Priorities completed',
      emptyText:'No priorities set yet. Write your three on the Daily Dashboard.',
    }),
    note: s.priorityTrend.length
      ? `<b>${s.perfectPriorityDays}</b> clean sweep${s.perfectPriorityDays===1?'':'s'}, <b>${s.zeroPriorityDays}</b> day${s.zeroPriorityDays===1?'':'s'} with none ticked off.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 5. Reading ------------------------------------------ */
  const readingChart = chartCard({
    title:'Daily reading',
    sub:'Pages logged each day in the Reading Log — darker means more pages.',
    unit:'pages / day',
    stats:[
      { v:fmtCompact(s.pagesReadSum), l:'Pages this month' },
      { v:s.readingDays ? Math.round(s.pagesReadSum/s.readingDays) : 0, l:'Avg per reading day' },
      { v:s.readingBest ? `${s.readingBest.value}` : '0', l: s.readingBest ? `Best · ${fmtDateShort(s.readingBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
    ],
    body: renderDayHeatmap(s.readingTrend, {
      monthKey, color:'var(--ch3)',
      fmt:v=>v+' pages', label:'Pages read',
      emptyText:'No reading logged yet this month.',
    }),
    note: s.readingTrend.length
      ? `Read on <b>${s.readingDays}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} · <b>${fmtCompact(s.minutesSum)}</b> minutes total · roughly <b>${s.daysElapsed ? (s.pagesReadSum/s.daysElapsed).toFixed(1) : 0}</b> pages per calendar day.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 6. Workout ------------------------------------------ */
  const typeEntries = WORKOUT_TYPES
    .map((t,i)=>({ label:t, count:s.workoutTypeCount[t]||0, color:`var(--ch${(i%6)+1})` }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const workoutChart = chartCard({
    title:'Training',
    sub:'Steps logged per day — darker means more steps — plus what kind of session each workout was.',
    unit:'steps / day',
    stats:[
      { v:s.workoutCount, l:'Sessions logged' },
      { v:fmtCompact(s.stepsSum), l:'Total steps' },
      { v:s.sleepCount ? (s.sleepSum/s.sleepCount).toFixed(1)+'h' : '—', l:'Avg sleep' },
    ],
    body: renderDayHeatmap(s.stepsTrend, {
      monthKey, color:'var(--ch2)',
      fmt:v=>fmtCompact(v)+' steps', label:'Steps',
      emptyText:'No steps logged yet this month.',
    }),
    legend: typeEntries.length ? `
      <div class="chart-note" style="margin-bottom:2px;"><b>Session types</b></div>
      ${renderBarBreakdown(typeEntries, { hidePct:false })}` : '',
    note: s.workoutCount
      ? `Trained on <b>${s.workoutCount}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} (<b>${Math.round((s.workoutCount/Math.max(1,s.daysElapsed))*100)}%</b>).`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 7. Business lane ------------------------------------ */
  // Kept as a bar chart, not the heatmap: this is the one day-series
  // with signed values, and a "less -> more" quartile ramp has no
  // sane way to shade a loss. A red day and a small-profit day would
  // both read as "low intensity" on that scale, which erases the
  // exact distinction the zero-baseline bar chart exists to show.
  const laneName = DB.lane ? ((LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane)||{}).name || 'Business lane') : 'Business lane';
  const laneChart = chartCard({
    title: laneName,
    sub:'Money logged per day. Negative days sit below the zero line.',
    unit:'$ / day',
    stats:[
      { v:fmtMoney(s.laneTotal), l:'Month total', tone: s.laneTotal>0?'pos':(s.laneTotal<0?'neg':'') },
      { v:s.laneDays ? fmtMoney(Math.round(s.laneTotal/s.laneDays)) : '$0', l:'Avg per logged day' },
      { v:s.laneBest ? fmtMoney(s.laneBest.value) : '$0', l:s.laneBest ? `Best · ${fmtDateShort(s.laneBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
    ],
    body: renderDaySeriesChart(s.laneTrend, {
      monthKey, type:'bar', yFrom0:true, color:'var(--ch1)',
      fmt:v=>fmtMoney(v), label:'Daily money',
      emptyText: DB.lane ? 'No business lane entries logged yet this month.' : 'No lane picked yet — choose one from the Business Lane page and its numbers show up here.',
    }),
    note: s.laneTrend.length
      ? `Logged on <b>${s.laneDays}</b> day${s.laneDays===1?'':'s'}${s.laneNegDays?` · <b>${s.laneNegDays}</b> day${s.laneNegDays===1?'':'s'} in the red`:''}.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 8. Mood (dashboard) --------------------------------- */
  const moodEntries = DASHBOARD_MOODS
    .map(m=>({ label:m, count:s.moodCount[m]||0, color:MOOD_COLORS[m]||'var(--ch6)' }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const moodTotal = moodEntries.reduce((a,e)=>a+e.count,0);
  const topMood = moodEntries.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count)[0];
  const moodChart = chartCard({
    title:'Mood breakdown',
    sub:'Your morning mood check-in on the Daily Dashboard.',
    unit:'check-ins',
    stats:[
      { v:moodTotal, l:'Check-ins' },
      { v:topMood ? topMood.label : '—', l:'Most common' },
      { v:topMood ? Math.round((topMood.count/moodTotal)*100)+'%' : '—', l:'Of all check-ins' },
    ],
    body: renderDonut(moodEntries, { centerLabel:'check-ins', label:'Mood breakdown', emptyText:'No mood check-ins logged yet this month.' }),
    legend: moodEntries.length ? renderLegend(moodEntries) : '',
    note: moodTotal ? `Checked in on <b>${moodTotal}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'}.` : '',
  });

  /* ---- 9. Mental state (journal) --------------------------- */
  // Kept separate from the mood donut on purpose: these are two
  // different question sets ("how do you feel" vs "where's your
  // head at") with two different word lists. The old summary
  // merged both into one count, so "Steady" and "Clear" were
  // silently pooled into the same breakdown.
  const mindEntries = JOURNAL_STATES
    .map(m=>({ label:m, count:s.mindCount[m]||0, color:MIND_COLORS[m]||'var(--ch6)' }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const mindTotal = mindEntries.reduce((a,e)=>a+e.count,0);
  const mindChart = chartCard({
    title:'Mental state',
    sub:'What you picked at the top of the Journal each day.',
    unit:'entries',
    stats:[
      { v:mindTotal, l:'Journal entries' },
      { v:s.journalCount, l:'Days journalled' },
      { v:`${Math.round((s.journalCount/Math.max(1,s.daysElapsed))*100)}%`, l:'Of days' },
    ],
    body: renderBarBreakdown(mindEntries, { emptyText:'No journal entries logged yet this month.' }),
    note: mindTotal ? `Bars are sorted by the Journal\u2019s own order, not by size, so the same state sits in the same place every month.` : '',
  });

  /* ---- 10. Monthly goals ----------------------------------- */
  const objEntries = (s.objectives.list||[])
    .filter(o=>o && o.title && o.title.trim())
    .map((o,i)=>({ label:o.title.trim(), count:+o.progress||0, color:`var(--ch${(i%6)+1})` }));
  const bucketTotal = (s.bucket.items||[]).filter(it=>it.text && it.text.trim()).length;
  const bucketDone = (s.bucket.items||[]).filter(it=>it.text && it.text.trim() && it.done).length;
  const incomeCurrent = (s.income.streams||[]).reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.current||0),0);
  const incomeTarget  = (s.income.streams||[]).reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.target||0),0);
  const goalsChart = chartCard({
    title:'Monthly goals',
    sub:'Progress on the three objectives, the bucket list and the income targets you set for this month.',
    unit:'% complete',
    stats:[
      { v: objEntries.length ? Math.round(objEntries.reduce((a,e)=>a+e.count,0)/objEntries.length)+'%' : '—', l:'Avg objective' },
      { v: bucketTotal ? `${bucketDone}/${bucketTotal}` : '—', l:'Bucket goals done' },
      { v: incomeTarget ? Math.round((incomeCurrent/incomeTarget)*100)+'%' : '—', l:'Of income target' },
    ],
    body: objEntries.length
      ? renderBarBreakdown(objEntries, { hidePct:true, fmt:v=>v+'%' })
      : chartEmpty('No objectives named for this month yet — set them from the 3 Objectives tile on Home.'),
    note: incomeTarget
      ? `Income streams: <b>${fmtMoney(incomeCurrent)}</b> logged against a <b>${fmtMoney(incomeTarget)}</b> target.`
      : (bucketTotal ? `Bucket list: <b>${bucketDone}</b> of <b>${bucketTotal}</b> ticked off.` : ''),
  });

  return `
    ${kpis}
    ${consistency}
    ${ratingChart}
    ${prChart}
    ${readingChart}
    ${workoutChart}
    ${laneChart}
    ${moodChart}
    ${mindChart}
    ${goalsChart}
  `;
}

function renderTrackerYear(yearKey){
  const s = computeYearSummary(yearKey);
  const isCurrent = yearKey === currentYearKey();
  const pct = s.daysElapsed ? Math.round((s.daysLogged/s.daysElapsed)*100) : 0;
  const periodWord = isCurrent ? `${s.daysElapsed} days in so far` : `all ${s.daysInYear} days`;

  /* ---- 1. Headline KPIs ------------------------------------ */
  const kpis = `
    <div class="tracker-kpi-grid">
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.daysLogged}<span class="unit">/${s.daysElapsed}</span></div>
        <div class="l">Days logged</div>
        <div class="s">${s.daysElapsed - s.daysLogged} missed ${isCurrent?'so far':'this year'}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${pct}<span class="unit">%</span>${s.prevYearRate===null?'':`<span class="delta ${pct-s.prevYearRate>=0?'up':'down'}">${pct-s.prevYearRate>0?'+':''}${pct-s.prevYearRate}</span>`}</div>
        <div class="l">Consistency</div>
        <div class="s">${s.prevYearRate===null ? 'No previous year to compare' : `${+yearKey-1}, same point: ${s.prevYearRate}%`}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.bestStreak}<span class="unit">d</span></div>
        <div class="l">Longest streak</div>
        <div class="s">Best unbroken run inside ${yearKey}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tracker-kpi">
        <div class="v">${s.avgRating!==null? s.avgRating.toFixed(1) : '—'}${s.avgRating!==null?'<span class="unit">/10</span>':''}</div>
        <div class="l">Avg day rating</div>
        <div class="s">${s.ratingTrend.length ? `From ${s.ratingTrend.length} rated day${s.ratingTrend.length===1?'':'s'}` : 'No days rated yet'}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  /* ---- 2. Consistency — the year strip ---------------------- */
  const totalPagesLogged = Object.values(s.heat).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const heatPoints = Object.entries(s.heat).filter(([,v])=>v>0).map(([date,value])=>({date,value}));
  const bestMonthLabel = s.bestMonth ? monthLabelShort(s.bestMonth.monthKey) : null;
  const consistency = chartCard({
    title:'Consistency',
    sub:`One square per day of ${yearKey}. Shade = how many pages you filled in that day.`,
    unit:'pages / day',
    stats:[
      { v:`${s.daysLogged}/${s.daysElapsed}`, l:'Days logged' },
      { v:`${pct}%`, l:'Hit rate' },
      { v: bestMonthLabel || '—', l:'Strongest month' },
    ],
    body: renderYearHeatmap(heatPoints, { yearKey, color:'var(--accent)', fmt:v=>v+(v===1?' page':' pages'), label:'Pages logged' }),
    note:`<b>${totalPagesLogged}</b> page entries across <b>${s.daysLogged}</b> day${s.daysLogged===1?'':'s'}, out of ${periodWord}.`,
  });

  /* ---- 3. Day rating trend — one point per rated day -------- */
  const ratingBest = s.ratingBest, ratingWorst = s.ratingWorst;
  const ratingChart = chartCard({
    title:'Day rating',
    sub:'How you scored each day at the end of it, on the Daily Dashboard.',
    unit:'score /10',
    stats:[
      { v: s.avgRating!==null ? s.avgRating.toFixed(1) : '—', l:'Average' },
      { v: ratingBest ? `${ratingBest.value}/10` : '—', l: ratingBest ? `Best · ${fmtDateShort(ratingBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
      { v: ratingWorst ? `${ratingWorst.value}/10` : '—', l: ratingWorst ? `Low · ${fmtDateShort(ratingWorst.date)}` : 'Lowest day' },
    ],
    body: renderYearHeatmap(s.ratingTrend, { yearKey, color:'var(--accent)', fmt:v=>v+'/10', label:'Day rating', emptyText:'No day ratings yet this year.' }),
    note: s.ratingTrend.length
      ? `Rated <b>${s.ratingTrend.length}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} this year.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 4. Daily priorities ----------------------------------- */
  const prChart = chartCard({
    title:'Daily priorities',
    sub:'The three priorities you set each morning, and how many you actually ticked off — darker means more cleared.',
    unit:'done / 3',
    stats:[
      { v:`${s.prioritiesDone}/${s.prioritiesSet}`, l:'Priorities cleared' },
      { v:`${s.prioritiesPct}%`, l:'Completion rate' },
      { v:s.priorityTrend.filter(p=>p.value===3).length, l:'Days at 3 of 3' },
    ],
    body: renderYearHeatmap(s.priorityTrend, { yearKey, color:'var(--ch4)', fmt:v=>v+' of 3', label:'Priorities completed', emptyText:'No priorities set yet this year.' }),
    note: s.priorityTrend.length
      ? `<b>${s.priorityTrend.filter(p=>p.value===3).length}</b> clean sweep${s.priorityTrend.filter(p=>p.value===3).length===1?'':'s'}, <b>${s.priorityTrend.filter(p=>p.value===0).length}</b> day${s.priorityTrend.filter(p=>p.value===0).length===1?'':'s'} with none ticked off.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 5. Reading --------------------------------------------- */
  const readingChart = chartCard({
    title:'Daily reading',
    sub:'Pages logged each day in the Reading Log — darker means more pages.',
    unit:'pages / day',
    stats:[
      { v:fmtCompact(s.pagesReadSum), l:'Pages this year' },
      { v:s.readingDays ? Math.round(s.pagesReadSum/s.readingDays) : 0, l:'Avg per reading day' },
      { v:s.readingBest ? `${s.readingBest.value}` : '0', l: s.readingBest ? `Best · ${fmtDateShort(s.readingBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
    ],
    body: renderYearHeatmap(s.readingTrend, { yearKey, color:'var(--ch3)', fmt:v=>v+' pages', label:'Pages read', emptyText:'No reading logged yet this year.' }),
    note: s.readingTrend.length
      ? `Read on <b>${s.readingDays}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} · <b>${fmtCompact(s.minutesSum)}</b> minutes total this year.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 6. Training ---------------------------------------------- */
  const typeEntries = WORKOUT_TYPES
    .map((t,i)=>({ label:t, count:s.workoutTypeCount[t]||0, color:`var(--ch${(i%6)+1})` }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const workoutChart = chartCard({
    title:'Training',
    sub:'Steps logged per day — darker means more steps — across the whole year.',
    unit:'steps / day',
    stats:[
      { v:s.workoutCount, l:'Sessions logged' },
      { v:fmtCompact(s.stepsSum), l:'Total steps' },
      { v:s.sleepCount ? (s.sleepSum/s.sleepCount).toFixed(1)+'h' : '—', l:'Avg sleep' },
    ],
    body: renderYearHeatmap(s.stepsTrend, { yearKey, color:'var(--ch2)', fmt:v=>fmtCompact(v)+' steps', label:'Steps', emptyText:'No steps logged yet this year.' }),
    legend: typeEntries.length ? `
      <div class="chart-note" style="margin-bottom:2px;"><b>Session types</b></div>
      ${renderBarBreakdown(typeEntries, { hidePct:false })}` : '',
    note: s.workoutCount
      ? `Trained on <b>${s.workoutCount}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} this year.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 7. Business lane — month bars, not a day heatmap ------- */
  // A signed metric still can't honestly live on a "less -> more"
  // heatmap ramp (same reasoning as the month view's lane chart —
  // see the comment there), and at 365 points a day-level chart of
  // any kind would be unreadably dense on a phone. One bar per
  // month is the right resolution for "how did this year go".
  const laneName = DB.lane ? ((LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane)||{}).name || 'Business lane') : 'Business lane';
  const laneMonthPoints = s.laneTrend.map(p=>({ monthKey: monthKeyOf(p.date), value: p.value }));
  const laneChart = chartCard({
    title: laneName,
    sub:'Money logged per month. Negative months sit below the zero line.',
    unit:'$ / month',
    stats:[
      { v:fmtMoney(s.laneTotal), l:'Year total', tone: s.laneTotal>0?'pos':(s.laneTotal<0?'neg':'') },
      { v:s.laneDays ? fmtMoney(Math.round(s.laneTotal/s.laneDays)) : '$0', l:'Avg per logged day' },
      { v:s.laneBest ? fmtMoney(s.laneBest.value) : '$0', l:s.laneBest ? `Best day · ${fmtDateShort(s.laneBest.date)}` : 'Best day' },
    ],
    body: renderMonthSeriesChart(laneMonthPoints, {
      yearKey, color:'var(--ch1)', fmt:v=>fmtMoney(v), label:'Monthly money',
      emptyText: DB.lane ? 'No business lane entries logged yet this year.' : 'No lane picked yet — choose one from the Business Lane page and its numbers show up here.',
    }),
    note: s.laneTrend.length
      ? `Logged on <b>${s.laneDays}</b> day${s.laneDays===1?'':'s'}${s.laneNegDays?` · <b>${s.laneNegDays}</b> day${s.laneNegDays===1?'':'s'} in the red`:''}.`
      : '',
  });

  /* ---- 8. Mood (dashboard) --------------------------------- */
  const moodEntries = DASHBOARD_MOODS
    .map(m=>({ label:m, count:s.moodCount[m]||0, color:MOOD_COLORS[m]||'var(--ch6)' }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const moodTotal = moodEntries.reduce((a,e)=>a+e.count,0);
  const topMood = moodEntries.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count)[0];
  const moodChart = chartCard({
    title:'Mood breakdown',
    sub:'Your morning mood check-in on the Daily Dashboard, across the whole year.',
    unit:'check-ins',
    stats:[
      { v:moodTotal, l:'Check-ins' },
      { v:topMood ? topMood.label : '—', l:'Most common' },
      { v:topMood ? Math.round((topMood.count/moodTotal)*100)+'%' : '—', l:'Of all check-ins' },
    ],
    body: renderDonut(moodEntries, { centerLabel:'check-ins', label:'Mood breakdown', emptyText:'No mood check-ins logged yet this year.' }),
    legend: moodEntries.length ? renderLegend(moodEntries) : '',
    note: moodTotal ? `Checked in on <b>${moodTotal}</b> of ${s.daysElapsed} day${s.daysElapsed===1?'':'s'} this year.` : '',
  });

  /* ---- 9. Mental state (journal) --------------------------- */
  const mindEntries = JOURNAL_STATES
    .map(m=>({ label:m, count:s.mindCount[m]||0, color:MIND_COLORS[m]||'var(--ch6)' }))
    .filter(e=>e.count>0);
  const mindTotal = mindEntries.reduce((a,e)=>a+e.count,0);
  const mindChart = chartCard({
    title:'Mental state',
    sub:'What you picked at the top of the Journal, across the whole year.',
    unit:'entries',
    stats:[
      { v:mindTotal, l:'Journal entries' },
      { v:s.journalCount, l:'Days journalled' },
      { v:`${Math.round((s.journalCount/Math.max(1,s.daysElapsed))*100)}%`, l:'Of days' },
    ],
    body: renderBarBreakdown(mindEntries, { emptyText:'No journal entries logged yet this year.' }),
    note: mindTotal ? `Bars are sorted by the Journal\u2019s own order, not by size, so the same state sits in the same place every year.` : '',
  });

  /* ---- 10. Month-by-month scoreboard ------------------------- */
  // The one thing genuinely unique to the year view rather than a
  // scaled-up month chart: which months actually pulled their
  // weight. Sorted by the calendar, not by rank, so December sits
  // under November the way a person expects when skimming a year.
  const monthRows = s.months
    .filter(ms => ms.daysElapsed > 0)
    .map(ms => ({
      label: monthLabelShort(ms.monthKey),
      count: Math.round((ms.daysLogged/ms.daysElapsed)*100),
      color: ms.monthKey === currentMonthKey() ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--ch4)',
    }));
  const monthScoreboard = chartCard({
    title:'Month by month',
    sub:'Consistency hit-rate for each month — this month is highlighted.',
    unit:'% of days',
    body: monthRows.length ? renderBarBreakdown(monthRows, { hidePct:true, fmt:v=>v+'%' }) : chartEmpty('Nothing logged yet this year.'),
    note: bestMonthLabel ? `<b>${esc(bestMonthLabel)}</b> was the most consistent month so far.` : '',
  });

  return `
    ${kpis}
    ${consistency}
    ${monthScoreboard}
    ${ratingChart}
    ${prChart}
    ${readingChart}
    ${workoutChart}
    ${laneChart}
    ${moodChart}
    ${mindChart}
  `;
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE ROUTER -> individual page renderers
   ============================================================ */
function renderPage(){
  const id = ROUTE.pageId;
  const renderer = PAGE_RENDERERS[id];
  if(!renderer){ nav('home'); return; }
  renderer(ROUTE.date);
}

/* ---------- shared field helpers ---------- */
function fieldWrap(label, hint, inner){
  return `<div class="field-card"><div class="fc-label">${label}</div>${hint?`<div class="fc-hint">${hint}</div>`:''}${inner}</div>`;
}
/* Locked view for a monthly page that's already been filled in
   for the given month. Shows what was set, plus an explicit
   override so a person can still fix a typo without the page
   nagging them to redo the whole thing every day. Body-only —
   embedded inline as a tab inside the Monthly Tracker, same
   pattern as the daily xxxBody() functions. */
function monthlyLockedBody(summaryHtml, pageId, monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  return `
    <div class="locked-banner">
      <div class="locked-icon">${icon('check',18)}</div>
      <div>
        <div class="locked-title">Done for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}</div>
        <div class="locked-sub">Set on ${new Date(monthlyPageTouchedAt(pageId,mk)).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'})}. Locked until next month.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    ${summaryHtml}
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="unlockMonthlyPage('${pageId}','${mk}')">${icon('pen',14)} Edit anyway</button>
  `;
}
function unlockMonthlyPage(pageId, monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  if(DB.monthly[mk] && DB.monthly[mk]._touched) delete DB.monthly[mk]._touched[pageId];
  saveDB();
  render();
}
/* One tap to carry yesterday's entry on this page forward, for
   daily pages where most fields repeat (session type, market,
   route, platform...). Only shows up when there's actually
   something to copy and today's version is still empty. */
function copyYesterdayBar(dateStr, pageId){
  if(pageIsDone(dateStr,pageId)) return '';
  if(!hasYesterdayData(dateStr,pageId)) return '';
  return `<button type="button" class="copy-yday-btn" onclick="copyFromYesterday('${dateStr}','${pageId}')">${icon('history',13)} Copy yesterday's entry</button>`;
}
function scaleTapper(dateStr, pageId, key, max, val, redAtMax){
  let cells='';
  for(let i=1;i<=max;i++){
    const active = val>=i;
    cells += `<div class="scale-dot ${active?'active':''} ${active&&redAtMax?'red':''}" onclick="setScale('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',${i},${max})">${i}</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="scale-row">${cells}</div>`;
}
function setScale(dateStr,pageId,key,val,max){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  p[key] = (p[key]===val) ? 0 : val; // tap same value again to clear
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  if(pageId==='reading' && key==='rating') libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  flashSaved();
  render();
}
function textField(dateStr,pageId,key,placeholder,val){
  return `<input class="textline" placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}" value="${esc(val)}"
    oninput="setText('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',this.value)">`;
}
function setText(dateStr,pageId,key,val){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  p[key]=val;
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  if(pageId==='reading' && (key==='title'||key==='author')) libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  saveDB();
}
function areaField(dateStr,pageId,key,placeholder,val,cls){
  return `<textarea class="${cls||'freewrite'}" placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}"
    oninput="setText('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',this.value)">${esc(val)}</textarea>`;
}
function pillGroup(dateStr,pageId,key,options,val,colorClass){
  return `<div class="pill-row">${options.map(o=>{
    const active = val===o;
    return `<button class="pill ${active?'active '+(colorClass||''):''}" onclick="setPill('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}','${o}')">${esc(o)}</button>`;
  }).join('')}</div>`;
}
function setPill(dateStr,pageId,key,val){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  p[key] = (p[key]===val)?null:val;
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  flashSaved();
  render();
}
function checkRow(dateStr,pageId,key,label){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  const checked = !!(p.checks && p.checks[key]);
  return `<div class="check-row ${checked?'struck':''}">
    <div class="checkbox ${checked?'checked':''}" onclick="toggleCheck('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}')">${icon('check',14)}</div>
    <div class="crow-text">${esc(label)}</div>
  </div>`;
}
function toggleCheck(dateStr,pageId,key){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  if(!p.checks) p.checks={};
  p.checks[key] = !p.checks[key];
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  flashSaved();
  render();
}
function counterField(dateStr,pageId,key,val,step,suffix){
  step = step||1;
  return `<div class="counter-row">
    <button class="counter-btn" onclick="bumpCounter('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',-${step})">${icon('minus',16)}</button>
    <input class="counter-val counter-input" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*"
      value="${esc(val||0)}"
      oninput="setCounterDirect('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',this.value)"
      onfocus="this.select()">${suffix?`<span class="counter-suffix">${esc(suffix)}</span>`:''}
    <button class="counter-btn" onclick="bumpCounter('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',${step})">${icon('plus',16)}</button>
  </div>`;
}
function bumpCounter(dateStr,pageId,key,delta){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  p[key] = Math.max(0, (p[key]||0) + delta);
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  if(pageId==='reading' && key==='pagesToday'){
    applyPagesTodayToProgress(dateStr);
    libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  }
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function setCounterDirect(dateStr,pageId,key,rawVal){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,pageId);
  // Strip to digits and keep at most ONE decimal point. The old
  // filter allowed "1.2.3", which unary-plus turns into NaN; that
  // NaN was written straight into the day record and serialised to
  // null by JSON.stringify, quietly wiping the field.
  let cleaned = String(rawVal).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');
  const dot = cleaned.indexOf('.');
  if(dot !== -1) cleaned = cleaned.slice(0, dot+1) + cleaned.slice(dot+1).replace(/\./g,'');
  const num = (cleaned === '' || cleaned === '.') ? 0 : parseFloat(cleaned);
  p[key] = isFinite(num) ? Math.max(0, num) : 0;
  markTouched(dateStr,pageId);
  if(pageId==='reading' && key==='pagesToday'){
    applyPagesTodayToProgress(dateStr);
    libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  }
  saveDB();
  // Don't full re-render mid-typing — it would reset cursor position.
  // The value is already correct in the input; other UI (stat-mini
  // cards showing the same number) will catch up on next render.
}
// The heart of "auto plus that value to the reading progress": page
// you're on = the page you started today at (baselinePage, captured
// once per day) + however many pages you've logged today. Since it
// always recomputes from that fixed baseline rather than nudging
// pageFrom by the delta each time, typing 12 then correcting it to
// 8 lands on the right page either way — no drift, no double count,
// however many times "pages read today" gets edited in one sitting.
function applyPagesTodayToProgress(dateStr){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  if(p.baselinePage===undefined || p.baselinePage===null){
    const book = libCurrentBook();
    p.baselinePage = (book && book.pageCurrent) || 0;
  }
  p.pageFrom = p.baselinePage + (+p.pagesToday||0);
}

function scaleRow10(dateStr,pageId,key,val){
  let cells='';
  for(let i=1;i<=10;i++){
    const active = val>=i;
    cells += `<div class="scale-dot ${active?'active red':''}" style="flex:1;height:30px;font-size:10.5px;" onclick="setScale('${dateStr}','${pageId}','${key}',${i},10)">${i}</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="scale-row" style="gap:3px;">${cells}</div>`;

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: WORKOUT LOG
   ============================================================ */
function workoutBody(dateStr){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  if(!p.exercises) p.exercises = [];
  const types = WORKOUT_TYPES;

  // Only open (not-done) exercises stay in the working table — a
  // checked one keeps showing here, ticked, for a couple seconds
  // (see PENDING_COMPLETE_EX in toggleExDone) and then animates out
  // and drops out of this list entirely, same as Apple's Reminders.
  // Nothing is deleted: done items stay in p.exercises (and count
  // toward the "closed" total below), they just aren't rendered as
  // an open row once their hold window passes.
  const openExercises = p.exercises.map((ex,i)=>({ex,i})).filter(x=>!x.ex.done || PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.has(dateStr+':'+x.i));
  const totalDone = p.exercises.filter(ex=>ex.done).length;
  const pendingShown = openExercises.filter(x=>x.ex.done).length;
  const doneCount = totalDone - pendingShown;

  const rows = openExercises.map(({ex,i})=>`
    <tr id="ex-row-${i}">
      <td><input placeholder="Exercise" value="${esc(ex.name)}" oninput="updateExRow('${dateStr}',${i},'name',this.value)" ${ex.done?'disabled':''}></td>
      <td style="width:44px"><input placeholder="Sets" value="${esc(ex.sets)}" oninput="updateExRow('${dateStr}',${i},'sets',this.value)" ${ex.done?'disabled':''}></td>
      <td style="width:44px"><input placeholder="Reps" value="${esc(ex.reps)}" oninput="updateExRow('${dateStr}',${i},'reps',this.value)" ${ex.done?'disabled':''}></td>
      <td style="width:52px"><input placeholder="Kg" value="${esc(ex.weight)}" oninput="updateExRow('${dateStr}',${i},'weight',this.value)" ${ex.done?'disabled':''}></td>
      <td style="width:30px"><div class="checkbox ${ex.done?'checked':''}" style="width:20px;height:20px" onclick="toggleExDone('${dateStr}',${i})">${ex.done?icon('check',12):''}</div></td>
    </tr>`).join('');

  return `
      ${copyYesterdayBar(dateStr,'workout')}
      ${fieldWrap('Session type', null, pillGroup(dateStr,'workout','type',types,p.type,'red'))}

      ${fieldWrap('Duration', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','duration','e.g. 45 min',p.duration))}
      ${fieldWrap('Intensity', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','intensity','e.g. Moderate',p.intensity))}
      ${fieldWrap('Location', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','location','Where',p.location))}
      ${fieldWrap('Steps today', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','steps',p.steps,500))}
      ${fieldWrap('Calories burned', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','calories',p.calories,50))}
      ${fieldWrap('Sleep last night (hrs)', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','sleep',p.sleep,0.5,'h'))}

      ${fieldWrap('Exercise log', 'Tap the circle to mark a set complete — it\'ll clear off the list once checked.', `
        <div class="preset-load-row">
          <button class="add-row-btn" style="margin:0; flex:1;" onclick="openWorkoutPresetPicker('${dateStr}')">${icon('bolt',14)} Load a preset</button>
          <button class="add-row-btn" style="margin:0;" onclick="nav('page','workoutPresets')">${icon('gear',14)}</button>
        </div>
        ${openExercises.length ? `
        <table class="log-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Exercise</th><th>Sets</th><th>Reps</th><th>Kg</th><th></th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
        </table>` : (doneCount ? '' : `<div class="empty-note" style="padding:20px 4px;">Nothing logged yet.</div>`)}
        <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addExRow('${dateStr}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add exercise</button>
        ${doneCount ? `<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="toggleShowDoneExercises('${dateStr}')">${icon(SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES?'chevright':'check',12)} ${SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES?'Hide':'Show'} ${doneCount} completed</button>` : ''}
        ${SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES ? renderDoneExercises(dateStr,p) : ''}
        ${trashCount('exercise', ctx=>ctx.dateStr===dateStr) ? `<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="openTrashSheet('exercise','${dateStr}')">${icon('trash',12)} Trash (${trashCount('exercise', ctx=>ctx.dateStr===dateStr)})</button>` : ''}
      `)}

      ${fieldWrap('Energy', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','energy',5,p.energy||0,true))}
      ${fieldWrap('Soreness', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','soreness',5,p.soreness||0,true))}
      ${fieldWrap('Recovery', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','recovery',5,p.recovery||0,true))}
  `;
}
// Completed exercises are hidden from the working list by default
// (see workoutBody) but never lost — this optional strip lets
// someone glance back at what they already finished, or undo a
// mis-tap, without cluttering the log they're actively filling in.
let SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES = false;
function toggleShowDoneExercises(dateStr){
  SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES = !SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES;
  render();
}
// Same "peek at what's done" toggle for the Bucket List's collapsed
// done strip (see bucketBody) — kept as its own flag, separate from
// SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES, since the two lists are shown on different pages.
let SHOW_DONE_BUCKET = false;
function toggleShowDoneBucket(){
  SHOW_DONE_BUCKET = !SHOW_DONE_BUCKET;
  render();
}
function renderDoneExercises(dateStr,p){
  const rows = p.exercises.map((ex,i)=>({ex,i})).filter(x=>x.ex.done && !PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.has(dateStr+':'+x.i)).map(({ex,i})=>`
    <div class="check-row">
      <div class="checkbox checked" onclick="toggleExDone('${dateStr}',${i})">${icon('check',14)}</div>
      <div class="crow-text" style="text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--muted);">${esc(ex.name||'Unnamed exercise')}${ex.sets||ex.reps?` — ${esc(ex.sets||'')}${ex.sets&&ex.reps?'×':''}${esc(ex.reps||'')}`:''}</div>
      <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="deleteExerciseToTrash('${dateStr}',${i})" aria-label="Move to trash">${icon('trash',13)}</button>
    </div>`).join('');
  return `<div class="field-card" style="margin-top:10px;">${rows}</div>`;
}
// Moves a completed exercise into the trash instead of leaving it
// as the only way to permanently clear it out. The row's full data
// (name/sets/reps/weight) travels with it so trashRestore can drop
// it right back into this same day's log if it was deleted by mistake.
function deleteExerciseToTrash(dateStr,i){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  const ex = p.exercises[i];
  if(!ex) return;
  const summary = ex.name || 'Unnamed exercise';
  p.exercises.splice(i,1);
  // Pending-complete keys are index-based ("2026-09-14:3"), and the
  // splice just shifted every later index down by one — keeping the
  // old keys would hold the wrong row open in its hold window.
  Array.from(PENDING_COMPLETE_EX).forEach(k=>{ if(k.indexOf(dateStr+':')===0) PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.delete(k); });
  trashAdd('exercise', {name:ex.name,sets:ex.sets,reps:ex.reps,weight:ex.weight}, {dateStr}, summary);
  saveDB();
  flashSaved('Moved to trash');
  render();
}
function renderWorkout(dateStr){
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Workout Log', true)}
    <div class="page-body">${workoutBody(dateStr)}</div>
  `;
}
function openWorkoutPresetPicker(dateStr){
  const presets = workoutPresetList();
  const savedRows = presets.map(preset=>`
    <button class="preset-pick-row" onclick="loadWorkoutPreset('${dateStr}','${preset.id}')">
      <div>
        <div class="preset-pick-name">${esc(preset.name)}</div>
        <div class="preset-pick-sub">${preset.exercises.length} exercise${preset.exercises.length===1?'':'s'}</div>
      </div>
      ${icon('chevright',15)}
    </button>`).join('');

  const suggestRows = WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS.map((s,i)=>`
    <button class="preset-pick-row" onclick="closeSheet(); addWorkoutPresetFromSuggestion(WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS[${i}]);">
      <div>
        <div class="preset-pick-name">${esc(s.name)}</div>
        <div class="preset-pick-sub">Suggested · ${s.exercises.length} exercises</div>
      </div>
      ${icon('plus',15)}
    </button>`).join('');

  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Load a preset</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body" style="padding-top:0;">
      ${presets.length ? `
        <div class="fc-hint" style="margin-bottom:8px;">Your presets</div>
        ${savedRows}
      ` : ''}
      <div class="fc-hint" style="margin:${presets.length?'16px':'0'} 0 8px;">${presets.length ? 'Or start from a suggestion' : 'No presets yet — start from a suggestion or build your own'}</div>
      ${suggestRows}
      <button class="lib-newbook-link" style="margin-top:14px;" onclick="closeSheet(); nav('page','workoutPresets');">${icon('gear',13)} Manage presets</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function addExRow(dateStr){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  if(!p.exercises) p.exercises=[];
  p.exercises.push({});
  markTouched(dateStr,'workout');
  render();
}
function updateExRow(dateStr,i,key,val){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  p.exercises[i][key]=val;
  markTouched(dateStr,'workout');
  saveDB();
}
// Checking an exercise off doesn't just mark it done — the checkbox
// fills in and the row sits fully ticked (inputs locked, so nothing
// can be edited mid-hold) for a couple seconds so the person
// actually sees the check register, and only then does the row
// animate out and drop off the visible log entirely, same pattern
// as Apple's Reminders/To Do. The data still remembers it was
// completed (ex.done stays true), it's just not shown as an open
// item anymore. Unchecking isn't offered from the log itself once
// it's gone; the row can always be restored from Trash if needed.
// PENDING_COMPLETE_EX (keyed "dateStr:i") is what keeps a just-
// checked row visible in the OPEN table during its hold window —
// see the filter in workoutBody — even though ex.done is already
// true. In-memory only; a hold in progress doesn't need to survive
// a reload.
const DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS = 2000;
let PENDING_COMPLETE_EX = new Set();
function toggleExDone(dateStr,i){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'workout');
  const ex = p.exercises[i];
  const key = dateStr+':'+i;
  ex.done = !ex.done;
  markTouched(dateStr,'workout');
  flashSaved();
  if(ex.done){
    PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.add(key);
    render();
    setTimeout(()=>{
      // If it got unchecked again during the hold, there's nothing
      // to collapse — just clear the pending flag.
      if(!PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.has(key)) return;
      const row = document.getElementById(`ex-row-${i}`);
      if(row){
        row.classList.add('row-completing');
        setTimeout(()=>{ PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.delete(key); render(); }, 260);
      } else {
        PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.delete(key);
        render();
      }
    }, DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS);
    return;
  }
  PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.delete(key);
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: WORKOUT PRESETS — build-your-own named templates
   (Leg Day, Push Day, Run Intervals...) that the daily Workout
   Log can load in one tap. This is a Setup page, same family as
   Timetable / Bucket List — not day-specific.
   ============================================================ */
function renderWorkoutPresets(){
  const presets = workoutPresetList();

  const presetCards = presets.map(preset=>{
    const exRows = (preset.exercises||[]).map((ex,i)=>`
      <div class="preset-ex-row">
        <input class="textline" placeholder="Exercise" value="${esc(ex.name)}" oninput="updateWorkoutPresetExercise('${preset.id}',${i},'name',this.value)">
        <input class="numline" style="width:44px;" placeholder="Sets" value="${esc(ex.sets)}" oninput="updateWorkoutPresetExercise('${preset.id}',${i},'sets',this.value)">
        <input class="numline" style="width:44px;" placeholder="Reps" value="${esc(ex.reps)}" oninput="updateWorkoutPresetExercise('${preset.id}',${i},'reps',this.value)">
        <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="removeWorkoutPresetExercise('${preset.id}',${i})" aria-label="Remove exercise">${icon('trash',13)}</button>
      </div>`).join('');
    return `
      <div class="field-card">
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
          <input class="textline" style="flex:1; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:800; font-size:14px; border-bottom:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; padding:8px 10px;" value="${esc(preset.name)}" oninput="updateWorkoutPresetName('${preset.id}',this.value)">
          <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="confirmDeleteWorkoutPreset('${preset.id}')" aria-label="Delete preset">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
        </div>
        <div style="height:10px"></div>
        ${exRows}
        <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addWorkoutPresetExercise('${preset.id}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add exercise</button>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const suggestRow = WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS.map((s,i)=>`
    <button class="pill" onclick="addWorkoutPresetFromSuggestion(WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS[${i}])">${icon('bolt',12)} ${esc(s.name)}</button>
  `).join('');

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Workout Presets', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      ${fieldWrap('Ready-made templates','Add one of these to start, or build your own below.', `<div class="pill-row">${suggestRow}</div>`)}
      ${presets.length ? presetCards : `<div class="empty-note">No presets yet. Add a suggestion above or create a blank one below.</div>`}
      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="createWorkoutPreset('New preset'); render();">${icon('plus',14)} New blank preset</button>
    </div>
  `;
}
function confirmDeleteWorkoutPreset(id){
  const preset = DB.workoutPresets[id];
  const name = preset ? preset.name : 'this preset';
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Delete "${esc(name)}"?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>This only removes the template — nothing already logged on any day changes.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="closeSheet(); deleteWorkoutPreset('${id}');">${icon('trash',15)} Delete preset</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Keep it</button>
    </div>
  `);
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: READING LOG
   ============================================================ */
function readingBody(dateStr){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  const book = libEnsureCurrentBook();
  // The book carries title/author/page-total forward from whichever
  // day they were first entered — today's page only needs to touch
  // these fields if it's changing them.
  if(!p.title && book.title) p.title = book.title;
  if(!p.author && book.author) p.author = book.author;
  if(!p.pageTotal && book.pageTotal) p.pageTotal = book.pageTotal;
  // baselinePage is "the page you were on before you opened the
  // book today" — captured once per day the first time this page
  // is touched, so "Pages read today" can be added on top of it
  // repeatedly (increasing or decreasing the counter) without ever
  // double-counting. See applyPagesTodayToProgress().
  if(p.baselinePage===undefined || p.baselinePage===null){
    p.baselinePage = book.pageCurrent || 0;
  }
  if(p.pageFrom===undefined || p.pageFrom==='') p.pageFrom = p.baselinePage + (+p.pagesToday||0);

  const pagesSoFar = libPagesReadForBook(book);
  const pct = p.pageTotal ? Math.min(100,Math.round(((+p.pageFrom||0)/(+p.pageTotal))*100)) : 0;

  return `
      <div class="lib-current-card">
        <div class="lib-current-top">
          <div class="lib-current-kicker">${icon('book',13)} Currently reading</div>
          <button class="lib-archive-link" onclick="nav('page','library')">Library ${icon('chevright',12)}</button>
        </div>
        <div class="lib-current-stats">
          <div><div class="v">${pagesSoFar}</div><div class="l">Pages so far</div></div>
          <div><div class="v">${libDaysActiveForBook(book)}</div><div class="l">Days on it</div></div>
          <div><div class="v">${pct}%</div><div class="l">Through book</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="openBookPicker()">${icon('book',14)} Switch book from Library</button>

      ${copyYesterdayBar(dateStr,'reading')}
      ${fieldWrap('Book title', null, `
        ${textField(dateStr,'reading','title','Book title',p.title)}
        <div style="height:8px"></div>
        ${textField(dateStr,'reading','author','Author',p.author)}
      `)}

      ${fieldWrap('Pages read today', null, counterField(dateStr,'reading','pagesToday',p.pagesToday,5))}
      ${fieldWrap('Time spent (min)', null, counterField(dateStr,'reading','minutes',p.minutes,10))}

      ${fieldWrap('Reading progress', 'Updates automatically as you log pages today — adjust it by hand if you skipped ahead or re-read.', `
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
          <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700;">Page</span>
          <input class="numline" placeholder="0" value="${esc(p.pageFrom)}" oninput="setPageFrom('${dateStr}',this.value)">
          <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700;">of</span>
          <input class="numline" placeholder="0" value="${esc(p.pageTotal)}" oninput="setPageTotal('${dateStr}',this.value)">
        </div>
        ${p.pageTotal ? `<div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div><div class="ptxt">${pct}%</div></div>`:''}
      `)}

      ${fieldWrap('Rate this book so far', null, scaleRow10(dateStr,'reading','rating',p.rating))}

      ${fieldWrap('What I took from today\'s reading', null, areaField(dateStr,'reading','takeaway','Key idea or reflection...',p.takeaway))}
      ${fieldWrap('A line worth keeping', null, areaField(dateStr,'reading','quote','A quote or passage that stuck with you...',p.quote))}

      <button class="finish-book-btn" onclick="confirmFinishBook()">${icon('check',15)} Finished this book</button>
  `;
}
function renderReading(dateStr){
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Reading Log', true)}
    <div class="page-body">${readingBody(dateStr)}</div>
  `;
}
// Sheet listing every book that's a candidate to switch to right
// now — ones on pause and ones queued up ("to read") — so picking
// a book to log against never means retyping a title you've
// already entered somewhere in the app.
function openBookPicker(){
  const books = libSwitchableBooks();
  const rows = books.map(b=>`
    <button class="preset-pick-row" onclick="closeSheet(); libResumeBook('${b.id}');">
      <div>
        <div class="preset-pick-name">${esc(b.title || 'Untitled book')}</div>
        <div class="preset-pick-sub">${b.author ? esc(b.author)+' · ' : ''}${b.status==='toread' ? 'To read' : `${libPagesReadForBook(b)} pages so far`}</div>
      </div>
      ${icon('chevright',15)}
    </button>`).join('');

  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Switch book</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body" style="padding-top:0;">
      ${books.length ? rows : `<div class="empty-note" style="padding:20px 4px;">No other books in your library yet.</div>`}
      <div class="fc-hint" style="margin:${books.length?'16px':'0'} 0 8px;">Add a new book to the library</div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
        <input class="textline" id="lib-pick-title" style="flex:1; border-bottom:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 10px;" placeholder="Book title">
      </div>
      <div style="height:8px"></div>
      <input class="textline" id="lib-pick-author" style="border-bottom:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 10px; width:100%;" placeholder="Author (optional)">
      <div style="height:8px"></div>
      <input class="textline" id="lib-pick-pages" type="number" inputmode="numeric" style="border-bottom:none; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 10px; width:100%;" placeholder="Total pages (optional)">
      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addBookFromPicker()">${icon('plus',14)} Add to library</button>
      <button class="lib-newbook-link" style="margin-top:14px;" onclick="closeSheet(); nav('page','library');">${icon('book',13)} Open full Library</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function addBookFromPicker(){
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('lib-pick-title');
  const authorEl = document.getElementById('lib-pick-author');
  const pagesEl = document.getElementById('lib-pick-pages');
  if(!titleEl || !titleEl.value.trim()) return;

function setPageTotal(dateStr,val){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  p.pageTotal = val;
  markTouched(dateStr,'reading');
  libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  saveDB();
  render();
}
// Manually correcting "page you're on" (skipped ahead, re-read a
// chapter, fixing a typo) re-anchors the baseline the auto-add math
// works from, so subsequent changes to "pages read today" build on
// top of this corrected value instead of overwriting it back to
// whatever the automatic calc would have said.
function setPageFrom(dateStr,val){
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'reading');
  p.pageFrom = val;
  p.baselinePage = Math.max(0, (+val||0) - (+p.pagesToday||0));
  markTouched(dateStr,'reading');
  libSyncFromReadingLog(dateStr);
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function confirmFinishBook(){
  const book = libCurrentBook();
  const title = book && book.title ? book.title : 'this book';
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Finish "${esc(title)}"?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>This moves it to your Library as finished and starts a fresh book next time you open Reading Log.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" style="background:var(--green);" onclick="closeSheet(); libFinishCurrentBook();">${icon('check',15)} Yes, mark as finished</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Keep reading it</button>

  `);
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: LIBRARY — archive of finished books plus the one you're
   on now. This is where the "retained" reading stats live once a
   book is done, so closing one out never throws numbers away.
   ============================================================ */
function renderLibrary(){
  const current = libCurrentBook();
  const finished = libFinishedBooks();
  const paused = libPausedBooks();
  const toRead = libToReadBooks();
  const totalPages = libTotalPagesRead();

  const currentCard = current && (current.title || current.pageCurrent) ? `
    <div class="lib-book-card lib-book-current">
      <div class="lib-book-top">
        <div class="lib-book-title">${esc(current.title || 'Untitled book')}</div>
        <span class="pill active" style="pointer-events:none;">Reading</span>
      </div>
      ${current.author ? `<div class="lib-book-author">${esc(current.author)}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="lib-book-stats">
        <div><div class="v">${libPagesReadForBook(current)}</div><div class="l">Pages read</div></div>
        <div><div class="v">${libDaysActiveForBook(current)}</div><div class="l">Days on it</div></div>
        <div><div class="v">${current.pageTotal ? Math.min(100,Math.round((current.pageCurrent/current.pageTotal)*100))+'%' : '—'}</div><div class="l">Through</div></div>
      </div>
      <button class="lib-continue-btn" onclick="openPage('reading')">Continue reading ${icon('chevright',13)}</button>
    </div>` : `
    <div class="lib-empty-current">
      <div>${icon('book',20)}</div>
      <div><b>No book in progress</b>Log a title in Reading to start tracking it here.</div>
    </div>`;

  const finishedCards = finished.map(b=>`
    <div class="lib-book-card">
      <div class="lib-book-top">
        <div class="lib-book-title">${esc(b.title || 'Untitled book')}</div>
        <button class="lib-delete-btn" onclick="confirmDeleteBook('${b.id}')" aria-label="Remove from library">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
      </div>
      ${b.author ? `<div class="lib-book-author">${esc(b.author)}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="lib-book-stats">
        <div><div class="v">${b.pagesReadFinal ?? libPagesReadForBook(b)}</div><div class="l">Pages read</div></div>
        <div><div class="v">${b.daysActiveFinal ?? libDaysActiveForBook(b)}</div><div class="l">Days spent</div></div>
        <div><div class="v">${b.rating ? b.rating+'/10' : '—'}</div><div class="l">Rating</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lib-book-finished-on">Finished ${fmtDateShort(b.finishedAt)}</div>
    </div>`).join('');

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Library', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      <div class="section-label" style="padding-left:0;">Now reading</div>
      ${currentCard}
      ${!current || (!current.title && !current.pageCurrent) ? '' : `<button class="lib-newbook-link" onclick="confirmStartNewBook()">${icon('plus',13)} Start a different book instead</button>`}

      ${paused.length ? `
      <div class="section-label" style="padding-left:0;">On pause <span class="sub">${paused.length}</span></div>
      <div class="lib-book-grid">${paused.map(b=>`
        <div class="lib-book-card">
          <div class="lib-book-top">
            <div class="lib-book-title">${esc(b.title || 'Untitled book')}</div>
            <button class="lib-delete-btn" onclick="confirmDeleteBook('${b.id}')" aria-label="Remove from library">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
          </div>
          ${b.author ? `<div class="lib-book-author">${esc(b.author)}</div>` : ''}
          <div class="lib-book-stats">
            <div><div class="v">${libPagesReadForBook(b)}</div><div class="l">Pages read</div></div>
            <div><div class="v">${b.pageTotal ? Math.min(100,Math.round((b.pageCurrent/b.pageTotal)*100))+'%' : '—'}</div><div class="l">Through</div></div>
            <div></div>
          </div>
          <button class="lib-continue-btn" onclick="libResumeBook('${b.id}')">Resume ${icon('chevright',13)}</button>
        </div>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}

      <div class="section-label" style="padding-left:0;">To read <span class="sub">${toRead.length}</span></div>
      ${toRead.length ? `<div class="lib-book-grid">${toRead.map(b=>`
        <div class="lib-book-card">
          <div class="lib-book-top">
            <div class="lib-book-title">${esc(b.title || 'Untitled book')}</div>
            <button class="lib-delete-btn" onclick="confirmDeleteBook('${b.id}')" aria-label="Remove from library">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
          </div>
          ${b.author ? `<div class="lib-book-author">${esc(b.author)}</div>` : ''}
          <button class="lib-continue-btn" onclick="libResumeBook('${b.id}')">Start reading ${icon('chevright',13)}</button>
        </div>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="empty-note">Nothing queued up yet.</div>`}
      <button class="lib-newbook-link" onclick="openAddBookSheet()">${icon('plus',13)} Add a book to your library</button>

      <div class="section-label" style="padding-left:0;">Finished <span class="sub">${finished.length} book${finished.length===1?'':'s'} · ${totalPages.toLocaleString()} pages total</span></div>
      ${finished.length ? `<div class="lib-book-grid">${finishedCards}</div>` : `<div class="empty-note">Nothing finished yet. Once you tap "Finished this book" in the Reading Log, it lands here for good.</div>`}
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>
    ${renderBottomNav('')}
  `;
}
