/* ============================================================
   PAGE: BUCKET LIST (monthly — one page per calendar month)
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   VISION BOARD
   Monthly page. The SETUP STEPS script replaces this with a picture-first version in the apps that have a Vision Board.
   ============================================================ */
function bucketBody(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const locked = isMonthlyPageLocked('bucket', mk);
  const page = getMonthlyPage('bucket', mk);
  if(!page.items) page.items = [
    {tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'MUST',text:''},
    {tier:'WANT',text:''},{tier:'WANT',text:''},{tier:'WANT',text:''},
    {tier:'SOMEDAY',text:''},{tier:'SOMEDAY',text:''},{tier:'SOMEDAY',text:''},
    {tier:'MUST',text:''},
  ];

  if(locked){
    const filled = page.items.filter(it=>it.text && it.text.trim());
    const summary = filled.length
      ? `<div class="field-card">${filled.map(it=>`
          <div class="locked-item-row">
            <span class="pill ${it.tier==='MUST'?'active red':''}" style="padding:4px 7px; font-size:9px;">${esc(it.tier)}</span>
            <span class="${it.done?'strike':''}">${esc(it.text)}</span>
          </div>`).join('')}</div>`
      : `<div class="empty-note">Nothing written down yet for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}.</div>`;
    return monthlyLockedBody(summary, 'bucket', mk);
  }

  // Same "checked items clear out" pattern as the workout log —
  // only open goals stay in the working list; a just-checked one
  // keeps showing here, ticked, for a couple seconds (see
  // PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET in toggleBucketDone) and then moves out
  // into the collapsed "Done" strip below instead of vanishing
  // outright, since a bucket-list goal is worth being able to
  // glance back at.
  const openItems = page.items.map((item,i)=>({item,i})).filter(x=>!x.item.done || PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.has(mk+':'+x.i));
  const doneItems = page.items.map((item,i)=>({item,i})).filter(x=>x.item.done && !PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.has(mk+':'+x.i));

  const rows = openItems.map(({item,i})=>`
    <div class="check-row" id="bucket-row-${i}">
      <div class="checkbox ${item.done?'checked':''}" onclick="toggleBucketDone('${mk}',${i})">${icon('check',14)}</div>
      <input class="textline" style="flex:1" placeholder="A goal you're chasing..." value="${esc(item.text)}" oninput="updateBucket('${mk}',${i},'text',this.value)" ${item.done?'disabled':''}>
      <button class="pill ${item.tier==='MUST'?'active red':''}" style="padding:5px 8px; font-size:9px;" onclick="cycleTier('${mk}',${i})" ${item.done?'disabled':''}>${esc(item.tier)}</button>
    </div>`).join('');

  const doneRows = doneItems.map(({item,i})=>`
    <div class="check-row">
      <div class="checkbox checked" onclick="toggleBucketDone('${mk}',${i})">${icon('check',14)}</div>
      <div class="crow-text" style="text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--muted);">${esc(item.text||'Untitled goal')}</div>
      <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="deleteBucketItemToTrash('${mk}',${i})" aria-label="Move to trash">${icon('trash',13)}</button>
    </div>`).join('');

  return `
    ${fieldWrap('Things you\'re chasing this lifetime','Be honest, be specific. Tap the tag to cycle Must / Want / Someday — checking one off tucks it away here. It\'s still counted once you lock the month, unless you delete it from Trash, which removes it everywhere.', (rows || `<div class="empty-note" style="padding:16px 4px;">Nothing open right now.</div>`) + `
      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addBucketItem('${mk}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add goal</button>
      ${doneItems.length ? `<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="toggleShowDoneBucket()">${icon(SHOW_DONE_BUCKET?'chevright':'check',12)} ${SHOW_DONE_BUCKET?'Hide':'Show'} ${doneItems.length} done</button>` : ''}
      ${SHOW_DONE_BUCKET ? `<div class="field-card" style="margin-top:10px;">${doneRows}</div>` : ''}
      ${trashCount('bucket', ctx=>ctx.monthKey===mk) ? `<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="openTrashSheet('bucket','${mk}')">${icon('trash',12)} Trash (${trashCount('bucket', ctx=>ctx.monthKey===mk)})</button>` : ''}
    `)}
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow('bucket','${mk}')">${icon('check',14)} Mark done for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}</button>
  `;
}
function updateBucket(mk,i,key,val){
  getMonthlyPage('bucket',mk).items[i][key]=val;
  saveDB();
}
// Same disappearing pattern as the workout exercise log: checking a
// goal off leaves it visible and ticked for a couple seconds (see
// DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS) before animating the row out, rather than
// vanishing or just striking it through instantly. The goal isn't
// deleted — item.done stays true and it still counts in the locked
// month-end summary — it just clears out of the active working list
// once its hold window passes.
let PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET = new Set();
function toggleBucketDone(mk,i){
  const item = getMonthlyPage('bucket',mk).items[i];
  const key = mk+':'+i;
  item.done = !item.done;
  flashSaved();
  saveDB();
  if(item.done){
    PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.add(key);
    render();
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(!PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.has(key)) return;
      const row = document.getElementById(`bucket-row-${i}`);
      if(row){
        row.classList.add('row-completing');
        setTimeout(()=>{ PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.delete(key); render(); }, 260);
      } else {
        PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.delete(key);
        render();
      }
    }, DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS);
    return;
  }
  PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.delete(key);
  render();
}
function cycleTier(mk,i){
  const order = ['MUST','WANT','SOMEDAY'];
  const item = getMonthlyPage('bucket',mk).items[i];
  const cur = order.indexOf(item.tier);
  item.tier = order[(cur+1)%3];
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function addBucketItem(mk){
  getMonthlyPage('bucket',mk).items.push({tier:'SOMEDAY',text:''});
  saveDB();
  render();
}
// Moves a completed goal into the trash — the one truly permanent
// way to remove a bucket item (unchecking it from the "done" strip
// just reopens it). Full item data (text + tier) travels with the
// trash entry so trashRestore can drop it back into this same
// month's list if deleted by mistake.
function deleteBucketItemToTrash(mk,i){
  const page = getMonthlyPage('bucket',mk);
  const item = page.items[i];
  if(!item) return;
  const summary = item.text || 'Untitled goal';
  page.items.splice(i,1);
  // Same index-shift problem as the exercise log — clear this
  // month's pending keys so no unrelated row stays held open.
  Array.from(PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET).forEach(k=>{ if(k.indexOf(mk+':')===0) PENDING_COMPLETE_BUCKET.delete(k); });
  trashAdd('bucket', {tier:item.tier,text:item.text}, {monthKey:mk}, summary);
  saveDB();
  flashSaved('Moved to trash');
  render();
}
function lockMonthlyPageNow(pageId, monthKey){
  touchMonthlyPage(pageId, monthKey);
  flashSaved(`Locked for ${monthLabelShort(monthKey)}`);
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: TIMETABLE (weekly template)
   ============================================================ */
function renderTimetable(dateStr){
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  const rows = blocks.map((b)=>{
    const mapped = getSlotMapping(b.time);
    return `
    <div class="timeline-row ${b.task?'filled':''}">
      <div class="t-label">${esc(fmtBlockTime(b.time))}</div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="What happens here..." value="${esc(b.task)}" oninput="updateTimetable('${b.time}',this.value)">
      <button class="tt-remove-btn" onclick="confirmRemoveBlock('${b.time}')" aria-label="Remove this block">${icon('trash',14)}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tt-focus-row">
      <span class="tt-focus-lbl">${icon('grid',12)} Links to</span>
      <select onchange="setSlotMapping('${b.time}', this.value || null); render();">
        <option value="">Nothing — idle hour</option>
        ${bxFocusPages().map(f=>`<option value="${f.id}" ${f.id===mapped?'selected':''}>${esc(f.name)}</option>`).join('')}
      </select>
    </div>
    ${!mapped ? `
    <div class="tt-focus-row">
      <span class="tt-focus-lbl">${icon('pen',12)} Idle quote</span>
      <input class="textline" style="flex:1" placeholder="${esc(idleQuoteFor(b.time,''))}" value="${esc((DB.timetable.idleQuotes||{})[b.time]||'')}" oninput="setIdleQuote('${b.time}', this.value); saveDB();">
    </div>` : ''}
    `;
  }).join('');

  const usedTimes = new Set(blocks.map(b=>b.time));
  const suggested = suggestNextBlockTime(usedTimes);

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Timetable', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      ${fieldWrap('How your ideal day is structured','Design it before you live it. Add a block at any time — not just on the hour — and remove any you don\'t use.', `
        <div class="pill-row" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
          ${TIMETABLE_PRESETS.map(p=>`<button class="pill" onclick="applyPresetAndRerender('${p.id}')">${icon('bolt',12)} ${esc(p.name)}</button>`).join('')}
        </div>
        ${blocks.length ? rows : `<div class="empty-note">No blocks yet — add your first one below.</div>`}
        <div class="tt-add-row">
          <input type="time" id="tt-new-time" class="tt-add-time" value="${esc(suggested)}" step="${TIME_STEP_MIN*60}">
          <button class="add-row-btn" style="flex:1;margin:0;" onclick="addTimetableBlockFromInput()">${icon('plus',14)} Add block</button>
        </div>
      `)}
      ${fieldWrap('What shows up on Home','Whichever block is linked to a page gets pushed to the top of Home, fully expanded, whenever the clock is inside that block right now. Unlinked blocks show a quote instead of an empty box.', '')}
    </div>
  `;
}
// Picks a reasonable default time to pre-fill the "add block" time
// input with: the next free half-hour after the latest existing
// block, or 07:00 if the timetable is empty. Purely a UX nicety —
// the person can change it before tapping Add.
function suggestNextBlockTime(usedTimes){
  if(!usedTimes || !usedTimes.size) return '07:00';
  let latest = -1;
  usedTimes.forEach(t=>{ const m = timeStrToMinutes(t); if(m>latest) latest=m; });
  let candidate = latest + TIME_STEP_MIN;
  let guard = 0;
  while(usedTimes.has(minutesToTimeStr(candidate)) && guard < 48){
    candidate += TIME_STEP_MIN;
    guard++;
  }
  return minutesToTimeStr(candidate);
}
function addTimetableBlockFromInput(){
  const input = document.getElementById('tt-new-time');
  if(!input || !input.value) return;
  addTimetableBlock(input.value);
}
function confirmRemoveBlock(time){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Remove ${esc(fmtBlockTime(time))} block?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>This removes the block, its task text, and any page it's linked to.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="closeSheet(); removeTimetableBlock('${time}');">${icon('trash',15)} Remove block</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Keep it</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function applyPresetAndRerender(presetId){
  applyTimetablePreset(presetId);
  flashSaved('Timetable filled');
  render();
}
function updateTimetable(time,val){
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  const b = blocks.find(x=>x.time===time);
  if(b) b.task = String(val || '');
  DB.timetable.blocks = blocks;
  touchSetupPage('timetable');
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: INCOME STREAMS
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   PAGE: INCOME STREAMS (monthly — one page per calendar month)
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   MONTHLY VAULT PAGE
   Monthly page. In Clean Boy and Clean Girl the POLISH script turns it into a list of products in rotation.
   ============================================================ */
function incomeBody(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const locked = isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk);
  const page = getMonthlyPage('income', mk);
  if(!page.streams) page.streams = [];
  const streams = page.streams;
  const total = streams.reduce((s,x)=> s + (+x.current||0), 0);
  const target = streams.reduce((s,x)=> s + (+x.target||0), 0);
  const statuses = ['Active','Testing','Paused'];

  if(locked){
    const summary = streams.length
      ? `<div class="two-col" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$${total.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="sl">Total monthly rev</div></div>
          <div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$${target.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="sl">Combined target</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-card">${streams.map(s=>`
          <div class="locked-item-row">
            <span style="font-weight:700;">${esc(s.name||'Unnamed stream')}</span>
            <span class="muted-inline">$${(+s.current||0).toLocaleString()} → $${(+s.target||0).toLocaleString()} · ${esc(s.status||'Testing')}</span>
          </div>`).join('')}</div>`
      : `<div class="empty-note">No streams added yet for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}.</div>`;
    return monthlyLockedBody(summary, 'income', mk);
  }

  const cards = streams.map((s,i)=>`
    <div class="field-card">
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Stream name / source" value="${esc(s.name)}" oninput="updateIncome('${mk}',${i},'name',this.value)" style="font-family:var(--font-display); text-transform:uppercase; font-size:13px;">
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:14px;">
        <div style="flex:1"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 4px;">Current $</div><input class="numline" inputmode="decimal" style="width:100%; text-align:left;" placeholder="0" value="${esc(s.current)}" oninput="updateIncome('${mk}',${i},'current',this.value)"></div>
        <div style="flex:1"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 4px;">Target $</div><input class="numline" inputmode="decimal" style="width:100%; text-align:left;" placeholder="0" value="${esc(s.target)}" oninput="updateIncome('${mk}',${i},'target',this.value)"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Next action / milestone" value="${esc(s.next)}" oninput="updateIncome('${mk}',${i},'next',this.value)">
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <div class="pill-row">${statuses.map(st=>`<button class="pill ${s.status===st?'active red':''}" onclick="setIncomeStatus('${mk}',${i},'${st}')">${esc(st)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <button class="rm-row" style="margin-top:8px; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; text-decoration:underline;" onclick="removeIncome('${mk}',${i})">Remove stream</button>
    </div>`).join('');

  return `
    <div class="two-col" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
      <div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$${total.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="sl">Total monthly rev</div></div>
      <div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$${target.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="sl">Combined target</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="section-label" style="padding:0 0 10px;">Active streams</div>
    ${cards}
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addIncomeStream('${mk}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add income stream</button>
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow('income','${mk}')">${icon('check',14)} Mark done for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}</button>
  `;
}
function addIncomeStream(mk){
  getMonthlyPage('income',mk).streams.push({status:'Testing'});
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function updateIncome(mk,i,key,val){
  getMonthlyPage('income',mk).streams[i][key]=val;
  saveDB();
  if(key==='current'||key==='target') render();
}
function setIncomeStatus(mk,i,val){
  getMonthlyPage('income',mk).streams[i].status=val;
  flashSaved();
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function removeIncome(mk,i){
  getMonthlyPage('income',mk).streams.splice(i,1);
  saveDB();
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: 3 OBJECTIVES (monthly)
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   PAGE: 3 OBJECTIVES (monthly — one page per calendar month)
   ============================================================ */
function objectivesBody(monthKey){
  const mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
  const locked = isMonthlyPageLocked('objectives', mk);
  const page = getMonthlyPage('objectives', mk);
  if(!page.list) page.list = [{},{},{}];

  if(locked){
    const filled = page.list.filter(o=>o.title && o.title.trim());
    const summary = filled.length
      ? `<div class="field-card">${filled.map(o=>`
          <div class="locked-item-row" style="align-items:flex-start;">
            <div>
              <div style="font-weight:700;">${esc(o.title)}</div>
              ${o.deadline?`<div class="muted-inline">Due ${esc(o.deadline)}</div>`:''}
            </div>
            <span class="muted-inline">${o.progress||0}%</span>
          </div>`).join('')}</div>`
      : `<div class="empty-note">No objectives named yet for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}.</div>`;
    return monthlyLockedBody(summary, 'objectives', mk);
  }

  const cards = page.list.map((o,i)=>`
    <div class="field-card">
      <div class="fc-label">Objective ${i+1}</div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Name the objective clearly..." value="${esc(o.title)}" oninput="updateObjective('${mk}',${i},'title',this.value)">
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Why it matters" value="${esc(o.why)}" oninput="updateObjective('${mk}',${i},'why',this.value)">
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Success metric" value="${esc(o.metric)}" oninput="updateObjective('${mk}',${i},'metric',this.value)">
      <div style="height:10px"></div>
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Deadline" value="${esc(o.deadline)}" oninput="updateObjective('${mk}',${i},'deadline',this.value)">
      <div class="fc-hint" style="margin-top:12px;">Progress — tap to set</div>
      ${scaleRow10Objectives(mk,i,o.progress)}
    </div>`).join('');

  return `
    ${fieldWrap('Three things. This month.', 'Name them clearly or they won\'t happen.', '')}
    ${cards}
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow('objectives','${mk}')">${icon('check',14)} Mark done for ${monthLabelShort(mk)}</button>
  `;
}
function scaleRow10Objectives(mk,i,val){
  let cells='';
  for(let s=10;s<=100;s+=10){
    const active = (val||0)>=s;
    cells += `<div class="scale-dot ${active?'active red':''}" style="flex:1;height:28px;font-size:9px;" onclick="setObjProgress('${mk}',${i},${s})">${s}</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="scale-row" style="gap:3px;">${cells}</div>`;
}
function setObjProgress(mk,i,val){
  const page = getMonthlyPage('objectives',mk);
  const o = page.list[i];
  o.progress = (o.progress===val)?0:val;
  flashSaved();
  saveDB();
  render();
}
function updateObjective(mk,i,key,val){
  getMonthlyPage('objectives',mk).list[i][key]=val;
  saveDB();
}

function renderLanePicker(dateStr){
  const cards = LANES.map(l=>`
    <div class="lane-card ${DB.lane===l.id?'selected':''}" onclick="pickLane('${l.id}')">
      <div class="lane-glyph">${esc(l.glyph)}</div>
      <div class="lane-info">
        <div class="lane-name">${esc(l.name)}</div>
        <div class="lane-desc">${esc(l.desc)}</div>
      </div>
      ${DB.lane===l.id ? `<div>${icon('check',18)}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`).join('');

  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Business Lane', true)}
    <div class="lane-picker">
      <div class="fc-hint" style="margin-bottom:14px;">Eight modes, one job each. Pick the one that's actually you and work it daily.</div>
      ${cards}
    </div>
    ${DB.lane ? `<div style="padding:0 16px 20px;"><button class="add-row-btn" onclick="openLaneLog()">${icon('chevright',14)} Open today's ${LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane).name}</button></div>` : ''}
  `;
}
function pickLane(id){
  DB.lane = id;
  saveDB();
  openLaneLog();
}
function openLaneLog(){
  nav('lanelog', 'lane');
}

/* ============================================================
   PAGE: LANE LOG (per-lane daily form)

const LANE_FIELDS = {
  TR: {title:'Trading Log', fields:[
    ['market','Market / session'],['balance','Account balance $'],['risk','Daily risk limit $'],
  ], scales:[['plan','Followed my trading plan'],['risklimit','Respected risk limits'],['emotion','Emotional control']],
  extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    if(!p.trades) p.trades=[];
    const rows = p.trades.map((t,i)=>`<tr>
      <td><input placeholder="Pair" value="${esc(t.pair)}" oninput="updateLaneRow('trades',${i},'pair',this.value)"></td>
      <td><input placeholder="Entry" value="${esc(t.entry)}" oninput="updateLaneRow('trades',${i},'entry',this.value)"></td>
      <td><input placeholder="Exit" value="${esc(t.exit)}" oninput="updateLaneRow('trades',${i},'exit',this.value)"></td>
      <td><input placeholder="P&L" value="${esc(t.pnl)}" oninput="updateLaneRow('trades',${i},'pnl',this.value)"></td>
    </tr>`).join('');
    return fieldWrap('Trade log', null, `<table class="log-table"><thead><tr><th>Pair</th><th>Entry</th><th>Exit</th><th>P&L</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="addLaneRow('trades')">${icon('plus',14)} Add trade</button>`);
  }},
  SM: {title:'Social Media', fields:[
    ['account','Client / account'],['platforms','Platform(s)'],['reach','Reach'],['followers','Followers gained'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Content pipeline', null, pillGroup(dateStr,'lane','pipeline',['Drafted','Scheduled','Awaiting approval','Posted'],p.pipeline,'red')) +
      fieldWrap('Top post today and key takeaway', null, areaField(dateStr,'lane','takeaway','What worked / what to repeat...',p.takeaway));
  }},
  CW: {title:'Car Wash', fields:[
    ['route','Route / location'],['customers','Customers served'],['revenue','Revenue $'],['tips','Tips $'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Supplies check','Tap what needs restocking', ['Soap','Microfiber','Wax / sealant','Tire shine','Vacuum bags'].map(s=>checkRow(dateStr,'lane','stock_'+s,s)).join('')) +
      fieldWrap('Note for next session', null, areaField(dateStr,'lane','note','Anything to remember...',p.note));
  }},
  EC: {title:'Dropshipping', fields:[
    ['store','Store / platform'],['sessions','Sessions'],['orders','Orders'],['revenue','Revenue $'],['adspend','Ad spend $'],['netprofit','Net profit $'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Note / next action', null, areaField(dateStr,'lane','note','...',p.note));
  }},
  FR: {title:'Freelance', fields:[
    ['client','Client'],['project','Project'],['hours','Total hours'],['billable','Billable hours'],['rate','Rate $/hr'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Invoice status', null, pillGroup(dateStr,'lane','invoice',['Drafted','Sent','Paid','Overdue'],p.invoice,'red'));
  }},
  CC: {title:'Creator Log', fields:[
    ['platform','Primary platform'],['views','Total views'],['newfollowers','New followers'],['revenue','Revenue today $'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Revenue stream today', null, pillGroup(dateStr,'lane','revstream',['Sponsor','Affiliate','Ad revenue','Digital product','None today'],p.revstream,'red')) +
      fieldWrap('Key takeaway', null, areaField(dateStr,'lane','takeaway','...',p.takeaway));
  }},
  LC: {title:'Lawn Care', fields:[
    ['route','Route / area'],['customers','Customers served'],['jobs','Jobs completed'],['revenue','Revenue $'],['mileage','Mileage'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Equipment used','Tap what you used today', ['Mower','Trimmer','Blower','Edger','Fertilizer'].map(s=>checkRow(dateStr,'lane','equip_'+s,s)).join('')) +
      fieldWrap('Note for next route', null, areaField(dateStr,'lane','note','...',p.note));
  }},
  RS: {title:'Reselling', fields:[
    ['source','Primary sourcing channel'],['itemssold','Items sold'],['revenue','Revenue $'],['fees','Fees + shipping $'],['netprofit','Net profit $'],
  ], scales:[], extra: dateStr=>{
    const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
    return fieldWrap('Sourcing trip', null, `
      <input class="textline" placeholder="Location / store" value="${esc(p.sourceloc)}" oninput="setText('${dateStr}','lane','sourceloc',this.value)">
      <div style="height:8px"></div>
      <input class="textline" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Cash spent sourcing $" value="${esc(p.sourcecash)}" oninput="setText('${dateStr}','lane','sourcecash',this.value)">
    `);
  }},
};
/* Returns null when there's no lane picked yet (caller decides what
   to show instead — the focus card falls back to the lane picker,
   the standalone route falls back to nav('page','lane')). */
function laneLogBody(dateStr){
  if(!DB.lane) return null;
  const conf = LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane];
  const p = getPage(dateStr,'lane');
  const numericLabel = /\$|hour|rate|sessions|orders|customers|jobs|mileage|items|units|views|followers|reach/i;
  const basicFields = conf.fields.map(([key,label])=>`
    <div style="margin-bottom:10px;">
      <div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 4px;">${esc(label)}</div>
      <input class="textline" inputmode="${numericLabel.test(label)?'decimal':'text'}" placeholder="${esc(label)}" value="${esc(p[key])}" oninput="setText('${dateStr}','lane','${key}',this.value)">
    </div>`).join('');
  const scales = conf.scales.map(([key,label])=>fieldWrap(label,null,scaleTapper(dateStr,'lane',key,5,p[key]||0,true))).join('');

  return `
      ${copyYesterdayBar(dateStr,'lane')}
      ${fieldWrap('Session basics', null, basicFields)}
      ${conf.extra ? conf.extra(dateStr) : ''}
      ${scales}
  `;
}
function renderLaneLog(dateStr){
  if(!DB.lane){ nav('page','lane'); return; }
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar(LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane].title, true)}
    <div class="page-body">${laneLogBody(dateStr)}</div>
  `;
}
function addLaneRow(listKey){
  const p = getPage(ROUTE.date,'lane');
  if(!p[listKey]) p[listKey]=[];
  p[listKey].push({});
  markTouched(ROUTE.date,'lane');
  render();
}
function updateLaneRow(listKey,i,key,val){
  const p = getPage(ROUTE.date,'lane');
  p[listKey][i][key]=val;
  markTouched(ROUTE.date,'lane');
  saveDB();
}

/* Bucket List / Income / Objectives are standalone pages again,
   reached from Home's Setup tiles via the normal openPage() path
   — same as Dashboard/Reading/etc, just monthly instead of daily.
   They previously lived as tabs inside the Monthly Tracker
   (TRACKER_TAB); pulled back out so the Tracker can be a pure
   report on what's already logged, with nothing to fill in on it.
   Each always shows the current month — see renderMonthlyPage. */
function renderMonthlyPage(title, bodyHtml){
  const mk = currentMonthKey();
  app.innerHTML = `
    <div class="topbar">
      <button class="back" onclick="navBack()">${icon('chevleft',18)} Back</button>
      <div class="title">${esc(title)}</div>
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <button class="theme-toggle" onclick="toggleTheme()" aria-label="Toggle dark mode">${icon(getTheme()==='dark'?'sun':'moon',15)}</button>
        <div class="date-pill">${esc(monthLabelShort(mk))}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="page-body" style="padding-top:14px;">${bodyHtml}</div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>
  `;
}
function renderBucketPage(){ renderMonthlyPage('Bucket List', bucketBody(currentMonthKey())); }
function renderIncomePage(){ renderMonthlyPage('Income Streams', incomeBody(currentMonthKey())); }
function renderObjectivesPage(){ renderMonthlyPage('3 Objectives', objectivesBody(currentMonthKey())); }

const PAGE_RENDERERS = {
  dashboard: renderDashboard,
  workout: renderWorkout,
  journal: renderJournal,
  reading: renderReading,
  timetable: renderTimetable,
  lane: renderLanePicker,
  library: renderLibrary,
  workoutPresets: renderWorkoutPresets,
  bucket: renderBucketPage,

};

/* ============================================================
   SETTINGS
   The Settings screen. Test mode adds its 'Testing' section at the bottom (see the end of the file).
   ============================================================ */
function renderSettings(){
  const laneInfo = DB.lane ? LANES.find(l=>l.id===DB.lane) : null;
  const totalBlocks = (DB.timetable.blocks||[]).length;
  const filledBlocks = (DB.timetable.blocks||[]).filter(b=>b.task).length;
  const monthlyRow = (p) => {
    const locked = isMonthlyPageLocked(p.id);
    const desc = locked ? `Done for ${monthLabelShort()} — tap to review` : `Not set up yet for ${monthLabelShort()}`;
    return `<button class="settings-row" onclick="openPage('${p.id}')">
      <div><div class="sr-name">${p.name}</div><div class="sr-desc">${desc}</div></div>
      <div class="sr-ico">${icon(locked?'check':p.icon,16)}</div>
    </button>`;
  };
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Settings', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      ${STORAGE_OK ? '' : `
      <div class="lane-note" style="margin:0 0 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--red);">
        <div class="lni" style="background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--red);">${icon('info',18)}</div>
        <div><b>This browser isn't saving</b>Private browsing (or a storage block) is stopping ${esc(BRAND.name)} from keeping your entries. Anything you log now is lost when you close the tab. Download a backup before you do.</div>
      </div>` }
      ${window.APP_TEST_MODE ? renderTestTimeSection() : ''}

      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">Your setup</div>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('page','lane')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Business lane</div><div class="sr-desc">${laneInfo?esc(laneInfo.name):'No lane picked yet'} — tap to change</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('briefcase',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('page','timetable')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Timetable</div><div class="sr-desc">${totalBlocks ? `${filledBlocks} of ${totalBlocks} blocks filled` : 'No blocks yet'}</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('clock',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('page','library')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Library</div><div class="sr-desc">${libFinishedBooks().length} book${libFinishedBooks().length===1?'':'s'} finished</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('book',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('page','workoutPresets')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Workout Presets</div><div class="sr-desc">${workoutPresetList().length} preset${workoutPresetList().length===1?'':'s'} saved</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('bolt',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="toggleTheme()">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Appearance</div><div class="sr-desc">${getTheme()==='dark'?'Dark mode':'Light mode'} — tap to switch</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon(getTheme()==='dark'?'sun':'moon',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="toggleAssistMode()" aria-pressed="${getAssistMode()}">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Assist Mode</div><div class="sr-desc">${getAssistMode()?'On — larger controls and simpler layout':'Off — turn on for easier tapping and reading'}</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('accessibility',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="confirmRestartOnboarding()">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Run setup again</div><div class="sr-desc">Walk back through the first-run questions — nothing logged is deleted</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('undo',16)}</div>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">${monthLabel()}</div>
        ${monthlyRow(SETUP_PAGES.find(p=>p.id==='bucket'))}
        ${monthlyRow(SETUP_PAGES.find(p=>p.id==='income'))}
        ${monthlyRow(SETUP_PAGES.find(p=>p.id==='objectives'))}
      </div>

      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">Backup</div>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="exportData()">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Download backup</div><div class="sr-desc">Saves every logged day as a .json file</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('download',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="triggerImport()">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Restore from backup</div><div class="sr-desc">Replaces everything currently in the app</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('upload',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <input type="file" id="import-file-input" accept="application/json" style="display:none" onchange="handleImportFile(this)">
      </div>

      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">Data</div>
        <button class="settings-row danger" onclick="openEraseConfirm()">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Erase all data</div><div class="sr-desc">Wipes every logged day. Cannot be undone.</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('trash',15)}</div>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>
    ${renderBottomNav('settings')}
  `;
}

/* ============================================================
   TEST-MODE TIME OVERRIDE UI — only ever rendered when
   window.APP_TEST_MODE is true (the tester build). Lets whoever
   is testing the app jump the "current time" the focus card and
   clock strip read from, without waiting for the real clock —
   a slider covering the full day plus quick-jump buttons for
   every timetable hour.
   ============================================================ */
function renderTestTimeSection(){
  const real = new Date();
  const overrideMins = getDebugTimeMinutes();
  const active = overrideMins !== null;
  const mins = active ? overrideMins : (real.getHours()*60 + real.getMinutes());
  const label = minutesToClockLabel(mins);
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();

  const quickJumps = blocks.map((b,i)=>{
    const slotStart = timeStrToMinutes(b.time);
    const on = active && currentTimetableSlotIndex(nowForApp())===i;
    const mapped = getSlotMapping(b.time);
    return `<button class="test-jump-chip ${on?'active':''}" onclick="setDebugTimeMinutes(${slotStart}); render();">
      ${esc(fmtBlockTime(b.time))}${mapped?' •':''}
    </button>`;
  }).join('');

  return `
    <div class="settings-section test-time-section">
      <div class="settings-heading">Test tools <span class="test-badge">test mode</span></div>
      <div class="test-time-card">
        <div class="test-time-row">
          <div class="test-time-display">${active?'Simulated':'Live'} time</div>
          <div class="test-time-value" id="test-time-live-label">${esc(label)}</div>
        </div>
        <input type="range" class="test-time-slider" min="0" max="1439" step="5" value="${mins}"
          oninput="setDebugTimeMinutes(this.value); document.getElementById('test-time-live-label').textContent = minutesToClockLabel(this.value);">
        <div class="test-jump-row">${quickJumps}</div>
        <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="setDebugTimeMinutes(null); render();" ${active?'':'disabled'}>
          ${icon('history',13)} Back to real clock
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="test-time-card" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 10px;">Backfills ${monthLabel()} with random dashboard/workout/reading/journal${DB.lane?'/lane':''} entries — days you've already logged are left untouched. Only for previewing how the Monthly Tracker charts look with data in them.</div>
        <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="randomFillMonth(currentMonthKey())">${icon('grid',13)} Fill ${monthLabelShort()} with test data</button>
        <button class="add-row-btn" style="color:var(--red);" onclick="confirmClearMonthData()">${icon('trash',13)} Clear ${monthLabelShort()}'s test data</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}
function confirmClearMonthData(){
  const mk = currentMonthKey();
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Clear ${esc(monthLabel(mk))}?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>Deletes every day logged this month — test data and real entries alike, since there's no way to tell them apart after the fact. This can't be undone.</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="closeSheet(); clearMonthData('${mk}');">${icon('trash',15)} Clear the month</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function minutesToClockLabel(mins){
  mins = Math.max(0, Math.min(1439, Math.round(+mins)));
  const h24 = Math.floor(mins/60), m = mins%60;
  const ampm = h24>=12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  let h12 = h24%12; if(h12===0) h12=12;
  return `${h12}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')} ${ampm}`;
}
// The slider's oninput needs to also trigger a re-render once the
// person lets go, so the focus card actually updates — but re-
// rendering on every drag tick would fight the slider's own DOM
// node mid-drag. onchange (fires on release) does the full render;
// oninput just keeps the live label in the settings screen honest.
document.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  if(e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('test-time-slider')){
    render();
  }
});

function openEraseConfirm(){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title">Erase all data?
      <button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.5; margin:0 2px 18px;">
      This deletes every day you've logged, your lane, timetable, bucket list, income streams, and objectives. It cannot be undone — consider downloading a backup first.
    </p>
    <div class="confirm-actions">
      <button class="confirm-cancel" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
      <button class="confirm-danger" onclick="confirmEraseAll()">Erase everything</button>
    </div>
  `);
}
function confirmEraseAll(){
  const keepUnlocked = DB.unlocked === true;   // an entitlement isn't log data: erasing entries must not un-buy the app
  localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  DB = loadDB();
  DB.unlocked = keepUnlocked;
  DB.days = {};
  DB.setupMeta = {};
  DB.onboarded = false;
  saveDB();
  closeSheet();
  render();
}

/* ============================================================
   BOTTOM SHEET (generic) — used for the date picker and
   destructive confirmations so neither needs a full page nav.
   ============================================================ */
let SHEET_SCROLL_Y = 0;
function openSheet(innerHtml){
  closeSheet();
  SHEET_SCROLL_Y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
  const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
  backdrop.className = 'sheet-backdrop';
  backdrop.id = 'active-sheet';
  backdrop.setAttribute('role','dialog');
  backdrop.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  backdrop.onclick = function(e){ if(e.target===backdrop) closeSheet(); };
  backdrop.innerHTML = `<div class="sheet"><div class="sheet-grabber"></div>${innerHtml}</div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
  document.documentElement.classList.add('sheet-open');
  document.body.classList.add('sheet-open');
  document.body.style.top = `-${SHEET_SCROLL_Y}px`;
  document.addEventListener('keydown', sheetEscHandler);
}
function sheetEscHandler(e){
  if(e.key==='Escape') closeSheet();
}
function closeSheet(){
  const el = document.getElementById('active-sheet');
  if(el) el.remove();
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', sheetEscHandler);
  if(document.body.classList.contains('sheet-open')){
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('sheet-open');
    document.body.classList.remove('sheet-open');
    document.body.style.top = '';
    window.scrollTo(0, SHEET_SCROLL_Y);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   DATE PICKER — jump straight to any date instead of only
   scrolling a 7-day strip.
   ============================================================ */
let CAL_MONTH = null;
let CAL_PICKER_OPEN = false;
const CAL_MIN_YEAR = 1900;
const CAL_MAX_YEAR = 2100;

function openDatePicker(){
  const sel = new Date((SELECTED_DATE || todayStr())+'T00:00:00');
  CAL_MONTH = { y: sel.getFullYear(), m: sel.getMonth() };
  CAL_PICKER_OPEN = false;
  openSheet(renderCalendarSheet());
}
function toggleCalPicker(){
  CAL_PICKER_OPEN = !CAL_PICKER_OPEN;
  refreshCalendarSheet();
}
function calendarMonthOptions(selectedMonth){
  const names = Array.from({length:12}, (_,i)=>new Date(2000,i,1).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long'}));
  return names.map((name,i)=>`<option value="${i}" ${i===selectedMonth?'selected':''}>${name}</option>`).join('');
}
function calendarYearOptions(selectedYear){
  let out='';
  for(let y=CAL_MIN_YEAR; y<=CAL_MAX_YEAR; y++) out += `<option value="${y}" ${y===selectedYear?'selected':''}>${y}</option>`;
  return out;
}
function formatCalendarSelection(ds){
  const d=new Date(ds+'T00:00:00');
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});
}
function renderCalendarSheet(){
  const {y,m} = CAL_MONTH;
  const first = new Date(y,m,1);
  const startOffset = (first.getDay()+6)%7; // Monday-first
  const daysInMonth = new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();
  const today = todayStr();
  const selected = SELECTED_DATE || today;

  let cells = '';
  for(let i=0;i<startOffset;i++) cells += `<div class="cal-day cal-day-empty" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;
  for(let day=1; day<=daysInMonth; day++) {
    const ds = `${y}-${String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const isToday = ds===today;
    const isSel = ds===selected;
    const has = dayHasAny(ds);
    cells += `<button type="button" class="cal-day ${isToday?'today':''} ${isSel?'selected':''}" onclick="pickCalendarDate('${ds}')" aria-label="${formatCalendarSelection(ds)}" aria-pressed="${isSel}">`+
      `${day}${has?'<span class="cdot"></span>':''}</button>`;
  }
  const totalCells = startOffset + daysInMonth;
  for(let i=totalCells;i<42;i++) cells += `<div class="cal-day cal-day-empty" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;
  const dows = ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S'];
  const selectedLabel = formatCalendarSelection(selected);

  return `
    <div class="sheet-title">
      <span>Choose a day</span>
      <button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cal-head">
      <div>
        <div class="cal-eyebrow">Selected</div>
        <div class="cal-selected-label">${selectedLabel}</div>
      </div>
      ${selected!==today ? `<button class="cal-today-chip" type="button" onclick="pickCalendarDate('${today}')">Today</button>` : ''}
    </div>
    <div class="cal-nav">
      <button class="cal-nav-btn" type="button" onclick="calShiftMonth(-1)" aria-label="Previous month">${icon('chevleft',16)}</button>
      <button class="cal-monthyear-btn" type="button" onclick="toggleCalPicker()" aria-label="Choose month and year" aria-expanded="${CAL_PICKER_OPEN?'true':'false'}">
        <span>${new Date(y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</span>
        ${icon('chevright',12,'class="cal-monthyear-caret"')}
      </button>
      <button class="cal-nav-btn" type="button" onclick="calShiftMonth(1)" aria-label="Next month">${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
    </div>
    ${CAL_PICKER_OPEN ? `
    <div class="cal-period-selectors">
      <select class="cal-period-select cal-month-select" aria-label="Month" onchange="calSetMonth(this.value)">${calendarMonthOptions(m)}</select>
      <select class="cal-period-select cal-year-select" aria-label="Year" onchange="calSetYear(this.value)">${calendarYearOptions(y)}</select>
    </div>` : ''}
    <div class="cal-grid" role="grid" aria-label="${new Date(y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}">
      ${dows.map(d=>`<div class="cal-dow" role="columnheader">${d}</div>`).join('')}
      ${cells}
    </div>
    <div class="cal-footer">
      <div class="cal-footer-note">Days with a dot already have activity.</div>
      <button class="cal-today-btn" type="button" onclick="pickCalendarDate('${today}')">${icon('calendar',14)} Today</button>
    </div>
  `;
}
function calShiftMonth(delta){
  const d = new Date(CAL_MONTH.y, CAL_MONTH.m + delta, 1);
  const nextY = d.getFullYear();
  if(nextY < CAL_MIN_YEAR || nextY > CAL_MAX_YEAR) return;
  CAL_MONTH = { y:nextY, m:d.getMonth() };
  refreshCalendarSheet();
}
function calSetMonth(value){
  const m=Number(value);
  if(Number.isFinite(m)) CAL_MONTH.m=Math.max(0,Math.min(11,m));
  CAL_PICKER_OPEN = false;
  refreshCalendarSheet();
}
function calSetYear(value){
  const y=Number(value);
  if(Number.isFinite(y)) CAL_MONTH.y=Math.max(CAL_MIN_YEAR,Math.min(CAL_MAX_YEAR,y));
  CAL_PICKER_OPEN = false;
  refreshCalendarSheet();
}
function refreshCalendarSheet(){
  const sheetBody=document.querySelector('#active-sheet .sheet');
  if(!sheetBody) return;
  const scrollTop=sheetBody.scrollTop;
  sheetBody.innerHTML=`<div class="sheet-grabber"></div>${renderCalendarSheet()}`;
  sheetBody.scrollTop=scrollTop;
}
function pickCalendarDate(ds){
  SELECTED_DATE=ds;
  ROUTE={view:'home',pageId:null,date:ds};
  closeSheet();
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'auto'}));
}


/* ============================================================
   CUSTOM BOXES — one shared module, identical in all 7 logbooks.

   MODEL
   DB.bx.boxes[boxId] = {
     id, custom, name, icon, from, until, hiddenFrom, order,
     fields:[ {id,label,type,icon,max,options,unit,created,deleted} ],
     labels:{ <builtinFieldKey>: 'new label' },   // renames of built-in fields
     hidden:{ <builtinFieldKey>: 'YYYY-MM-DD' },   // removals of built-in fields
   }
   - Custom boxes are ordinary entries in the daily page list, so the
     day ring, streak, Next Up and History all count them through the
     same `_touched` flag as every built-in box. No second system.
   - Every value lives in the day record: DB.days[ds].pages[boxId]['cf_'+fieldId].
   - REMOVING never deletes data: a field/box just gets a date stamp and
     stops being offered from that day on. Old values stay in their day
     records and stay in the Tracker.
   - The Tracker never looks fields up by name. It reads the registry
     and scans the data for any cf_* key, so every field registers
     itself as a metric the moment it exists.
   ============================================================ */
const BX_SEED_FIT = false; window.__FIT_SUGGEST = false;
const BX_PHOTO_MAX_CHARS = 140000;            // ~105 KB of JPEG per photo
const BX_FIELD_TYPES = [

  { id:'toggle', name:'Toggle',          desc:'Done or not done',             icon:'toggle' },
  { id:'choice', name:'Multiple choice', desc:'Pick one from your own list',  icon:'listcheck' },
  { id:'photo',  name:'Photo',           desc:'Take or choose a picture',     icon:'camera' },
];
