    layers:'<path d="M12 3 3 8l9 5 9-5-9-5Z"/><path d="M3 13l9 5 9-5"/>',
  };
  Object.keys(NEW).forEach(k=>{ if(!ICONS[k]) ICONS[k] = NEW[k]; });
})();
const BX_ICON_CHOICES = ['star','heart','shirt','camera','coffee','leaf','music','smile','sparkle','bag','phone','bed',
  'pill','dumbbell','drop','flame','bolt','book','moon','sun','target','clock','flag','pen','calendar','briefcase','chart','home'];

let BX_EDIT = null;        // id of the box currently in "Customize" mode
let FWCTX = null;          // set while a built-in box body is being built
let BX_FORM = null;        // state of the open field/box form sheet
let BX_EXPLORE = '';       // Tracker "Explore any field" selection
let BX_WPERIOD = 'month';  // Widget Preview: data widget period

/* ---------- registry access (always lazy, so a restored backup
   or an older save can never leave this half-initialised) ---------- */
function bxFitDef(){
  return {
    id:'fit', custom:true, name:'Fit of the Day', icon:'shirt', from:todayStr(), until:null, order:1,
    labels:{}, hidden:{},
    fields:[
      { id:'photo',    label:'Photo of the outfit',                      type:'photo',  icon:'camera',   created:todayStr(), deleted:null },
      { id:'wore',     label:'What you wore',                            type:'short',  icon:'shirt',    created:todayStr(), deleted:null },
      { id:'occasion', label:'Occasion / context',                       type:'short',  icon:'calendar', created:todayStr(), deleted:null },
      { id:'feel',     label:'How it made you feel',                     type:'scale',  icon:'smile', max:5, created:todayStr(), deleted:null },
      { id:'next',     label:"One thing you'd change or keep next time", type:'long',   icon:'pen',      created:todayStr(), deleted:null },
    ],
  };
}
function bxDB(){
  if(!DB.bx || typeof DB.bx!=='object' || Array.isArray(DB.bx)) DB.bx = {};
  const b = DB.bx;
  if(!b.boxes || typeof b.boxes!=='object' || Array.isArray(b.boxes)) b.boxes = {};
  if(!b.seeded || typeof b.seeded!=='object' || Array.isArray(b.seeded)) b.seeded = {};
  if(typeof BX_SEED_FIT !== 'undefined' && BX_SEED_FIT && !b.seeded.fit){
    b.seeded.fit = true;                       // seeded once; deleting it later sticks
    if(!b.boxes.fit) b.boxes.fit = bxFitDef();
    saveDB();
  }
  return b;
}
function bxCfg(id, create){
  const b = bxDB();
  let c = b.boxes[id];
  if(!c && create){ c = b.boxes[id] = { id, custom:false, fields:[], labels:{}, hidden:{} }; }
  if(c){
    if(!Array.isArray(c.fields)) c.fields = [];
    if(!c.labels || typeof c.labels!=='object') c.labels = {};
    if(!c.hidden || typeof c.hidden!=='object') c.hidden = {};
  }
  return c || null;
}
function bxIsCore(id){ return CORE_PAGES.some(p=>p.id===id); }
function bxIsBox(id){ const c = bxCfg(id); return !!(c && c.custom); }
function bxIsDaily(id){ return bxIsCore(id) || bxIsBox(id); }
function bxCustomBoxes(){
  return Object.keys(bxDB().boxes).map(k=>bxDB().boxes[k]).filter(c=>c && c.custom)
    .sort((a,b)=>(a.order||0)-(b.order||0));
}
function bxNewId(prefix){ return prefix + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,5); }
function bxSlug(label){
  return String(label||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').slice(0,60) || 'field';
}
/* Fallback icon: initials of the first two words, connector words
   skipped. "Outfit Of The Day" -> "OT", "Morning Routine" -> "MR". */
function bxInitials(name){
  const SKIP = ['of','and','for','to','in','on','at','with','&'];
  const words = String(name||'').trim().split(/[^A-Za-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F]+/).filter(Boolean);
  if(!words.length) return '?';
  let sig = words.filter(w=>SKIP.indexOf(w.toLowerCase())===-1);
  if(!sig.length) sig = words;
  if(sig.length===1) return sig[0].slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
  return (sig[0].charAt(0)+sig[1].charAt(0)).toUpperCase();
}
function bxMono(txt, size, extra){
  const s = size || 20;
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${s}" height="${s}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" ${extra||''} aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="5.5"/><text x="12" y="15.7" text-anchor="middle" font-family="inherit" font-size="${String(txt).length>1?9.2:11}" font-weight="800" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">${esc(txt)}</text></svg>`;
}
function bxFieldIcon(f){ return f.icon || ('mono:'+bxInitials(f.label)); }
function bxBoxMeta(id){
  const c = bxCfg(id), core = CORE_PAGES.find(p=>p.id===id);
  const name = (c && c.name) || (core && core.name) || id;
  let ic = (c && c.icon) || (core && core.icon) || null;
  if(!ic) ic = 'mono:'+bxInitials(name);
  return { name, icon:ic };
}
function bxBoxName(id){ return bxBoxMeta(id).name; }

/* ---------- wrappers: hook the existing app without rewriting it ---------- */
(function bxHookApp(){
  const _icon = icon;
  icon = function(name, size, extra){
    if(typeof name==='string' && name.indexOf('mono:')===0) return bxMono(name.slice(5), size, extra);
    return _icon(name, size, extra);
  };

  const _renderTopbar = renderTopbar;
  renderTopbar = function(title, showBack){
    if((ROUTE.view==='page' || ROUTE.view==='lanelog') && ROUTE.pageId && bxIsDaily(ROUTE.pageId)){
      const c = bxCfg(ROUTE.pageId);
      if(c && c.name) title = esc(c.name);
    }
    return _renderTopbar(title, showBack);
  };

  const _pagesList = pagesList;
  pagesList = function(ds){
    bxDB();
    const out = [];
    _pagesList(ds).forEach(p=>{
      const c = bxCfg(p.id);
      if(c && c.hiddenFrom && ds >= c.hiddenFrom && !pageIsDone(ds,p.id)) return;
      out.push(c && (c.name||c.icon) ? Object.assign({}, p, { name:c.name||p.name, icon:c.icon||p.icon }) : p);
    });
    bxCustomBoxes().forEach(b=>{
      const active = ds >= (b.from||'0000') && !(b.until && ds >= b.until);
      if(!active && !pageIsDone(ds,b.id)) return;
      const m = bxBoxMeta(b.id);
      out.push({ id:b.id, name:m.name, icon:m.icon, cadence:'daily', custom:true, status:()=>'Tap to log' });
    });
    return out;
  };

  const _pageIconFor = pageIconFor;
  pageIconFor = function(id){ return bxIsDaily(id) ? bxBoxMeta(id).icon : _pageIconFor(id); };

  const _focusPageMeta = focusPageMeta;
  focusPageMeta = function(id){
    if(bxIsBox(id)){ const c = bxCfg(id); return (c.until ? null : { id, name:bxBoxMeta(id).name }); }
    const m = _focusPageMeta(id);
    if(m && bxIsCore(id)){ const c = bxCfg(id); if(c && c.name) return Object.assign({}, m, { name:c.name }); }
    return m;
  };

  const _doneSummary = doneSummary;
  doneSummary = function(ds, id){ return bxIsBox(id) ? bxSummary(ds,id) : _doneSummary(ds,id); };

  const _fieldWrap = fieldWrap;
  fieldWrap = function(label, hint, inner){
    const c = FWCTX;
    if(!c) return _fieldWrap(label, hint, inner);
    const base = bxSlug(label);
    c.seen[base] = (c.seen[base]||0) + 1;
    const key = c.seen[base] > 1 ? base+'-'+c.seen[base] : base;
    const cfg = bxCfg(c.boxId);
    const removedOn = cfg && cfg.hidden[key];
    const isRemoved = !!removedOn && c.date >= removedOn;
    const renamed = cfg && cfg.labels[key];
    const rawLabel = renamed ? renamed : String(label);
    if(!c.edit){
      if(isRemoved) return '';
      return _fieldWrap(renamed ? esc(renamed) : label, hint, inner);
    }
    if(isRemoved){
      return `<div class="bx-removed"><span class="nm">${renamed?esc(renamed):label}</span><span class="tg">Removed</span>
        <button class="bx-restore" onclick="bxRestoreBuiltin('${c.boxId}','${key}')">Restore</button></div>`;
    }
    BX_LBL[c.boxId+':'+key] = rawLabel.replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'');
    return `<div class="field-card bx-fc-edit">
      <div class="bx-fc-bar">
        <input class="textline" maxlength="70" value="${esc(rawLabel.replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''))}" aria-label="Field name"
          onchange="bxRenameBuiltin('${c.boxId}','${key}',this.value)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')this.blur()">
        <button class="bx-x" aria-label="Remove field" onclick="bxConfirmRemoveBuiltin('${c.boxId}','${key}')">${icon('trash',15)}</button>
      </div>
      <div class="bx-fc-inner">${hint?`<div class="fc-hint">${hint}</div>`:''}${inner}</div>
    </div>`;
  };

  const _renderPage = renderPage;
  renderPage = function(){
    const id = ROUTE.pageId;
    const custom = bxIsBox(id);
    const daily = !custom && bxIsCore(id) && id!=='lane';   // 'lane' picker has no fields to customise
    if(!custom && !daily) return _renderPage();
    if(custom){ bxRenderCustomPage(ROUTE.date); return; }
    const renderer = PAGE_RENDERERS[id];
    if(!renderer){ nav('home'); return; }
    FWCTX = { boxId:id, date:ROUTE.date, edit:BX_EDIT===id, seen:{} };
    try{ renderer(ROUTE.date); } finally { FWCTX = null; }
    bxDecorate(id, ROUTE.date);
  };

  if(typeof renderLaneLog === 'function'){
    const _renderLaneLog = renderLaneLog;
    renderLaneLog = function(ds){
      if(!DB.lane) return _renderLaneLog(ds);
      FWCTX = { boxId:'lane', date:ds, edit:BX_EDIT==='lane', seen:{} };
      try{ _renderLaneLog(ds); } finally { FWCTX = null; }
      bxDecorate('lane', ds);
    };
  }

  const _nav = nav;
  nav = function(view, pageId, opts){ BX_EDIT = null; return _nav(view, pageId, opts); };

  const _render = render;
  render = function(){
    if(DB.onboarded && (ROUTE.view==='boxes' || ROUTE.view==='widgets')){
      clearSideRail();
      if(ROUTE.view==='boxes') bxRenderManager(); else bxRenderWidgets();
      return;
    }
    _render();
  };

  const _renderTracker = renderTracker;
  renderTracker = function(){
    _renderTracker();
    try{
      const gap = app.querySelector('.gap-block');
      if(gap) gap.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', bxTrackerHtml());
    }catch(e){ console.error('bx tracker', e); }
  };

  const _renderSettings = renderSettings;
  renderSettings = function(){
    _renderSettings();
    const heads = Array.prototype.slice.call(app.querySelectorAll('.settings-heading'));
    const backup = heads.find(h=>h.textContent.trim()==='Backup');
    if(!backup || !backup.parentElement) return;
    const nBoxes = bxCustomBoxes().filter(b=>!b.until).length;
    backup.parentElement.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', `
      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">Customize</div>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('boxes')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Boxes &amp; fields</div><div class="sr-desc">${nBoxes} custom box${nBoxes===1?'':'es'} — rename, remove or add fields to any box</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('layers',16)}</div>
        </button>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('widgets')">
          <div><div class="sr-name">Widget Preview</div><div class="sr-desc">Mockup of home-screen widgets — native app only</div></div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon('widgets',16)}</div>
        </button>
      </div>`);
  };

  /* Test-data fill also fills custom boxes, so charts can be checked. */
  const _rfm = randomFillMonth;
  randomFillMonth = function(monthKey, opts){
    const n = _rfm(monthKey, opts);
    try{ bxFillCustom(monthKey || currentMonthKey()); }catch(e){ console.error('bx fill', e); }
    return n;
  };
})();

/* ---------- value helpers ---------- */
function bxNorm(type, raw){
  switch(type){
    case 'number': { if(raw===''||raw===null||raw===undefined||typeof raw==='boolean') return null; const n = typeof raw==='number' ? raw : parseFloat(raw); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
    case 'scale':  { const n = +raw; return n>0 ? n : null; }
    case 'toggle': return raw===true ? 1 : (raw===false ? 0 : null);
    case 'choice': return (typeof raw==='string' && raw) ? raw : null;
    case 'photo':  return (typeof raw==='string' && raw.indexOf('data:image')===0) ? raw : null;
    default:       return (typeof raw==='string' && raw.trim()) ? raw.trim() : null;
  }
}
function bxFieldIsShown(f, ds, pg){
  /* A removed field is offered on days BEFORE the removal date and not from it on.
     Its values are never touched, so older days still show them and the Tracker
     keeps charting them. */
  return !f.deleted || ds < f.deleted;
}
function bxDisplay(f, v){
  const n = bxNorm(f.type, v);
  if(n===null) return '';
  if(f.type==='number') return String(n) + (f.unit ? ' '+f.unit : '');
  if(f.type==='scale') return n+'/'+(f.max||5);
  if(f.type==='toggle') return n ? 'Yes' : 'No';
  if(f.type==='photo') return 'Photo';
  const s = String(n); return s.length>28 ? s.slice(0,27)+'…' : s;
}
function bxSummary(ds, id){
  const c = bxCfg(id); if(!c) return 'Logged';
  const pg = (DB.days[ds] && DB.days[ds].pages && DB.days[ds].pages[id]) || {};
  const live = c.fields.filter(f=>!f.deleted || bxNorm(f.type, pg['cf_'+f.id])!==null);
  if(!live.length) return 'Logged';
  const filled = live.filter(f=>bxNorm(f.type, pg['cf_'+f.id])!==null).length;
  return filled+' of '+live.length+' filled';
}

/* ---------- writing values ---------- */
function bxTrySave(){
  try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(DB)); return true; }catch(e){ return false; }
}
function bxSetNum(ds, box, fid, raw){
  const p = getPage(ds, box);
  const n = parseFloat(String(raw).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''));
  if(isFinite(n)) p['cf_'+fid] = n; else delete p['cf_'+fid];
  markTouched(ds, box);
}
function bxSetText(ds, box, fid, val){ getPage(ds, box)['cf_'+fid] = val; markTouched(ds, box); }
function bxSetScale(ds, box, fid, val){
  const p = getPage(ds, box); const k = 'cf_'+fid;
  p[k] = (p[k]===val) ? 0 : val;
  markTouched(ds, box); flashSaved(); render();
}
function bxToggle(ds, box, fid){
  const p = getPage(ds, box); const k = 'cf_'+fid;
  p[k] = !p[k];
  markTouched(ds, box); flashSaved(); render();
}
function bxSetChoice(ds, box, fid, idx){
  const c = bxCfg(box); const f = c && c.fields.find(x=>x.id===fid); if(!f) return;
  const opt = (f.options||[])[idx]; if(opt===undefined) return;
  const p = getPage(ds, box); const k = 'cf_'+fid;
  p[k] = (p[k]===opt) ? '' : opt;
  markTouched(ds, box); flashSaved(); render();
}
function bxClearPhoto(ds, box, fid){
  const p = getPage(ds, box); delete p['cf_'+fid];
  markTouched(ds, box); flashSaved('Photo removed'); render();
}

/* ---------- field rendering ---------- */
function bxInput(ds, box, f, v){
  const L = esc(f.label);
  switch(f.type){
    case 'number':
      return `<div class="bx-numrow"><input class="textline" inputmode="decimal" aria-label="${L}" placeholder="0"
        value="${esc(bxNorm('number',v)===null?'':v)}" oninput="bxSetNum('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}',this.value)">${f.unit?`<span class="counter-suffix">${esc(f.unit)}</span>`:''}</div>`;
    case 'short':
      return `<input class="textline" aria-label="${L}" placeholder="Type here" value="${esc(v)}" oninput="bxSetText('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}',this.value)">`;
    case 'long':
      return `<textarea class="freewrite" aria-label="${L}" placeholder="" oninput="bxSetText('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}',this.value)">${esc(v)}</textarea>`;
    case 'scale': {
      const max = f.max===10 ? 10 : 5, cur = +v || 0;
      let cells = '';
      for(let i=1;i<=max;i++){
        cells += `<div class="scale-dot ${cur>=i?'active red':''}" role="button" aria-label="${L} ${i}"
          ${max===10?'style="flex:1;height:30px;font-size:10.5px;"':''} onclick="bxSetScale('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}',${i})">${i}</div>`;
      }
      return `<div class="scale-row ${max===10?'bx-s10':''}" ${max===10?'style="gap:3px;"':''}>${cells}</div>`;
    }
    case 'toggle': {
      const on = v===true;
      return `<div class="check-row"><div class="checkbox ${on?'checked':''}" role="checkbox" aria-checked="${on}" aria-label="${L}" tabindex="0"
        onclick="bxToggle('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}')">${icon('check',14)}</div><div class="crow-text">${on?'Yes':'Not yet'}</div></div>`;
    }
    case 'choice': {
      const opts = Array.isArray(f.options) ? f.options : [];
      return `<div class="pill-row">${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="pill ${v===o?'active red':''}" onclick="bxSetChoice('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}',${i})">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
    }
    case 'photo': {
      const has = bxNorm('photo', v) !== null;
      const idc = `bxph-${box}-${f.id}-c`, idl = `bxph-${box}-${f.id}-l`;
      return `<div class="bx-photo-wrap">
        ${has ? `<img class="bx-photo" src="${v}" alt="${L}">` : ''}
        <div class="bx-photo-btns">
          <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('${idc}').click()">${icon('camera',14)} ${has?'Retake':'Take photo'}</button>
          <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('${idl}').click()">${icon('upload',14)} ${has?'Choose another':'Choose from library'}</button>
          ${has ? `<button type="button" onclick="bxClearPhoto('${ds}','${box}','${f.id}')">${icon('trash',14)} Remove</button>` : ''}
        </div>
        <input class="bx-file" id="${idc}" type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" onchange="bxPhotoPicked(this,'${ds}','${box}','${f.id}')">
        <input class="bx-file" id="${idl}" type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="bxPhotoPicked(this,'${ds}','${box}','${f.id}')">
      </div>`;
    }
  }
  return '';
}
function bxTypeLabel(f){
  const t = BX_FIELD_TYPES.find(x=>x.id===f.type);
  let s = t ? t.name : f.type;
  if(f.type==='scale') s += ' · 1 to '+(f.max===10?10:5);
  if(f.type==='choice') s += ' · '+((f.options||[]).length)+' options';
  if(f.type==='number' && f.unit) s += ' · '+f.unit;
  return s;
}
function bxFieldCard(ds, box, f){
  const pg = getPage(ds, box);
  return `<div class="field-card bx-cf"><div class="fc-label"><span class="bx-lab-ico">${icon(bxFieldIcon(f),15)}</span>${esc(f.label)}</div>${bxInput(ds, box, f, pg['cf_'+f.id])}</div>`;
}
function bxFieldEditCard(ds, box, f, i, n){
  const pg = getPage(ds, box);
  if(f.deleted && ds >= f.deleted){
    return `<div class="bx-removed"><span class="nm">${esc(f.label)}</span><span class="tg">Removed</span>
      <button class="bx-restore" onclick="bxRestoreField('${box}','${f.id}')">Restore</button></div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="field-card bx-cf bx-fc-edit">
    <div class="bx-fc-bar">
      <button class="bx-iconbtn" aria-label="Edit field: icon, type options" onclick="bxOpenFieldForm('${box}','${f.id}')">${icon(bxFieldIcon(f),20)}</button>
      <input class="textline" maxlength="70" value="${esc(f.label)}" aria-label="Field name" onchange="bxRenameField('${box}','${f.id}',this.value)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')this.blur()">
      <div class="bx-mini">
        <button aria-label="Move up" ${i===0?'disabled':''} onclick="bxMoveField('${box}','${f.id}',-1)">${icon('arrowup',15)}</button>
        <button aria-label="Move down" ${i===n-1?'disabled':''} onclick="bxMoveField('${box}','${f.id}',1)">${icon('arrowdown',15)}</button>
        <button aria-label="Remove field" onclick="bxConfirmRemoveField('${box}','${f.id}')">${icon('trash',15)}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="bx-type-tag">${esc(bxTypeLabel(f))} · tap the icon to edit</div>
    <div class="bx-fc-inner">${bxInput(ds, box, f, pg['cf_'+f.id])}</div>
  </div>`;
}
function bxFieldsHtml(ds, box, edit){
  const c = bxCfg(box); if(!c) return '';
  const pg = getPage(ds, box);
  const n = c.fields.length;
  return c.fields.map((f,i)=>{
    if(edit) return bxFieldEditCard(ds, box, f, i, n);
    return bxFieldIsShown(f, ds, pg) ? bxFieldCard(ds, box, f) : '';
  }).join('');
}

/* ---------- edit bar + footer (shared by built-in and custom boxes) ---------- */
function bxEditBar(id){
  if(BX_EDIT !== id){
    return `<div class="bx-bar"><button class="bx-chip" onclick="bxOpenEdit('${id}')">${icon('pen',13)} Customize</button></div>`;
  }
  const m = bxBoxMeta(id);
  return `<div class="bx-edit-banner">
    <div class="bx-eb-top"><div><b>Customizing this box</b><span>Rename, remove or add fields. Removing a field keeps every past entry.</span></div>
      <button class="bx-done" onclick="bxCloseEdit()">Done</button></div>
    <div class="bx-eb-name">
      <button class="bx-iconbtn" aria-label="Change box icon" onclick="bxOpenIconSheet('${id}')">${icon(m.icon,22)}</button>
      <input class="textline" maxlength="40" value="${esc(m.name)}" aria-label="Box name" onchange="bxRenameBox('${id}',this.value)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')this.blur()">
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function bxEditFooter(id){
  const custom = bxIsBox(id);
  return `<div class="bx-foot">
    <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="bxOpenToolbox('${id}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add a field</button>
    <button class="add-row-btn bx-danger" onclick="bxConfirmRemoveBox('${id}')">${icon('trash',14)} ${custom?'Remove this box':'Hide this box'}</button>
  </div>`;
}
function bxDecorate(id, ds){
  const body = app.querySelector('.page-body');
  if(!body) return;
  const edit = BX_EDIT === id;
  body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', bxEditBar(id));
  body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', bxFieldsHtml(ds, id, edit) + (edit ? bxEditFooter(id) : ''));
}
function bxRenderCustomPage(ds){
  const id = ROUTE.pageId;
  app.innerHTML = `${renderTopbar('', true)}<div class="page-body"></div>`;
  const body = app.querySelector('.page-body');
  const edit = BX_EDIT === id;
  const c = bxCfg(id);
  const pg = getPage(ds, id);
  const anyShown = c.fields.some(f=>bxFieldIsShown(f, ds, pg));
  body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', bxEditBar(id));
  if(c.until) body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="bx-removed"><span class="nm">This box is removed</span><span class="tg">Past entries kept</span><button class="bx-restore" onclick="bxRestoreBox('${id}')">Restore</button></div>`);
  if(!anyShown && !edit){
    body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="bx-empty">No fields in this box yet.<br>Add the first one — a number, a note, a scale, a photo.</div>
      <button class="add-row-btn" onclick="bxOpenToolbox('${id}')">${icon('plus',14)} Add a field</button>`);
    return;
  }
  body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', bxFieldsHtml(ds, id, edit) + (edit ? bxEditFooter(id) : ''));
}

/* Focus card on Home: custom boxes inline, plus custom fields on built-ins. */
function bxCtxBegin(id, ds){ FWCTX = bxIsCore(id) ? { boxId:id, date:ds, edit:false, seen:{} } : null; }
function bxFocusBody(id, ds, html){
  FWCTX = null;
  if(bxIsBox(id)) return bxFieldsHtml(ds, id, false) || '<div class="bx-empty" style="margin:0">No fields yet. Open the box to add some.</div>';
  return html + (bxIsCore(id) ? bxFieldsHtml(ds, id, false) : '');
}
/* ============================================================
   BOXES YOU CAN LINK TO AN HOUR
   The built-in pages plus any custom boxes you made. This list feeds every 'link an hour to a box' picker.
   ============================================================ */
function bxFocusPages(){
  const extra = bxCustomBoxes().filter(b=>!b.until).map(b=>({ id:b.id, name:bxBoxMeta(b.id).name }));
  const base = FOCUS_PAGES.map(f=>{ const c = bxCfg(f.id); return (c && c.name && bxIsCore(f.id)) ? Object.assign({}, f, { name:c.name }) : f; });
  return base.concat(extra);
}
function bxAddBoxRow(){
  return `<button class="bx-add-row" onclick="bxNewBoxSheet()">${icon('plus',15)} New box</button>`;
}

/* ---------- edit-mode actions ---------- */
const BX_LBL = {};   // "box:key" -> label text, filled while a built-in box renders in edit mode
function bxOpenEdit(id){ BX_EDIT = id; render(); }
function bxCloseEdit(){ BX_EDIT = null; render(); }
function bxOpenBoxEdit(id){
  if(id==='lane'){
    if(!DB.lane){ flashSaved('Pick one first, then customize it'); return; }
    nav('lanelog','lane');
  } else nav('page', id);
  BX_EDIT = id; render();
}
function bxConfirmSheet(title, body, btn, action){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>${esc(title)}</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="confirm-body">
      <p>${body}</p>
      <button class="confirm-danger-btn" onclick="${action}">${icon('trash',15)} ${esc(btn)}</button>
      <button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button>
    </div>`);
}

/* built-in fields: rename / remove / restore (data is never touched) */
function bxRenameBuiltin(box, key, val){
  const c = bxCfg(box, true), v = String(val||'').trim();
  if(v) c.labels[key] = v; else delete c.labels[key];
  saveDB(); flashSaved(v ? 'Renamed' : 'Name reset');
  if(!v) render();
}
function bxConfirmRemoveBuiltin(box, key){
  const nm = BX_LBL[box+':'+key] || 'this field';
  bxConfirmSheet('Remove “'+nm+'”?', 'It stops showing from today on. Everything you already logged in it is kept — nothing is deleted.', 'Remove field', `bxRemoveBuiltin('${box}','${key}')`);
}
function bxRemoveBuiltin(box, key){
  bxCfg(box, true).hidden[key] = todayStr();
  saveDB(); closeSheet(); render(); flashSaved('Field removed');
}
function bxRestoreBuiltin(box, key){
  const c = bxCfg(box); if(c) delete c.hidden[key];
  saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Field restored');
}

/* custom fields */
function bxFindField(box, fid){ const c = bxCfg(box); return c ? c.fields.find(f=>f.id===fid) : null; }
function bxRenameField(box, fid, val){
  const f = bxFindField(box, fid); if(!f) return;
  const v = String(val||'').trim();
  if(!v){ render(); return; }
  f.label = v; saveDB(); flashSaved('Renamed');
}
function bxMoveField(box, fid, dir){
  const c = bxCfg(box); if(!c) return;
  const i = c.fields.findIndex(f=>f.id===fid), j = i+dir;
  if(i<0 || j<0 || j>=c.fields.length) return;
  const t = c.fields[i]; c.fields[i] = c.fields[j]; c.fields[j] = t;
  saveDB(); render();
}
function bxConfirmRemoveField(box, fid){
  const f = bxFindField(box, fid); if(!f) return;
  bxConfirmSheet('Remove “'+f.label+'”?', 'It stops showing from today on. Everything you already logged in it is kept, and it stays in your Tracker.', 'Remove field', `bxRemoveField('${box}','${fid}')`);
}
function bxRemoveField(box, fid){
  const f = bxFindField(box, fid); if(!f) return;
  f.deleted = todayStr(); saveDB(); closeSheet(); render(); flashSaved('Field removed');
}
function bxRestoreField(box, fid){
  const f = bxFindField(box, fid); if(!f) return;
  f.deleted = null; saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Field restored');
}

/* boxes */
function bxRenameBox(id, val){
  const c = bxCfg(id, true), v = String(val||'').trim();
  if(!v){ if(c.custom){ render(); return; } delete c.name; }
  else c.name = v;
  saveDB(); flashSaved('Renamed'); render();
}
function bxConfirmRemoveBox(id){
  const custom = bxIsBox(id), nm = bxBoxName(id);
  bxConfirmSheet((custom?'Remove “':'Hide “')+nm+'”?',
    custom ? 'It disappears from your daily boxes from today on. Past entries are kept and stay in your Tracker. You can bring it back from Boxes &amp; fields.'
           : 'It disappears from your daily boxes from today on. Past entries are kept. You can bring it back from Boxes &amp; fields.',
    custom ? 'Remove box' : 'Hide box', `bxRemoveBox('${id}')`);
}
function bxRemoveBox(id){
  if(bxIsBox(id)) bxCfg(id).until = todayStr(); else bxCfg(id, true).hiddenFrom = todayStr();
  BX_EDIT = null; saveDB(); closeSheet();
  flashSaved(bxIsBox(id) ? 'Box removed' : 'Box hidden');
  nav('home');
}
function bxRestoreBox(id){
  const c = bxCfg(id); if(!c) return;
  if(c.custom) c.until = null; else delete c.hiddenFrom;
  saveDB(); flashSaved('Box restored'); render();
}

/* ---------- toolbox ---------- */
function bxOpenToolbox(box){
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Add a field</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="bx-type-grid">${BX_FIELD_TYPES.map(t=>`
      <button class="bx-type" onclick="bxPickType('${box}','${t.id}')">
        <span class="ti">${icon(t.icon,20)}</span>
        <span><div class="tn">${esc(t.name)}</div><div class="td">${esc(t.desc)}</div></span>
      </button>`).join('')}</div>`);
}
function bxPickType(box, type){ BX_FORM = { mode:'field', box, fid:null, type, icon:null, max:5 }; bxShowFieldForm(null); }
function bxOpenFieldForm(box, fid){
  const f = bxFindField(box, fid); if(!f) return;
  BX_FORM = { mode:'field', box, fid, type:f.type, icon:f.icon||null, max:f.max===10?10:5 };
  bxShowFieldForm(f);
}
function bxIconPickerHtml(){
  const cur = BX_FORM.icon;
  const items = BX_ICON_CHOICES.map(n=>`<button type="button" class="bx-iconbtn ${cur===n?'sel':''}" data-ic="${n}" aria-label="${n}" onclick="bxPickIcon('${n}')">${icon(n,20)}</button>`).join('');
  return `<div class="bx-icon-row">
      <button type="button" class="bx-iconbtn" id="bx-f-iconbtn" aria-label="Choose icon" onclick="bxToggleIconGrid()"></button>
      <div class="txt" id="bx-f-icontxt"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bx-icon-grid" id="bx-f-icongrid" hidden>
      <button type="button" class="bx-iconbtn ${cur?'':'sel'}" data-ic="" aria-label="Automatic icon" onclick="bxPickIcon('')" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;">Auto</button>
      ${items}
    </div>`;
}
function bxFormName(){ const el = document.getElementById('bx-f-label'); return el ? el.value : ''; }
function bxRefreshIconPreview(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('bx-f-iconbtn'); if(!btn) return;
  const auto = 'mono:'+bxInitials(bxFormName() || '?');
  btn.innerHTML = icon(BX_FORM.icon || auto, 22);
  const t = document.getElementById('bx-f-icontxt');
  if(t) t.textContent = BX_FORM.icon ? 'Your pick. Tap to change it.' : 'Automatic — made from the name’s initials. Tap to choose another.';
  document.querySelectorAll('#bx-f-icongrid [data-ic]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel', (b.getAttribute('data-ic')||null)===BX_FORM.icon));
}
function bxToggleIconGrid(){ const g = document.getElementById('bx-f-icongrid'); if(g) g.hidden = !g.hidden; }
function bxPickIcon(name){
  BX_FORM.icon = name || null; bxRefreshIconPreview();
  const g = document.getElementById('bx-f-icongrid'); if(g) g.hidden = true;
}
function bxSetScaleMax(n){
  BX_FORM.max = n;
  document.querySelectorAll('#bx-f-seg button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on', +b.getAttribute('data-n')===n));
}
function bxFormErr(t){ const e = document.getElementById('bx-f-err'); if(e) e.textContent = t; }
function bxShowFieldForm(f){
  const F = BX_FORM, t = BX_FIELD_TYPES.find(x=>x.id===F.type);
  let extra = '';
  if(F.type==='scale'){
    extra = `<label class="bx-l">Range</label><div class="bx-seg" id="bx-f-seg">
      <button type="button" data-n="5" class="${F.max===5?'on':''}" onclick="bxSetScaleMax(5)">1 to 5</button>
      <button type="button" data-n="10" class="${F.max===10?'on':''}" onclick="bxSetScaleMax(10)">1 to 10</button></div>`;
  } else if(F.type==='choice'){
    extra = `<label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-opts">Options — one per line</label>
      <textarea id="bx-f-opts" class="freewrite" placeholder="Low&#10;Medium&#10;High">${esc(f && f.options ? f.options.join('\n') : '')}</textarea>`;
  } else if(F.type==='number'){
    extra = `<label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-unit">Unit (optional)</label>
      <input id="bx-f-unit" class="textline" maxlength="12" placeholder="e.g. km, cups, min" value="${esc(f && f.unit ? f.unit : '')}">`;
  }
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>${f?'Edit field':'New field · '+esc(t.name)}</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="bx-form">
      <label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-label">Name</label>
      <input id="bx-f-label" class="textline" maxlength="70" placeholder="What are you tracking?" value="${esc(f?f.label:'')}"
        oninput="bxRefreshIconPreview()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();bxSaveField();}">
      <label class="bx-l">Icon</label>
      ${bxIconPickerHtml()}
      ${extra}
      <div class="bx-err" id="bx-f-err" role="alert"></div>
      <div class="bx-actions"><button class="sec" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button><button class="pri" onclick="bxSaveField()">${f?'Save':'Add field'}</button></div>
    </div>`);
  bxRefreshIconPreview();
}
function bxParseOptions(raw){
  const seen = {}, out = [];
  String(raw||'').split(/[\n,]+/).forEach(s=>{
    const v = s.trim().slice(0,30);
    if(v && !seen[v.toLowerCase()]){ seen[v.toLowerCase()] = 1; out.push(v); }
  });
  return out.slice(0,8);
}
function bxSaveField(){
  const F = BX_FORM; if(!F || F.mode!=='field') return;
  const label = bxFormName().trim();
  if(!label){ bxFormErr('Give the field a name.'); return; }
  let options = null;
  if(F.type==='choice'){
    options = bxParseOptions((document.getElementById('bx-f-opts')||{}).value);
    if(options.length < 2){ bxFormErr('Add at least two options, one per line.'); return; }
  }
  const unitEl = document.getElementById('bx-f-unit');
  const unit = unitEl ? unitEl.value.trim().slice(0,12) : '';
  const c = bxCfg(F.box, true);
  if(F.fid){
    const f = bxFindField(F.box, F.fid); if(!f) return;
    f.label = label; f.icon = F.icon || null;
    if(F.type==='scale') f.max = F.max;
    if(F.type==='choice') f.options = options;
    if(F.type==='number') f.unit = unit;
  } else {
    const f = { id:bxNewId('f'), label, type:F.type, icon:F.icon||null, created:todayStr(), deleted:null };
    if(F.type==='scale') f.max = F.max;
    if(F.type==='choice') f.options = options;
    if(F.type==='number') f.unit = unit;
    c.fields.push(f);
  }
  saveDB(); closeSheet(); render(); flashSaved(F.fid ? 'Field saved' : 'Field added');
}

/* ---------- box icon sheet + new box ---------- */
function bxOpenIconSheet(id){
  const c = bxCfg(id), cur = (c && c.icon) || null, custom = bxIsBox(id);
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>Box icon</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="bx-icon-grid">
      <button type="button" class="bx-iconbtn ${cur?'':'sel'}" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;" onclick="bxApplyBoxIcon('${id}','')">${custom?'Auto':'Default'}</button>
      ${BX_ICON_CHOICES.map(n=>`<button type="button" class="bx-iconbtn ${cur===n?'sel':''}" aria-label="${n}" onclick="bxApplyBoxIcon('${id}','${n}')">${icon(n,20)}</button>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <p class="bx-note" style="margin-top:12px">${custom?'Auto uses the initials of the box name.':'Default restores this box’s original icon.'}</p>`);
}
function bxApplyBoxIcon(id, name){
  const c = bxCfg(id, true);
  if(name) c.icon = name; else delete c.icon;
  if(!name && c.custom) c.icon = null;
  saveDB(); closeSheet(); render(); flashSaved('Icon updated');
}
function bxNewBoxSheet(){
  BX_FORM = { mode:'box', icon:null };
  openSheet(`
    <div class="sheet-title"><span>New box</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">${icon('close',15)}</button></div>
    <div class="bx-form">
      <label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-label">Name</label>
      <input id="bx-f-label" class="textline" maxlength="40" placeholder="e.g. Skin check" oninput="bxRefreshIconPreview()"
        onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();bxCreateBox();}">
      <label class="bx-l">Icon</label>
      ${bxIconPickerHtml()}
      <div class="bx-err" id="bx-f-err" role="alert"></div>
      <div class="bx-actions"><button class="sec" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button><button class="pri" onclick="bxCreateBox()">Create box</button></div>
    </div>`);
  bxRefreshIconPreview();
}
function bxCreateBox(){
  const name = bxFormName().trim();
  if(!name){ bxFormErr('Give the box a name.'); return; }
  const b = bxDB();
  const order = Math.max(1, ...bxCustomBoxes().map(x=>x.order||0)) + 1;
  const id = bxNewId('cx_');
  b.boxes[id] = { id, custom:true, name, icon:(BX_FORM && BX_FORM.icon) || null, from:todayStr(), until:null, order, fields:[], labels:{}, hidden:{} };
  saveDB(); closeSheet();
  nav('page', id); BX_EDIT = id; render();
  flashSaved('Box created');
}

/* ---------- photo: compress before storing ---------- */
function bxCompress(file){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file), img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){
      try{
        const SIZES = [1024, 800, 640, 512], QUAL = [0.72, 0.62, 0.52, 0.42];
        let out = null;
        for(let i=0;i<SIZES.length;i++){
          const sc = Math.min(1, SIZES[i] / Math.max(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight));
          const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalWidth*sc)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalHeight*sc));
          const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
          const cx = cv.getContext('2d'); cx.fillStyle = '#fff'; cx.fillRect(0,0,w,h); cx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
          out = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', QUAL[i]);
          if(out.length <= BX_PHOTO_MAX_CHARS) break;
        }
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve(out);
      }catch(e){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(e); }
    };
    img.onerror = function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); reject(new Error('decode')); };
    img.src = url;
  });
}
function bxPhotoPicked(input, ds, box, fid){
  const file = input.files && input.files[0];
  input.value = '';
  if(!file) return;
  flashSaved('Compressing photo…');
  bxCompress(file).then(function(uri){
    const p = getPage(ds, box), k = 'cf_'+fid, prev = p[k];
    p[k] = uri;
    if(!bxTrySave()){
      if(prev===undefined) delete p[k]; else p[k] = prev;
      flashSaved('Storage is full — photo not saved');
      return;
    }
    markTouched(ds, box); flashSaved('Photo saved'); render();
  }).catch(function(){ flashSaved('Couldn’t read that photo'); });
}

/* ---------- Boxes & fields (manager screen) ---------- */
function bxStorageInfo(){
  let chars = 0;
  try{ chars = JSON.stringify(DB).length; }catch(e){}
  const mb = chars * 2 / 1048576;               // localStorage counts UTF-16 units
  return { mb, pct: Math.min(100, Math.round(mb / 5 * 100)) };
}
function bxRenderManager(){
  const today = todayStr();
  const core = CORE_PAGES.map(p=>{
    const c = bxCfg(p.id), m = bxBoxMeta(p.id);
    const off = !!(c && c.hiddenFrom && today >= c.hiddenFrom);
    const nCustom = c ? c.fields.filter(f=>!f.deleted).length : 0;
    const nGone = c ? Object.keys(c.hidden).length + c.fields.filter(f=>f.deleted).length : 0;
    const bits = [];
    if(nCustom) bits.push(nCustom+' added field'+(nCustom===1?'':'s'));
    if(nGone) bits.push(nGone+' removed');
    if(c && c.name) bits.push('renamed');
    return `<div class="bx-mrow ${off?'off':''}">
      <span class="mi">${icon(m.icon,22)}</span>
      <button class="mt" onclick="bxOpenBoxEdit('${p.id}')"><div class="mn">${esc(m.name)}</div><div class="md">${off?'Hidden · ':''}${bits.length?esc(bits.join(' · ')):'Built-in · tap to customize'}</div></button>
      <button class="bx-x" aria-label="${off?'Show':'Hide'} ${esc(m.name)}" onclick="${off?`bxRestoreBox('${p.id}')`:`bxConfirmRemoveBox('${p.id}')`}">${icon(off?'eye':'eyeoff',15)}</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  const customs = bxCustomBoxes();
  const live = customs.filter(b=>!b.until), gone = customs.filter(b=>b.until);
  const crow = b=>{
    const m = bxBoxMeta(b.id), n = b.fields.filter(f=>!f.deleted).length;
    return `<div class="bx-mrow ${b.until?'off':''}">
      <span class="mi">${icon(m.icon,22)}</span>
      <button class="mt" onclick="bxOpenBoxEdit('${b.id}')"><div class="mn">${esc(m.name)}</div><div class="md">${b.until?'Removed · past entries kept':n+' field'+(n===1?'':'s')+' · tap to customize'}</div></button>
      ${b.until ? `<button class="bx-restore" onclick="bxRestoreBox('${b.id}')">Restore</button>`
                : `<button class="bx-x" aria-label="Remove ${esc(m.name)}" onclick="bxConfirmRemoveBox('${b.id}')">${icon('trash',15)}</button>`}
    </div>`;
  };
  const st = bxStorageInfo();
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Boxes & fields', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      <p class="bx-note">Every box on your day can be changed. Rename a field, remove one, or add your own. Removing never deletes anything you already logged.</p>
      <button class="add-row-btn" style="margin-bottom:18px" onclick="bxNewBoxSheet()">${icon('plus',14)} New box</button>
      <div class="settings-section"><div class="settings-heading">Your boxes</div>
        ${live.length ? live.map(crow).join('') : '<p class="bx-note">None yet. Make one with “New box”.</p>'}</div>
      <div class="settings-section"><div class="settings-heading">Built-in boxes</div>${core}</div>
      ${gone.length ? `<div class="settings-section"><div class="settings-heading">Removed boxes</div>${gone.map(crow).join('')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="settings-section"><div class="settings-heading">Storage</div>
        <div class="bx-meter" role="img" aria-label="${st.pct}% of browser storage used"><i style="width:${Math.max(2,st.pct)}%"></i></div>
        <p class="bx-note">About ${st.mb.toFixed(1)} MB of roughly 5 MB used. Photos are shrunk before saving, but a daily photo adds up — download a backup now and then.${st.pct>=70?' <b>Getting full.</b>':''}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   TRACKER — generic metric layer.
   Nothing here looks a field up by name. A metric exists because
   (a) it is in the registry, or (b) a cf_* key is sitting in the
   day data. (b) means even a field whose registry entry is gone
   (old backup, removed box) still shows up. Removed fields keep
   charting their history.
   ============================================================ */
function bxYearDates(yk){
  let out = [];
  for(let m=1;m<=12;m++) out = out.concat(datesInMonth(yk+'-'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')));
  return out;
}
function bxPretty(k){
  const s = String(k).replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g,'$1 $2').replace(/[_.\-]+/g,' ').trim();
  return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
}
function bxInferType(raw){
  if(typeof raw==='boolean') return 'toggle';
  if(typeof raw==='number') return 'number';
  if(typeof raw==='string' && raw.indexOf('data:image')===0) return 'photo';
  return 'short';
}
function bxCollect(dates){
  const metas = {};
  Object.keys(bxDB().boxes).forEach(bid=>{
    const b = bxDB().boxes[bid];
    (b.fields||[]).forEach(f=>{
      metas[bid+'|'+f.id] = { key:bid+'|'+f.id, box:bid, fid:f.id, type:f.type, label:f.label, max:f.max===10?10:5,
        options:f.options||[], unit:f.unit||'', gone:!!(f.deleted || (b.custom && b.until)), registered:true };
    });
  });
  const pts = {};
  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    const d = DB.days[ds]; if(!d || !d.pages) return;
    Object.keys(d.pages).forEach(pid=>{
      const pg = d.pages[pid]; if(!pg || typeof pg!=='object') return;
      Object.keys(pg).forEach(k=>{
        if(k.indexOf('cf_')!==0) return;
        const fid = k.slice(3), key = pid+'|'+fid;
        if(!metas[key]) metas[key] = { key, box:pid, fid, type:bxInferType(pg[k]), label:bxPretty(fid), max:5, options:[], unit:'', gone:true, registered:false };
        const v = bxNorm(metas[key].type, pg[k]);
        if(v===null) return;
        (pts[key] = pts[key] || []).push({ date:ds, v });
      });
    });
  });
  return { metas, pts };
}
function bxDiscoverNumeric(dates){
  const found = {};
  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    const d = DB.days[ds]; if(!d || !d.pages) return;
    Object.keys(d.pages).forEach(pid=>{
      const pg = d.pages[pid]; if(!pg || typeof pg!=='object') return;
      Object.keys(pg).forEach(k=>{
        if(k.charAt(0)==='_' || k.indexOf('cf_')===0) return;
        const raw = pg[k]; let n = null;
        if(typeof raw==='number' && isFinite(raw)) n = raw;
        else if(typeof raw==='string' && /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(raw.trim())) n = parseFloat(raw);
        if(n===null) return;
        const key = pid+'|'+k;
        (found[key] = found[key] || { key, label:bxBoxName(pid)+' · '+bxPretty(k), pts:[] }).pts.push({ date:ds, value:n });
      });
    });
  });
  return found;
}
function bxFmtNum(n){ return Number.isInteger(n) ? fmtCompact(n) : String(+n.toFixed(1)); }

function bxMetricCard(m, list, c){
  const color = 'var(--ch'+((c.idx%6)+1)+')';
  const heat = (points, fmt, label, empty)=> c.period==='year'
    ? renderYearHeatmap(points, { yearKey:c.yk, color, fmt, label, emptyText:empty })
    : renderDayHeatmap(points, { monthKey:c.mk, color, fmt, label, emptyText:empty });
  const n = list.length, span = c.period==='year' ? 'this year' : 'this month';
  const logged = { v:n, l:'Days logged' };
  const sub = (m.gone ? 'Removed field · history kept. ' : '') + 'From ' + bxBoxName(m.box) + '.';
  const pctNote = c.elapsed ? ` Logged on <b>${n}</b> of ${c.elapsed} day${c.elapsed===1?'':'s'} ${span}.` : '';
  const best = arr => arr.reduce((a,b)=> b.v>a.v ? b : a);
  let o = { title:m.label, sub, stats:[logged], body:'', note:pctNote };
  const asPts = f => list.map(p=>({ date:p.date, value:f(p) }));
  switch(m.type){
    case 'number': {
      const tot = list.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.v,0), b = best(list), u = m.unit ? ' '+m.unit : '';
      o.unit = m.unit || 'per day';
      o.stats = [ { v:bxFmtNum(tot), l:'Total' }, { v:bxFmtNum(tot/n), l:'Avg per day logged' }, { v:bxFmtNum(b.v), l:'Best · '+fmtDateShort(b.date) } ];
      o.body = heat(asPts(p=>p.v), v=>bxFmtNum(v)+u, m.label, 'Nothing logged yet.');
      break; }
    case 'scale': {
      const avg = list.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.v,0)/n, mx = m.max;
      o.unit = 'out of '+mx;
      o.stats = [ { v:avg.toFixed(1)+'/'+mx, l:'Average' }, logged, { v:best(list).v+'/'+mx, l:'Best · '+fmtDateShort(best(list).date) } ];
      o.body = c.period==='year'
        ? heat(asPts(p=>p.v), v=>v+'/'+mx, m.label, 'Nothing logged yet.')
        : renderDaySeriesChart(asPts(p=>p.v), { monthKey:c.mk, type:'line', yFrom0:true, yMax:mx, tickCount:5, color, fmt:v=>v+'/'+mx, label:m.label, emptyText:'Nothing logged yet.' });
      break; }
    case 'toggle': {
      const yes = list.filter(p=>p.v===1);
      o.unit = 'yes / no';
      o.stats = [ { v:yes.length, l:'Days checked' }, logged, { v:n?Math.round(yes.length/n*100)+'%':'—', l:'Of days logged' } ];
      o.body = heat(yes.map(p=>({ date:p.date, value:1 })), ()=>'Checked', m.label, 'Never checked '+span+'.');
      break; }
    case 'choice': {
      const cnt = {}; list.forEach(p=>{ cnt[p.v] = (cnt[p.v]||0)+1; });
      const order = (m.options||[]).concat(Object.keys(cnt).filter(k=>(m.options||[]).indexOf(k)===-1));
      const entries = order.filter(k=>cnt[k]).map((k,i)=>({ label:k, count:cnt[k], color:'var(--ch'+((i%6)+1)+')' }));
      const top = entries.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count)[0];
      o.unit = 'picks';
      o.stats = [ logged, { v:top?top.label:'—', l:'Most picked' } ];
      o.body = renderBarBreakdown(entries, { hidePct:false });
      break; }
    case 'photo': {
      const recent = list.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).slice(0, c.period==='year'?8:12);
      o.unit = 'photos';
      o.stats = [ { v:n, l:'Photos' } ];
      o.body = `<div class="bx-gallery">${recent.map(p=>`<button aria-label="Open ${fmtDateShort(p.date)}" onclick="selectDate('${p.date}');nav('page','${m.box}')"><img src="${p.v}" alt=""><span>${esc(fmtDateShort(p.date))}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>` +
        `<div style="height:10px"></div>` + heat(asPts(()=>1), ()=>'Photo', m.label, 'No photos yet.');
      o.note = `Newest first. Tap a photo to open that day.` + pctNote;
      break; }
    default: {
      o.unit = 'days written';
      o.stats = [ { v:n, l:'Days written' }, { v:c.elapsed?Math.round(n/c.elapsed*100)+'%':'—', l:'Of days '+(c.period==='year'?'so far':'elapsed') } ];
      o.body = heat(asPts(()=>1), ()=>'Written', m.label, 'Nothing written yet.');
    }
  }
  return chartCard(o);
}

function bxSetExplore(v){ BX_EXPLORE = v; render(); }
function bxTrackerHtml(){
  const period = (typeof TRACKER_PERIOD!=='undefined' && TRACKER_PERIOD==='year') ? 'year' : 'month';
  const mk = SUMMARY_MONTH || currentMonthKey(), yk = SUMMARY_YEAR || currentYearKey();
  const dates = period==='year' ? bxYearDates(yk) : datesInMonth(mk);
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const elapsed = dates.filter(d=>d<=todayDs).length;
  const { metas, pts } = bxCollect(dates);
  const byBox = {};
  Object.keys(metas).forEach(k=>{ (byBox[metas[k].box] = byBox[metas[k].box] || []).push(metas[k]); });
  const customOrder = bxCustomBoxes().map(b=>b.id);
  const boxIds = Object.keys(byBox).sort((a,b)=>{
    const ia = customOrder.indexOf(a), ib = customOrder.indexOf(b);
    return (ia<0?999:ia) - (ib<0?999:ib);
  });
  let idx = 0, html = '';
  boxIds.forEach(bid=>{
    const list = byBox[bid];
    const withData = list.filter(m=>pts[m.key] && pts[m.key].length);
    const active = list.filter(m=>!m.gone);
    if(!withData.length && !active.length) return;
    const ctx = { period, mk, yk, elapsed };
    html += `<div class="section-label">${esc(bxBoxName(bid))} <span class="sub">${withData.length} field${withData.length===1?'':'s'} with entries</span></div>`;
    if(!withData.length){
      html += chartCard({ title:bxBoxName(bid), sub:'Fields: '+active.map(m=>m.label).join(', '), body:chartEmpty('Nothing logged in this box '+(period==='year'?'this year':'this month')+' yet.') });
      return;
    }
    withData.forEach(m=>{ html += bxMetricCard(m, pts[m.key], Object.assign({ idx:idx++ }, ctx)); });
  });
  /* Explore: any numeric field that actually has data, found by scanning — no names assumed. */
  const disc = bxDiscoverNumeric(dates);
  const dkeys = Object.keys(disc).sort((a,b)=>disc[a].label.localeCompare(disc[b].label));
  let explore = '';
  if(dkeys.length){
    const sel = disc[BX_EXPLORE];
    const opts = `<option value="">Choose a field…</option>` + dkeys.map(k=>`<option value="${esc(k)}" ${k===BX_EXPLORE?'selected':''}>${esc(disc[k].label)}</option>`).join('');
    let body = chartEmpty('Pick any numeric field you have logged to chart it here.'), stats = [];
    if(sel){
      const vals = sel.pts.map(p=>p.value), tot = vals.reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0), mx = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
      stats = [ { v:sel.pts.length, l:'Days logged' }, { v:bxFmtNum(tot/vals.length), l:'Average' }, { v:bxFmtNum(mx), l:'Highest' } ];
      body = period==='year'
        ? renderYearHeatmap(sel.pts, { yearKey:yk, color:'var(--ch5)', fmt:v=>bxFmtNum(v), label:sel.label })
        : renderDayHeatmap(sel.pts, { monthKey:mk, color:'var(--ch5)', fmt:v=>bxFmtNum(v), label:sel.label });
    }
    explore = `<div class="section-label">Explore any field <span class="sub">${dkeys.length} numeric</span></div>` +
      chartCard({ title:sel?sel.label:'Any field', sub:'Reads whatever numbers exist in your entries.', stats, body:`<select class="bx-select" aria-label="Field to chart" onchange="bxSetExplore(this.value)">${opts}</select>${body}` });
  }
  if(!html && !explore) return '';
  return `<div class="bx-track"><div class="section-label" style="padding-top:26px">Your boxes <span class="sub">fields you added or built</span></div>${html || '<div class="empty-note" style="padding:20px">No custom fields yet. Add one from any box with Customize.</div>'}${explore}</div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   WIDGET PREVIEW — mockup only. Nothing here is a real widget.
   ============================================================ */
function bxPinned(){
  const now = nowForApp();
  const blocks = normalizeTimetableBlocks();
  const slot = blocks[currentTimetableSlotIndex(now)];
  const time = slot ? slot.time : null;
  const timeLabel = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{ hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
  const id = time ? getSlotMapping(time) : null;
  const meta = id ? focusPageMeta(id) : null;
  if(!id || !meta || (id==='lane' && !DB.lane)){
    return { timeLabel, quote: time ? idleQuoteFor(time, todayStr()) : IDLE_QUOTES[0] };
  }
  return { timeLabel, id, meta };
}
function bxDayCounts(){
  const t = todayStr(), pl = pagesList(t);
  return { done: pl.filter(p=>pageIsDone(t,p.id)).length, total: pl.length };
}
function bxRing(done, total){
  const R = 21, C = 2*Math.PI*R, off = C*(1 - (total ? done/total : 0));
  return `<div class="bx-wring" role="img" aria-label="${done} of ${total} boxes done today"><svg viewBox="0 0 54 54"><circle class="t" cx="27" cy="27" r="${R}"/><circle class="f" cx="27" cy="27" r="${R}" stroke-dasharray="${C}" stroke-dashoffset="${off}"/></svg><b>${done}/${total}</b></div>`;
}
function bxLogWidget(size){
  const p = bxPinned(), k = bxDayCounts(), t = todayStr();
  const cls = size==='s' ? 'bx-w-s' : 'bx-w-m';
  if(!p.id){
    if(size==='s') return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}"><div class="wl">${esc(p.timeLabel)}</div><div class="wq">“${esc(p.quote)}”</div><div class="ws">${k.done} of ${k.total} done</div></div>`;
    return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l"><div class="wl">${esc(p.timeLabel)} · nothing pinned</div><div class="wq">“${esc(p.quote)}”</div><div class="ws">Idle hour, same line as the app.</div></div><div class="r">${bxRing(k.done,k.total)}</div></div></div>`;
  }
  const m = bxBoxMeta(p.id), done = pageIsDone(t, p.id);
  const status = done ? doneSummary(t, p.id) : 'Not logged yet';
  let kv = '';
  if(size==='m' && bxIsBox(p.id)){
    const c = bxCfg(p.id), pg = (DB.days[t] && DB.days[t].pages[p.id]) || {};
    kv = c.fields.filter(f=>!f.deleted).slice(0,2).map(f=>`<div class="wkv"><span>${esc(f.label)}</span><span>${esc(bxDisplay(f, pg['cf_'+f.id]) || '—')}</span></div>`).join('');
  }
  const head = `<div class="wh"><span class="wi">${icon(m.icon,17)}</span><div class="wn">${esc(m.name)}</div></div>`;
  if(size==='s') return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}">${head}<div><div class="ws">${esc(status)}</div><div class="wl" style="margin-top:4px">Pinned · ${esc(p.timeLabel)}</div></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l">${head}<div><div class="ws">${esc(status)}</div>${kv}</div><div class="wl">Pinned · ${esc(p.timeLabel)}</div></div><div class="r">${bxRing(k.done,k.total)}</div></div></div>`;
}
function bxPeriodStats(){
  const t = todayStr();
  if(BX_WPERIOD==='year'){
    const yk = currentYearKey(), months = [];
    let logged = 0, elapsed = 0;
    for(let m=1;m<=12;m++){
      const ds = datesInMonth(yk+'-'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')).filter(d=>d<=t);
      const n = ds.filter(d=>dayHasAny(d)).length;
      logged += n; elapsed += ds.length; months.push(n);
    }
    const mx = Math.max(1, ...months);
    return { label:yk, logged, elapsed, bars:months.map(n=>({ on:n>0, h:Math.max(8, Math.round(n/mx*100)) })) };
  }
  const mk = currentMonthKey(), all = datesInMonth(mk), ds = all.filter(d=>d<=t);
  return { label:monthLabelShort(mk), logged:ds.filter(d=>dayHasAny(d)).length, elapsed:ds.length,
    bars:all.map(d=>({ on:d<=t && dayHasAny(d), h:100 })) };
}
function bxDataWidget(size){
  const s = bxPeriodStats(), pct = s.elapsed ? Math.round(s.logged/s.elapsed*100) : 0;
  const cls = size==='s' ? 'bx-w-s' : 'bx-w-m';
  const unit = BX_WPERIOD==='year' ? 'year' : 'month';
  if(size==='s') return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}"><div class="wl">${esc(s.label)}</div><div><div class="wbig">${pct}<small>%</small></div><div class="ws">${s.logged} of ${s.elapsed} ${s.elapsed===1?'day':'days'} logged</div></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="bx-widget ${cls}"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l"><div class="wl">${esc(s.label)} · this ${unit}</div>
    <div><div class="wbig">${s.logged}<small>/${s.elapsed} ${s.elapsed===1?'day':'days'}</small></div></div>
    <div class="bx-wheat" aria-hidden="true">${s.bars.map(b=>`<i class="${b.on?'on':''}" style="height:${b.h}%"></i>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <div class="r"><div class="wbig" style="font-size:26px">${DB.streak}</div><div class="wl">streak</div></div></div></div>`;
}
function bxSetWPeriod(p){ BX_WPERIOD = p; render(); }
function bxRenderWidgets(){
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Widget Preview', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      <div class="bx-wnote" role="note">${icon('info',18)}<span>Preview — home screen widgets require the native app.</span></div>
      <p class="bx-note">These are mockups of the two widget sizes, drawn from your real data. They can’t be added to a home screen from here.</p>
      <div class="bx-wsec">
        <h3>Log widget</h3>
        <p class="sub">Mirrors the box pinned to the current hour in your timetable. With nothing pinned, it shows the rotating line from the app’s idle state.</p>
        <div class="bx-wrow">
          <div>${bxLogWidget('s')}<div class="bx-wcap">Small · 1:1</div></div>
          <div style="flex:1 1 100%">${bxLogWidget('m')}<div class="bx-wcap">Medium · about 2.3:1</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="bx-wsec">
        <h3>Data widget</h3>
        <p class="sub">A monthly or yearly summary. Choose which.</p>
        <div class="bx-seg2" role="group" aria-label="Data widget period">
          <button class="${BX_WPERIOD==='month'?'on':''}" aria-pressed="${BX_WPERIOD==='month'}" onclick="bxSetWPeriod('month')">Monthly</button>
          <button class="${BX_WPERIOD==='year'?'on':''}" aria-pressed="${BX_WPERIOD==='year'}" onclick="bxSetWPeriod('year')">Yearly</button>
        </div>
        <div class="bx-wrow">
          <div>${bxDataWidget('s')}<div class="bx-wcap">Small · 1:1</div></div>
          <div style="flex:1 1 100%">${bxDataWidget('m')}<div class="bx-wcap">Medium · about 2.3:1</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="bx-note">Preview — home screen widgets require the native app.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   TEST-DATA FILL for custom fields (called by randomFillMonth).
   ============================================================ */
let BX_TINY = null;
function bxTinyPhotos(){
  if(BX_TINY) return BX_TINY;
  BX_TINY = [];
  const hues = [12, 200, 140, 40];
  hues.forEach(h=>{
    try{
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = 48; cv.height = 48;
      const cx = cv.getContext('2d'), g = cx.createLinearGradient(0,0,48,48);
      g.addColorStop(0,'hsl('+h+',60%,70%)'); g.addColorStop(1,'hsl('+((h+50)%360)+',55%,40%)');
      cx.fillStyle = g; cx.fillRect(0,0,48,48);
      BX_TINY.push(cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.6));
    }catch(e){}
  });
  return BX_TINY;
}
function bxFillCustom(mk){
  const todayDs = todayStr();
  const dates = datesInMonth(mk).filter(d=>d<=todayDs);
  const boxes = Object.keys(bxDB().boxes).map(k=>bxDB().boxes[k]);
  const WORDS = ['Same as usual','Went fine','Kept it simple','Busy day','Felt good','Rushed','Quiet one'];
  dates.forEach(ds=>{
    boxes.forEach(b=>{
      const fields = (b.fields||[]).filter(f=>!f.deleted);
      if(!fields.length) return;
      if(b.custom && b.until && ds >= b.until) return;
      if(Math.random() > 0.8) return;
      const day = DB.days[ds] || (DB.days[ds] = { pages:{} });
      const pg = day.pages[b.id] || (day.pages[b.id] = {});
      if(Object.keys(pg).some(k=>k.indexOf('cf_')===0)) return;       // never overwrite real entries
      fields.forEach(f=>{
        if(Math.random() < 0.15) return;
        const k = 'cf_'+f.id;
        if(f.type==='number') pg[k] = rngInt(1,60);
        else if(f.type==='short') pg[k] = rngPick(WORDS);
        else if(f.type==='long') pg[k] = rngPick(WORDS)+'. '+rngPick(WORDS)+'.';
        else if(f.type==='scale') pg[k] = rngInt(1, f.max===10?10:5);
        else if(f.type==='toggle') pg[k] = Math.random() > 0.4;
        else if(f.type==='choice' && f.options && f.options.length) pg[k] = rngPick(f.options);
        else if(f.type==='photo'){ const ph = bxTinyPhotos(); if(ph.length) pg[k] = rngPick(ph); }
      });
      pg._touched = true; pg._touchedAt = Date.now();
    });
  });
  recomputeStreak(); saveDB(); render();
}


/* ============================================================
   UPGRADE SCREEN — identical in all 7 logbooks.

   Uses only components that already exist in this app (home hero,
   field card, onboarding CTA button, "all done" badge, settings row)
   and the brand/palette from window.LOGBOOK. No new CSS.

   ENTITLEMENT
   DB.unlocked is the single flag. It is a plain boolean for now:
   false = show the paywall, true = show the "Unlocked" state.
   It must be set by a purchase-verification step (the matching PDF
   purchase, or a StoreKit transaction) — never by the UI itself.
   It survives "Erase everything" and is NOT taken from a restored
   backup file, because the store decides entitlement, not a JSON file.

   PRICING (same as web)
   Own        $7 one time
   Subscribe  $2 / month
   ============================================================ */
const UPGRADE_PRICES = {
  own:       { name:'Own',       price:'$7', unit:'one time', hint:'Pay once. Yours to keep.',        cta:'Own it · $7' },
  subscribe: { name:'Subscribe', price:'$2', unit:'/ month',  hint:'Billed monthly. Cancel any time.', cta:'Subscribe · $2/month' },
};

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   PLACEHOLDER — NATIVE DEVELOPER: START HERE.
   Both buttons on the Upgrade screen call this with:
     type === 'own'        one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase
     type === 'subscribe'  auto-renewing subscription
   Real implementation on iOS is StoreKit / In-App Purchase (not a card
   form). When a transaction is verified, set DB.unlocked = true, call
   saveDB(), then render() so the screen flips to its Unlocked state.
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function handlePurchase(type) { /* TODO: wire to StoreKit */ }

function renderUpgrade(){
  const unlocked = DB.unlocked === true;
  const hero = `
    <div class="home-hero" style="margin:0 0 16px;">
      <p class="brand">${esc(BRAND.wordmark)}</p>
      <h2 class="headline" style="margin-bottom:0;">${unlocked ? esc(BRAND.shortName||BRAND.name) : 'Unlock ' + esc(BRAND.shortName||BRAND.name)}</h2>
    </div>`;
  let body;
  if(unlocked){
    body = `
      <div class="field-card">
        <div class="nextup-alldone">
          <span class="ok-badge">${icon('check',18)}</span>
          <div>
            <div class="nextup-title">Unlocked</div>
            <div class="nextup-sub">Thanks for your purchase. ${esc(BRAND.name)} is unlocked on this device — nothing more to buy.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  } else {
    const opt = key => {
      const o = UPGRADE_PRICES[key];
      return `
        <div class="field-card">
          <div class="fc-label">${esc(o.name)}</div>
          <div class="fc-hint">${esc(o.hint)}</div>
          <div class="nextup-title" style="font-size:30px;margin:2px 0 14px;">${esc(o.price)} <span class="nextup-sub" style="font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;">${esc(o.unit)}</span></div>
          <button class="onboard-cta" onclick="handlePurchase('${key}')">${esc(o.cta)} ${icon('chevright',16)}</button>
        </div>`;
    };
    body = `
      <p class="onb-sub" style="margin-bottom:14px;">Two ways to unlock ${esc(BRAND.name)}. Pick whichever suits you.</p>
      ${opt('own')}
      ${opt('subscribe')}`;
  }
  app.innerHTML = `
    ${renderTopbar('Upgrade', true)}
    <div class="page-body">
      ${hero}
      ${body}
    </div>
    <div class="gap-block"></div>`;
}

(function upgradeHook(){
  const _render = render;
  render = function(){
    if(DB.onboarded && ROUTE.view === 'upgrade'){ clearSideRail(); renderUpgrade(); return; }
    _render();
  };

  const _renderSettings = renderSettings;
  renderSettings = function(){
    _renderSettings();
    const first = app.querySelector('.settings-section');
    if(!first) return;
    const unlocked = DB.unlocked === true;
    first.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', `
      <div class="settings-section">
        <div class="settings-heading">${unlocked ? 'Your plan' : 'Upgrade'}</div>
        <button class="settings-row" onclick="nav('upgrade')">
          <div>
            <div class="sr-name">${unlocked ? 'Unlocked' : 'Upgrade'}</div>
            <div class="sr-desc">${unlocked ? 'Thanks for your purchase' : 'Own for $7 one time, or subscribe for $2/month'}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="sr-ico">${icon(unlocked ? 'check' : 'bolt', 16)}</div>
        </button>
      </div>`);
  };
})();

/* ============================================================
   ROUTER
   render() draws whichever screen ROUTE points at. Nearly every tap calls it, so it redraws the whole screen.
   ============================================================ */
function render(){
  // Every route starts from "no rail" and only the tab-root views
  // (Home, Tracker, History, Settings, Library) put one back, via
  // renderBottomNav -> mountSideRail. Clearing here — once, before
  // dispatch — rather than adding a clear call to every non-tab-root
  // renderer is what guarantees a stale rail can never survive a
  // navigation to a page that doesn't call renderBottomNav.
  clearSideRail();
  if(!DB.onboarded){ renderOnboarding(); return; }
  if(ROUTE.view==='home') renderHome();
  else if(ROUTE.view==='history') renderHistory();
  else if(ROUTE.view==='tracker') renderTracker();
  else if(ROUTE.view==='page') renderPage();
  else if(ROUTE.view==='lanelog') renderLaneLog(ROUTE.date);
  else if(ROUTE.view==='settings') renderSettings();
  else renderHome();
}

/* CYCLE 5: no first draw here. BOOT (the last script) draws once, after every add-on has loaded, so the old screen never flashes. */
(function dismissSplash(){
  const splash = document.getElementById('app-splash');
  if(!splash) return;
  // Small minimum-show time so the splash doesn't just flash on fast
  // devices — but never blocks longer than a real slow first paint.
  const MIN_MS = 380;
  const start = performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now();
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
    const elapsed = (performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now()) - start;
    setTimeout(()=>{ splash.classList.add('hide'); }, Math.max(0, MIN_MS - elapsed));
  });
})();
setInterval(()=>{
  if(ROUTE.view==='home' && SELECTED_DATE===todayStr()){
    const strip = document.querySelector('.clock-strip');
    if(strip){
      const replacement = document.createRange().createContextualFragment(renderClockStrip());
      strip.replaceWith(replacement.firstElementChild);
    }
  }
}, 30000);

/* ============================================================
/* ============================================================
   NAV BAR — always visible, no scroll-based hiding.
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   This used to auto-hide on scroll-down and reappear on scroll-up
   (an Instagram-style pattern). Removed: the bottom tab bar is the
   only way to reach Home/Tracker/History/Settings, and a piece of
   primary navigation that can disappear and not reliably come back
   is a real usability problem, not a nice animation — confirmed by
   a real person hitting exactly that: scroll down on Settings and
   the whole nav is just gone. Always-visible is correct here even
   though it costs a little vertical space; a chart/data-heavy app
   like this one needs navigation that's never in doubt.
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   LAYOUT MODE WATCHER
   The only JS-side awareness of the tablet/desktop side-rail:
   toggles one class on <body> when the viewport crosses the
   1100px breakpoint that responsive.css uses for ".side-rail".
   Every other responsive change (grid columns, #app width,
   hover states) is pure CSS and needs no JS at all — this class
   exists only because the bottom tab bar and the side rail are
   the same information twice and one of them should be inert,
   not just visually hidden, so a screen-reader or keyboard user
   tabbing through the page doesn't land on four buttons that do
   nothing and then four more that work. matchMedia (not a resize
   listener doing its own width math) so this can never disagree
   with the CSS about where the line is. */
const LAYOUT_MQ = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(min-width:1100px)') : null;
function applyLayoutMode(isDesktop){
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('layout-desktop', isDesktop);
  document.querySelectorAll('.bottom-tabs button, .assist-toggle').forEach(el=>{
    el.setAttribute('tabindex', isDesktop ? '-1' : '0');
    el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isDesktop ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
}
if(LAYOUT_MQ){
  applyLayoutMode(LAYOUT_MQ.matches);
  const onLayoutChange = e => applyLayoutMode(e.matches);
  if(LAYOUT_MQ.addEventListener) LAYOUT_MQ.addEventListener('change', onLayoutChange);
  else if(LAYOUT_MQ.addListener) LAYOUT_MQ.addListener(onLayoutChange); // older Safari
}
</script>
<style id="polish-extra">
/* ---- shared by all 7 apps: paint-your-day timetable, and the Clean "in rotation" list ---- */

.ttp-tile:not(.k-empty){border-style:solid;border-color:transparent;background:var(--surface-2);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 24%, var(--surface));box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--c);}
