.ttp-live b{font-weight:800;}
.ttp-live .arr{color:var(--accent);font-weight:800;}
.ttp-live .tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--c,var(--accent));color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;}
.ttp-tile .lk{position:absolute;top:7px;right:7px;width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--c);opacity:.95;}
.ttp-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 14px;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 8px;}
.ttp-legend svg{width:13px;height:13px;vertical-align:-2px;color:var(--accent);}
.tt-adv{margin:14px 0 0;}.tt-adv summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.tt-adv summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}.tt-adv[open] summary{margin-bottom:10px;}
.ttp-homecard{border:1.5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)!important;}
.ttp-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin:10px 0 8px;}
.ttp-fill{width:100%;min-height:44px;margin:0 0 6px;border-radius:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;}
.ttp-fill[hidden]{display:none;}
.tt-tool-btn{width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;border:0;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:700;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ttp-chip,.ttp-meter i{transition:none;}}
.rot-add{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.rot-card{padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface-2);margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;}
.rot-card .textline{margin-bottom:8px;}
.rot-x{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;}
.rot-card .rot-name{padding-right:40px;}
</style>
<script>
/* Shared polish for all 7 apps. Four jobs:
   1. STOP THE JITTER: the app redraws a whole screen on every tap, and each redraw replayed a 6px slide-in.
      Now the slide-in only plays when you actually move to a different screen.
   2. TIMETABLE HELPERS + PAINTER: a full-24-hours model (no presets) and "paint your day": pick Sleep / Free / a box,
      then tap or drag across the hour tiles. Painting links the hour to the box and names it after it (no typing).
      Used by first-run setup AND the Timetable page.
   3. TIMETABLE PAGE: swaps the old preset buttons for the painter; the name rows underneath become optional details.
   4. CLEAN COLLECTION (Clean Boy / Clean Girl only): the vault becomes a list of products IN ROTATION. */
(function(){
  try{
    var app = document.getElementById('app');
    var val = function(id){ var e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value : ''; };

    /* ---- 1) slide-in only on a real screen change ---- */
    var lastKey = null, baseRender = render;
    render = function(){
      /* "where am I": the route (or setup step), NOT the date/tab — those re-render in place */
      var key = DB.onboarded ? (ROUTE.view+'|'+(ROUTE.pageId||'')) : ('setup|'+ONSTEP);
      if(app) app.classList.toggle('route-anim', key!==lastKey);
      lastKey = key;
      return baseRender.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    /* ---- 2) timetable helpers (window.TT) ---- */
    var HOURS = []; for(var h=0;h<24;h++) HOURS.push((h<10?'0':'')+h+':00');
    var TT = window.TT = { HOURS: HOURS };
    /* hours from `from` up to (not including) `to`, wrapping past midnight: 23:00 -> 06:00 gives 7 hours */
    TT.between = function(from, to){
      var i = parseInt(from,10), j = parseInt(to,10), out = [];
      if(i===j) return out;
      while(i!==j){ out.push(HOURS[i]); i = (i+1)%24; }
      return out;
    };
    /* make sure every hour 00:00-23:00 has a block (empty ones are fine); keeps any in-between times like 06:30 */
    TT.withAllHours = function(blocks){
      var by = {}; (blocks||[]).forEach(function(b){ by[b.time] = b; });
      var out = HOURS.map(function(t){ return by[t] || { time:t, task:'' }; });
      (blocks||[]).forEach(function(b){ if(HOURS.indexOf(b.time)<0) out.push(b); });
      out.sort(function(a,b){ return timeStrToMinutes(a.time)-timeStrToMinutes(b.time); });
      return out;
    };
    /* how many of the 24 hours are planned (a box, Sleep or Free all count; so does any name typed on the Timetable page), and whether all 24 are */
    TT.filledCount = function(blocks){ var by = {}; (blocks||[]).forEach(function(b){ if(b && b.task && String(b.task).trim()) by[b.time] = 1; }); return HOURS.filter(function(t){ return by[t]; }).length; };
    TT.complete = function(blocks){ return TT.filledCount(blocks) === 24; };
    /* "7 AM" style label for the small hour tiles */
    TT.short = function(t){ var h = parseInt(t,10); return (h%12||12)+' '+(h<12?'AM':'PM'); };

    /* ============================================================
       PAINT YOUR DAY  (the assign-first timetable)
       Pick a "brush" (Sleep, Free, or one of your boxes) and tap or drag across the 24 hour tiles.
       Painting an hour with a box LINKS the hour to that box and names it after the box, so no typing is needed.
       Tap a painted hour with the same brush (or use the Erase brush) to clear it. Undo takes back the last stroke.
       The Rename brush opens a small sheet to give one hour your own name (optional, never required).
       Data stays exactly as before: DB.timetable.blocks = [{time,task}] and DB.timetable.mapping = {time: boxId}.
       Sleep / Free are just the words "Sleep" / "Free" as the hour's name with no box linked.
       The painter updates itself in place (no full redraw), so dragging never jumps the screen. */
    var BRUSH = null, CUR = null, UNDO = [], UNDO_FOR = null;   /* UNDO survives the Timetable page redrawing itself */
    var HUES = [16,38,84,146,176,206,262,312,340,56,120,230];
    var norm = function(s){ return String(s||'').trim().toLowerCase(); };
    var boxHue = function(id){
      var i = CORE_PAGES.findIndex(function(p){ return p.id===id; });
      if(i<0){ var x = 0; for(var k=0;k<id.length;k++) x = (x*31 + id.charCodeAt(k))>>>0; i = x; }
      return HUES[i % HUES.length];
    };
    var colorOf = function(kind, id){
      if(kind==='sleep') return 'hsl(228 30% 52%)';
      if(kind==='free') return 'hsl(150 12% 52%)';
      if(kind==='box') return 'hsl('+boxHue(id)+' 52% 48%)';
      return 'var(--accent)';
    };
    /* what an hour currently is: {kind:'empty'|'sleep'|'free'|'box'|'named', id, label} */
    var kindOf = function(block, mapping){
      var t = block && block.task ? String(block.task).trim() : '', id = mapping && mapping[block && block.time];
      if(id && (bxIsCore(id) || bxIsBox(id))) return { kind:'box', id:id, label: t || bxBoxName(id) };
      if(!t) return { kind:'empty', label:'' };
      if(norm(t)==='sleep') return { kind:'sleep', label:t };
      if(norm(t)==='free') return { kind:'free', label:t };
      return { kind:'named', label:t };
    };
    var brushKind = function(b){ return b==='sleep' ? {kind:'sleep'} : b==='free' ? {kind:'free'} : {kind:'box', id:b}; };
    var findBlock = function(blocks, t){ for(var i=0;i<blocks.length;i++){ if(blocks[i].time===t) return blocks[i]; } return null; };
    var applyBrush = function(st, t, brush){
      var blocks = st.blocks(), map = st.mapping(), b = findBlock(blocks, t);
      if(!b){ b = { time:t, task:'' }; blocks.push(b); blocks.sort(function(x,y){ return timeStrToMinutes(x.time)-timeStrToMinutes(y.time); }); }
      if(brush==null){ b.task = ''; delete map[t]; }
      else if(brush==='sleep'){ b.task = 'Sleep'; delete map[t]; }
      else if(brush==='free'){ b.task = 'Free'; delete map[t]; }
      else { b.task = bxBoxName(brush); map[t] = brush; }
    };
    var sameAs = function(k, brush){
      if(brush==='sleep') return k.kind==='sleep';
      if(brush==='free') return k.kind==='free';
      return k.kind==='box' && k.id===brush;
    };
    var snap = function(st){ return JSON.stringify({ b:st.blocks(), m:st.mapping() }); };
    var restore = function(st, s){ var o = JSON.parse(s), bl = st.blocks(), mp = st.mapping(); bl.length = 0; o.b.forEach(function(x){ bl.push(x); }); Object.keys(mp).forEach(function(k){ delete mp[k]; }); Object.keys(o.m).forEach(function(k){ mp[k] = o.m[k]; }); };

    /* palette entries: Sleep, Free, every box that is on, then the Rename and Erase tools */
    var paletteItems = function(all){
      var items = [{ id:'sleep', name:'Sleep', icon:'moon' }, { id:'free', name:'Free', icon:'clock' }], seen = {};
      bxFocusPages().forEach(function(f){ seen[f.id] = 1; items.push({ id:f.id, name:f.name, icon:pageIconFor(f.id) }); });
      /* first-run setup: every suggestion is a brush too; painting with one adds that box */
      if(all && window.bxsSuggestions) window.bxsSuggestions().forEach(function(x){ if(!seen[x.id]) items.push({ id:x.id, name:x.name, icon:x.icon }); });
      return items;
    };
    var CHAIN = '<svg class="lk" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.5.5l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7-7l-1.7 1.7"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.5-.5l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7 7l1.7-1.7"/></svg>';
    TT.mount = function(host, st, opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      st.ensureHours();
      if(UNDO_FOR!==st.id){ UNDO = []; UNDO_FOR = st.id; }
      var undo = UNDO, stroke = null;
      var items = paletteItems(opts.allBoxes);
      if(!BRUSH || (BRUSH!=='erase' && BRUSH!=='rename' && !items.some(function(i){ return i.id===BRUSH; }))) BRUSH = (items[2] || items[0]).id;
      CUR = { host:host, st:st, opts:opts, redraw:function(){ draw(); } };
      function counts(){ var n = TT.filledCount(st.blocks()); return n; }
      function tileHtml(t){
        var b = findBlock(st.blocks(), t) || { time:t, task:'' }, k = kindOf(b, st.mapping());
        var inner = k.kind==='empty' ? '<span class="n"></span>' : '<span class="n">'+esc(k.label)+'</span>';
        return '<button type="button" class="ttp-tile k-'+k.kind+'" data-t="'+t+'" style="--c:'+colorOf(k.kind, k.id)+'" aria-label="'+esc(fmtBlockTime(t))+': '+esc(k.kind==='empty' ? 'not planned' : k.kind==='box' ? k.label+', linked, Home opens it at this hour' : k.label)+'">'
          + '<span class="h">'+TT.short(t)+'</span>'+(k.kind==='box' ? CHAIN : '')+inner+'</button>';
      }
      function paletteHtml(){
        var chips = items.map(function(i){
          return '<button type="button" class="ttp-chip'+(BRUSH===i.id?' on':'')+'" data-brush="'+i.id+'" style="--c:'+colorOf(i.id==='sleep'?'sleep':i.id==='free'?'free':'box', i.id)+'" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(BRUSH===i.id)+'"><span class="dot"></span>'+esc(i.name)+'</button>'; }).join('');
        var more = opts.allBoxes ? (window.onboardNewBoxSheet ? '<button type="button" class="ttp-chip more" data-new="1"><span class="pl">'+icon('plus',12)+'</span>New box</button>' : '')
          : '<button type="button" class="ttp-chip more" data-more="1"><span class="pl">'+icon('plus',12)+'</span>Add a box</button>';
        var tools = '<button type="button" class="ttp-chip tool'+(BRUSH==='rename'?' on':'')+'" data-brush="rename" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(BRUSH==='rename')+'">'+icon('pen',14)+'Rename</button>'
                  + '<button type="button" class="ttp-chip tool'+(BRUSH==='erase'?' on':'')+'" data-brush="erase" role="radio" aria-checked="'+(BRUSH==='erase')+'">'+icon('close',13)+'Erase</button>';
        return '<div class="ttp-pal'+(opts.sticky?' sticky':'')+'" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Brush">'+chips+more+tools+'</div>';
      }
      function howHtml(){
        var nowT = ('0'+new Date().getHours()).slice(-2)+':00', nb = findBlock(st.blocks(), nowT) || { time:nowT, task:'' }, nk = kindOf(nb, st.mapping());
        var br = items.filter(function(i){ return i.id===BRUSH; })[0];
        var live = nk.kind==='box' ? '<span class="tag" style="--c:'+colorOf('box', nk.id)+'">'+CHAIN+esc(nk.label)+'</span> <span>opens on Home</span>'
                 : nk.kind==='empty' ? '<b>nothing yet</b> '
                 : '<span>a calm quote ('+esc(nk.label)+' has no box)</span>';
        var tip = BRUSH==='erase' ? 'Erase brush: tap hours to unlink them.' : BRUSH==='rename' ? 'Rename brush: tap an hour to name it.'
                : (BRUSH==='sleep'||BRUSH==='free') ? esc(br ? br.name : '')+' hours are not linked to a box: Home just shows a quote.'
                : 'Brush: <b>'+esc(br ? br.name : 'a box')+'</b>. Each hour you touch gets linked.';
        return '<div class="ttp-how"><div class="ttp-how-h">'+CHAIN.replace('class="lk"','width="18" height="18"')+' Hours open boxes on Home</div>'
          + '<ol><li><i>1</i><span><b>Pick a box</b> (or Sleep / Free)</span></li><li><i>2</i><span><b>Tap or drag</b> across its hours</span></li><li><i>3</i><span><b>That is the link:</b> at those hours, Home opens that box</span></li></ol>'
          + '<div class="ttp-live"><span>'+tip+'</span></div>'
          + '<div class="ttp-live"><span>Now (<b>'+TT.short(nowT)+'</b>)</span><span class="arr">→</span>'+live+'</div></div>';
      }
      function draw(){
        items = paletteItems(opts.allBoxes);
        var n = counts();
        host.innerHTML = '<div class="ttp">'
          + howHtml()
          + '<div class="ttp-meter"><div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(n/24*100)+'%"></i></div><div class="row"><span class="cnt">'+n+' of 24 hours planned</span><button type="button" class="ttp-undo" '+(undo.length?'':'disabled')+'>'+icon('undo',13)+' Undo</button></div></div>'
          + paletteHtml()
          + '<div class="ttp-grid" role="group" aria-label="24 hours">'+HOURS.map(tileHtml).join('')+'</div>'
          + '<div class="ttp-legend"><span>'+CHAIN+' linked: Home opens this box</span><span>no chain: Sleep or Free</span></div>'
          + '<p class="ttp-hint">'+(BRUSH==='rename' ? 'Tap an hour to give it your own name.' : BRUSH==='erase' ? 'Tap, or hold and drag, to clear hours.' : 'Tap an hour to paint it. Hold, then drag, to paint a run. Tap a painted hour again to clear it.')+'</p>'
          + '<button type="button" class="ttp-fill"'+(n===24?' hidden':'')+'>Mark every empty hour as Free</button>'
          + '</div>';
        wire();
      }
      function refreshTile(t){
        /* update the tile IN PLACE: if the node under a moving finger is replaced, the browser stops sending that touch's events */
        var el = host.querySelector('.ttp-tile[data-t="'+t+'"]'); if(!el) return;
        var tmp = document.createElement('div'); tmp.innerHTML = tileHtml(t); var nw = tmp.firstChild;
        el.className = nw.className + (el.classList.contains('hold') ? ' hold' : ''); el.setAttribute('style', nw.getAttribute('style')); el.setAttribute('aria-label', nw.getAttribute('aria-label')); el.innerHTML = nw.innerHTML;
      }
      function refreshMeter(){
        var n = counts(), bar = host.querySelector('.ttp-meter i'), c = host.querySelector('.ttp-meter .cnt'), u = host.querySelector('.ttp-undo'), f = host.querySelector('.ttp-fill');
        if(bar) bar.style.width = (n/24*100)+'%'; if(c) c.textContent = n+' of 24 hours planned';
        if(u) u.disabled = !undo.length; if(f) f.hidden = n===24;
        var hw = host.querySelector('.ttp-how'); if(hw) hw.outerHTML = howHtml();
        if(opts.onChange) opts.onChange(n);
      }
      function setBrush(b){
        BRUSH = b;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.ttp-chip[data-brush]'), function(c){ var on = c.getAttribute('data-brush')===b; c.classList.toggle('on', on); c.setAttribute('aria-checked', on); });
        var hw0 = host.querySelector('.ttp-how'); if(hw0) hw0.outerHTML = howHtml();
        var hint = host.querySelector('.ttp-hint'); if(hint) hint.textContent = b==='rename' ? 'Tap an hour to give it your own name.' : b==='erase' ? 'Tap, or hold and drag, to clear hours.' : 'Tap an hour to paint it. Hold, then drag, to paint a run. Tap a painted hour again to clear it.';
      }
      function paintTile(el){
        var t = el.getAttribute('data-t'); if(stroke.seen[t]) return; stroke.seen[t] = 1;
        var b = findBlock(st.blocks(), t) || { time:t, task:'' }, k = kindOf(b, st.mapping());
        if(stroke.mode===null) stroke.mode = (BRUSH==='erase' || sameAs(k, BRUSH)) ? 'erase' : 'paint';
        if(stroke.mode==='paint'){ if(bxIsCore(BRUSH) || bxIsBox(BRUSH) || BRUSH==='fit'){ if(window.bxsEnsure) window.bxsEnsure(BRUSH); } applyBrush(st, t, BRUSH); }
        else applyBrush(st, t, null);
        stroke.changed = true; refreshTile(t);
      }
      function wire(){
        var grid = host.querySelector('.ttp-grid');
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.ttp-chip[data-brush]'), function(c){ c.addEventListener('click', function(){ setBrush(c.getAttribute('data-brush')); }); });
        var more = host.querySelector('[data-more]'); if(more) more.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(window.bxNewBoxSheet) bxNewBoxSheet(); });
        var nw = host.querySelector('[data-new]'); if(nw) nw.addEventListener('click', function(){ window.onboardNewBoxSheet(); });
        var u = host.querySelector('.ttp-undo'); if(u) u.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(!undo.length) return; restore(st, undo.pop()); st.save(); draw(); if(opts.onChange) opts.onChange(counts()); if(opts.afterStroke) opts.afterStroke(); });
        var f = host.querySelector('.ttp-fill'); if(f) f.addEventListener('click', function(){
          undo.push(snap(st)); st.blocks().forEach(function(b){ if(HOURS.indexOf(b.time)>=0 && !(b.task && b.task.trim())) b.task = 'Free'; });
          st.save(); draw(); if(opts.onChange) opts.onChange(counts()); if(opts.afterStroke) opts.afterStroke(); });
        /* ---- how fingers paint ----
           MOUSE: press and drag paints straight away.
           TOUCH: a quick swipe just SCROLLS the page (it never paints), a tap paints one hour, and HOLD ~0.25 s then drag
           paints a run of hours (the tile pulses when painting starts). This is why you can always scroll, even when your
           finger lands on the hour tiles. */
        var HOLD_MS = 250, MOVE_TOL = 9, tch = null;
        var onScroll = function(){ if(tch && !tch.holding){ tch.moved = true; clearTimeout(tch.timer); } };
        var tileAt = function(x, y){ var el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); el = el && el.closest && el.closest('.ttp-tile'); return el && grid.contains(el) ? el : null; };
        var beginStroke = function(){ undo.push(snap(st)); if(undo.length>25) undo.shift(); stroke = { mode:null, seen:{}, changed:false }; };
        var endStroke = function(){
          if(!stroke) return; var s = stroke; stroke = null;
          if(!s.changed){ undo.pop(); return; }
          st.save(); refreshMeter(); if(opts.afterStroke) opts.afterStroke();
        };
        grid.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
          if(e.pointerType==='touch') return;                       /* touch is handled below */
          var el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ttp-tile'); if(!el) return;
          if(BRUSH==='rename'){ TT.rename(el.getAttribute('data-t')); return; }
          e.preventDefault(); beginStroke(); paintTile(el);
          try{ grid.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(x){}
        });
        grid.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){ if(!stroke || e.pointerType==='touch') return; var el = tileAt(e.clientX, e.clientY); if(el) paintTile(el); });
        grid.addEventListener('pointerup', function(e){ if(e.pointerType!=='touch') endStroke(); });
        /* touch + pointer events: some browsers scroll without ever sending touchmove, but they DO send pointermove
           (and pointercancel when they take over for a scroll), so use those too to tell a swipe from a tap */
        grid.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){
          if(e.pointerType!=='touch' || !tch || tch.holding) return;
          if(Math.hypot(e.clientX-tch.x, e.clientY-tch.y) > MOVE_TOL){ tch.moved = true; clearTimeout(tch.timer); } });
        grid.addEventListener('pointercancel', function(e){
          if(e.pointerType!=='touch'){ endStroke(); return; }
          if(tch && !tch.holding){ tch.moved = true; clearTimeout(tch.timer); } });
        grid.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
          if(tch){ clearTimeout(tch.timer); } tch = null;
          if(e.touches.length!==1) return;
          var t = e.touches[0], el = tileAt(t.clientX, t.clientY); if(!el) return;
          tch = { el:el, x:t.clientX, y:t.clientY, t0:Date.now(), holding:false, moved:false };
          document.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, true);       /* the page scrolled under this finger: it was a scroll, not a tap */
          if(BRUSH!=='rename') tch.timer = setTimeout(function(){
            if(!tch || tch.moved) return; tch.holding = true; beginStroke(); paintTile(tch.el);
            tch.el.classList.add('hold'); try{ if(navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(10); }catch(x){}
          }, HOLD_MS);
        }, { passive:true });
        grid.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e){
          if(!tch) return; var t = e.touches[0];
          if(tch.holding){ if(e.cancelable) e.preventDefault(); var el = tileAt(t.clientX, t.clientY); if(el) paintTile(el); return; }
          if(Math.hypot(t.clientX-tch.x, t.clientY-tch.y) > MOVE_TOL){ tch.moved = true; clearTimeout(tch.timer); }   /* it is a scroll: leave it alone */
        }, { passive:false });
        var touchDone = function(e){
          if(!tch) return; var c = tch; tch = null; clearTimeout(c.timer); document.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll, true);
          var ct = e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]; if(ct && Math.hypot(ct.clientX-c.x, ct.clientY-c.y) > MOVE_TOL) c.moved = true;
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.ttp-tile.hold'), function(x){ x.classList.remove('hold'); });
          if(c.holding){ endStroke(); return; }
          if(e.type==='touchend' && !c.moved && Date.now()-c.t0 < 700){        /* a tap */
            if(BRUSH==='rename'){ TT.rename(c.el.getAttribute('data-t')); return; }
            beginStroke(); paintTile(c.el); endStroke();
          }
        };
        grid.addEventListener('touchend', touchDone); grid.addEventListener('touchcancel', touchDone);
        grid.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); });
        /* keyboard / screen reader: Enter or Space on a tile paints it (those arrive as clicks with detail 0) */
        grid.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          var el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ttp-tile'); if(!el || e.detail!==0) return;
          if(BRUSH==='rename'){ TT.rename(el.getAttribute('data-t')); return; }
          beginStroke(); paintTile(el); endStroke();
        });
      }
      draw();
    };
    /* Rename one hour (optional). Leaving it empty puts the name back to the box's own name. */
    TT.rename = function(t){
      if(!CUR) return; var b = findBlock(CUR.st.blocks(), t), k = kindOf(b || {time:t, task:''}, CUR.st.mapping());
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>Name '+esc(fmtBlockTime(t))+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
        + '<div class="bx-form"><label class="bx-l" for="ttp-name">Your own name for this hour (optional)</label>'
        + '<input id="ttp-name" class="textline" maxlength="60" value="'+esc(b && b.task || '')+'" placeholder="'+esc(k.kind==='box' ? bxBoxName(k.id) : 'e.g. Gym')+'" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){event.preventDefault();ttRenameSave(\''+t+'\');}">'
        + '<div class="bx-actions"><button class="sec" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button><button class="pri" onclick="ttRenameSave(\''+t+'\')">Save</button></div></div>');
    };
    window.ttRenameSave = function(t){
      if(!CUR) return closeSheet();
      var v = ((document.getElementById('ttp-name')||{}).value||'').trim(), st = CUR.st, b = findBlock(st.blocks(), t);
      if(!b){ b = { time:t, task:'' }; st.blocks().push(b); }
      var id = st.mapping()[t]; b.task = v || (id ? bxBoxName(id) : '');
      st.save(); closeSheet(); CUR.redraw(); if(CUR.opts.onChange) CUR.opts.onChange(TT.filledCount(st.blocks())); if(CUR.opts.afterStroke) CUR.opts.afterStroke();
    };
    TT.painted = function(){ return CUR; };

    /* ---- 3) Timetable page: the painter replaces the old preset buttons and the two helper cards ---- */
    var pageStore = {
      id:'page',
      ensureHours:function(){ var all = TT.withAllHours(normalizeTimetableBlocks()); if(all.length!==DB.timetable.blocks.length){ DB.timetable.blocks = all; saveDB(); } },
      blocks:function(){ return DB.timetable.blocks; },
      mapping:function(){ if(!DB.timetable.mapping) DB.timetable.mapping = {}; return DB.timetable.mapping; },
      save:function(){ touchSetupPage('timetable'); }
    };
    var baseTT = renderTimetable;
    var wrappedTT = function(dateStr){
      baseTT(dateStr);
      var pills = document.querySelector('#app .pill-row'); if(!pills) return;
      pills.outerHTML = '<div id="ttp-host"></div>';
      var hostEl = document.getElementById('ttp-host');
      /* the name rows underneath are the "details" and are optional; redraw them after each stroke so they match */
      TT.mount(hostEl, pageStore, { afterStroke:function(){ var y = window.scrollY; render(); window.scrollTo({top:y, behavior:'instant'}); } });
      /* plain wording: say the one idea, and tuck the old per-block rows (half-hour blocks, idle quotes) into an optional drawer */
      try{
        var card = hostEl.closest('.field-card'), lab = card && card.querySelector('.fc-label'), hint = card && card.querySelector('.fc-hint');
        if(lab) lab.textContent = 'Link your hours to boxes';
        if(hint) hint.textContent = 'Paint an hour with a box. At that hour, Home opens that box for you.';
        if(card){
          var rest = []; var n = hostEl.nextSibling; while(n){ rest.push(n); n = n.nextSibling; }
          if(rest.length){
            var d = document.createElement('details'); d.className = 'tt-adv'; if(window.__ttAdvOpen) d.open = true;
            d.setAttribute('ontoggle', 'window.__ttAdvOpen=this.open');
            d.innerHTML = '<summary>More options: half-hour blocks and idle quotes</summary>';
            hostEl.parentNode.insertBefore(d, hostEl.nextSibling); rest.forEach(function(x){ d.appendChild(x); });
          }
        }
        var cards = document.querySelectorAll('#app .page-body > .field-card'), last = cards[cards.length-1];
        if(last && last!==card){ last.classList.add('ttp-homecard'); var l2 = last.querySelector('.fc-label'), h2 = last.querySelector('.fc-hint'); if(l2) l2.textContent = 'What you will see on Home'; if(h2) h2.textContent = 'The box linked to the current hour sits at the top of Home, ready to log. Hours with no box (Sleep, Free) show a quote instead.'; }
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('timetable wording', e); }
    };
    renderTimetable = wrappedTT;
    if(typeof PAGE_RENDERERS!=='undefined' && PAGE_RENDERERS.timetable) PAGE_RENDERERS.timetable = wrappedTT; /* the page table holds its own reference */

    /* ---- 5) LINKING FIX ----
       The "link an hour to a box" list used to be a fixed template (Workout Log, Business Lane, Daily Dashboard...)
       copied from one app, so it showed names that did not exist in your app, left out real boxes (Mind & Focus,
       Night Wind-down, Shower...) and Home could only draw five of them. Now the list is built from THIS app's own
       boxes (CORE_PAGES) with their real names, plus any boxes you made, and Home can draw every one of them. */
    FOCUS_PAGES.length = 0;
    CORE_PAGES.forEach(function(p){ FOCUS_PAGES.push({ id:p.id, name:p.name }); });
    var HOME_DRAWS = { dashboard:1, workout:1, journal:1, reading:1, lane:1 };   /* these Home already knew how to draw */
    var baseFocusBody = bxFocusBody;
    bxFocusBody = function(id, ds, html){
      if(!html && !HOME_DRAWS[id] && bxIsCore(id) && typeof window[id+'Body']==='function'){
        try{ html = window[id+'Body'](ds); }catch(e){ html = ''; }
      }
      return baseFocusBody(id, ds, html);
    };

    /* ---- 4) Clean collection: products IN ROTATION, as many as you like ---- */
    var inc = SETUP_PAGES.find(function(p){ return p.id==='income'; });
    if(inc && /product/i.test(inc.name) && typeof incomeBody==='function'){
      window.__rotOn = true;
      /* the list for one month. A new month starts as a copy of the last month that had one,
         so you only edit what changed instead of retyping your shelf. Old single-product data is carried over once. */
      var rotList = function(mk){
        var pg = getMonthlyPage('income', mk);
        if(!Array.isArray(pg.inRotation)){
          var list = null, keys = Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).filter(function(k){ return k<mk; }).sort().reverse();
          for(var i=0;i<keys.length && !list;i++){ var prev = DB.monthly[keys[i]].income; if(prev && Array.isArray(prev.inRotation) && prev.inRotation.length) list = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev.inRotation)); }
          if(!list) list = (pg.rotation && pg.rotation.name) ? [{ name:pg.rotation.name, brand:pg.rotation.brand||'', note:pg.rotation.characteristics||'' }] : [];
          pg.inRotation = list;
        }
        return pg.inRotation;
      };
      window.rotList = rotList; /* shared with the lists patch (tap-first adding) */
      window.rotAdd = function(mk){
        var name = (val('rot-name')||'').trim(), brand = (val('rot-brand')||'').trim();
        if(!name){ flashSaved('Type the product name first'); return; }
        rotList(mk).unshift({ name:name, brand:brand, note:'' }); saveDB(); render(); /* newest first, so it shows right under the form */
      };
      window.rotEdit = function(mk, i, key, v){ var l = rotList(mk); if(l[i]){ l[i][key] = v; saveDB(); } }; /* no redraw: it fires per keystroke */
      window.rotRemove = function(mk, i){ rotList(mk).splice(i,1); saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Removed from rotation'); };
      incomeBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey(), list = rotList(mk);
        if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)){
          var rows = list.filter(function(p){ return p.name; }).map(function(p){
            return '<div class="locked-item-row" style="align-items:flex-start;"><span style="font-weight:700;">'+esc(p.name)+'</span><span class="muted-inline">'+esc(p.brand||'')+'</span></div>'; }).join('');
          return monthlyLockedBody(rows ? '<div class="field-card">'+rows+'</div>' : '<div class="empty-note">Nothing in rotation for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'.</div>', 'income', mk);
        }
        var cards = list.map(function(p,i){
          return '<div class="rot-card"><input class="textline rot-name" placeholder="Product name" value="'+esc(p.name)+'" oninput="rotEdit(\''+mk+'\','+i+',\'name\',this.value)">'
            + '<input class="textline" placeholder="Brand" value="'+esc(p.brand)+'" oninput="rotEdit(\''+mk+'\','+i+',\'brand\',this.value)">'
            + '<input class="textline" placeholder="Notes (scent, texture, how long it lasts...)" value="'+esc(p.note)+'" oninput="rotEdit(\''+mk+'\','+i+',\'note\',this.value)">'
            + '<button class="rot-x" aria-label="Remove '+esc(p.name||'product')+' from rotation" onclick="rotRemove(\''+mk+'\','+i+')">'+icon('close',13)+'</button></div>'; }).join('');
        var add = '<div class="rot-add"><input id="rot-name" class="textline" maxlength="80" placeholder="Add a product or perfume" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){event.preventDefault();rotAdd(\''+mk+'\');}">'
          + '<input id="rot-brand" class="textline" maxlength="60" placeholder="Brand (optional)" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){event.preventDefault();rotAdd(\''+mk+'\');}">'
          + '<button class="tt-tool-btn" onclick="rotAdd(\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add to rotation</button></div>';
        return fieldWrap('In rotation', 'Only what you are using right now. Add as many as you like, and remove anything you have finished or put away.', add + (cards || '<div class="empty-note">Nothing in rotation yet.</div>'))
          + '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow(\'income\',\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+' Mark done for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'</button>';
      };
    }
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('polish', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   ICONS: the emoji are gone. This adds a set of thin, matching line icons to the app's own icon table
   (the same one that already draws the check mark, the book and the trash can), so every picture in the app
   is one family: same stroke, same corners, same colour as the text around it (they follow dark mode and the accent).
   Use:  icon('dumbbell', 22).   Nothing else in the app changes.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof ICONS==='undefined') return;
    var N = {
      dumbbell:'<path d="M6.5 6.5v11M17.5 6.5v11M3.5 9.2v5.6M20.5 9.2v5.6M6.5 12h11"/>',

      walk:'<circle cx="12.6" cy="4.6" r="1.9"/><path d="M12 8.6l-1.6 4.1 2.6 2.6-.8 5.2M12 8.6l2.6 3.4 2.8.8M10.4 12.7L7.2 14"/>',
      lotus:'<path d="M12 4.5c2 2 3 4.2 3 6.4s-1.3 4.1-3 4.1-3-1.9-3-4.1 1-4.4 3-6.4Z"/><path d="M3.8 10.4c3.2.2 5.4 2 6.4 5-3.2.4-5.8-.6-6.4-5ZM20.2 10.4c-3.2.2-5.4 2-6.4 5 3.2.4 5.8-.6 6.4-5Z"/><path d="M6 19.4c3.5 1.2 8.5 1.2 12 0"/>',
      ball:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M12 8l3.6 2.6-1.4 4.2H9.8L8.4 10.6 12 8ZM12 8V3.4M15.6 10.6l4.4-1.2M14.2 14.8l2.8 3.6M9.8 14.8l-2.8 3.6M8.4 10.6L4 9.4"/>',
      sleep:'<path d="M19.5 14.6A8 8 0 1 1 9.4 4.5a6.4 6.4 0 0 0 10.1 10.1Z"/><path d="M14 3.5h4l-4 4.2h4"/>',
      rower:'<path d="M3 17.5c2 1.6 4 1.6 6 0s4-1.6 6 0 4 1.6 6 0"/><circle cx="14.5" cy="5.4" r="1.7"/><path d="M13.5 8.4L11 12l-3.5 1.5M11 12l3.5 2.5M16.5 10.2l3.5-2.2"/>',
      core:'<rect x="7" y="3.5" width="10" height="17" rx="5"/><path d="M12 6.5v11M8.6 9.8h6.8M8.6 14.2h6.8"/>',
      bottle:'<path d="M9.5 3.5h5v3h-5z"/><path d="M8.5 6.5h7l1 3.2v9.3a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5H9a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5-1.5V9.7l1-3.2Z"/><path d="M7.7 12.5h8.6"/>',
      hair:'<path d="M7 20c-1-3.5-1.4-7 .4-10.2C8.8 7.3 10.2 6 12 6s3.2 1.3 4.6 3.8c1.8 3.2 1.4 6.7.4 10.2"/><path d="M9.6 9.5c.8 2.2 2.8 3.6 5 4M12 3.4v2.2"/>',
      tooth:'<path d="M12 6.4c-1.4-1.4-5.2-1.8-6 1.6-.7 3 1.4 4.6 1.6 8.2.1 2 .8 4 2 4 1.3 0 1.2-3.2 2.4-3.2s1.1 3.2 2.4 3.2c1.2 0 1.9-2 2-4 .2-3.6 2.3-5.2 1.6-8.2-.8-3.4-4.6-3-6-1.6Z"/>',
      razor:'<path d="M5 9h12v4H5z"/><path d="M17 11h2.5M8 13v4.5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V13M8 9V6.5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4"/>',
      sparkle:'<path d="M12 3.5c.5 4.2 1.8 5.5 6 6-4.2.5-5.5 1.8-6 6-.5-4.2-1.8-5.5-6-6 4.2-.5 5.5-1.8 6-6Z"/><path d="M18.5 15.5c.2 1.8.7 2.3 2.5 2.5-1.8.2-2.3.7-2.5 2.5-.2-1.8-.7-2.3-2.5-2.5 1.8-.2 2.3-.7 2.5-2.5Z"/>',
      repeat:'<path d="M5 11V9.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 7.5 7H19M16 4l3 3-3 3M19 13v1.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1-2.5 2.5H5M8 20l-3-3 3-3"/>',
      star:'<path d="M12 3.6l2.5 5.2 5.7.8-4.1 4 1 5.7L12 16.6l-5.1 2.7 1-5.7-4.1-4 5.7-.8L12 3.6Z"/>',
      medal:'<circle cx="12" cy="14.5" r="5.5"/><path d="M8.5 10L6.5 3.5h4L12 7l1.5-3.5h4L15.5 10"/><path d="M12 12v5M10.4 13.2l1.6-1.2"/>',
      trophy:'<path d="M8 4h8v5.5a4 4 0 0 1-8 0V4Z"/><path d="M8 6H5v1.5A3 3 0 0 0 8 10.5M16 6h3v1.5a3 3 0 0 1-3 3M12 13.5V17M8.5 20h7M10 17h4"/>',
      shield:'<path d="M12 3.5l7 2.6v5.4c0 4.4-3 7.6-7 9-4-1.4-7-4.6-7-9V6.1l7-2.6Z"/><path d="M8.8 12l2.2 2.2 4.2-4.4"/>',
      leaf:'<path d="M5 19c-.4-7 3.6-13 14-14 .6 9.2-4.6 14.2-12 13.4"/><path d="M5 19c2.5-4 5.2-6.6 9-8.4"/>',
      sprout:'<path d="M12 20.5v-8"/><path d="M12 12.5C12 8.8 9.6 6.6 5.5 6.5c0 4 2.2 6 6.5 6ZM12 14c0-3 2-5 6.5-5 0 3.6-2.4 5.4-6.5 5Z"/>',
      coffee:'<path d="M5 9h11v5.5A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 11.5 19h-2A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 5 14.5V9Z"/><path d="M16 10.5h1.6a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 0 4.8H15.6M8.5 3.8c-.6.8.6 1.4 0 2.4M12 3.8c-.6.8.6 1.4 0 2.4"/>',
      pin:'<path d="M12 21c-4.2-4.4-6.3-7.6-6.3-10.4a6.3 6.3 0 0 1 12.6 0C18.3 13.4 16.2 16.6 12 21Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10.4" r="2.2"/>',
      rocket:'<path d="M14.5 4.5c2.6-.8 4.6-.8 5-.3.4.5.4 2.4-.4 5L14.8 13.5l-4.3-4.3L14.5 4.5Z"/><path d="M10.5 9.2L7 9.8 4.5 12.3l3.8.2M14.8 13.5l-.6 3.5-2.5 2.5-.2-3.8M7.2 16.8c-1.3.3-2.2 1.2-2.7 2.7 1.5-.5 2.4-1.4 2.7-2.7Z"/><circle cx="15.8" cy="8.2" r="1"/>',
      heart:'<path d="M12 20c-5.5-3.8-8-7-8-10.2A4.3 4.3 0 0 1 8.3 5.5c1.6 0 2.9.8 3.7 2.2.8-1.4 2.1-2.2 3.7-2.2A4.3 4.3 0 0 1 20 9.8C20 13 17.5 16.2 12 20Z"/>',
      bell:'<path d="M6 16.5v-5a6 6 0 0 1 12 0v5l1.5 2h-15L6 16.5Z"/><path d="M10 20.5a2.2 2.2 0 0 0 4 0"/>',
      cup:'<path d="M6 4.5h12l-1.2 13.2a2 2 0 0 1-2 1.8H9.2a2 2 0 0 1-2-1.8L6 4.5Z"/><path d="M6.6 10h10.8"/>',
      note:'<rect x="5" y="3.5" width="14" height="17" rx="2"/><path d="M8.5 8.5h7M8.5 12h7M8.5 15.5h4"/>',
      car:'<path d="M4 16.5V12l2-4.5h12L20 12v4.5"/><path d="M3.5 16.5h17M7.5 16.5v2.2M16.5 16.5v2.2M4 12h16"/><circle cx="8" cy="14" r=".6" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="16" cy="14" r=".6" fill="currentColor"/>',
      camera:'<path d="M4 8.5h3l1.6-2.5h6.8L17 8.5h3v10H4v-10Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13.2" r="3.2"/>',
      mail:'<rect x="3.5" y="5.5" width="17" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M4 7l8 6 8-6"/>',
      code:'<path d="M8.5 7L3.5 12l5 5M15.5 7l5 5-5 5M13.5 5l-3 14"/>',
      brain:'<path d="M9.5 4.5a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-2 2.8 3 3 0 0 0 1.4 2.6 3.2 3.2 0 0 0 1.6 4.2 2.8 2.8 0 0 0 5 1.2V5.6A2.4 2.4 0 0 0 9.5 4.5ZM14.5 4.5a3 3 0 0 1 3 3 3 3 0 0 1 2 2.8 3 3 0 0 1-1.4 2.6 3.2 3.2 0 0 1-1.6 4.2 2.8 2.8 0 0 1-5 1.2"/>',
      /* five faces, from low to great (they replace the emoji faces) */
      face1:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M8.8 16.2c1.9-1.7 4.5-1.7 6.4 0"/><path d="M8.6 9.6l1.9.6M15.4 9.6l-1.9.6"/>',
      face2:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M9 15.8c1.8-1 4.2-1 6 0"/><circle cx="9.2" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="14.8" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/>',
      face3:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M9 15.2h6"/><circle cx="9.2" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="14.8" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/>',
      face4:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M8.8 14c1.8 2 4.6 2 6.4 0"/><circle cx="9.2" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="14.8" cy="10" r=".7" fill="currentColor"/>',
      face5:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.6"/><path d="M8 13.2h8c0 2.4-1.8 4-4 4s-4-1.6-4-4Z"/><path d="M8.4 9.8c.5-.8 1.5-.8 2 0M13.6 9.8c.5-.8 1.5-.8 2 0"/>',
      tray:'<path d="M4 13l2.4-7.5h11.2L20 13v5.5H4V13Z"/><path d="M4 13h4.2a3.8 3.8 0 0 0 7.6 0H20"/>',
      calcheck:'<rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M8 3v4M16 3v4M3.5 10h17M9 15l2.2 2.2L15.5 13"/>'
    };
    for(var k in N) if(!ICONS[k]) ICONS[k] = N[k];
    window.IC_NAMES = Object.keys(N);
    /* a slightly lighter line than before (2 -> 1.75) so the icons look finer; the check mark keeps its own heavy stroke */
    var _icon = icon;
    icon = function(name, size, extra){ var h = _icon(name, size, extra); return h.replace('stroke-width="2"', 'stroke-width="'+(size!=null && size<=14 ? '2' : '1.75')+'"'); };

    /* every emoji the apps used to show is swapped for one of these icons the moment it lands on the page (and in toasts and sheets).
       Only this fixed list is touched, so anything you type yourself is left exactly as you wrote it. */
    var MAP = { '\u{1F3CB}\uFE0F':'dumbbell','\u{1F3CB}':'dumbbell','\u{1F4AA}':'dumbbell','\u{1F3C3}':'run','\u{1F9D8}':'lotus','\u26BD':'ball','\u{1F6B6}':'walk','\u{1F634}':'sleep','\u{1F6A3}':'rower',
      '\u{1F9B5}':'run','\u{1F9BF}':'run','\u{1F525}':'flame','\u2764\uFE0F':'heart','\u26A1':'bolt','\u{1F3C5}':'medal','\u{1F604}':'face5','\u{1F642}':'face4','\u{1F610}':'face3','\u{1F615}':'face2','\u{1F623}':'face1',
      '\u{1F630}':'face2','\u{1F624}':'face1','\u{1F641}':'face2','\u{1F61E}':'face1','\u{1F9F4}':'bottle','\u{1F487}':'hair','\u{1F9B7}':'tooth','\u{1FA92}':'razor','\u{1F4A7}':'drop','\u2728':'sparkle','\u{1F9EA}':'bottle',
      '\u{1F501}':'repeat','\u2705':'check','\u{1F389}':'sparkle' };
    var RX = new RegExp(Object.keys(MAP).sort(function(a,b){ return b.length-a.length; }).map(function(k){ return k.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'); }).join('|'), 'gu');
    function swapIn(root){
      if(!root || !RX.test(root.textContent||'')) return; RX.lastIndex = 0;
      var w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null), hit = [], n;
      while((n = w.nextNode())){ if(RX.test(n.nodeValue)){ var par = n.parentNode && n.parentNode.nodeName; if(par!=='SCRIPT' && par!=='STYLE' && par!=='TEXTAREA' && par!=='OPTION' && par!=='TITLE') hit.push(n); } RX.lastIndex = 0; }
      hit.forEach(function(t){
        var html = esc(t.nodeValue).replace(RX, function(m){ return '<span class="ic-em" aria-hidden="true">'+_icon(MAP[m]==='check' ? 'check' : MAP[m], 20)+'</span>'; });
        var sp = document.createElement('span'); sp.className = 'ic-wrap'; sp.innerHTML = html; t.parentNode.replaceChild(sp, t);
      });
    }
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'ico-extra';
    st.textContent = '.ic-wrap{display:contents}.ic-em{display:inline-flex;vertical-align:-.2em;line-height:1}.ic-em svg{width:1.1em;height:1.1em;stroke-width:1.75}.em .ic-em svg,.ui-card .em svg{width:1.25em;height:1.25em}';
    document.head.appendChild(st);
    var busy = false;
    new MutationObserver(function(){ if(busy) return; busy = true; try{ swapIn(document.body); }catch(e){} busy = false; }).observe(document.body, { childList:true, subtree:true, characterData:true });
    try{ swapIn(document.body); }catch(e){}
    /* an emoji or a short word -> the matching icon name (used where old saved text still holds an emoji) */
    window.icOf = function(name, size){ return icon(name, size||20); };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('icons patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<style id="boxes-extra">
/* ---- suggestion-only boxes: chips, empty state, manager "Suggested" section ---- */
.bxs-sugg{margin:10px 0 6px;}
.bxs-sugg-title{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);margin:0 2px 8px;}

.bxs-chip:active{transform:scale(.96);}
.bxs-chip .pl{display:inline-flex;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;}

/* first-run "choose your boxes" tiles */
.bxs-pick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:2px 0 12px;}
.bxs-tile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;min-height:92px;padding:14px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:transform .14s,border-color .14s,background .14s;}
.bxs-tile:active{transform:scale(.97);}
.bxs-tile .ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bxs-chip,.bxs-tile{transition:none;}}

<script>
/* ============================================================
   SUGGESTION-ONLY BOXES  (shared by all 7 apps)
   Nothing is pre-added any more. The app's built-in daily boxes (CORE_PAGES) are only SUGGESTIONS:
   you tap one to add it, and from that day on it shows on Home, in the day ring, in the streak and in the
   "link an hour to a box" lists. Removing a box never deletes what you already logged.

   ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH:  ACTIVE_BOXES(dateStr)  =  the boxes that count on that day.  pagesList() returns it,
   and everything that used to read pagesList() (Home tiles, the ring, week dots, History, widgets) follows.

   HOW "ADDED" IS STORED (no change to the backup format; old backups still import):
     DB.bx.boxes[id].addedFrom = 'YYYY-MM-DD'   a built-in box counts from that date on ('0000-00-00' = always)
     DB.bx.boxes[id].hiddenFrom                 existing "hide" switch: from that date on it no longer counts
     DB.bx.suggest = 1                          the one-time migration below has run
   A day that already has data for a box still shows that box, so history never loses anything.

   ONE-TIME MIGRATION (existing installs, and old backups the first time they are opened):
   a built-in box is kept if you ever logged in it, linked an hour to it, customised it, or (Daily Hobbies / Business Lane)
   picked a lane. Every other built-in box becomes a suggestion. */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof CORE_PAGES==='undefined' || typeof bxDB!=='function' || typeof pagesList!=='function') return;
    var EPOCH = '0000-00-00';
    var FIT = !!window.__FIT_SUGGEST;          /* Clean + Sober used to auto-create a "Fit of the Day" box; it is a suggestion now */

    /* did this box ever get logged in? (any day page that is marked done or holds any value) */
    function hasData(id){
      var days = DB.days || {};
      for(var d in days){ var pg = days[d] && days[d].pages && days[d].pages[id]; if(pg && (pg._touched || Object.keys(pg).length)) return true; }
      return false;
    }
    function linked(id){ var m = (DB.timetable && DB.timetable.mapping) || {}; for(var t in m){ if(m[t]===id) return true; } return false; }
    function fitUntouched(c){
      var def = bxFitDef();
      return c && c.name===def.name && !c.until && c.fields && c.fields.length===def.fields.length && !c.fields.some(function(f){ return f.deleted; })
        && Object.keys(c.labels||{}).length===0 && Object.keys(c.hidden||{}).length===0;
    }
    function migrate(){
      var b = bxDB(); if(b.suggest===1) return;
      b.suggest = 1;
      CORE_PAGES.forEach(function(p){
        var c = bxCfg(p.id);
        if(c && c.addedFrom) return;
        var keep = hasData(p.id) || linked(p.id) || (p.id==='lane' && DB.lane) || (c && (c.name || c.icon || (c.fields||[]).length || Object.keys(c.labels||{}).length || Object.keys(c.hidden||{}).length));
        if(keep){ c = bxCfg(p.id, true); c.addedFrom = EPOCH; }
      });
      /* a Fit of the Day box that was auto-created and never used goes back to being a suggestion */
      if(b.boxes.fit && fitUntouched(b.boxes.fit) && !hasData('fit') && !linked('fit')) delete b.boxes.fit;
      saveDB();
    }
    function ensure(){ if(!DB.bx || DB.bx.suggest!==1) migrate(); }

    /* ---- who counts on which day ---- */
    function isAdded(id, ds){ var c = bxCfg(id); return !!(c && c.addedFrom && ds >= c.addedFrom); }
    function activeNow(id){
      var t = todayStr(), c = bxCfg(id);
      if(bxIsCore(id)) return !!(c && c.addedFrom && t >= c.addedFrom && !(c.hiddenFrom && t >= c.hiddenFrom));
      return !!(c && c.custom && !c.until);
    }
    var basePages = pagesList;
    pagesList = function(ds){
      ensure();
      ds = ds || todayStr();
      return basePages(ds).filter(function(p){ return p.custom || !bxIsCore(p.id) || isAdded(p.id, ds) || pageIsDone(ds, p.id); });
    };
    window.ACTIVE_BOXES = function(ds){ return pagesList(ds || todayStr()); };
    window.bxsIsActive = activeNow;

    /* ---- suggestions ---- */
    window.bxsSuggestions = function(){
      ensure();
      var out = CORE_PAGES.filter(function(p){ return !activeNow(p.id); }).map(function(p){ var m = bxBoxMeta(p.id); return { id:p.id, name:m.name, icon:m.icon }; });
      if(FIT && !(DB.bx.boxes.fit && !DB.bx.boxes.fit.until)){ var f = bxFitDef(); out.push({ id:'fit', name:f.name, icon:f.icon }); }
      return out;
    };
    /* every box that counts right now (built-in added + custom), for the first-run picker */
    window.bxsChosen = function(){ return pagesList(todayStr()).filter(function(p){ return activeNow(p.id); }); };

    window.bxsAdd = function(id, quiet){
      ensure();
      if(id==='fit' && FIT){
        var b = bxDB();
        if(!b.boxes.fit) b.boxes.fit = bxFitDef(); else { b.boxes.fit.until = null; }
      } else if(bxIsCore(id)){
        var c = bxCfg(id, true); c.addedFrom = todayStr(); delete c.hiddenFrom;
      } else if(bxIsBox(id)){ bxCfg(id).until = null; }
      if(!saveDB()) return false;
      if(!quiet) flashSaved('Added '+bxBoxName(id));
      return true;
    };
    window.bxsRemove = function(id, quiet){
      ensure();
      if(bxIsCore(id)){
        var c = bxCfg(id, true);
        if(hasData(id)) c.hiddenFrom = todayStr(); else { delete c.addedFrom; delete c.hiddenFrom; }
      } else if(bxIsBox(id)){
        var cc = bxCfg(id);
        if(hasData(id)) cc.until = todayStr(); else delete bxDB().boxes[id];
      }
      saveDB();
      if(!quiet) flashSaved('Removed');
    };
    window.bxsTap = function(id){ if(window.bxsAdd(id)) render(); };
    /* the timetable painter calls this: using a suggestion on an hour adds it */
    window.bxsEnsure = function(id){ if(id && id!=='sleep' && id!=='free' && !activeNow(id) && (bxIsCore(id) || id==='fit' || bxIsBox(id))) window.bxsAdd(id, true); };

    /* ---- suggestions live in the "New box" popup (nothing else on Home/Settings advertises them) ---- */
    var baseNewBox = bxNewBoxSheet;
    bxNewBoxSheet = function(){
      baseNewBox.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var s = window.bxsSuggestions(), form = document.querySelector('.bx-form'); if(!form || !s.length) return;
        form.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<div class="bxs-sugg" style="margin-top:0;"><div class="bxs-sugg-title">Suggested boxes \u2014 tap to add</div><div class="bxs-chips">'
          + s.map(function(x){ return '<button type="button" class="bxs-chip" onclick="bxsSheetAdd(\''+x.id+'\')"><span class="pl">'+icon('plus',12)+'</span>'+esc(x.name)+'</button>'; }).join('')
          + '</div><div class="bxs-or">or make your own</div></div>');
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('boxes sheet', e); }
    };
    window.bxsSheetAdd = function(id){ if(window.bxsAdd(id)){ closeSheet(); render(); } };
    /* Home with no boxes: one calm card instead of an empty grid; the "no hobby picked yet" note only shows when that box is on */
    var baseHome = renderHome;
    renderHome = function(){
      var r = baseHome.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var ds = SELECTED_DATE || todayStr();
        if(!ACTIVE_BOXES(ds).length){
          var body = document.querySelector('#app .home-rest-toggle') || document.querySelector('#app .home-rest-body'), rest = document.querySelector('#app .home-rest-body');
          var card = '<div class="bxs-empty"><b>No boxes yet</b><p>Boxes are the pages you log in. Add one and it shows up here.</p><button class="bx-add-row" onclick="bxNewBoxSheet()">'+icon('plus',15)+' Add a box</button></div>';
          if(body && !(rest && rest.classList.contains('open'))) body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', card);
        }
        var ln = document.querySelector('#app .lane-note'); if(ln && !activeNow('lane')) ln.remove();
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('boxes home', e); }
      return r;
    };

    /* ---- link pickers (timetable, Home idle card) only offer boxes that are on ---- */
    var baseFocus = bxFocusPages;
    bxFocusPages = function(){
      ensure();
      return baseFocus().filter(function(f){ return !bxIsCore(f.id) || activeNow(f.id); });
    };

    /* ---- Boxes & fields screen: built-ins that are not added are not listed (they are suggestions in "New box") ---- */
    var baseManager = bxRenderManager;
    bxRenderManager = function(){
      ensure(); baseManager();
      try{
        var built = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#app .settings-heading')).filter(function(h){ return h.textContent.trim()==='Built-in boxes'; })[0];
        if(built){
          Array.prototype.slice.call(built.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.bx-mrow')).forEach(function(row){
            var m = /bxOpenBoxEdit\('([^']+)'/.exec(row.innerHTML); if(m && !activeNow(m[1])) row.remove();
          });
          if(!built.parentElement.querySelector('.bx-mrow')) built.parentElement.remove(); else built.textContent = 'Your built-in boxes';
        }
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('boxes manager', e); }
    };
    /* test data: filling random months turns every suggestion on first, so charts and the ring have something to show */
    var baseFill = randomFillMonth;
    randomFillMonth = function(){
      ensure();
      CORE_PAGES.forEach(function(p){ var c = bxCfg(p.id, true); if(!c.addedFrom && !c.hiddenFrom) c.addedFrom = EPOCH; });
      if(FIT && !DB.bx.boxes.fit) DB.bx.boxes.fit = Object.assign(bxFitDef(), { from:EPOCH });
      return baseFill.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    ensure();
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('boxes patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<style id="setup-extra">
/* setup flow: time -> box explainer, add-an-hour, new box, picture-first vision board */
.onb-tt-time{flex:none;min-width:64px;white-space:nowrap;}
.onb-hours-meter{margin:0 0 12px;}
.onb-hours-meter .bar{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden;}
.onb-hours-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);transition:width .2s;}
.onb-hours-meter span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:6px;}
.onb-how-card{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:10px;}
.onb-how-n{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;flex:none;}
.onb-how-card b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:3px;color:var(--ink);}
.onb-how-card p{margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink-soft);}
.onb-demo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface-2);margin:4px 0 6px;font-size:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.onb-demo .t{font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);}
.onb-demo .task{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);}
.onb-demo .arrow{color:var(--muted);}
.onb-demo .box{margin-left:auto;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:800;}
.onb-demo-cap{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin:0 0 10px;}
.onb-add-hour{margin-top:16px;padding:14px;border-radius:18px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);}
.onb-add-title{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;}
.onb-add-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:stretch;}
.onb-add-row input[type=time]{flex:1 1 130px;min-width:0;order:1;}
.onb-add-btn{flex:0 0 auto;order:2;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:14px;border:0;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:800;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;}
.onb-add-row input:not([type=time]){flex:1 1 100%;min-width:0;order:3;}
.onb-tt-x{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-left:6px;cursor:pointer;}
.onb-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin:4px 0 14px;}
.vb-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:4px 14px 6px;}
.vb-tile{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-2);}
.vb-tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
.vb-x{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;}
.vb-add{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;}
.vb-add input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:pointer;}
.vb-count{padding:2px 18px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}
.vb-words{margin:12px 0 4px;}
.vb-words summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);}
.vb-words summary span{font-weight:600;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}
.vb-words summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.vb-words[open] summary{margin-bottom:10px;}
</style>
<script>
/* First-run setup, shared by all 7 apps.
   - one step per monthly setup page (Vault, Reflections, Habits...), reading each app's own SETUP_PAGES
   - a MANDATORY timetable (all 24 hours named before anything else), and a plain-language "time -> box" explainer, a full 24-hour grid with quick fill (no presets), link-a-stretch and new-box inside the timetable step
   - one consistent step count + progress bar (steps = the groups the welcome screen lists)
   - Vision Board is picture-first */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof ONBOARD_STEPS==='undefined' || typeof SETUP_PAGES==='undefined') return;
    var TT_GROUP = 'Plan your day in boxes';

    /* ---- steps ----
       Same shape as before: How it works -> the timetable -> the monthly pages. The timetable screen is now a paint-your-day
       screen: painting an hour with a box LINKS it (and adds that box). Boxes you do not paint stay suggestions. */
    var have = {}; ONBOARD_STEPS.forEach(function(s){ have[s.id] = 1; });
    ONBOARD_STEPS.forEach(function(s){ if(/^timetable-/.test(s.id)) s.group = TT_GROUP; });
    var pi = ONBOARD_STEPS.findIndex(function(s){ return s.id==='timetable-pick'; });
    if(pi>=0) ONBOARD_STEPS.splice(pi, 0, { id:'timetable-intro', group:TT_GROUP }, { id:'timetable-hours', group:TT_GROUP });
    /* No presets (Early Riser / 9-to-5 / Night Owl) and no separate link screen. */
    for(var r=ONBOARD_STEPS.length-1; r>=0; r--){ if(/^timetable-(pick|review|focus)$/.test(ONBOARD_STEPS[r].id)) ONBOARD_STEPS.splice(r,1); }
    /* The timetable is mandatory and comes right after the boxes in every app. Hustler used to open on "pick your lane". */
    var li = ONBOARD_STEPS.findIndex(function(s){ return s.id==='lane'; });
    if(li>=0){
      var laneStep = ONBOARD_STEPS.splice(li,1)[0], bi = ONBOARD_STEPS.findIndex(function(s){ return s.id==='bucket'; });
      ONBOARD_STEPS.splice(bi>=0 ? bi : ONBOARD_STEPS.length, 0, laneStep);
    }
    var pages = SETUP_PAGES.filter(function(p){ return p.id!=='timetable' && !have[p.id] && typeof window[p.id+'Body']==='function'; });
    var fresh = pages.map(function(p){ return { id:'setup-'+p.id, group:(p.id==='income' && window.__rotOn) ? 'Add your products in rotation' : 'Set up '+p.name }; });
    var at = ONBOARD_STEPS.findIndex(function(s){ return s.id==='objectives'; }); /* Hustler ends on its own objectives step */
    if(at < 0) at = ONBOARD_STEPS.length;
    ONBOARD_STEPS.splice.apply(ONBOARD_STEPS, [at, 0].concat(fresh));
    ONSTEPS_ORDER.length = 0; ONBOARD_GROUPS.length = 0;
    ONBOARD_STEPS.forEach(function(s){ ONSTEPS_ORDER.push(s.id); if(ONBOARD_GROUPS.indexOf(s.group)<0) ONBOARD_GROUPS.push(s.group); });

    /* ---- consistent "Step n of N" + progress bar, counted in groups ---- */
    var PARTS = { 'timetable-intro':'How it works', 'timetable-hours':'Paint your day' };
    var baseShell = onboardShell;
    onboardShell = function(opts){
      var step = ONBOARD_STEPS.find(function(s){ return s.id===ONSTEP; });
      var G = ONBOARD_GROUPS.length, gi = step ? ONBOARD_GROUPS.indexOf(step.group) : -1;
      var o = Object.assign({}, opts);
      if(gi>=0) o.eyebrow = 'Step '+(gi+1)+' of '+G + (PARTS[ONSTEP] ? ' · '+PARTS[ONSTEP] : '');
      baseShell(o);
      var bar = document.querySelector('#app .onb-progress');
      if(!ttDone()){ var sk = document.querySelector('#app .onboard-skip'); if(sk) sk.replaceWith(document.createElement('span')); }   /* no "Skip setup" until the timetable is done */
      if(bar && gi>=0) bar.innerHTML = Array.from({length:G}).map(function(_,i){ return '<div class="onb-seg '+(i<=gi?'filled':'')+'"></div>'; }).join('');
    };

    /* ---- MANDATORY TIMETABLE ----
       Nothing past the timetable can be reached until all 24 hours are PLANNED: each hour is a box, Sleep or Free
       (Free is one tap). Naming hours is no longer required. The Continue button stays locked, the Skip buttons are
       hidden, and finishing is refused. */
    var draftBlocks = function(){ return ONDRAFT.blocks || (DB.timetable && DB.timetable.blocks) || []; };
    var ttDone = function(){ return TT.complete(draftBlocks()); };
    var baseFinish = finishOnboarding;
    finishOnboarding = function(){
      if(!ttDone()){ flashSaved('Plan all 24 hours of your day first'); onboardGoto(ONSTEP==='welcome' ? 'timetable-hours' : 'timetable-hours'); return; }
      /* the painted day REPLACES the saved links (an hour you cleared must not keep its old box), and a box that a
         painted hour points at is switched on even if it was un-ticked later */
      var m = ONDRAFT.mapping || {};
      Object.keys(m).forEach(function(t){ if(window.bxsEnsure) window.bxsEnsure(m[t]); });
      DB.timetable.mapping = {};
      return baseFinish.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var baseNext = onboardNext;
    onboardNext = function(){
      if(ONSTEP==='timetable-hours' && !ttDone()){ flashSaved('Plan every hour first — Free counts'); return; }
      return baseNext.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var baseRender = renderOnboarding;
    renderOnboarding = function(){
      if(ONSTEP==='welcome'){ var r = baseRender(); if(!ttDone()){ Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#app button'), function(b){ if(/Skip, take me/i.test(b.innerText)) b.remove(); });
          var top = document.querySelector('#app .onboard-skip'); if(top) top.replaceWith(document.createElement('span')); }   /* the welcome screen draws its own skip links */
        return r; }
            if(ONSTEP==='timetable-intro') return renderOnboardTimetableIntro();
      if(ONSTEP==='timetable-hours') return renderOnboardTimetableHours();
      if(String(ONSTEP).indexOf('setup-')===0) return renderOnboardSetupPage(ONSTEP.slice(6));
      return baseRender();
    };

    /* start the draft from what is saved when setup is run again, otherwise from nothing (24 empty hours, no links) */
    var seedDraft = function(){
      if(!ONDRAFT.blocks) ONDRAFT.blocks = [];
      ONDRAFT.blocks = TT.withAllHours(ONDRAFT.blocks.length ? ONDRAFT.blocks : (DB.timetable.blocks||[]).map(function(b){ return { time:b.time, task:b.task||'' }; }));
      if(!ONDRAFT.mapping || !Object.keys(ONDRAFT.mapping).length) ONDRAFT.mapping = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DB.timetable.mapping||{}));
    };

    /* ---- 1) the "boxes on a day" explainer ---- */
    window.renderOnboardTimetableIntro = function(){
      var names = bxFocusPages().map(function(f){ return f.name; });
      var a = names[0] || 'Movement', b = names[1] || a;
      var card = function(n,t,p){ return '<div class="onb-how-card"><div class="onb-how-n">'+n+'</div><div><b>'+t+'</b><p>'+p+'</p></div></div>'; };
      onboardShell({
        title: 'Your day, in boxes.',
        sub: 'The one idea this app is built on. Takes ten seconds.',
        body: '<div class="onb-demo"><span class="t">7:00 AM</span><span class="arrow">→</span><span class="box">'+esc(a)+' box</span></div>'
            + '<p class="onb-demo-cap">Example: you gave 7:00 AM the '+esc(a)+' box, so at 7:00 AM Home opens it.</p>'
            + card(1,'Paint your day','Pick a box, then tap the hours it belongs to. Hold and drag to paint a run. Painting an hour links it to that box.')
            + card(2,'Boxes appear as you use them','Nothing is added for you. A box you paint into your day is added; the rest stay suggestions.')
            + card(3,'Home shows the right box, right on time','When an hour arrives, its box sits front and centre on Home. One tap to log.'),
        ctaLabel: 'Got it', ctaEnabled: true, showSkip: true, showBack: true
      });
    };

    /* ---- 3) paint your day ---- */
    var draftStore = {
      id:'draft',
      ensureHours:function(){ seedDraft(); },
      blocks:function(){ return ONDRAFT.blocks; },
      mapping:function(){ return ONDRAFT.mapping; },
      save:function(){ saveOnboardDraft(); }
    };
    var syncCTA = function(n){
      var cta = document.querySelector('#app .onboard-cta'); if(!cta) return;
      cta.disabled = n<24; cta.innerHTML = (n===24 ? 'Continue' : 'Plan all 24 hours to continue') + ' ' + icon('chevright',16);
      var sk = document.querySelector('#app .onboard-skip'); if(n===24 && !sk){ /* skip links come back on the next screen */ }
    };
    window.renderOnboardTimetableHours = function(){
      seedDraft();
      var filled = TT.filledCount(ONDRAFT.blocks);
      onboardShell({
        title: 'Paint your day.',
        sub: 'Give every hour a box, Sleep or Free. Free is fine.',
        body: '<div id="ttp-host"></div>',
        ctaLabel: filled===24 ? 'Continue' : 'Plan all 24 hours to continue', ctaEnabled: filled===24, showSkip: false, showBack: true
      });
      TT.mount(document.getElementById('ttp-host'), draftStore, { sticky:true, allBoxes:true, onChange:syncCTA });
    };

    var KINDS = [['toggle','Done / not done','Done'],['number','A number','Amount'],['scale','A 1\u20135 rating','Rating'],['short','A quick note','Note']];
    var BOXKIND = 'toggle';
    window.onboardNewBoxSheet = function(){
      BOXKIND = 'toggle';
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>New box</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
        + '<div class="bx-form"><label class="bx-l" for="onb-box-name">Name</label>'
        + '<input id="onb-box-name" class="textline" maxlength="40" placeholder="e.g. Skin check" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'){event.preventDefault();onboardCreateBox();}">'
        + '<label class="bx-l">What will you log?</label>'
        + '<div class="bx-seg2" style="flex-wrap:wrap;">'+KINDS.map(function(k,i){ return '<button class="'+(i===0?'on':'')+'" onclick="onboardPickKind(\''+k[0]+'\',this)">'+k[1]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="bx-err" id="onb-box-err" role="alert"></div>'
        + '<div class="bx-actions"><button class="sec" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button><button class="pri" onclick="onboardCreateBox()">Create box</button></div></div>');
    };
    window.onboardPickKind = function(kind, btn){ BOXKIND = kind; var row = btn.parentNode; Array.prototype.forEach.call(row.children, function(x){ x.classList.toggle('on', x===btn); }); };
    window.onboardCreateBox = function(){
      var name = ((document.getElementById('onb-box-name')||{}).value||'').trim();
      if(!name){ var e = document.getElementById('onb-box-err'); if(e) e.textContent = 'Give the box a name.'; return; }
      var kind = KINDS.find(function(k){ return k[0]===BOXKIND; }) || KINDS[0];
      var b = bxDB(), order = Math.max.apply(null, [1].concat(bxCustomBoxes().map(function(x){ return x.order||0; }))) + 1, id = bxNewId('cx_');
      var f = { id:bxNewId('f'), label:kind[2], type:kind[0], icon:null, created:todayStr(), deleted:null };
      if(kind[0]==='scale') f.max = 5; if(kind[0]==='number') f.unit = '';
      b.boxes[id] = { id:id, custom:true, name:name, icon:null, from:todayStr(), until:null, order:order, fields:[f], labels:{}, hidden:{} };
      if(!saveDB()){ delete b.boxes[id]; return; }
      closeSheet(); render(); flashSaved('Box created');
    };


    /* ---- 4) one step per monthly setup page ---- */
    window.renderOnboardSetupPage = function(pageId){
      var sp = SETUP_PAGES.find(function(p){ return p.id===pageId; }) || {name:pageId};
      var mk = currentMonthKey();
      var locked = isMonthlyPageLocked(pageId, mk);
      var html = window[pageId+'Body'](mk).replace(/<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow\([^"]*"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button>/, '');
      var vision = pageId==='bucket' && window.__vbOn, rot = pageId==='income' && window.__rotOn;
      onboardShell({
        title: vision ? 'Build your '+esc(sp.name)+'.' : rot ? 'What is in rotation?' : 'Set up your '+esc(sp.name),
        sub: vision ? 'Add the pictures that show the version of you you are working towards. Pictures first \u2014 words are optional.'
           : rot ? 'Add the products and perfumes you are using right now, as many as you like. Anything finished can be removed later.'
                    : 'For '+monthLabel(mk)+'. Fill in what you can \u2014 change any of it later from Settings.',
        body: html + (locked ? '' : '<button class="onboard-ghost" style="margin-top:6px;" onclick="onboardNext()">Skip for now</button>'),
        ctaLabel: locked ? 'Continue' : 'Mark done & continue',
        ctaAction: locked ? 'onboardNext()' : "onboardSetupDone('"+pageId+"')",
        ctaEnabled: true, showSkip: true, showBack: true
      });
    };
    window.onboardSetupDone = function(pageId){ touchMonthlyPage(pageId, currentMonthKey()); onboardNext(); };

    /* ---- 5) picture-first Vision Board (the page itself, so setup, the page and the monthly tab all agree) ---- */
    var vp = SETUP_PAGES.find(function(p){ return p.id==='bucket'; });
    if(vp && /vision/i.test(vp.name) && typeof bucketBody==='function'){
      window.__vbOn = true;
      var VB_MAX = 6;
      var vbPics = function(mk){ var p = getMonthlyPage('bucket', mk); if(!Array.isArray(p.pics)) p.pics = []; return p.pics; };
      var vbGrid = function(mk, editable){
        var pics = vbPics(mk); if(!pics.length && !editable) return '';
        var tiles = pics.map(function(src,i){ return '<div class="vb-tile"><img src="'+src+'" alt="Vision picture '+(i+1)+'">'
          + (editable ? '<button class="vb-x" aria-label="Remove picture '+(i+1)+'" onclick="vbRemove(\''+mk+'\','+i+')">'+icon('close',13)+'</button>' : '')+'</div>'; }).join('');
        var add = editable && pics.length<VB_MAX ? '<label class="vb-tile vb-add"><input type="file" accept="image/*" aria-label="Add a picture" onchange="vbPicked(this,\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('plus',22)+'<span>Add picture</span></label>' : '';
        return '<div class="vb-grid">'+tiles+add+'</div>' + (editable ? '<div class="vb-count">'+pics.length+' of '+VB_MAX+' \u00b7 tap + to pick from your photos</div>' : '');
      };
      var vbCompress = function(file){ return new Promise(function(res,rej){
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(file), img = new Image();
        img.onload = function(){ try{
          var S=[560,480,400,320], Q=[0.66,0.56,0.46,0.4], out=null;
          for(var i=0;i<S.length;i++){ var sc = Math.min(1, S[i]/Math.max(img.naturalWidth,img.naturalHeight));
            var w = Math.max(1,Math.round(img.naturalWidth*sc)), h = Math.max(1,Math.round(img.naturalHeight*sc));
            var cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h; var cx = cv.getContext('2d'); cx.fillStyle='#fff'; cx.fillRect(0,0,w,h); cx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
            out = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', Q[i]); if(out.length<=60000) break; }
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url); out && out.length<=140000 ? res(out) : rej(new Error('big')); }catch(e){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); rej(e); } };
        img.onerror = function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); rej(new Error('decode')); };
        img.src = url; }); };
      window.vbPicked = function(input, mk){
        var file = input.files && input.files[0]; input.value = ''; if(!file) return;
        flashSaved('Adding picture\u2026');
        vbCompress(file).then(function(uri){
          var arr = vbPics(mk); arr.push(uri);
          if(!saveDB()){ arr.pop(); flashSaved('Storage is full \u2014 picture not saved'); return; }
          flashSaved('Picture added'); render();
        }).catch(function(){ flashSaved("Couldn't read that picture"); });
      };
      window.vbRemove = function(mk, i){ var arr = vbPics(mk); if(!arr[i]) return; arr.splice(i,1); saveDB(); render(); };
      var baseBucket = bucketBody;
      bucketBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
        var locked = isMonthlyPageLocked('bucket', mk);
        if(locked) return vbGrid(mk,false) ? fieldWrap(esc(vp.name), null, vbGrid(mk,false)) + baseBucket(mk) : baseBucket(mk);
        var first = null, fw = fieldWrap, html;
        fieldWrap = function(t,s,i){ if(!first && (i===''||i==null)){ first = {t:t,s:s}; return ''; } return fw.apply(this, arguments); };
        try{ html = baseBucket(mk); } finally { fieldWrap = fw; }
        var btn = (html.match(/<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow\([^"]*"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button>/)||[''])[0];
        var foot = (html.match(/<p class="fc-footnote">[\s\S]*?<\/p>/)||[''])[0];
        var cards = html.replace(btn,'').replace(foot,'');
        return fieldWrap(first ? first.t : esc(vp.name), first ? first.s : null, vbGrid(mk,true))
          + '<details class="vb-words"'+(window.__vbWordsOpen ? ' open' : '')+' ontoggle="window.__vbWordsOpen=this.open"><summary>Add a few words <span>optional</span></summary>'+cards+'</details>'
          + foot + btn;
      };
    }

    /* the saved-draft restore ran before these steps existed; re-check it so reloads resume on them */
    try{
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(ONBOARD_KEY), saved = raw && JSON.parse(raw);
      if(!DB.onboarded && saved && saved.step && ONSTEPS_ORDER.indexOf(saved.step)>=0) ONSTEP = saved.step;
    }catch(e){}
    if(!DB.onboarded) render();
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('setup steps', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   "OTHER" SUGGESTIONS (Cycle 5)
   When you type something into any "+ Other" box, it comes back as a suggested chip (dashed outline) in that same place:
     - it stays for 7 days. Picking it again starts the 7 days over.
     - not picked within 7 days: it is deleted.
     - at most 3 per place. A 4th pushes out the oldest, so the most recent 3 stay.
   Saved in DB.otherSug = { "place key": [ { v:"text", last:"2026-10-18" } ] }. Old backups just do not have it.
   Other scripts call: OTHERS.add(key, text), OTHERS.use(key, text), OTHERS.list(key, optionsAlreadyShown).
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  var MAX = 3, DAYS = 7;
  function store(){ if(!DB.otherSug || typeof DB.otherSug !== 'object') DB.otherSug = {}; return DB.otherSug; }
  function ms(d){ var p = String(d).split('-'); return new Date(+p[0], (+p[1]||1)-1, +p[2]||1).getTime(); }
  function old(last){ return (ms(todayStr()) - ms(last)) / 86400000 > DAYS; }
  /* drop the expired ones and anything past the newest 3; returns the clean array for that place */
  function clean(key){
    var s = store(), a = Array.isArray(s[key]) ? s[key] : [], before = JSON.stringify(a);
    a = a.filter(function(x){ return x && x.v && x.last && !old(x.last); });
    a.sort(function(x,y){ return ms(y.last) - ms(x.last); });
    a = a.slice(0, MAX);
    if(a.length) s[key] = a; else delete s[key];
    if(JSON.stringify(a) !== before){ try{ saveDB(); }catch(e){} }
    return a;
  }
  var OTHERS = window.OTHERS = {
    MAX: MAX, DAYS: DAYS,
    add: function(key, text){
      text = String(text||'').trim(); if(!key || !text) return;
      var a = clean(key).filter(function(x){ return x.v.toLowerCase() !== text.toLowerCase(); });
      a.unshift({ v:text, last:todayStr() }); store()[key] = a.slice(0, MAX); try{ saveDB(); }catch(e){}
    },
    use: function(key, text){
      var a = clean(key), hit = a.filter(function(x){ return x.v === text; })[0];
      if(hit){ hit.last = todayStr(); try{ saveDB(); }catch(e){} }
    },
    /* suggestions for this place, leaving out anything already on screen as a normal option */
    list: function(key, shown){
      shown = shown || [];
      return clean(key).map(function(x){ return x.v; }).filter(function(v){ return shown.indexOf(v) < 0; });
    }
  };
  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'others-css';
  st.textContent = '.ui-chip.sugg{border-style:dashed !important;background:transparent}.ui-chip.sugg.on{border-style:solid !important}.ui-chip.sugg::before{content:"\\21BB";font-size:11px;margin-right:5px;opacity:.55}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   TAP-FIRST INPUTS  (Bot A, task 3)
   -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   What this file does, in plain words:
   - Most things you used to TYPE are now things you TAP: chips (meals, moods, wins, gratitude...),
     "+ / -" steppers with press-and-hold (duration, hours, bedtime), and one-tap workout presets with a
     tick-off exercise list.
   - Typing is still there as a small "Other" fallback, so nothing is ever blocked.
   - Your DATA is unchanged: every answer is still saved as the same plain text as before
     (e.g. "45 min", "10:30 pm", "Eggs, Toast"). Old backups and old entries keep working.
   - It works by replacing the small helper functions the pages already call (textField, areaField,
     counterField, scaleTapper, pillGroup, checkRow), so every page and the Home focus cards pick it up.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    /* ---------- small helpers ---------- */
    var JUST = null;             /* the one control that was just tapped (so only IT plays the "pop") */
    var OPEN = {};               /* which "Other..." / "note" boxes are open (survives redraws) */
    var E = function(s){ return esc(s==null ? '' : String(s)); };
    var isSober = !!(window.CORE_PAGES || CORE_PAGES) && CORE_PAGES.some(function(p){ return p.id==='checkin'; });
    /* Hustler's workout page is the only one with an exercise table (every app has the preset helpers, only one uses them) */
    var isHustler = /ex-row/.test(String(workoutBody));
    function K(ds,pid,key){ return ds+'|'+pid+'|'+key; }
    function D(act, ds, pid, key, val, more){
      return 'data-ui="'+act+'" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-pid="'+E(pid)+'" data-key="'+E(key)+'"'+(val!=null ? ' data-val="'+E(val)+'"' : '')+(more||'');
    }
    function justCls(id){ return JUST===id ? ' just' : ''; }
    function put(ds,pid,key,val){ setText(ds,pid,key,val); flashSaved(); }
    function redraw(id){ JUST = id || null; render(); }

    /* "Just tapped" is cleared right after the redraw so a later, unrelated redraw never replays the pop. */
    var _render = render;
    render = function(){ var r = _render.apply(this, arguments); JUST = null; return r; };

    /* ---------- styles ---------- */
    var css = ''
    + '.pill{position:relative;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.ui-chips{gap:8px;}'
    + '.ui-chip{min-height:40px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}'
    + '.ui-chip .em{font-size:17px;line-height:1;}'
    + '.ui-chip.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);box-shadow:0 4px 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 38%,transparent);}'
    + '.ui-chip.more{background:transparent;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted);}'
    + '.ui-face{flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:72px;min-height:70px;justify-content:center;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;}'
