    + '.ui-face .em{font-size:28px;transition:transform .2s var(--ease-out);}'
    + '.ui-face.on .em{transform:scale(1.18);}'
    + '.ui-otherrow{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;}'
    + '.ui-otherrow input{flex:1;min-width:0;}'
    + '.ui-rl{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);align-self:center;margin-right:2px;}'
    + '.ui-recents{margin:0 0 8px;}'
    + '.ui-notebtn{margin-top:10px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;padding:6px 2px;cursor:pointer;}'
    + 'textarea.ui-note{min-height:72px;margin-top:10px;}'
    /* stepper */
    + '.ui-stepper{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:20px;padding:6px;}'
    + '.ui-sbtn{width:56px;height:56px;border:none;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .15s,color .15s;}'
    + '.ui-sbtn:active{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);transform:scale(.88);}'
    + '.ui-sval{flex:1;text-align:center;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;line-height:1;}'
    + '.ui-sval b{font-size:32px;letter-spacing:-.02em;}'
    + '.ui-sval span{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin-left:5px;}'
    + '.ui-sval.empty b{color:var(--muted);opacity:.6;}'
    + '.ui-sval.bump{animation:uiBump .22s var(--ease-out);}'
    + '.ui-quick{margin-top:10px;}'
    /* cards (workout presets, quick-start) */
    + '.ui-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;}'
    + '.ui-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:74px;padding:8px 4px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;position:relative;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),border-color .15s,background .15s,box-shadow .15s;}'
    + '.ui-card .em{font-size:26px;line-height:1;}'
    + '.ui-card:active{transform:scale(.93);}'
    + '.ui-card.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 28%,transparent);}'
    /* tick-off list */
    + '.ui-prog{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden;margin:2px 0 6px;}'
    + '.ui-prog i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--green));transition:width .35s var(--ease-out);}'
    + '.ui-proglabel{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}'
    + '.ui-crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:0 0 6px;}'
    + '.ui-ctap{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:50px;padding:6px 12px;border:none;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .15s,opacity .2s;}'
    + '.ui-ctap:active{transform:scale(.97);}'
    + '.ui-cbox{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;}'
    + '.ui-cbox svg{width:16px;height:16px;opacity:0;transform:scale(.5);transition:opacity .15s,transform .2s var(--ease-out);stroke:var(--accent-ink);}'
    + '.ui-crow.done .ui-ctap{opacity:.62;}'
    + '.ui-crow.done .ui-ctap .t{text-decoration:line-through;}'
    + '.ui-crow.done .ui-cbox{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);}'
    + '.ui-crow.done .ui-cbox svg{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}'
    + '.ui-cx{width:36px;height:36px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;}'
    /* hustler exercise cards */
    + '.ui-ex{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:18px;padding:12px;margin:0 0 10px;}'
    + '.ui-ex.row-completing{animation:rowComplete .26s var(--ease-out) forwards;overflow:hidden;}'
    + '.ui-ex-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;}'
    + '.ui-ex-top input{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:800;}'
    + '.ui-ex-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;}'
    + '.ui-ex-grid label{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px;}'
    + '.ui-ex .ui-stepper{padding:4px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);gap:2px;}'
    + '.ui-ex .ui-sbtn{width:34px;height:40px;font-size:20px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:none;}'
    + '.ui-ex .ui-sval b{font-size:19px;}'
    + '.ui-pick{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:42px;padding:8px 12px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .15s;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}'
    + '.ui-pick span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}'
    + '.ui-pick:active{transform:scale(.97);}'
    + '.ui-pick.on{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--ink);}'
    + '.field-card > .ui-pick{min-height:48px;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px;}'
    + '.ui-sheetbody{padding:6px 2px 14px;}'
    + '.ui-sheetdone{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px;min-height:50px;font-size:15px;}'
    /* the small "pop" for whatever was just tapped */
    + '.just{animation:uiPop .42s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1);}'
    + '.pill.just::after,.ui-card.just::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:inherit;border:2px solid var(--accent);opacity:0;animation:uiRing .5s var(--ease-out);pointer-events:none;}'
    + '.checkbox{position:relative;}.checkbox::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-9px 0 -9px -9px;}'   /* same look, bigger invisible tap area (it was 26px) */
    + '.scale-dot.just,.checkbox.just{animation:uiPop .42s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1);}'
    + '@keyframes uiPop{0%{transform:scale(.82)}55%{transform:scale(1.14)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}'
    + '@keyframes uiRing{0%{opacity:.9;transform:scale(.9)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.28)}}'
    + '@keyframes uiBump{0%{transform:scale(.9)}60%{transform:scale(1.08)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}'
    + '@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.just,.ui-sval.bump,.pill.just::after,.ui-card.just::after{animation:none!important}}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'ui-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* ---------- chips: pick ONE (tap again to clear), plus "Other..." for anything else ---------- */
    function chipBtn(label, on, attrs, em, extraCls){
      return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+(extraCls||'')+'" '+attrs+' aria-pressed="'+(on?'true':'false')+'">'
        + (em ? '<span class="em">'+em+'</span>' : '')+E(label)+'</button>';
    }
    function otherRow(ds,pid,key){
      if(!OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|o']) return '';
      return '<div class="ui-otherrow"><input class="textline ui-other" data-k="'+E(K(ds,pid,key))+'" placeholder="Type it here" '+D('addother',ds,pid,key)+'>'
        + '<button type="button" class="pill active red" '+D('addother',ds,pid,key)+'>Add</button></div>';
    }
    function singleChips(ds,pid,key,val,spec){
      val = val==null ? '' : String(val);
      var opts = spec.opts.slice(), custom = (val && opts.indexOf(val)<0) ? val : null, em = spec.em || {};
      var h = '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">';
      opts.forEach(function(o){ var on = val===o; h += chipBtn(spec.fmt ? spec.fmt(o) : o, on, D('set',ds,pid,key,o), em[o], (spec.face?' ui-face':'')+justCls('c'+key+o)); });
      if(custom) h += chipBtn(custom, true, D('set',ds,pid,key,custom), null, justCls('c'+key+custom));
      if(spec.other!==false && window.OTHERS) OTHERS.list(pid+'.'+key, opts.concat(custom?[custom]:[])).forEach(function(o){ h += chipBtn(o, false, D('set',ds,pid,key,o), null, ' sugg'); });
      if(spec.other!==false) h += chipBtn('+ Other', false, D('other',ds,pid,key), null, ' more');
      return h + '</div>' + otherRow(ds,pid,key);
    }

    /* ---------- chips: pick SEVERAL (saved as "A, B, C"), optional note ----------
       A value looks like  "Calm, Focused — long day".  Words before the dash are chips, text after it is a note.
       Old free-text entries (sentences) are kept whole as the note, so nothing is lost. */
    function parseMulti(v){
      v = v==null ? '' : String(v); var i = v.indexOf(' — '), head = v, note = '';
      if(i>=0){ head = v.slice(0,i); note = v.slice(i+3); }
      var toks = head ? head.split(/\s*,\s*/).filter(Boolean) : [];
      var chiplike = toks.every(function(t){ return t.length<=28 && !/[.!?\n]/.test(t); });
      if(!chiplike) return { tok:[], note:v };
      return { tok:toks, note:note };
    }
    function buildMulti(tok, note){ var h = tok.join(', '); return note ? (h ? h+' — '+note : note) : h; }
    function multiChips(ds,pid,key,val,spec){
      var m = parseMulti(val), opts = spec.opts, extra = m.tok.filter(function(t){ return opts.indexOf(t)<0; });
      var h = '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">';
      opts.concat(extra).forEach(function(o){ var on = m.tok.indexOf(o)>=0; h += chipBtn(o, on, D('tog',ds,pid,key,o), null, justCls('c'+key+o)); });
      if(spec.other!==false && window.OTHERS) OTHERS.list(pid+'.'+key, opts.concat(extra)).forEach(function(o){ h += chipBtn(o, false, D('tog',ds,pid,key,o), null, ' sugg'); });
      h += chipBtn('+ Other', false, D('other',ds,pid,key), null, ' more') + '</div>' + otherRow(ds,pid,key);
      if(spec.note){
        var open = !!m.note || OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|n'];
        h += open ? '<textarea class="freewrite ui-note" placeholder="Add a note (optional)" '+D('note',ds,pid,key)+'>'+E(m.note)+'</textarea>'
                  : '<button type="button" class="ui-notebtn" '+D('opennote',ds,pid,key)+'>✎ Add a note</button>';
      }
      return h;
    }

    /* ---------- steppers: big - / + buttons, press-and-hold to run, quick chips underneath ---------- */
    var KIND = {
      min:  { parse:function(s){ var m = /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/.exec(String(s||'')); if(!m) return null; var n = parseFloat(m[1]); return /h(our|r)?s?\b/i.test(s) && !/min/i.test(s) ? n*60 : n; },
              fmt:function(n){ return Math.round(n)+' min'; }, disp:function(n){ return [String(Math.round(n)),'min']; }, step:5, min:5, max:300, def:30 },
      hrs:  { parse:function(s){ var n = parseFloat(String(s||'').replace(',','.')); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; },
              fmt:function(n){ return String(Math.round(n*2)/2); }, disp:function(n){ return [String(Math.round(n*2)/2),'h']; }, step:.5, min:0, max:24, def:2 },
      num:  { parse:function(s){ var n = parseFloat(String(s||'')); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; },
              fmt:function(n){ return String(Math.round(n)); }, disp:function(n){ return [String(Math.round(n)),'']; }, step:1, min:0, max:999, def:1 },
      /* big: any whole number that can run into the thousands (reach, views, followers, sessions) */
      big:  { parse:function(s){ var n = parseFloat(String(s||'').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,'')); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; },
              fmt:function(n){ return String(Math.round(n)); }, disp:function(n){ return [Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'),'']; }, step:10, min:0, max:1000000000, def:100 },
      /* money: whole dollars (or cents) with a $ sign; used for Hustler income, costs and trade results */
      money:{ parse:function(s){ var t = String(s||'').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''); var n = parseFloat(t); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; },
              fmt:function(n){ return String(Math.round(n*100)/100); },
              disp:function(n){ n = Math.round(n*100)/100; var a = Math.abs(n); return [(n<0?'-':'')+'$'+a.toLocaleString('en-US'),'']; },
              step:10, min:-1000000, max:10000000, def:100 },
      time: { parse:function(s){
                var m = /(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*([ap])?m?/i.exec(String(s||'')); if(!m) return null;
                var h = +m[1], mi = +(m[2]||0), ap = m[3] ? m[3].toLowerCase() : '';
                if(ap==='p' && h<12) h += 12; else if(ap==='a' && h===12) h = 0; else if(!ap && h>=6 && h<=11) h += 12;
                return (h%24)*60 + mi; },
              fmt:function(n){ n = ((Math.round(n)%1440)+1440)%1440; var h = Math.floor(n/60), mi = n%60, ap = h>=12 ? 'pm' : 'am', h12 = h%12 || 12; return h12+':'+(mi<10?'0':'')+mi+' '+ap; },
              disp:function(n){ n = ((Math.round(n)%1440)+1440)%1440; var h = Math.floor(n/60), mi = n%60, h12 = h%12 || 12; return [h12+':'+(mi<10?'0':'')+mi, h>=12?'pm':'am']; },
              step:15, min:0, max:1440, def:22*60+30, wrap:true }
    };
    function stepperHtml(kind, curVal, attrsMinus, attrsPlus, idAttr){
      var k = KIND[kind], n = k.parse(curVal), d = n==null ? ['—',''] : k.disp(n);
      return '<div class="ui-stepper" '+(idAttr||'')+'>'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less" '+attrsMinus+'>−</button>'
        + '<div class="ui-sval'+(n==null?' empty':'')+'"><b>'+E(d[0])+'</b>'+(d[1]?'<span>'+E(d[1])+'</span>':'')+'</div>'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More" '+attrsPlus+'>+</button></div>';
    }
    function stepSpec(ds,pid,key,val,spec){
      var k = KIND[spec.kind], kk = E(K(ds,pid,key));
      var h = stepperHtml(spec.kind, val, D('step',ds,pid,key,null,' data-dir="-1"'), D('step',ds,pid,key,null,' data-dir="1"'), 'data-k="'+kk+'"');
      if(spec.quick){
        var curN = k.parse(val);
        h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick" data-kq="'+kk+'">';
        spec.quick.forEach(function(q){
          var s = spec.kind==='hrs' || spec.kind==='num' || spec.kind==='money' || spec.kind==='big' ? String(q) : (spec.kind==='min' ? q+' min' : q);
          var on = curN!=null && k.parse(s)===curN;
          h += chipBtn(spec.lab ? spec.lab(q) : (spec.kind==='hrs' ? q+'h' : (spec.kind==='money' ? (q<0 ? '-$'+(-q).toLocaleString('en-US') : '$'+Number(q).toLocaleString('en-US')) : (spec.kind==='big' ? Number(q).toLocaleString('en-US') : s))), on, D('put',ds,pid,key,s), null, justCls('q'+key+s));
        });
        h += '</div>';
      }
      return h;
    }
    function clampStep(spec, n, dir){
      var k = KIND[spec.kind], step = spec.step || k.step, lo = spec.min!=null ? spec.min : k.min, hi = spec.max!=null ? spec.max : k.max;
      if(n==null) return spec.def!=null ? spec.def : k.def;
      n = n + dir*step;
      if(k.wrap) return ((n%1440)+1440)%1440;
      return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));
    }

    /* ---------- what is tap-able where.  Key = pageId.fieldKey ---------- */
    var WINS = ['Deep work','Finished a task','Stayed off my phone','Trained','Said no','Learned something','Helped someone'].concat(isSober ? ['Stayed sober'] : []);
    var S = {
      /* movement */
      'workout.duration':  { t:'step', kind:'min', quick:[20,30,45,60,90] },
      'workout.intensity': { t:'single', opts:['Light','Moderate','Hard'], other:false },
      'workout.stepGoal':  { t:'single', opts:['5000','7500','8000','10000','12000'], fmt:function(o){ return Number(o).toLocaleString('en-US'); } },
      'workout.location':  { t:'single', opts:['Gym','Home','Outdoors','Park','Studio','Pool'] },
      /* food */
      'dashboard.breakfast':{ t:'multi', opts:['Eggs','Oats','Toast','Fruit','Yogurt','Smoothie','Rice','Coffee only','Skipped'] },
      'dashboard.lunch':    { t:'multi', opts:['Rice','Chicken','Fish','Salad','Soup','Noodles','Pasta','Veggies','Eggs','Beef','Tofu','Skipped'] },
      'dashboard.dinner':   { t:'multi', opts:['Rice','Chicken','Fish','Salad','Soup','Noodles','Pasta','Veggies','Eggs','Beef','Tofu','Skipped'] },
      'dashboard.feel':     { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Energised','Calm','Happy','Focused','Tired','Stressed','Low','Anxious','Proud','Heavy'] },
      'dashboard.win':      { t:'multi', note:true, opts:WINS },
      /* mind */
      'journal.mood':      { t:'single', face:true, other:false, opts:['Great','Good','Okay','Low','Rough','Anxious','Stressed','Tired'],
                             em:{Great:'😄',Good:'🙂',Okay:'😐',Low:'😕',Rough:'😣',Anxious:'😰',Stressed:'😤',Tired:'😴'} },
      'journal.oneword':   { t:'single', opts:['Calm','Focused','Grateful','Tired','Driven','Free','Steady','Hopeful','Strong','Present','Restless','Proud','Light'] },
      'journal.intention': { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Stay present','Be kind to myself','Finish what matters','Move my body','Say no when needed','Stay off my phone','Be patient','Show up'] },
      'journal.remember':  { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['A good meal','Time with someone','Sunshine','A small win','Rest','Laughter','Nature','Learning something'] },
      'journal.oneThing':  { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Stay on track','Move','Rest','Reach out','Eat well','Sleep early','Be patient'] },
      'night.intention':   { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Wake early','Workout','Deep work first','Eat well','Call someone','Early night','Stay off my phone'] },
      'night.reflection':  { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Good day','Proud of myself','Stayed on track','Tough but okay','Could do better','Grateful','Learned something','Rested'] },
      'night.lightsOut':   { t:'step', kind:'time', quick:['9:30 pm','10:00 pm','10:30 pm','11:00 pm','11:30 pm','12:00 am'] },
      'night.routineTime': { t:'step', kind:'time', def:21*60, quick:['8:00 pm','9:00 pm','10:00 pm'] },
      'night.routine':     { t:'multi', opts:['Skincare','Stretch','Read','Journal','Tea','Shower','Meditate','Plan tomorrow'] },
      'mindfocus.win':       { t:'multi', note:true, opts:WINS },
      'mindfocus.distracted':{ t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Phone','Social media','Messages','Noise','Tiredness','Worry','Snacking','Meetings'] },
      'mindfocus.distractions':{ t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Phone','Social media','Messages','Noise','Tiredness','Worry','Snacking','Meetings'] },
      'mindfocus.hrs':       { t:'step', kind:'hrs', quick:[1,2,3,4,6,8] },
      'mindfocus.totalHrs':  { t:'step', kind:'hrs', quick:[1,2,3,4,6,8] },
      'mindfocus.screenHrs': { t:'step', kind:'hrs', def:3, quick:[1,2,3,4,6,8] },
      'checkin.win':       { t:'multi', note:true, opts:WINS },
      'checkin.helped':    { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Exercise','Talking to someone','A walk','Breathing','Good sleep','Music','Meditation','Reading','Cold shower','Journalling'] },
      'shower.feel':       { t:'single', opts:['Fresh','Energised','Relaxed','Clean','Sleepy','Cold'] },
      'shower.note':       { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Cold finish','Skincare','Hair care','Shaved','Long relax','Quick rinse'] },
      'reading.timeSpent': { t:'step', kind:'min', def:20, quick:[10,20,30,45,60] },
      'reading.chapter':   { t:'step', kind:'num' },
      'reading.why':       { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['To learn','To relax','To grow','Curiosity','Recommended','Escape'] }
    };
    var GRAT = ['Family','Friends','Health','Home','Food','Sleep','Sunshine','Work','Music','My body','A quiet moment','Progress'].concat(isSober ? ['Being sober'] : []);

    /* ---------- "pickers": small tap-to-choose buttons for rows that repeat (routine steps, gratitude, products...).
       Tapping one opens a sheet of chips (your recent answers first). Typing is only the last resort. ---------- */
    var PICK = {
      'night.routine':     { title:'Routine step', opts:['Skincare','Stretch','Read','Journal','Tea','Shower','Meditate','Plan tomorrow','Prep clothes'] },
      'night.routineTime': { title:'What time?', step:{ kind:'time', def:21*60, quick:['8:00 pm','9:00 pm','10:00 pm','11:00 pm'] } },
      'night.grat':        { title:'Grateful for', opts:GRAT },
      'night.g':           { title:'Grateful for', opts:GRAT },
      'journal.grat':      { title:'Grateful for', opts:GRAT },
      /* Clean: these two read the products already in your rotation first, then the product catalogue, so the shower
         box, the rotation and the brand all agree (see wizard_patch.js, window.CATALOG) */
      'shower.product':    { title:'Product', opts:['Face wash','Cleanser','Shampoo','Conditioner','Body wash','Moisturiser','Sunscreen','Serum','Toner','Soap'], rot:function(){ return rotationNames(); } },
      'shower.brand':      { title:'Brand', opts:[], dyn:function(ds,pid,key){ return brandOptions(ds,key); } },
      'shower.feel':       { title:'How it feels after', opts:['Fresh','Soft','Smooth','Clean','Calm','Oily','Dry','Tight'] },
      'mindfocus.work':    { title:'What I worked on', opts:['Deep work','Planning','Coding','Writing','Study','Admin','Email','Meetings'] },
      'mindfocus.hrs':     { title:'Hours', step:{ kind:'hrs', def:1, quick:[0.5,1,1.5,2,3] } }
    };
    /* priorities / objectives: tap from a list (typing is still there as "Something else") */
    var PRIO = ['Deep work','Workout','Read','Plan the day','Finish a task','Call someone','Tidy up','Study','Early night'].concat(isHustler ? ['Post content','Follow up leads','Review numbers','Send invoices'] : []);
    PICK['dashboard.obj'] = { title:'Priority', opts:PRIO };   /* the trailing number is stripped, so this covers obj1, obj2, obj3 */
    PICK['night.obj'] = { title:'Tomorrow\'s priority', opts:PRIO };
    S['dashboard.carry'] = { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['Follow up','Fix a mistake','Restock','Reply to messages','Plan tomorrow','Check the numbers','Rest'] };
    S['dashboard.notes'] = { t:'multi', note:true, opts:['An idea','A worry','A reminder','A win','A question','To research'] };
    function rotationNames(){ try{ return window.CATALOG ? window.CATALOG.rotation().map(function(p){ return p.name; }).filter(Boolean) : []; }catch(e){ return []; } }
    function rotationBrandOf(name){ try{ var r = window.CATALOG.rotation().filter(function(p){ return p.name===name; })[0]; return r ? r.brand : ''; }catch(e){ return ''; } }
    /* brands for "brand N": the brand of the product you picked in slot N, then the catalogue brands for that kind of product, then the common ones */
    function brandOptions(ds, key){
      var n = (/(\d+)$/.exec(key)||[])[1], prod = n ? (getPage(ds,'shower')['product'+n]||'') : '', out = [], C = window.CATALOG;
      if(!C) return [];
      var rb = rotationBrandOf(prod); if(rb) out.push(rb);
      var hit = C.findName(prod); if(hit){ out.push(hit.brand); C.brandsFor(hit.kind).forEach(function(b){ out.push(b); }); }
      else { var kind = ''; C.kinds.forEach(function(k){ if(!kind && prod && prod.toLowerCase().indexOf(k.toLowerCase())>=0) kind = k; }); if(kind) C.brandsFor(kind).forEach(function(b){ out.push(b); }); }
      C.rotation().forEach(function(p){ if(p.brand) out.push(p.brand); });
      return out.concat(C.allBrands.slice(0,16));
    }
    /* picking a product that is in your rotation (or a known catalogue product) fills the brand next to it, if that is still empty */
    function fillBrand(ds,pid,key,val){
      if(pid!=='shower' || !/^product\d+$/.test(key) || !val) return;
      var n = key.replace('product',''), pg = getPage(ds,'shower'); if(pg['brand'+n]) return;
      var b = rotationBrandOf(val) || ((window.CATALOG && window.CATALOG.findName(val)) || {}).brand || '';
      if(b) put(ds,'shower','brand'+n,b);
    }
    function pickSpec(pid,key){ var nk = key.replace(/\d+$/,''); return nk!==key ? PICK[pid+'.'+nk] : null; }
    function specFor(pid,key){ var sp = S[pid+'.'+key]; if(sp) return sp; var pk = pickSpec(pid,key); return pk && pk.step ? pk.step : null; }
    function pickBtn(ds,pid,key,val,ph){
      var has = val!=null && String(val)!=='', label = has ? val : (/^\d$/.test(ph||'') ? 'Pick #'+ph : (/_/.test(ph||'') ? '\u2014' : (ph && ph.length>1 && ph.length<=12 ? ph : 'Tap to pick')));
      return '<button type="button" class="ui-pick'+(has?' on':'')+justCls('pk'+key)+'" '+D('openpick',ds,pid,key)+'><span>'+E(label)+'</span></button>';
    }
    function openPick(ds,pid,key){
      var pk = pickSpec(pid,key); if(!pk) return;
      var val = getPage(ds,pid)[key]; val = val==null ? '' : String(val), body = '';
      if(pk.step){
        body = stepSpec(ds,pid,key,val,pk.step) + '<button type="button" class="pill active red ui-sheetdone" '+D('pickdone',ds,pid,key)+'>Done</button>';
      } else {
        var rc = []; for(var n=1;n<=6;n++){ rc = rc.concat(recents(ds,pid,key.replace(/\d+$/,'')+n)); }
        var all = [], rot = pk.rot ? pk.rot() : [], base = pk.dyn ? pk.dyn(ds,pid,key) : pk.opts;
        rc.concat(base).forEach(function(o){ if(all.indexOf(o)<0 && rot.indexOf(o)<0) all.push(o); });
        if(window.OTHERS) OTHERS.list(pid+'.'+key.replace(/\d+$/,''), all.concat(rot)).forEach(function(o){ all.push(o); });
        if(val && all.indexOf(val)<0 && rot.indexOf(val)<0) all.unshift(val);
        body = (rot.length ? '<div class="ui-rl" style="margin:0 0 8px;">In your rotation</div><div class="pill-row ui-chips">' + rot.map(function(o){ return chipBtn(o, o===val, D('pickset',ds,pid,key,o)); }).join('') + '</div><div class="ui-rl" style="margin:14px 0 8px;">Or pick a kind</div>' : '')
          + '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">' + all.map(function(o){ return chipBtn(o, o===val, D('pickset',ds,pid,key,o)); }).join('') + '</div>'
          + '<div class="ui-otherrow"><input class="textline ui-other" data-k="'+E(K(ds,pid,key))+'" placeholder="Something else\u2026" '+D('pickother',ds,pid,key)+'><button type="button" class="pill active red" '+D('pickother',ds,pid,key)+'>Add</button></div>';
      }
      if(val) body += '<button type="button" class="ui-notebtn" '+D('pickclear',ds,pid,key)+'>Clear this</button>';
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+E(pk.title)+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div><div class="ui-sheetbody">'+body+'</div>');
    }

    /* "Recent" chips for the text boxes that really are free text (titles, objectives, brands...) */
    function recents(ds,pid,key){
      var days = Object.keys(DB.days||{}).filter(function(d){ return d!==ds; }).sort().reverse(), out = [];
      for(var i=0;i<days.length && i<45 && out.length<4;i++){
        var pg = DB.days[days[i]].pages && DB.days[days[i]].pages[pid], v = pg && pg[key];
        if(typeof v==='string' && v.trim() && v.length<=40 && out.indexOf(v.trim())<0) out.push(v.trim());
      }
      if(pid==='reading' && (key==='title' || key==='author') && typeof libCurrentBook==='function'){
        try{ var b = libCurrentBook(), x = b && (key==='title' ? b.title : b.author); if(x && out.indexOf(x)<0) out.unshift(x); }catch(e){}
      }
      return out;
    }

    /* ---------- the replaced helpers ---------- */
    var baseText = textField, baseArea = areaField, baseCounter = counterField;
    textField = function(ds,pid,key,ph,val){
      if(pickSpec(pid,key)) return pickBtn(ds,pid,key,val,ph);
      var sp = S[pid+'.'+key];
      if(sp){
        if(sp.t==='single') return singleChips(ds,pid,key,val,sp);
        if(sp.t==='multi')  return multiChips(ds,pid,key,val,sp);
        if(sp.t==='step')   return stepSpec(ds,pid,key,val,sp);
      }
      /* not a known field: keep the normal text box, but offer your recent answers as one-tap chips */
      var rc = (!val) ? recents(ds,pid,key) : [];
      var h = '';
      if(rc.length){ h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-recents"><span class="ui-rl">Recent</span>'; rc.forEach(function(r){ h += chipBtn(r,false,D('set',ds,pid,key,r)); }); h += '</div>'; }
      return h + baseText(ds,pid,key,ph,val);
    };
    areaField = function(ds,pid,key,ph,val,cls){
      var sp = S[pid+'.'+key];
      if(sp && sp.t==='multi') return multiChips(ds,pid,key,val,sp);
      return baseArea(ds,pid,key,ph,val,cls);
    };
    /* counters keep their number box, and gain one-tap "+" chips */
    var QUICK_ADD = { 'workout.steps':[1000,2500,5000], 'reading.pagesToday':[5,10,20], 'workout.calories':[100,250,500], 'reading.minutes':[10,15,30] };
    counterField = function(ds,pid,key,val,step,suffix){
      var h = baseCounter(ds,pid,key,val,step,suffix), qa = QUICK_ADD[pid+'.'+key];
      if(qa){ h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">'; qa.forEach(function(n){ h += chipBtn('+'+n.toLocaleString('en-US'), false, D('bump',ds,pid,key,n), null, justCls('b'+key+n)); }); h += '</div>'; }
      if(pid==='workout' && key==='sleep'){ h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">'; [5,6,7,8,9].forEach(function(n){ h += chipBtn(n+'h', Number(val)===n, D('cset',ds,pid,key,n), null, justCls('s'+key+n)); }); h += '</div>'; }
      return h;
    };
    /* same markup as before, plus a "just" class so the tapped one pops */
    scaleTapper = function(ds,pid,key,max,val,redAtMax){
      var cells = '';
      for(var i=1;i<=max;i++){ var a = val>=i;
        cells += '<div class="scale-dot '+(a?'active':'')+' '+(a&&redAtMax?'red':'')+(JUST==='s'+key+i?' just':'')+'" onclick="setScale(\''+ds+'\',\''+pid+'\',\''+key+'\','+i+','+max+')">'+i+'</div>'; }
      return '<div class="scale-row">'+cells+'</div>';
    };
    var baseSetScale = setScale; setScale = function(ds,pid,key,val,max){ JUST = 's'+key+val; return baseSetScale(ds,pid,key,val,max); };
    pillGroup = function(ds,pid,key,options,val,colorClass){
      return '<div class="pill-row">'+options.map(function(o){
        var a = val===o;
        return '<button class="pill '+(a?'active '+(colorClass||''):'')+(JUST==='p'+key+o?' just':'')+'" onclick="setPill(\''+ds+'\',\''+pid+'\',\''+key+'\',\''+o+'\')">'+esc(o)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
    };
    var baseSetPill = setPill; setPill = function(ds,pid,key,val){ JUST = 'p'+key+val; return baseSetPill(ds,pid,key,val); };
    var baseToggleCheck = toggleCheck; toggleCheck = function(ds,pid,key){ JUST = 'k'+pid+key; return baseToggleCheck(ds,pid,key); };
    checkRow = function(ds,pid,key,label){
      var p = getPage(ds,pid), c = !!(p.checks && p.checks[key]);
      return '<div class="check-row '+(c?'struck':'')+'"><div class="checkbox '+(c?'checked':'')+(JUST==='k'+pid+key?' just':'')+'" onclick="toggleCheck(\''+ds+'\',\''+pid+'\',\''+key+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+'</div><div class="crow-text">'+esc(label)+'</div></div>';
    };

    /* CYCLE 5: the old Workout presets cards and tick-list log were removed (Movement replaced them in Cycle 3). Only the two small helpers below stay, because old saved logs are still read by them. */
    function parseLog(v){
      var items = [], legacy = false;
      String(v||'').split('\n').forEach(function(l){ if(!l.trim()) return; var m = /^([•✓])\s?(.*)$/.exec(l); if(m) items.push({ d:m[1]==='✓', t:m[2] }); else legacy = true; });
      return { items:items, legacy:legacy };
    }
    function logText(items){ return items.map(function(i){ return (i.d?'✓ ':'• ')+i.t; }).join('\n'); }

    /* =====================================================================================================
       HUSTLER'S workout: preset cards fill the exercise list in one tap, sets / reps / kg become steppers
       ===================================================================================================== */
    var EXK = { sets:{ def:3, min:1, max:12, step:1 }, reps:{ def:10, min:1, max:60, step:1 }, weight:{ def:20, min:0, max:500, step:2.5 } };
    var EX_MOVES = ['Bench Press','Squat','Deadlift','Overhead Press','Pull-ups','Barbell Row','Lunges','Plank'];
    function exStepper(ds,i,key,val,label){
      var s = String(val==null?'':val), n = parseFloat(s), has = isFinite(n) && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s);
      var disp = has ? String(n) : (s ? s : '—');
      return '<div><label>'+label+'</label><div class="ui-stepper" data-xk="'+ds+'|'+i+'|'+key+'">'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less" data-ui="exstep" data-ds="'+ds+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-key="'+key+'" data-dir="-1">−</button>'
        + '<div class="ui-sval'+(s?'':' empty')+'"><b>'+E(disp)+'</b></div>'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More" data-ui="exstep" data-ds="'+ds+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-key="'+key+'" data-dir="1">+</button></div></div>';
    }
    if(isHustler){
      workoutBody = function(dateStr){
        var p = getPage(dateStr,'workout'); if(!p.exercises) p.exercises = [];
        var openEx = p.exercises.map(function(ex,i){ return {ex:ex,i:i}; }).filter(function(x){ return !x.ex.done || PENDING_COMPLETE_EX.has(dateStr+':'+x.i); });
        var totalDone = p.exercises.filter(function(ex){ return ex.done; }).length, doneCount = totalDone - openEx.filter(function(x){ return x.ex.done; }).length;
        /* quick start: your saved presets first, then the built-in suggestions you have not saved yet */
        var saved = workoutPresetList(), cards = '';
        saved.slice(0,6).forEach(function(pr){ cards += '<button type="button" class="ui-card" data-ui="expreset" data-ds="'+dateStr+'" data-val="id:'+E(pr.id)+'"><span class="em">'+presetEm(pr.name)+'</span>'+E(pr.name)+'</button>'; });
        WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS.forEach(function(s,idx){ if(saved.some(function(pr){ return pr.name===s.name; })) return; cards += '<button type="button" class="ui-card" data-ui="expreset" data-ds="'+dateStr+'" data-val="s:'+idx+'"><span class="em">'+presetEm(s.name)+'</span>'+E(s.name)+'</button>'; });
        var exRows = openEx.map(function(x){
          var ex = x.ex, i = x.i;
          return '<div class="ui-ex'+(ex.done?' done':'')+'" id="ex-row-'+i+'"><div class="ui-ex-top">'
            + '<input class="textline" placeholder="Exercise" value="'+E(ex.name)+'" oninput="updateExRow(\''+dateStr+'\','+i+',\'name\',this.value)" '+(ex.done?'disabled':'')+'>'
            + '<div class="checkbox '+(ex.done?'checked':'')+'" style="width:30px;height:30px" onclick="toggleExDone(\''+dateStr+'\','+i+')">'+(ex.done?icon('check',14):'')+'</div></div>'
            + '<div class="ui-ex-grid">'+exStepper(dateStr,i,'sets',ex.sets,'Sets')+exStepper(dateStr,i,'reps',ex.reps,'Reps')+exStepper(dateStr,i,'weight',ex.weight,'Kg')+'</div></div>';
        }).join('');
        var movesAdd = '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">'+EX_MOVES.map(function(m){ return chipBtn('+ '+m,false,'data-ui="exadd" data-ds="'+dateStr+'" data-val="'+E(m)+'"'); }).join('')
          + '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip more" onclick="addExRow(\''+dateStr+'\')">+ Other</button></div>';
        return copyYesterdayBar(dateStr,'workout')
          + fieldWrap('Session type', null, pillGroup(dateStr,'workout','type',WORKOUT_TYPES,p.type,'red'))
          + fieldWrap('Quick start', 'One tap loads the whole workout — then just tick it off.', '<div class="ui-cards">'+cards+'</div><button class="lib-newbook-link" style="margin-top:10px;" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'workoutPresets\')">'+icon('gear',13)+' Manage presets</button>')
          + fieldWrap('Duration', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','duration','e.g. 45 min',p.duration))
          + fieldWrap('Intensity', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','intensity','e.g. Moderate',p.intensity))
          + fieldWrap('Location', null, textField(dateStr,'workout','location','Where',p.location))
          + fieldWrap('Steps today', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','steps',p.steps,500))
          + fieldWrap('Calories burned', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','calories',p.calories,50))
          + fieldWrap('Sleep last night (hrs)', null, counterField(dateStr,'workout','sleep',p.sleep,0.5,'h'))
          + fieldWrap('Exercise log', 'Tap the circle to mark an exercise done — it clears off the list once checked.',
              (openEx.length ? exRows : (doneCount ? '' : '<div class="empty-note" style="padding:14px 4px;">Nothing yet — tap a quick start above or add a move.</div>'))
              + movesAdd
              + (doneCount ? '<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="toggleShowDoneExercises(\''+dateStr+'\')">'+icon(SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES?'chevright':'check',12)+' '+(SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES?'Hide':'Show')+' '+doneCount+' completed</button>' : '')
              + (SHOW_DONE_EXERCISES ? renderDoneExercises(dateStr,p) : '')
              + (trashCount('exercise', function(ctx){ return ctx.dateStr===dateStr; }) ? '<button class="crow-done-toggle" onclick="openTrashSheet(\'exercise\',\''+dateStr+'\')">'+icon('trash',12)+' Trash ('+trashCount('exercise', function(ctx){ return ctx.dateStr===dateStr; })+')</button>' : ''))
          + fieldWrap('Energy', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','energy',5,p.energy||0,true))
          + fieldWrap('Soreness', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','soreness',5,p.soreness||0,true))
          + fieldWrap('Recovery', null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'workout','recovery',5,p.recovery||0,true));
      };
    }
    function presetEm(n){ n = String(n).toLowerCase(); return /push/.test(n)?'💪':/pull/.test(n)?'🚣':/leg/.test(n)?'🦵':/run|sprint|cardio/.test(n)?'🏃':/yoga|mobil/.test(n)?'🧘':'🏋️'; }

    /* =====================================================================================================
       ONE click handler for all the new controls (they use data- attributes instead of inline code)
       ===================================================================================================== */
    function after(id){ redraw(id); }
    function doAct(b){
      var act = b.getAttribute('data-ui'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), pid = b.getAttribute('data-pid'), key = b.getAttribute('data-key'), val = b.getAttribute('data-val');
      var pg, cur, m, sp;
      switch(act){
        case 'set':   cur = (getPage(ds,pid)[key]||''); if(cur!==val && window.OTHERS) OTHERS.use(pid+'.'+key, val); put(ds,pid,key, cur===val ? '' : val); return after('c'+key+val);
        case 'put':   put(ds,pid,key,val); return after('q'+key+val);
        case 'tog':   m = parseMulti(getPage(ds,pid)[key]); var ix = m.tok.indexOf(val); if(ix>=0) m.tok.splice(ix,1); else { m.tok.push(val); if(window.OTHERS) OTHERS.use(pid+'.'+key, val); }
                      put(ds,pid,key, buildMulti(m.tok, m.note)); return after('c'+key+val);
        case 'other': OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|o'] = !OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|o']; render();
                      setTimeout(function(){ var i = document.querySelector('.ui-other'); if(i) i.focus(); }, 30); return;
        case 'addother': var inp = document.querySelector('.ui-other[data-k="'+K(ds,pid,key)+'"]'), t = inp ? inp.value.trim() : '';
                      OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|o'] = false; if(!t){ render(); return; }
                      sp = S[pid+'.'+key];
                      if(window.OTHERS) OTHERS.add(pid+'.'+key, t);
                      if(sp && sp.t==='multi'){ m = parseMulti(getPage(ds,pid)[key]); if(m.tok.indexOf(t)<0) m.tok.push(t); put(ds,pid,key,buildMulti(m.tok,m.note)); }
                      else put(ds,pid,key,t);
                      return after('c'+key+t);
        case 'opennote': OPEN[K(ds,pid,key)+'|n'] = true; render(); setTimeout(function(){ var n = document.querySelector('textarea.ui-note'); if(n) n.focus(); }, 30); return;
        case 'openpick': openPick(ds,pid,key); return;
        case 'pickset':  cur = (getPage(ds,pid)[key]||''); if(cur!==val && window.OTHERS) OTHERS.use(pid+'.'+key.replace(/\d+$/,''), val); put(ds,pid,key, cur===val ? '' : val); fillBrand(ds,pid,key,cur===val ? '' : val); closeSheet(); return after('pk'+key);
        case 'pickother': var pin = document.querySelector('.ui-other[data-k="'+K(ds,pid,key)+'"]'), pt = pin ? pin.value.trim() : ''; if(!pt) return; if(window.OTHERS) OTHERS.add(pid+'.'+key.replace(/\d+$/,''), pt); put(ds,pid,key,pt); fillBrand(ds,pid,key,pt); closeSheet(); return after('pk'+key);
        case 'pickclear': put(ds,pid,key,''); closeSheet(); return after(null);
        case 'pickdone':  closeSheet(); return after('pk'+key);
        case 'bump':  JUST = 'b'+key+val; bumpCounter(ds,pid,key,Number(val)); return;
        case 'cset':  setCounterDirect(ds,pid,key,val); flashSaved(); return after('s'+key+val);
        /* workout presets (non-Hustler) */
        /* Hustler */
        case 'expreset': var pr;
                      if(val.indexOf('id:')===0) pr = DB.workoutPresets[val.slice(3)];
                      else { var sg = WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS[Number(val.slice(2))]; pr = workoutPresetList().filter(function(x){ return x.name===sg.name; })[0] || addWorkoutPresetFromSuggestion(sg); }
                      if(!pr) return; pg = getPage(ds,'workout');
                      if(!pg.type) pg.type = /run|cardio|sprint/i.test(pr.name) ? 'Cardio' : 'Strength';
                      if(!pg.duration) pg.duration = /run|sprint/i.test(pr.name) ? '40 min' : '45 min';
                      loadWorkoutPreset(ds, pr.id); return;
        case 'exadd': pg = getPage(ds,'workout'); if(!pg.exercises) pg.exercises = []; pg.exercises.push({ name:val, sets:'3', reps:'10', weight:'', done:false }); markTouched(ds,'workout'); flashSaved(); return after(null);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-ui]'); if(!b) return;
      var act = b.getAttribute('data-ui');
      /* tapping INTO a typing box must never run its action (that closed the "Move name" box before you could type: Enter and the Add button do the saving) */
      if(/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      if(act==='step' || act==='exstep'){ if(e.detail===0) stepBtn(b); return; }   /* real taps are handled by the press code below; keyboard "click" has detail 0 */
      if(act==='note') return;
      doAct(b);
    });
    /* typing in a note box: keep the chips part, replace the note, save quietly (no redraw = no lost cursor) */
    document.addEventListener('input', function(e){
      var t = e.target; if(!t || t.getAttribute('data-ui')!=='note') return;
      var ds = t.getAttribute('data-ds'), pid = t.getAttribute('data-pid'), key = t.getAttribute('data-key');
      var m = parseMulti(getPage(ds,pid)[key]); setText(ds,pid,key, buildMulti(m.tok, t.value));
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      var t = e.target; if(e.key!=='Enter' || !t || !t.classList || !t.classList.contains('ui-other')) return;
      e.preventDefault(); doAct(t);
    });

    /* ---------- steppers: tap = one step, hold = keeps going. Swiping to scroll never steps. ---------- */
    function pop(sv){ sv.classList.remove('bump'); void sv.offsetWidth; sv.classList.add('bump'); }
    function stepBtn(b){
      var act = b.getAttribute('data-ui'), dir = Number(b.getAttribute('data-dir')), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), key = b.getAttribute('data-key');
      if(act==='exstep'){
        var i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')), pg = getPage(ds,'workout'), ex = pg.exercises && pg.exercises[i]; if(!ex) return;
        var sp = EXK[key], n = parseFloat(ex[key]); if(!isFinite(n)) n = null;
        n = n==null ? sp.def : Math.max(sp.min, Math.min(sp.max, n + dir*sp.step)); ex[key] = String(n);
        markTouched(ds,'workout');
        var sv = b.parentNode.querySelector('.ui-sval'); if(sv){ sv.classList.remove('empty'); sv.firstChild.textContent = String(n); pop(sv); }
        return;
      }
      var pid = b.getAttribute('data-pid'), spec = specFor(pid,key); if(!spec) return;
      var k = KIND[spec.kind], nv = clampStep(spec, k.parse(getPage(ds,pid)[key]), dir), s = k.fmt(nv);
      setText(ds,pid,key,s);
      var host = b.closest('.ui-stepper'), sv2 = host && host.querySelector('.ui-sval');
      if(sv2){ var d = k.disp(nv); sv2.classList.remove('empty'); sv2.innerHTML = '<b>'+E(d[0])+'</b>'+(d[1]?'<span>'+E(d[1])+'</span>':''); pop(sv2); }
      var qc = document.querySelector('[data-kq="'+K(ds,pid,key)+'"]');
      if(qc) Array.prototype.forEach.call(qc.querySelectorAll('[data-ui="put"]'), function(c){ var on = k.parse(c.getAttribute('data-val'))===nv; c.classList.toggle('on', on); c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on?'true':'false'); });
      flashSaved();
    }
    var rep = null;
    function endRep(ok){ if(!rep) return; var r = rep; rep = null; clearTimeout(r.t); clearInterval(r.i); if(ok && !r.held) stepBtn(r.b); }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-ui="step"],[data-ui="exstep"]'); if(!b) return;
      endRep(false); rep = { b:b, x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY, held:false };
      rep.t = setTimeout(function(){ if(!rep) return; rep.held = true; stepBtn(b); rep.i = setInterval(function(){ stepBtn(b); }, 110); }, 380);
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){ if(rep && !rep.held && Math.hypot(e.clientX-rep.x, e.clientY-rep.y) > 9) endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', function(){ endRep(true); });
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', function(){ endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ui-sbtn')) e.preventDefault(); });

    window.UI = { specs:S, workoutPresets:[], parseMulti:parseMulti, buildMulti:buildMulti, parseLog:parseLog, quickAdd:QUICK_ADD, kinds:KIND, justCls:justCls, picks:PICK };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('tap-first inputs', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   UNLIMITED LISTS, TAP-FIRST  (Bot A, task 10)
   -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   What this does, in plain words:
   1. Every list in setup and on the monthly pages (products, perfumes, books, objectives, income streams,
      goals, rewards, habits) now has an "Add" button, and you can add as many as you like. Each card can be
      removed again (tap the x twice, so a slip of the thumb cannot delete anything).
   2. Adding is done by TAPPING: a sheet of choices opens, you tap one or several, then "Add". Typing is the
      last resort and always sits behind a "+ Other" chip, also inside setup.
   3. The boxes that used to be typed (vision-board words, brand, author, notes, money amounts...) are now
      buttons that open a sheet of tap choices. Money and hours use + / - steppers with quick chips.
   4. Your saved data keeps the same shape. Old backups still import: the first book in a group still lives where
      it always did, extra ones sit in a new "..._more" list that older versions simply ignore.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    var KEY = String(typeof STORAGE_KEY!=='undefined' ? STORAGE_KEY : '');
    var FAM = /^clean/.test(KEY) ? 'clean' : /^reading/.test(KEY) ? 'reading' : /^sober/.test(KEY) ? 'sober' : /^(hustler|canvas)/.test(KEY) ? 'hustler' : '';
    if(!FAM) return;
    var BOY = /boy/.test(KEY);
    var E = esc;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ styles ------------------------- */
    var css = ''
    + '.ls-lab{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 8px;}'
    + '.ls-lab:first-child{margin-top:2px;}'
    + '.ls-body{display:block;}'
    + '.ls-go{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:16px;min-height:50px;border:none;border-radius:16px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),opacity .15s;}'
    + '.ls-go:active{transform:scale(.98);}'
    + '.ls-go[disabled]{opacity:.4;}'
    + '.ls-go{position:sticky;bottom:calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:2;box-shadow:0 -12px 14px -4px var(--surface,#fff),0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}'
    + '.ls-num{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin:6px 0 10px;}'
    + '.ls-num button{min-width:48px;height:48px;border:none;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}'
    + '.ls-num button:active{transform:scale(.94);}'
    + '.ls-nv{flex:1;text-align:center;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.02em;}'
    + '.ls-nv small{font-size:13px;opacity:.6;margin-left:3px;}'
    + '.ls-card{position:relative;}'
    + '.ls-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;}'
    + '.ls-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;line-height:1.2;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0;}'
    + '.ls-x{flex:none;min-width:34px;height:34px;padding:0 8px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.ls-x.armed{background:#D64545;color:#fff;}'
    + '.ls-f{margin-top:10px;}'
    + '.ls-f .fc-hint{margin:0 0 4px;}'
    + '.ls-two{display:flex;gap:10px;}.ls-two>.ls-f{flex:1;min-width:0;}'
    + '.ls-add{margin-top:10px;}'
    + '.ui-pick.ls-wrap{height:auto;}.ui-pick.ls-wrap span{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3;}'
    + '.habit-name-input.ls-hbtn{display:flex;align-items:center;text-align:left;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:0 6px;touch-action:manipulation;overflow:hidden;}'
    + '.habit-name-input.ls-hbtn span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}'
    + '.habit-name-input.ls-hbtn.empty{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;}'
    + '.ls-names{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:0 0 10px;}'
    + '.ls-goalbtn{flex:1;min-width:0;}'
    + '.ls-empty{padding:14px 4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;}';
    css += '.ls-intro{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:14px;padding:11px 13px;margin:0 0 14px}.ls-intro b{color:var(--ink)}.ls-intro i{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'lists-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ small helpers ------------------ */
    function uniq(a){ var o = []; a.forEach(function(x){ if(x!=null && x!=='' && o.indexOf(x)<0) o.push(x); }); return o; }
    function getPath(obj, key){ var p = String(key).split('.'), o = obj; for(var i=0;i<p.length;i++){ if(o==null) return undefined; o = o[p[i]]; } return o; }
    function norm(key){ return String(key).replace(/\d+/g, '#'); }
    function isBlank(o){ if(!o) return true; return Object.keys(o).every(function(k){ var v = o[k]; return v==null || v==='' || v===0 || (typeof v==='object' && !Object.keys(v).length); }); }
    function mkOf(m){ return m || currentMonthKey(); }
    function pg(pid, mk){ return getMonthlyPage(pid, mk); }
    var MONTHS = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    function fmtShort(d){ var y = d.getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear() ? '' : ', '+d.getFullYear(); return MONTHS[d.getMonth()]+' '+d.getDate()+y; }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ "recent answers" for a field ---- */
    function collect(obj, parts, out){
      if(obj==null) return;
      if(!parts.length){ if(typeof obj==='string' && obj.trim() && obj.length<=40) out.push(obj.trim()); return; }
      var p = parts[0], rest = parts.slice(1);
      if(p==='#'){ Object.keys(obj).forEach(function(k){ collect(obj[k], rest, out); }); }
      else collect(obj[p], rest, out);
    }
    function recentsMF(pid, key){
      var out = [], parts = norm(key).split('.');
      Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).sort().reverse().slice(0,8).forEach(function(m){ collect((DB.monthly[m]||{})[pid], parts, out); });
      return uniq(out).slice(0,6);
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the tap sheet ------------------ */
    var SH = null;
    function stateOf(){ var o = {}; SH.secs.forEach(function(s){ o[s.id] = (s.num||s.date) ? s.val : s.sel.slice(); }); return o; }
    function fmtN(n){ n = Number(n); if(!isFinite(n)) return '0'; return Math.abs(n-Math.round(n))<1e-9 ? String(Math.round(n)) : String(Math.round(n*10)/10); }
    function secHtml(s, si){
      var h = '<div class="ls-sec">' + (s.label ? '<div class="ls-lab">'+E(s.label)+'</div>' : '');
      if(s.num){
        var n = s.num, big = n.step*10;
        h += '<div class="ls-num"><button type="button" data-ls="nstep" data-s="'+si+'" data-d="'+(-big)+'" aria-label="Minus '+fmtN(big)+'">−'+fmtN(big)+'</button><button type="button" data-ls="nstep" data-s="'+si+'" data-d="'+(-n.step)+'" aria-label="Minus">−</button>'
          + '<div class="ls-nv">'+E((n.prefix||'')+fmtN(s.val||0))+(n.unit?'<small>'+E(n.unit)+'</small>':'')+'</div>'
          + '<button type="button" data-ls="nstep" data-s="'+si+'" data-d="'+n.step+'" aria-label="Plus">+</button><button type="button" data-ls="nstep" data-s="'+si+'" data-d="'+big+'" aria-label="Plus '+fmtN(big)+'">+'+fmtN(big)+'</button></div>';
        if(n.quick) h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">'+n.quick.map(function(q){ return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(Number(s.val)===q?' on':'')+'" data-ls="nq" data-s="'+si+'" data-v="'+q+'">'+E((n.prefix||'')+fmtN(q)+(n.unit||''))+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
        return h + '</div>';
      }
      if(s.date){
        h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">'+s.date.map(function(q,qi){ return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip" data-ls="dq" data-s="'+si+'" data-v="'+qi+'">'+E(q[0])+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
          + '<div class="ls-lab">Or pick a day</div><input type="date" class="textline" data-ls-date="'+si+'">';
        return h + '</div>';
      }
      var opts = typeof s.opts==='function' ? s.opts(stateOf()) : s.opts;
      s._all = opts.concat(s.sel.filter(function(v){ return opts.indexOf(v)<0; }));
      s._sug = (s.other!==false && window.OTHERS) ? OTHERS.list(okey(si), s._all) : [];
      s._all = s._all.concat(s._sug);
      h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">' + s._all.map(function(o,oi){ var on = s.sel.indexOf(o)>=0; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+(s._sug.indexOf(o)>=0?' sugg':'')+'" data-ls="chip" data-s="'+si+'" data-o="'+oi+'" aria-pressed="'+(on?'true':'false')+'">'+E(o)+'</button>'; }).join('');
      if(s.other!==false) h += '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip more" data-ls="oth" data-s="'+si+'">+ Other</button>';
      h += '</div>';
      if(s.openO) h += '<div class="ui-otherrow"><input class="textline ls-other" data-s="'+si+'" maxlength="80" placeholder="Type it here"><button type="button" class="pill active red" data-ls="addoth" data-s="'+si+'">Add</button></div>';
      return h + '</div>';
    }
    function bodyHtml(){
      var h = SH.secs.map(secHtml).join('');
      if(SH.intro){ var st0 = stateOf(); h = '<div class="ls-intro">'+(typeof SH.intro==='function' ? SH.intro(st0) : SH.intro)+'</div>' + h; }
      if(!SH.instant){
        var st = stateOf(), n = SH.count ? SH.count(st) : 1, lab = SH.cta ? SH.cta(st, n) : 'Done';
        h += '<button type="button" class="ls-go" data-ls="done"'+(SH.needs && n<1 ? ' disabled' : '')+'>'+E(lab)+'</button>';
      }
      (SH.extra||[]).forEach(function(x,xi){ h += '<button type="button" class="ui-notebtn" data-ls="x" data-n="'+xi+'">'+E(x.label)+'</button>'; });
      return h;
    }

    function openLS(cfg){
      SH = cfg; cfg.secs.forEach(function(s){ s.sel = s.sel || []; });
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+E(cfg.title)+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div><div class="ui-sheetbody"><div class="ls-body" id="ls-body">'+bodyHtml()+'</div></div>');
    }
    function finish(){ var cb = SH && SH.done, st = SH && stateOf(); closeSheet(); SH = null; if(cb) cb(st); }
    /* the place key for "Other" suggestions: this sheet's title + this section */
    function okey(si){ var s = SH.secs[si]; return 'sheet:'+(SH.title||'')+'|'+(s.id||si); }
    function pickChip(si, val){
      var s = SH.secs[si], ix = s.sel.indexOf(val);
      if(ix<0 && window.OTHERS) OTHERS.use(okey(si), val);
      if(s.multi){ if(ix>=0) s.sel.splice(ix,1); else s.sel.push(val); repaint(); return; }
      if(ix>=0) s.sel = []; else s.sel = [val];
      if(SH.instant) return finish();
      if(SH.onChange){ try{ SH.onChange(stateOf(), SH.secs); }catch(e){} }   /* a sheet can tidy its other sections after a tap */
      repaint();
    }
    function onLS(b){
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-ls'), si = Number(b.getAttribute('data-s')), s;
      if(a==='chip'){ s = SH.secs[si]; return pickChip(si, s._all[Number(b.getAttribute('data-o'))]); }
      if(a==='oth'){ SH.secs[si].openO = !SH.secs[si].openO; repaint(); var i = document.querySelector('.ls-other'); if(i) setTimeout(function(){ i.focus(); }, 30); return; }
      if(a==='addoth'){ var inp = document.querySelector('.ls-other[data-s="'+si+'"]'), t = inp ? inp.value.trim() : ''; SH.secs[si].openO = false; if(!t) return repaint(); s = SH.secs[si]; if(window.OTHERS) OTHERS.add(okey(si), t); if(s.multi){ if(s.sel.indexOf(t)<0) s.sel.push(t); repaint(); } else { s.sel = [t]; if(SH.instant) return finish(); repaint(); } return; }
      if(a==='nstep'){ s = SH.secs[si]; var n = s.num, v = Number(s.val||0) + Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')); v = Math.max(n.min!=null?n.min:0, Math.min(n.max!=null?n.max:1e9, Math.round(v*100)/100)); s.val = v; repaint(); return; }
      if(a==='nq'){ SH.secs[si].val = Number(b.getAttribute('data-v')); repaint(); return; }
      if(a==='dq'){ s = SH.secs[si]; s.val = s.date[Number(b.getAttribute('data-v'))][1]; return finish(); }
      if(a==='done') return finish();
      if(a==='x'){ var x = SH.extra[Number(b.getAttribute('data-n'))]; closeSheet(); SH = null; if(x && x.act) x.act(); return; }
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ monthly fields as tap buttons --- */
    function specFor(pid, key){ return MS[pid+'.'+norm(key)] || null; }
    function disp(sp, val){ if(sp.t==='num') return (sp.prefix||'')+fmtN(val)+(sp.unit?' '+sp.unit:''); return String(val); }
    function fbtn(pid, mk, key, ph, val, sp){
      var has = val!=null && String(val)!=='', label = has ? disp(sp, val) : (sp.ph || 'Tap to choose');
      return '<button type="button" class="ui-pick'+(has?' on':'')+(sp.t==='multi'?' ls-wrap':'')+'" data-ls-mf="1" data-p="'+pid+'" data-m="'+mk+'" data-k="'+E(key)+'"><span>'+E(label)+'</span></button>';
    }
    /* Hustler's never had the shared monthly-field helpers (its pages typed straight into their own fields), so give it the same ones */
    if(typeof updateMonthlyField==='undefined'){
      window.updateMonthlyField = function(pageId, mk, key, val){ var o = getMonthlyPage(pageId, mk), p = String(key).split('.'); for(var i=0;i<p.length-1;i++){ if(!o[p[i]] || typeof o[p[i]]!=='object') o[p[i]] = {}; o = o[p[i]]; } o[p[p.length-1]] = val; saveDB(); };
    }
    if(typeof monthlyTextField==='undefined'){
      window.monthlyTextField = function(pid, mk, key, ph, val){ return '<input class="textline" placeholder="'+E(ph)+'" value="'+E(val||'')+'" oninput="updateMonthlyField(\''+pid+'\',\''+mk+'\',\''+key+'\',this.value)">'; };
      window.monthlyAreaField = function(pid, mk, key, ph, val, cls){ return '<textarea class="'+(cls||'freewrite')+'" placeholder="'+E(ph)+'" oninput="updateMonthlyField(\''+pid+'\',\''+mk+'\',\''+key+'\',this.value)">'+E(val||'')+'</textarea>'; };
    }
    var baseText = monthlyTextField, baseArea = monthlyAreaField;
    monthlyTextField = function(pid, mk, key, ph, val){ var sp = specFor(pid, key); return sp ? fbtn(pid, mk, key, ph, val, sp) : baseText.apply(this, arguments); };
    monthlyAreaField = function(pid, mk, key, ph, val, cls){ var sp = specFor(pid, key); return sp ? fbtn(pid, mk, key, ph, val, sp) : baseArea.apply(this, arguments); };

    function setMF(pid, mk, key, val, sp){
      updateMonthlyField(pid, mk, key, val);
      if(sp.fill && val){
        var f = sp.fill(val), page = pg(pid, mk);
        if(f) Object.keys(f).forEach(function(sib){
          var sk = key.replace(/[^.]+$/, sib);
          if(specFor(pid, sk) && !getPath(page, sk)) updateMonthlyField(pid, mk, sk, f[sib]);
        });
      }
      render();
    }
    function openMF(pid, mk, key){
      var sp = specFor(pid, key); if(!sp) return;
      var cur = getPath(pg(pid, mk), key); cur = cur==null ? '' : String(cur);
      var clear = cur ? [{ label:'Clear this', act:function(){ setMF(pid, mk, key, '', sp); } }] : [];
      if(sp.t==='single'){
        var opts = uniq((sp.rec ? recentsMF(pid, key) : []).concat(sp.opts));
        return openLS({ title:sp.title, instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:opts, sel:cur?[cur]:[], other:sp.other }], extra:clear,
          done:function(st){ setMF(pid, mk, key, st.v[0] || '', sp); } });
      }
      if(sp.t==='multi'){
        var m = window.UI.parseMulti(cur);
        return openLS({ title:sp.title, secs:[{ id:'v', multi:true, opts:uniq(recentsMF(pid, key).filter(function(x){ return sp.opts.indexOf(x)<0 && x.length<=28 && !/[.!?]/.test(x); }).concat(sp.opts)), sel:m.tok.slice() }], extra:clear,
          cta:function(st){ return st.v.length ? 'Done · '+st.v.length+' picked' : 'Done'; },
          done:function(st){ setMF(pid, mk, key, window.UI.buildMulti(st.v, m.note), sp); } });
      }
      if(sp.t==='num'){
        var n0 = parseFloat(cur); if(!isFinite(n0)) n0 = sp.def || 0;
        return openLS({ title:sp.title, secs:[{ id:'v', num:sp, val:n0 }], extra:clear, cta:function(){ return 'Done'; },
          done:function(st){ setMF(pid, mk, key, fmtN(st.v), sp); } });
      }
      if(sp.t==='date'){
        var qs = [['Today', 0], ['End of this week', (7-new Date().getDay())%7], ['End of this month', null], ['In 2 weeks', 14], ['In 30 days', 30], ['In 90 days', 90], ['End of the year', 'y']].map(function(q){
          var d; if(q[1]===null){ d = new Date(); d = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth()+1, 0, 12); } else if(q[1]==='y'){ d = new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 11, 31, 12); } else d = plusDays(q[1]);
          return [q[0]+' · '+fmtShort(d), fmtShort(d)]; });
        return openLS({ title:sp.title, instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', date:qs, val:'' }], extra:clear, done:function(st){ if(st.v) setMF(pid, mk, key, st.v, sp); } });
      }
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ list cards: the shared pieces --- */
    function card(h, mk, i, title, inner){
      return '<div class="field-card ls-card"><div class="ls-head"><div class="ls-title">'+E(title)+'</div><button type="button" class="ls-x" data-ls-rm="1" data-h="'+h+'" data-m="'+mk+'" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Remove '+E(title)+'">'+icon('close',13)+'</button></div>'+inner+'</div>';
    }
    function frow(label, inner){ return '<div class="ls-f"><div class="fc-hint">'+E(label)+'</div>'+inner+'</div>'; }
    function addBtn(h, mk, label){ return '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn ls-add" data-ls-add="1" data-h="'+h+'" data-m="'+mk+'">'+icon('plus',14)+' '+E(label)+'</button>'; }
    function doneBtn(pid, mk){ return '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow(\''+pid+'\',\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+' Mark done for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'</button>'; }

    /* where each list lives. "vault:reading" = the Reading Vault group, whose first book stays in its old place */
    function listOf(h, mk){
      var t = h.split(':'), g = t[1], page;
      if(t[0]==='obj'){ page = pg('objectives', mk); if(!Array.isArray(page.list)) page.list = FAM==='clean' && !BOY ? [{},{},{},{}] : [{},{},{}]; return page.list; }
      if(t[0]==='rot') return window.rotList(mk);
      if(t[0]==='rew'){ page = pg('income', mk); if(!Array.isArray(page.rewards)) page.rewards = []; return page.rewards; }
      if(t[0]==='streams'){ page = pg('income', mk); if(!Array.isArray(page.streams)) page.streams = []; return page.streams; }
      if(t[0]==='bucket') return pg('bucket', mk).items;
      if(t[0]==='vault'){ page = pg('income', mk); if(!page[g]) page[g] = {}; return [page[g]].concat(page[g+'_more'] || []); }
      return [];
    }
    function addItems(h, mk, items){
      var t = h.split(':'), g = t[1];
      if(t[0]==='vault'){
        var page = pg('income', mk); if(!page[g]) page[g] = {}; if(!Array.isArray(page[g+'_more'])) page[g+'_more'] = [];
        items.forEach(function(it){ if(isBlank(page[g])) page[g] = it; else page[g+'_more'].push(it); });
      } else { var arr = listOf(h, mk); items.forEach(function(it){ arr.push(it); }); }
      saveDB(); render();
    }
    function removeAt(h, mk, i){
      var t = h.split(':'), g = t[1];
      if(t[0]==='vault'){ var page = pg('income', mk), more = page[g+'_more'] || []; if(i===0){ page[g] = more.length ? more.shift() : {}; } else more.splice(i-1, 1); }
      else listOf(h, mk).splice(i, 1);
      saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Removed');
    }
    function vPath(g, i, k){ return i===0 ? g+'.'+k : g+'_more.'+(i-1)+'.'+k; }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ "Add" sheets (tap several, then Add) */
    function addCfg(h, mk){
      var t = h.split(':')[0], g = h.split(':')[1];
      if((t==='obj' || t==='rot') && FAM==='clean'){
        return { title: t==='rot' ? 'Add to your rotation' : 'Add products to review', noun:'product',
          secs:[{ id:'k', label:'Skincare, hair and body', multi:true, opts:KINDS, sel:[] }, { id:'p', label:'Fragrances', multi:true, opts:PERF.map(function(p){ return p[0]; }), sel:[] }, { id:'b', label:'Brand for the products above (optional)', opts:BRANDS, sel:[] }],
          make:function(st){ var o = []; st.k.forEach(function(n){ var it = { name:n, brand:st.b[0]||'' }; if(t==='rot') it.note = ''; o.push(it); }); st.p.forEach(function(n){ var b = ''; PERF.forEach(function(p){ if(p[0]===n) b = p[1]; }); var it = { name:n, brand:b }; if(t==='rot') it.note = ''; o.push(it); }); return o; },
          blank:function(){ return t==='rot' ? { name:'', brand:'', note:'' } : {}; } };
      }
      if(FAM==='reading' && (t==='obj' || t==='vault')){
        return { title: t==='vault' ? 'Add books' : 'Add books to review', noun:'book',
          secs:[{ id:'g', label:'Pick a genre to browse', opts:GENRES, sel:['Self-help'], other:false }, { id:'b', label:'Books', multi:true, sel:[], opts:function(st){ var gg = st.g[0]; return BOOKS.filter(function(b){ return !gg || b[2]===gg; }).map(function(b){ return b[0]; }); } }],
          make:function(st){ return st.b.map(function(ti){ var b = bookByTitle(ti), it = { title:ti, author:b?b[1]:'' }; if(t==='vault') it.genre = b?b[2]:''; return it; }); }, blank:function(){ return {}; } };
      }
      if(FAM==='sober' && t==='obj') return { title:'Add things you tried', noun:'activity', secs:[{ id:'a', multi:true, opts:ACTIVITIES, sel:[] }], make:function(st){ return st.a.map(function(n){ return { name:n }; }); }, blank:function(){ return {}; } };
      if(FAM==='sober' && t==='rew') return { title:'Add rewards', noun:'reward', secs:[{ id:'r', label:'Reward', multi:true, opts:REWARDS, sel:[] }, { id:'m', label:'Milestone it marked (optional)', opts:MILESTONES, sel:[] }], make:function(st){ return st.r.map(function(n){ return { reward:n, milestone:st.m[0]||'' }; }); }, blank:function(){ return {}; } };
      if(FAM==='hustler' && t==='obj') return { title:'Add objectives', noun:'objective', secs:[{ id:'o', multi:true, opts:OBJ_H, sel:[] }], make:function(st){ return st.o.map(function(n){ return { title:n }; }); }, blank:function(){ return {}; } };
      if(FAM==='hustler' && t==='streams') return { title:'Add income streams', noun:'stream', secs:[{ id:'s', multi:true, opts:STREAMS, sel:[] }], make:function(st){ return st.s.map(function(n){ return { name:n, status:'Testing' }; }); }, blank:function(){ return { status:'Testing' }; } };
      if(FAM==='hustler' && t==='bucket') return { title:'Add goals', noun:'goal', secs:[{ id:'t', label:'How much do you want it?', opts:['MUST','WANT','SOMEDAY'], sel:['MUST'], other:false }, { id:'g', label:'Goals', multi:true, sel:[], opts:function(st){ return GOALS[st.t[0]||'MUST']; } }],
        make:function(st){ return st.g.map(function(n){ return { tier:st.t[0]||'MUST', text:n }; }); }, blank:function(){ return { tier:'SOMEDAY', text:'' }; } };
      return null;
    }
    function openAdd(h, mk, into){
      if(window.WIZ && window.WIZ.handles(h)) return window.WIZ.open(h, mk, into ? function(it){ into([it]); } : null);   /* Clean: the guided stuff > brand > name picker */
      var c = addCfg(h, mk); if(!c) return;
      c.secs.forEach(function(s){ s.sel = (s.sel||[]).slice(); });
      var multiSec = c.secs.filter(function(s){ return s.multi; });
      openLS({ title:c.title, secs:c.secs, needs:false,
        count:function(st){ return multiSec.reduce(function(a,s){ return a + st[s.id].length; }, 0); },
        cta:function(st, n){ return n ? 'Add '+n+' '+c.noun+(n===1?'':'s') : 'Add an empty '+c.noun+' card'; },
        done:function(st){ var items = c.make(st); if(!items.length) items = [c.blank()]; (into || function(it){ addItems(h, mk, it); })(items); flashSaved(items.length+' added'); } });
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ objectives (all apps) ------------- */
    var OBJ_CFG = {
      clean:  { noun:'product', primary:'name', order:['name','brand','characteristics','note','@rating'], labels:{ name:'Product', brand:'Brand', characteristics:'Characteristics', note:'My note' } },
      readingBoy:  { noun:'book', primary:'title', order:['title','author','impression','note','@rating'], labels:{ title:'Title', author:'Author', impression:'First impression', note:'Note' } },
      readingGirl: { noun:'book', primary:'title', order:['title','author','@rating','@rec','impression'], labels:{ title:'Title', author:'Author', impression:'First impression' } },
      soberBoy:  { noun:'activity', primary:'name', order:['name','@rating','went','note'], labels:{ name:'Activity or tool', went:'How it went', note:'Note' } },
      soberGirl: { noun:'activity', primary:'name', order:['name','@rating','went'], labels:{ name:'Activity or tool', went:'How it went' } },
      hustler: { noun:'objective', primary:'title', order:['title','why','metric','deadline','@progress'], labels:{ title:'Objective', why:'Why it matters', metric:'Success metric', deadline:'Deadline' } }
    };
    var OC = OBJ_CFG[FAM==='clean' ? 'clean' : FAM==='hustler' ? 'hustler' : FAM+(BOY?'Boy':'Girl')];
    var baseObjectives = objectivesBody;
    objectivesBody = function(monthKey){
      var mk = mkOf(monthKey);
      if(isMonthlyPageLocked('objectives', mk)) return baseObjectives(mk);
      var list = listOf('obj', mk);
      var cards = list.map(function(o, i){
        var inner = '';
        OC.order.forEach(function(tok){
          if(tok==='@rating') inner += frow('Rating', monthlyScaleRow10('objectives', mk, 'list.'+i+'.rating', o.rating));
          else if(tok==='@progress') inner += frow('Progress — tap to set', scaleRow10Objectives(mk, i, o.progress));
          else if(tok==='@rec') inner += frow('Would recommend', '<div class="pill-row">'+['Y','N'].map(function(v){ return '<button class="pill '+(o.recommend===v?'active red':'')+'" onclick="setRecommend(\''+mk+'\','+i+',\''+v+'\')">'+v+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>');
          else inner += frow(OC.labels[tok], monthlyTextField('objectives', mk, 'list.'+i+'.'+tok, OC.labels[tok], o[tok]));
        });
        var title = FAM==='hustler' ? ('Objective '+(i+1)+(o.title ? ' · '+o.title : '')) : (o[OC.primary] || 'New '+OC.noun);
        return card('obj', mk, i, title, inner);
      }).join('');
      var head = FAM==='hustler' ? fieldWrap('Your objectives this month', 'Name them clearly or they won\'t happen. Add as many as you need.', '')
        : fieldWrap(FAM==='clean' ? 'Thoughts on new products' : FAM==='reading' ? 'Thoughts on new reads' : 'Wins & reflections',
            FAM==='clean' ? 'First impressions · what you think · honest rating. Add as many as you like.' : FAM==='reading' ? 'First impressions · honest rating · notes. Add as many as you like.' : 'New tools you tried · what actually worked. Add as many as you like.', '');
      return head + (cards || '<div class="ls-empty">Nothing here yet. Tap the button below.</div>') + addBtn('obj', mk, 'Add another '+OC.noun) + doneBtn('objectives', mk);
    };

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Clean: products in rotation ------ */
    if(FAM==='clean' && window.rotList){
      var baseRot = incomeBody;
      incomeBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = mkOf(monthKey);
        if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)) return baseRot(mk);
        var list = window.rotList(mk);
        var cards = list.map(function(p, i){
          return card('rot', mk, i, p.name || 'New product',
            frow('Product', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'inRotation.'+i+'.name', 'Product', p.name))
            + frow('Brand', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'inRotation.'+i+'.brand', 'Brand', p.brand))
            + frow('Notes', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'inRotation.'+i+'.note', 'Notes', p.note)));
        }).join('');
        return fieldWrap('In rotation', 'Only what you are using right now. Add as many as you like, and remove anything you have finished or put away.', '')
          + (cards || '<div class="ls-empty">Nothing in rotation yet. Tap the button below.</div>') + addBtn('rot', mk, 'Add products or perfumes') + doneBtn('income', mk);
      };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Reading: the vault -------------- */
    if(FAM==='reading'){
      var baseVault = incomeBody;
      var GROUPS = BOY
        ? [{ key:'reading', label:'Reading', f:['title','author','genre','owned'], note:1, rating:1 }, { key:'finished', label:'Finished', f:['title','author','genre','status'], rating:1 }, { key:'onDeck', label:'On deck', f:['title','why'] }]
        : [{ key:'reading', label:'Reading', f:['title','author','genre','owned'], note:1, rating:1 }, { key:'finished', label:'Finished', f:['title','author','genre','owned'], rating:1 }, { key:'tbr', label:'TBR / DNF', f:['title','author','status','genre'] }];
      var FL = { title:'Title', author:'Author', genre:'Genre', owned:'Owned / borrowed', status:'Status', why:'Why this one next' };
      incomeBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = mkOf(monthKey), page = pg('income', mk);
        if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)){
          var rows = '';
          GROUPS.forEach(function(g){ listOf('vault:'+g.key, mk).forEach(function(it){ if(it && it.title) rows += '<div class="locked-item-row" style="align-items:flex-start;"><span style="font-weight:700;">'+E(g.label)+'</span><span class="muted-inline">'+E(it.title)+(it.author?' · '+E(it.author):'')+'</span></div>'; }); });
          return monthlyLockedBody(rows ? '<div class="field-card">'+rows+'</div>' : '<div class="empty-note">Nothing logged yet for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'.</div>', 'income', mk);
        }
        var out = fieldWrap(BOY ? 'Reading vault' : 'Book vault', 'Add as many books as you like in each shelf.', '');
        GROUPS.forEach(function(g){
          var items = listOf('vault:'+g.key, mk);
          out += '<div class="section-label" style="padding:14px 0 8px;">'+E(g.label)+'</div>';
          out += items.map(function(it, i){
            var inner = g.f.map(function(k){ return frow(FL[k], monthlyTextField('income', mk, vPath(g.key, i, k), FL[k], it[k])); }).join('');
            if(g.note) inner += frow('Note', monthlyAreaField('income', mk, vPath(g.key, i, 'note'), 'Note', it.note));
            if(g.rating) inner += frow('Rating', monthlyScaleRow10('income', mk, vPath(g.key, i, 'rating'), it.rating));
            return card('vault:'+g.key, mk, i, it.title || 'New book', inner);
          }).join('');
          out += addBtn('vault:'+g.key, mk, 'Add books to '+g.label.toLowerCase());
        });
        return out + doneBtn('income', mk);
      };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Sober: milestone vault ---------- */
    if(FAM==='sober'){
      var baseSober = incomeBody;
      var QD = [['Today',0],['Yesterday',1],['1 week ago',7],['2 weeks ago',14],['30 days ago',30],['90 days ago',90],['6 months ago',182],['1 year ago',365]];
      window.lsQDate = function(mk, key, n){ var d = new Date(); d.setHours(12,0,0,0); d.setDate(d.getDate()-n); updateMonthlyField('income', mk, key, localDateStr(d)); render(); };
      function qdates(mk, key, cur){
        return '<div class="pill-row ui-chips" style="margin-top:8px;">'+QD.map(function(q){ var d = new Date(); d.setHours(12,0,0,0); d.setDate(d.getDate()-q[1]); var on = cur===localDateStr(d); return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" onclick="lsQDate(\''+mk+'\',\''+key+'\','+q[1]+')">'+q[0]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      }
      incomeBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = mkOf(monthKey), page = pg('income', mk), rew = listOf('rew', mk);
        if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)){
          var rows = [['Start date',page.startDate],['Longest streak',page.longest],['Date achieved',page.achieved],['Note',page.note]].filter(function(r){ return r[1]; }).map(function(r){ return [r[0], r[1]]; });
          rew.forEach(function(r){ if(r.reward) rows.push(['Reward', r.reward+(r.milestone?' · '+r.milestone:'')]); });
          var summary = rows.length ? '<div class="field-card">'+rows.map(function(r){ return '<div class="locked-item-row" style="align-items:flex-start;"><span style="font-weight:700;">'+E(r[0])+'</span><span class="muted-inline">'+E(r[1])+'</span></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>' : '<div class="empty-note">Nothing logged yet for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'.</div>';
          return monthlyLockedBody(summary, 'income', mk);
        }
        var start = soberStartDate(), today = todayStr(), days = start ? soberDaysAt(today) : null;
        var unit = days===null ? '—' : (days>=60 ? Math.floor(days/30)+' months' : days>=14 ? Math.floor(days/7)+' weeks' : days+' days');
        var cards = rew.map(function(r, i){
          return card('rew', mk, i, r.reward || 'New reward', frow('Reward', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'rewards.'+i+'.reward', 'Reward', r.reward)) + frow('Milestone it marked', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'rewards.'+i+'.milestone', 'Milestone', r.milestone)));
        }).join('');
        return fieldWrap('Milestone vault', BOY ? 'Track the streak. Respect the work.' : 'Your streak, your record, your small rewards', '')
          + fieldWrap('Start date', 'Days / weeks / months sober counts up from here', '<input type="date" class="textline" value="'+E(page.startDate||'')+'" onchange="updateMonthlyField(\'income\',\''+mk+'\',\'startDate\',this.value); render();">'+qdates(mk,'startDate',page.startDate))
