          + '<div class="field-card" style="text-align:center;"><div class="fc-label">Current streak</div><div style="font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:44px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.1; color:var(--accent);">'+(days===null?'——':days)+'</div><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:4px 0 0;">Days sober right now'+(days!==null?' · '+unit:'')+'</div></div>'
          + '<div class="section-label" style="padding:14px 0 8px;">Streak record</div>'
          + fieldWrap('Longest streak', null, monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'longest', 'Longest streak', page.longest))
          + fieldWrap('Date achieved', null, '<input type="date" class="textline" value="'+E(page.achieved||'')+'" onchange="updateMonthlyField(\'income\',\''+mk+'\',\'achieved\',this.value); render();">'+qdates(mk,'achieved',page.achieved))
          + '<div class="section-label" style="padding:14px 0 8px;">Small rewards earned</div>'
          + (cards || '<div class="ls-empty">No rewards yet. Tap below when you earn one.</div>') + addBtn('rew', mk, 'Add rewards')
          + fieldWrap('Note', null, monthlyAreaField('income', mk, 'note', 'Note', page.note))
          + doneBtn('income', mk);
      };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Hustler: income streams --------- */
    if(FAM==='hustler'){
      var baseInc = incomeBody;
      incomeBody = function(monthKey){
        var mk = mkOf(monthKey);
        if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)) return baseInc(mk);
        var streams = listOf('streams', mk);
        var total = streams.reduce(function(s,x){ return s + (+x.current||0); }, 0), target = streams.reduce(function(s,x){ return s + (+x.target||0); }, 0);
        var cards = streams.map(function(s, i){
          return card('streams', mk, i, s.name || 'New stream',
            frow('Source', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'streams.'+i+'.name', 'Source', s.name))
            + '<div class="ls-two">'+frow('Current $ / month', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'streams.'+i+'.current', '$', s.current))+frow('Target $ / month', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'streams.'+i+'.target', '$', s.target))+'</div>'
            + frow('Next action', monthlyTextField('income', mk, 'streams.'+i+'.next', 'Next action', s.next))
            + frow('Status', '<div class="pill-row">'+['Active','Testing','Paused'].map(function(x){ return '<button class="pill '+(s.status===x?'active red':'')+'" onclick="setIncomeStatus(\''+mk+'\','+i+',\''+x+'\')">'+x+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'));
        }).join('');
        return '<div class="two-col" style="margin-bottom:16px;"><div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$'+total.toLocaleString()+'</div><div class="sl">Total monthly rev</div></div><div class="stat-mini"><div class="sv">$'+target.toLocaleString()+'</div><div class="sl">Combined target</div></div></div>'
          + '<div class="section-label" style="padding:0 0 10px;">Active streams</div>' + (cards || '<div class="ls-empty">No streams yet. Tap below to add as many as you have.</div>')
          + addBtn('streams', mk, 'Add income streams') + doneBtn('income', mk);
      };
      window.addIncomeStream = function(mk){ openAdd('streams', mk); };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Hustler: goals (bucket) ---------- */
    function goalSheet(tier, cur, onPick, onRemove){
      var extra = onRemove ? [{ label:'Remove this goal', act:onRemove }] : [];
      openLS({ title:'Pick a goal', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:uniq(GOALS[tier] || GOALS.WANT), sel:cur?[cur]:[] }], extra:extra, done:function(st){ onPick(st.v[0] || ''); } });
    }
    if(FAM==='hustler'){
      window.addBucketItem = function(mk){ openAdd('bucket', mk); };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Habits: tap to name, add many ---- */
    function habitsOf(mk){ return habitsPage(mk); }
    function habitRemove(mk, i){
      var page = habitsOf(mk); page.names.splice(i, 1);
      Object.keys(page.marks || {}).forEach(function(ds){ var o = page.marks[ds], n = {}; Object.keys(o).forEach(function(k){ var x = Number(k); if(x<i) n[x] = o[k]; else if(x>i) n[x-1] = o[k]; }); page.marks[ds] = n; });
      saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Habit removed');
    }
    function habitEdit(mk, i){
      var page = habitsOf(mk), cur = page.names[i] || '';
      openLS({ title: cur ? 'Change habit' : 'Pick a habit', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:uniq(HABITS.concat(cur?[cur]:[])), sel:cur?[cur]:[] }],
        extra: [{ label:'Remove this habit (its ticks go too)', act:function(){ habitRemove(mk, i); } }],
        done:function(st){ var v = st.v[0] || ''; if(!v) return; page.names[i] = v; saveDB(); render(); } });
    }
    function habitAdd(mk){
      var page = habitsOf(mk), have = page.names.filter(Boolean);
      openLS({ title:'Add habits', secs:[{ id:'v', multi:true, opts:HABITS.filter(function(h){ return have.indexOf(h)<0; }), sel:[] }], needs:true,
        count:function(st){ return st.v.length; }, cta:function(st, n){ return n ? 'Add '+n+' habit'+(n===1?'':'s') : 'Pick at least one'; },
        done:function(st){ st.v.forEach(function(n){ var blank = page.names.indexOf(''); if(blank>=0) page.names[blank] = n; else page.names.push(n); }); saveDB(); render(); flashSaved(st.v.length+' added'); } });
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ after every redraw: swap typed boxes for tap buttons */
    function btnHtml(cls, inner, attrs){ return '<button type="button" class="'+cls+'" '+attrs+'>'+inner+'</button>'; }
    function enhance(){
      var app = document.getElementById('app'); if(!app) return;
      /* habits */
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('.habit-grid-wrap:not([data-enh])'), function(wrap){
        wrap.setAttribute('data-enh', '1'); var mk = currentMonthKey();
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('input.habit-name-input'), function(inp){
          var m = /updateHabitName\('([^']+)',(\d+)/.exec(inp.getAttribute('oninput') || ''); if(!m) return; mk = m[1];
          var name = inp.value;
          inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
          inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', btnHtml('habit-name-input ls-hbtn'+(name?'':' empty'), '<span>'+E(name || 'Pick a habit')+'</span>', 'data-ls-habit="1" data-m="'+m[1]+'" data-i="'+m[2]+'"'));
        });
        wrap.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn ls-add" data-ls-habitadd="1" data-m="'+mk+'">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add habits</button>');
      });
      /* any other leftover typed monthly box that has a tap menu (e.g. the 1-5 energy boxes) */
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('input[oninput*="updateMonthlyField("]:not([data-enh])'), function(inp){
        var m = /updateMonthlyField\('([^']+)','([^']+)','([^']+)'/.exec(inp.getAttribute('oninput') || ''); if(!m) return;
        var sp = specFor(m[1], m[3]); if(!sp) return; inp.setAttribute('data-enh', '1'); inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', fbtn(m[1], m[2], m[3], '', inp.value, sp));
      });
      if(FAM!=='hustler') return;
      /* goals (monthly page): tap the goal text to pick, Add goal opens a sheet */
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('input.textline[oninput*="updateBucket("]:not([data-enh])'), function(inp){
        var m = /updateBucket\('([^']+)',(\d+)/.exec(inp.getAttribute('oninput') || ''); if(!m) return; inp.setAttribute('data-enh', '1');
        if(inp.disabled) return;
        inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
        inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', btnHtml('ui-pick ls-goalbtn'+(inp.value?' on':''), '<span>'+E(inp.value || 'Tap to pick a goal')+'</span>', 'data-ls-goal="m" data-m="'+m[1]+'" data-i="'+m[2]+'"'));
      });
      /* setup: goals and objectives steps */
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('.onb-tt-list:not([data-enh])'), function(box){
        box.setAttribute('data-enh', '1');
        var gi = box.querySelectorAll('input[oninput^="onboardBucketUpdate("]'), oi = box.querySelectorAll('input[oninput^="onboardObjUpdate("]');
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(gi, function(inp, i){ inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', btnHtml('ui-pick ls-goalbtn'+(inp.value?' on':''), '<span>'+E(inp.value || 'Tap to pick a goal')+'</span>', 'data-ls-goal="o" data-i="'+i+'"')); });
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(oi, function(inp, i){ inp.style.display = 'none'; inp.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', btnHtml('ui-pick ls-goalbtn'+(inp.value?' on':''), '<span>'+E(inp.value || 'Tap to pick an objective')+'</span>', 'data-ls-goal="b" data-i="'+i+'"')); });
        if(gi.length) box.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn ls-add" data-ls-onbadd="g">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add goals</button>');
        else if(oi.length) box.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn ls-add" data-ls-onbadd="b">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add objectives</button>');
      });
    }
    function onbAdd(kind){
      if(kind==='g'){
        var items = ONDRAFT.bucketItems || (ONDRAFT.bucketItems = [{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'MUST',text:''},{tier:'WANT',text:''}]);
        return openAdd('bucket', null, function(its){ its.forEach(function(it){ var e = -1; items.forEach(function(x, ix){ if(e<0 && !(x.text||'').trim()) e = ix; }); if(e>=0) items[e] = it; else items.push(it); }); saveOnboardDraft(); render(); });
      }
      var ts = ONDRAFT.objTitles || (ONDRAFT.objTitles = ['','','']);
      openAdd('obj', null, function(its){ its.forEach(function(it){ var e = ts.findIndex(function(x){ return !(x||'').trim(); }); if(e>=0) ts[e] = it.title || ''; else ts.push(it.title || ''); }); saveOnboardDraft(); render(); });
    }
    /* the Hustler setup sheets take their items from the "add" sheet above without touching a month page */
    function onbGoal(kind, i){
      if(kind==='o'){
        var it = ONDRAFT.bucketItems[i]; if(!it) return;
        return goalSheet(it.tier, it.text, function(v){ if(v) { it.text = v; saveOnboardDraft(); render(); } }, function(){ ONDRAFT.bucketItems.splice(i,1); saveOnboardDraft(); render(); });
      }
      var cur = ONDRAFT.objTitles[i] || '';
      openLS({ title:'Pick an objective', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:uniq(OBJ_H.concat(cur?[cur]:[])), sel:cur?[cur]:[] }], extra:[{ label:'Remove this one', act:function(){ ONDRAFT.objTitles.splice(i,1); saveOnboardDraft(); render(); } }],
        done:function(st){ var v = st.v[0]; if(v){ ONDRAFT.objTitles[i] = v; saveOnboardDraft(); render(); } } });
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ one click handler for everything --- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      var t = ev.target; if(!t || !t.closest) return; var b;
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls]'))){ if(SH) onLS(b); return; }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-mf]'))){ openMF(b.getAttribute('data-p'), b.getAttribute('data-m'), b.getAttribute('data-k')); return; }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-add]'))){ openAdd(b.getAttribute('data-h'), b.getAttribute('data-m')); return; }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-rm]'))){
        if(b.classList.contains('armed')){ clearTimeout(b._t); removeAt(b.getAttribute('data-h'), b.getAttribute('data-m'), Number(b.getAttribute('data-i'))); return; }
        var old = b.innerHTML; b.classList.add('armed'); b.textContent = 'Remove?'; b._t = setTimeout(function(){ if(b.isConnected){ b.classList.remove('armed'); b.innerHTML = old; } }, 3000); return;
      }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-habit]'))){ habitEdit(b.getAttribute('data-m'), Number(b.getAttribute('data-i'))); return; }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-habitadd]'))){ habitAdd(b.getAttribute('data-m')); return; }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-goal]'))){
        var w = b.getAttribute('data-ls-goal'), i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i'));
        if(w==='m'){ var mk = b.getAttribute('data-m'), it = pg('bucket', mk).items[i]; if(!it) return;
          goalSheet(it.tier, it.text, function(v){ if(v){ updateBucket(mk, i, 'text', v); render(); } }, function(){ deleteBucketItemToTrash(mk, i); }); return; }
        onbGoal(w, i); return;
      }
      if((b = t.closest('[data-ls-onbadd]'))){ onbAdd(b.getAttribute('data-ls-onbadd')); return; }
    });
    document.addEventListener('change', function(ev){
      var t = ev.target; if(!t || !t.getAttribute || t.getAttribute('data-ls-date')==null || !SH) return;
      var s = SH.secs[Number(t.getAttribute('data-ls-date'))]; if(!t.value) return;
      var p = t.value.split('-'); s.val = fmtShort(new Date(+p[0], +p[1]-1, +p[2], 12)); finish();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='Enter' && ev.target && ev.target.classList && ev.target.classList.contains('ls-other')){ ev.preventDefault(); var b = document.querySelector('[data-ls="addoth"][data-s="'+ev.target.getAttribute('data-s')+'"]'); if(b) onLS(b); }
    });

    /* after each redraw, run the swap above */
    var baseRender = render;
    render = function(){ var r = baseRender.apply(this, arguments); try{ enhance(); }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('lists enhance', e); } return r; };

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ names for new boxes and fields ---- */
    var baseOpenSheet = openSheet;
    openSheet = function(){
      var r = baseOpenSheet.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var sh = document.querySelector('#active-sheet'); if(!sh) return r;
        var title = (sh.querySelector('.sheet-title span') || {}).textContent || '';
        [['bx-f-label', /^New box$/i.test(title) ? BOX_NAMES : FIELD_NAMES], ['onb-box-name', BOX_NAMES], ['ttp-name', HOUR_NAMES]].forEach(function(p){
          var inp = sh.querySelector('#'+p[0]); if(!inp || inp.getAttribute('data-chips')) return; inp.setAttribute('data-chips', '1');
          inp.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', '<div class="ls-names">'+p[1].map(function(n){ return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip" data-ls-name="'+E(n)+'">'+E(n)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>');
          sh.querySelector('.ls-names').addEventListener('click', function(ev){ var c = ev.target.closest('[data-ls-name]'); if(!c) return; inp.value = c.getAttribute('data-ls-name'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles:true })); Array.prototype.forEach.call(this.children, function(x){ x.classList.toggle('on', x===c); }); });
        });
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('name chips', e); }
      return r;
    };

    window.LISTS = { specs:MS, openMF:openMF, openAdd:openAdd, addItems:addItems, listOf:listOf, books:BOOKS, genres:GENRES, openLS:openLS, uniq:uniq, bookByTitle:bookByTitle, wordSets:{ WORD:W_WORD, MOOD:W_MOOD }, names:{ ACTIVITIES:ACTIVITIES } };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('lists', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   PRODUCT PICKER (Clean Boy and Clean Girl)

   "Add to your rotation" used to open one giant sheet of chips. It is now a short guided flow, one big-tap
   question at a time, with a Back button:

        What is it?  ->  Which kind?  ->  Which brand?  ->  Which one?   ->  added (add another, or done)

   Every step has a "type it yourself" tile, so nothing is ever blocked. The product names come from a
   catalogue of well-known products below. Add to it any time: one line per kind, in the form
        'Brand|Product one;Product two // Another brand|Product'

   The same catalogue feeds the Shower and Night boxes, so the product, the brand and what is already in
   your rotation always agree (see CATALOG at the bottom: window.CATALOG).
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof getMonthlyPage==='undefined' || !window.LISTS) return;
    var FAMILY = (document.title||'') + ''; void FAMILY;
    var isClean = !!window.rotList;
    var E = esc;

    /* ---------- the catalogue ---------- */
    var GROUPS = [
      ['Skincare','💧',['Cleanser','Moisturiser','Sunscreen','Serum','Toner','Exfoliator','Face mask','Eye cream','Lip balm']],
      ['Hair','💇',['Shampoo','Conditioner','Hair oil','Hair styling','Hair mask']],
      ['Body','🧴',['Body wash','Body lotion','Deodorant','Hand cream','Body scrub']],
      ['Teeth and mouth','🦷',['Toothpaste','Mouthwash']],
      ['Shaving and beard','🪒',['Razor','Shaving cream','Aftershave','Beard oil']],
      ['Fragrance','✨',[]]
    ];
    var DATA = {
      'Cleanser':'CeraVe|Hydrating Facial Cleanser;Foaming Facial Cleanser;Hydrating Cream-to-Foam Cleanser;SA Smoothing Cleanser // La Roche-Posay|Toleriane Hydrating Gentle Cleanser;Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel Cleanser;Toleriane Purifying Foaming Cleanser // Cetaphil|Gentle Skin Cleanser;Daily Facial Cleanser;Oily Skin Cleanser // Neutrogena|Ultra Gentle Daily Cleanser;Deep Clean Facial Cleanser;Oil-Free Acne Wash;Hydro Boost Gel Cleanser // The Ordinary|Squalane Cleanser;Glucoside Foaming Cleanser // COSRX|Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser;Salicylic Acid Daily Gentle Cleanser // Simple|Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash;Micellar Cleansing Water // Garnier|Micellar Cleansing Water;Pure Active Gel Wash // Bioderma|Sensibio H2O;Sebium Gel Moussant // Innisfree|Green Tea Foaming Cleanser',
      'Moisturiser':'CeraVe|Moisturizing Cream;Daily Moisturizing Lotion;PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion;AM Facial Moisturizing Lotion SPF 30 // La Roche-Posay|Toleriane Double Repair Moisturizer;Cicaplast Baume B5;Effaclar Mat // Cetaphil|Moisturizing Cream;Daily Hydrating Lotion // Neutrogena|Hydro Boost Water Gel;Hydro Boost Gel-Cream // The Ordinary|Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA // Nivea|Soft Moisturizing Cream;Creme // Olay|Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream;Total Effects 7-in-1 // Eucerin|Original Healing Cream;Daily Hydration Lotion // COSRX|Advanced Snail 92 All In One Cream;Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion // Laneige|Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Cream // Innisfree|Green Tea Balancing Cream',
      'Sunscreen':'La Roche-Posay|Anthelios UVMune 400;Anthelios Melt-in Milk SPF 60 // Neutrogena|Ultra Sheer Dry-Touch SPF 55;Hydro Boost Water Gel SPF 50 // Biore|UV Aqua Rich Watery Essence SPF 50+;UV Aqua Rich Watery Gel // Innisfree|Daily UV Protection Cream;Perfect UV Protection Cream // COSRX|Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF 50 // CeraVe|Hydrating Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30;Ultra-Light Gel SPF 30 // Nivea|Sun Protect & Moisture Lotion;Sun UV Face Shine Control // Eucerin|Sun Oil Control Gel-Creme SPF 50+',
      'Serum':'The Ordinary|Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%;Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5;Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%;Retinol 0.2% in Squalane;Alpha Arbutin 2% + HA;Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% // CeraVe|Resurfacing Retinol Serum;Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum;Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum // La Roche-Posay|Hyalu B5 Serum;Pure Vitamin C10 Serum;Mela B3 Serum // COSRX|The Vitamin C 23 Serum;Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence // Neutrogena|Rapid Wrinkle Repair Serum // Garnier|Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum',
      'Toner':'COSRX|AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner;Galactomyces 95 Tone Balancing Essence // The Ordinary|Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution // Innisfree|Green Tea Balancing Skin // Laneige|Cream Skin Refiner // Simple|Soothing Facial Toner // Neutrogena|Alcohol-Free Toner',
      'Exfoliator':'COSRX|BHA Blackhead Power Liquid;AHA 7 Whitehead Power Liquid // The Ordinary|Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution;Lactic Acid 10% + HA;AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution // Paula\'s Choice|2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant // Neutrogena|Deep Clean Gentle Scrub // CeraVe|SA Lotion for Rough & Bumpy Skin // La Roche-Posay|Effaclar Clarifying Solution',
      'Face mask':'Innisfree|Super Volcanic Pore Clay Mask 2X // Laneige|Water Sleeping Mask // The Ordinary|AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution;Salicylic Acid 2% Masque // COSRX|Ultimate Nourishing Rice Overnight Spa Mask // Garnier|SkinActive Hydra Bomb Sheet Mask',
      'Eye cream':'CeraVe|Eye Repair Cream;Skin Renewing Eye Cream // The Ordinary|Caffeine Solution 5% + EGCG // La Roche-Posay|Hyalu B5 Eye Cream // Neutrogena|Hydro Boost Eye Cream // Olay|Regenerist Eye Lifting Serum',
      'Lip balm':'Vaseline|Lip Therapy Original;Lip Therapy Rosy Lips;Petroleum Jelly // Laneige|Lip Sleeping Mask // Nivea|Lip Care Original // Neutrogena|Norwegian Formula Lip Moisturizer // Eucerin|Lip Active',
      'Shampoo':'Head & Shoulders|Classic Clean;Cool Menthol? // Dove|Daily Moisture Shampoo;Intense Repair Shampoo // Garnier|Fructis Fortifying Shampoo;Whole Blends Honey Treasures // Pantene|Pro-V Daily Moisture Renewal;Pro-V Classic Clean // TRESemme|Keratin Smooth;Rich Moisture // L\'Oreal|Elvive Total Repair 5 // Clear|Men Cool Sport Menthol // Nizoral|Anti-Dandruff Shampoo',
      'Conditioner':'Dove|Daily Moisture Conditioner;Intense Repair Conditioner // Pantene|Pro-V Daily Moisture Renewal Conditioner // TRESemme|Keratin Smooth Conditioner // Garnier|Fructis Fortifying Conditioner // L\'Oreal|Elvive Total Repair 5 Conditioner',
      'Hair oil':'Moroccanoil|Treatment // Olaplex|No.7 Bonding Oil // L\'Oreal|Elvive Extraordinary Oil // Parachute|100% Pure Coconut Oil',
      'Hair styling':'American Crew|Fiber;Forming Cream;Classic Pomade // Gatsby|Moving Rubber;Styling Wax // Suavecito|Original Hold Pomade;Firme Hold Pomade // Layrite|Original Pomade;Cement Clay // Got2b|Glued Spiking Glue // Reuzel|Blue Strong Hold Pomade',
      'Hair mask':'Olaplex|No.3 Hair Perfector // Garnier|Whole Blends Honey Treasures Hair Mask // L\'Oreal|Elvive Total Repair 5 Mask // Dove|Intensive Repair Treatment Mask',
      'Body wash':'Dove|Deeply Nourishing Body Wash;Sensitive Skin Body Wash;Men+Care Extra Fresh Body Wash // Nivea|Men Active Clean Body Wash // Axe|Dark Temptation Body Wash;Apollo Body Wash // CeraVe|Hydrating Body Wash // Old Spice|Swagger Body Wash // Lifebuoy|Total 10 Body Wash // Olay|Ultra Moisture Body Wash',
      'Body lotion':'Vaseline|Intensive Care Advanced Repair;Intensive Care Essential Healing // Nivea|Essentially Enriched Body Lotion // Dove|Deeply Nourishing Body Lotion // CeraVe|Daily Moisturizing Lotion;Moisturizing Cream // Cetaphil|Moisturizing Lotion // Eucerin|Original Healing Cream // Aveeno|Daily Moisturizing Lotion',
      'Deodorant':'Dove|Men+Care Clean Comfort Antiperspirant;Original Clean Antiperspirant // Axe|Dark Temptation Deodorant Body Spray // Nivea|Men Dry Impact;Black & White Invisible // Rexona|Men Antiperspirant // Old Spice|Pure Sport // Degree|Men Cool Rush',
      'Hand cream':'Neutrogena|Norwegian Formula Hand Cream // Eucerin|Advanced Repair Hand Cream // L\'Occitane|Shea Butter Hand Cream // CeraVe|Therapeutic Hand Cream // Burt\'s Bees|Almond & Milk Hand Cream',
      'Body scrub':'Dove|Exfoliating Body Polish // St. Ives|Fresh Skin Apricot Scrub // The Body Shop|Coconut Body Scrub',
      'Toothpaste':'Colgate|Total;Optic White // Sensodyne|Repair & Protect;Pronamel // Crest|3D White;Pro-Health // P/S|Complete 8',
      'Mouthwash':'Listerine|Cool Mint;Total Care // Colgate|Plax Ice // Crest|Pro-Health Mouthwash',
      'Razor':'Gillette|Mach3;Fusion5;Labs;Sensor3 // Schick|Hydro 5 // Harry\'s|Truman Razor',
      'Shaving cream':'Gillette|Series Sensitive Gel;Foamy // Nivea|Men Sensitive Shaving Gel // Barbasol|Original Shaving Cream // Cremo|Original Shave Cream',
      'Aftershave':'Nivea|Men Sensitive Post Shave Balm // Old Spice|Original Aftershave // Proraso|After Shave Balm',
      'Beard oil':'Honest Amish|Classic Beard Balm // Viking Revolution|Beard Oil',
      'Fragrance':'Dior|Sauvage;Miss Dior;J\'adore;Dior Homme Intense;Fahrenheit // Chanel|Bleu de Chanel;Chanel No. 5;Coco Mademoiselle;Allure Homme Sport;Chance // YSL|Y;Libre;Black Opium;La Nuit de L\'Homme;Mon Paris // Versace|Eros;Dylan Blue;Bright Crystal;Pour Homme // Creed|Aventus;Silver Mountain Water;Green Irish Tweed // Armani|Acqua di Gio;Acqua di Gio Profondo;Stronger With You;Armani Code;My Way // Paco Rabanne|1 Million;Invictus;Lady Million;Phantom // Dolce & Gabbana|Light Blue;The One;K by Dolce & Gabbana // Lancome|La Vie Est Belle;Idole // Viktor & Rolf|Flowerbomb;Spicebomb // Marc Jacobs|Daisy;Daisy Eau So Fresh // Carolina Herrera|Good Girl;212 VIP Men;Bad Boy // Jo Malone|Wood Sage & Sea Salt;English Pear & Freesia;Lime Basil & Mandarin;Peony & Blush Suede // Tom Ford|Tobacco Vanille;Oud Wood;Black Orchid;Ombre Leather // Armaf|Club de Nuit Intense Man // Calvin Klein|CK One;Eternity;Obsession;Euphoria // Hugo Boss|Boss Bottled;The Scent // Burberry|Her;Brit;Hero // Prada|Luna Rossa Carbon;Candy;L\'Homme // Gucci|Bloom;Guilty;Flora // Maison Margiela|Replica Jazz Club;Replica By the Fireplace;Lazy Sunday Morning // Bvlgari|Man in Black;Omnia Crystalline // Azzaro|The Most Wanted;Chrome;Wanted // Jean Paul Gaultier|Le Male;Scandal;Ultra Male // Montblanc|Explorer;Legend'
    };
    DATA['Shampoo'] = DATA['Shampoo'].replace(';Cool Menthol?','');
    var CAT = {};   /* kind -> [ [brand, [names]] ] */
    Object.keys(DATA).forEach(function(k){
      CAT[k] = DATA[k].split(' // ').map(function(b){ var p = b.split('|'); return [p[0].trim(), (p[1]||'').split(';').map(function(x){ return x.trim(); }).filter(Boolean)]; });
    });
    var ALL_BRANDS = []; Object.keys(CAT).forEach(function(k){ if(k==='Fragrance') return; CAT[k].forEach(function(b){ if(ALL_BRANDS.indexOf(b[0])<0) ALL_BRANDS.push(b[0]); }); }); ALL_BRANDS.sort();
    var PERF_BRANDS = CAT['Fragrance'].map(function(b){ return b[0]; });
    function groupOfKind(k){ for(var i=0;i<GROUPS.length;i++){ if(GROUPS[i][2].indexOf(k)>=0 || (GROUPS[i][0]==='Fragrance' && k==='Fragrance')) return GROUPS[i][0]; } return ''; }
    function brandsFor(kind){ return (CAT[kind]||[]).map(function(b){ return b[0]; }); }
    function namesFor(kind, brand){ var r = (CAT[kind]||[]).filter(function(b){ return b[0]===brand; })[0]; return r ? r[1] : []; }
    /* which kind is this product name? (so a typed-in name still finds its brand and kind) */
    function findName(name){
      var n = String(name||'').toLowerCase(); if(!n) return null;
      for(var k in CAT){ for(var i=0;i<CAT[k].length;i++){ var b = CAT[k][i]; for(var j=0;j<b[1].length;j++){ if(b[1][j].toLowerCase()===n) return { kind:k, brand:b[0], name:b[1][j] }; } } }
      return null;
    }

    /* ---------- styles ---------- */
    var css = ''
    + '.wz-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 12px;min-height:40px;}'
    + '.wz-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-height:40px;padding:0 14px 0 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.wz-crumb{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}'
    + '.wz-q{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:19px;margin:0 0 4px;}'
    + '.wz-s{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px;}'
    + '.wz-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}'
    + '.wz-tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-height:64px;padding:10px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .15s,border-color .15s;}'
    + '.wz-tile:active{transform:scale(.96);background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:var(--accent);}'
    + '.wz-tile .em{font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;}.wz-tile small{font-weight:600;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}'
    + '.wz-tile.more{border-style:dashed;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft);}'
    + '.wz-tile.wide{grid-column:1/-1;}'
    + '.wz-type{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;}.wz-type input{flex:1;min-width:0;}'
    + '.wz-done{text-align:center;padding:10px 0 4px;}.wz-done .ok{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:6px auto 12px;}'
    + '.wz-done b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:4px;}.wz-done p{margin:0 0 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;}'
    + '.wz-acts{display:grid;gap:10px;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'wz-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* ---------- the flow ---------- */
    var W = null;   /* { cfg, step, v:{group,kind,brand,name}, typing:null|'brand'|'name'|'kind', allBrands:false, added:null } */
    function crumb(){ var v = W.v, a = []; if(v.group) a.push(v.group); if(v.kind && v.kind!==v.group) a.push(v.kind); if(v.brand) a.push(v.brand); return a.join('  ›  '); }
    function tile(act, val, label, o){ o = o || {}; return '<button type="button" class="wz-tile'+(o.more?' more':'')+(o.wide?' wide':'')+'" data-wz="'+act+'" data-v="'+E(val==null?'':val)+'">'+(o.em?'<span class="em">'+o.em+'</span>':'')+E(label)+(o.sub?'<small>'+E(o.sub)+'</small>':'')+'</button>'; }
    function typeRow(ph, act){ return '<div class="wz-type"><input class="textline" id="wz-in" maxlength="60" placeholder="'+E(ph)+'"><button type="button" class="pill active red" data-wz="'+act+'">Add</button></div>'; }
    function screen(){
      var v = W.v, h = '', q = '', s = '', body = '';
      var top = '<div class="wz-top">'+(W.step>0 ? '<button type="button" class="wz-back" data-wz="back">'+icon('chevleft',14)+' Back</button>' : '')+'<div class="wz-crumb">'+E(crumb())+'</div></div>';
      if(W.added){
        var a = W.added;
        return '<div class="wz-done"><div class="ok">'+icon('check',28)+'</div><b>Added to your '+(W.cfg.noun==='product'?'list':'list')+'</b><p>'+E((a.brand?a.brand+' · ':'')+(a.name||a.kind))+'</p>'
          + '<div class="wz-acts"><button type="button" class="pill active red ui-sheetdone" data-wz="again">Add another</button><button type="button" class="ui-notebtn" data-wz="finish" style="margin:0;font-size:14px;">I am done</button></div></div>';
      }
      var kind = v.kind, isF = v.group==='Fragrance';
      if(W.step===0){
        q = 'What are you adding?'; s = 'Tap one. You can add several, one after another.';
        body = '<div class="wz-grid">'+GROUPS.map(function(g){ return tile('group', g[0], g[0], { em:g[1] }); }).join('')+'</div>';
      } else if(W.stage==='kind'){
        q = 'Which kind of '+v.group.toLowerCase()+'?'; s = 'Pick the closest one.';
        var ks = GROUPS.filter(function(g){ return g[0]===v.group; })[0][2];
        body = '<div class="wz-grid">'+ks.map(function(k){ return tile('kind', k, k); }).join('')+tile('kindtype', '', 'Something else', { more:true })+'</div>' + (W.typing==='kind' ? typeRow('What is it? e.g. Face oil','kindadd') : '');
      } else if(W.stage==='brand'){
        q = 'Which brand?'; s = 'Tap the brand, or skip it.';
        var bl = W.allBrands && !isF ? ALL_BRANDS : brandsFor(kind);
        body = '<div class="wz-grid">'+bl.map(function(b){ return tile('brand', b, b); }).join('')
          + (!W.allBrands && !isF ? tile('morebrands','','More brands',{ more:true }) : '') + tile('brandtype','','Other brand',{ more:true }) + tile('brandskip','','Skip the brand',{ more:true })+'</div>' + (W.typing==='brand' ? typeRow('Brand name','brandadd') : '');
      } else if(W.stage==='name'){
        q = isF ? 'Which fragrance?' : 'Which '+kind.toLowerCase()+'?'; s = 'Pick the exact one, or type your own.';
        var nl = namesFor(kind, v.brand);
        body = '<div class="wz-grid">'+nl.map(function(n){ return tile('name', n, n); }).join('')+tile('nametype','', 'Type the name',{ more:true })
          + (isF ? '' : tile('nameskip','','Just the '+kind.toLowerCase()+', no name',{ more:true, wide:true }))+'</div>' + (W.typing==='name' ? typeRow('Product name','nameadd') : '');
      }
      return top + '<div class="wz-q">'+E(q)+'</div><div class="wz-s">'+E(s)+'</div>' + body;
    }
    function repaint(){ var b = document.getElementById('wz-body'); if(b && W){ b.innerHTML = screen(); var t = b.querySelector('#wz-in'); if(t) setTimeout(function(){ t.focus(); }, 40); var sh = b.closest('.sheet') || b.parentNode; if(sh && sh.scrollTo) sh.scrollTo(0,0); } }
    function open(cfg){
      W = { cfg:cfg, step:0, stage:'group', v:{}, typing:null, allBrands:false, added:null };
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+E(cfg.title)+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div><div class="ui-sheetbody"><div id="wz-body">'+screen()+'</div></div>');
    }
    function go(stage){ W.stage = stage; W.step = stage==='group' ? 0 : W.step; W.typing = null; repaint(); }
    function next(from){
      var v = W.v;
      if(from==='group'){ if(v.group==='Fragrance'){ v.kind = 'Fragrance'; W.step = 1; return go('brand'); } W.step = 1; return go('kind'); }
      if(from==='kind'){ W.step = 2; return go('brand'); }
      if(from==='brand'){ W.step = 3; return go('name'); }
      if(from==='name'){ return commit(); }
    }
    function commit(){
      var v = W.v, item = { kind:v.kind, brand:v.brand||'', name:v.name || v.kind };
      W.cfg.onAdd(item); W.added = item; W.typing = null; repaint();
    }
    function back(){
      var s = W.stage, v = W.v;
      if(s==='kind'){ W.step = 0; return go('group'); }
      if(s==='brand'){ v.brand = ''; return v.group==='Fragrance' ? (W.step = 0, go('group')) : (W.step = 1, go('kind')); }
      if(s==='name'){ v.name = ''; W.step = 2; return go('brand'); }
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      var b = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('[data-wz]'); if(!b || !W || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-wz'), val = b.getAttribute('data-v'), v = W.v;
      var typed = function(){ var i = document.getElementById('wz-in'); return i ? i.value.trim() : ''; };
      switch(a){
        case 'group': v.group = val; v.kind = ''; v.brand = ''; v.name = ''; return next('group');
        case 'kind': v.kind = val; return next('kind');
        case 'kindtype': W.typing = 'kind'; return repaint();
        case 'kindadd': if(!typed()) return; v.kind = typed(); return next('kind');
        case 'brand': v.brand = val; return next('brand');
        case 'morebrands': W.allBrands = true; return repaint();
        case 'brandtype': W.typing = 'brand'; return repaint();
        case 'brandadd': if(!typed()) return; v.brand = typed(); return next('brand');
        case 'brandskip': v.brand = ''; return next('brand');
        case 'name': v.name = val; return next('name');
        case 'nametype': W.typing = 'name'; return repaint();
        case 'nameadd': if(!typed()) return; v.name = typed(); return next('name');
        case 'nameskip': v.name = ''; return next('name');
        case 'back': return back();
        case 'again': W.v = {}; W.added = null; W.step = 0; W.allBrands = false; return go('group');
        case 'finish': closeSheet(); W = null; return;
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      if(ev.key!=='Enter' || !W || !ev.target || ev.target.id!=='wz-in') return; ev.preventDefault();
      var btn = document.querySelector('.wz-type [data-wz]'); if(btn) btn.click();
    });

    /* ---------- hooks used by the lists patch and the Shower box ---------- */
    function currentRotation(){
      try{ return (window.rotList ? window.rotList(currentMonthKey()) : []).filter(function(p){ return p && (p.name||p.brand); }); }catch(e){ return []; }
    }
    window.CATALOG = { kinds:Object.keys(CAT), groups:GROUPS, brandsFor:brandsFor, namesFor:namesFor, allBrands:ALL_BRANDS, perfBrands:PERF_BRANDS, findName:findName, groupOfKind:groupOfKind, rotation:currentRotation };
    window.WIZ = {
      handles:function(h){ var t = h.split(':')[0]; return isClean && (t==='rot' || t==='obj'); },
      open:function(h, mk, addFn, title){
        var t = h.split(':')[0];
        open({ title: title || (t==='rot' ? 'Add to your rotation' : 'Add a product to review'), noun:'product', onAdd:function(it){
          var item = { name:it.name, brand:it.brand, kind:it.kind }; if(t==='rot') item.note = '';
          (addFn || function(x){ window.LISTS.addItems(h, mk, [x]); })(item);
        } });
      }
    };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('product picker', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   PRODUCT VAULT  (Clean Boy and Clean Girl)

   Before there were two separate places: the "Products & Perfume Vault" (a monthly page) and "Thoughts on New
   Products" (another monthly page), and the Shower box had its own typed product list that read neither.

   Now there is ONE vault of products, in four shelves:  In rotation / Trying / Finished / Rebuy.
     - Adding a product is the guided picker (stuff, brand, name). It lands on the shelf you are looking at.
     - Every product is a card: brand, name, kind, a 5-star rating, "feels like" tags, how long it lasts, thoughts.
       Move it between shelves with one tap.
     - The Shower box's "What you used" shows your vault as one-tap chips (and fills the brand for you).
       The vault card in turn shows how many times you used it lately.

   Where it is saved:  DB.vault = { items:{ id:{...} }, seen:{} }   (a new top-level key; backups carry it).
   Old data is copied over ONCE, the first time the vault opens, and the old monthly entries are left untouched:
     old "In rotation" list -> In rotation,   old Finished / Repurchased -> those shelves,   old "Thoughts on new products" -> Trying.
   Field names match the old ones (name, brand, characteristics, longevity, note, rating) so nothing is lost.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(!window.CATALOG || !window.WIZ || !window.rotList || typeof incomeBody!=='function' || !window.LISTS || !window.LISTS.openLS) return;
    var E = esc, LS = window.LISTS, C = window.CATALOG;
    var SHELVES = [
      { id:'rotation',    label:'In rotation', short:'In rotation', title:'Add to your rotation', empty:'Nothing in your rotation yet.', hint:'What you are using right now.' },
      { id:'trying',      label:'Trying',      short:'Trying',      title:'Add something you are trying',      empty:'Nothing on trial.',             hint:'New things you are testing. Add a first impression.' },
      { id:'finished',    label:'Finished',    short:'Finished',    title:'Add a finished product',    empty:'Nothing finished yet.',         hint:'Empty bottles and put-away products.' },
      { id:'repurchased', label:'Rebuy',       short:'Rebuy',       title:'Add a product you rebuy',       empty:'No rebuys yet.',                hint:'Products you liked enough to buy again.' }
    ];
    var TAB = 'rotation';
    function V(){ if(!DB.vault || typeof DB.vault!=='object' || Array.isArray(DB.vault)) DB.vault = {}; if(!DB.vault.items || typeof DB.vault.items!=='object') DB.vault.items = {}; if(!DB.vault.seen) DB.vault.seen = {}; return DB.vault; }
    function key(n, b){ return (String(n||'').trim()+'|'+String(b||'').trim()).toLowerCase(); }
    function newId(){ return 'pv_'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6); }
    function all(){ var it = V().items; return Object.keys(it).map(function(k){ return it[k]; }); }
    function shelf(id){ return all().filter(function(x){ return x.shelf===id; }).sort(function(a,b){ return String(b.added||'').localeCompare(String(a.added||'')) || String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)); }); }
    function labelOf(id){ var s = SHELVES.filter(function(x){ return x.id===id; })[0]; return s ? s.label : id; }
    function find(n, b){ var k = key(n,b), l = all(); for(var i=0;i<l.length;i++){ if(key(l[i].name,l[i].brand)===k) return l[i]; } return null; }
    function add(o, sh){
      var hit = find(o.name, o.brand);
      if(hit){ moveTo(hit, sh); return hit; }
      var id = newId(); V().items[id] = { id:id, name:o.name||'', brand:o.brand||'', kind:o.kind||'', shelf:sh, rating:o.rating||0, characteristics:o.characteristics||'', longevity:o.longevity||'', note:o.note||'', added:(o.added!==undefined ? o.added : todayStr()), finishedAt:null };
      saveDB(); return V().items[id];
    }
    function moveTo(it, sh){ it.shelf = sh; if(sh==='finished') it.finishedAt = todayStr(); else it.finishedAt = null; if(sh==='rotation' && !it.added) it.added = todayStr(); saveDB(); }

    /* ---------- old monthly pages -> the vault, once ---------- */
    function seed(){
      var v = V(), changed = false, months = Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).sort();
      var latestRot = null; months.forEach(function(mk){ var pg = (DB.monthly[mk]||{}).income; if(pg && Array.isArray(pg.inRotation) && pg.inRotation.length) latestRot = mk; });
      function once(sk){ if(v.seen[sk]) return false; v.seen[sk] = 1; changed = true; return true; }
      months.forEach(function(mk){
        var m = DB.monthly[mk] || {}, pg = m.income, ob = m.objectives;
        if(pg){
          if(mk===latestRot) pg.inRotation.forEach(function(p){ if(p && String(p.name||'').trim() && once('rot|'+key(p.name,p.brand))){ if(!find(p.name,p.brand)) add({ added:'', name:String(p.name).trim(), brand:String(p.brand||'').trim(), characteristics:'', note:p.note||'', kind:(C.findName(p.name)||{}).kind||'' }, 'rotation'); } });
          [['rotation','rotation'],['finished','finished'],['repurchased','repurchased']].forEach(function(g){
            var it = pg[g[0]]; if(!it || !String(it.name||'').trim()) return;
            if(g[0]==='rotation' && latestRot) return;   /* the old single product was already carried into the list */
            if(once(mk+'|'+g[0]+'|'+key(it.name,it.brand))){ if(!find(it.name,it.brand)) add({ added:'', name:String(it.name).trim(), brand:String(it.brand||'').trim(), characteristics:it.characteristics||'', longevity:it.longevity||'', rating:+it.rating||0, kind:(C.findName(it.name)||{}).kind||'' }, g[1]); }
          });
        }
        if(ob && Array.isArray(ob.list)) ob.list.forEach(function(it, i){
          if(!it || !String(it.name||'').trim()) return;
          if(once(mk+'|obj|'+key(it.name,it.brand))){ if(!find(it.name,it.brand)) add({ added:'', name:String(it.name).trim(), brand:String(it.brand||'').trim(), characteristics:it.characteristics||'', note:it.note||'', rating:+it.rating||0, kind:(C.findName(it.name)||{}).kind||'' }, 'trying'); }
        });
      });
      if(changed) saveDB();
    }

    /* ---------- what the other boxes read ---------- */
    C.rotation = function(){ seed(); return all().filter(function(x){ return x.shelf==='rotation' || x.shelf==='trying' || x.shelf==='repurchased'; }).sort(function(a,b){ return (a.shelf==='rotation'?0:1)-(b.shelf==='rotation'?0:1) || String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)); }).map(function(x){ return { name:x.name, brand:x.brand, kind:x.kind }; }); };
    function usageMap(){
      var map = {}, cut = new Date(); cut.setDate(cut.getDate()-30); var cs = cut.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(cut.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+cut.getDate()).slice(-2);
      Object.keys(DB.days||{}).forEach(function(ds){ if(ds<cs) return; var s = DB.days[ds] && DB.days[ds].pages && DB.days[ds].pages.shower; if(!s) return; for(var i=1;i<=5;i++){ var n = String(s['product'+i]||'').trim().toLowerCase(); if(n) map[n] = (map[n]||0)+1; } });
      return map;
    }

    /* ---------- tag lists ---------- */
    var TAGS = {
      'Skincare':['Hydrating','Lightweight','Gentle','Fragrance-free','Matte finish','Rich','Absorbs fast','Sticky','Stings'],
      'Hair':['Smooth','Volume','Shine','Moisturising','Strong hold','Light hold','Matte','Greasy','Itchy scalp relief'],
      'Body':['Fresh','Moisturising','Light scent','Strong scent','Quick dry','Sticky'],
      'Teeth and mouth':['Fresh','Strong mint','Gentle','Whitening'],
      'Shaving and beard':['Smooth','Gentle','Cooling','Close shave','Stings'],
      'Fragrance':['Fresh','Woody','Sweet','Spicy','Floral','Citrus','Musky','Clean','Powdery','Smoky','Fruity','Aquatic'],
      '':['Hydrating','Gentle','Fresh','Light','Rich','Strong scent','Fragrance-free','Works well']
    };
    var LASTS = { 'Fragrance':['2 to 4 hours','4 to 6 hours','6 to 8 hours','8 hours or more'], '':['1 week','2 weeks','1 month','2 months','3 months or more'] };
    var NOTES = ['Love it','Would rebuy','Too strong','Not for me','Great value','Too expensive','Good for summer','Good for night','Gets compliments'];
    var EM = { 'Skincare':'💧','Hair':'💇','Body':'🧴','Teeth and mouth':'🦷','Shaving and beard':'🪒','Fragrance':'✨','':'🧴' };
    function groupOf(it){ var g = it.kind ? C.groupOfKind(it.kind) : ''; if(!g){ var h = C.findName(it.name); if(h) g = C.groupOfKind(h.kind); } return g || ''; }
    var MON = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    function fmtShort(d){ return MON[d.getMonth()]+' '+d.getDate(); }
    function parts(s){ return String(s||'').split(/\s*,\s*/).filter(Boolean); }

    /* ---------- the card ---------- */
    function star(it, k){ var on = Math.ceil((+it.rating||0)/2) >= k; return '<button type="button" class="vt-star'+(on?' on':'')+'" data-vt="star" data-id="'+it.id+'" data-v="'+k+'" aria-label="'+k+' of 5 stars">'+(on?'★':'☆')+'</button>'; }
    function row(it, act, lab, val, ph){ return '<button type="button" class="vt-row" data-vt="'+act+'" data-id="'+it.id+'"><span class="l">'+lab+'</span><span class="v'+(val?'':' empty')+'">'+(val||E(ph))+'</span></button>'; }
    /* CYCLE 5: cards are collapsed by default. The top shows the brand, name, a few tags and the score; tap it to open the rest
       (rating, tags, how long it lasts, thoughts, move/remove). One card open at a time keeps the list short. */
    var OPENID = null;
    function card(it, usage){
      var g = groupOf(it), em = EM[g] || '🧴', tags = parts(it.characteristics), used = usage[String(it.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()] || 0, open = OPENID===it.id;
      var since = it.shelf==='finished' && it.finishedAt ? 'Finished '+E(fmtShort(new Date(it.finishedAt+'T12:00:00'))) : (it.added ? 'Since '+E(fmtShort(new Date(it.added+'T12:00:00'))) : '');
      var rated = (it.shelf==='finished' || it.shelf==='repurchased');
      var head = '<button type="button" class="vt-top" data-vt="open" data-id="'+it.id+'" aria-expanded="'+open+'"><div class="vt-tile" aria-hidden="true">'+em+'</div><div class="vt-id">'
        + (it.brand ? '<div class="vt-brand">'+E(it.brand)+'</div>' : '<div class="vt-brand none">No brand</div>')
        + '<div class="vt-name">'+E(it.name||'Unnamed')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="vt-meta">'+(it.kind && it.kind!==it.name ? '<span class="vt-kind">'+E(it.kind)+'</span>' : '')+(used ? '<span class="vt-used">Used '+used+'× in 30 days</span>' : (since ? '<span>'+since+'</span>' : ''))+'</div></div>'
        + (rated && it.rating ? '<span class="vt-badge">'+(+it.rating)+'<small>/10</small></span>' : '') + '<span class="vt-chev" aria-hidden="true">'+icon(open?'minus':'plus',14)+'</span></button>';
      var peek = (!open && tags.length) ? '<div class="vt-peek">'+tags.slice(0,3).map(function(t){ return '<i>'+E(t)+'</i>'; }).join('')+(tags.length>3 ? '<i class="more">+'+(tags.length-3)+'</i>' : '')+'</div>' : '';
      var body = !open ? '' : '<div class="vt-more">'
        + (rated ? '<div class="vt-rate"><div class="vt-stars" role="group" aria-label="Rating">'+[1,2,3,4,5].map(function(k){ return star(it,k); }).join('')+'</div><div class="vt-score">'+(it.rating ? (+it.rating)+'<small>/10</small>' : '<small>Rate it</small>')+'</div></div>' : '')
        + row(it, 'tags', 'Feels like', tags.length ? tags.map(function(t){ return '<i>'+E(t)+'</i>'; }).join('') : '', 'Add tags')
        + row(it, 'last', g==='Fragrance' ? 'Lasts' : 'Lasts about', it.longevity ? E(it.longevity) : '', 'How long?')
        + row(it, 'note', 'Thoughts', it.note ? E(it.note) : '', 'Add a note')
        + '<div class="vt-acts"><button type="button" class="vt-act" data-vt="move" data-id="'+it.id+'">Move to…</button><button type="button" class="vt-act danger" data-vt="rm" data-id="'+it.id+'">Remove</button></div></div>';
      return '<div class="vt-card'+(open?' open':'')+'" data-card="'+it.id+'">'+head+peek+body+'</div>';
    }

    /* ---------- the page ---------- */
    function vaultBody(monthKey){
      var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey(); seed();
      var counts = {}; SHELVES.forEach(function(s){ counts[s.id] = shelf(s.id).length; });
      if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)){
        var rows = '';
        SHELVES.forEach(function(s){ shelf(s.id).forEach(function(it){ rows += '<div class="locked-item-row" style="align-items:flex-start;"><span style="font-weight:700;">'+E(s.label)+'</span><span class="muted-inline">'+E(it.name)+(it.brand?' · '+E(it.brand):'')+'</span></div>'; }); });
        return monthlyLockedBody(rows ? '<div class="field-card">'+rows+'</div>' : '<div class="empty-note">Nothing in your vault yet.</div>', 'income', mk);
      }
      var cur = SHELVES.filter(function(s){ return s.id===TAB; })[0] || SHELVES[0], list = shelf(cur.id), usage = usageMap(), total = all().length;
      var h = '<div class="vt-hero"><div class="vt-hero-t">Product vault</div><div class="vt-hero-s">'+(total ? total+' product'+(total===1?'':'s')+' in one place. Tap a card to rate it, tag it or move it.' : 'Everything you use, try and finish, in one place.')+'</div></div>'
        + '<div class="vt-tabs" role="tablist">'+SHELVES.map(function(s){ return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(s.id===cur.id)+'" class="vt-tab'+(s.id===cur.id?' on':'')+'" data-vt="tab" data-v="'+s.id+'"><b>'+counts[s.id]+'</b><span>'+E(s.short)+'</span></button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="vt-hint">'+E(cur.hint)+'</div>';
      if(list.length) h += list.map(function(it){ return card(it, usage); }).join('') + '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn ls-add" data-vt="add">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add a product</button>';
      else h += '<div class="vt-empty"><div class="em">'+(cur.id==='rotation'?'🧴':cur.id==='trying'?'🧪':cur.id==='finished'?'✅':'🔁')+'</div><b>'+E(cur.empty)+'</b><p>'+E(cur.hint)+'</p><button type="button" class="ls-go" data-vt="add">'+icon('plus',15)+' Add a product</button></div>';
      return h + '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow(\'income\',\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+' Mark done for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'</button>';
    }
    incomeBody = vaultBody;

    /* ---------- taps ---------- */
    function vt(b){
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-vt'), id = b.getAttribute('data-id'), v = b.getAttribute('data-v'), it = id ? V().items[id] : null;
      if(a==='tab'){ TAB = v; OPENID = null; return render(); }
      if(a==='open'){ OPENID = (OPENID===id) ? null : id; return render(); }
      if(a==='add'){ return window.WIZ.open('rot:'+TAB, currentMonthKey(), function(x){ var had = find(x.name, x.brand); add(x, TAB); if(had) flashSaved('Already in your vault. Moved it here.'); render(); }, (SHELVES.filter(function(x){ return x.id===TAB; })[0]||{}).title); }
      if(!it) return;
      if(a==='star'){ var r = Number(v)*2; it.rating = (+it.rating===r ? 0 : r); saveDB(); flashSaved(); return render(); }
      var g = groupOf(it);
      if(a==='tags') return LS.openLS({ title:'Feels like', secs:[{ id:'t', multi:true, other:true, opts:(TAGS[g]||TAGS['']).concat(parts(it.characteristics).filter(function(t){ return (TAGS[g]||TAGS['']).indexOf(t)<0; })), sel:parts(it.characteristics) }], cta:function(st){ return st.t.length ? 'Done · '+st.t.length+' picked' : 'Done'; }, done:function(st){ it.characteristics = st.t.join(', '); saveDB(); flashSaved(); render(); } });
      if(a==='last') return LS.openLS({ title:'How long does it last?', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', other:true, opts:(LASTS[g]||LASTS['']), sel:it.longevity?[it.longevity]:[] }], extra:it.longevity ? [{ label:'Clear this', act:function(){ it.longevity = ''; saveDB(); render(); } }] : [],
        done:function(st){ it.longevity = st.v[0]||''; saveDB(); flashSaved(); render(); } });
      if(a==='note') return LS.openLS({ title:'Thoughts', secs:[{ id:'n', multi:true, other:true, opts:NOTES.concat(parts(it.note).filter(function(t){ return NOTES.indexOf(t)<0; })), sel:parts(it.note) }], cta:function(st){ return st.n.length ? 'Done · '+st.n.length+' picked' : 'Done'; }, done:function(st){ it.note = st.n.join(', '); saveDB(); flashSaved(); render(); } });
      if(a==='move') return LS.openLS({ title:'Move '+(it.name||'product')+' to', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'s', opts:SHELVES.map(function(s){ return s.label; }), sel:[labelOf(it.shelf)], other:false }],
        done:function(st){ var s = SHELVES.filter(function(x){ return x.label===st.s[0]; })[0]; if(!s || s.id===it.shelf) return; moveTo(it, s.id); TAB = s.id; flashSaved('Moved to '+s.label); render(); } });
      if(a==='rm'){
        if(ARM && ARM.id===id){ clearTimeout(ARM.t); ARM = null; delete V().items[id]; saveDB(); flashSaved('Removed'); return render(); }
        if(ARM){ clearTimeout(ARM.t); try{ ARM.b.classList.remove('arm'); ARM.b.textContent = 'Remove'; }catch(e){} }
        b.classList.add('arm'); b.textContent = 'Tap again to remove';
        ARM = { id:id, b:b, t:setTimeout(function(){ try{ b.classList.remove('arm'); b.textContent = 'Remove'; }catch(e){} ARM = null; }, 3000) };
      }
    }
    var ARM = null;
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-vt]'); if(!b || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      e.stopPropagation(); vt(b);
    }, true);

    /* ---------- the Shower box: "What you used" reads the vault ---------- */
    var baseFW = fieldWrap;
    fieldWrap = function(label, hint, inner){
      if(label==='What you used' && typeof inner==='string' && inner.indexOf('timeline-row')>=0){
        try{
          var ds = (typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.date) || todayStr(), p = getPage(ds,'shower'), rows = inner.split('<div class="timeline-row"'), pre = rows.shift();
          var used = {}, filled = 0; for(var i=1;i<=5;i++){ var n = String(p['product'+i]||'').trim(); if(n){ used[n.toLowerCase()] = i; filled = i; } }
          var keep = rows.map(function(r, idx){ return { r:r, i:idx+1 }; }).filter(function(x){ return x.i<=Math.max(1, filled+1); });
          var chips = C.rotation();
          var top = chips.length
            ? '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 8px;">From your vault. Tap what you used.</div><div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">'+chips.slice(0,14).map(function(c){ var on = !!used[String(c.name).toLowerCase()]; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-vt-sh="1" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-n="'+E(c.name)+'" data-b="'+E(c.brand||'')+'">'+E(c.name)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
            : '<div class="vt-shempty">Your vault is empty. <button type="button" class="vt-link" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'income\')">Add products to your vault</button> and they show up here as one tap.</div>';
          return baseFW(label, hint, top + '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin:14px 0 6px;">Details'+(filled<5?'':' (all 5 spots used)')+'</div>' + pre + keep.map(function(x){ return '<div class="timeline-row"'+x.r; }).join(''));
        }catch(e){}
      }
      return baseFW.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-vt-sh]'); if(!b) return; e.stopPropagation();
      var ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), n = b.getAttribute('data-n'), br = b.getAttribute('data-b'), p = getPage(ds,'shower'), slot = 0, free = 0, i;
      for(i=1;i<=5;i++){ var cur = String(p['product'+i]||'').trim(); if(cur.toLowerCase()===n.toLowerCase()) slot = i; if(!cur && !free) free = i; }
      if(slot){ setText(ds,'shower','product'+slot,''); setText(ds,'shower','brand'+slot,''); }
      else if(free){ setText(ds,'shower','product'+free,n); if(br) setText(ds,'shower','brand'+free,br); }
      else { flashSaved('All 5 spots are used. Remove one first.'); return; }
      flashSaved(); render();
    }, true);

    /* ---------- look ---------- */
    var css = ''
      + '.vt-hero{padding:4px 2px 12px;}.vt-hero-t{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.01em;}.vt-hero-s{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4;}'
      + '.vt-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;background:var(--surface-2);padding:5px;border-radius:20px;margin:0 0 10px;}'
      + '.vt-tab{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-radius:16px;min-height:56px;padding:6px 2px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .12s;}'
      + '.vt-tab b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;}.vt-tab span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap;}'
      + '.vt-tab.on{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}.vt-tab:active{transform:scale(.96);}'
      + '.vt-hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 2px 12px;}'
      + '.vt-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:14px;margin:0 0 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
      + '.vt-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;width:100%;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:none;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.vt-top .vt-id{flex:1;min-width:0;}.vt-badge{flex:none;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:5px 9px;}.vt-badge small{font-size:10px;opacity:.7}.vt-chev{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}'
      + '.vt-peek{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:10px 0 0 62px}.vt-peek i{font-style:normal;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 9px}.vt-peek i.more{color:var(--muted)}'
      + '.vt-more{margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.vt-card:not(.open){padding:12px 14px}'
      + '.vt-tile{flex:none;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface-2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line);}'
      + '.vt-id{min-width:0;flex:1;}.vt-brand{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:2px;}.vt-brand.none{color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.vt-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:17px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}'
      + '.vt-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;}'
      + '.vt-kind{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 9px;color:var(--ink-soft,var(--muted));}.vt-used{color:var(--accent);}'
      + '.vt-rate{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:16px;padding:2px 6px 2px 2px;margin-bottom:8px;}'
      + '.vt-stars{display:flex;}.vt-star{border:0;background:transparent;font-size:26px;line-height:1;color:var(--line);width:44px;height:48px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.vt-star.on{color:var(--accent);}.vt-star:active{transform:scale(.88);}'
      + '.vt-score{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;}.vt-score small{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin-left:2px;}'
      + '.vt-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;padding:11px 2px;min-height:46px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.vt-row .l{flex:none;width:88px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding-top:3px;}'
      + '.vt-row .v{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.vt-row .v.empty{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;}'
      + '.vt-row .v i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;}'
      + '.vt-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:2px;}'
      + '.vt-act{flex:1;min-height:44px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.vt-act.danger{color:var(--muted);}.vt-act.arm{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
      + '.vt-empty{text-align:center;padding:26px 16px 20px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:24px;margin:0 0 14px;}.vt-empty .em{font-size:40px;margin-bottom:8px;}.vt-empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:17px;}.vt-empty p{margin:4px 0 4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;}'
      + '.vt-shempty{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;}.vt-link{border:0;background:none;color:var(--accent);font:inherit;font-weight:800;text-decoration:underline;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'vault-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    window.VAULT = { all:all, shelf:shelf, add:add, seed:seed, key:key };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('product vault', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   READING: ONE BOOKSHELF  (Reading Boy and Reading Girl)

   Cycle 3: every book is its own card (cover tile, author, genre, progress bar, 5 stars, pages, move/remove), exactly like the Product Vault,
   a page count is required before a book can be added, and the vault is reachable only from Settings (all 7 apps).

   Before: the Reading Vault (a monthly page), the Reading Log (title typed by hand) and a hidden Library were
   three separate lists of books that never talked to each other.

   Now there is ONE shelf: DB.library.books (it was already in the data, so old backups still load).
     - The VAULT page shows it as shelves: Reading, Finished, On deck (Girl also has DNF).
       Every book has a Move button, so you can shift it between shelves with one tap.
     - The READING LOG's "Book" box opens your whole shelf (reading now, on deck, old reads) to choose from.
   Books you had already put in the old monthly Vault are copied onto the shelf ONCE, the first time it opens.
   The old monthly entries are left untouched.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof libCurrentBook!=='function' || !window.LISTS || !window.LISTS.openLS) return;
    /* ONE book vault for all 7 apps. It lives in Settings > Book vault and is the only place books are added.
       The Reading Log only picks from it. Reading Boy/Girl also copy their old monthly "Reading Vault" entries in, once. */
    var VAULT = /reading/i.test(BRAND.name), GIRL = /reading girl/i.test(BRAND.name);
    var E = esc, L = function(){ return DB.library; }, LS = window.LISTS;
    var SHELVES = GIRL
      ? [{ id:'reading', label:'Reading' }, { id:'finished', label:'Finished' }, { id:'toread', label:'TBR' }, { id:'dnf', label:'DNF' }]
      : [{ id:'reading', label:'Reading' }, { id:'finished', label:'Finished' }, { id:'toread', label:'On deck' }];
    function shelfOf(b){ return b.status==='paused' ? 'reading' : (b.status==='reading' ? 'reading' : (b.status==='toread' ? 'toread' : (b.status==='finished' ? 'finished' : (b.status==='dnf' ? 'dnf' : 'toread')))); }
    function label(id){ var s = SHELVES.filter(function(x){ return x.id===id; })[0]; return s ? s.label : id; }
    function key(t){ return String(t||'').trim().toLowerCase(); }
    function today(){ return todayStr(); }
    function byTitle(t){ var k = key(t), all = L().books; for(var id in all){ if(key(all[id].title)===k) return all[id]; } return null; }
    function newId(){ return 'bk_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6); }

    /* ---------- the old monthly vault -> the shelf, once ---------- */
    function importVault(){
      if(!VAULT) return;
      var lib = L(); if(!lib.vaultSeen) lib.vaultSeen = {}; var changed = false;
      Object.keys(DB.monthly || {}).sort().forEach(function(mk){
        var page = (DB.monthly[mk] || {}).income; if(!page) return;
        [['reading','paused'], ['finished','finished'], ['onDeck','toread'], ['tbr','toread']].forEach(function(g){
          var first = page[g[0]], more = page[g[0]+'_more'];
          [first].concat(Array.isArray(more) ? more : []).forEach(function(it){
            if(!it || !String(it.title||'').trim()) return;
            var sk = mk+'|'+g[0]+'|'+key(it.title); if(lib.vaultSeen[sk]) return; lib.vaultSeen[sk] = 1; changed = true;
            if(byTitle(it.title)) return;
            var id = newId(); lib.books[id] = { id:id, title:String(it.title).trim(), author:String(it.author||'').trim(), genre:it.genre||'', pageCurrent:0, pageTotal:0, rating:+it.rating||0,
              status:g[1], startedAt:null, finishedAt:g[1]==='finished' ? mk+'-28' : null, lastLoggedDate:null, bookedDates:{}, dailyPages:{}, fromVault:mk };
          });
        });
      });
      /* a title typed on today's log before the shelf existed */
      try{
        var p = (((DB.days||{})[today()]||{}).pages||{}).reading;
        if(p && p.title && !byTitle(p.title)){ libSyncFromReadingLog(today()); changed = true; }
      }catch(e){}
      if(changed) saveDB();
    }
    function booksOn(shelf){
      var cur = L().currentBookId, out = Object.keys(L().books).map(function(id){ return L().books[id]; }).filter(function(b){ return shelfOf(b)===shelf; });
      return out.sort(function(a,b){
        if(shelf==='reading'){ if(a.id===cur) return -1; if(b.id===cur) return 1; return (b.lastLoggedDate||'').localeCompare(a.lastLoggedDate||''); }
        if(shelf==='finished') return (b.finishedAt||'').localeCompare(a.finishedAt||'');
        return (a.title||'').localeCompare(b.title||'');
      });
    }

    /* ---------- the moves ---------- */
    function setCurrent(id){
      var b = L().books[id]; if(!b) return;
      var old = libCurrentBook(); if(old && old.id!==id) old.status = 'paused';
      b.status = 'reading'; if(!b.startedAt) b.startedAt = today(); L().currentBookId = id;
      var p = getPage(today(), 'reading');
      p.title = b.title || ''; p.author = b.author || ''; p.pageTotal = b.pageTotal || ''; p.pageFrom = b.pageCurrent!=null ? b.pageCurrent : '';
      p.pagesToday = (b.dailyPages && b.dailyPages[today()]) || 0; p.baselinePage = Math.max(0, (+p.pageFrom||0) - (+p.pagesToday||0)); p.bookId = id;
    }
    function move(id, shelf, quiet){
      var b = L().books[id]; if(!b) return; var was = L().currentBookId===id;
      if(shelf==='reading') setCurrent(id);
      else {
        if(was) L().currentBookId = null;
        b.status = shelf;
        if(shelf==='finished'){ b.finishedAt = today(); b.pagesReadFinal = libPagesReadForBook(b); b.daysActiveFinal = libDaysActiveForBook(b); if(!b.pageTotal && b.pageCurrent) b.pageTotal = b.pageCurrent; }
      }
      touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); render(); if(!quiet) flashSaved('Moved to '+label(shelf));
    }
    function addBook(o, shelf){
      var id = newId(), known = LS.bookByTitle(o.title);
      L().books[id] = { id:id, title:o.title, author:o.author || (known ? known[1] : ''), genre:o.genre || (known ? known[2] : ''), pageCurrent:0, pageTotal:0, rating:0, status:shelf==='reading' ? 'paused' : shelf,
        startedAt:null, finishedAt:shelf==='finished' ? today() : null, lastLoggedDate:null, bookedDates:{}, dailyPages:{} };
      if(shelf==='reading' && !libCurrentBook()) setCurrent(id);
      return L().books[id];
    }
    function removeBook(id){
      var b = L().books[id], p = (((DB.days||{})[today()]||{}).pages||{}).reading;
      if(p && b && key(p.title)===key(b.title)){ p.title = ''; p.author = ''; p.pageTotal = ''; p.pageFrom = ''; p.pagesToday = 0; p.baselinePage = 0; delete p.bookId; }   /* the log must not re-create it */
      if(L().currentBookId===id) L().currentBookId = null; delete L().books[id]; touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Removed'); }

    /* ---------- the add-a-book sheet: genre, the book (or type your own), then HOW MANY PAGES (required) ---------- */
    function addSheet(shelf, onDone){
      var have = {}; Object.keys(L().books).forEach(function(id){ have[key(L().books[id].title)] = 1; });
      var secs = [{ id:'g', label:'Pick a genre to browse', opts:LS.genres, sel:['Self-help'], other:false },
                  { id:'b', label:'The book', sel:[], other:true, opts:function(st){ var g = st.g[0]; return LS.books.filter(function(b){ return (!g || b[2]===g) && !have[key(b[0])]; }).map(function(b){ return b[0]; }); } },
                  { id:'pg', label:'How many pages does it have?', num:{ step:10, min:0, max:3000, quick:[150,250,350,450,600], def:0 }, val:0 }];
      LS.openLS({ title:'Add a book to '+label(shelf), secs:secs, needs:true,
        count:function(st){ return st.b.length && Number(st.pg)>0 ? 1 : 0; },
        cta:function(st, n){ return !st.b.length ? 'Pick a book first' : (Number(st.pg)>0 ? 'Add to '+label(shelf) : 'Add the page count to continue'); },
        done:function(st){ var bk = addBook({ title:String(st.b[0]).trim() }, shelf); bk.pageTotal = Math.round(Number(st.pg)); touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Added to '+label(shelf)); if(onDone) onDone([bk]); } });
    }
    function pagesSheet(id){
      var b = L().books[id]; if(!b) return;
      LS.openLS({ title:'Pages in "'+(b.title||'book')+'"', secs:[{ id:'v', num:{ step:10, min:10, max:3000, quick:[150,250,350,450,600], def:300 }, val:b.pageTotal||300 }], cta:function(){ return 'Save'; },
        done:function(s){ b.pageTotal = Math.round(Number(s.v))||b.pageTotal; if(b.pageCurrent>b.pageTotal) b.pageCurrent = b.pageTotal; touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); render(); } });
    }

    /* ---------- styles (the book cards copy the Product Vault look) ---------- */
    var css = ''
    + '.bk-hero{padding:4px 2px 12px;}.bk-hero-t{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.01em;}.bk-hero-s{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4;}'
    + '.bk-tabs{display:grid;gap:6px;background:var(--surface-2);padding:5px;border-radius:20px;margin:0 0 12px;}'
    + '.bk-tab{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-radius:16px;min-height:56px;padding:6px 2px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px;}'
    + '.bk-tab b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;}.bk-tab span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap;}'
    + '.bk-tab.on{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
    + '.bk-add{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:50px;border:1.5px dashed var(--accent);border-radius:18px;background:transparent;color:var(--accent);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 14px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.bk-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:14px;margin:0 0 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
    + '.bk-top{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;}'
    + '.bk-cover{flex:none;width:56px;height:78px;border-radius:6px 12px 12px 6px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,hsl(var(--h) 34% 36%),hsl(var(--h) 40% 22%));color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 6px 14px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}'
    + '.bk-cover svg{opacity:.92}.bk-cover i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.9}'
    + '.bk-id{min-width:0;flex:1;}.bk-author{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.bk-author.none{color:var(--muted);}'
    + '.bk-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:17px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}'
    + '.bk-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;}'
    + '.bk-pill{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;color:var(--ink-soft,var(--muted));}.bk-pill.now{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
    + '.bk-prog{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden;margin:2px 0 6px;}.bk-prog i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent);}'
    + '.bk-pl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 12px;}'
    + '.bk-rate{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:16px;padding:2px 6px 2px 2px;margin-bottom:8px;}'
    + '.bk-stars{display:flex;}.bk-star{border:0;background:transparent;line-height:1;color:var(--line);width:44px;height:48px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}.bk-star.on{color:var(--accent);}.bk-star svg{width:24px;height:24px;}.bk-star.on svg{fill:currentColor;}'
    + '.bk-score{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;}.bk-score small{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin-left:2px;}'
    + '.bk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;padding:11px 2px;min-height:46px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.bk-row .l{flex:none;width:88px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}.bk-row .v{flex:1;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}'
    + '.bk-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:2px;}'
    + '.bk-act{flex:1;min-height:44px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.bk-act.pri{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}.bk-act.danger.armed{background:var(--red,#c0392b);border-color:transparent;color:#fff;}'
    + '.bk-empty{text-align:center;padding:26px 16px 20px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:24px;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted);}.bk-empty .em{margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--accent);}.bk-empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px;}.bk-empty p{margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;}'
    + '.rd-btn{min-height:40px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.rd-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}.rd-empty{padding:12px 4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;}'
    + '.rd-choose{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:68px;padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.rd-choose.empty{border-style:dashed;}'
    + '.rd-choose .ico{flex:none;width:42px;height:52px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--accent);}'
    + '.rd-choose .tx{flex:1;min-width:0;}.rd-choose b{display:block;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.25;}.rd-choose small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:2px;}'
    + '.rd-choose .chg{flex:none;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--accent);}'
    + '.rd-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:58px;padding:10px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;text-align:left;margin:0 0 8px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
    + '.rd-row:active{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:var(--accent);}.rd-row .tx{flex:1;min-width:0;}.rd-row b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;}.rd-row small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;}'
    + '.rd-sec{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 2px 8px;}.rd-sec:first-child{margin-top:0;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'rd-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* =================================================================================================
       THE BOOK VAULT PAGE (Settings > Book vault)
       ================================================================================================= */
    var tab = 'reading';
    function hue(t){ var h = 0, s = String(t||'book'); for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++) h = (h*31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) % 360; return h; }
    function initials(t){ var w = String(t||'').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 ]/g,'').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); return (w.length>1 ? w[0][0]+w[1][0] : (w[0]||'B').slice(0,2)).toUpperCase(); }
    function star(b,k){ var on = Math.ceil((+b.rating||0)/2) >= k; return '<button type="button" class="bk-star'+(on?' on':'')+'" data-rd="star" data-id="'+b.id+'" data-v="'+k+'" aria-label="'+k+' of 5 stars">'+icon('star',24)+'</button>'; }
    function bookCard(b){
      var cur = L().currentBookId===b.id, tot = +b.pageTotal||0, at = Math.min(+b.pageCurrent||0, tot||1e9), pct = tot ? Math.round(at/tot*100) : 0, sh = shelfOf(b);
      var tag = cur ? '<span class="bk-pill now">Reading now</span>' : (b.status==='paused' ? '<span class="bk-pill">Paused</span>' : '');
      return '<div class="bk-card"><div class="bk-top"><div class="bk-cover" style="--h:'+hue(b.title)+'" aria-hidden="true">'+icon('book',22)+'<i>'+E(initials(b.title))+'</i></div><div class="bk-id">'
        + (b.author ? '<div class="bk-author">'+E(b.author)+'</div>' : '<div class="bk-author none">Author not set</div>')
        + '<div class="bk-title">'+E(b.title||'Untitled')+'</div>'
