        + '<div class="bk-meta">'+(b.genre ? '<span class="bk-pill">'+E(b.genre)+'</span>' : '')+tag+'</div></div></div>'
        + (tot && sh!=='toread' ? '<div class="bk-prog" role="img" aria-label="'+pct+' percent read"><i style="width:'+(sh==='finished' ? 100 : pct)+'%"></i></div><div class="bk-pl">'+(sh==='finished' ? tot+' pages · finished'+(b.finishedAt ? ' '+E(b.finishedAt) : '') : at+' of '+tot+' pages · '+pct+'%')+'</div>' : '')
        + (sh!=='finished' ? '' : '<div class="bk-rate"><div class="bk-stars" role="group" aria-label="Rating">'+[1,2,3,4,5].map(function(k){ return star(b,k); }).join('')+'</div><div class="bk-score">'+(b.rating ? (+b.rating)+'<small>/10</small>' : '<small>Tap to rate</small>')+'</div></div>')
        + '<button type="button" class="bk-row" data-rd="pages" data-id="'+b.id+'"><span class="l">Pages</span><span class="v">'+(tot ? tot+' pages' : 'Add the page count')+'</span></button>'
        + '<div class="bk-acts"><button type="button" class="bk-act pri" data-rd="move" data-id="'+b.id+'">Move to…</button><button type="button" class="bk-act danger" data-rd="rm" data-id="'+b.id+'" aria-label="Remove '+E(b.title||'book')+'">Remove</button></div></div>';
    }
    function shelfBody(){
      importVault();
      var cur = SHELVES.filter(function(s){ return s.id===tab; })[0] || SHELVES[0]; tab = cur.id;
      var total = Object.keys(L().books).length, list = booksOn(cur.id);
      var h = '<div class="bk-hero"><div class="bk-hero-t">Book vault</div><div class="bk-hero-s">'+(total ? total+' book'+(total===1?'':'s')+' in one place. Books are added here, and picked on the Reading Log.' : 'Every book you read, want to read or finished. Add the first one below.')+'</div></div>'
        + '<div class="bk-tabs" style="grid-template-columns:repeat('+SHELVES.length+',1fr)" role="tablist">'+SHELVES.map(function(s){ return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(s.id===cur.id)+'" class="bk-tab'+(s.id===cur.id?' on':'')+'" data-rd="tab" data-v="'+s.id+'"><b>'+booksOn(s.id).length+'</b><span>'+E(s.label)+'</span></button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
        + '<button type="button" class="bk-add" data-rd="add" data-shelf="'+cur.id+'">'+icon('plus',16)+' Add a book to '+E(cur.label)+'</button>';
      h += list.length ? list.map(bookCard).join('') : '<div class="bk-empty"><div class="em">'+icon('book',34)+'</div><b>Nothing on '+E(cur.label)+' yet</b><p>Tap the button above. You will pick a book and say how many pages it has.</p></div>';
      return h;
    }
    function shelfPage(){
      app.innerHTML = renderTopbar('Book vault', true) + '<div class="page-body">'+shelfBody()+'</div><div class="gap-block"></div>';
    }
    PAGE_RENDERERS.library = shelfPage; renderLibrary = shelfPage;
    if(VAULT && typeof incomeBody==='function') incomeBody = shelfBody;   /* an old link to the Reading Vault shows the same shelf */

    /* =================================================================================================
       THE READING LOG: "Book" box + chooser
       ================================================================================================= */
    var HIDE = '<!--rd-hide-->', BOOKBOX = '<!--rd-book-->';
    var _tf = textField;
    textField = function(ds, pid, key, ph, val){
      if(pid==='reading' && key==='title'){
        importVault();
        var b = libCurrentBook(), title = (b && b.title) || val || '', author = (b && b.author) || (getPage(ds,'reading').author||''), pages = b && b.pageTotal ? ' · '+(b.pageCurrent||0)+' of '+b.pageTotal+' pages' : '';
        return BOOKBOX + '<button type="button" class="rd-choose'+(title?'':' empty')+'" data-rd="choose"><span class="ico">'+icon('book',22)+'</span><span class="tx"><b>'+E(title || 'Choose your book')+'</b><small>'+E(title ? (author||'')+pages : 'Pick from your shelf, or add a new one')+'</small></span><span class="chg">'+(title?'Change':'Choose')+'</span></button>'
          + (title && b ? '<div class="rd-acts"><button type="button" class="rd-btn" data-rd="finish">'+icon('check',13)+' Finished this book</button><button type="button" class="rd-btn" data-rd="moveCur" data-id="'+b.id+'">Move to…</button></div>' : '');
      }
      if(pid==='reading' && key==='author') return HIDE;
      return _tf.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var _fw = fieldWrap;
    fieldWrap = function(label, hint, inner){
      if(typeof inner==='string'){
        if(inner.indexOf(HIDE)===0) return '';
        
      }
      return _fw.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    function chooser(){
      importVault();
      var cur = L().currentBookId, h = '<div class="ui-sheetbody">';
      var groups = [['Reading now and paused','reading'], ['On deck','toread'], ['Finished: read again', 'finished']];
      if(GIRL) groups = [['Reading now and paused','reading'], ['TBR','toread'], ['Finished: read again','finished']];
      var any = false;
      groups.forEach(function(g){
        var list = booksOn(g[1]); if(!list.length) return; any = true;
        h += '<div class="rd-sec">'+E(g[0])+'</div>' + list.map(function(b){
          return '<button type="button" class="rd-row" data-rd="pick" data-id="'+b.id+'"><span class="tx"><b>'+E(b.title||'Untitled')+'</b><small>'+E([b.author, b.id===cur ? 'Reading now' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</small></span>'+icon('chevright',15)+'</button>';
        }).join('');
      });
      if(!any) h += '<div class="rd-empty">Your shelf is empty. Add your first book in Settings › Book vault.</div>';
      h += '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn" data-rd="gotovault" style="margin-top:12px;">'+icon('book',14)+' Add books in Settings › Book vault</button></div>';
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>Choose your book</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'+h);
    }

    /* =================================================================================================
       CLICKS
       ================================================================================================= */
    function moveSheet(id){
      var b = L().books[id]; if(!b) return; var here = shelfOf(b);
      LS.openLS({ title:'Move "'+(b.title||'book')+'" to', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:SHELVES.filter(function(s){ return s.id!==here || (s.id==='reading' && L().currentBookId!==id); }).map(function(s){ return s.label; }), sel:[], other:false }],
        done:function(st){ var s = SHELVES.filter(function(x){ return x.label===st.v[0]; })[0]; if(s) move(id, s.id); } });
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      var t = ev.target; if(!t || !t.closest) return; var b = t.closest('[data-rd]'); if(!b) return;
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-rd'), id = b.getAttribute('data-id');
      switch(a){
        case 'move': case 'moveCur': return moveSheet(id);
        case 'rate': var bk = L().books[id]; if(!bk) return;
          return LS.openLS({ title:'Rate "'+(bk.title||'book')+'"', secs:[{ id:'v', num:{ step:1, min:0, max:10, quick:[5,6,7,8,9,10], def:7 }, val:bk.rating||7 }], cta:function(){ return 'Done'; },
            done:function(s){ bk.rating = Number(s.v)||0; saveDB(); render(); } });
        case 'rm':
          if(b.classList.contains('armed')){ clearTimeout(b._t); return removeBook(id); }
          var old = b.innerHTML; b.classList.add('armed'); b.textContent = 'Tap again to remove'; b._t = setTimeout(function(){ if(b.isConnected){ b.classList.remove('armed'); b.innerHTML = old; } }, 3000); return;
        case 'add': return addSheet(b.getAttribute('data-shelf'));
        case 'choose': return chooser();
        case 'pick': closeSheet(); if(L().currentBookId===id){ render(); return; } setCurrent(id); touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); render(); flashSaved('Now reading'); return;
        case 'gotovault': closeSheet(); return nav('page','library');
        case 'tab': tab = b.getAttribute('data-v'); return render();
        case 'star': var sb = L().books[id], k = Number(b.getAttribute('data-v')); if(!sb) return; sb.rating = (Math.ceil((+sb.rating||0)/2)===k ? 0 : k*2); touchSetupPage('library'); saveDB(); return render();
        case 'pages': return pagesSheet(id);
        case 'finish': return confirmFinishBook ? confirmFinishBook() : libFinishCurrentBook();
      }
    });

    /* the old "Switch book" sheet (typed title / author) now opens the same shelf chooser everywhere */
    if(typeof openBookPicker==='function') openBookPicker = chooser;
        window.READ = { importVault:importVault, move:move, shelves:SHELVES, books:booksOn, chooser:chooser, addBook:addBook, setCurrent:setCurrent };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('reading patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   HOBBIES (Sober Boy / Girl) and BUSINESS LANES (Hustler's): tap first, and make your own

   WHAT THIS DOES, IN PLAIN WORDS
   1. Every box in the daily hobby / business log becomes taps (chips, + / - steppers, quick amounts).
      Typing is still there as "+ Other", but nothing needs it.
   2. "Create your own": next to the built-in hobbies / business lanes there is a card to make your own.
      You tap a name, tap the things you want to track, and it becomes a normal log (saved in DB.customLanes).
      You can edit it or delete it later. Deleting only removes the log, the days you already logged stay.
   3. Hustler trades: the little typed table is now one card per trade (tap a pair, tap a result).
      The saved data is the same shape as before (pair / entry / exit / pnl), so old backups still work.
   4. Hustler workout: a short explainer at the top says how this log is different (you build your own
      presets), and the preset editor is rebuilt as taps (the old one redrew itself after every key you typed).
   Nothing here changes how data is saved, only how it is entered.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof LANES==='undefined' || typeof LANE_FIELDS==='undefined' || !window.UI || !window.LISTS || !window.LISTS.openLS) return;
    var SOBER = LANES.some(function(l){ return l.id==='CB'; }), HUST = LANES.some(function(l){ return l.id==='TR'; });
    if(!SOBER && !HUST) return;
    var E = esc, UI = window.UI, LS = window.LISTS, SP = UI.specs, KINDS = UI.kinds;
    var NOUN = SOBER ? 'hobby' : 'business log';

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ small spec helpers ---------- */
    function multi(opts){ return { t:'multi', note:true, opts:opts }; }
    function single(opts){ return { t:'single', opts:opts }; }
    function mins(q){ return { t:'step', kind:'min', quick:q }; }
    function money(step, q, lo){ return { t:'step', kind:'money', step:step, min:lo==null ? 0 : lo, quick:q }; }
    function big(step, q){ return { t:'step', kind:'big', step:step, quick:q }; }
    function num(q){ return { t:'step', kind:'num', quick:q }; }
    function hrs(q){ return { t:'step', kind:'hrs', quick:q }; }
    function reg(map){ Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){ SP['lane.'+k] = map[k]; }); }
    var NOTE_SOBER = multi(['Good session','Felt hard','Proud of it','Had fun','Rushed','Learned something','Need more practice']);
    var NOTE_HUST = multi(['Good day','Slow day','Learned something','Need to follow up','Raise prices','Try a new idea','Rest tomorrow']);

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ SOBER hobby boxes ---------- */
    if(SOBER){
      reg({
        dish: single(['Pasta','Stir-fry','Soup','Salad','Bread','Cake','Cookies','Curry','Rice dish','Eggs','Smoothie']),
        instrument: single(['Guitar','Piano','Ukulele','Drums','Voice','Violin','Bass','Keyboard']),
        piece: multi(['Scales','Warm-up','A new song','An old favourite','Improvising','Sight reading','Theory']),
        improved: multi(['Timing','Speed','Accuracy','Memory','Confidence','Technique','Tone']),
        activity: single(['Run','Walk','Swim','Cycling','Football','Basketball','Tennis','Badminton','Yoga','Climbing','Boxing','Hike']),
        duration: mins([20,30,45,60,90]),
        medium: single(['Pencil','Ink','Watercolour','Acrylic','Digital','Charcoal','Markers','Oil','Clay']),
        timeSpent: mins([15,30,45,60,90,120]),
        subject: single(['Portrait','Landscape','Still life','Animals','Abstract','Character','Plants','Buildings']),
        task: multi(['Watering','Weeding','Planting','Pruning','Potting','Harvesting','Composting','Feeding']),
        plants: multi(['Herbs','Tomatoes','Flowers','Succulents','Vegetables','Houseplants','Trees','Seedlings']),
        observation: multi(['New growth','Blooming','Needs water','Pests','Healthy','Wilting','Fruiting']),
        game: single(['Strategy','Shooter','RPG','Puzzle','Racing','Sports','Co-op','Indie']),
        project: single(['Shelf','Furniture','Repair','Knitting','Sewing','Candle','Jewellery','Woodwork','Decor']),
        materials: multi(['Wood','Paint','Fabric','Yarn','Glue','Metal','Paper','Screws']),
        org: single(['Food bank','Animal shelter','Beach clean-up','Hospital','School','Temple / church','Community garden','A neighbour']),
        impact: multi(['Fed people','Helped a neighbour','Cleaned up','Taught someone','Kept company','Raised money']),
        note: NOTE_SOBER
      });
      UI.quickAdd['lane.minutes'] = [10,20,30,45];
      UI.quickAdd['lane.hours'] = [0.5,1,2,3];
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUSTLER business boxes ---------- */
    if(HUST){
      var CASH = [20,50,100,200,500];
      reg({
        market: single(['London','New York','Asia','Crypto','Forex','Stocks','Futures','Options']),
        balance: money(100, [500,1000,5000,10000]),
        risk: money(10, [10,25,50,100]),
        account: single(['My page','A client','My brand','Side account']),
        platforms: multi(['Instagram','TikTok','YouTube','Facebook','X','LinkedIn','Threads']),
        reach: big(100, [100,500,1000,5000,10000]),
        followers: big(10, [10,25,50,100,500]),
        takeaway: multi(['Hook worked','Story posts did best','Reels beat photos','Posted at night','Collab helped','Trending audio','Needs a better hook']),
        route: single(['Home visits','Driveway','Car park','Mall','Office','Mobile','North side','South side','Downtown']),
        customers: num([1,2,3,5,8,10]),
        revenue: money(10, CASH),
        tips: money(5, [5,10,20,50]),
        store: single(['Shopify','TikTok Shop','Etsy','Amazon','Facebook shop','Lazada','Shopee']),
        sessions: big(10, [50,100,250,500]),
        orders: num([1,2,3,5,10]),
        adspend: money(5, [10,25,50,100]),
        netprofit: money(10, [-50,-20,20,50,100,200], -1000000),
        hours: hrs([1,2,4,6,8]),
        billable: hrs([1,2,4,6,8]),
        rate: money(5, [15,25,50,75,100]),
        platform: single(['YouTube','TikTok','Instagram','Twitch','Podcast','Substack','X']),
        views: big(100, [100,1000,5000,10000]),
        newfollowers: big(10, [10,25,50,100,500]),
        jobs: num([1,2,3,5,8]),
        mileage: big(5, [10,20,50]),
        source: single(['Thrift store','Garage sale','Online','Wholesale','Marketplace','Auction','Flea market']),
        itemssold: num([1,2,3,5,10]),
        fees: money(5, [5,10,20,50]),
        sourceloc: single(['Thrift shop','Garage sale','Flea market','Online arbitrage','Wholesale market']),
        sourcecash: money(5, [20,50,100,200]),
        note: NOTE_HUST
      });
      /* the plain "Client" and "Project" names for Freelance stay typed, but show your recent answers as one-tap chips (that is automatic) */
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ CUSTOM LANES: what you can track ---------- */
    /* id, label, how it is entered. The two money ones keep the same data keys the tracker already reads (revenue, netprofit). */
    var TPL = SOBER ? [
      { id:'time',  label:'Time spent',      key:'cx_time',  kind:'t', spec:mins([15,30,45,60,90,120]), on:1 },
      { id:'what',  label:'What I did',      key:'cx_what',  kind:'a', spec:multi(['Practised','Learned something new','Made something','Finished something','With others','On my own']), on:1 },
      { id:'felt',  label:'How it felt (1–5)', key:'cx_felt', kind:'s', hint:'Energy scale, 1–5', on:1 },
      { id:'rate',  label:'How it went (1–10)', key:'cx_rate', kind:'x' },
      { id:'solo',  label:'Solo or group',   key:'cx_solo',  kind:'p', opts:['Solo','Group'] },
      { id:'prog',  label:'Progress %',      key:'cx_prog',  kind:'g', hint:'0% → goal: complete → 100%' },
      { id:'note',  label:'Note',            key:'cx_note',  kind:'a', spec:NOTE_SOBER, on:1 }
    ] : [
      { id:'rev',   label:'Revenue $',        key:'revenue',   kind:'t', spec:money(10, CASH), on:1 },
      { id:'costs', label:'Costs $',          key:'cx_costs',  kind:'t', spec:money(5, [10,25,50,100]) },
      { id:'net',   label:'Net profit $',     key:'netprofit', kind:'t', spec:money(10, [-50,-20,20,50,100,200], -1000000), on:1 },
      { id:'hours', label:'Hours worked',     key:'cx_hours',  kind:'t', spec:hrs([1,2,4,6,8]), on:1 },
      { id:'cust',  label:'Customers / orders', key:'cx_cust', kind:'t', spec:num([1,2,3,5,10]), on:1 },
      { id:'leads', label:'Leads / enquiries', key:'cx_leads', kind:'t', spec:num([1,2,3,5,10]) },
      { id:'chan',  label:'Where they came from', key:'cx_chan', kind:'t', spec:single(['Walk-in','Referral','Social media','Marketplace','Ads','Repeat customer']) },
      { id:'plan',  label:'Followed my plan (1–5)', key:'cx_plan', kind:'s', on:1 },
      { id:'eng',   label:'Energy (1–5)',     key:'cx_eng',    kind:'s' },
      { id:'next',  label:'Next action',      key:'cx_next',   kind:'a', spec:multi(['Follow up','Restock','Raise prices','Post content','Chase payment','Test an idea','Hire help']) },
      { id:'note',  label:'Note',             key:'cx_note',   kind:'a', spec:NOTE_HUST, on:1 }
    ];
    TPL.forEach(function(t){ if(t.spec) SP['lane.'+t.key] = t.spec; });
    var IDEAS = SOBER
      ? ['Writing','Photography','Chess','Meditation','Language learning','Hiking','Dancing','Knitting','Woodworking','Pets','Fishing','Journaling']
      : ['Photography gigs','Tutoring','Delivery driving','Barbering','Food stall','Handmade goods','Coaching','Cleaning service','Event DJ','Real estate','Vending','Repairs'];

    function customList(){ if(!Array.isArray(DB.customLanes)) DB.customLanes = []; return DB.customLanes; }
    function isCustom(id){ return customList().some(function(c){ return c.id===id; }); }
    function tplOf(id){ return TPL.filter(function(t){ return t.id===id; })[0]; }
    function glyphOf(name){ var g = String(name||'').replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g,'').slice(0,2).toUpperCase(); return g || 'NW'; }

    /* turn every saved custom lane into a real entry of LANES / LANE_FIELDS (runs before every draw) */
    function syncLanes(){
      var list = customList(), want = {};
      list.forEach(function(c){
        want[c.id] = 1;
        var tp = (c.fields||[]).map(tplOf).filter(Boolean), g = glyphOf(c.name), sub = SOBER ? 'Your own hobby' : 'Your own business log';
        var ent = LANES.filter(function(l){ return l.id===c.id; })[0];
        if(!ent){ ent = { id:c.id, glyph:g, name:c.name, desc:'', custom:true }; LANES.push(ent); }
        ent.name = c.name; ent.glyph = g; ent.custom = true;
        ent.desc = (tp.length ? tp.map(function(t){ return t.label.replace(/ \(.*\)$/,'').replace(/ \$$/,''); }).slice(0,4).join(' · ') : sub);
        if(SOBER){
          LANE_FIELDS[c.id] = { title:c.name, sub:sub, items:tp.map(function(t){
            if(t.kind==='t') return ['t', t.key, t.label];
            if(t.kind==='a') return ['a', t.key, t.label];
            if(t.kind==='p') return ['p', t.key, t.label, t.opts];
            if(t.kind==='s') return ['s', t.key, t.label.replace(/ \(.*\)$/,''), t.hint||'1–5'];
            if(t.kind==='x') return ['x', t.key, t.label.replace(/ \(.*\)$/,'')];
            if(t.kind==='g') return ['g', t.key, t.label, t.hint];
            return null; }).filter(Boolean) };
        } else {
          LANE_FIELDS[c.id] = { title:c.name, fields:tp.filter(function(t){ return t.kind==='t'; }).map(function(t){ return [t.key, t.label]; }),
            scales:tp.filter(function(t){ return t.kind==='s'; }).map(function(t){ return [t.key, t.label.replace(/ \(.*\)$/,'')]; }),
            extra:function(ds){ var p = getPage(ds,'lane'), h = '';
              tp.filter(function(t){ return t.kind==='a'; }).forEach(function(t){ h += fieldWrap(t.label, null, areaField(ds,'lane',t.key,'',p[t.key])); });
              return h; } };
        }
      });
      for(var i=LANES.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(LANES[i].custom && !want[LANES[i].id]){ delete LANE_FIELDS[LANES[i].id]; LANES.splice(i,1); } }
      if(DB.lane && !LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane]) DB.lane = null;
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the create / edit sheet ---------- */
    function openCreate(editId, inOnboarding){
      var cur = editId ? customList().filter(function(c){ return c.id===editId; })[0] : null;
      var curSel = cur ? (cur.fields||[]).map(function(id){ var t = tplOf(id); return t && t.label; }).filter(Boolean)
                       : TPL.filter(function(t){ return t.on; }).map(function(t){ return t.label; });
      LS.openLS({
        title: cur ? 'Edit your '+NOUN : 'Create your own '+NOUN, needs:true,
        count:function(st){ return st.name.length && st.fields.length ? 1 : 0; },
        cta:function(){ return cur ? 'Save changes' : 'Create my '+NOUN; },
        secs:[
          { id:'name', label:'1 · What is it called?', opts:IDEAS, sel:cur ? [cur.name] : [] },
          { id:'fields', label:'2 · What will you track each day?', multi:true, other:false, opts:TPL.map(function(t){ return t.label; }), sel:curSel }
        ],
        extra: cur ? [{ label:'Delete this '+NOUN, act:function(){ confirmDelete(cur.id); } }] : [],
        done:function(st){
          var name = String(st.name[0]||'').trim().slice(0,40), ids = st.fields.map(function(l){ return TPL.filter(function(t){ return t.label===l; })[0]; }).filter(Boolean).map(function(t){ return t.id; });
          if(!name || !ids.length) return;
          var list = customList();
          if(cur){ cur.name = name; cur.fields = ids; saveDB(); syncLanes(); flashSaved('Saved'); render(); return; }
          var id = 'X' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,5);
          list.push({ id:id, name:name, fields:ids, made:Date.now() }); DB.lane = id; saveDB(); syncLanes();
          if(inOnboarding && typeof ONDRAFT!=='undefined'){ ONDRAFT.lane = id; if(typeof saveOnboardDraft==='function') saveOnboardDraft(); render(); return; }
          flashSaved('"'+name+'" is ready'); openLaneLog();
        }
      });
    }
    function confirmDelete(id){
      var c = customList().filter(function(x){ return x.id===id; })[0]; if(!c) return;
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>Delete "'+E(c.name)+'"?</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
        + '<div class="confirm-body"><p>This removes the log from your list. Days you already logged are not erased.</p>'
        + '<button class="confirm-danger-btn" data-ln="delgo" data-id="'+E(id)+'">'+icon('trash',15)+' Delete</button>'
        + '<button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Keep it</button></div>');
    }
    function doDelete(id){
      var list = customList(), i = list.findIndex ? list.findIndex(function(x){ return x.id===id; }) : -1;
      if(i>=0) list.splice(i,1);
      if(DB.lane===id) DB.lane = null;
      saveDB(); syncLanes(); closeSheet(); flashSaved('Deleted'); nav('page','lane');
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ lane picker ---------- */
    function pickerPage(dateStr){
      syncLanes();
      var cards = LANES.map(function(l,i){
        var sel = DB.lane===l.id;
        return '<div class="lane-card '+(sel?'selected':'')+'" onclick="pickLane(\''+l.id+'\')"><div class="lane-glyph">'+E(l.glyph)+'</div>'
          + '<div class="lane-info"><div class="lane-name">'+E(l.name)+'</div><div class="lane-desc">'+E(l.desc)+'</div></div>'
          + (l.custom ? '<button type="button" class="ln-mini" data-ln="edit" data-id="'+E(l.id)+'">Edit</button>' : '')
          + (sel ? '<div>'+icon('check',18)+'</div>' : '') + '</div>';
      }).join('');
      var make = '<button type="button" class="lane-card ln-make" data-ln="create"><div class="lane-glyph">+</div><div class="lane-info"><div class="lane-name">Create your own '+NOUN+'</div>'
        + '<div class="lane-desc">'+(SOBER ? 'Not on the list? Tap a name, tap what to track, done.' : 'Not on the list? Tap a name, tap what to track, done.')+'</div></div></button>';
      var cur = DB.lane ? LANES.filter(function(l){ return l.id===DB.lane; })[0] : null;
      app.innerHTML = renderTopbar(SOBER ? 'Daily Hobbies' : 'Business Lane', true)
        + '<div class="lane-picker"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin-bottom:14px;">'
        + (SOBER ? 'Tap the hobby that is really you. You can switch any time, or create your own.' : 'Tap the business you run. You can switch any time, or create your own log.') + '</div>'
        + cards + make + '</div>'
        + (cur ? '<div style="padding:0 16px 20px;"><button class="add-row-btn" onclick="openLaneLog()">'+icon('chevright',14)+' Open today\'s '+E(cur.name)+'</button></div>' : '');
    }
    renderLanePicker = pickerPage;
    if(typeof PAGE_RENDERERS!=='undefined') PAGE_RENDERERS.lane = pickerPage;

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the lane log page body ---------- */
    var baseBody = laneLogBody;
    function footer(){
      if(typeof ROUTE==='undefined' || ROUTE.view!=='lanelog') return '';
      var h = '';
      if(HUST) h += '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'lane\')">'+icon('chevleft',14)+' Change business lane</button>';
      if(DB.lane && isCustom(DB.lane)) h += '<button class="add-row-btn" data-ln="edit" data-id="'+E(DB.lane)+'">'+icon('gear',14)+' Edit this '+NOUN+'</button>';
      return h;
    }
    function hustBody(dateStr){
      if(!DB.lane) return null;
      var conf = LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane]; if(!conf) return null;
      var p = getPage(dateStr,'lane'), custom = isCustom(DB.lane);
      var basics = conf.fields.map(function(f){
        return '<div style="margin-bottom:12px;"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 6px;">'+E(f[1])+'</div>'+textField(dateStr,'lane',f[0],f[1],p[f[0]])+'</div>'; }).join('');
      var scales = conf.scales.map(function(s){ return fieldWrap(s[1], null, scaleTapper(dateStr,'lane',s[0],5,p[s[0]]||0,true)); }).join('');
      return copyYesterdayBar(dateStr,'lane')
        + (basics ? fieldWrap(custom ? 'Today\'s numbers' : 'Session basics', null, basics) : '')
        + (conf.extra ? conf.extra(dateStr) : '') + scales;
    }
    laneLogBody = function(dateStr){
      syncLanes();
      var b = HUST ? hustBody(dateStr) : baseBody(dateStr);
      return b==null ? b : b + footer();
    };

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUSTLER: trades as cards ---------- */
    if(HUST){
      var PAIRS = ['EUR/USD','GBP/USD','USD/JPY','XAU/USD','BTC/USD','NAS100'], OPENO = {};
      function pnlN(t){ var n = parseFloat(t.pnl); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
      function money$(n){ return (n<0 ? '-$' : '$') + Math.abs(Math.round(n*100)/100).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
      LANE_FIELDS.TR.extra = function(ds){
        var p = getPage(ds,'lane'); if(!Array.isArray(p.trades)) p.trades = [];
        var total = 0, any = false, h = '';
        p.trades.forEach(function(t,i){
          var n = pnlN(t); if(n!=null){ total += n; any = true; }
          var pairs = PAIRS.slice(); if(t.pair && pairs.indexOf(t.pair)<0) pairs.push(t.pair);
          h += '<div class="ln-trade"><div class="ln-th"><b>Trade '+(i+1)+'</b><button type="button" class="ln-x" data-ln="tdel" data-i="'+i+'">Remove</button></div>'
            + '<div class="ln-lab">Pair</div><div class="pill-row ui-chips">'
            + pairs.map(function(pr){ var on = t.pair===pr; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-ln="tpair" data-i="'+i+'" data-v="'+E(pr)+'">'+E(pr)+'</button>'; }).join('')
            + '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip more" data-ln="tother" data-i="'+i+'">+ Other</button></div>'
            + (OPENO[i] ? '<div class="ui-otherrow"><input class="textline ln-other" data-i="'+i+'" placeholder="Type the pair"><button type="button" class="pill active red" data-ln="taddo" data-i="'+i+'">Add</button></div>' : '')
            + '<div class="ln-lab">Result</div><div class="ui-stepper"><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less" data-ln="tstep" data-i="'+i+'" data-d="-10">−</button>'
            + '<div class="ui-sval'+(n==null?' empty':'')+(n!=null && n<0 ? ' ln-neg' : '')+(n>0 ? ' ln-pos' : '')+'"><b>'+(n==null ? '—' : (n>0?'+':'')+money$(n))+'</b></div>'
            + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More" data-ln="tstep" data-i="'+i+'" data-d="10">+</button></div>'
            + '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">' + [-100,-50,-20,20,50,100].map(function(q){ return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(n===q?' on':'')+'" data-ln="tq" data-i="'+i+'" data-v="'+q+'">'+(q<0?'-$'+(-q):'+$'+q)+'</button>'; }).join('') + '</div>'
            + '<div class="ln-two"><div><div class="ln-lab">Entry (optional)</div><input class="textline" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Price" value="'+E(t.entry||'')+'" oninput="updateLaneRow(\'trades\','+i+',\'entry\',this.value)"></div>'
            + '<div><div class="ln-lab">Exit (optional)</div><input class="textline" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Price" value="'+E(t.exit||'')+'" oninput="updateLaneRow(\'trades\','+i+',\'exit\',this.value)"></div></div></div>';
        });
        h += '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn" data-ln="tadd">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add a trade</button>';
        if(any) h += '<div class="ln-total">Today: <b class="'+(total<0?'ln-neg':'ln-pos')+'">'+(total>0?'+':'')+money$(total)+'</b></div>';
        return fieldWrap('Trades', 'Tap a pair, tap the result. Entry and exit prices are optional.', h);
      };
      LANE_FIELDS.RS.extra = function(ds){
        var p = getPage(ds,'lane');
        return fieldWrap('Sourcing trip', null, textField(ds,'lane','sourceloc','Location / store',p.sourceloc) + '<div style="height:10px"></div>' + textField(ds,'lane','sourcecash','Cash spent sourcing $',p.sourcecash));
      };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUSTLER: the workout log ---------- */
    var EXPARTS = ['Chest','Back','Legs','Shoulders','Arms','Core','Cardio'];
    var EXLIB = {
      Chest:['Bench Press','Incline Dumbbell Press','Push-ups','Chest Fly','Dips'],
      Back:['Deadlift','Pull-ups','Barbell Row','Lat Pulldown','Seated Row'],
      Legs:['Squat','Lunges','Leg Press','Romanian Deadlift','Calf Raise','Hip Thrust'],
      Shoulders:['Overhead Press','Lateral Raise','Face Pull','Arnold Press'],
      Arms:['Bicep Curl','Tricep Pushdown','Hammer Curl','Skull Crusher'],
      Core:['Plank','Crunches','Leg Raises','Russian Twist','Ab Wheel'],
      Cardio:['Run','Jump Rope','Cycling','Rowing','Stairs','Swim']
    };
    function partOf(name){ for(var k in EXLIB){ if(EXLIB[k].indexOf(name)>=0) return k; } return 'Chest'; }
    function pickExercises(title, single, firstName, cb){
      LS.openLS({
        title:title, needs:true,
        count:function(st){ return st.ex.length; },
        cta:function(st){ return single ? 'Use this' : (st.ex.length ? 'Add '+st.ex.length+' exercise'+(st.ex.length===1?'':'s') : 'Add'); },
        secs:[
          { id:'part', label:'Body part', opts:EXPARTS, other:false, sel:[partOf(firstName||'')] },
          { id:'ex', label:single ? 'Pick one' : 'Pick as many as you like', multi:!single, opts:function(st){ return st.part.length ? EXLIB[st.part[0]] : []; }, sel:firstName ? [firstName] : [] }
        ],
        done:function(st){ if(st.ex.length) cb(st.ex); }
      });
    }
    function newExercise(name){ return { name:name, sets:'3', reps:'10', weight:'', done:false }; }

    if(HUST){
      /* the daily log: "+ Other" used to add an empty typed row; now it opens the exercise sheet */
      addExRow = function(ds){
        pickExercises('Add exercises', false, '', function(names){
          var p = getPage(ds,'workout'); if(!Array.isArray(p.exercises)) p.exercises = [];
          names.forEach(function(n){ p.exercises.push(newExercise(n)); });
          markTouched(ds,'workout'); flashSaved(); render();
        });
      };
      /* the explainer at the top of the Hustler Workout Log */
      var baseWorkout = workoutBody;
      var HINTS = function(){ if(!DB.seenHints || typeof DB.seenHints!=='object') DB.seenHints = {}; return DB.seenHints; };
      workoutBody = function(ds){ return baseWorkout(ds); };   /* the old Hustler-only explainer is gone: every app now shares one Movement log (move_patch.js) */

      /* the preset editor, rebuilt as taps */
      function pst(id){ return DB.workoutPresets && DB.workoutPresets[id]; }
      function stepper(id,i,key,val){
        return '<div class="wp-st"><span>'+(key==='sets'?'Sets':'Reps')+'</span><div class="ui-stepper"><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less" data-wp="st" data-id="'+id+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-key="'+key+'" data-d="-1">−</button>'
          + '<div class="ui-sval'+(val?'':' empty')+'"><b>'+E(val||'—')+'</b></div><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More" data-wp="st" data-id="'+id+'" data-i="'+i+'" data-key="'+key+'" data-d="1">+</button></div></div>';
      }
      function presetsPage(){
        var list = workoutPresetList();
        var cards = list.map(function(pr){
          var rows = (pr.exercises||[]).map(function(ex,i){
            return '<div class="wp-ex"><div class="wp-ex-top"><button type="button" class="wp-exname'+(ex.name?'':' empty')+'" data-wp="exname" data-id="'+pr.id+'" data-i="'+i+'">'+E(ex.name||'Tap to choose')+'</button>'
              + '<button type="button" class="tt-remove-btn" data-wp="exdel" data-id="'+pr.id+'" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Remove exercise">'+icon('trash',13)+'</button></div>'
              + '<div class="wp-ex-grid">'+stepper(pr.id,i,'sets',ex.sets)+stepper(pr.id,i,'reps',ex.reps)+'</div></div>'; }).join('');
          return '<div class="field-card wp-card"><div class="wp-head"><button type="button" class="wp-name" data-wp="rename" data-id="'+pr.id+'">'+E(pr.name)+' <span>✎</span></button>'
            + '<button type="button" class="tt-remove-btn" data-wp="del" data-id="'+pr.id+'" aria-label="Delete preset">'+icon('trash',14)+'</button></div>'
            + (rows || '<div class="empty-note" style="padding:8px 2px 12px;">No exercises yet.</div>')
            + '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn" data-wp="exadd" data-id="'+pr.id+'">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add exercises</button></div>'; }).join('');
        var sugg = WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS.filter(function(s){ return !list.some(function(p){ return p.name===s.name; }); });
        var sRow = sugg.length ? fieldWrap('Ready-made starting points', 'One tap adds it to your presets. You can change anything after.', '<div class="pill-row">'+sugg.map(function(s){ return '<button type="button" class="pill" data-wp="sugg" data-n="'+E(s.name)+'">'+icon('bolt',12)+' '+E(s.name)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>') : '';
        app.innerHTML = renderTopbar('Workout Presets', true)
          + '<div class="page-body"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 12px;">A preset is a named workout. Build it once, then load it on the Workout Log with one tap.</div>'
          + (list.length ? cards : '<div class="empty-note">No presets yet. Tap "New preset" or add a ready-made one.</div>')
          + '<button type="button" class="ls-go" data-wp="new" style="margin:6px 0 14px;">'+icon('plus',15)+' New preset</button>' + sRow + '</div>';
      }
      PAGE_RENDERERS.workoutPresets = presetsPage; renderWorkoutPresets = presetsPage;
      var PNAMES = ['Push Day','Pull Day','Leg Day','Full Body','Upper Body','Core','Cardio','Mobility','Run Intervals'];
      function newPreset(){
        LS.openLS({ title:'New preset', needs:true, count:function(st){ return st.name.length; }, cta:function(){ return 'Next: add exercises'; },
          secs:[{ id:'name', label:'Name it', opts:PNAMES, sel:[] }],
          done:function(st){ var nm = String(st.name[0]||'').trim(); if(!nm) return; var pr = createWorkoutPreset(nm); saveDB(); render(); setTimeout(function(){ addEx(pr.id); }, 60); } });
      }
      function addEx(id){
        pickExercises('Add exercises', false, '', function(names){
          var pr = pst(id); if(!pr) return; if(!Array.isArray(pr.exercises)) pr.exercises = [];
          names.forEach(function(n){ pr.exercises.push({ name:n, sets:'3', reps:'10' }); });
          touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); flashSaved(); render();
        });
      }
      function wpAct(b){
        var a = b.getAttribute('data-wp'), id = b.getAttribute('data-id'), i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')), pr = id ? pst(id) : null;
        if(a==='new') return newPreset();
        if(a==='sugg'){ var s = WORKOUT_PRESET_SUGGESTIONS.filter(function(x){ return x.name===b.getAttribute('data-n'); })[0]; if(s) addWorkoutPresetFromSuggestion(s); return; }
        if(!pr) return;
        if(a==='del') return confirmDeleteWorkoutPreset(id);
        if(a==='exadd') return addEx(id);
        if(a==='exdel'){ removeWorkoutPresetExercise(id, i); return; }
        if(a==='rename'){
          return LS.openLS({ title:'Rename preset', needs:true, count:function(st){ return st.name.length; }, cta:function(){ return 'Save name'; },
            secs:[{ id:'name', label:'Name', opts:PNAMES, sel:[pr.name] }],
            done:function(st){ var nm = String(st.name[0]||'').trim(); if(nm){ pr.name = nm; touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); flashSaved(); render(); } } });
        }
        if(a==='exname'){
          var ex = pr.exercises[i]; if(!ex) return;
          return pickExercises('Change exercise', true, ex.name, function(names){ ex.name = names[0]; touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); flashSaved(); render(); });
        }
        if(a==='st'){
          var ex2 = pr.exercises[i]; if(!ex2) return;
          var key = b.getAttribute('data-key'), d = Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')), n = parseInt(ex2[key],10);
          var def = key==='sets' ? 3 : 10, max = key==='sets' ? 12 : 60;
          n = isFinite(n) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(max, n + d)) : def; ex2[key] = String(n); touchSetupPage('workoutPresets');
          var sv = b.parentNode.querySelector('.ui-sval'); if(sv){ sv.classList.remove('empty'); sv.firstChild.textContent = String(n); }
          return;
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-wp]'); if(!b) return; wpAct(b);
      });
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ one click handler for the lane controls ---------- */
    function lnAct(b){
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-ln'), i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')), ds = (typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.date) || todayStr();
      if(a==='create') return openCreate(null, typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.view==='onboard');
      if(a==='edit') return openCreate(b.getAttribute('data-id'));
      if(a==='delgo') return doDelete(b.getAttribute('data-id'));
      if(!HUST) return;
      var p = getPage(ds,'lane');
      if(a==='howhide'){ HINTS().hwk = 1; saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='howopen'){ HINTS().hwk = 0; saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='presets') return nav('page','workoutPresets');
      if(!Array.isArray(p.trades)) p.trades = [];
      var t = p.trades[i];
      if(a==='tadd'){ p.trades.push({}); markTouched(ds,'lane'); saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(!t) return;
      if(a==='tdel'){ p.trades.splice(i,1); OPENO = {}; markTouched(ds,'lane'); saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='tpair'){ t.pair = t.pair===b.getAttribute('data-v') ? '' : b.getAttribute('data-v'); }
      else if(a==='tother'){ OPENO[i] = !OPENO[i]; render(); setTimeout(function(){ var x = document.querySelector('.ln-other'); if(x) x.focus(); }, 30); return; }
      else if(a==='taddo'){ var inp = document.querySelector('.ln-other[data-i="'+i+'"]'), v = inp ? inp.value.trim().toUpperCase() : ''; OPENO[i] = false; if(v) t.pair = v; }
      else if(a==='tstep'){ var n = parseFloat(t.pnl); n = isFinite(n) ? n + Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')) : Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')); t.pnl = String(Math.round(n*100)/100); }
      else if(a==='tq'){ t.pnl = String(Number(b.getAttribute('data-v'))); }
      markTouched(ds,'lane'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); render();
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-ln]'); if(!b) return;
      if(/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      e.stopPropagation(); lnAct(b);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      var t = e.target; if(e.key!=='Enter' || !t || !t.classList || !t.classList.contains('ln-other')) return;
      e.preventDefault(); var go = document.querySelector('[data-ln="taddo"][data-i="'+t.getAttribute('data-i')+'"]'); if(go) lnAct(go);
    });

    /* Hustler onboarding: add the "create your own" card under the built-in lanes */
    if(HUST && typeof onboardShell==='function'){
      var baseShell = onboardShell;
      onboardShell = function(o){
        if(o && /building/i.test(o.title||'') && typeof o.body==='string')
          o.body += '<div class="onb-radio-card" data-ln="create" role="button"><div class="lane-glyph">+</div><div class="lane-info"><div class="lane-name">Create your own business log</div><div class="lane-desc">Not on the list? Tap a name, tap what to track.</div></div></div>';
        return baseShell.apply(this, arguments);
      };
    }

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ look (uses the app's own colours) ---------- */
    var css = ''
      + '.ln-trade{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:18px;padding:12px;margin:0 0 12px;}'
      + '.ln-th{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13.5px;}'
      + '.ln-x{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:8px;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.ln-lab{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 6px;}'
      + '.ln-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}'
      + '.ln-total{text-align:right;font-weight:700;margin:2px 4px 6px;}'
      + '.ln-pos b,.ln-pos{color:var(--good,#2e8b57);}.ln-neg b,.ln-neg{color:var(--bad,#c0392b);}'
      + '.ln-mini{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;min-height:36px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;margin-right:8px;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.ln-make{width:100%;text-align:left;border:2px dashed var(--line);background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;}'
      + '.ln-make .lane-glyph{font-size:22px;}'
      + '.ln-explain{border:2px solid var(--accent);}'
      + '.ln-eh{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px;}'
      + '.ln-ep{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 9px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;}'
      + '.ln-ep b{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;}'
      + '.ln-how-mini{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 2px;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.wp-card{margin-bottom:12px;}'
      + '.wp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}'
      + '.wp-name{flex:1;text-align:left;border:0;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.wp-name span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-left:4px;}'
      + '.wp-ex{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;margin:0 0 8px;}'
      + '.wp-ex-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;}'
      + '.wp-exname{flex:1;text-align:left;border:0;background:var(--surface);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.wp-exname.empty{color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.wp-ex-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}'
      + '.wp-st span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px;}'
      + '.wp-ex-grid>*{min-width:0;}'
      + '.wp-ex .ui-stepper{padding:3px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);gap:2px;}'
      + '.wp-ex .ui-sbtn{width:38px;min-width:0;height:44px;font-size:20px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:none;flex:none;}'
      + '.wp-ex .ui-sval{min-width:0;flex:1;}.wp-ex .ui-sval b{font-size:20px;}'
      + '.ls-sec+.ls-sec{margin-top:16px;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'lane-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ keep custom lanes registered before every draw ---------- */
    var baseRender = render;
    render = function(){ try{ syncLanes(); }catch(e){} return baseRender.apply(this, arguments); };
    syncLanes();
    if(customList().length){ try{ render(); }catch(e){} }

    window.LANEX = { isCustom:isCustom, create:openCreate, sync:syncLanes, tpl:TPL };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('lane patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   MOVEMENT LOG  (all 7 apps, one shared piece)

   Before: six apps had a plain tick list of move names, and only Hustler's had sets / reps / kg. Everything was
   "sets x reps", even a run. And the saved presets (Push Day...) could not be reached from the other six apps.

   Now the Movement page is the same in every app:
     1. Session type   (the app's own list: Strength, Cardio, Mobility ...)
     2. Your presets   (only the ones YOU saved. Tap one to load it into today. "New preset" makes one.)
     3. Exercise log   one card per move. A card measures the move in the way that fits it:
          Reps      sets, reps, kg                       (Squat, Bench Press ...)
          Distance  distance, time, pace  (km, mi or m)  (Run, Cycling, Swim ...) - fill any two, the third follows
          Hold      sets and seconds                     (Plank, Wall sit ...)
          Time      just minutes                         (Stretching, Yoga, Jump rope ...)
        Every card has small tabs to switch the way it is measured, so nothing is forced.
     4. The app's other fields (duration, intensity, energy, steps ...) exactly as before.

   The ready-made presets (Push Day, 5K Run ...) now show up ONLY inside "New preset", so the Movement page stays clean.

   Data: an exercise is still {name, sets, reps, weight, done}. New cards add optional fields next to those:
   kind, unit, dist, mins, pace, secs. Old entries show as normal "Reps" cards. Presets use the same shape.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof workoutBody!=='function' || !window.LISTS || !window.LISTS.openLS || typeof createWorkoutPreset!=='function') return;
    var E = esc, LS = window.LISTS, baseBody = workoutBody;

    /* ---------- what each move is measured in ---------- */
    var PROF = {
      'Run':{k:'dist',u:'km',d:3,p:360,m:25}, 'Walk':{k:'dist',u:'km',d:3,p:600,m:35}, 'Hike':{k:'dist',u:'km',d:5,p:720,m:60},
      'Cycling':{k:'dist',u:'km',d:10,p:180,m:30}, 'Elliptical':{k:'dist',u:'km',d:3,p:480,m:25},
      'Swim':{k:'dist',u:'m',d:400,p:150,m:20}, 'Rowing':{k:'dist',u:'m',d:2000,p:130,m:15},
      'Jump Rope':{k:'time',m:10}, 'Stairs':{k:'time',m:15}, 'Stretching':{k:'time',m:10}, 'Yoga':{k:'time',m:30}, 'Foam Rolling':{k:'time',m:10},
      'Warm-up':{k:'time',m:5}, 'Warm-up jog':{k:'time',m:10}, 'Cooldown walk':{k:'time',m:10}, 'Sun salutations':{k:'time',m:10}, 'Hip openers':{k:'time',m:10},
      'Plank':{k:'hold',s:45}, 'Side Plank':{k:'hold',s:30}, 'Wall Sit':{k:'hold',s:45}, 'Dead Hang':{k:'hold',s:30}, 'L-Sit':{k:'hold',s:20}
    };
    var PER = { km:1, mi:1, m:100 }, PACE_LAB = { km:'/km', mi:'/mi', m:'/100m' };
    function prof(name){ var n = String(name||'').trim().toLowerCase(); for(var k in PROF){ if(k.toLowerCase()===n) return PROF[k]; } return null; }
    function num(v){ if(v==null || v==='') return null; var s = String(v); if(!/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) return null; return parseFloat(s); }
    function newEx(name, over){
      var p = prof(name), ex = { name:name, kind:'str', sets:'3', reps:'10', weight:'', done:false };
      if(p && p.k==='dist') ex = { name:name, kind:'dist', unit:p.u, dist:'', mins:'', pace:'', done:false };
      else if(p && p.k==='time') ex = { name:name, kind:'time', mins:'', done:false };
      else if(p && p.k==='hold') ex = { name:name, kind:'hold', sets:'3', secs:'', done:false };
      if(over) for(var k in over) ex[k] = over[k];
      return ex;
    }
    function kindOf(ex){ return ex.kind || 'str'; }

    /* ---------- the steppers ---------- */
    function spec(ex, f){
      var p = prof(ex.name) || {}, u = ex.unit || 'km';
      switch(f){
        case 'sets':   return { def:3, min:1, max:12, step:1 };
        case 'reps':   return { def:10, min:1, max:100, step:1 };
        case 'weight': return { def:20, min:0, max:500, step:2.5 };
        case 'dist':   return u==='m' ? { def:p.d||400, min:0, max:20000, step:50 } : { def:p.d||(u==='mi'?2:3), min:0, max:300, step:0.5 };
        case 'mins':   return { def:p.m||30, min:1, max:600, step:5 };
        case 'pace':   return { def:p.p||(u==='m'?150:360), min:30, max:1800, step:5 };
        case 'secs':   return { def:p.s||45, min:5, max:600, step:5 };
      }
    }
    function snap(n, dir, sp){
      var q = n/sp.step, r = Math.round(q), onGrid = Math.abs(q-r) < 1e-6, t;
      if(onGrid) t = (r+dir)*sp.step; else t = (dir>0 ? Math.ceil(q) : Math.floor(q))*sp.step;
      t = Math.round(t*100)/100; return Math.max(sp.min, Math.min(sp.max, t));
    }
    function clock(s){ s = Math.round(s); return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+('0'+(s%60)).slice(-2); }
    function trim(n){ return String(Math.round(n*100)/100); }
    function disp(f, ex){
      var n = num(ex[f]); if(n==null) return '—';
      switch(f){
        case 'weight': return trim(n)+' kg';
        case 'dist':   return trim(n)+' '+(ex.unit||'km');
        case 'mins':   return n>=60 ? Math.floor(n/60)+'h '+('0'+Math.round(n%60)).slice(-2) : trim(n)+' min';
        case 'pace':   return clock(n);
        case 'secs':   return n>=60 ? clock(n) : trim(n)+' s';
        default:       return trim(n);
      }
    }
    function fmtDist(v, u){ return u==='m' ? String(Math.max(10, Math.round(v/10)*10)) : String(Math.max(0.1, Math.round(v*10)/10)); }
    /* distance, time, pace. DISTANCE IS THE BASIS (Cycle 5): changing time or pace never changes the distance.
       - you change distance: time follows from the pace you have (or pace follows from the time)
       - you change time:     pace follows (distance stays)
       - you change pace:     time follows (distance stays)
       Only when there is no distance yet does time + pace work one out, so you can still fill any two of the three. */
    function recalc(ex, ch){
      var d = num(ex.dist), m = num(ex.mins), p = num(ex.pace), u = ex.unit||'km', per = PER[u]||1;
      var haveD = d>0;
      if(ch==='dist'){
        if(haveD && p>0) ex.mins = String(Math.max(1, Math.round(d/per*p/60)));
        else if(haveD && m>0) ex.pace = String(Math.round(m*60/(d/per)));
      } else if(ch==='mins'){
        if(haveD && m>0) ex.pace = String(Math.round(m*60/(d/per)));
        else if(!haveD && p>0 && m>0) ex.dist = fmtDist(m*60/p*per, u);
      } else if(ch==='pace'){
        if(haveD && p>0) ex.mins = String(Math.max(1, Math.round(d/per*p/60)));
        else if(!haveD && p>0 && m>0) ex.dist = fmtDist(m*60/p*per, u);
      }
    }
    function speedText(ex){
      var d = num(ex.dist), m = num(ex.mins), p = num(ex.pace), u = ex.unit||'km', per = PER[u]||1, sec = null;
      if(d>0 && m>0) sec = m*60/(d/per); else if(p>0) sec = p;
      if(!sec) return '';
      var perHour = (u==='m' ? 0.1 : 1) * 3600 / sec;
      return 'Pace '+clock(sec)+' '+PACE_LAB[u]+' · '+(Math.round(perHour*10)/10)+' '+(u==='mi' ? 'mph' : 'km/h');
    }

    /* ---------- one exercise card (used on the day AND in the preset editor) ---------- */
    var LABELS = { sets:'Sets', reps:'Reps', weight:'Kg', dist:'Distance', mins:'Time', pace:'Pace', secs:'Hold' };
    var CHIPS = { dist:{ km:[1,3,5,10], mi:[1,2,3,6], m:[200,400,800,1500] }, mins:[15,20,30,45,60], secs:[20,30,45,60,90] };
    function ctxAttr(w, ds, i){ return ' data-w="'+w+'" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-i="'+i+'"'; }
    function stepper(w, ds, i, ex, f){
      var has = num(ex[f])!=null;
      return '<div class="mv-f"><label>'+LABELS[f]+'</label><div class="ui-stepper">'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less '+LABELS[f]+'" data-mv="st"'+ctxAttr(w,ds,i)+' data-f="'+f+'" data-d="-1">−</button>'
        + '<div class="ui-sval mv-val'+(has?'':' empty')+'" data-f="'+f+'"><b>'+E(disp(f,ex))+'</b></div>'
        + '<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More '+LABELS[f]+'" data-mv="st"'+ctxAttr(w,ds,i)+' data-f="'+f+'" data-d="1">+</button></div></div>';
    }
    function chipRow(w, ds, i, ex, f){
      var list = f==='dist' ? CHIPS.dist[ex.unit||'km'] : CHIPS[f];
      return '<div class="mv-chips"><span>'+LABELS[f]+'</span>'+list.map(function(v){
        var label = f==='dist' ? v+' '+(ex.unit||'km') : (f==='mins' ? v+' min' : v+' s');
        return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip" data-mv="chip"'+ctxAttr(w,ds,i)+' data-f="'+f+'" data-v="'+v+'">'+label+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    /* one line that says what is set, so a closed card still tells you everything (5 km · 30 min · 6:00 /km) */
    function sumText(ex){
      var k = kindOf(ex), t = [], n;
      if(k==='dist'){ if(num(ex.dist)!=null) t.push(disp('dist',ex)); if(num(ex.mins)!=null) t.push(disp('mins',ex)); if(num(ex.pace)!=null) t.push(disp('pace',ex)+' '+PACE_LAB[ex.unit||'km']); }
      else if(k==='hold'){ if(num(ex.sets)!=null && num(ex.secs)!=null) t.push(trim(num(ex.sets))+' × '+disp('secs',ex)); else if(num(ex.secs)!=null) t.push(disp('secs',ex)); }
      else if(k==='time'){ if(num(ex.mins)!=null) t.push(disp('mins',ex)); }
      else { if(num(ex.sets)!=null && num(ex.reps)!=null) t.push(trim(num(ex.sets))+' × '+trim(num(ex.reps))); if(num(ex.weight)) t.push(disp('weight',ex)); }
      return t.length ? t.join(' · ') : 'Tap to set it up';
    }
    var KIND_LAB = { str:'Reps', dist:'Distance', hold:'Hold', time:'Time' };
    /* which card is open (one at a time, so the page never gets long and cramped) */
    var openKey = '', showDone = false, PEND = {};
    function keyOf(w, ds, i){ return w+'|'+ds+'|'+i; }
    function exFields(w, ds, i, ex){
      var k = kindOf(ex), h = '', c = ctxAttr(w,ds,i);
      var kinds = [['str','Reps'],['dist','Distance'],['hold','Hold'],['time','Time']];
      h += '<div class="mv-kinds" role="group" aria-label="Measure it by">'+kinds.map(function(x){ return '<button type="button" class="mv-kind'+(k===x[0]?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+(k===x[0])+'" data-mv="kind"'+c+' data-v="'+x[0]+'">'+x[1]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      var rows = '';
      if(k==='dist'){
        h += '<div class="mv-units">'+['km','mi','m'].map(function(u){ return '<button type="button" class="mv-kind'+((ex.unit||'km')===u?' on':'')+'" data-mv="unit"'+c+' data-v="'+u+'">'+u+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
        rows += stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'dist')+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'mins')+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'pace');
        h += '<div class="mv-rows">'+rows+'</div><div class="mv-read" data-read="1">'+E(speedText(ex))+'</div>';
        if(num(ex.dist)==null) h += chipRow(w,ds,i,ex,'dist');
        if(num(ex.mins)==null) h += chipRow(w,ds,i,ex,'mins');
      } else if(k==='hold'){
        h += '<div class="mv-rows">'+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'sets')+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'secs')+'</div>';
        if(num(ex.secs)==null) h += chipRow(w,ds,i,ex,'secs');
      } else if(k==='time'){
        h += '<div class="mv-rows">'+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'mins')+'</div>';
        if(num(ex.mins)==null) h += chipRow(w,ds,i,ex,'mins');
      } else {
        h += '<div class="mv-rows">'+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'sets')+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'reps')+stepper(w,ds,i,ex,'weight')+'</div>';
      }
      return h;
    }
    /* the card: [tick] name + summary [open arrow]. Opened, it shows the tabs and steppers and a Remove button. */
    function exCard(w, ds, i, ex, withDone){
      var c = ctxAttr(w,ds,i), open = openKey===keyOf(w,ds,i);
      return '<div class="ui-ex mv-ex k-'+kindOf(ex)+(open?' open':'')+(ex.done?' done':'')+'" id="'+(w==='d'?'ex-row-':'pex-row-')+(w==='d'?i:ds+'-'+i)+'" data-w="'+w+'" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-i="'+i+'"><div class="mv-head">'
        + (withDone ? '<button type="button" class="mv-tick'+(ex.done?' on':'')+'" role="checkbox" aria-checked="'+(!!ex.done)+'" aria-label="Done: '+E(ex.name||'move')+'" data-mv="done"'+c+'>'+icon('check',15)+'</button>' : '')
        + '<button type="button" class="mv-tx" data-mv="open"'+c+' aria-expanded="'+open+'"><b class="'+(ex.name?'':'empty')+'">'+E(ex.name||'Tap to choose')+'</b><small>'+E(sumText(ex))+'</small></button>'
        + '<button type="button" class="mv-chev" data-mv="open"'+c+' aria-label="'+(open?'Close':'Edit')+'">'+icon(open?'chevleft':'chevright',16)+'</button></div>'
        + (open ? '<div class="mv-body">'+exFields(w,ds,i,ex)
          + '<div class="mv-foot"><button type="button" class="mv-link" data-mv="exname"'+c+'>'+icon('pen',13)+' Change move</button>'
          + '<button type="button" class="mv-rm" data-mv="rm"'+c+' aria-label="Remove '+E(ex.name||'exercise')+'">'+icon('trash',14)+'</button></div></div>' : '')
        + '</div>';
    }

    /* ---------- the exercise library ---------- */
    var PARTS = ['Chest','Back','Legs','Shoulders','Arms','Core','Cardio','Mobility'];
    var LIB = {
      Chest:['Bench Press','Incline Dumbbell Press','Push-ups','Chest Fly','Dips'],
      Back:['Deadlift','Pull-ups','Barbell Row','Lat Pulldown','Seated Row'],
      Legs:['Squat','Lunges','Leg Press','Romanian Deadlift','Calf Raise','Hip Thrust'],
      Shoulders:['Overhead Press','Lateral Raise','Face Pull','Arnold Press'],
      Arms:['Bicep Curl','Tricep Pushdown','Hammer Curl','Skull Crusher'],
      Core:['Plank','Side Plank','Crunches','Leg Raises','Russian Twist','Ab Wheel','Wall Sit','Dead Hang'],
      Cardio:['Run','Walk','Hike','Cycling','Swim','Rowing','Elliptical','Jump Rope','Stairs'],
      Mobility:['Stretching','Yoga','Foam Rolling','Sun salutations','Hip openers']
    };
    function partOf(name){ for(var k in LIB){ if(LIB[k].indexOf(name)>=0) return k; } return 'Chest'; }
    function typeToPart(t){ return /cardio|walk|sport/i.test(t||'') ? 'Cardio' : (/mobil/i.test(t||'') ? 'Mobility' : 'Chest'); }
    function pickExercises(title, single, firstName, defPart, cb){
      LS.openLS({
        title:title, needs:true,
        count:function(st){ return st.ex.length; },
        cta:function(st){ return single ? 'Use this' : (st.ex.length ? 'Add '+st.ex.length+' exercise'+(st.ex.length===1?'':'s') : 'Add'); },
        secs:[
          { id:'part', label:'What kind of move', opts:PARTS, other:false, sel:[firstName ? partOf(firstName) : (defPart||'Chest')] },
          { id:'ex', label:single ? 'Pick one' : 'Pick as many as you like', multi:!single, other:true, opts:function(st){ return st.part.length ? LIB[st.part[0]] : []; }, sel:firstName ? [firstName] : [] }
        ],
        done:function(st){ if(st.ex.length) cb(st.ex); }
      });
    }

    /* ---------- ready-made presets: they live ONLY inside "New preset" ---------- */
    function S(name,sets,reps,kg){ return newEx(name, { sets:String(sets), reps:String(reps) }); }
    function H(name,sets,secs){ return newEx(name, { kind:'hold', sets:String(sets), secs:String(secs) }); }
    function T(name,mins){ return newEx(name, { kind:'time', mins:String(mins) }); }
    function Dd(name,u,dist,mins){ return newEx(name, { kind:'dist', unit:u, dist:String(dist), mins:mins?String(mins):'', pace:mins ? String(Math.round(mins*60/(u==='m'?dist/100:dist))) : '' }); }
    var PRE = {
      'Push Day':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [S('Bench Press',4,8),S('Overhead Press',3,10),S('Incline Dumbbell Press',3,10),S('Tricep Pushdown',3,12)]; } },
      'Pull Day':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [S('Deadlift',4,6),S('Pull-ups',3,8),S('Barbell Row',3,10),S('Bicep Curl',3,12)]; } },
      'Leg Day':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [S('Squat',4,8),S('Romanian Deadlift',3,10),S('Leg Press',3,12),S('Calf Raise',3,15)]; } },
      'Full Body':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [S('Squat',3,8),S('Bench Press',3,8),S('Barbell Row',3,8),S('Overhead Press',3,10),H('Plank',3,45)]; } },
      'Upper Body':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [S('Bench Press',3,8),S('Pull-ups',3,8),S('Overhead Press',3,10),S('Barbell Row',3,10),S('Bicep Curl',3,12)]; } },
      'Core':{ type:'Strength', ex:function(){ return [H('Plank',3,45),S('Crunches',3,15),S('Leg Raises',3,12),S('Russian Twist',3,20)]; } },
      '5K Run':{ type:'Cardio', ex:function(){ return [T('Warm-up',5),Dd('Run','km',5,30),T('Cooldown walk',5)]; } },
      'Run Intervals':{ type:'Cardio', ex:function(){ return [T('Warm-up jog',10),Dd('Run','km',3,18),T('Cooldown walk',10)]; } },
      'Cardio Mix':{ type:'Cardio', ex:function(){ return [Dd('Cycling','km',10,30),T('Jump Rope',10),T('Stairs',10)]; } },
      'Swim':{ type:'Cardio', ex:function(){ return [T('Warm-up',5),Dd('Swim','m',800,20)]; } },
      'Mobility':{ type:'Mobility', ex:function(){ return [T('Stretching',10),T('Yoga',20),T('Foam Rolling',10)]; } }
    };
    var PNAMES = Object.keys(PRE);
    function copyEx(e){ var o = {}; for(var k in e) o[k] = e[k]; return o; }
    function pst(id){ return DB.workoutPresets && DB.workoutPresets[id]; }
    function newPreset(then){
      LS.openLS({ title:'New preset', needs:true, count:function(st){ return st.name.length; },
        cta:function(st){ return st.name.length && PRE[st.name[0]] ? 'Add this preset' : 'Next: pick exercises'; },
        secs:[{ id:'name', label:'Pick a ready-made one (you can change anything after), or tap + Other to make your own.', opts:PNAMES, sel:[], other:true }],
        done:function(st){
          var nm = String(st.name[0]||'').trim(); if(!nm) return;
          var pr = createWorkoutPreset(nm);
          if(PRE[nm]){ pr.exercises = PRE[nm].ex(); pr.type = PRE[nm].type; saveDB(); touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); flashSaved('Preset saved'); render(); if(then) then(pr); return; }
          saveDB(); render();
          setTimeout(function(){ addToPreset(pr.id, then); }, 60);
        } });
    }
    function addToPreset(id, then){
      pickExercises('Add exercises', false, '', 'Chest', function(names){
        var pr = pst(id); if(!pr) return; if(!Array.isArray(pr.exercises)) pr.exercises = [];
        names.forEach(function(n){ pr.exercises.push(newEx(n)); });
        touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); saveDB(); flashSaved('Preset saved'); render(); if(then) then(pr);
      });
    }
    function loadPreset(ds, id){
      var pr = pst(id); if(!pr) return;
      var p = getPage(ds,'workout'); if(!Array.isArray(p.exercises)) p.exercises = [];
      (pr.exercises||[]).forEach(function(e){ var c = copyEx(e); c.done = false; if(!c.kind) c.kind = 'str'; p.exercises.push(c); });
      if(!p.type && pr.type) p.type = pr.type;
      markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved('Loaded '+pr.name); render();
    }

    /* ---------- the page ---------- */
    var HUES = [16,152,208,268,38,336];   /* one hue per preset, in list order, so neighbours never look alike */
    function hueOf(k){ return HUES[k % HUES.length]; }
    var EM = { 'Strength':'dumbbell','Cardio':'run','Mobility':'lotus','Sport':'ball','Walk':'walk','Rest day':'sleep' };   /* icon names (the emoji are gone) */
    var QUICK = {
      strength:['Squat','Deadlift','Bench Press','Pull-ups','Plank'],
      cardio:['Run','Walk','Cycling','Swim','Jump Rope'],
      mobility:['Stretching','Yoga','Foam Rolling'],
      none:['Run','Squat','Push-ups','Plank','Stretching']
    };
    function quickFor(t){ t = String(t||'').toLowerCase(); return /strength/.test(t) ? QUICK.strength : (/cardio|walk|sport/.test(t) ? QUICK.cardio : (/mobil/.test(t) ? QUICK.mobility : QUICK.none)); }
    var DROP = /^(session type|type|quick start|exercise log|workout log|workout \/ movement log|workout log)$/i;
    function labelOf(el){ var l = el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.fc-label'); return l ? l.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : ''; }
    function myBlocks(ds, p){
      var types = (typeof WORKOUT_TYPES!=='undefined' && WORKOUT_TYPES.length) ? WORKOUT_TYPES : ['Strength','Cardio','Mobility','Sport','Rest day'];
      var h = '<div class="field-card"><div class="fc-label">Session type</div><div class="ui-cards">'+types.map(function(t){
        return '<button type="button" class="ui-card'+(p.type===t?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+(p.type===t)+'" data-mv="type" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-v="'+E(t)+'"><span class="em">'+icon(EM[t]||'medal',26)+'</span>'+E(t)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
        + (p.type && types.indexOf(p.type)<0 ? '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin:10px 0 0;">Logged as “'+E(p.type)+'”. Tap a card to switch.</div>' : '') + '</div>';
      var pres = workoutPresetList();
      if(pres.length){
        h += '<div class="field-card mv-prefield"><div class="fc-label">Presets</div><div class="mv-ptiles">'+pres.map(function(pr, k){
          return '<button type="button" class="mv-ptile" style="--ph:'+hueOf(k)+'" data-mv="ldpre" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-id="'+E(pr.id)+'"><span class="ic">'+icon(EM[pr.type]||'dumbbell',20)+'</span><b>'+E(pr.name)+'</b><small>'+(pr.exercises||[]).length+' move'+((pr.exercises||[]).length===1?'':'s')+'</small></button>'; }).join('')
          + '</div><button type="button" class="mv-link" data-mv="settings">Make or edit presets in Settings</button></div>';
      } else {
        h += '<button type="button" class="mv-slim" data-mv="settings"><span class="ic">'+icon('bolt',16)+'</span><span class="tx"><b>Presets</b><small>None yet. Build one in Settings, load it here in one tap.</small></span>'+icon('chevright',16)+'</button>';
      }
      var ex = Array.isArray(p.exercises) ? p.exercises : [], done = ex.filter(function(e,i){ return e.done && !PEND[keyOf('d',ds,i)]; }).length, left = ex.length - done;
      h += '<div class="field-card"><div class="fc-label">Exercise log</div>'
        + '<div class="fc-hint">'+(ex.length ? (left ? left+' to go, '+done+' done. Tap a move to set it, tap the circle when you finish it.' : 'All '+ex.length+' done. Nice work.') : 'Tap a move to add it. Each one is measured the way that fits (reps, distance, time).')+'</div>'
        + ex.map(function(e,i){ return (e.done && !PEND[keyOf('d',ds,i)]) ? '' : exCard('d', ds, i, e, true); }).join('')
        + (done ? '<button type="button" class="mv-donebar" data-mv="donetoggle" aria-expanded="'+showDone+'">'+icon('check',14)+' Done · '+done+'<span class="mv-dsp"></span>'+icon(showDone?'chevleft':'chevright',14)+'</button>'
            + (showDone ? '<div class="mv-donelist">'+ex.map(function(e,i){ return (e.done && !PEND[keyOf('d',ds,i)]) ? '<div class="mv-drow"><span><b>'+E(e.name||'Move')+'</b><small>'+E(sumText(e))+'</small></span><button type="button" class="mv-undo" data-mv="done" data-w="d" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-i="'+i+'">Undo</button></div>' : ''; }).join('')+'</div>' : '') : '')
        + '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">'+quickFor(p.type).map(function(n){ return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip" data-mv="addq" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-v="'+E(n)+'">+ '+E(n)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip more" data-mv="addmore" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'">+ More</button></div></div>';
      return h;
    }
    workoutBody = function(ds){
      var html = baseBody(ds), p = getPage(ds,'workout'), box = document.createElement('div'); box.innerHTML = html;
      var out = '', placed = false, kids = Array.prototype.slice.call(box.children), oldLog = String(p.log||'').trim();
      kids.forEach(function(el){
        var lab = labelOf(el);
        if(el.classList.contains('field-card') && DROP.test(lab)){
          if(!placed && /^(session type|type)$/i.test(lab)){ out += myBlocks(ds, p); placed = true; }
          else if(/log$/i.test(lab) && oldLog && !/^exercise log$/i.test(lab)) out += '<div class="mv-older">'+el.outerHTML+'</div>';   /* an older tick-list is kept visible if that day has one */
          return;
        }
        out += el.outerHTML;
      });
      if(!placed) out = myBlocks(ds, p) + out;
      return out;
    };
    addExRow = function(ds){
      var p = getPage(ds,'workout');
      pickExercises('Add exercises', false, '', typeToPart(p.type), function(names){
        if(!Array.isArray(p.exercises)) p.exercises = [];
        names.forEach(function(n){ p.exercises.push(newEx(n)); });
        markTouched(ds,'workout'); flashSaved(); render();
      });
    };

    /* ---------- the preset editor page (every app) ---------- */
    function presetsPage(){
      var list = workoutPresetList();
      var cards = list.map(function(pr, k){
        var rows = (pr.exercises||[]).map(function(ex,i){ return exCard('p', pr.id, i, ex, false); }).join('');
        return '<div class="field-card mv-pcard" style="--ph:'+hueOf(k)+'"><div class="mv-phead"><span class="mv-pic">'+icon(EM[pr.type]||'dumbbell',20)+'</span><button type="button" class="mv-pname" data-mv="rename" data-id="'+E(pr.id)+'">'+E(pr.name)+' <span>'+icon('pen',12)+'</span></button>'
          + '<button type="button" class="tt-remove-btn" data-mv="pdel" data-id="'+E(pr.id)+'" aria-label="Delete preset">'+icon('trash',14)+'</button></div>'
          + (rows || '<div class="empty-note" style="padding:8px 2px 12px;">No exercises yet.</div>')
          + '<button type="button" class="add-row-btn" data-mv="pexadd" data-id="'+E(pr.id)+'">'+icon('plus',14)+' Add exercises</button></div>'; }).join('');
      app.innerHTML = renderTopbar('Workout Presets', true)
        + '<div class="page-body"><div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 12px;">A preset is a named workout. Build it once, then load it from the Movement page with one tap.</div>'
        + (list.length ? cards : '<div class="empty-note">No presets yet. Tap New preset below.</div>')
        + '<button type="button" class="ls-go" data-mv="newpre" style="margin:6px 0 14px;">'+icon('plus',15)+' New preset</button></div>';
    }
    PAGE_RENDERERS.workoutPresets = presetsPage; renderWorkoutPresets = presetsPage;

    /* ---------- taps ---------- */
    function res(b){
      var w = b.getAttribute('data-w'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')), ex, pr, p;
      if(w==='d'){ p = getPage(ds,'workout'); ex = p.exercises && p.exercises[i]; return ex ? { ex:ex, list:p.exercises, i:i, save:function(){ markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); } } : null; }
      pr = pst(ds); ex = pr && pr.exercises && pr.exercises[i];
      return ex ? { ex:ex, list:pr.exercises, i:i, save:function(){ touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); } } : null;
    }
    function refresh(card, ex){
      if(!card) return;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(card.querySelectorAll('.mv-val'), function(v){ var f = v.getAttribute('data-f'), has = num(ex[f])!=null; v.classList.toggle('empty', !has); v.firstChild.textContent = disp(f, ex); });
      var r = card.querySelector('[data-read]'); if(r) r.textContent = speedText(ex);
      var sm = card.querySelector('.mv-tx small'); if(sm) sm.textContent = sumText(ex);
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(card.querySelectorAll('.mv-chips'), function(c){ var f = c.querySelector('[data-f]').getAttribute('data-f'); if(num(ex[f])!=null) c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });
    }
    function stepNow(b){
      var r = res(b); if(!r) return; var f = b.getAttribute('data-f'), d = Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')), sp = spec(r.ex, f), n = num(r.ex[f]);
      n = n==null ? sp.def : snap(n, d, sp); r.ex[f] = trim(n);
      if(f==='dist' || f==='mins' || f==='pace') recalc(r.ex, f);
      r.save();
      var card = b.closest('.mv-ex'), sv = b.parentNode.querySelector('.ui-sval'); refresh(card, r.ex);
      if(sv){ sv.classList.remove('bump'); void sv.offsetWidth; sv.classList.add('bump'); }
    }
    /* redraw just ONE card in place (not the whole page), so nothing jumps or flickers while you tweak a move */
    function reflow(b){
      var card = b.closest('.mv-ex'), r = res(b); if(!card || !r){ return render(); }
      var w = card.getAttribute('data-w'), ds = card.getAttribute('data-ds'), i = Number(card.getAttribute('data-i'));
      var tmp = document.createElement('div'); tmp.innerHTML = exCard(w, ds, i, r.ex, w==='d');
      /* only one card is open at a time: close any other that is open on this page */
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.mv-ex.open'), function(o){ if(o!==card){ var rr = res(o.querySelector('[data-mv]')); if(rr){ var t2 = document.createElement('div'); t2.innerHTML = exCard(o.getAttribute('data-w'), o.getAttribute('data-ds'), Number(o.getAttribute('data-i')), rr.ex, o.getAttribute('data-w')==='d'); o.parentNode.replaceChild(t2.firstChild, o); } } });
      card.parentNode.replaceChild(tmp.firstChild, card);
    }
    var rep = null, rmArm = null;
    function endRep(ok){ if(!rep) return; var r = rep; rep = null; clearTimeout(r.t); clearInterval(r.i); if(ok && !r.held) stepNow(r.b); }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-mv="st"]'); if(!b) return;
      endRep(false); rep = { b:b, x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY, held:false };
      rep.t = setTimeout(function(){ if(!rep) return; rep.held = true; stepNow(b); rep.i = setInterval(function(){ stepNow(b); }, 110); }, 380);
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){ if(rep && !rep.held && Math.hypot(e.clientX-rep.x, e.clientY-rep.y) > 9) endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', function(){ endRep(true); });
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', function(){ endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.ui-sbtn')) e.preventDefault(); });

    function mvAct(b){
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-mv'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), v = b.getAttribute('data-v'), id = b.getAttribute('data-id'), r, p;
      if(a==='st'){ return; }   /* handled by the press code above (a keyboard "click" has detail 0 and is handled in the listener) */
      if(a==='type'){ p = getPage(ds,'workout'); p.type = p.type===v ? '' : v; markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); return render(); }
      if(a==='ldpre') return loadPreset(ds, id);
      if(a==='newpre') return newPreset();
      if(a==='editpre' || a==='settings') return nav('page','workoutPresets');
      if(a==='addq'){ p = getPage(ds,'workout'); if(!Array.isArray(p.exercises)) p.exercises = []; p.exercises.push(newEx(v)); openKey = keyOf('d', ds, p.exercises.length-1); markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); return render(); }
      if(a==='addmore') return addExRow(ds);
      if(a==='rename'){
        var pr0 = pst(id); if(!pr0) return;
        return LS.openLS({ title:'Rename preset', needs:true, count:function(st){ return st.name.length; }, cta:function(){ return 'Save name'; },
          secs:[{ id:'name', label:'Name', opts:PNAMES, sel:[pr0.name], other:true }],
          done:function(st){ var nm = String(st.name[0]||'').trim(); if(nm){ pr0.name = nm; touchSetupPage('workoutPresets'); saveDB(); flashSaved(); render(); } } });
      }
      if(a==='donetoggle'){ showDone = !showDone; return render(); }
      if(a==='pdel') return confirmDeleteWorkoutPreset(id);
      if(a==='pexadd') return addToPreset(id);
      r = res(b); if(!r) return;
      if(a==='open'){ var k0 = keyOf(b.getAttribute('data-w'), ds, b.getAttribute('data-i')); openKey = openKey===k0 ? '' : k0; return reflow(b); }
      if(a==='done'){
        /* same feel the exercise list always had: the tick shows for a moment, the card collapses away, a "Done" strip keeps count.
           Tap the tick again during the pause and nothing happens; Undo in the strip brings a move back. */
        var wk = keyOf(b.getAttribute('data-w'), ds, b.getAttribute('data-i')), going = !r.ex.done, idx = b.getAttribute('data-i');
        r.ex.done = going; if(going && openKey===wk) openKey = ''; r.save();
        if(going && b.getAttribute('data-w')==='d'){
          PEND[wk] = 1; render();
          setTimeout(function(){ if(!PEND[wk]) return; var cardEl = document.getElementById('ex-row-'+idx); if(cardEl){ cardEl.classList.add('row-completing'); setTimeout(function(){ delete PEND[wk]; render(); }, 260); } else { delete PEND[wk]; render(); } }, (typeof DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS==='number' ? DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS : 2000));
          return;
        }
        delete PEND[wk]; return render();
      }
      if(a==='kind'){ r.ex.kind = v; if((v==='str'||v==='hold') && r.ex.sets==null) r.ex.sets = '3'; if(v==='dist' && !r.ex.unit) r.ex.unit = (prof(r.ex.name)||{}).u || 'km'; r.save(); return reflow(b); }
      if(a==='unit'){ r.ex.unit = v; recalc(r.ex, 'dist'); r.save(); return reflow(b); }
      if(a==='chip'){ var f = b.getAttribute('data-f'); r.ex[f] = v; if(f==='dist' || f==='mins') recalc(r.ex, f); r.save(); return reflow(b); }
      if(a==='exname'){
        return pickExercises('Change exercise', true, r.ex.name, '', function(names){
          var nm = names[0], pf = prof(nm); r.ex.name = nm;
          if(pf && !r.ex.kind) { var n2 = newEx(nm); for(var k in n2) if(r.ex[k]==null) r.ex[k] = n2[k]; }
          r.save(); render(); });
      }
      if(a==='rm'){
        if(rmArm && rmArm.b===b){ clearTimeout(rmArm.t); rmArm = null; r.list.splice(r.i,1); r.save(); return render(); }
        if(rmArm){ clearTimeout(rmArm.t); rmArm.b.classList.remove('arm'); }
        b.classList.add('arm'); b.innerHTML = 'Remove?';
        rmArm = { b:b, t:setTimeout(function(){ try{ b.classList.remove('arm'); b.innerHTML = icon('trash',14); }catch(e){} rmArm = null; }, 3000) };
        return;
      }
    }
