    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-mv]'); if(!b) return;
      if(/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      if(b.getAttribute('data-mv')==='st'){ if(e.detail===0) stepNow(b); return; }
      mvAct(b);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      var t = e.target; if((e.key!=='Enter' && e.key!==' ') || !t || !t.getAttribute || t.getAttribute('data-mv')!=='done') return;
      e.preventDefault(); mvAct(t);
    });

    /* ---------- the hold-to-edit sheet (custom_patch) asks for the right steppers for a card ---------- */
    function rowSteps(ex){
      var k = kindOf(ex), fs = k==='dist' ? ['dist','mins'] : (k==='hold' ? ['sets','secs'] : (k==='time' ? ['mins'] : ['sets','reps','weight']));
      return fs.map(function(f){ var sp = spec(ex, f); return { k:f, label:LABELS[f], v:num(ex[f]), def:sp.def, min:sp.min, max:sp.max, step:sp.step }; });
    }

    /* ---------- look ---------- */
    var css = ''
      + '.ui-ex-grid.two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.ui-ex-grid.one{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:8px;}'
      + '.ui-ex-grid>*{min-width:0;}'
      + '.mv-f label{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px;}'
      + '.mv-ex{padding:6px 12px;overflow:hidden;transition:height .26s ease,opacity .22s ease,margin .26s ease;}.mv-ex.mv-out{opacity:0;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0;}'
      + '.mv-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:56px;}'
      + '.mv-tick{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;padding:0;}.mv-tick.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
      + '.mv-tx{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;border:0;background:none;padding:6px 0;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.mv-tx b{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.mv-tx b.empty{color:var(--muted);}.mv-tx small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:1px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}'
      + '.mv-chev{flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.mv-ex.open .mv-chev svg{transform:rotate(-90deg);}'
      + '.mv-body{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:2px;padding:12px 0 10px;}'
      + '.mv-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}'
      + '.mv-f{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;}.mv-f label{margin:0;text-align:left;width:74px;flex:none;}.mv-f .ui-stepper{flex:1;max-width:210px;margin-left:auto;}'
      + '.mv-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:8px;}'
      + '.mv-donebar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:44px;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0 14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.mv-dsp{flex:1;}'
      + '.mv-donelist{margin:6px 0 0;}.mv-drow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}.mv-drow span{flex:1;min-width:0;}.mv-drow b{display:block;font-size:14px;}.mv-drow small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;}.mv-undo{border:0;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;min-height:36px;padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.mv-ex .ui-sval b{font-size:17px;white-space:nowrap;}'
      + '.ui-ex-grid:not(.two):not(.one) .ui-sval b{font-size:19px;}'
      + '.mv-name{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;border:0;background:var(--surface);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}'
      + '.mv-name.empty{color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.mv-rm{flex:none;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border-radius:12px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}'
      + '.mv-rm.arm{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);padding:0 10px;}'
      + '.mv-kinds,.mv-units{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:0 0 10px;}'
      + '.mv-units{margin:-2px 0 10px;}'
      + '.mv-kind{flex:1;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft,var(--muted));border-radius:999px;min-height:36px;padding:0 8px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.mv-kind.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
      + '.mv-units .mv-kind{flex:none;min-width:52px;}'
      + '.mv-read{text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0 0;min-height:16px;}'
      + '.mv-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;}'
      + '.mv-chips span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);width:100%;}'
      + '.mv-chips .ui-chip{min-height:38px;}'
      + '.mv-empty{padding:14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink-soft,var(--muted));}.mv-empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px;}'
      + '.mv-link{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;padding:8px 2px;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.mv-older{opacity:.9;}'
      + '.mv-pcard{margin-bottom:12px;}.mv-phead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}'
      + '.mv-pname{flex:1;text-align:left;border:0;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.mv-pname span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-left:4px;}'
      + '.ls-sec+.ls-sec{margin-top:16px;}'
      /* ---- Cycle 4: one row of session types, a clear check ring, a colour rail per kind, distinct preset tiles ---- */
      + '.field-card .ui-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(58px,1fr));gap:6px;}.field-card .ui-card{min-height:62px;padding:8px 2px;font-size:11.5px;gap:4px;border-radius:14px;}.field-card .ui-card .em svg{width:22px;height:22px;}'
      + '.mv-ex{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:4px 10px 4px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
      + '.mv-ex::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:4px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:hsl(20 70% 52%);}.mv-ex.k-dist::before{background:hsl(208 70% 52%);}.mv-ex.k-time::before{background:hsl(152 55% 40%);}'
      + '.mv-tick{width:42px;height:42px;border:2.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 40%,transparent);background:var(--surface);color:var(--accent-ink);transition:transform .12s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease;}.mv-tick svg{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);transition:opacity .16s ease,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);width:20px;height:20px;stroke-width:3;}'
      + '.mv-tick:active{transform:scale(.88);}.mv-tick.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);}.mv-tick.on svg{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}'
      + '.mv-ex.done .mv-tx b{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.mv-slim{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:56px;padding:8px 12px;margin:0 0 12px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.mv-slim .ic{flex:none;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);}.mv-slim .tx{flex:1;min-width:0;}.mv-slim b{display:block;font-size:14px;}.mv-slim small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.35;}'
      + '.mv-ptiles{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;margin:0 -4px 6px;padding:2px 4px 6px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}'
      + '.mv-ptile{flex:none;scroll-snap-align:start;width:128px;min-height:98px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;background:hsl(var(--ph) 70% 93%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 45% 22%);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;}'
      + '.mv-ptile .ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;background:hsl(var(--ph) 65% 82%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 55% 28%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:6px;}.mv-ptile b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.2;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;}.mv-ptile small{font-size:11.5px;opacity:.75;}.mv-ptile:active{transform:scale(.97);}'
      + 'html[data-theme="dark"] .mv-ptile{background:hsl(var(--ph) 32% 20%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 70% 88%);}html[data-theme="dark"] .mv-ptile .ic{background:hsl(var(--ph) 36% 30%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 80% 82%);}'
      + '.mv-pcard{border-left:5px solid hsl(var(--ph) 62% 54%);}.mv-pic{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:hsl(var(--ph) 70% 91%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 55% 30%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}'
      + 'html[data-theme="dark"] .mv-pic{background:hsl(var(--ph) 34% 26%);color:hsl(var(--ph) 80% 82%);}.mv-pcard .mv-pname{background:transparent;padding-left:4px;}.mv-pcard .mv-ex::before{background:hsl(var(--ph) 62% 54%);}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'move-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    window.MOVE = { rowSteps:rowSteps, newEx:newEx, prof:prof, kindOf:kindOf, recalc:recalc, PRE:PRE, num:num, spec:spec, loadPreset:loadPreset, newPreset:newPreset, minutesOf:function(ds){ var p = getPage(ds,'workout'), t = 0; (p.exercises||[]).forEach(function(e){ var k = kindOf(e), m = num(e.mins); if((k==='dist'||k==='time') && m) t += m; }); return t; } };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('movement patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   CUSTOMIZE PATCH  (all 7 logbooks)

   Three things live here:
   1) A new field type for "Add a field": a TO-DO LIST. Tick items off, add more as you go, or give it a
      starting list that shows up every day.
   2) PRESS AND HOLD (like moving apps around on an iPhone): hold any field on a box page and the box
      goes into Customize mode, with a gentle wiggle, ready to rename, remove or add fields.
   3) Press and hold on one ROW of a list (a workout move, a to-do item) to rename it, change its sets
      and reps, or delete it.

   Nothing here changes how data is stored. A to-do list is saved in the field's usual cf_<id> slot as
   plain text lines ("• item" open, "✓ item" ticked), so old backups import and new ones round-trip.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof BX_FIELD_TYPES==='undefined' || typeof bxInput==='undefined') return;
    var E = esc;

    /* ---------- little helpers ---------- */
    function parseTodo(v){ var out = []; String(v||'').split('\n').forEach(function(l){ var m = /^([•✓])\s?(.*)$/.exec(l); if(m && m[2].trim()) out.push({ d:m[1]==='✓', t:m[2].trim() }); }); return out; }
    function todoText(items){ return items.map(function(i){ return (i.d?'✓ ':'• ')+i.t; }).join('\n'); }
    function fieldOf(box, fid){ var c = bxCfg(box); return c ? c.fields.find(function(f){ return f.id===fid; }) : null; }
    /* what to show for a day: if nothing was ever saved for this field that day, show the starting list (unticked) */
    function itemsFor(f, ds, box){
      var raw = getPage(ds, box)['cf_'+f.id];
      if(raw==null) return (f.items||[]).map(function(t){ return { d:false, t:t }; });
      return parseTodo(raw);
    }
    function save(ds, box, fid, items){
      var p = getPage(ds, box); p['cf_'+fid] = items.length ? todoText(items) : '';
      markTouched(ds, box); saveDB();
    }
    var OPEN = {};   /* which to-do lists have their "type an item" row open (in memory only) */
    function recentItems(box, fid, have){
      var out = [], seen = {}; have.forEach(function(i){ seen[i.t.toLowerCase()] = 1; });
      Object.keys(DB.days||{}).sort().reverse().slice(0, 40).forEach(function(ds){
        var pg = DB.days[ds] && DB.days[ds].pages && DB.days[ds].pages[box]; if(!pg) return;
        parseTodo(pg['cf_'+fid]).forEach(function(i){ var k = i.t.toLowerCase(); if(!seen[k] && out.length<8){ seen[k] = 1; out.push(i.t); } });
      });
      return out;
    }

    /* ---------- styles ---------- */
    var css = ''
    + '.cu-add{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;}.cu-add input{flex:1;min-width:0;}'
    + '.cu-tip{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;}'
    + '.field-card:not(.bx-fc-edit),.ui-crow,.ui-ex{-webkit-touch-callout:none;}'
    + '.field-card:not(.bx-fc-edit) :not(input):not(textarea),.ui-crow :not(input),.ui-ex :not(input){-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}'
    + '.field-card input,.field-card textarea{-webkit-user-select:text;user-select:text;}'
    + '.cu-lp{animation:cuPress .5s ease-out forwards;}'
    + '@keyframes cuPress{0%{transform:scale(1)}100%{transform:scale(.975);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}}'
    + '@keyframes cuJig{0%{transform:rotate(-.4deg)}50%{transform:rotate(.4deg)}100%{transform:rotate(-.4deg)}}'
    + '.bx-fc-edit{animation:cuJig .3s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 60%;}'
    + '.bx-fc-edit:nth-of-type(2n){animation-duration:.34s;animation-delay:-.12s;}'
    + '.bx-fc-edit:focus-within,.bx-fc-edit:active{animation:none;}'
    + '.bx-edit-banner{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;background:var(--bg);}'
    + '.cu-hl{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent);border-radius:20px;}'
    + '@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bx-fc-edit,.cu-lp{animation:none!important}}'
    + '.cu-rs .ui-stepper{margin-bottom:12px;}.cu-rs .bx-l{display:block;margin:12px 0 6px;}'
    + '.cu-rs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}.cu-rs-grid .ui-sbtn{width:44px;height:48px;font-size:22px;}.cu-rs-grid .ui-sval b{font-size:24px;}'
    + '.cu-danger{color:var(--red,#c0392b)!important;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'cu-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    /* =================================================================================================
       1) THE TO-DO LIST FIELD
       ================================================================================================= */
    BX_FIELD_TYPES.push({ id:'todo', name:'To-do list', desc:'Tick items off, add more as you go', icon:'check' });

    var _norm = bxNorm;
    bxNorm = function(type, raw){
      if(type!=='todo') return _norm.apply(this, arguments);
      var it = parseTodo(raw); return it.length ? it.filter(function(i){ return i.d; }).length : null;   /* "how many are ticked" */
    };
    var _disp = bxDisplay;
    bxDisplay = function(f, v){
      if(f.type!=='todo') return _disp.apply(this, arguments);
      var it = parseTodo(v); return it.length ? it.filter(function(i){ return i.d; }).length+' of '+it.length+' done' : '';
    };
    var _tl = bxTypeLabel;
    bxTypeLabel = function(f){
      if(f.type!=='todo') return _tl.apply(this, arguments);
      return 'To-do list'+(f.items && f.items.length ? ' · '+f.items.length+' starter item'+(f.items.length===1?'':'s') : '');
    };

    function todoHtml(ds, box, f){
      var items = itemsFor(f, ds, box), done = items.filter(function(i){ return i.d; }).length, n = items.length, h = '';
      var base = ' data-box="'+E(box)+'" data-fid="'+E(f.id)+'" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'"';
      if(n){
        h += '<div class="ui-prog"><i style="width:'+Math.round(done/n*100)+'%"></i></div><div class="ui-proglabel">'+done+' of '+n+' done</div>';
        items.forEach(function(it, i){
          h += '<div class="ui-crow'+(it.d?' done':'')+'"><button type="button" class="ui-ctap" data-cu="tdx" data-i="'+i+'"'+base+'><span class="ui-cbox">'+icon('check',16)+'</span><span class="t">'+E(it.t)+'</span></button>'
             + '<button type="button" class="ui-cx" aria-label="Remove '+E(it.t)+'" data-cu="tdel" data-i="'+i+'"'+base+'>×</button></div>';
        });
      } else h += '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin:0 0 8px;">Nothing on the list yet. Add your first item.</div>';
      var key = ds+'|'+box+'|'+f.id, rec = recentItems(box, f.id, items);
      h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick">';
      rec.forEach(function(r){ h += '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip" data-cu="tdadd" data-val="'+E(r)+'"'+base+'>+ '+E(r)+'</button>'; });
      h += '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip more" data-cu="tdopen"'+base+'>+ New item</button></div>';
      if(OPEN[key]) h += '<div class="cu-add"><input class="textline" maxlength="80" placeholder="What needs doing?" data-cu-in="1"'+base+'><button type="button" class="pill active red" data-cu="tdsave"'+base+'>Add</button></div>';
      if(n) h += '<span class="cu-tip">Press and hold an item to rename it.</span>';
      return h;
    }
    var _inp = bxInput;
    bxInput = function(ds, box, f, v){ return f.type==='todo' ? todoHtml(ds, box, f) : _inp.apply(this, arguments); };

    /* the field form: a "starting list" box for to-do lists */
    var _show = bxShowFieldForm;
    bxShowFieldForm = function(f){
      _show.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(BX_FORM && BX_FORM.type==='todo'){
          var err = document.getElementById('bx-f-err'); if(!err) return;
          err.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', '<label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-items">Starting list (optional) — one per line</label>'
            + '<textarea id="bx-f-items" class="freewrite" placeholder="Make bed&#10;Stretch&#10;Pack bag">'+E((f && f.items ? f.items : []).join('\n'))+'</textarea>'
            + '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin-top:6px;">These show up unticked every day. You can always add one-off items on the day.</div>');
        }
      }catch(e){}
    };
    var _save = bxSaveField;
    bxSaveField = function(){
      var F = BX_FORM, ta = document.getElementById('bx-f-items'), raw = ta ? ta.value : null;
      var c = F && F.box ? bxCfg(F.box, true) : null, before = c ? c.fields.length : 0;
      _save.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(!F || F.type!=='todo' || raw==null || document.getElementById('bx-f-label')) return;   /* still open = it refused to save */
        var items = String(raw).split(/\n+/).map(function(s){ return s.trim().slice(0,80); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20);
        var f = F.fid ? fieldOf(F.box, F.fid) : (c && c.fields.length>before ? c.fields[c.fields.length-1] : null);
        if(f){ f.items = items; saveDB(); render(); }
      }catch(e){}
    };
    /* Tracker: a to-do list charts as "items ticked per day" */
    if(typeof bxMetricCard==='function'){
      var _mc = bxMetricCard;
      bxMetricCard = function(m, list, c){
        if(m && m.type==='todo') m = Object.assign({}, m, { type:'number', unit:'items done' });
        return _mc.call(this, m, list, c);
      };
    }

    /* ---------- the to-do list's own taps ---------- */
    function cuAct(b){
      var a = b.getAttribute('data-cu'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), box = b.getAttribute('data-box'), fid = b.getAttribute('data-fid'), f = fid ? fieldOf(box, fid) : null, items, i;
      if(f){ items = itemsFor(f, ds, box); i = Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')); }
      switch(a){
        case 'tdx': if(items[i]) items[i].d = !items[i].d; save(ds, box, fid, items); return render();
        case 'tdel': items.splice(i, 1); save(ds, box, fid, items); return render();
        case 'tdadd': items.push({ d:false, t:b.getAttribute('data-val') }); save(ds, box, fid, items); return render();
        case 'tdopen': OPEN[ds+'|'+box+'|'+fid] = !OPEN[ds+'|'+box+'|'+fid]; render(); setTimeout(function(){ var x = document.querySelector('[data-cu-in]'); if(x) x.focus(); }, 40); return;
        case 'tdsave': var inp = document.querySelector('[data-cu-in][data-fid="'+fid+'"]'), t = inp ? inp.value.trim() : '';
                       OPEN[ds+'|'+box+'|'+fid] = false; if(t){ items.push({ d:false, t:t }); save(ds, box, fid, items); } return render();
        case 'rsstep': return rsStep(b);
        case 'rssave': return rsSave();
        case 'rsdel': return rsDelete();
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      if(suppressNext){ suppressNext = false; ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); return; }
      var b = ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest('[data-cu]'); if(!b || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return; cuAct(b);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      var t = ev.target; if(ev.key!=='Enter' || !t || !t.getAttribute || !t.hasAttribute('data-cu-in')) return;
      ev.preventDefault(); var b = document.querySelector('[data-cu="tdsave"][data-fid="'+t.getAttribute('data-fid')+'"]'); if(b) cuAct(b);
    });

    /* =================================================================================================
       3) THE ROW SHEET (press and hold one list row)
       ================================================================================================= */
    var RS = null;
    var SR_RE = /^(.*?)\s*(\d+)\s*[×x]\s*(\d+\s*s?)$/i;
    function rsHtml(){
      var h = '<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+E(RS.title)+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
        + '<div class="bx-form cu-rs"><label class="bx-l" for="cu-rs-name">Name</label><input id="cu-rs-name" class="textline" maxlength="80" value="'+E(RS.name)+'">';
      if(RS.steps){
        h += '<label class="bx-l">Sets and reps'+(RS.kg?' (and weight)':'')+'</label><div class="cu-rs-grid">';
        RS.steps.forEach(function(s){ h += '<div><div class="fc-hint" style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px;">'+E(s.label)+'</div><div class="ui-stepper"><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" data-cu="rsstep" data-k="'+s.k+'" data-d="-1" aria-label="Less '+E(s.label)+'">−</button><div class="ui-sval'+(s.v==null?' empty':'')+'" data-rsv="'+s.k+'"><b>'+(s.v==null?'—':E(String(s.v)))+'</b></div><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" data-cu="rsstep" data-k="'+s.k+'" data-d="1" aria-label="More '+E(s.label)+'">+</button></div></div>'; });
        h += '</div>';
      }
      h += '<div class="bx-actions"><button type="button" class="sec cu-danger" data-cu="rsdel">Delete</button><button type="button" class="pri" data-cu="rssave">Save</button></div></div>';
      return h;
    }
    function rsOpen(cfg){ RS = cfg; openSheet(rsHtml()); }
    function rsStep(b){
      var k = b.getAttribute('data-k'), d = Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')), s = RS.steps.filter(function(x){ return x.k===k; })[0]; if(!s) return;
      var n = parseFloat(s.v); if(!isFinite(n)) n = s.def; else n = Math.max(s.min, Math.min(s.max, n + d*s.step)); s.v = n;
      var el = document.querySelector('[data-rsv="'+k+'"]'); if(el){ el.classList.remove('empty'); el.firstChild.textContent = String(n); }
    }
    function rsSave(){ var nm = (document.getElementById('cu-rs-name')||{}).value; nm = (nm||'').trim(); var r = RS; if(!nm) return flashSaved('Give it a name'); closeSheet(); RS = null; r.onSave(nm, r.steps); }
    function rsDelete(){ var r = RS; closeSheet(); RS = null; r.onDelete(); }
    function stepOf(r, k){ return r.steps.filter(function(x){ return x.k===k; })[0]; }

    /* a row of the (non-Hustler) workout tick list, or of a to-do list */
    function openTickRow(btn){
      var ds = btn.getAttribute('data-ds'), isTodo = btn.getAttribute('data-cu')==='tdx', i = Number(isTodo ? btn.getAttribute('data-i') : btn.getAttribute('data-val'));
      if(isTodo){
        var box = btn.getAttribute('data-box'), fid = btn.getAttribute('data-fid'), f = fieldOf(box, fid); if(!f) return;
        var items = itemsFor(f, ds, box); if(!items[i]) return;
        return rsOpen({ title:'Edit item', name:items[i].t, steps:null,
          onSave:function(nm){ items[i].t = nm; save(ds, box, fid, items); render(); flashSaved('Saved'); },
          onDelete:function(){ items.splice(i,1); save(ds, box, fid, items); render(); flashSaved('Removed'); } });
      }
      var pl = window.UI.parseLog(getPage(ds,'workout').log), it = pl.items[i]; if(!it) return;
      var m = SR_RE.exec(it.t), name = m ? m[1].trim() : it.t;
      var steps = [ { k:'sets', label:'Sets', v:m ? Number(m[2]) : null, def:3, min:1, max:12, step:1 }, { k:'reps', label:'Reps', v:m ? parseInt(m[3],10) : null, def:10, min:1, max:60, step:1, suf:m && /s\s*$/i.test(m[3]) ? 's' : '' } ];
      rsOpen({ title:'Edit move', name:name, steps:steps,
        onSave:function(nm, st){ var s = stepOf({steps:st},'sets'), r = stepOf({steps:st},'reps'); it.t = nm + (s.v!=null && r.v!=null ? ' '+s.v+'×'+r.v+(r.suf||'') : ''); setText(ds,'workout','log', todoText(pl.items)); flashSaved('Saved'); render(); },
        onDelete:function(){ pl.items.splice(i,1); setText(ds,'workout','log', todoText(pl.items)); flashSaved('Removed'); render(); } });
    }
    /* a Hustler exercise card (name, sets, reps, kg) */
    function openHustlerRow(row){
      var idm = /ex-row-(\d+)/.exec(row.id||''), i = idm ? Number(idm[1]) : -1, st = row.querySelector('[data-ds]'), ds = st ? st.getAttribute('data-ds') : null;
      if(i<0 || !ds) return; var ex = (getPage(ds,'workout').exercises||[])[i]; if(!ex) return;
      function num(v){ var n = parseFloat(v); return isFinite(n) && /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(String(v)) ? n : null; }
      var steps = window.MOVE ? window.MOVE.rowSteps(ex) : [ { k:'sets', label:'Sets', v:num(ex.sets), def:3, min:1, max:12, step:1 }, { k:'reps', label:'Reps', v:num(ex.reps), def:10, min:1, max:60, step:1 }, { k:'weight', label:'Kg', v:num(ex.weight), def:20, min:0, max:500, step:2.5 } ];
      rsOpen({ title:'Edit exercise', name:ex.name||'', steps:steps, kg:true,
        onSave:function(nm, s){ ex.name = nm; s.forEach(function(x){ if(x.v!=null) ex[x.k] = String(x.v); }); markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved('Saved'); render(); },
        onDelete:function(){ var l = getPage(ds,'workout').exercises; l.splice(i,1); markTouched(ds,'workout'); saveDB(); flashSaved('Removed'); render(); } });
    }

    /* =================================================================================================
       2) PRESS AND HOLD
       ================================================================================================= */
    var suppressNext = false, LP = null, HOLD_MS = 520, MOVE_OK = 10;
    function boxIdNow(){
      if(typeof ROUTE==='undefined') return null;
      if(ROUTE.view==='lanelog' && DB.lane) return 'lane';
      if(ROUTE.view==='page' && ROUTE.pageId && bxIsDaily(ROUTE.pageId) && ROUTE.pageId!=='lane') return ROUTE.pageId;
      return null;
    }
    function labelOf(card){ var l = card.querySelector('.fc-label, .field-label, .fc-title, label'); return l ? l.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : ''; }
    function enterCustomize(card, id){
      var lab = labelOf(card); bxOpenEdit(id);
      try{ localStorage.setItem('cu-tip-seen', '1'); }catch(e){}
      setTimeout(function(){
        var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#app .bx-fc-edit')), hit = null;
        cards.forEach(function(c){ var inp = c.querySelector('.bx-fc-bar input'); if(!hit && lab && inp && lab.indexOf(inp.value.trim())===0 && inp.value.trim()) hit = c; });
        if(hit){ hit.scrollIntoView({ block:'center', behavior:'smooth' }); hit.classList.add('cu-hl'); setTimeout(function(){ hit.classList.remove('cu-hl'); }, 1400); }
      }, 60);
      flashSaved('Customizing — tap Done when finished');
    }
    function startHold(ev){
      if(ev.pointerType==='mouse' && ev.button!==0) return;
      if(document.querySelector('#active-sheet')) return;
      suppressNext = false;
      var t = ev.target; if(!t || !t.closest) return;
      var row = t.closest && (t.closest('.ui-crow') || t.closest('.ui-ex'));
      var card = t.closest && t.closest('.field-card');
      if(t.closest && t.closest('.bx-fc-edit, .bx-edit-banner, .ui-sbtn')) return;
      var id = boxIdNow(); if(!id) return;
      var kind = row ? 'row' : (card && BX_EDIT!==id ? 'card' : null); if(!kind) return;
      if(kind==='row' && row.classList.contains('ui-crow') && !row.querySelector('[data-ui="wkx"],[data-cu="tdx"]')) kind = card && BX_EDIT!==id ? 'card' : null;
      if(!kind) return;
      cancelHold();
      LP = { kind:kind, el:kind==='row' ? row : card, x:ev.clientX, y:ev.clientY, id:id, target:t };
      LP.el.classList.add('cu-lp');
      LP.timer = setTimeout(function(){
        var l = LP; if(!l) return; LP = null; l.el.classList.remove('cu-lp');
        if(document.activeElement && document.activeElement===l.target) return;   /* they are typing in it: leave it alone */
        suppressNext = true;   /* the lift of the finger after a hold must not also count as a tap */
        try{ if(navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(18); }catch(e){}
        if(l.kind==='row'){
          var b = l.el.querySelector('[data-ui="wkx"],[data-cu="tdx"]');
          if(b) return openTickRow(b);
          if(l.el.classList.contains('ui-ex')) return openHustlerRow(l.el);
        }
        enterCustomize(l.el, l.id);
      }, HOLD_MS);
    }
    function cancelHold(){ if(!LP) return; clearTimeout(LP.timer); if(LP.el) LP.el.classList.remove('cu-lp'); LP = null; }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', startHold);
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', function(ev){ if(LP && Math.hypot(ev.clientX-LP.x, ev.clientY-LP.y) > MOVE_OK) cancelHold(); });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', cancelHold);
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancelHold);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', cancelHold, true);
    /* the phone's own "press and hold" menu / text selection must not pop up on a field */
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(ev){ var t = ev.target; if(t && t.closest && (t.closest('.field-card') || t.closest('.ui-crow')) && !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(t.tagName)) ev.preventDefault(); });

    /* a one-line hint next to the Customize button, until you have used press and hold once */
    var _bar = bxEditBar;
    bxEditBar = function(id){
      var h = _bar.apply(this, arguments), seen = false; try{ seen = !!localStorage.getItem('cu-tip-seen'); }catch(e){}
      if(BX_EDIT===id || seen) return h;
      return h + '<div class="cu-tip" style="text-align:center;margin:-2px 0 10px;">Tip: press and hold any field to customize it</div>';
    };

    window.CUSTOM = { parseTodo:parseTodo, todoText:todoText, rowSheet:rsOpen };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('customize patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   ADD A FIELD, THE SAME WAY AS THE BUILT-IN ONES  (all 7 apps)

   A field you add yourself used to be a bare typing box. Now it works like the built-in boxes do:
     Number         - and + buttons (hold to run), quick "+5 +10 +20" chips, you choose how big one tap is, and a unit.
     Minutes        - and + in 5s, with 10 / 20 / 30 / 45 / 60 chips      (shows "1h 15")
     Money          - and + in 10s, with $ chips
     Percent        - and + in 5s, with 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 chips
     Time of day    - and + in 15 minutes, with common times as chips     ("10:30 pm")
     Mood           - five faces, tap one
     Pick several   - your own list of options, tap as many as you like
   ...next to the ones that were already there (Short text, Long text, Scale, Toggle, Multiple choice, Photo, To-do list).
   Typing is still there: tap the value of a Number field to type an exact amount.

   Data: a number-like field is saved as a plain number (the same cf_<id> slot as before), Time of day as text
   ("10:30 pm"), Mood as 1 to 5, Pick several as "A, B". The Tracker charts them (Minutes / Money / Percent as numbers,
   Mood as a 1 to 5 scale).
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof BX_FIELD_TYPES==='undefined' || typeof bxInput==='undefined' || typeof bxNorm==='undefined') return;
    var E = esc;
    var NUMT = { number:1, duration:1, money:1, percent:1 };
    var DEF = {   /* step, smallest, biggest, quick chips and whether a chip sets the value (set) or adds to it (add) */
      duration:{ step:5, min:0, max:1440, unit:'min', quick:[10,20,30,45,60], mode:'set' },
      money:{ step:10, min:-1000000, max:100000000, unit:'$', quick:[10,20,50,100,500], mode:'set' },
      percent:{ step:5, min:0, max:100, unit:'%', quick:[25,50,75,100], mode:'set' },
      number:{ step:1, min:-1000000, max:100000000, unit:'', quick:null, mode:'add' }
    };
    function cfg(f){ var d = DEF[f.type] || DEF.number, st = +f.step > 0 ? +f.step : d.step, q = d.quick;
      if(!q) q = [st*5, st*10, st*20];
      return { step:st, min:d.min, max:d.max, unit:f.type==='number' ? (f.unit||'') : d.unit, quick:q, mode:d.mode }; }
    function fieldOf(box, fid){ var c = bxCfg(box); return c ? c.fields.find(function(x){ return x.id===fid; }) : null; }
    function num(v){ if(v===''||v==null||typeof v==='boolean') return null; var n = typeof v==='number' ? v : parseFloat(v); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
    function trim(n){ return String(Math.round(n*100)/100); }
    function fmtVal(f, n){
      if(n==null) return '—';
      if(f.type==='duration') return n>=60 ? Math.floor(n/60)+'h '+('0'+Math.round(n%60)).slice(-2) : trim(n)+' min';
      if(f.type==='money') return (n<0?'-$':'$')+Math.abs(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
      if(f.type==='percent') return trim(n)+'%';
      return Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US')+(f.unit ? ' '+f.unit : '');
    }
    /* ---- time of day ---- */
    function parseTime(s){ var m = /^\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*(am|pm)\s*$/i.exec(String(s||'')); if(!m) return null; var h = +m[1]%12; if(/pm/i.test(m[3])) h += 12; return h*60 + +m[2]; }
    function fmtTime(mins){ mins = ((mins%1440)+1440)%1440; var h = Math.floor(mins/60), m = mins%60, ap = h>=12 ? 'pm' : 'am'; h = h%12; if(!h) h = 12; return h+':'+('0'+m).slice(-2)+' '+ap; }
    var TIMES = ['6:00 am','7:00 am','8:00 am','9:00 pm','10:00 pm','11:00 pm'];
    var FACES = [['😞','Awful'],['🙁','Low'],['😐','Okay'],['🙂','Good'],['😄','Great']];

    /* ---- the field types list: the new ones, in a sensible order ---- */
    var have = {}; BX_FIELD_TYPES.forEach(function(t){ have[t.id] = t; });
    var NEW = [
      { id:'number',   name:'Number',        desc:'A count, with + and − buttons', icon:'hash' },
      { id:'duration', name:'Minutes',       desc:'Time spent, tap to add',        icon:'clock' },
      { id:'money',    name:'Money',         desc:'An amount in dollars',          icon:'dollar' },
      { id:'percent',  name:'Percent',       desc:'How much, 0 to 100',            icon:'chart' },
      { id:'time',     name:'Time of day',   desc:'Like bedtime or wake-up',       icon:'clock' },
      { id:'scale',    name:'Scale',         desc:'Tap 1 to 5, or 1 to 10',        icon:'steps' },
      { id:'mood',     name:'Mood',          desc:'Five faces, tap one',           icon:'smile' },
      { id:'toggle',   name:'Toggle',        desc:'Done or not done',              icon:'toggle' },
      { id:'choice',   name:'Pick one',      desc:'One from your own list',        icon:'listcheck' },
      { id:'multi',    name:'Pick several',  desc:'Any from your own list',        icon:'listcheck' },
      { id:'todo',     name:'To-do list',    desc:'Tick items off, add more',      icon:'check' },
      { id:'list',     name:'List',          desc:'Groceries, names, anything you jot down', icon:'lines' },
      { id:'short',    name:'Short text',    desc:'A word or a line',              icon:'textline' },
      { id:'long',     name:'Long text',     desc:'Free writing',                  icon:'lines' },
      { id:'photo',    name:'Photo',         desc:'Take or choose a picture',      icon:'camera' }
    ];
    var ordered = NEW.map(function(t){ return Object.assign({}, have[t.id]||{}, t); });
    Object.keys(have).forEach(function(id){ if(!ordered.some(function(t){ return t.id===id; })) ordered.push(have[id]); });
    BX_FIELD_TYPES.length = 0; ordered.forEach(function(t){ BX_FIELD_TYPES.push(t); });

    /* ---- values ---- */
    var _norm = bxNorm;
    bxNorm = function(type, raw){
      if(NUMT[type]) return _norm.call(this, 'number', raw);
      if(type==='mood') return _norm.call(this, 'scale', raw);
      return _norm.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var _disp = bxDisplay;
    bxDisplay = function(f, v){
      if(NUMT[f.type] && f.type!=='number') return fmtVal(f, bxNorm('number', v)) === '—' ? '' : fmtVal(f, bxNorm('number', v));
      if(f.type==='mood'){ var n = bxNorm('scale', v); return n ? FACES[Math.min(5,n)-1][0]+' '+FACES[Math.min(5,n)-1][1] : ''; }
      if(f.type==='list'){ var li = String(v||'').split('\n').filter(Boolean); return li.length ? li.length+' item'+(li.length===1?'':'s')+': '+li.slice(0,3).join(', ')+(li.length>3?'…':'') : ''; }
      if(f.type==='time' || f.type==='multi'){ var s = String(v||'').trim(); return s.length>28 ? s.slice(0,27)+'…' : s; }
      return _disp.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    var _tl = bxTypeLabel;
    bxTypeLabel = function(f){
      if(f.type==='multi') return 'Pick several · '+((f.options||[]).length)+' options';
      if(f.type==='list') return 'List';
      if(NUMT[f.type]){ var t = BX_FIELD_TYPES.find(function(x){ return x.id===f.type; }); var c = cfg(f); return (f.type==='number' ? _tl.apply(this, arguments) : t.name)+(f.step ? ' · step '+f.step : ''); }
      var t2 = BX_FIELD_TYPES.find(function(x){ return x.id===f.type; });
      if(f.type==='time' || f.type==='mood') return t2 ? t2.name : f.type;
      return _tl.apply(this, arguments);
    };
    if(typeof bxMetricCard==='function'){
      var _mc = bxMetricCard;
      bxMetricCard = function(m, list, c){
        if(m && (m.type==='duration' || m.type==='money' || m.type==='percent')) m = Object.assign({}, m, { type:'number', unit:DEF[m.type].unit });
        else if(m && m.type==='mood') m = Object.assign({}, m, { type:'scale', max:5 });
        else if(m && (m.type==='time' || m.type==='multi' || m.type==='list')) m = Object.assign({}, m, { type:'short' });
        return _mc.call(this, m, list, c);
      };
    }

    /* ---- drawing ---- */
    var TYPING = {};
    function put(ds, box, fid, v){ var p = getPage(ds, box); if(v===null || v==='') delete p['cf_'+fid]; else p['cf_'+fid] = v; markTouched(ds, box); saveDB(); }
    function a(ds, box, f){ return ' data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-box="'+E(box)+'" data-fid="'+E(f.id)+'"'; }
    function numHtml(ds, box, f, v){
      var c = cfg(f), n = num(v), key = ds+'|'+box+'|'+f.id, h;
      var valBtn = f.type==='number'
        ? '<button type="button" class="ui-sval fx-val'+(n==null?' empty':'')+'" data-fx="type"'+a(ds,box,f)+' aria-label="Type an exact amount"><b>'+E(fmtVal(f,n))+'</b></button>'
        : '<div class="ui-sval fx-val'+(n==null?' empty':'')+'"><b>'+E(fmtVal(f,n))+'</b></div>';
      h = '<div class="ui-stepper fx-st"><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Less" data-fx="st" data-d="-1"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>−</button>'+valBtn+'<button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="More" data-fx="st" data-d="1"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>+</button></div>';
      h += '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick fx-q">'+c.quick.map(function(q){
        var label = c.mode==='add' ? '+'+Number(q).toLocaleString('en-US') : fmtVal(f, q), on = c.mode==='set' && n===q;
        return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-fx="q" data-v="'+q+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>'+E(label)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      if(TYPING[key]) h += '<div class="ui-otherrow"><input class="textline fx-in" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Type a number" value="'+E(n==null?'':n)+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+'><button type="button" class="pill active red" data-fx="typesave"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>Save</button></div>';
      return h;
    }
    function timeHtml(ds, box, f, v){
      var t = parseTime(v), h = '<div class="ui-stepper fx-st"><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Earlier" data-fx="st" data-d="-1"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>−</button><div class="ui-sval fx-val'+(t==null?' empty':'')+'"><b>'+E(t==null ? (String(v||'').trim()||'—') : fmtTime(t))+'</b></div><button type="button" class="ui-sbtn" aria-label="Later" data-fx="st" data-d="1"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>+</button></div>';
      return h + '<div class="pill-row ui-chips ui-quick fx-q">'+TIMES.map(function(x){ var on = String(v||'').toLowerCase()===x; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-fx="qt" data-v="'+x+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>'+x+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    function moodHtml(ds, box, f, v){
      var n = +v || 0;
      return '<div class="pill-row ui-chips fx-mood">'+FACES.map(function(x,i){ var on = n===i+1; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip ui-face'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-fx="mood" data-v="'+(i+1)+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+'><span class="em">'+x[0]+'</span>'+x[1]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    function multiHtml(ds, box, f, v){
      var sel = String(v||'').split(/\s*,\s*/).filter(Boolean), opts = Array.isArray(f.options) ? f.options : [];
      return '<div class="pill-row ui-chips">'+opts.map(function(o,i){ var on = sel.indexOf(o)>=0; return '<button type="button" class="pill ui-chip'+(on?' on':'')+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'" data-fx="multi" data-v="'+E(o)+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>'+E(o)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    /* ---- List: plain old list filling (groceries, names, ideas). Saved as lines of text in the same cf_<id> slot ---- */
    function itemsOf(v){ return String(v||'').split('\n').map(function(x){ return x.trim(); }).filter(Boolean); }
    function rowsHtml(ds, box, f, items){
      return items.map(function(t,i){ return '<div class="fx-lrow"><span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="t">'+E(t)+'</span><button type="button" class="fx-lx" data-fx="lrm" data-i="'+i+'"'+a(ds,box,f)+' aria-label="Remove '+E(t)+'">'+icon('close',14)+'</button></div>'; }).join('');
    }
    function listHtml(ds, box, f, v){
      var items = itemsOf(v);
      return '<div class="fx-list"><div class="fx-lrows">'+rowsHtml(ds,box,f,items)+'</div>'
        + '<div class="fx-ladd"><input class="textline fx-lin" type="text" enterkeyhint="done" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Add an item"'+a(ds,box,f)+'><button type="button" class="fx-lgo" data-fx="ladd"'+a(ds,box,f)+'>'+icon('plus',15)+' Add</button></div>'
        + '<div class="fx-lcount">'+(items.length ? items.length+' item'+(items.length===1?'':'s') : 'Nothing yet. Type one and press Add.')+'</div></div>';
    }
    function listAct(b){
      var act = b.getAttribute('data-fx'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), box = b.getAttribute('data-box'), f = fieldOf(box, b.getAttribute('data-fid')); if(!f) return;
      var card = b.closest('.fx-list') || (b.closest('.field-card') && b.closest('.field-card').querySelector('.fx-list')), inp = card && card.querySelector('.fx-lin');
      var items = itemsOf(getPage(ds, box)['cf_'+f.id]);
      if(act==='ladd'){ var txt = inp ? inp.value : ''; itemsOf(txt).forEach(function(x){ items.push(x); }); if(inp){ inp.value = ''; } }
      else if(act==='lrm'){ items.splice(Number(b.getAttribute('data-i')), 1); }
      put(ds, box, f.id, items.join('\n'));
      if(card){
        card.querySelector('.fx-lrows').innerHTML = rowsHtml(ds, box, f, items);
        var c = card.querySelector('.fx-lcount'); if(c) c.textContent = items.length ? items.length+' item'+(items.length===1?'':'s') : 'Nothing yet. Type one and press Add.';
        if(inp && act==='ladd') inp.focus();
      }
      flashSaved();
    }
    var _inp = bxInput;
    bxInput = function(ds, box, f, v){
      if(NUMT[f.type]) return numHtml(ds, box, f, v);
      if(f.type==='time') return timeHtml(ds, box, f, v);
      if(f.type==='mood') return moodHtml(ds, box, f, v);
      if(f.type==='multi') return multiHtml(ds, box, f, v);
      if(f.type==='list') return listHtml(ds, box, f, v);
      return _inp.apply(this, arguments);
    };

    /* ---- taps ---- */
    function stepNow(b){
      var ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), box = b.getAttribute('data-box'), f = fieldOf(box, b.getAttribute('data-fid')); if(!f) return;
      var d = Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')), pgv = getPage(ds, box)['cf_'+f.id], card = b.closest('.field-card'), n, txt;
      if(f.type==='time'){
        var t = parseTime(pgv); t = t==null ? (d>0 ? 8*60 : 22*60) : t + d*15; var s = fmtTime(t); put(ds, box, f.id, s); txt = s;
      } else {
        var c = cfg(f), cur = num(pgv); n = cur==null ? (d>0 ? c.step : 0) : cur + d*c.step;
        if(cur==null && d<0) n = 0;
        n = Math.max(c.min, Math.min(c.max, Math.round(n*100)/100)); put(ds, box, f.id, n); txt = fmtVal(f, n);
        if(card) Array.prototype.forEach.call(card.querySelectorAll('.fx-q [data-fx="q"]'), function(x){ var on = c.mode==='set' && Number(x.getAttribute('data-v'))===n; x.classList.toggle('on', on); x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on); });
      }
      var sv = card && card.querySelector('.fx-val'); if(sv){ sv.classList.remove('empty'); sv.firstChild.textContent = txt; sv.classList.remove('bump'); void sv.offsetWidth; sv.classList.add('bump'); }
      flashSaved();
    }
    var rep = null;
    function endRep(ok){ if(!rep) return; var r = rep; rep = null; clearTimeout(r.t); clearInterval(r.i); if(ok && !r.held) stepNow(r.b); }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-fx="st"]'); if(!b) return;
      endRep(false); rep = { b:b, x:e.clientX, y:e.clientY, held:false };
      rep.t = setTimeout(function(){ if(!rep) return; rep.held = true; stepNow(b); rep.i = setInterval(function(){ stepNow(b); }, 110); }, 380);
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e){ if(rep && !rep.held && Math.hypot(e.clientX-rep.x, e.clientY-rep.y) > 9) endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', function(){ endRep(true); });
    document.addEventListener('pointercancel', function(){ endRep(false); });
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e){ if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.fx-st .ui-sbtn')) e.preventDefault(); });
    function fxAct(b){
      var act = b.getAttribute('data-fx'), ds = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), box = b.getAttribute('data-box'), fid = b.getAttribute('data-fid'), f = fieldOf(box, fid), v = b.getAttribute('data-v'), key = ds+'|'+box+'|'+fid;
      if(act==='st'){ return; }
      if(act==='ladd' || act==='lrm'){ return listAct(b); }
      if(!f) return;
      if(act==='q'){ var c = cfg(f), q = Number(v), cur = num(getPage(ds,box)['cf_'+fid]); put(ds, box, fid, c.mode==='add' ? Math.max(c.min, Math.min(c.max, (cur||0)+q)) : (cur===q ? null : q)); return render(); }
      if(act==='qt'){ put(ds, box, fid, String(getPage(ds,box)['cf_'+fid]||'').toLowerCase()===v ? '' : v); return render(); }
      if(act==='mood'){ put(ds, box, fid, (+getPage(ds,box)['cf_'+fid]===Number(v)) ? null : Number(v)); return render(); }
      if(act==='multi'){ var sel = String(getPage(ds,box)['cf_'+fid]||'').split(/\s*,\s*/).filter(Boolean), i = sel.indexOf(v); if(i>=0) sel.splice(i,1); else sel.push(v); put(ds, box, fid, sel.join(', ')); return render(); }
      if(act==='type'){ TYPING[key] = !TYPING[key]; render(); setTimeout(function(){ var x = document.querySelector('.fx-in'); if(x) x.focus(); }, 40); return; }
      if(act==='typesave'){ var inp = document.querySelector('.fx-in[data-fid="'+fid+'"]'), n = inp ? parseFloat(String(inp.value).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,'')) : NaN; TYPING[key] = false; if(isFinite(n)) put(ds, box, fid, n); return render(); }
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-fx]'); if(!b || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(b.tagName)) return;
      e.stopPropagation();
      if(b.getAttribute('data-fx')==='st'){ if(e.detail===0) stepNow(b); return; }
      fxAct(b);
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      var t0 = e.target; if(e.key==='Enter' && t0 && t0.classList && t0.classList.contains('fx-lin')){ e.preventDefault(); var go0 = t0.parentNode.querySelector('[data-fx="ladd"]'); if(go0) listAct(go0); return; }
      var t = e.target; if(e.key!=='Enter' || !t || !t.classList || !t.classList.contains('fx-in')) return;
      e.preventDefault(); var go = document.querySelector('[data-fx="typesave"][data-fid="'+t.getAttribute('data-fid')+'"]'); if(go) fxAct(go);
    });

    /* ---- the field form: step size for number-like fields, options for "Pick several" ---- */
    var STEPS = [1,5,10,25,50,100,500];
    window.bxFxStep = function(n){ if(BX_FORM) BX_FORM.step = n; Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#bx-f-step button'), function(x){ x.classList.toggle('on', +x.getAttribute('data-n')===n); }); };
    var _show = bxShowFieldForm;
    bxShowFieldForm = function(f){
      _show.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var F = BX_FORM, err = document.getElementById('bx-f-err'); if(!F || !err) return;
        if(NUMT[F.type]){
          F.step = f && +f.step>0 ? +f.step : DEF[F.type].step;
          err.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', '<label class="bx-l">Each tap changes it by</label><div class="bx-seg" id="bx-f-step">'+STEPS.map(function(n){ return '<button type="button" data-n="'+n+'" class="'+(n===F.step?'on':'')+'" onclick="bxFxStep('+n+')">'+n+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
            + '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin-top:6px;">You can still tap the number to type an exact amount.</div>');
        } else if(F.type==='multi'){
          err.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', '<label class="bx-l" for="bx-f-mopts">Options, one per line</label><textarea id="bx-f-mopts" class="freewrite" placeholder="Gym&#10;Run&#10;Swim">'+E((f && f.options ? f.options : []).join('\n'))+'</textarea>'
            + '<div class="fc-hint" style="margin-top:6px;">You tap any of them each day. Up to 8.</div>');
        }
      }catch(e){}
    };
    var _save = bxSaveField;
    bxSaveField = function(){
      var F = BX_FORM, ta = document.getElementById('bx-f-mopts'), step = F ? F.step : null;
      var c = F && F.box ? bxCfg(F.box, true) : null, before = c ? c.fields.length : 0, opts = null;
      if(F && F.type==='multi' && ta){
        opts = bxParseOptions(ta.value);
        if(!String(bxFormName()).trim()){ bxFormErr('Give the field a name.'); return; }
        if(opts.length < 2){ bxFormErr('Add at least two options, one per line.'); return; }
      }
      _save.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(!F || document.getElementById('bx-f-label')) return;   /* the sheet is still open: it refused to save */
        var f = F.fid ? fieldOf(F.box, F.fid) : (c && c.fields.length>before ? c.fields[c.fields.length-1] : null); if(!f) return;
        if(NUMT[F.type] && step){ f.step = step; saveDB(); render(); }
        if(F.type==='multi' && opts){ f.options = opts; saveDB(); render(); }
      }catch(e){}
    };

    var css = '.fx-list{display:block;}.fx-lrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:46px;padding:0 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}.fx-lrow .dot{flex:none;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);}.fx-lrow .t{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:15px;}.fx-lx{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.fx-ladd{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;}.fx-ladd .fx-lin{flex:1;min-width:0;}.fx-lgo{flex:none;min-height:46px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.fx-lcount{margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.fx-val{border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;}button.fx-val b{border-bottom:2px dotted var(--line);}.fx-mood{gap:8px;}.fx-mood .ui-face{min-width:0;flex:1 1 56px;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'fx-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
    window.FIELDX = { types:BX_FIELD_TYPES, cfg:cfg };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('fields patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   CYCLE 3 (all 7 apps): small shared pieces
     1. SETTINGS gets "Book vault" and "Workout presets". They are the only places books and presets are made.
     2. TICKED ITEMS DISAPPEAR everywhere (the Apple-Reminders feel the apps already had on the old exercise list):
        tick a row, it shows as done for a moment, collapses away, and a "Done" strip keeps count. Tap the strip to bring one back.
        This covers every tick-row on the daily pages (objectives, routine steps, ...). Movement cards do the same (see move_patch).
     3. ADD A FIELD says what to USE each kind for ("Glasses of water, pages read") and offers tappable name ideas.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    var E = esc;

    /* ---------- 1. Settings rows ---------- */
    var _render = render;
    render = function(){
      var r = _render.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.view==='settings'){
          var sec = document.querySelector('#app .settings-section');
          if(sec && !sec.querySelector('[data-c3]')){
            /* Hustler already had rows with these two jobs (named Book Library / Workout Presets): rename and reuse them, never duplicate */
            var names = document.querySelectorAll('#app .settings-row .sr-name'), have = { lib:null, pre:null };
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(names, function(n){ var t = n.textContent.trim(); if(/^(book )?(library|vault)$/i.test(t)) have.lib = n.closest('.settings-row'); if(/^workout presets$/i.test(t)) have.pre = n.closest('.settings-row'); });
            function fix(row, key, name, desc){ row.setAttribute('data-c3', key); row.querySelector('.sr-name').textContent = name; var d = row.querySelector('.sr-desc'); if(d) d.textContent = desc; }
            if(have.lib) fix(have.lib, 'lib', 'Book vault', libDesc());
            if(have.pre) fix(have.pre, 'pre', 'Workout presets', preDesc());
            var rows = (have.lib ? '' : '<button class="settings-row" data-c3="lib" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'library\')"><div><div class="sr-name">Book vault</div><div class="sr-desc">'+libDesc()+'</div></div><div class="sr-ico">'+icon('book',16)+'</div></button>')
              + (have.pre ? '' : '<button class="settings-row" data-c3="pre" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'workoutPresets\')"><div><div class="sr-name">Workout presets</div><div class="sr-desc">'+preDesc()+'</div></div><div class="sr-ico">'+icon('bolt',16)+'</div></button>');
            if(rows){ var h = sec.querySelector('.settings-heading'); if(h) h.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', rows); else sec.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', rows); }
          }
        }
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('settings rows', e); }
      return r;
    };
    function libDesc(){ try{ var n = Object.keys(DB.library.books||{}).length; return n ? n+' book'+(n===1?'':'s')+'. Add and manage them here' : 'Add the books you read, want to read or finished'; }catch(e){ return 'Your shelf'; } }
    function preDesc(){ try{ var n = workoutPresetList().length; return n ? n+' saved. Make and edit them here' : 'Save a workout once, load it with one tap'; }catch(e){ return 'Build a routine'; } }

    /* ---------- 2. ticked rows disappear ---------- */
    var HOLD = typeof DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS==='number' ? DONE_ROW_HOLD_MS : 2000, PEND = {};
    function rowId(row){ var cb = row.querySelector('.checkbox'); var o = cb && cb.getAttribute('onclick'); var m = o && /toggleCheck\('([^']*)','([^']*)','([^']*)'\)/.exec(o); return m ? m[1]+'|'+m[2]+'|'+m[3] : null; }
    function findRow(id){ var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#app .check-row'); for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++) if(rowId(rows[i])===id) return rows[i]; return null; }
    var _tc = toggleCheck;
    toggleCheck = function(ds, pid, key){
      var p = getPage(ds, pid), will = !(p.checks && p.checks[key]), id = ds+'|'+pid+'|'+key;
      if(will) PEND[id] = 1; else delete PEND[id];
      var r = _tc.apply(this, arguments);
      if(will) setTimeout(function(){
        if(!PEND[id]) return;                                   /* un-ticked again during the pause: nothing to collapse */
        var row = findRow(id);
        if(row){ row.classList.add('row-completing'); setTimeout(function(){ delete PEND[id]; render(); }, 260); } else { delete PEND[id]; render(); }
      }, HOLD);
      return r;
    };
    var EXCLUDE = { bucket:1, objectives:1, income:1, habits:1, library:1, workoutPresets:1 };
    var _r2 = render;
    render = function(){
      var r = _r2.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(typeof ROUTE==='undefined' || ROUTE.view!=='page' || EXCLUDE[ROUTE.pageId]) return r;
        var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#app .page-body .check-row')), groups = [];
        rows.forEach(function(row){ var par = row.parentNode; var g = groups.filter(function(x){ return x.par===par; })[0]; if(!g){ g = { par:par, rows:[] }; groups.push(g); } g.rows.push(row); });
        groups.forEach(function(g){
          var done = g.rows.filter(function(row){ var cb = row.querySelector('.checkbox'); var id = rowId(row); return cb && cb.classList.contains('checked') && !(id && PEND[id]); });
          if(!done.length) return;
          var box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'tidy';
          box.innerHTML = '<button type="button" class="tidy-bar" aria-expanded="false">'+icon('check',14)+' Done · '+done.length+'<span class="tidy-sp"></span>'+icon('chevright',14)+'</button><div class="tidy-list" hidden></div>';
          var list = box.querySelector('.tidy-list'), last = g.rows[g.rows.length-1];
          done.forEach(function(row){ list.appendChild(row); });
          last.parentNode.insertBefore(box, last.nextSibling && last.nextSibling.parentNode===g.par ? last.nextSibling : null);
          if(!g.par.contains(box)) g.par.appendChild(box);
        });
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('tidy', e); }
      return r;
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tidy-bar'); if(!b) return;
      var l = b.parentNode.querySelector('.tidy-list'), open = l.hasAttribute('hidden');
      if(open) l.removeAttribute('hidden'); else l.setAttribute('hidden','');
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    });
    var css = '.lib-archive-link,.lib-newbook-link{display:none!important}.tidy{margin:6px 0 0;}.tidy-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.tidy-sp{flex:1;}'
      + '.tidy-list{margin-top:4px;}.tidy-list[hidden]{display:none;}';

    /* ---------- 3. Add a field: say what it is FOR ---------- */
    var USE = {
      number:  { ex:[['Glasses of water','glasses'],['Pages read','pages'],['Coffees','cups']] },
      duration:{ ex:[['Deep work'],['Meditation'],['Time outside']] },
      money:   { ex:[['Money spent today'],['Tips earned'],['Added to savings']] },
      percent: { ex:[['Plan completed'],['Focus level'],['Battery left']] },
      time:    { ex:[['Bedtime'],['Wake-up time'],['First meal']] },
      scale:   { ex:[['Energy'],['Stress'],['Focus']] },
      mood:    { ex:[['How the day felt'],['Mood after training'],['Mood at night']] },
      toggle:  { ex:[['Took vitamins'],['Made the bed'],['No sugar today']] },
      choice:  { ex:[['Sleep quality','Poor\nOkay\nGreat'],['Weather','Sunny\nCloudy\nRainy'],['Energy','Low\nMedium\nHigh']] },
      multi:   { ex:[['What I ate','Rice\nEggs\nFruit\nSalad'],['Where I went','Home\nWork\nGym\nCafe'],['Who I saw','Family\nFriends\nColleagues']] },
      todo:    { ex:[['Errands'],['Tomorrow prep'],['Things to reply to']] },
      list:    { ex:[['Groceries'],['People to call'],['Packing list']] },
      short:   { ex:[['Song of the day'],['One word for today'],['Best meal']] },
      long:    { ex:[['What I learned'],['Gratitude'],['Ideas']] },
      photo:   { ex:[['Meal'],['Outfit of the day'],['Progress shot']] }
    };
    BX_FIELD_TYPES.forEach(function(t){ var u = USE[t.id]; if(u) t.desc = 'For: '+u.ex.map(function(x){ return x[0].toLowerCase(); }).join(', '); });
    /* CYCLE 5: the name ideas for a new field (chips, prefilled name, units, options) now live in c5_patch.js, per lifestyle. The tile text above ("For: ...") still comes from USE. */
    css += '.bx-sug{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:8px 0 2px;align-items:center;}.bx-sug span{width:100%;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.bx-sug button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;min-height:38px;padding:0 13px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.bx-sug button.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'c3-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('cycle 3 shared patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   CARRY TO TOMORROW (all 7 apps)

   HUSTLER: "Carry into tomorrow" on the Daily Dashboard. Tap Follow up / Restock / Fix a mistake ... and it is put into
     tomorrow's 3 objectives by itself (first empty slot). Take the tap off and it comes back out (if you did not change it).
     The slots show a small "Carried over" tag, and a card at the top of tomorrow's dashboard lists what came from yesterday.
   EVERY APP: whatever you wrote last night as "Tomorrow's intention" or "Tomorrow's top 3 objectives" is shown at the top of today's
     Dashboard / Journal page as a "From last night" card, so it is in front of you without hunting for it.

   Saved as:  tomorrow's dashboard page gets   carryIn: [ { t:'Follow up', slot:1 } ]   (slot 0 = the 3 slots were full).
   It is idempotent: running it twice never doubles anything.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof getPage!=='function' || typeof saveDB!=='function' || typeof render!=='function') return;
    var E = esc, HUSTLER = /hustler|canvas/i.test(BRAND.name), busy = false;
    function ymd(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
    function shift(ds, n){ var d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate()+n); return ymd(d); }
    function parseTok(v){ v = v==null ? '' : String(v); var i = v.indexOf(' — '), head = i>=0 ? v.slice(0,i) : v; var toks = head ? head.split(/\s*,\s*/).filter(Boolean) : []; return toks.every(function(t){ return t.length<=28 && !/[.!?\n]/.test(t); }) ? toks : []; }

    /* ---------- Hustler: carry chips -> tomorrow's objectives ---------- */
    function syncDay(ds){
      var p = getPage(ds, 'dashboard'), toks = parseTok(p.carry), tm = shift(ds, 1), tp = getPage(tm, 'dashboard'), added = [], changed = false;
      if(!Array.isArray(tp.carryIn)) tp.carryIn = [];
      /* new taps go in */
      toks.forEach(function(t){
        if(tp.carryIn.some(function(c){ return c.t===t; })) return;
        var slot = 0; for(var n=1;n<=3;n++){ if(!String(tp['obj'+n]||'').trim()){ slot = n; break; } }
        if(slot){ tp['obj'+slot] = t; }
        tp.carryIn.push({ t:t, slot:slot, from:ds }); added.push(t); changed = true;
      });
      /* taps taken off come back out (only if the slot still says what we put there) */
      tp.carryIn = tp.carryIn.filter(function(c){
        if(c.from!==ds || toks.indexOf(c.t)>=0) return true;
        if(c.slot && tp['obj'+c.slot]===c.t && !(tp.checks && tp.checks['o'+c.slot])) tp['obj'+c.slot] = '';
        changed = true; return false;
      });
      if(!tp.carryIn.length) delete tp.carryIn;
      return { changed:changed, added:added };
    }
    if(HUSTLER){
      var _save = saveDB;
      saveDB = function(){
        if(!busy){
          busy = true;
          try{
            var seen = {}, list = [typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.date, todayStr(), shift(todayStr(), -1)].filter(function(d){ if(!d || seen[d]) return false; seen[d] = 1; return true; });
            var all = [];
            list.forEach(function(ds){ var r = syncDay(ds); if(r.added.length) all = all.concat(r.added); });
            if(all.length) setTimeout(function(){ try{ flashSaved("Added to tomorrow's priorities: "+all.join(', ')); }catch(e){} }, 0);
          }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('carry sync', e); }
          busy = false;
        }
        return _save.apply(this, arguments);
      };
    }

    /* ---------- the visible parts (after every redraw) ---------- */
    var _r = render;
    render = function(){
      var r = _r.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        if(typeof ROUTE==='undefined' || ROUTE.view!=='page') return r;
        var pb = document.querySelector('#app .page-body'); if(!pb) return r; var ds = ROUTE.date || todayStr();
        if(HUSTLER && ROUTE.pageId==='dashboard'){
          var tp = getPage(ds, 'dashboard');
          /* the explainer under the Carry field (this is the feature, so it is spelled out) */
          var lab = Array.prototype.filter.call(pb.querySelectorAll('.fc-label'), function(l){ return /carry into tomorrow/i.test(l.textContent); })[0];
          if(lab && !pb.querySelector('.cy-note')){ var card = lab.closest('.field-card'); if(card) card.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<div class="cy-note">'+icon('chevright',14)+'<span>Tap what to carry. It goes into <b>tomorrow\'s 3 objectives</b> on its own.</span></div>'); }
          /* tomorrow's page: where each objective came from */
          if(Array.isArray(tp.carryIn) && tp.carryIn.length && !pb.querySelector('.cy-banner')){
            pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<div class="cy-banner"><div class="cy-h">'+icon('repeat',15)+' Carried over from yesterday</div><div class="cy-chips">'+tp.carryIn.map(function(c){ return '<span>'+E(c.t)+(c.slot ? '' : ' <small>(priorities were full)</small>')+'</span>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>');
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(pb.querySelectorAll('.check-row'), function(row, i){
              var hit = tp.carryIn.filter(function(c){ return c.slot===i+1 && tp['obj'+(i+1)]===c.t; })[0];
              if(hit) row.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<span class="cy-tag">Carried over</span>');
            });
          }
        } else if(ds===todayStr() && /^(dashboard|journal)$/.test(ROUTE.pageId) && !pb.querySelector('.cy-banner')){
          var y = shift(ds, -1), n = getPage(y, 'night'), items = [];
          [n.intention, n.obj1, n.obj2, n.obj3].forEach(function(v){ if(v && String(v).trim()) items.push(String(v).trim()); });
          if(!items.length && !HUSTLER){ var j = getPage(y, 'journal'); if(j.intention && String(j.intention).trim()) items.push(String(j.intention).trim()); }
          if(items.length) pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<div class="cy-banner last"><div class="cy-h">'+icon('moon',15)+' From last night</div><div class="cy-chips">'+items.map(function(t){ return '<span>'+E(t.length>70 ? t.slice(0,68)+'…' : t)+'</span>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>');
        }
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('carry view', e); }
      return r;
    };

    var css = '.cy-note{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--ink);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.35;}.cy-note svg{flex:none;color:var(--accent);}'
      + '.cy-banner{margin:0 0 14px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface-2));border:1px solid var(--line);}'
      + '.cy-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:8px;}'
      + '.cy-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;}.cy-chips span{background:var(--surface);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;}.cy-chips small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;}'
      + '.cy-tag{flex:none;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;margin-left:6px;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'carry-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
    window.CARRY = { syncDay:syncDay };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('carry patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   SOBER BOY / SOBER GIRL: a streak that holds up by itself.

   THE PROBLEM (before): "Days sober" was a number you typed again on every day's journal, and the Milestone Vault's start date
   was stored inside whichever month you happened to open, so a new start date never replaced the old one. Nothing carried
   from one day to the next, which is why this was the only logbook that felt like it forgot yesterday.

   NOW: one running record, DB.sober = { start:'YYYY-MM-DD', checks:{date:'ok'}, runs:[{start,end,days,why}], best:N }.
     - The count is worked out from the start date, so it is right on any day without logging anything.
     - "I stayed sober today" is ONE button (a daily check-in, optional: the count keeps going without it).
     - "I slipped" is the honest reset: it saves the run you just finished into Past runs, then starts again from day 0.
     - The Milestone Vault is built from the same record: earned milestones (with dates), the next one with days to go, best streak,
       and every past run. Nothing is ever deleted by a slip.
     - Old data is read once: the earliest start date found in the old monthly vault pages becomes the start.
     - Each day's journal still gets "soberDays" filled in by itself, so old charts and backups keep working.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    var CANVAS = /canvas/i.test(BRAND.name);
    if(!(/sober/i.test(BRAND.name) || CANVAS) || typeof journalBody!=='function' || typeof incomeBody!=='function' || !window.LISTS) return;
    var E = esc, LS = window.LISTS;
    var MILES = [[1,'First day'],[3,'Three days'],[7,'One week'],[14,'Two weeks'],[30,'One month'],[60,'Two months'],[90,'Three months'],[180,'Six months'],[365,'One year'],[730,'Two years']];
    var WHY = ['Stress','Boredom','Social pressure','Tired','Anxious','Celebration','Craving hit hard','Other'];

    function ymd(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
    function shift(ds, n){ var d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate()+n); return ymd(d); }
    function between(a, b){ return Math.round((new Date(b+'T00:00:00') - new Date(a+'T00:00:00'))/86400000); }
    function pretty(ds){ var d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00'); return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric' }); }

    /* ---------- the record (and the one-time read of the old data) ---------- */
    function S(){
      if(!DB.sober || typeof DB.sober!=='object'){
        var start = '', best = 0;
        try{ Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).forEach(function(mk){ var v = DB.monthly[mk] && DB.monthly[mk].income && DB.monthly[mk].income.startDate; if(v && (!start || v<start)) start = v; }); }catch(e){}
        DB.sober = { start:start, checks:{}, runs:[], best:best };
      }
      var s = DB.sober; if(!s.checks) s.checks = {}; if(!Array.isArray(s.runs)) s.runs = []; if(s.best==null) s.best = 0;
      return s;
    }
    function streakAt(ds){ var s = S(); if(!s.start) return null; var n = between(s.start, ds); return n>=0 ? n : null; }
    function streak(){ return streakAt(todayStr()); }
    function bestEver(){ var s = S(), b = s.best||0, cur = streak(); s.runs.forEach(function(r){ if(r.days>b) b = r.days; }); if(cur!=null && cur>b) b = cur; return b; }
    function checkedRun(){ var s = S(), n = 0, d = todayStr(); if(!s.checks[d]) d = shift(d,-1); while(s.checks[d] && (!s.start || d>=s.start)){ n++; d = shift(d,-1); } return n; }
    function unitText(n){ return n==null ? '' : (n>=60 ? Math.floor(n/30)+' months' : (n>=14 ? Math.floor(n/7)+' weeks' : (n===1 ? '1 day' : n+' days'))); }
    function nextMile(n){ for(var i=0;i<MILES.length;i++) if(MILES[i][0]>(n||0)) return MILES[i]; return null; }
    function prevMile(n){ var p = [0,'Start']; MILES.forEach(function(m){ if(m[0]<=(n||0)) p = m; }); return p; }
    function earnedList(){
      var s = S(), cur = streak(), out = [];
      MILES.forEach(function(m){
        var when = null;
        if(cur!=null && cur>=m[0]) when = shift(s.start, m[0]);
        else { s.runs.forEach(function(r){ if(!when && r.days>=m[0]) when = shift(r.start, m[0]); }); }
        out.push({ n:m[0], name:m[1], when:when, now:(cur!=null && cur>=m[0]) });
      });
      return out;
    }

    /* ---------- the actions ---------- */
    function syncJournal(ds){ if(CANVAS) return; try{ var n = streakAt(ds); var p = getPage(ds,'journal'); if(n!=null) p.soberDays = String(n); }catch(e){} }
    function startToday(){ var s = S(); s.start = todayStr(); syncJournal(todayStr()); saveDB(); flashSaved('Day 0. Your count starts today'); render(); }
    function startOn(v){ if(!v) return; var s = S(); s.start = v; syncJournal(todayStr()); saveDB(); flashSaved('Start date saved'); render(); }
    function checkIn(){
      var s = S(), t = todayStr(); if(!s.start){ return startToday(); }
      if(s.checks[t]){ delete s.checks[t]; saveDB(); render(); return; }
      s.checks[t] = 'ok'; syncJournal(t); markTouched(t, CANVAS ? 'streak' : 'journal');
      var n = streak(), hit = MILES.filter(function(m){ return m[0]===n; })[0];
      flashSaved(hit ? 'Milestone: '+hit[1]+' sober!' : 'Checked in. Day '+n);
      saveDB(); render();
    }
    function slipSheet(){
      var s = S(), n = streak(); if(!s.start) return;
      LS.openLS({ title:'I slipped', needs:false,
        secs:[{ id:'why', label:'What was going on? (optional)', opts:WHY, sel:[], other:true }],
        cta:function(){ return 'Reset to day 0'; },
        done:function(st){
          var t = todayStr(), why = (st.why||[]).join(', ');
          s.runs.push({ start:s.start, end:t, days:n, why:why, at:t });
          if(n>(s.best||0)) s.best = n;
          s.start = t; delete s.checks[t]; syncJournal(t); touchSetupPage('income'); saveDB();
          flashSaved('Day 0. Your '+n+' day'+(n===1?'':'s')+' are saved in Past runs'); render();
        } });
    }

    /* ---------- the streak card (Journal and Milestone Vault) ---------- */
    function week(){
      var s = S(), t = todayStr(), h = '';
      for(var i=6;i>=0;i--){ var d = shift(t,-i), on = !!s.checks[d], slip = s.runs.some(function(r){ return r.end===d; }), future = s.start && d<s.start;
        h += '<div class="sb-d'+(on?' on':'')+(slip?' slip':'')+(i===0?' today':'')+'"><span>'+new Date(d+'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'narrow'})+'</span><i>'+(slip ? icon('close',12) : (on ? icon('check',12) : ''))+'</i></div>'; }
      return '<div class="sb-week" aria-label="Last 7 days">'+h+'</div>';
    }
    function card(){
      var s = S(), n = streak(), t = todayStr(), done = !!s.checks[t], nx = nextMile(n || 0), pv = prevMile(n || 0);
      if(!s.start){
        return '<div class="sb-card empty"><div class="sb-ico">'+icon('sprout',30)+'</div><div class="sb-h">Start your count</div><p>Your days are counted from a start date, so you never have to log them by hand.</p>'
          + '<button type="button" class="sb-go" data-sb="start">'+icon('sprout',16)+' Start from today</button>'
          + '<label class="sb-date">Already going? Pick your start date<input type="date" max="'+t+'" data-sb="date"></label></div>';
      }
      var pct = nx ? Math.max(4, Math.round(((n-pv[0])/(nx[0]-pv[0]))*100)) : 100;
      return '<div class="sb-card"><div class="sb-lab">Days sober</div><div class="sb-num">'+n+'</div><div class="sb-unit">'+(n>=14 ? unitText(n)+' · ' : '')+'since '+E(pretty(s.start))+'</div>'
        + (nx ? '<div class="sb-bar" role="img" aria-label="Progress to '+E(nx[1])+'"><i style="width:'+pct+'%"></i></div><div class="sb-nx">'+(nx[0]-n)+' day'+(nx[0]-n===1?'':'s')+' to <b>'+E(nx[1])+'</b></div>' : '<div class="sb-nx"><b>Every milestone reached.</b> Keep going.</div>')
        + week()
        + '<button type="button" class="sb-go'+(done?' done':'')+'" data-sb="check" aria-pressed="'+done+'">'+icon(done?'check':'shield',17)+' '+(done ? 'Checked in today. Tap to undo' : 'I stayed sober today')+'</button>'
        + '<button type="button" class="sb-slip" data-sb="slip">I slipped</button>'
        + '<div class="sb-fine">'+(checkedRun()>1 ? checkedRun()+' check-ins in a row. ' : '')+'The count keeps going even if you forget to check in. A slip saves your run and starts again, nothing is deleted.</div></div>';
    }

    /* ---------- Journal: the typed counter becomes the card ---------- */
    var baseJ = journalBody;
    if(!CANVAS) journalBody = function(ds){
      var p = getPage(ds,'journal'); if(streakAt(ds)!=null && !p.soberDays) p.soberDays = String(streakAt(ds));   /* carries into every day by itself */
      var box = document.createElement('div'); box.innerHTML = baseJ.apply(this, arguments); var out = '', placed = false;
      Array.prototype.slice.call(box.children).forEach(function(el){
        var l = el.querySelector && el.querySelector('.fc-label');
