        if(l && /days sober counter/i.test(l.textContent)){ if(!placed){ out += (ds===todayStr() ? card() : '<div class="sb-card past"><div class="sb-lab">Days sober on this day</div><div class="sb-num">'+(streakAt(ds)==null ? '—' : streakAt(ds))+'</div></div>'); placed = true; } return; }
        out += el.outerHTML;
      });
      return placed ? out : card() + out;
    };

    /* ---------- Milestone Vault ---------- */
    function vault(mk){
      var s = S(), cur = streak(), best = bestEver(), list = earnedList(), earned = list.filter(function(x){ return x.when; }).length;
      var h = card();
      h += '<div class="sb-stats"><div><b>'+best+'</b><span>Best streak</span></div><div><b>'+earned+'</b><span>Milestones</span></div><div><b>'+s.runs.length+'</b><span>Past runs</span></div></div>';
      h += '<div class="sb-sec">Milestones</div><div class="sb-miles">'+list.map(function(m){
        var nx = nextMile(cur||0), isNext = nx && nx[0]===m.n && !m.when;
        return '<div class="sb-m'+(m.when ? ' got' : '')+(isNext ? ' next' : '')+'"><div class="sb-mi">'+icon(m.when ? (m.n>=365 ? 'trophy' : (m.n>=30 ? 'medal' : 'shield')) : 'shield',22)+'</div><div class="sb-mt"><b>'+E(m.name)+'</b><small>'+(m.when ? (m.now ? 'Reached ' : 'Reached in an earlier run, ')+E(pretty(m.when)) : (isNext && cur!=null ? (m.n-cur)+' to go' : m.n+' days'))+'</small></div></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      h += '<div class="sb-sec">Past runs</div>';
      h += s.runs.length ? s.runs.slice().reverse().map(function(r){ return '<div class="sb-run"><div class="sb-rn"><b>'+r.days+'</b><span>days</span></div><div class="sb-rt"><b>'+E(pretty(r.start))+' to '+E(pretty(r.end))+'</b><small>'+(r.why ? E(r.why) : 'No note')+'</small></div></div>'; }).join('')
        : '<div class="sb-none">No past runs. If you slip, the run you finished shows up here.</div>';
      if(s.start) h += '<label class="sb-date sb-edit">Change start date<input type="date" max="'+todayStr()+'" value="'+E(s.start)+'" data-sb="date"></label>';
      return h;
    }
    var baseInc = incomeBody;
    if(!CANVAS) incomeBody = function(monthKey){
      var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey();
      if(isMonthlyPageLocked('income', mk)){
        var n = streak(), summary = '<div class="field-card"><div class="locked-item-row"><span style="font-weight:700;">Days sober</span><span class="muted-inline">'+(n==null ? 'not started' : n)+'</span></div><div class="locked-item-row"><span style="font-weight:700;">Best streak</span><span class="muted-inline">'+bestEver()+'</span></div></div>';
        return monthlyLockedBody(summary, 'income', mk);
      }
      return fieldWrap('Milestone vault', 'One streak, counted for you. Check in once a day, or just let it run.', '') + vault(mk)
        + '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow(\'income\',\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+' Mark done for '+monthLabelShort(mk)+'</button>';
    };
    /* every older place that asked "what is the start date / what day is it" now reads the one record */
    if(!CANVAS){ soberStartDate = function(){ return S().start || null; }; soberDaysAt = function(ds){ return streakAt(ds); }; }

    /* ---------- clicks ---------- */
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-sb]'); if(!b) return; var a = b.getAttribute('data-sb');
      if(a==='start'){ e.stopPropagation(); startToday(); } else if(a==='check'){ e.stopPropagation(); checkIn(); } else if(a==='slip'){ e.stopPropagation(); slipSheet(); }
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('change', function(e){ var b = e.target; if(b && b.getAttribute && b.getAttribute('data-sb')==='date'){ var v = b.value; if(v && v<=todayStr()) startOn(v); } });

    var css = ''
      + '.sb-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;padding:20px 18px 16px;margin:0 0 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
      + '.sb-card.past{padding:14px;}.sb-card.empty{padding:24px 18px;}.sb-ico{color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px;}.sb-h{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:4px;}.sb-card p{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-lab{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:76px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--accent);margin:4px 0 2px;}.sb-card.past .sb-num{font-size:40px;}'
      + '.sb-unit{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;}'
      + '.sb-bar{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden;margin:0 6px 6px;}.sb-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent);}'
      + '.sb-nx{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px;}.sb-nx b{color:var(--ink);}'
      + '.sb-week{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;margin:0 2px 14px;}.sb-d{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-d i{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:transparent;font-style:normal;}.sb-d.on i{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}.sb-d.slip i{border-color:var(--red,#c0392b);color:var(--red,#c0392b);}.sb-d.today span{color:var(--ink);}'
      + '.sb-go{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:56px;border:0;border-radius:18px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.sb-go.done{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--accent);}.sb-go:active{transform:scale(.98);}'
      + '.sb-slip{display:block;width:100%;min-height:46px;margin-top:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.sb-fine{margin-top:12px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-date{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;}.sb-date input{font:inherit;min-height:46px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);}.sb-edit{margin:14px 2px 6px;}'
      + '.sb-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:0 0 6px;}.sb-stats div{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 6px;text-align:center;}.sb-stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;}.sb-stats span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-sec{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:18px 2px 8px;}'
      + '.sb-miles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}.sb-m{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);opacity:.6;}.sb-m.got{opacity:1;border-color:var(--accent);background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface));}.sb-m.next{opacity:1;border-style:dashed;}'
      + '.sb-mi{flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface-2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);}.sb-m.got .sb-mi{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
      + '.sb-mt{min-width:0;}.sb-mt b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.2;}.sb-mt small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.3;}'
      + '.sb-run{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);margin:0 0 8px;}.sb-rn{flex:none;width:54px;text-align:center;}.sb-rn b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:24px;line-height:1;}.sb-rn span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.sb-rt b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;}.sb-rt small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;}.sb-none{padding:14px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;text-align:center;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'sober-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
    window.SOBER = { S:S, streak:streak, checkIn:checkIn, startToday:startToday, slip:slipSheet, best:bestEver, card:card, vault:vault };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('sober patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   READING BOY / READING GIRL: the timetable, reimagined as "Your reading day".

   Before: a grid of 24 empty boxes and three lines of instructions.
   Now:   - a headline with the day's reading hours and a daily page goal (10 / 20 / 30 / 50, or your own with +/-)
          - one-tap reading slots (Morning pages, Lunch read, After work, Before bed): tap to book that hour for reading, tap again to clear it
          - the day as a rail, in four chapters (Morning, Midday, Evening, Night). Each hour is a row; tap it to choose what happens then
            (Reading, any of your boxes, Sleep, Free, or clear it). Reading hours are drawn bigger so the plan is readable at a glance
          - "On Home": what Home will open right now
          - starting points (the same templates as before) and a link to the classic painter view, so nothing was taken away.
   The data is exactly what it was: DB.timetable.blocks = [{time,task}] and DB.timetable.mapping = {time: boxId}.
   The only new value is DB.timetable.readGoal (pages per day).
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(!/reading/i.test(BRAND.name) || typeof renderTimetable!=='function' || !window.TT || !window.LISTS) return;
    var E = esc, LS = window.LISTS, classic = false, shut = { night:true };
    var CH = [ { id:'am', name:'Morning', win:'5 AM to 11 AM', hrs:[5,6,7,8,9,10] }, { id:'mid', name:'Midday', win:'11 AM to 5 PM', hrs:[11,12,13,14,15,16] },
               { id:'eve', name:'Evening', win:'5 PM to 10 PM', hrs:[17,18,19,20,21] }, { id:'night', name:'Night', win:'10 PM to 5 AM', hrs:[22,23,0,1,2,3,4] } ];
    var SLOTS = [ ['Morning pages',7], ['Lunch read',12], ['After work',18], ['Before bed',21] ];
    var GOALS = [10,20,30,50];
    var baseTT = renderTimetable;

    function hh(h){ return (h<10?'0':'')+h+':00'; }
    function ensure(){ var all = TT.withAllHours(normalizeTimetableBlocks()); if(all.length!==DB.timetable.blocks.length){ DB.timetable.blocks = all; } if(!DB.timetable.mapping) DB.timetable.mapping = {}; return DB.timetable.blocks; }
    function blockAt(t){ var b = ensure().filter(function(x){ return x.time===t; })[0]; return b; }
    function boxes(){ try{ return bxFocusPages(); }catch(e){ return []; } }
    function readId(){ try{ return CORE_PAGES.some(function(p){ return p.id==='reading'; }) ? 'reading' : null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
    function kind(t){
      var b = blockAt(t) || { time:t, task:'' }, id = DB.timetable.mapping[t], task = String(b.task||'').trim(), low = task.toLowerCase();
      if(id) return { k:id==='reading' ? 'read' : 'box', id:id, label:id==='reading' ? 'Reading time' : (task || (typeof bxBoxName==='function' ? bxBoxName(id) : id)) };
      if(!task) return { k:'empty', label:'' };
      if(low==='sleep') return { k:'sleep', label:task };
      if(low==='free') return { k:'free', label:task };
      return { k:'named', label:task };
    }
    function setHour(t, what, id){
      var b = blockAt(t); if(!b) return; var m = DB.timetable.mapping;
      if(what==='box'){ if(id==='reading'){ try{ if(!boxes().some(function(x){ return x.id==='reading'; })) bxsAdd('reading', true); }catch(e){} }
        b.task = (typeof bxBoxName==='function' ? bxBoxName(id) : id); m[t] = id; }
      else { delete m[t]; b.task = what==='sleep' ? 'Sleep' : (what==='free' ? 'Free' : ''); }
      touchSetupPage('timetable'); saveDB(); var y = window.scrollY; render(); window.scrollTo({ top:y, behavior:'instant' });
    }
    function hue(id){ var x = 0; for(var i=0;i<id.length;i++) x = (x*31 + id.charCodeAt(i)) % 360; return x; }
    function iconFor(k, id){ if(k==='read') return 'book'; if(k==='sleep') return 'moon'; if(k==='free') return 'sun'; if(k==='named') return 'pen'; try{ var m = bxBoxMeta(id); if(m && m.icon && ICONS[m.icon]) return m.icon; }catch(e){} return 'grid'; }
    function readCount(){ return ensure().filter(function(b){ return DB.timetable.mapping[b.time]==='reading'; }).length; }
    function goal(){ var g = +DB.timetable.readGoal; return g>0 ? g : 20; }

    function row(h){
      var t = hh(h), k = kind(t), col = k.k==='box' ? 'style="--rh:'+hue(k.id)+'"' : '';
      return '<button type="button" class="rt-row '+k.k+'" data-rt="hour" data-t="'+t+'" '+col+'><span class="rt-t">'+TT.short(t)+'</span><span class="rt-rail"><i></i></span>'
        + '<span class="rt-c">'+(k.k==='empty' ? '<em>Free to plan</em>' : '<span class="rt-i">'+icon(iconFor(k.k, k.id), k.k==='read' ? 20 : 16)+'</span><b>'+E(k.label)+'</b>'+'')+'</span></button>';
    }
    function chapter(c){
      var n = c.hrs.filter(function(h){ return kind(hh(h)).k!=='empty'; }).length, open = !shut[c.id];
      return '<section class="rt-ch"><button type="button" class="rt-chh" data-rt="chap" data-c="'+c.id+'" aria-expanded="'+open+'"><span><b>'+c.name+'</b><small>'+c.win+'</small></span><span class="rt-n">'+n+' of '+c.hrs.length+'</span>'+icon(open?'chevleft':'chevright',15)+'</button>'
        + (open ? '<div class="rt-list">'+c.hrs.map(row).join('')+'</div>' : '')+'</section>';
    }
    function nowLine(){
      var h = new Date().getHours(), k = kind(hh(h));
      return '<div class="rt-now"><span>Now · '+TT.short(hh(h))+'</span><b>'+(k.k==='empty' ? 'nothing planned' : (k.k==='read' ? 'Reading Log opens' : E(k.label)))+'</b></div>';
    }
    function page(dateStr){
      if(classic){ baseTT(dateStr); var pb0 = document.querySelector('#app .page-body'); if(pb0) pb0.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<button type="button" class="rt-back" data-rt="modern">'+icon('chevleft',14)+' Back to your reading day</button>'); return; }
      ensure(); var rc = readCount(), planned = TT.filledCount(DB.timetable.blocks), g = goal(), rid = readId();
      var h = '<div class="rt-hero"><div class="rt-hl">Your reading day</div><div class="rt-hs">'+(rc ? 'You read at <b>'+rc+' hour'+(rc===1?'':'s')+'</b> a day. At those hours Home opens your Reading Log.' : 'Pick the hours you read. At those hours Home opens your Reading Log for you.')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="rt-stats"><div><b>'+rc+'</b><span>Reading hours</span></div><div><b>'+planned+'<small>/24</small></b><span>Hours planned</span></div><div><b>'+g+'</b><span>Pages a day</span></div></div>'
        + '<div class="rt-goal"><span>Daily page goal</span><div class="rt-gs">'+GOALS.map(function(x){ return '<button type="button" class="'+(g===x?'on':'')+'" data-rt="goal" data-v="'+x+'">'+x+'</button>'; }).join('')+'<button type="button" data-rt="gm" aria-label="Less">−</button><button type="button" data-rt="gp" aria-label="More">+</button></div></div></div>';
      if(rid) h += '<div class="rt-sec">Reading slots <small>tap to book or clear</small></div><div class="rt-slots">'+SLOTS.map(function(s){ var on = DB.timetable.mapping[hh(s[1])]==='reading'; return '<button type="button" class="rt-slot'+(on?' on':'')+'" data-rt="slot" data-t="'+hh(s[1])+'" aria-pressed="'+on+'"><b>'+s[0]+'</b><span>'+TT.short(hh(s[1]))+'</span></button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      h += nowLine();
      h += '<div class="rt-sec">Your day</div>'+CH.map(chapter).join('');
      if(typeof TIMETABLE_PRESETS!=='undefined' && TIMETABLE_PRESETS.length) h += '<div class="rt-sec">Starting points <small>replaces your plan</small></div><div class="rt-pre">'+TIMETABLE_PRESETS.map(function(p){ return '<button type="button" data-rt="preset" data-id="'+E(p.id)+'">'+icon('bolt',12)+' '+E(p.name)+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
      h += '<button type="button" class="rt-classic" data-rt="classic">Classic painter view and idle quotes</button>';
      app.innerHTML = renderTopbar('Timetable', true)+'<div class="page-body">'+h+'</div><div class="gap-block"></div>';
    }
    renderTimetable = page; if(PAGE_RENDERERS && PAGE_RENDERERS.timetable) PAGE_RENDERERS.timetable = page;

    function chooseSheet(t){
      var list = boxes(), labels = [], map = {};
      var rid = readId(); if(rid){ var rn = (typeof bxBoxName==='function' ? bxBoxName(rid) : 'Reading'); labels.push(rn); map[rn] = ['box', rid]; }
      list.forEach(function(b){ if(b.id==='reading') return; labels.push(b.name); map[b.name] = ['box', b.id]; });
      labels.push('Sleep'); map['Sleep'] = ['sleep']; labels.push('Free'); map['Free'] = ['free']; labels.push('Clear this hour'); map['Clear this hour'] = ['clear'];
      LS.openLS({ title:TT.short(t)+': what happens now?', instant:true, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:labels, sel:[], other:false }],
        done:function(st){ var c = map[st.v[0]]; if(c) setHour(t, c[0], c[1]); } });
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('[data-rt]'); if(!b) return; var a = b.getAttribute('data-rt'), t = b.getAttribute('data-t');
      e.stopPropagation();
      if(a==='hour') return chooseSheet(t);
      if(a==='slot'){ var cur = DB.timetable.mapping[t]; return cur==='reading' ? setHour(t,'clear') : setHour(t,'box','reading'); }
      if(a==='chap'){ var id = b.getAttribute('data-c'); shut[id] = !shut[id]; return render(); }
      if(a==='goal'){ DB.timetable.readGoal = +b.getAttribute('data-v'); touchSetupPage('timetable'); saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='gm' || a==='gp'){ var g = goal() + (a==='gp' ? 5 : -5); DB.timetable.readGoal = Math.max(5, Math.min(500, g)); touchSetupPage('timetable'); saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='preset'){ applyTimetablePreset(b.getAttribute('data-id')); touchSetupPage('timetable'); saveDB(); return render(); }
      if(a==='classic'){ classic = true; return render(); }
      if(a==='modern'){ classic = false; return render(); }
    }, true);

    var css = ''
      + '.rt-hero{background:linear-gradient(155deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;padding:18px 16px 14px;margin:0 0 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}'
      + '.rt-hl{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.02em;}.rt-hs{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45;margin:4px 0 14px;}.rt-hs b{color:var(--ink);}'
      + '.rt-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}.rt-stats div{background:var(--surface);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;}.rt-stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;}.rt-stats small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}.rt-stats span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.rt-goal{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}.rt-goal>span{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}.rt-gs{display:flex;gap:6px;}'
      + '.rt-gs button{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.rt-gs button.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}'
      + '.rt-sec{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:18px 2px 8px;}.rt-sec small{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;margin-left:6px;}'
      + '.rt-slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}.rt-slot{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;padding:12px 14px;min-height:62px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}.rt-slot b{font-size:14px;}.rt-slot span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;}.rt-slot.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);}.rt-slot.on span{color:inherit;opacity:.85;}'
      + '.rt-now{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;margin:14px 0 0;font-size:13px;}.rt-now span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;}.rt-now b{text-align:right;}'
      + '.rt-ch{margin:0 0 10px;}.rt-chh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:0 6px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;text-align:left;}.rt-chh span:first-child{flex:1;}.rt-chh b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:17px;}.rt-chh small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;}.rt-n{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.rt-list{padding:2px 0 4px;}.rt-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:10px;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;min-height:52px;}'
      + '.rt-t{flex:none;width:44px;padding-top:15px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);text-align:right;}'
      + '.rt-rail{flex:none;width:14px;display:flex;justify-content:center;position:relative;}.rt-rail:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--line);}.rt-rail i{position:relative;margin-top:19px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:2px solid var(--line);}'
      + '.rt-c{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:3px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;}.rt-c em{font-style:normal;}'
      + '.rt-i{flex:none;display:flex;}.rt-c b{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.rt-c small{margin-left:auto;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.85;}'
      + '.rt-row:not(.empty) .rt-c{border-style:solid;border-color:transparent;background:var(--surface-2);}'
      + '.rt-row.read .rt-c{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);padding:14px 14px;}.rt-row.read .rt-c b{color:inherit;font-size:15px;}.rt-row.read .rt-rail i{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);}'
      + '.rt-row.box .rt-c{background:hsl(var(--rh) 60% 92%);color:hsl(var(--rh) 40% 24%);}.rt-row.box .rt-c b{color:inherit;}.rt-row.box .rt-rail i{background:hsl(var(--rh) 52% 48%);border-color:hsl(var(--rh) 52% 48%);}'
      + '.rt-row.sleep .rt-rail i{background:hsl(228 30% 52%);border-color:hsl(228 30% 52%);}.rt-row.free .rt-rail i{background:hsl(150 12% 52%);border-color:hsl(150 12% 52%);}'
      + ':root[data-theme="dark"] .rt-row.box .rt-c{background:hsl(var(--rh) 28% 22%);color:hsl(var(--rh) 60% 86%);}'
      + '.rt-pre{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;}.rt-pre button{min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.rt-classic,.rt-back{display:block;width:100%;margin:18px 0 0;min-height:46px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;}.rt-back{margin:0 0 10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--accent);text-align:left;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'readtt-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
    window.READTT = { kind:kind, setHour:setHour };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('reading timetable', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   BOX IDEAS OF THE WEEK (all apps)

   "New box" now starts with a short list of ready-made, pretty niche boxes, four at a time, and the four change every Monday
   (cafe hopping, a Claude-run log with cycles and what was worked on, a no-spend day, a sourdough log, ...). Tap Add and the box is
   made WITH its fields already set up, so there is nothing to build. They are normal boxes after that (rename, change fields, delete).

   How the weekly change works: there is a built-in pool of 24 ideas and the week number picks which 4 show. It works offline and
   needs no account. New ideas reach the pool when the app itself is updated (the app cannot fetch anything by itself).
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof bxNewBoxSheet!=='function' || typeof bxDB!=='function') return;
    var E = esc;
    var N = function(l,u,s){ var f = { l:l, t:'number' }; if(u) f.u = u; if(s) f.s = s; return f; };
    var P = [
      { n:'Cafe hopping', i:'coffee', w:'Where you went, what you drank, would you go back', f:[['Cafe','short'],['Area','short'],['What I had','multi',['Pour-over','Latte','Cold brew','Matcha','Pastry']],['Rating','scale',5],['Would go back','toggle'],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Claude run log', i:'code', w:'How many cycles, what you worked on, and how it went', f:[['Cycles',N('Cycles','cycles')],['What I worked on','short'],['Kind of work','multi',['Code','Research','Writing','Data','Planning']],['Time spent','duration'],['How it went','choice',['Shipped','Partly done','Stuck']],['Next step','short']] },
      { n:'No-spend day', i:'shield', w:'Days you spent nothing, and the urges you skipped', f:[['No-spend day','toggle'],['Money saved','money'],['Urges skipped',N('Urges skipped','')],['What I did instead','short']] },
      { n:'Sourdough and baking', i:'sparkle', w:'Hydration, proof time, how the crumb turned out', f:[['What I baked','short'],['Hydration','percent'],['Proof time','duration'],['Crumb','scale',5],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Golden hour walk', i:'sun', w:'The evening walk: distance, mood, one photo', f:[['Distance',N('Distance','km')],['Time out','duration'],['How I felt','mood'],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Language streak', i:'pen', w:'Minutes, new words, did you speak out loud', f:[['Minutes','duration'],['New words',N('New words','words',5)],['Spoke out loud','toggle'],['Confidence','scale',5]] },
      { n:'Cold plunge and sauna', i:'drop', w:'Contrast therapy: time, temperature, how it felt', f:[['Cold time','duration'],['Water temp',N('Water temp','C')],['Sauna time','duration'],['Felt after','mood']] },
      { n:'Sketch a day', i:'pen', w:'One drawing a day: subject, minutes, a photo of it', f:[['Subject','short'],['Minutes','duration'],['Photo','photo'],['Happy with it','scale',5]] },
      { n:'Zone 2 cardio', i:'heart', w:'Easy-effort cardio: distance, heart rate, effort', f:[['Distance',N('Distance','km')],['Time','duration'],['Average heart rate',N('Average heart rate','bpm',5)],['Felt easy','scale',5]] },
      { n:'Street food crawl', i:'bag', w:'Where you ate, what it cost, was it worth it', f:[['Spot','short'],['What I ate','short'],['Cost','money'],['Worth it','scale',5],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Side project sprint', i:'star', w:'Hours put in, did you ship, what blocked you', f:[['Hours','duration'],['Shipped something','toggle'],['What I did','short'],['Blocker','short']] },
      { n:'Podcast and audiobook log', i:'music', w:'What you listened to and the one thing you kept', f:[['Title','short'],['Listened for','duration'],['One takeaway','long']] },
      { n:'Digital detox', i:'phone', w:'Screen-free hours and how many times you picked it up', f:[['Screen-free time','duration'],['Pickups',N('Pickups','times',5)],['Biggest pull','multi',['Social','Messages','News','Video','Games']],['Mood','mood']] },
      { n:'Plant care', i:'leaf', w:'Water, light and new growth for your plants', f:[['Watered','toggle'],['New leaf','toggle'],['Light','scale',5],['Notes','short']] },
      { n:'Thrift and vintage finds', i:'shirt', w:'What you found, what you paid, would you wear it', f:[['Find','short'],['Paid','money'],['Where','short'],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Film night', i:'camera', w:'What you watched, where, and how good it was', f:[['Title','short'],['Where','multi',['Cinema','Home','Friends','Streaming']],['Rating','scale',5],['One line','short']] },
      { n:'Concerts and gigs', i:'music', w:'Who played, where, the moment you will remember', f:[['Artist','short'],['Venue','short'],['Rating','scale',5],['Best moment','long']] },
      { n:'AI study session', i:'code', w:'Learn with an assistant: topic, time, can you explain it back', f:[['Topic','short'],['Minutes','duration'],['Explained it back','toggle'],['Confidence','scale',5]] },
      { n:'Home cooking', i:'coffee', w:'What you cooked, what it cost, leftovers', f:[['Dish','short'],['Cost','money'],['Leftovers','toggle'],['Photo','photo']] },
      { n:'Micro adventure', i:'leaf', w:'A small trip near home: where, how far, a photo', f:[['Where','short'],['Distance',N('Distance','km')],['Photo','photo'],['Felt','mood']] },
      { n:'Reading sprints', i:'star', w:'Timed reading rounds: rounds, pages, focus', f:[['Rounds',N('Rounds','rounds')],['Pages',N('Pages','pages',5)],['Focus','scale',5]] },
      { n:'Gratitude postcards', i:'heart', w:'Who you thanked and how', f:[['Who','short'],['How','choice',['Said it','Wrote it','Sent a gift']],['What for','long']] },
      { n:'Morning pages', i:'pen', w:'Three pages out of your head before the day starts', f:[['Done','toggle'],['Minutes','duration'],['Mood before','mood'],['Mood after','mood']] },
      { n:'Weekend reset', i:'sparkle', w:'A tidy-up list for the weekend, ticked off', f:[['Reset list','todo'],['Time spent','duration'],['Feels like','scale',5]] }
    ];
    function weekNo(){ var d = new Date(todayStr()+'T00:00:00'); return Math.floor((Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate())/86400000 + 3)/7); }
    function mondayLabel(){ var d = new Date(todayStr()+'T00:00:00'); var back = (d.getDay()+6)%7; d.setDate(d.getDate()-back); return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day:'numeric', month:'short' }); }
    function thisWeek(){ var n = P.length, s = (weekNo()*4) % n, out = []; for(var k=0;k<4;k++) out.push(P[(s+k)%n]); return out; }
    function fieldOf(d){
      var f = { id:bxNewId('f'), label:d[0], type:'number', icon:null, created:todayStr(), deleted:null };
      var x = d[1]; if(typeof x==='object'){ f.type = 'number'; f.label = x.l; if(x.u) f.unit = x.u; if(x.s) f.step = x.s; return f; }
      f.type = x; if(x==='scale') f.max = d[2]||5; if(x==='choice' || x==='multi') f.options = d[2]; return f;
    }
    /* makes a real custom box from an idea {n:name, i:icon, f:[fields]} and returns its id (also used by Canvas's lifestyle packs) */
    function make(d){
      var b = bxDB(), order = Math.max.apply(null, [1].concat(bxCustomBoxes().map(function(x){ return x.order||0; }))) + 1, id = bxNewId('cx_');
      b.boxes[id] = { id:id, custom:true, name:d.n, icon:d.i, from:todayStr(), until:null, order:order, fields:d.f.map(fieldOf), labels:{}, hidden:{} };
      saveDB(); return id;
    }
    window.bxAddIdea = function(i){
      var d = thisWeek()[i]; if(!d) return;
      var id = make(d); closeSheet(); nav('page', id); render(); flashSaved(d.n+' added');
    };
    var _sheet = bxNewBoxSheet;
    bxNewBoxSheet = function(){
      _sheet.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var form = document.querySelector('.bx-form'); if(!form) return;
        var h = '<div class="bi-wrap"><div class="bi-h"><b>Ideas this week</b><span>New picks every Monday · from '+E(mondayLabel())+'</span></div>'
          + thisWeek().map(function(d, i){ return '<div class="bi-card"><div class="bi-ic">'+icon(d.i,20)+'</div><div class="bi-tx"><b>'+E(d.n)+'</b><small>'+E(d.w)+'</small></div><button type="button" class="bi-add" onclick="bxAddIdea('+i+')" aria-label="Add '+E(d.n)+'">Add</button></div>'; }).join('')
          + '</div>';
        form.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', h);
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('box ideas', e); }
    };
    var css = '.bi-wrap{margin:0 0 4px;}.bi-h{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin:0 0 10px;}.bi-h b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:17px;}.bi-h span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}'
      + '.bi-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 10px 10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);margin:0 0 8px;}'
      + '.bi-ic{flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface-2));color:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}'
      + '.bi-tx{flex:1;min-width:0;}.bi-tx b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;}.bi-tx small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.35;margin-top:1px;}'
      + '.bi-add{flex:none;min-width:64px;min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;}'
      + '.bi-or{text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:14px 0 6px;}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'ideas-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
    window.BXIDEAS = { pool:P, thisWeek:thisWeek, weekNo:weekNo, make:make, N:N };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('ideas patch', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   INSIGHTS (Cycle 4): the "Wow, that helps" tab on the Tracker.
   Nothing new is saved. Everything is worked out on the spot from the
   days you already logged (DB.days), so old backups light up too.
   Cards: score ring, year of squares, best weekday, "what helps you",
   momentum, trends, personal bests, plus a few per-app specials.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  if(typeof renderTracker !== 'function' || typeof TRACKER_PERIOD === 'undefined') return;
  var E = function(s){ return (typeof esc === 'function') ? esc(s) : String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]; }); };
  var WD = ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'];
  var YEAR_SEL = null;

  /* ---- plain helpers ---- */
  function pad(n){ return (n<10?'0':'')+n; }
  function ds(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate()); }
  function addDays(d,n){ var x = new Date(d.getTime()); x.setDate(x.getDate()+n); return x; }
  function num(v){ var n = parseFloat(v); return isFinite(n) ? n : null; }
  function name(pid){ try{ return bxBoxName(pid); }catch(e){ return pid; } }
  function avg(a){ return a.length ? a.reduce(function(s,x){ return s+x; },0)/a.length : null; }
  function f1(n){ return (Math.round(n*10)/10).toString(); }
  function sum(a){ return a.reduce(function(s,x){ return s+x; },0); }

  /* ---- pull one tidy record per day, today back N days ---- */
  function gather(N){
    var out = [], today = new Date(); today.setHours(12,0,0,0);
    for(var i=N-1;i>=0;i--){
      var d = addDays(today,-i), k = ds(d), day = (DB.days||{})[k], r = { ds:k, date:d, wd:(d.getDay()+6)%7, logged:false, pages:{}, rating:null, wo:0, pg:0, steps:null, sleep:null, money:0, nb:0 };
      if(day && day.pages){
        var pgs = day.pages;
        for(var pid in pgs){ if(pgs[pid] && pgs[pid]._touched){ r.pages[pid] = 1; r.nb++; } }
        r.logged = r.nb > 0;
        if(pgs.dashboard){ r.rating = num(pgs.dashboard.rating); }
        if(pgs.workout && pgs.workout._touched){
          r.wo = num(pgs.workout.duration) || 0; r.steps = num(pgs.workout.steps); r.sleep = num(pgs.workout.sleep);
          var ex = pgs.workout.exercises; if(!r.wo && ex && ex.length && window.MOVE && MOVE.minutesOf){ try{ r.wo = MOVE.minutesOf(pgs.workout) || 0; }catch(e){} }
        }
        if(pgs.reading && pgs.reading._touched){ r.pg = num(pgs.reading.pagesToday) || 0; }
        try{ if(typeof laneValueForDay === 'function'){ r.money = laneValueForDay(k) || 0; } }catch(e){}
        // custom number fields on custom boxes
        r.cf = {};
        for(var p2 in pgs){ var pp = pgs[p2]; if(!pp) continue; for(var key in pp){ if(key.indexOf('cf_')===0){ var nv = num(pp[key]); if(nv!==null && String(pp[key]).trim()!=='' && !/\n/.test(String(pp[key]))) r.cf[p2+'|'+key] = nv; } } }
      }
      out.push(r);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* ---- small SVG pieces ---- */
  function ring(pct, label, sub){
    var R = 46, C = 2*Math.PI*R, off = C*(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pct)));
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" class="in-ring" role="img" aria-label="'+E(label)+'">'
      + '<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="'+R+'" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="10"/>'
      + '<circle cx="60" cy="60" r="'+R+'" fill="none" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="'+C.toFixed(1)+'" stroke-dashoffset="'+off.toFixed(1)+'" transform="rotate(-90 60 60)"/>'
      + '<text x="60" y="58" text-anchor="middle" class="in-ring-n">'+E(label)+'</text>'
      + '<text x="60" y="76" text-anchor="middle" class="in-ring-s">'+E(sub)+'</text></svg>';
  }
  function spark(vals, color){
    var v = vals.filter(function(x){ return x!==null; }); if(v.length < 2) return '';
    var W = 120, H = 34, mn = Math.min.apply(null,v), mx = Math.max.apply(null,v), rg = (mx-mn) || 1, n = vals.length, pts = [], last = null;
    vals.forEach(function(x,i){ if(x===null) return; var X = (i/(n-1))*W, Y = H-3-((x-mn)/rg)*(H-8); pts.push(X.toFixed(1)+','+Y.toFixed(1)); last = [X,Y]; });
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" class="in-spark" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="'+pts.join(' ')+'" fill="none" stroke="'+color+'" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg>';
  }
  function bars(items, max, color){
    return '<div class="in-bars">'+items.map(function(it){
      var h = max ? Math.max(it.v>0?4:0, Math.round(it.v/max*100)) : 0;
      return '<div class="in-bar'+(it.hi?' hi':'')+'"><div class="in-bar-v">'+E(it.t||'')+'</div><div class="in-bar-col"><i style="height:'+h+'%;'+(color?'background:'+color:'')+'"></i></div><div class="in-bar-l">'+E(it.l)+'</div></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
  }

  /* ---- the cards ---- */
  function cardHero(all){
    var last = all.slice(-30), prev = all.slice(-60,-30);
    var a = last.filter(function(r){ return r.logged; }).length, b = prev.filter(function(r){ return r.logged; }).length;
    var pct = a/30, delta = a-b;
    var streak = 0, best = 0, cur = 0;
    all.forEach(function(r){ if(r.logged){ cur++; if(cur>best) best = cur; } else cur = 0; });
    for(var i=all.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(all[i].logged) streak++; else if(i===all.length-1) continue; else break; }
    var lvl = pct>=.85 ? 'Locked in' : pct>=.6 ? 'On a roll' : pct>=.35 ? 'Building' : 'Warming up';
    var chip = function(v,l){ return '<div class="in-chip"><b>'+v+'</b><span>'+E(l)+'</span></div>'; };
    return '<div class="in-card in-hero"><div class="in-hero-l">'+ring(pct, a+'/30', 'days logged')+'</div><div class="in-hero-r">'
      + '<div class="in-kicker">Last 30 days</div><div class="in-big">'+E(lvl)+'</div>'
      + '<div class="in-delta '+(delta>0?'up':delta<0?'dn':'')+'">'+(delta>0?'▲ +':delta<0?'▼ ':'● ')+delta+' vs the 30 days before</div>'
      + '<div class="in-chips">'+chip(streak,'day streak')+chip(best,'best run')+chip(all.filter(function(r){ return r.logged; }).length,'this half-year')+'</div></div></div>';
  }
  function cardYear(all){
    var W = 26, cell = 12, gap = 3, step = cell+gap, today = all[all.length-1];
    // start on the Monday W-1 weeks back
    var start = addDays(today.date, -((today.wd) + (W-1)*7)), map = {};
    all.forEach(function(r){ map[r.ds] = r; });
    var mx = 1; all.forEach(function(r){ if(r.nb>mx) mx = r.nb; });
    var svg = '', mlab = '', lastM = -1;
    for(var w=0; w<W; w++){
      for(var d=0; d<7; d++){
        var dt = addDays(start, w*7+d); if(dt > today.date) continue;
        var k = ds(dt), r = map[k], lvl = !r || !r.logged ? 0 : Math.min(4, 1+Math.floor((r.nb/mx)*3.99));
        var sel = (YEAR_SEL===k) ? ' sel' : '';
        svg += '<rect class="in-sq l'+lvl+sel+'" data-in="day" data-ds="'+k+'" x="'+(w*step)+'" y="'+(d*step+14)+'" width="'+cell+'" height="'+cell+'" rx="3"/>';
        if(d===0 && dt.getMonth()!==lastM){ lastM = dt.getMonth(); mlab += '<text x="'+(w*step)+'" y="9" class="in-mlab">'+['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][lastM]+'</text>'; }
      }
    }
    var info = '<div class="in-pick">Tap a square to see that day.</div>';
    if(YEAR_SEL && map[YEAR_SEL]){
      var r2 = map[YEAR_SEL], names = Object.keys(r2.pages).map(name);
      info = '<div class="in-pick"><b>'+E(YEAR_SEL)+'</b> · '+(r2.logged ? E(names.slice(0,5).join(', ')+(names.length>5?' +'+(names.length-5):'')) : 'nothing logged')+(r2.rating!==null?' · rating '+r2.rating:'')+'</div>';
    }
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Your half-year in squares</div><div class="in-sub">Darker = more boxes filled that day</div>'
      + '<div class="in-scroll"><svg viewBox="0 0 '+(W*step)+' '+(7*step+14)+'" class="in-heat">'+mlab+svg+'</svg></div>'+info+'</div>';
  }
  function cardWeekday(all){
    var cnt = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0], tot = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0];
    all.forEach(function(r){ tot[r.wd]++; if(r.logged) cnt[r.wd]++; });
    var rate = cnt.map(function(c,i){ return tot[i] ? c/tot[i] : 0; }), best = rate.indexOf(Math.max.apply(null,rate)), worst = rate.indexOf(Math.min.apply(null,rate));
    var items = WD.map(function(l,i){ return { l:l, v:rate[i]*100, t:Math.round(rate[i]*100)+'%', hi:i===best }; });
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Your best day of the week</div><div class="in-sub">How often you show up, by weekday</div>'
      + bars(items,100) + '<div class="in-note"><b>'+WD[best]+'</b> is your strongest day. '+(rate[worst] < rate[best]-.15 ? '<b>'+WD[worst]+'</b> is where it slips. Plan something small for it.' : 'You are steady all week.')+'</div></div>';
  }
  function cardHelps(all){
    var rated = all.filter(function(r){ return r.rating!==null && r.logged; });
    if(rated.length < 8){
      return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">What helps you</div><div class="in-sub">Which habits go with your better days</div><div class="in-lock"><div class="in-lockbar"><i style="width:'+Math.round(rated.length/8*100)+'%"></i></div><div class="in-note">Rate '+(8-rated.length)+' more day'+(8-rated.length===1?'':'s')+' on the Dashboard to unlock this. It compares your good and bad days.</div></div></div>';
    }
    var rows = [], base = avg(rated.map(function(r){ return r.rating; }));
    function test(label, fn){
      var w = rated.filter(fn), n = rated.filter(function(r){ return !fn(r); });
      if(w.length < 3 || n.length < 3) return;
      var diff = avg(w.map(function(r){ return r.rating; })) - avg(n.map(function(r){ return r.rating; }));
      rows.push({ label:label, diff:diff, w:w.length });
    }
    var pids = {}; rated.forEach(function(r){ for(var p in r.pages) pids[p] = 1; });
    Object.keys(pids).forEach(function(p){ if(p==='dashboard'||p==='setup'||p==='library'||p==='streak') return; test(name(p), function(r){ return !!r.pages[p]; }); });
    test('7h+ sleep', function(r){ return r.sleep!==null && r.sleep>=7; });
    test('Moving 20+ min', function(r){ return r.wo>=20; });
    rows.sort(function(a,b){ return Math.abs(b.diff)-Math.abs(a.diff); });
    rows = rows.filter(function(r){ return Math.abs(r.diff) >= .3; }).slice(0,5);
    if(!rows.length) return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">What helps you</div><div class="in-note">Nothing stands out yet. Keep logging and a pattern will show.</div></div>';
    var mxd = Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(function(r){ return Math.abs(r.diff); }));
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">What helps you</div><div class="in-sub">Your rating on days you did it vs days you did not · average '+f1(base)+'</div>'
      + rows.map(function(r){
          var up = r.diff>0, w = Math.round(Math.abs(r.diff)/mxd*100);
          return '<div class="in-help"><div class="in-help-t"><span>'+E(r.label)+'</span><b class="'+(up?'up':'dn')+'">'+(up?'+':'')+f1(r.diff)+'</b></div><div class="in-help-bar"><i class="'+(up?'up':'dn')+'" style="width:'+w+'%"></i></div></div>';
        }).join('') + '<div class="in-note">Patterns, not proof. But they are your own numbers.</div></div>';
  }
  function cardMomentum(all){
    var weeks = [], i;
    for(i=11;i>=0;i--){ var sl = all.slice(Math.max(0,all.length-(i+1)*7), all.length-i*7); weeks.push({ n: sl.filter(function(r){ return r.logged; }).length, l: i===0?'now':'-'+i+'w' }); }
    var items = weeks.map(function(w,j){ return { l:(j%3===2||j===11)?w.l:'', v:w.n, t:w.n||'', hi:j===11 }; });
    var a = avg(weeks.slice(-4).map(function(w){ return w.n; })), b = avg(weeks.slice(-8,-4).map(function(w){ return w.n; }));
    var msg = a>b+.5 ? 'You are climbing: '+f1(a)+' days a week lately, up from '+f1(b)+'.' : a<b-.5 ? 'A dip: '+f1(a)+' days a week, down from '+f1(b)+'. Shrink the goal, keep the chain.' : 'Holding steady at about '+f1(a)+' days a week.';
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Momentum</div><div class="in-sub">Days logged per week, last 12 weeks</div>'+bars(items,7)+'<div class="in-note">'+msg+'</div></div>';
  }
  function trendRow(label, vals, unit, color, fmt){
    var v = vals.filter(function(x){ return x!==null; }); if(v.length < 3) return '';
    var half = Math.floor(vals.length/2), A = avg(vals.slice(half).filter(function(x){ return x!==null; })), B = avg(vals.slice(0,half).filter(function(x){ return x!==null; }));
    var arrow = (A!==null && B!==null) ? (A>B*1.03 ? '↑' : A<B*.97 ? '↓' : '→') : '';
    return '<div class="in-trend"><div class="in-trend-l"><div class="in-trend-t">'+E(label)+'</div><div class="in-trend-v">'+(fmt?fmt(avg(v)):f1(avg(v)))+'<small> '+E(unit)+' avg</small> <em>'+arrow+'</em></div></div>'+spark(vals,color)+'</div>';
  }
  function cardTrends(all){
    var last = all.slice(-30), rows = '';
    rows += trendRow('Day rating', last.map(function(r){ return r.rating; }), '/10', 'var(--accent)');
    rows += trendRow('Movement', last.map(function(r){ return r.wo>0 ? r.wo : null; }), 'min', 'var(--ch2)', function(x){ return Math.round(x); });
    rows += trendRow('Pages read', last.map(function(r){ return r.pg>0 ? r.pg : null; }), 'pages', 'var(--ch3)', function(x){ return Math.round(x); });
    rows += trendRow('Steps', last.map(function(r){ return r.steps; }), '', 'var(--ch4)', function(x){ return Math.round(x).toLocaleString(); });
    rows += trendRow('Sleep', last.map(function(r){ return r.sleep; }), 'h', 'var(--ch5)');
    rows += trendRow('Money', last.map(function(r){ return r.money ? r.money : null; }), '', 'var(--green)', function(x){ return Math.round(x).toLocaleString(); });
    // custom number fields: up to 3 that have enough data
    var keys = {}; last.forEach(function(r){ for(var k in (r.cf||{})) keys[k] = (keys[k]||0)+1; });
    Object.keys(keys).filter(function(k){ return keys[k]>=3; }).slice(0,3).forEach(function(k){
      var pid = k.split('|')[0], fid = k.split('|')[1].slice(3), label = fid;
      try{ var bx = bxCustomBoxes().filter(function(b){ return b.id===pid; })[0]; if(bx){ var fl = (bx.fields||[]).filter(function(f){ return f.id===fid; })[0]; if(fl) label = bx.name+': '+fl.label; } }catch(e){}
      rows += trendRow(label, last.map(function(r){ return (r.cf&&r.cf[k]!==undefined) ? r.cf[k] : null; }), '', 'var(--ch6)');
    });
    if(!rows) return '';
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Trends</div><div class="in-sub">Last 30 days · arrow compares the second half with the first</div>'+rows+'</div>';
  }
  function cardBests(all){
    var items = [], mx;
    function pick(label, key, unit, fmt){
      var best = null; all.forEach(function(r){ var v = r[key]; if(v!==null && v>0 && (!best || v>best.v)) best = { v:v, ds:r.ds }; });
      if(best) items.push({ l:label, v:(fmt?fmt(best.v):best.v)+unit, d:best.ds });
    }
    pick('Longest movement','wo',' min'); pick('Most pages','pg',' pages'); pick('Most steps','steps','',function(x){ return Math.round(x).toLocaleString(); });
    var br = null; all.forEach(function(r){ if(r.rating!==null && (!br || r.rating>br.v)) br = { v:r.rating, ds:r.ds }; }); if(br) items.push({ l:'Best day', v:br.v+'/10', d:br.ds });
    var fb = null; all.forEach(function(r){ if(r.nb>0 && (!fb || r.nb>fb.v)) fb = { v:r.nb, ds:r.ds }; }); if(fb) items.push({ l:'Fullest day', v:fb.v+' boxes', d:fb.ds });
    if(!items.length) return '';
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Personal bests</div><div class="in-bests">'+items.map(function(i){ return '<div class="in-best"><b>'+E(i.v)+'</b><span>'+E(i.l)+'</span><small>'+E(i.d)+'</small></div>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
  }
  function cardSpecials(all){
    var out = '';
    // Books finished (apps with a library)
    try{
      var bk = DB.library && DB.library.books ? Object.keys(DB.library.books).map(function(k){ return DB.library.books[k]; }) : [];
      var fin = bk.filter(function(b){ return b.shelf==='finished'; });
      if(fin.length){
        var rated = fin.filter(function(b){ return b.rating; });
        out += '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Your shelf</div><div class="in-bests"><div class="in-best"><b>'+fin.length+'</b><span>books finished</span></div>'+(rated.length?'<div class="in-best"><b>'+f1(avg(rated.map(function(b){ return +b.rating; })))+'</b><span>avg stars</span></div>':'')+'<div class="in-best"><b>'+sum(all.map(function(r){ return r.pg; })).toLocaleString()+'</b><span>pages, half-year</span></div></div></div>';
      }
    }catch(e){}
    // Money by month (Hustler / Canvas style lanes)
    var money = {}, any = false;
    all.forEach(function(r){ if(r.money){ var m = r.ds.slice(0,7); money[m] = (money[m]||0)+r.money; any = true; } });
    if(any){
      var ms = Object.keys(money).sort().slice(-6), mx = Math.max.apply(null, ms.map(function(m){ return Math.abs(money[m]); })) || 1;
      out += '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Money by month</div><div class="in-sub">Net of what you logged</div>'
        + bars(ms.map(function(m,i){ return { l:m.slice(5), v:Math.abs(money[m]), t:Math.round(money[m]).toLocaleString(), hi:i===ms.length-1 }; }), mx, 'var(--green)')+'</div>';
    }
    // Sober days
    try{
      if(window.SOBER && SOBER.streak){
        var s = SOBER.streak(), n = (typeof s==='object' && s) ? (s.days!==undefined ? s.days : s.current) : s, b = SOBER.best ? SOBER.best() : null;
        if(typeof n==='number' && n>=0){
          out += '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Clean streak</div><div class="in-bests"><div class="in-best"><b>'+n+'</b><span>days now</span></div>'+((typeof b==='number')?'<div class="in-best"><b>'+b+'</b><span>best ever</span></div>':'')+'</div></div>';
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return out;
  }

  var CSS = '.in-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin:12px 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm,none)}'
    + '.in-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}.in-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 12px}'
    + '.in-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:12px;line-height:1.45}.in-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}'
    + '.in-hero{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface))}.in-hero-l{flex:0 0 112px}.in-hero-r{flex:1;min-width:0}'
    + '.in-ring{width:112px;height:112px;display:block}.in-ring-n{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;fill:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display)}.in-ring-s{font-size:9.5px;fill:var(--muted)}'
    + '.in-big{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.1;margin:2px 0 4px}.in-delta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}.in-delta.up{color:var(--green)}.in-delta.dn{color:var(--red)}'
    + '.in-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.in-chip{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:64px}.in-chip b{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display)}.in-chip span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted)}'
    + '.in-scroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding-bottom:4px}.in-heat{display:block;height:auto;width:100%}.in-mlab{font-size:9px;fill:var(--muted)}'
    + '.in-sq{fill:var(--line);cursor:pointer}.in-sq.l1{fill:var(--accent);opacity:.3}.in-sq.l2{fill:var(--accent);opacity:.55}.in-sq.l3{fill:var(--accent);opacity:.8}.in-sq.l4{fill:var(--accent)}.in-sq.sel{stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:2}'
    + '.in-pick{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px;min-height:18px}'
    + '.in-bars{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-end;height:132px}.in-bar{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;height:100%;min-width:0}.in-bar-col{flex:1;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.in-bar-col i{display:block;width:100%;background:var(--accent);opacity:.45;border-radius:8px;transition:height .5s}.in-bar.hi .in-bar-col i{opacity:1}.in-bar-v{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);height:14px}.in-bar-l{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);height:16px;margin-top:4px;white-space:nowrap}'
    + '.in-help{margin:10px 0}.in-help-t{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink)}.in-help-t b.up{color:var(--green)}.in-help-t b.dn{color:var(--red)}.in-help-bar{height:8px;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:6px;margin-top:5px;overflow:hidden}.in-help-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px}.in-help-bar i.up{background:var(--green)}.in-help-bar i.dn{background:var(--red)}'
    + '.in-lockbar{height:10px;background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.in-lockbar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:6px}'
    + '.in-trend{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.in-trend:first-of-type{border-top:0}.in-trend-t{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.in-trend-v{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display)}.in-trend-v small{font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}.in-trend-v em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}.in-spark{width:42%;height:34px;flex:0 0 42%}'
    + '.in-bests{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(104px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:10px}.in-best{background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.in-best b{font-size:18px;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display)}.in-best span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}.in-best small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}'
    + '.in-empty{text-align:center;padding:28px 16px}.in-empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}.in-empty span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft)}';

  function renderInsights(){
    var all = gather(182), logged = all.filter(function(r){ return r.logged; }).length;
    if(logged < 3){
      return '<div class="in-card in-empty"><b>Your insights will appear here</b><span>Log 3 days and this page turns into charts: your streak, your best weekday, and what lifts your days.</span></div>';
    }
    return cardHero(all) + cardYear(all) + cardHelps(all) + cardWeekday(all) + cardMomentum(all) + cardTrends(all) + cardBests(all) + cardSpecials(all);
  }

  /* ---- plug into the Tracker: a new first tab, and it is the default ---- */
  TRACKER_PERIOD = 'insights';
  var baseRT = renderTracker;
  renderTracker = function(){
    if(TRACKER_PERIOD !== 'insights'){
      baseRT();
      var bar = document.querySelector('.tracker-tabs');
      if(bar && !bar.querySelector('[data-in="tab"]')){
        bar.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', '<button class="tracker-tab" data-in="tab" onclick="setTrackerPeriod(\'insights\')">Insights</button>');
      }
      return;
    }
    var tabs = [['insights','Insights'],['month','Month'],['year','Year']].map(function(t){
      return '<button class="tracker-tab '+(TRACKER_PERIOD===t[0]?'active':'')+'" data-in="tab" onclick="setTrackerPeriod(\''+t[0]+'\')">'+t[1]+'</button>';
    }).join('');
    app.innerHTML = renderTopbar('Tracker', false) + '<div class="tracker-tabs">'+tabs+'</div><div class="in-wrap">'+renderInsights()+'</div><div class="gap-block"></div>' + renderBottomNav('tracker');
  };
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var el = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-in="day"]') : null;
    if(!el) return;
    YEAR_SEL = el.getAttribute('data-ds'); render();
  });
  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);
  window.INSIGHTS = { render: renderInsights, gather: gather };
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   FINISH REWARD  (Bot A, task 4)
   -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The moment a box turns "done" for the day, a short celebration plays over the screen:
     a ring draws itself, a check pops in, a burst of dots flies out in your accent colour, and a line
     says which box you finished and how today is going. Finishing every box of the day gets a bigger
     burst and your streak.

   Rules it follows (so it never gets annoying or breaks anything):
   - It plays only when a box goes from "not done" to "done" -- once per box per day. Not on opening the app,
     not on redraws, not when importing a backup, not while Test mode fills random data.
   - It is drawn on its own layer ABOVE the app, so nothing on the page moves or jumps.
   - It never blocks taps (the layer ignores touches) and removes itself when finished (about 1.2 seconds).
   - If the phone is set to "reduce motion" it shows a simple fade instead of movement.
   - Visual only: no sound, no vibration.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    var muted = 0, layer = null, timer = null, lastKey = '', lastAt = 0;
    var reduce = function(){ try{ return window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; }catch(e){ return false; } };
    function cssVar(n, fb){ try{ var v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim(); return v || fb; }catch(e){ return fb; } }
    function nameOf(pid){
      try{ if(typeof bxBoxName==='function'){ var n = bxBoxName(pid); if(n) return n; } }catch(e){}
      try{ var c = CORE_PAGES.filter(function(p){ return p.id===pid; })[0]; if(c) return c.title || c.label || c.name || pid; }catch(e){}
      try{ var sp = SETUP_PAGES.filter(function(p){ return p.id===pid; })[0]; if(sp && sp.name) return sp.name; }catch(e){}   /* monthly pages: use their real title, not the internal id */
      return pid;
    }
    function clear(){ if(timer){ clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; } if(layer && layer.parentNode) layer.parentNode.removeChild(layer); layer = null; }

    /* how is the day going?  -> { done, total, all } */
    function dayState(ds){
      try{
        var list = (typeof ACTIVE_BOXES==='function' ? ACTIVE_BOXES(ds) : pagesList(ds)) || [];
        var total = list.length, done = 0;
        list.forEach(function(p){ if(pageIsDone(ds, p.id)) done++; });
        return { done:done, total:total, all: total>0 && done>=total };
      }catch(e){ return { done:0, total:0, all:false }; }
    }

    /* kind: 'box' | 'day'.  Draws the whole thing on a fixed layer. */
    function play(kind, label, line){
      clear();
      var accent = cssVar('--accent', '#E4572E'), green = cssVar('--green', '#2E9E6B'), ink = cssVar('--ink', '#222'), surface = cssVar('--surface', '#fff');
      var big = kind==='day', R = big ? 44 : 36, C = 2*Math.PI*R, S = (R+10)*2;
      layer = document.createElement('div'); layer.id = 'rw-layer'; layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      layer.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:2147483000;pointer-events:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;';
      var card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:22px 26px 18px;border-radius:28px;background:'+surface+';box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.22);max-width:78vw;text-align:center;transform:translateZ(0);will-change:transform,opacity;';
      card.innerHTML =
        '<svg width="'+S+'" height="'+S+'" viewBox="0 0 '+S+' '+S+'" style="display:block;overflow:visible">'
        + '<circle cx="'+S/2+'" cy="'+S/2+'" r="'+R+'" fill="none" stroke="'+accent+'" stroke-opacity=".16" stroke-width="8"/>'
        + '<circle class="rw-ring" cx="'+S/2+'" cy="'+S/2+'" r="'+R+'" fill="none" stroke="'+(big?green:accent)+'" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(-90 '+S/2+' '+S/2+')" stroke-dasharray="'+C+'" stroke-dashoffset="'+C+'"/>'
        + '<path class="rw-check" d="M'+(S/2-R*.38)+' '+(S/2+R*.02)+' L'+(S/2-R*.08)+' '+(S/2+R*.3)+' L'+(S/2+R*.42)+' '+(S/2-R*.28)+'" fill="none" stroke="'+(big?green:accent)+'" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-dasharray="60" stroke-dashoffset="60"/>'
        + '</svg>'
        + '<div style="font-family:var(--font-display,inherit);font-size:'+(big?22:19)+'px;font-weight:800;color:'+ink+';letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.15;"></div>'
        + '<div style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:'+cssVar('--muted','#777')+';"></div>';
      var texts = card.querySelectorAll('div'); texts[0].textContent = label; texts[1].textContent = line || '';
      if(!line) texts[1].style.display = 'none';
      layer.appendChild(card); document.body.appendChild(layer);

      if(reduce() || !card.animate){
        card.querySelector('.rw-ring').setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset','0'); card.querySelector('.rw-check').setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset','0');
        if(card.animate) card.animate([{opacity:0},{opacity:1,offset:.2},{opacity:1,offset:.75},{opacity:0}], {duration:900, easing:'ease-out'});
        timer = setTimeout(clear, 950); return;
      }
      var E = 'cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)', P = 'cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)';
      card.animate([{ transform:'translateZ(0) scale(.7)', opacity:0 }, { transform:'translateZ(0) scale(1)', opacity:1 }], { duration:300, easing:P, fill:'both' });
      card.querySelector('.rw-ring').animate([{ strokeDashoffset:C }, { strokeDashoffset:0 }], { duration:520, delay:60, easing:E, fill:'forwards' });
      card.querySelector('.rw-check').animate([{ strokeDashoffset:60 }, { strokeDashoffset:0 }], { duration:300, delay:420, easing:E, fill:'forwards' });
      card.querySelector('svg').animate([{ transform:'scale(1)' }, { transform:'scale(1.14)', offset:.6 }, { transform:'scale(1)' }], { duration:260, delay:700, easing:'ease-out' });
      /* the burst: dots and short rays flying outward from the middle of the ring */
      var box = card.querySelector('svg').getBoundingClientRect(), cx = box.left + box.width/2, cy = box.top + box.height/2;
      var n = big ? 26 : 16, colors = [accent, green, '#F5B700', accent, ink], i;
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
        var a = (Math.PI*2*i/n) + (Math.random()*.4-.2), dist = (big ? 120 : 84) + Math.random()*(big ? 90 : 50), sz = 5 + Math.random()*(big?6:4);
        var d = document.createElement('i'), ray = i%3===0;
        d.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:'+(cx-sz/2)+'px;top:'+(cy-sz/2)+'px;width:'+(ray?sz*.55:sz)+'px;height:'+(ray?sz*2.2:sz)+'px;border-radius:'+(ray?'3px':'50%')+';background:'+colors[i%colors.length]+';opacity:0;will-change:transform,opacity;';
        layer.appendChild(d);
        var dx = Math.cos(a)*dist, dy = Math.sin(a)*dist + (big ? 36 : 14), rot = ray ? (a*180/Math.PI+90) : 0;
        d.animate([{ transform:'translate(0,0) rotate('+rot+'deg) scale(.4)', opacity:0 },
                   { transform:'translate('+dx*.7+'px,'+dy*.7+'px) rotate('+rot+'deg) scale(1)', opacity:1, offset:.35 },
                   { transform:'translate('+dx+'px,'+(dy+30)+'px) rotate('+(rot+(big?200:0))+'deg) scale(.5)', opacity:0 }],
                  { duration:760 + Math.random()*280, delay:430 + Math.random()*90, easing:'cubic-bezier(.15,.7,.3,1)', fill:'both' });
      }
      card.animate([{ opacity:1, transform:'translateZ(0) scale(1)' }, { opacity:0, transform:'translateZ(0) translateY(-12px) scale(.96)' }], { duration:280, delay:big?1500:1100, easing:'ease-in', fill:'forwards' });
      timer = setTimeout(clear, big ? 1850 : 1450);
    }

    /* the one entry point: the app's other code never calls play() directly */
    function celebrate(ds, pid){
      if(muted>0) return; if(typeof DB==='undefined' || !DB.onboarded) return;
      var key = ds+'|'+pid, now = Date.now(); if(key===lastKey && now-lastAt<600) return; lastKey = key; lastAt = now;   /* only stops a double-tap */
      var st = dayState(ds), isToday = (ds===todayStr()), name = nameOf(pid);
      if(isToday && st.all && st.total>1){
        var s = DB.streak || 0;
        play('day', 'Day complete', s>1 ? s+'-day streak — keep it going' : 'All '+st.total+' boxes done');
      } else {
        play('box', name+' done', isToday && st.total>1 ? st.done+' of '+st.total+' done today' : (isToday ? '' : 'Saved'));
      }
    }

    /* ---- the Finish button: the ONLY thing that plays the box animation ----
       A box still turns "done" by itself as soon as you log something (nothing about your data or streak changed),
       but it no longer plays anything on its own. Tapping Finish on a box marks it done (if it was not yet), remembers that you
       finished it, and plays the animation. Tap it again any time to see it again. */
    function finished(ds, pid){ return !!(DB.finished && DB.finished[ds] && DB.finished[ds][pid]); }
    window.finishBox = function(ds, pid){
      try{
        if(!DB.finished || typeof DB.finished!=='object') DB.finished = {};
        if(!DB.finished[ds]) DB.finished[ds] = {};
        DB.finished[ds][pid] = Date.now();
        if(!pageIsDone(ds, pid)) markTouched(ds, pid);   /* the app's own function: also keeps the streak right */
        saveDB(); render();
        celebrate(ds, pid);
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('finish', e); }
    };
    function finBar(ds, pid, sticky){
      var on = finished(ds, pid), nm = nameOf(pid);
      return '<div class="fin-bar'+(sticky?' sticky':'')+'"><button type="button" class="fin-btn'+(on?' on':'')+'" onclick="finishBox(\''+ds+'\',\''+pid+'\')" aria-label="'+(on?'Finished. Tap to play the animation again':'Finish '+esc(nm))+'">'
        + icon('check',18)+'<span>'+(on?'Finished':'Finish '+esc(nm))+'</span></button></div>';
    }
    var finCss = '.fin-bar{margin:18px 0 6px;}.fin-bar.sticky{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:5;margin:10px -4px 0;padding:22px 4px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--bg,#fff) 68%,transparent);}'
      + '.fin-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;width:100%;min-height:54px;border:none;border-radius:18px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .12s var(--ease),background .2s;}'
      + '.fin-btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}.fin-btn svg{stroke:currentColor;flex:none;}.fin-btn span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0;}'
      + '.fin-btn.on{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none;border:2px solid var(--accent);}.fin-btn.on svg{stroke:var(--accent);}';
    finCss += 'html:has(.fin-bar.sticky){scroll-padding-bottom:104px;}';   /* when the browser scrolls a tapped box into view, keep it clear of the Finish bar */
    var finSt = document.createElement('style'); finSt.id = 'finish-extra'; finSt.textContent = finCss; document.head.appendChild(finSt);
    function isBox(id, ds){ try{ return (typeof ACTIVE_BOXES==='function' ? ACTIVE_BOXES(ds) : pagesList(ds)).some(function(p){ return p.id===id; }); }catch(e){ return false; } }
    /* one Finish button at the end of every daily box page */
    var baseRender = render;
    render = function(){
      var r = baseRender.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var fid = typeof ROUTE==='undefined' ? null : (ROUTE.view==='page' ? ROUTE.pageId : (ROUTE.view==='lanelog' && DB.lane ? 'lane' : null));   /* the business-lane log is the "lane" box too */
        if(fid && isBox(fid, ROUTE.date) && !(typeof BX_EDIT!=='undefined' && BX_EDIT===fid)){
          var pb = document.querySelector('#app .page-body');
          if(pb && !pb.querySelector('.fin-bar')) pb.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', finBar(ROUTE.date, fid, true));
        }
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('finish bar', e); }
      return r;
    };
    /* and under the box shown on Home */
    if(typeof bxFocusBody === 'function'){
      var baseFocus = bxFocusBody;
      bxFocusBody = function(id, ds, html){ var h = baseFocus.apply(this, arguments); try{ if(isBox(id, ds)) h += finBar(ds, id, false); }catch(e){} return h; };
    }
    /* ---- hook: the monthly pages (locking one in is the "I'm done" moment) ---- */
    if(typeof lockMonthlyPageNow === 'function'){
      var baseLock = lockMonthlyPageNow;
      lockMonthlyPageNow = function(pageId, monthKey){
        var r = baseLock.apply(this, arguments);
        try{ if(typeof DB!=='undefined' && DB.onboarded && !muted) play('box', nameOf(pageId)+' saved', ''); }catch(e){}
        return r;
      };
    }
    /* ---- stay quiet while Test mode fills a year of random data ---- */
    if(typeof randomFillMonth === 'function'){
      var baseFill = randomFillMonth;
      randomFillMonth = function(){ muted++; try{ return baseFill.apply(this, arguments); } finally { muted--; } };
    }
    /* ---- never leave a layer behind when the page is hidden or navigated ---- */
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ if(document.hidden) clear(); });

    window.REWARD = { play:function(kind){ var st = dayState(todayStr()); play(kind==='day'?'day':'box', kind==='day' ? 'Day complete' : 'Box done', kind==='day' ? ((DB.streak||0)+'-day streak') : (st.done+' of '+st.total+' done today')); },
                      mute:function(){ muted++; }, unmute:function(){ muted = Math.max(0, muted-1); }, clear:clear };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('reward', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   ONE BOX FEEDS ANOTHER  (all 7 apps)   "fill in the least amount of looping data"

   When you tap FINISH on a box, what you logged there is carried to where it belongs, so you never type it twice:

   - Hustler's business lane (Car Wash, Trading, Freelance, your own log...):  the month's money so far
     (the same number the Tracker uses: net profit, else revenue, else trade results) becomes that lane's
     stream on this month's INCOME STREAMS page ("Car Wash: $240"). Finish again tomorrow and it updates.
     It is SET to the month's total (never added on top), so finishing twice can never double count.
   - Movement (every app): if you left Duration empty, Finish fills it in from your distance and time cards.
   - Clean's shower products already show up in the Product Vault as "Used N times" (no Finish needed).

   Nothing here changes the data format: income streams are the same {name, current, target, next, status} rows.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof window.finishBox!=='function') return;
    var base = window.finishBox;
    function money(n){ return (n<0?'-$':'$')+Math.abs(Math.round(n*100)/100).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
    function laneName(){ try{ var l = (typeof LANES!=='undefined' ? LANES : []).filter(function(x){ return x.id===DB.lane; })[0]; return l ? l.name : ''; }catch(e){ return ''; } }
    function syncLane(ds){
      if(typeof laneValueForDay!=='function' || !DB.lane || typeof datesInMonth!=='function' || typeof getMonthlyPage!=='function') return;
      var name = laneName(); if(!name) return;
      var mk = ds.slice(0,7), tot = 0;
      datesInMonth(mk).forEach(function(d){ tot += (laneValueForDay(d)||0); });
      tot = Math.round(tot*100)/100;
      var pg = getMonthlyPage('income', mk); if(!Array.isArray(pg.streams)) pg.streams = [];
      var s = pg.streams.filter(function(x){ return String(x.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase(); })[0];
      if(!s){ if(!tot) return; s = { name:name, current:'', target:'', next:'', status:'Active', auto:1 }; pg.streams.push(s); }
      s.current = String(tot); saveDB();
      flashSaved(name+': '+money(tot)+' this month, now in Income Streams');
    }
    /* TIME OF A BOX (Cycle 5). The clock starts the first time you do anything in today's box (add a move, tick a set, type a value).
       When you press Finish, the box's time field is filled for you if it is empty (a typed value always wins):
         1. the time since you started, if it is believable (5 minutes to 6 hours)
         2. otherwise a sensible guess: the minutes of your moves / pages, or the average of your last 5 entries, or a small default
       Works for: Movement (Duration), Reading (Time spent), the business-lane log (minutes / duration / time spent / hours),
       and any "Minutes" field you added to your own boxes. The time is filled BEFORE the screen redraws, so you see it at once. */
    function startClock(ds, pid){
      try{ if(ds!==todayStr() || pid==='setup' || pid==='library') return; var p = getPage(ds,pid); if(!p._t0 && !pageDoneFlag(ds,pid)) p._t0 = Date.now(); }catch(e){}
    }
    function pageDoneFlag(ds, pid){ return !!(DB.finished && DB.finished[ds] && DB.finished[ds][pid]); }
    if(typeof markTouched==='function'){ var _mt = markTouched; markTouched = function(ds, pid){ startClock(ds, pid); return _mt.apply(this, arguments); }; }
    /* the average of the last 5 non-empty numbers saved under this key on this page */
    function recentAvg(pid, get){
      var days = Object.keys(DB.days||{}).sort().reverse(), v = [];
      for(var i=0;i<days.length && v.length<5;i++){ var pg = DB.days[days[i]].pages && DB.days[days[i]].pages[pid]; var n = pg ? get(pg) : null; if(n>0) v.push(n); }
      return v.length ? Math.round(v.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; },0)/v.length) : 0;
    }
    function elapsed(p){ if(!p._t0) return 0; var e = (Date.now()-p._t0)/60000; return (e>=5 && e<=360) ? Math.round(e) : 0; }
    /* each filler: { empty(p), get(p) number for history, set(p, minutes), guess(ds, p) }  */
    function fillers(pid){
      var out = [];
      if(pid==='workout') out.push({
        empty:function(p){ return !String(p.duration||'').trim(); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p.duration); },
        set:function(p,m){ p.duration = m+' min'; },
        guess:function(ds,p){ var m = window.MOVE && window.MOVE.minutesOf ? Math.round(window.MOVE.minutesOf(ds)) : 0; return m>0 ? m : 0; }, dflt:30, label:'Workout time' });
      else if(pid==='reading') out.push({
        empty:function(p){ return !(parseFloat(p.minutes)>0); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p.minutes); },
        set:function(p,m){ p.minutes = m; },
        guess:function(ds,p){ var n = parseFloat(p.pagesToday); return n>0 ? Math.max(5, Math.round(n*2)) : 0; }, dflt:20, label:'Reading time' });
      else if(pid==='lane'){
        var lf = null; try{ lf = (typeof LANE_FIELDS!=='undefined' && DB.lane && LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane]) ? LANE_FIELDS[DB.lane].items : null; }catch(e){}
        (lf||[]).forEach(function(it){ var k = it[1];
          if(k==='minutes') out.push({ empty:function(p){ return !(parseFloat(p[k])>0); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p[k]); }, set:function(p,m){ p[k] = m; }, guess:function(){ return 0; }, dflt:0, label:'Time' });
          else if(k==='duration' || k==='timeSpent') out.push({ empty:function(p){ return !String(p[k]||'').trim(); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p[k]); }, set:function(p,m){ p[k] = m+' min'; }, guess:function(){ return 0; }, dflt:0, label:'Time' });
          else if(k==='hours') out.push({ empty:function(p){ return !(parseFloat(p[k])>0); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p[k])*60; }, set:function(p,m){ p[k] = Math.max(0.5, Math.round(m/30)/2); }, guess:function(){ return 0; }, dflt:0, label:'Hours' });
        });
      } else {
        try{ (bxCfg(pid).fields||[]).filter(function(f){ return f && f.type==='duration' && !f.deleted; }).forEach(function(f){ var k = 'cf_'+f.id;
          out.push({ empty:function(p){ return !(parseFloat(p[k])>0); }, get:function(p){ return parseFloat(p[k]); }, set:function(p,m){ p[k] = m; }, guess:function(){ return 0; }, dflt:0, label:f.label||'Time' }); }); }catch(e){}
      }
      return out;
    }
    function fillTime(ds, pid){
      var fs = fillers(pid); if(!fs.length) return;
      var p = getPage(ds,pid), done = [];
      fs.forEach(function(f){
        if(!f.empty(p)) return;
        var m = elapsed(p) || f.guess(ds,p) || recentAvg(pid, f.get) || f.dflt;
        if(m>0){ f.set(p, Math.round(m)); done.push(f.label+': '+Math.round(m)+' min'); }
      });
      if(done.length){ saveDB(); try{ flashSaved(done[0].replace(/: /,' added: ')); }catch(e){} }
    }
    window.finishBox = function(ds, pid){
      var first = !pageDoneFlag(ds,pid);
      try{ if(first && ds===todayStr()) fillTime(ds, pid); }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('time fill', e); }
      var r = base.apply(this, arguments);
      try{ if(pid==='lane') syncLane(ds); }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('cross-box', e); }
      return r;
    };
    window.XBOX = { syncLane:syncLane, fillTime:fillTime };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('xbox', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   WIDGET PREVIEW, LIVELIER  (Bot A, task 5)
