   -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The Widget Preview screen showed plain white cards. This gives the same four mock-ups (log small/medium,
   data small/medium) the look of the Home hero: your theme's gradient, a glowing box icon, a ring that
   fills, a flame streak chip, and a row of dots for the last 7 days.
   It is still only a preview, drawn from your real data. Nothing is saved or changed.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){
  try{
    if(typeof bxLogWidget !== 'function' || typeof bxDataWidget !== 'function') return;

    var css = ''
    + '.bx-widget.bxw{border:none;color:var(--accent-ink);background:radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.26),transparent 46%),radial-gradient(circle at 0% 100%,rgba(255,255,255,.14),transparent 46%),linear-gradient(155deg,var(--hero-from) 0%,var(--hero-via) 55%,var(--hero-to) 100%);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}'
    + '.bxw .wl,.bxw .ws,.bxw .wkv span:first-child{color:inherit;opacity:.82;}'
    + '.bxw .wkv span:last-child{color:inherit;}'
    + '.bxw .wn,.bxw .wq,.bxw .wbig{color:inherit;}'
    + '.bxw .wbig small{color:inherit;opacity:.75;}'
    + '.bxw-ico{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.1),0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18);flex:none;color:inherit;}'
    + '.bxw-ico svg{stroke:currentColor;}'
    + '.bxw-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;}'
    + '.bxw-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;}'
    + '.bxw-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}'
    + '.bxw-chip.done{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#17724A;}'
    + '.bxw-chip i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:bxwPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;flex:none;}'
    + '.bxw-streak{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 9px 4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;}'
    + '.bxw-streak svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:none;fill:#FFC53D;}'
    + '.bxw-dots{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;}'
    + '.bxw-dots i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}'
    + '.bxw-dots i.on{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.7);}'
    + '.bxw-dots i.today{outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);outline-offset:2px;}'
    + '.bxw-ring{position:relative;flex:none;}'
    + '.bxw-ring svg{display:block;transform:rotate(-90deg);overflow:visible;}'
    + '.bxw-ring .t{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.28);}'
    + '.bxw-ring .f{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-linecap:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55));animation:bxwDraw 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;}'
    + '.bxw-ring b{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;line-height:1;}'
    + '.bxw-ring b small{font-size:9.5px;opacity:.8;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:2px;text-transform:uppercase;}'
    + '.bxw-bars{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:36px;}'
    + '.bxw-bars i{flex:1;min-width:2px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);transform-origin:bottom;animation:bxwGrow .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;}'
    + '.bxw-bars i.on{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.5);}'
    + '.bx-w-m .wsplit{gap:12px;}'
    + '@keyframes bxwDraw{from{stroke-dashoffset:var(--c)}}'
    + '@keyframes bxwGrow{from{transform:scaleY(.1);opacity:0}}'
    + '@keyframes bxwPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.7)}}'
    + '@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bxw-chip i,.bxw-ring .f,.bxw-bars i{animation:none!important}}';
    var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'widgets-extra'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);

    function ringSvg(done, total, size, stroke, center, label){
      var R = (size - stroke)/2, C = 2*Math.PI*R, frac = total ? Math.min(1, done/total) : 0, off = C*(1-frac);
      return '<div class="bxw-ring" style="width:'+size+'px;height:'+size+'px" role="img" aria-label="'+esc(label||'')+'"><svg width="'+size+'" height="'+size+'" viewBox="0 0 '+size+' '+size+'">'
        + '<circle class="t" cx="'+size/2+'" cy="'+size/2+'" r="'+R+'" stroke-width="'+stroke+'"/>'
        + '<circle class="f" cx="'+size/2+'" cy="'+size/2+'" r="'+R+'" stroke-width="'+stroke+'" stroke-dasharray="'+C+'" stroke-dashoffset="'+off+'" style="--c:'+C+'"/></svg>'
        + '<b>'+center+'</b></div>';
    }
    function weekDots(){
      var h = '<div class="bxw-dots" aria-hidden="true">';
      for(var i=6;i>=0;i--){ var d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-i); var ds = localDateStr(d);
        h += '<i class="'+(dayHasAny(ds)?'on':'')+(i===0?' today':'')+'"></i>'; }
      return h+'</div>';
    }
    function streakChip(){ var n = DB.streak||0; return '<span class="bxw-streak">'+icon('flame',14)+n+'</span>'; }

    bxLogWidget = function(size){
      var p = bxPinned(), k = bxDayCounts(), t = todayStr(), cls = (size==='s' ? 'bx-w-s' : 'bx-w-m')+' bxw';
      var label = k.done+' of '+k.total+' boxes done today';
      if(!p.id){
        if(size==='s') return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="bxw-top"><div class="wl">'+esc(p.timeLabel)+'</div>'+streakChip()+'</div><div class="wq">“'+esc(p.quote)+'”</div><div class="ws">'+k.done+' of '+k.total+' done</div></div>';
        return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l"><div class="wl">'+esc(p.timeLabel)+' · nothing pinned</div><div class="wq">“'+esc(p.quote)+'”</div>'+weekDots()+'</div><div class="r">'+ringSvg(k.done,k.total,72,8,k.done+'/'+k.total,label)+streakChip()+'</div></div></div>';
      }
      var m = bxBoxMeta(p.id), done = pageIsDone(t, p.id), status = done ? doneSummary(t, p.id) : 'Not logged yet';
      var chip = '<div class="bxw-chip'+(done?' done':'')+'">'+(done ? icon('check',12)+' ' : '<i></i>')+esc(done ? (size==='s' ? 'Logged' : status) : 'Tap to log')+'</div>';
      var kv = '';
      if(size==='m' && bxIsBox(p.id)){
        var c = bxCfg(p.id), pg = (DB.days[t] && DB.days[t].pages[p.id]) || {};
        kv = c.fields.filter(function(f){ return !f.deleted; }).slice(0,2).map(function(f){ return '<div class="wkv"><span>'+esc(f.label)+'</span><span>'+esc(bxDisplay(f, pg['cf_'+f.id]) || '—')+'</span></div>'; }).join('');
      }
      var ico = '<span class="bxw-ico">'+icon(m.icon,20)+'</span>';
      if(size==='s') return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="bxw-top">'+ico+ringSvg(k.done,k.total,40,5,'<span style="font-size:11px">'+k.done+'/'+k.total+'</span>',label)+'</div><div><div class="bxw-name">'+esc(m.name)+'</div>'+chip+'</div></div>';
      return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l"><div class="bxw-top" style="justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;gap:10px">'+ico+'<div class="bxw-name">'+esc(m.name)+'</div></div><div>'+chip+kv+'</div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px"><span class="wl">Pinned · '+esc(p.timeLabel)+'</span></div></div>'
        + '<div class="r">'+ringSvg(k.done,k.total,72,8,k.done+'/'+k.total+'<small>today</small>',label)+streakChip()+'</div></div></div>';
    };

    bxDataWidget = function(size){
      var s = bxPeriodStats(), pct = s.elapsed ? Math.round(s.logged/s.elapsed*100) : 0, cls = (size==='s' ? 'bx-w-s' : 'bx-w-m')+' bxw';
      var unit = BX_WPERIOD==='year' ? 'year' : 'month', label = s.logged+' of '+s.elapsed+' days logged';
      if(size==='s') return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="bxw-top"><div class="wl">'+esc(s.label)+'</div>'+streakChip()+'</div>'
        + '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px"><div><div class="wbig">'+pct+'<small>%</small></div><div class="ws">'+s.logged+' of '+s.elapsed+' '+(s.elapsed===1?'day':'days')+'</div></div></div></div>';
      return '<div class="bx-widget '+cls+'"><div class="wsplit"><div class="l"><div class="wl">'+esc(s.label)+' · this '+unit+'</div>'
        + '<div><div class="wbig">'+s.logged+'<small>/'+s.elapsed+' '+(s.elapsed===1?'day':'days')+'</small></div></div>'
        + '<div class="bxw-bars" aria-hidden="true">'+s.bars.map(function(b,i){ return '<i class="'+(b.on?'on':'')+'" style="height:'+b.h+'%;animation-delay:'+Math.min(i*18,500)+'ms"></i>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>'
        + '<div class="r">'+ringSvg(s.logged,s.elapsed,72,8,pct+'%',label)+streakChip()+'</div></div></div>';
    };
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('widgets', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Test mode: an in-app switch between your real data and a separate test copy.
   It never changes how the app looks. Real data lives under the normal key, test data under "<key>-test". */
(function(){
  try{
    var MODE_KEY = "hustlers-logbook-v1" + '-mode';
    var VISIBLE = true;
    var isTest = !!window.APP_TEST_MODE;
    if(isTest && document.title.indexOf('TEST')!==0) document.title = 'TEST \u00b7 ' + document.title;
    function setMode(on){ try{ if(on) localStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY,'test'); else localStorage.removeItem(MODE_KEY); }catch(e){} location.reload(); }
    function sheet(title, text, label, action, accent){
      openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+title+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
        + '<div class="confirm-body"><p>'+text+'</p>'
        + '<button class="confirm-danger-btn" '+(accent?'style="background:var(--accent);" ':'')+'onclick="'+action+'">'+label+'</button>'
        + '<button class="confirm-cancel-btn" onclick="closeSheet()">Cancel</button></div>');
    }
    window.toggleTestMode = function(){
      if(!isTest) sheet('Switch to test mode?', 'You will use a separate copy of this app. Your real data is not touched, and you can switch back any time.', 'Switch to test mode', 'testSetMode(true)', true);
      else sheet('Back to your real data?', 'Your test data stays saved for next time.', 'Use my real data', 'testSetMode(false)', true);
    };
    window.testSetMode = function(on){ setMode(on); };
    var rwFlip = false;
    window.testRewardPreview = function(){ if(window.REWARD){ REWARD.play(rwFlip ? 'day' : 'box'); rwFlip = !rwFlip; } };
    window.testFillYear = function(){
      /* randomFillMonth saves, recomputes the streak and redraws on every single entry (1,600+ times for a year).
         Hold all three still while filling, then do each once at the end. */
      var _save = saveDB, _rec = recomputeStreak, _flash = flashSaved, _render = render;
      saveDB = function(){ return true; }; recomputeStreak = function(){}; flashSaved = function(){}; render = function(){};
      try{ return fillYear(); } finally { saveDB = _save; recomputeStreak = _rec; flashSaved = _flash; render = _render; finish(); }
      function finish(){
        recomputeStreak();
        var ok = saveDB();
        flashSaved(ok ? 'Filled '+window.__testFilled+' days of test data' : "Couldn't save \u2014 storage may be full");
        render();
      }
    };
    function fillYear(){
      var now = new Date(), total = 0, i;
      for(i=12;i>=0;i--){ var d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()-i, 1);
        total += randomFillMonth(d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')) || 0; }
      /* one custom box with a year of data, so the custom-box charts have something to show */
      try{
        var b = bxDB(), id = 'cx_testbox', from = localDateStr(new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()-12, 1));
        if(!b.boxes[id]){ b.boxes[id] = { id:id, custom:true, name:'Test Box', icon:null, from:from, until:null, order:90, labels:{}, hidden:{}, fields:[
          {id:'reps', label:'Reps', type:'number', unit:'x', icon:null, created:from, deleted:null},
          {id:'mood', label:'Mood', type:'scale', max:5, icon:null, created:from, deleted:null},
          {id:'done', label:'Done', type:'toggle', icon:null, created:from, deleted:null}] }; }
        /* write straight into the pages and save once: the normal setters save + redraw on every single call */
        for(var k=0;k<=370;k++){ if(Math.random()<0.7){ var ds = localDateStr(new Date(now.getTime()-k*864e5)), pg = getPage(ds,id);
          pg.cf_reps = 8+Math.floor(Math.random()*12); pg.cf_mood = 1+Math.floor(Math.random()*5); pg.cf_done = Math.random()<0.6;
          pg._touched = true; pg._touchedAt = Date.now(); } }
      }catch(e){}
      window.__testFilled = total;
    }
    window.testClearAsk = function(){ sheet('Clear test data?', 'Only the test copy is cleared. Your real data is not touched.', 'Clear test data', 'testClearData()', false); };
    window.testClearData = function(){ if(!isTest) return; try{ localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(ONBOARD_KEY); }catch(e){} location.reload(); };

    var baseSettings = renderSettings;
    renderSettings = function(){
      baseSettings();
      var show = VISIBLE || isTest || location.search.indexOf('testtools')>=0;
      var host = document.querySelector('#app .page-body');
      if(!show || !host) return;
      var row = function(name, desc, fn){ return '<button class="settings-row" onclick="'+fn+'"><div><div class="sr-name">'+name+'</div><div class="sr-desc">'+desc+'</div></div><div class="sr-ico">'+icon('bolt',16)+'</div></button>'; };
      var html = '<div class="settings-section"><div class="settings-heading">Testing</div>'
        + row('Preview finish animation', 'Plays the \u201Cbox done\u201D celebration (tap again for the \u201Cday complete\u201D one)', 'testRewardPreview()')
        + row('Test mode', isTest ? 'On \u2014 using a separate test copy of the data' : 'Off \u2014 using your real data', 'toggleTestMode()')
        + (isTest ? row('Fill a year of random data', 'Last 13 months plus a custom box \u2014 test copy only', 'testFillYear()') + row('Clear test data', 'Wipes only the test copy', 'testClearAsk()') : '')
        + '</div>';
      host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    };
    if(location.hash==='#settings' || (window.ROUTE && ROUTE.view==='settings')) render();
  }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('test mode', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   HAIR LOG v2 (Cycle 6, Clean Boy and Clean Girl only). A MONTHLY BOX on Home (and in Settings > This month).
   Tabs inside it:
     Card     the character card for your hair: portrait (or your own photo), rarity, level, stats, traits, goals, next-care tip, badges
     Photos   take or pick pictures (front / side / back / top / scalp), see them as a gallery, before and after
     Routine  a calendar of your hair days; they fill themselves from "Hair today" in Shower & Hygiene (and you can tap a day too)
     History  a timeline of hair days and photos, and the monthly health score journey
   LINKED TO HYGIENE: Shower & Hygiene gets a "Hair today" field. Pick Washed / Conditioned / Mask...: that day is added to the Routine tab
   by itself. Shower & Hygiene also gets a history card (last 14 days, products you use most) and its own progress photos.
   Saved per month: DB.monthly[month].hair = { traits, stats, routine, goals, photos:[...], days:{date:1} }, and
   DB.monthly[month].hygiene = { photos:[...] }. All optional, so older backups still import. A new month starts as a copy of last month's card.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){ try{
  if(typeof BRAND==='undefined' || !/clean/i.test(BRAND.name||'')) return;
  if(typeof PAGE_RENDERERS==='undefined' || typeof getMonthlyPage!=='function') return;
  var E = esc, LS = function(){ return window.LISTS; };

  var TRAITS = [
    { k:'pattern',  label:'Pattern',  opts:['Straight','Wavy','Curly','Coily'] },
    { k:'length',   label:'Length',   opts:['Buzzed','Short','Medium','Long','Very long'] },
    { k:'colour',   label:'Colour',   opts:['Black','Dark brown','Brown','Blonde','Red','Grey','Dyed'] },
    { k:'strand',   label:'Strand',   opts:['Fine','Medium','Coarse'] },
    { k:'density',  label:'Density',  opts:['Thin','Medium','Thick'] },
    { k:'style',    label:'Style',    opts:['Natural','Fringe','Side part','Middle part','Slicked back','Tied up'] },
    { k:'scalp',    label:'Scalp',    opts:['Dry','Balanced','Oily','Sensitive'] },
    { k:'porosity', label:'Porosity', opts:['Low','Medium','High'] }
  ];
  var STATS = [ ['moisture','Moisture'], ['strength','Strength'], ['shine','Shine'], ['volume','Volume'], ['scalpHealth','Scalp'], ['growth','Growth'] ];
  var ROUTINE = ['Shampoo','Conditioner','Hair mask','Leave-in','Hair oil','Scalp scrub','Heat protectant','Styling cream','Gel / wax','Comb / brush'];
  var GOALS = ['Grow it out','More moisture','More volume','More shine','Less frizz','Stronger','Thicker','Curl definition','Healthier scalp','Keep it as is'];
  var DAILY = ['Washed','Conditioned','Hair mask','Oil / scalp care','Styled','Brushed','Trimmed','Coloured'];
  var ANGLES = ['Front','Side','Back','Top','Scalp','Close-up'];
  var COL = { 'Black':'#1c1818','Dark brown':'#3a2a21','Brown':'#6a4a33','Blonde':'#d8b56b','Red':'#b0452a','Grey':'#b8b8bf','Dyed':'#8b5cf0' };
  var TITLE = { 'Straight':'The Silk Blade', 'Wavy':'The Tide Rider', 'Curly':'The Spring Mage', 'Coily':'The Crown Keeper' };
  var TAB = 'card', ANGLE = 'Front', DEL = '';

  /* the daily "Hair today" chips in Shower & Hygiene use the normal tap-chip engine */
  try{ if(window.UI && UI.specs) UI.specs['shower.hair'] = { t:'multi', opts:DAILY, other:false }; }catch(e){}

  /* ---- small helpers ---- */
  function prevMk(mk){ var p = mk.split('-'), d = new Date(+p[0], +p[1]-2, 1); return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'); }
  function ymd(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
  function addD(ds, n){ var d = new Date(ds+'T12:00:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate()+n); return ymd(d); }
  function daysBetween(a, b){ return Math.round((new Date(b+'T12:00:00') - new Date(a+'T12:00:00'))/86400000); }
  function nice(ds){ try{ return new Date(ds+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day:'numeric', month:'short' }); }catch(e){ return ds; } }
  function has(o){ return o && Object.keys(o).some(function(k){ return k.charAt(0)!=='_'; }); }
  function raw(mk){ return DB.monthly && DB.monthly[mk] && DB.monthly[mk].hair; }
  function uniq(a){ var s = {}; return a.filter(function(x){ if(s[x]) return false; s[x] = 1; return true; }); }

  /* ---- the card data ---- */
  function data(mk){
    var d = getMonthlyPage('hair', mk);
    if(!has(d)){   /* new month: start from last month's card (photos and days stay with their own month) */
      var pd = raw(prevMk(mk));
      if(has(pd)){ var c = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pd)); ['trim','note','photos','days','coloured','heat','protein','avatar'].forEach(function(k){ delete c[k]; }); Object.keys(c).forEach(function(k){ d[k] = c[k]; }); d.fromPrev = true; }
    }
    return d;
  }
  function score(d){ var v = STATS.map(function(s){ return +d[s[0]] || 0; }).filter(function(x){ return x>0; }); return v.length ? Math.round(v.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; },0)/v.length*20) : null; }
  function rarity(sc){ return sc==null ? '' : sc>=88 ? 'Legendary' : sc>=72 ? 'Epic' : sc>=56 ? 'Rare' : sc>=40 ? 'Uncommon' : 'Common'; }

  /* ---- hair days: filled from Shower & Hygiene ("Hair today", "Hair care" note, hair products) plus the days you tap yourself ---- */
  function autoKinds(ds){
    var day = DB.days && DB.days[ds], p = day && day.pages && day.pages.shower; if(!p || !p._touched) return [];
    var out = [];
    try{ UI.parseMulti(p.hair).tok.forEach(function(t){ out.push(t); }); }catch(e){}
    if(/hair care/i.test(String(p.note||''))) out.push('Hair care');
    for(var i=0;i<9;i++){ var t = String(p['product'+i]||''); if(!t) continue;
      if(/shampoo/i.test(t)) out.push('Washed'); else if(/conditioner/i.test(t)) out.push('Conditioned'); else if(/hair|scalp/i.test(t)) out.push('Hair care'); }
    return uniq(out);
  }
  function daysOf(mk){
    var map = {}, h = raw(mk), man = (h && h.days) || {};
    var ds = (typeof datesInMonth==='function') ? datesInMonth(mk) : [];
    ds.forEach(function(d){ var k = autoKinds(d), m = !!man[d]; if(k.length || m) map[d] = { kinds:k, auto:k.length>0, manual:m }; });
    return map;
  }
  function isDay(ds){ var m = daysOf(ds.slice(0,7)); return !!m[ds]; }
  function kindsOn(ds){ var m = daysOf(ds.slice(0,7))[ds]; return m ? m.kinds : []; }
  function streak(){   /* consecutive hair days up to today (today may still be open) */
    var t = todayStr(), n = 0, d = isDay(t) ? t : addD(t,-1);
    while(n<400 && isDay(d)){ n++; d = addD(d,-1); }
    return n;
  }
  function totalDays(){ var n = 0, seen = {}; Object.keys(DB.days||{}).forEach(function(d){ var k = d.slice(0,7); if(!seen[k]){ seen[k] = daysOf(k); } if(seen[k][d]) n++; });
    Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).forEach(function(k){ if(!seen[k]){ seen[k] = daysOf(k); Object.keys(seen[k]).forEach(function(d){ if(!DB.days[d]) n++; }); } }); return n; }
  function lastWith(re){ var t = todayStr(); for(var i=0;i<120;i++){ var d = addD(t,-i), k = kindsOn(d); if(k.some(function(x){ return re.test(x); })) return d; } return ''; }
  function weekStart(){ var t = todayStr(), d = new Date(t+'T12:00:00'), wd = (d.getDay()+6)%7; return addD(t,-wd); }
  function washesThisWeek(){ var s = weekStart(), n = 0; for(var i=0;i<7;i++){ var d = addD(s,i); if(d>todayStr()) break; if(kindsOn(d).some(function(x){ return /wash|shampoo/i.test(x); })) n++; } return n; }
  function level(){ var n = totalDays(), lv = 1 + Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n)), lo = Math.pow(lv-1,2), hi = Math.pow(lv,2); return { n:n, lv:lv, pct:Math.round((n-lo)/Math.max(1,hi-lo)*100), toNext:hi-n }; }

  /* ---- photos (hair: DB.monthly[m].hair.photos, hygiene: DB.monthly[m].hygiene.photos) ---- */
  function store(kind, mk, make){ var m = DB.monthly && DB.monthly[mk], o = m && m[kind]; if(!o && make) o = getMonthlyPage(kind, mk); if(o && make && !Array.isArray(o.photos)) o.photos = []; return o && Array.isArray(o.photos) ? o.photos : []; }
  function photosOf(kind){
    var out = []; Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).sort().forEach(function(mk){ store(kind, mk).forEach(function(p){ out.push({ id:p.id, ds:p.ds, tag:p.tag, img:p.img, mk:mk, kind:kind }); }); });
    return out.sort(function(a,b){ return a.ds===b.ds ? (a.id<b.id?-1:1) : (a.ds<b.ds?-1:1); });
  }
  function findPhoto(id){ var all = photosOf('hair').concat(photosOf('hygiene')); return all.filter(function(p){ return p.id===id; })[0] || null; }
  function compress(file, cb){
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(file), img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){
      try{
        var SZ = [640, 520, 420], Q = [.62, .52, .42], out = null;
        for(var i=0;i<SZ.length;i++){
          var sc = Math.min(1, SZ[i]/Math.max(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight)), w = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalWidth*sc)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalHeight*sc));
          var cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; var cx = cv.getContext('2d'); cx.fillStyle = '#fff'; cx.fillRect(0,0,w,h); cx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
          out = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', Q[i]); if(out.length <= 70000) break;
        }
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url); cb(out);
      }catch(e){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); cb(null); }
    };
    img.onerror = function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); cb(null); };
    img.src = url;
  }
  function addPhoto(kind, file){
    if(!file) return;
    try{ flashSaved('Compressing photo…'); }catch(e){}
    compress(file, function(uri){
      if(!uri){ try{ flashSaved('Could not read that photo'); }catch(e){} return; }
      var mk = currentMonthKey(); if(kind==='hair') data(mk);
      var arr = store(kind, mk, true), item = { id:'ph'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.floor(Math.random()*1e3), ds:todayStr(), tag:(kind==='hair' ? ANGLE : 'Progress'), img:uri };
      arr.push(item);
      var ok = (typeof bxTrySave==='function') ? bxTrySave() : (saveDB(), true);
      if(!ok){ arr.pop(); try{ flashSaved('Storage is full: photo not saved. Delete an old photo first.'); }catch(e){} return; }
      try{ flashSaved('Photo saved'); }catch(e){} render();
    });
  }
  function removePhoto(id){
    Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).forEach(function(mk){ ['hair','hygiene'].forEach(function(k){ var o = DB.monthly[mk][k]; if(o && Array.isArray(o.photos)){ o.photos = o.photos.filter(function(p){ return p.id!==id; }); if(k==='hair' && o.avatar===id) delete o.avatar; } }); });
    saveDB();
  }
  function kb(n){ return Math.round(n/1024)+' KB'; }
  /* ---- the portrait ---- */
  function shade(hex, amt){   /* lighter (+) or darker (-) hex colour */
    var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16), r = n>>16, g = (n>>8)&255, b = n&255;
    var f = function(c){ return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c + (amt>0 ? (255-c)*amt : c*amt)))); };
    return '#'+[f(r),f(g),f(b)].map(function(c){ return (c<16?'0':'')+c.toString(16); }).join('');
  }
  function portrait(d){
    var hair = COL[d.colour] || COL['Brown'], dark = shade(hair,-.35), light = shade(hair,.35);
    var li = Math.max(0, TRAITS[1].opts.indexOf(d.length)); if(d.length==null) li = 2;
    var pat = d.pattern || 'Wavy', style = d.style || 'Natural', dens = Math.max(0, TRAITS[4].opts.indexOf(d.density)); if(!d.density) dens = 1;
    var ex = dens*4 + (pat==='Curly' ? 6 : pat==='Coily' ? 12 : 0), buzz = li===0, up = style==='Tied up';
    var yEnd = [0,128,168,206,240][li], sh = +d.shine || 3;
    var s = '<svg viewBox="0 0 240 250" class="hr-svg" role="img" aria-label="Your hair: '+E((d.pattern||'')+' '+(d.length||'').toLowerCase())+'">';
    s += '<defs><linearGradient id="hrg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="'+light+'" stop-opacity=".35"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="'+hair+'" stop-opacity=".18"/></linearGradient></defs>';
    s += '<rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="250" rx="26" fill="url(#hrg)"/>';
    /* shoulders and neck */
    s += '<path d="M24 250 Q34 208 120 202 Q206 208 216 250 Z" class="hr-body"/><rect x="104" y="150" width="32" height="56" rx="12" class="hr-skin2"/>';
    /* back hair (behind the face) */
    if(!buzz && li>=2 && !up){
      var L = 60-ex, R = 180+ex;
      s += '<path d="M'+L+' 96 C'+(L-8)+' 130 '+(L-10)+' '+(yEnd-24)+' '+(L-2)+' '+yEnd+' L'+(R+2)+' '+yEnd+' C'+(R+10)+' '+(yEnd-24)+' '+(R+8)+' 130 '+R+' 96 Z" fill="'+hair+'"/>';
      if(pat==='Curly' || pat==='Coily'){ var rr = pat==='Coily' ? 6 : 9, st = pat==='Coily' ? 12 : 17;
        for(var y = 100; y <= yEnd; y += st){ s += '<circle cx="'+(L-4+ (y>yEnd-30?3:0))+'" cy="'+y+'" r="'+rr+'" fill="'+hair+'"/><circle cx="'+(R+4-(y>yEnd-30?3:0))+'" cy="'+y+'" r="'+rr+'" fill="'+hair+'"/>'; }
        for(var x = L+6; x <= R-6; x += st){ s += '<circle cx="'+x+'" cy="'+(yEnd-2)+'" r="'+rr+'" fill="'+hair+'"/>'; } }
      if(pat==='Wavy'){ for(var k=0;k<5;k++){ var x0 = L+14+k*((R-L-28)/4); s += '<path d="M'+x0+' 110 q-8 '+((yEnd-110)/4)+' 0 '+((yEnd-110)/2)+' t0 '+((yEnd-110)/2)+'" stroke="'+dark+'" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity=".55"/>'; } }
      if(pat==='Straight'){ for(var j=0;j<6;j++){ var x1 = L+10+j*((R-L-20)/5); s += '<line x1="'+x1+'" y1="110" x2="'+x1+'" y2="'+(yEnd-4)+'" stroke="'+dark+'" stroke-width="1.6" opacity=".4"/>'; } }
    }
    /* face */
    s += '<ellipse cx="72" cy="120" rx="7" ry="11" class="hr-skin2"/><ellipse cx="168" cy="120" rx="7" ry="11" class="hr-skin2"/><ellipse cx="120" cy="116" rx="46" ry="56" class="hr-skin"/>';
    /* hair on top */
    var top;
    if(buzz){ top = '<path d="M76 100 C72 56 100 42 120 42 C140 42 168 56 164 100 C158 82 142 74 120 74 C98 74 82 82 76 100 Z" fill="'+hair+'" opacity=".7"/>'; }
    else {
      var hl = style==='Slicked back' ? 70 : style==='Fringe' ? 104 : 86, o = ex;
      top = '<path d="M'+(66-o)+' 118 C'+(56-o)+' 46 96 28 120 28 C144 28 '+(184+o)+' 46 '+(174+o)+' 118 C166 94 150 '+hl+' 120 '+hl+' C90 '+hl+' 74 94 '+(66-o)+' 118 Z" fill="'+hair+'"/>';
      if(style==='Fringe') top += '<path d="M76 96 C96 84 140 84 164 96 C150 110 130 100 120 110 C108 100 92 110 76 96 Z" fill="'+hair+'"/>';
      if(style==='Side part'){ top += '<path d="M98 34 C96 56 104 74 130 86" stroke="'+dark+'" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" opacity=".7"/>'; }
      if(style==='Middle part'){ top += '<path d="M120 30 L120 82" stroke="'+dark+'" stroke-width="2.2" opacity=".7"/>'; }
      if(li===1){ top += '<rect x="'+(70-o)+'" y="100" width="10" height="30" rx="5" fill="'+hair+'"/><rect x="'+(160+o)+'" y="100" width="10" height="30" rx="5" fill="'+hair+'"/>'; }
      if(up) top += '<circle cx="120" cy="22" r="'+(13+ex/3)+'" fill="'+hair+'"/><circle cx="120" cy="22" r="'+(7+ex/4)+'" fill="'+dark+'" opacity=".35"/>';
      if(pat==='Curly' || pat==='Coily'){ var rr2 = pat==='Coily' ? 6 : 8, n = pat==='Coily' ? 17 : 12;
        for(var a = 0; a <= n; a++){ var t = Math.PI * (1 + a/n), cx = 120 + Math.cos(t)*(54+ex), cy = 96 + Math.sin(t)*(66+ex*.6); top += '<circle cx="'+cx.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+cy.toFixed(1)+'" r="'+rr2+'" fill="'+hair+'"/>'; } }
      if(pat==='Wavy'){ for(var w=0; w<4; w++){ top += '<path d="M'+(88+w*20)+' 36 q-8 14 0 26 t0 24" stroke="'+dark+'" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" opacity=".5"/>'; } }
    }
    s += top;
    /* shine band */
    if(!buzz) s += '<path d="M86 52 C100 40 134 40 152 54" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="'+(.06+sh*.07).toFixed(2)+'"/>';
    /* a friendly face */
    s += '<circle cx="104" cy="122" r="3.2" class="hr-ink"/><circle cx="136" cy="122" r="3.2" class="hr-ink"/><path d="M108 142 Q120 152 132 142" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" class="hr-ink-s"/>';
    var sc = score(d); if(sc!=null && sc>=70) s += '<path d="M206 40 l3 8 8 3 -8 3 -3 8 -3 -8 -8 -3 8 -3z" class="hr-star"/><path d="M28 70 l2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 6 -2z" class="hr-star"/>';
    return s + '</svg>';
  }


  /* ---- the page ---- */
  function history(mk){
    var out = [], cur = mk;
    for(var i=0;i<6;i++){ var pd = raw(cur); out.unshift({ mk:cur, sc: has(pd) ? score(pd) : null }); cur = prevMk(cur); }
    return out;
  }
  function pips(d, k){ var v = +d[k] || 0; return [1,2,3,4,5].map(function(n){ return '<button type="button" class="hr-pip'+(n<=v?' on':'')+'" data-hr="stat" data-k="'+k+'" data-v="'+n+'" aria-label="'+n+' of 5"></button>'; }).join(''); }
  function thumb(p, extra){ return '<button type="button" class="hr-th'+(extra||'')+'" data-hr="pview" data-id="'+E(p.id)+'" aria-label="Open photo"><img src="'+p.img+'" alt="'+E((p.tag||'')+' '+nice(p.ds))+'" loading="lazy"><span>'+E(p.tag||'')+'</span></button>'; }

  /* next-care tip, from your routine */
  function nextCare(d){
    var goal = d.wash==null ? 2 : +d.wash, w = washesThisWeek(), lw = lastWith(/wash|shampoo/i), since = lw ? daysBetween(lw, todayStr()) : null, mask = lastWith(/mask/i);
    if(w < goal && (since==null || since>=2)) return { t:'Wash day is due', s: w+' of '+goal+' washes this week'+(since!=null ? ' · last wash '+(since===0?'today':since+' day'+(since===1?'':'s')+' ago') : ''), tone:'due' };
    if(!mask || daysBetween(mask, todayStr())>=14) return { t:'Time for a treatment', s: mask ? 'Last mask was '+daysBetween(mask, todayStr())+' days ago' : 'No hair mask logged yet', tone:'due' };
    return { t:'On track', s: w+' of '+goal+' washes this week · streak '+streak()+' day'+(streak()===1?'':'s'), tone:'ok' };
  }
  function badges(){
    var ph = photosOf('hair').length, bestRun = (function(){ var best = 0, run = 0, t = todayStr(); for(var i=119;i>=0;i--){ if(isDay(addD(t,-i))){ run++; if(run>best) best = run; } else run = 0; } return best; })(), L = level().n, masks = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<120;i++){ if(kindsOn(addD(todayStr(),-i)).some(function(x){ return /mask/i.test(x); })) masks++; }
    var trim = Object.keys(DB.monthly||{}).some(function(k){ var h = raw(k); return h && h.trim; });
    return [ ['📸','First photo',ph>=1], ['🗂️','Photo diary (5)',ph>=5], ['🔥','3-day streak',bestRun>=3], ['⚡','7-day streak',bestRun>=7], ['🧴','Mask master (3)',masks>=3], ['✂️','Trim logged',trim], ['🌟','30 hair days',L>=30], ['👑','Level 5',level().lv>=5] ];
  }

  function tabBar(){
    return '<div class="hr-tabs" role="tablist">'+[['card','Card'],['photos','Photos'],['routine','Routine'],['history','History']].map(function(t){ return '<button type="button" role="tab" class="hr-tab'+(TAB===t[0]?' on':'')+'" aria-selected="'+(TAB===t[0]?'true':'false')+'" data-hr="tab" data-v="'+t[0]+'">'+t[1]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function heroPic(d, mk){
    var av = d.avatar ? findPhoto(d.avatar) : null;
    return av ? '<div class="hr-photo"><img src="'+av.img+'" alt="Your hair"></div>' : portrait(d);
  }
  function cardTab(mk, d){
    var sc = score(d), pm = prevMk(mk), pd = raw(pm), ps = has(pd) ? score(pd) : null, delta = (sc!=null && ps!=null) ? sc-ps : null;
    var title = TITLE[d.pattern] || 'Your Hair', sub = [d.length, d.pattern, d.colour].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Tap the traits below to build your card';
    var lv = level(), care = nextCare(d), st = streak(), nb = badges();
    var h = '<div class="hr-card"><div class="hr-top"><div class="hr-pic">'+heroPic(d, mk)+(d.avatar ? '<button type="button" class="hr-art" data-hr="art">Use art</button>' : '')+'</div><div class="hr-id">'
      + (sc!=null ? '<div class="hr-rar r-'+rarity(sc).toLowerCase()+'">'+rarity(sc)+'</div>' : '<div class="hr-rar">New card</div>')
      + '<div class="hr-title">'+E(title)+'</div><div class="hr-sub">'+E(sub)+'</div>'
      + '<div class="hr-score"><b>'+(sc==null ? '–' : sc)+'</b><span>hair health</span>'+(delta!=null && delta!==0 ? '<em class="'+(delta>0?'up':'dn')+'">'+(delta>0?'▲ +':'▼ ')+delta+'</em>' : '')+'</div></div></div>'
      + '<div class="hr-lv"><div class="hr-lvh"><b>Level '+lv.lv+'</b><span>'+lv.n+' hair days · '+lv.toNext+' to level '+(lv.lv+1)+'</span></div><div class="hr-lvbar"><i style="width:'+lv.pct+'%"></i></div></div>'
      + '<div class="hr-mini"><div><b>'+st+'</b><span>day streak</span></div><div><b>'+washesThisWeek()+'</b><span>washes this week</span></div><div><b>'+photosOf('hair').length+'</b><span>photos</span></div></div>'
      + (d.fromPrev ? '<div class="hr-copy">Copied from last month. Change what is different.</div>' : '') + '</div>';
    h += '<div class="hr-care '+care.tone+'"><b>'+E(care.t)+'</b><span>'+E(care.s)+'</span><button type="button" data-hr="tab" data-v="routine">Open routine</button></div>';
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Stats</div><div class="fc-hint">How it feels this month. 1 is poor, 5 is great.</div>'
      + STATS.map(function(s){ return '<div class="hr-stat"><span>'+E(s[1])+'</span><div class="hr-pips">'+pips(d, s[0])+'</div><b>'+(d[s[0]] ? d[s[0]] : '–')+'</b></div>'; }).join('') + '</div>';
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Traits</div><div class="hr-traits">'
      + TRAITS.map(function(t){ return '<button type="button" class="hr-trait'+(d[t.k]?' set':'')+'" data-hr="trait" data-k="'+t.k+'"><small>'+E(t.label)+'</small><b>'+E(d[t.k] || 'Pick')+'</b></button>'; }).join('') + '</div></div>';
    var g = Array.isArray(d.goals) ? d.goals : [];
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Goals</div><div class="hr-chips">' + (g.length ? g.map(function(x){ return '<i>'+E(x)+'</i>'; }).join('') : '<span class="hr-none">Nothing picked yet</span>') + '</div>'
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-edit2" data-hr="goals">'+icon('pen',13)+' Choose your goals</button></div>';
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Badges</div><div class="hr-badges">'+nb.map(function(b){ return '<div class="hr-b'+(b[2]?' got':'')+'"><span>'+b[0]+'</span><small>'+E(b[1])+'</small></div>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">This month</div><div class="hr-tog">'
      + [['trim','Got a trim'],['coloured','Coloured it'],['heat','Heat styled a lot'],['protein','Did a protein or repair treatment']].map(function(t){ return '<button type="button" class="hr-t'+(d[t[0]]?' on':'')+'" data-hr="tog" data-k="'+t[0]+'" aria-pressed="'+(d[t[0]]?'true':'false')+'">'+E(t[1])+'</button>'; }).join('') + '</div>'
      + '<textarea class="freewrite" id="hr-note" rows="3" placeholder="Notes: what helped, what did not (optional)">'+E(d.note||'')+'</textarea></div>';
    return h;
  }
  function photosTab(mk, d){
    var all = photosOf('hair'), h = '';
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Add a photo</div><div class="fc-hint">Pictures stay on this phone. They are shrunk so lots of them fit.</div>'
      + '<div class="hr-angles">'+ANGLES.map(function(a){ return '<button type="button" class="hr-ang'+(ANGLE===a?' on':'')+'" data-hr="angle" data-v="'+a+'" aria-pressed="'+(ANGLE===a?'true':'false')+'">'+a+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-add" data-hr="addphoto">'+icon('camera',16)+' Take or choose a '+E(ANGLE.toLowerCase())+' photo</button>'
      + '<input type="file" accept="image/*" id="hr-file" data-store="hair" hidden></div>';
    if(!all.length){ h += '<div class="hr-empty"><b>No photos yet</b><span>Add one now and a month from now you can compare. Same light and same angle works best.</span></div>'; return h; }
    var last = all[all.length-1], first = all.filter(function(p){ return p.tag===last.tag; })[0] || all[0];
    if(first.id!==last.id){
      var gap = daysBetween(first.ds, last.ds);
      h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Before and after</div><div class="fc-hint">'+E(last.tag)+' · '+gap+' day'+(gap===1?'':'s')+' apart</div><div class="hr-ba">'
        + '<div>'+thumb(first,' big')+'<small>'+E(nice(first.ds))+'</small></div><div>'+thumb(last,' big')+'<small>'+E(nice(last.ds))+'</small></div></div></div>';
    }
    var groups = {}, order = [];
    all.slice().reverse().forEach(function(p){ if(!groups[p.mk]){ groups[p.mk] = []; order.push(p.mk); } groups[p.mk].push(p); });
    order.forEach(function(k){ h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">'+E(monthLabel(k))+'</div><div class="hr-grid">'+groups[k].map(function(p){ return thumb(p); }).join('')+'</div></div>'; });
    var bytes = all.reduce(function(a,p){ return a + (p.img||'').length; }, 0);
    h += '<div class="hr-foot">'+all.length+' photo'+(all.length===1?'':'s')+' · about '+kb(bytes*0.75)+' on this phone</div>';
    return h;
  }
  function routineTab(mk, d){
    var map = daysOf(mk), ds = datesInMonth(mk), t = todayStr(), cnt = Object.keys(map).length, h = '';
    var first = new Date(ds[0]+'T12:00:00'), lead = (first.getDay()+6)%7, cells = '';
    for(var i=0;i<lead;i++) cells += '<i class="hr-cell none"></i>';
    ds.forEach(function(x){ var m = map[x], cls = 'hr-cell' + (x>t ? ' fut' : '') + (m ? (m.auto ? ' auto' : ' man') : '') + (x===t ? ' today' : '');
      cells += '<button type="button" class="'+cls+'" data-hr="day" data-ds="'+x+'" aria-label="'+E(nice(x)+(m?' hair day':''))+'"'+(x>t?' disabled':'')+'>'+(+x.slice(8))+'</button>'; });
    var kinds = {}; Object.keys(map).forEach(function(k){ map[k].kinds.forEach(function(n){ kinds[n] = (kinds[n]||0)+1; }); });
    var ks = Object.keys(kinds).sort(function(a,b){ return kinds[b]-kinds[a]; });
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">'+E(monthLabel(mk))+'</div><div class="fc-hint">Filled in by itself when you pick “Hair today” in Shower &amp; Hygiene. Tap a day to add or remove it yourself.</div>'
      + '<div class="hr-dow"><span>M</span><span>T</span><span>W</span><span>T</span><span>F</span><span>S</span><span>S</span></div><div class="hr-cal">'+cells+'</div>'
      + '<div class="hr-key"><span><i class="auto"></i>From Shower &amp; Hygiene</span><span><i class="man"></i>Added by you</span></div></div>';
    var lw = lastWith(/wash|shampoo/i);
    h += '<div class="hr-mini hr-mini2"><div><b>'+cnt+'</b><span>hair days this month</span></div><div><b>'+streak()+'</b><span>day streak</span></div><div><b>'+(lw ? daysBetween(lw, t) : '–')+'</b><span>days since a wash</span></div></div>';
    if(ks.length) h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">What you did</div><div class="hr-chips">'+ks.map(function(k){ return '<i>'+E(k)+' · '+kinds[k]+'</i>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
    var r = Array.isArray(d.routine) ? d.routine : [];
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Your routine</div><div class="hr-chips">' + (r.length ? r.map(function(x){ return '<i>'+E(x)+'</i>'; }).join('') : '<span class="hr-none">Nothing picked yet</span>') + '</div>'
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-edit2" data-hr="routine">'+icon('pen',13)+' Choose your routine</button>'
      + '<div class="hr-wash"><span>Wash days a week (your goal)</span><div><button type="button" data-hr="wash" data-d="-1" aria-label="Fewer">'+icon('minus',14)+'</button><b>'+(d.wash==null ? '–' : d.wash)+'</b><button type="button" data-hr="wash" data-d="1" aria-label="More">'+icon('plus',14)+'</button></div></div></div>';
    h += '<button type="button" class="hr-add" data-hr="gohyg">'+icon('drop',16)+' Log hair care in Shower &amp; Hygiene</button>';
    return h;
  }
  function historyTab(mk, d){
    var t = todayStr(), rows = [], ph = {};
    photosOf('hair').forEach(function(p){ (ph[p.ds] = ph[p.ds] || []).push(p); });
    for(var i=0;i<90;i++){ var x = addD(t,-i), m = daysOf(x.slice(0,7))[x], pp = ph[x]; if(m || pp) rows.push({ ds:x, m:m, pp:pp||[] }); }
    var h = '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Hair history</div><div class="fc-hint">The last 90 days: every hair day and every photo.</div>';
    h += rows.length ? '<div class="hr-tl">'+rows.map(function(r){
      var kinds = r.m ? (r.m.kinds.length ? r.m.kinds : ['Hair day']) : [];
      return '<div class="hr-tr"><div class="hr-td"><b>'+E(nice(r.ds))+'</b><small>'+(r.ds===t?'today':daysBetween(r.ds,t)+'d ago')+'</small></div><div class="hr-tb">'
        + (kinds.length ? '<div class="hr-chips">'+kinds.map(function(k){ return '<i>'+E(k)+'</i>'; }).join('')+(r.m && r.m.auto ? '<em>from Shower &amp; Hygiene</em>' : '')+'</div>' : '')
        + (r.pp.length ? '<div class="hr-row">'+r.pp.map(function(p){ return thumb(p); }).join('')+'</div>' : '')+'</div></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      : '<div class="hr-none" style="padding:6px 0">Nothing yet. Pick “Hair today” in Shower &amp; Hygiene or add a photo.</div>';
    h += '</div>';
    var hs = history(mk);
    h += '<div class="field-card hr-sec"><div class="fc-label">Your hair journey</div><div class="fc-hint">Health score by month</div><div class="hr-hist">'
      + hs.map(function(x,i){ return '<div class="hr-h'+(i===hs.length-1?' now':'')+'"><div class="hr-hv">'+(x.sc==null?'':x.sc)+'</div><div class="hr-hb"><i style="height:'+(x.sc==null?0:Math.max(6,Math.round(x.sc)))+'%"></i></div><div class="hr-hl">'+E(monthLabelShort(x.mk).slice(0,3))+'</div></div>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
    return h;
  }
  function body(mk){
    var d = data(mk), locked = isMonthlyPageLocked('hair', mk), h = '';
    if(locked) h += '<div class="locked-banner"><div class="locked-icon">'+icon('check',18)+'</div><div><div class="locked-title">Done for '+E(monthLabelShort(mk))+'</div><div class="locked-sub">Your card is saved. You can still add photos and days.</div></div><button type="button" class="hr-edit" onclick="unlockMonthlyPage(\'hair\',\''+mk+'\')">Edit</button></div>';
    h += tabBar() + (TAB==='photos' ? photosTab(mk,d) : TAB==='routine' ? routineTab(mk,d) : TAB==='history' ? historyTab(mk,d) : cardTab(mk,d));
    if(TAB==='card' && !locked) h += '<button class="add-row-btn" onclick="lockMonthlyPageNow(\'hair\',\''+mk+'\')">'+icon('check',14)+' Mark done for '+E(monthLabelShort(mk))+'</button>';
    return h;
  }
  function renderHair(){ renderMonthlyPage('Hair Log', body(currentMonthKey())); }
  PAGE_RENDERERS.hair = renderHair;

  /* ---- taps ---- */
  function sheet(title, opts, sel, multi, done){
    if(!LS()) return;
    LS().openLS({ title:title, instant:!multi, secs:[{ id:'v', opts:opts, sel:sel, multi:multi, other:multi }], cta:function(){ return 'Done'; }, done:function(st){ done(st.v); } });
  }
  function viewer(p){
    var mine = p.kind==='hair';
    openSheet('<div class="sheet-title"><span>'+E((p.tag||'Photo')+' · '+nice(p.ds))+'</span><button class="sheet-close" onclick="closeSheet()" aria-label="Close">'+icon('close',15)+'</button></div>'
      + '<div class="ui-sheetbody"><img class="hr-big" src="'+p.img+'" alt="">'
      + (mine ? '<button type="button" class="hr-add" data-hr="avatar" data-id="'+E(p.id)+'">'+icon('sparkle',15)+' Use on my hair card</button>' : '')
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-del" data-hr="pdel" data-id="'+E(p.id)+'">Delete this photo</button></div>');
    DEL = '';
  }
  document.addEventListener('change', function(e){
    var t = e.target; if(!t || !t.matches || !t.matches('input[type=file][data-store]')) return;
    var f = t.files && t.files[0]; t.value = ''; addPhoto(t.getAttribute('data-store')==='hygiene' ? 'hygiene' : 'hair', f);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-hr]') : null; if(!b) return;
    var a = b.getAttribute('data-hr'), k = b.getAttribute('data-k'), mk = currentMonthKey();
    if(a==='addphoto'){ var inp = b.nextElementSibling; if(inp && inp.tagName==='INPUT') inp.click(); return; }
    if(a==='pview'){ var ph = findPhoto(b.getAttribute('data-id')); if(ph) viewer(ph); return; }
    if(a==='pdel'){ var id = b.getAttribute('data-id'); if(DEL!==id){ DEL = id; b.textContent = 'Tap again to delete for good'; b.classList.add('sure'); return; } removePhoto(id); DEL = ''; closeSheet(); render(); try{ flashSaved('Photo deleted'); }catch(x){} return; }
    if(a==='avatar'){ data(mk).avatar = b.getAttribute('data-id'); saveDB(); closeSheet(); render(); try{ flashSaved('Now on your card'); }catch(x){} return; }
    if(a==='gohair'){ TAB = 'routine'; nav('page','hair'); return; }
    if(a==='gohyg'){ nav('page','shower'); return; }
    if(a==='tab'){ TAB = b.getAttribute('data-v'); render(); try{ window.scrollTo(0,0); }catch(x){} return; }
    if(a==='angle'){ ANGLE = b.getAttribute('data-v'); render(); return; }
    if(ROUTE.view!=='page' || ROUTE.pageId!=='hair') return;
    var d = data(mk);
    function save(){ delete d.fromPrev; saveDB(); render(); }
    if(a==='art'){ delete d.avatar; return save(); }
    if(a==='day'){
      var x = b.getAttribute('data-ds'), hm = data(x.slice(0,7)), m = daysOf(x.slice(0,7))[x];
      if(m && m.auto && !m.manual){ try{ flashSaved('This day came from Shower & Hygiene'); }catch(y){} return; }
      if(!hm.days) hm.days = {}; if(hm.days[x]) delete hm.days[x]; else hm.days[x] = 1;
      if(x.slice(0,7)===mk) delete d.fromPrev; saveDB(); render(); return;
    }
    if(a==='stat'){ var v = +b.getAttribute('data-v'); d[k] = (+d[k]===v) ? 0 : v; return save(); }
    if(a==='tog'){ d[k] = !d[k]; return save(); }
    if(a==='wash'){ d.wash = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, (d.wash==null ? 2 : +d.wash) + Number(b.getAttribute('data-d')))); return save(); }
    if(a==='trait'){ var t = TRAITS.filter(function(z){ return z.k===k; })[0]; return sheet(t.label, t.opts, d[k] ? [d[k]] : [], false, function(v){ d[k] = v[0] || ''; save(); }); }
    if(a==='routine') return sheet('Your routine', ROUTINE, (d.routine||[]).slice(), true, function(v){ d.routine = v; save(); });
    if(a==='goals') return sheet('Your goals', GOALS, (d.goals||[]).slice(), true, function(v){ d.goals = v; save(); });
  });
  document.addEventListener('input', function(e){
    var t = e.target; if(!t || t.id!=='hr-note') return; data(currentMonthKey()).note = t.value; saveDB();
  });

  /* ---- Shower & Hygiene: "Hair today" field, and a history card with its own photos ---- */
  function hygCard(ds){
    var t = todayStr(), mk = currentMonthKey(), dots = '', n14 = 0, prods = {};
    for(var i=13;i>=0;i--){ var d = addD(t,-i), p = DB.days[d] && DB.days[d].pages && DB.days[d].pages.shower, on = !!(p && p._touched); if(on) n14++; dots += '<i class="'+(on?'on':'')+(d===ds?' sel':'')+'" title="'+E(nice(d))+'"></i>'; }
    for(var j=0;j<30;j++){ var q = DB.days[addD(t,-j)], sp = q && q.pages && q.pages.shower; if(sp) for(var z=0;z<9;z++){ var nm = String(sp['product'+z]||'').trim(); if(nm) prods[nm] = (prods[nm]||0)+1; } }
    var top = Object.keys(prods).sort(function(a,b){ return prods[b]-prods[a]; }).slice(0,3), hairN = Object.keys(daysOf(mk)).length, ph = photosOf('hygiene').slice(-6).reverse();
    return '<div class="field-card hg-card"><div class="fc-label">Hygiene history</div><div class="fc-hint">The last 14 days of Shower &amp; Hygiene</div><div class="hg-dots">'+dots+'</div>'
      + '<div class="hr-mini hr-mini2"><div><b>'+n14+'/14</b><span>days logged</span></div><div><b>'+Object.keys(prods).length+'</b><span>products (30 days)</span></div><div><b>'+hairN+'</b><span>hair days this month</span></div></div>'
      + (top.length ? '<div class="hr-chips">'+top.map(function(p){ return '<i>'+E(p)+' · '+prods[p]+'x</i>'; }).join('')+'</div>' : '')
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-edit2" data-hr="gohair">'+icon('sparkle',13)+' Open your Hair Log (routine, photos, history)</button>'
      + '<div class="fc-label" style="margin-top:16px">Progress photos</div>'
      + (ph.length ? '<div class="hr-grid">'+ph.map(function(p){ return thumb(p); }).join('')+'</div>' : '<div class="hr-none">Skin, body or anything you want to track. Add one to start your history.</div>')
      + '<button type="button" class="hr-add" data-hr="addphoto" style="margin-top:10px">'+icon('camera',16)+' Add a progress photo</button><input type="file" accept="image/*" data-store="hygiene" hidden></div>';
  }
  if(typeof showerBody==='function'){
    var baseSB = showerBody;
    showerBody = function(ds){
      var h = baseSB.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var p = getPage(ds, 'shower');
        var field = '<div class="field-card"><div class="fc-label">Hair today</div><div class="fc-hint">Pick what you did. That day is added to your Hair Log routine by itself.</div>'
          + textField(ds, 'shower', 'hair', '', p.hair) + (isDay(ds) ? '<div class="hr-linked">'+icon('check',13)+' Counted in your Hair Log routine</div>' : '') + '</div>';
        var mark = '<div class="field-card"><div class="fc-label">Frequency check</div>', at = h.indexOf(mark);
        h = at>=0 ? h.slice(0,at) + field + h.slice(at) : h + field;
        h += hygCard(ds);
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('hair: shower', e); }
      return h;
    };
  }

  /* ---- Home tile (monthly box) and a row in Settings > This month ---- */
  try{
    if(typeof SETUP_PAGES!=='undefined' && !SETUP_PAGES.some(function(p){ return p.id==='hair'; })){
      var at2 = -1; SETUP_PAGES.forEach(function(p,i){ if(p.id==='income') at2 = i; });
      SETUP_PAGES.splice(at2>=0 ? at2+1 : SETUP_PAGES.length, 0, { id:'hair', name:'Hair Log', icon:'sparkle', cadence:'monthly', status:function(){ var L = level(); return 'Level '+L.lv+' · photos & routine'; } });
    }
  }catch(e){}
  var baseR = render;
  render = function(){
    var out = baseR.apply(this, arguments);
    try{
      if(ROUTE.view==='settings' && !document.querySelector('[data-hair-row]')){
        var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#app .settings-row .sr-name'), at = null;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(rows, function(n){ if(/Products & Perfume Vault|Vision Board/i.test(n.textContent)) at = n.closest('.settings-row'); });
        var mk = currentMonthKey(), done = isMonthlyPageLocked('hair', mk), sc = score(data(mk));
        var row = '<button class="settings-row" data-hair-row="1" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'hair\')"><div><div class="sr-name">Hair Log</div><div class="sr-desc">'+(done ? 'Done for '+E(monthLabelShort(mk))+(sc!=null ? ', health '+sc : '') : 'Your hair as a character card, with photos, routine and history')+'</div></div><div class="sr-ico">'+icon(done?'check':'sparkle',16)+'</div></button>';
        if(at) at.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', row); else { var sec = document.querySelector('#app .settings-section'); if(sec) sec.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', row); }
      }
    }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('hair row', e); }
    return out;
  };
  window.HAIR = { score:score, portrait:portrait, data:data, daysOf:daysOf, streak:streak, photos:photosOf, level:level, autoKinds:autoKinds };

  var css = '.hr-card{border-radius:26px;padding:14px;margin:0 0 14px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}'
    + '.hr-top{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}.hr-pic{flex:0 0 46%;max-width:190px}.hr-svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:22px}.hr-svg .hr-skin{fill:#e8c8ab}.hr-svg .hr-skin2{fill:#dcb899}.hr-svg .hr-body{fill:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 16%,var(--surface))}.hr-svg .hr-ink{fill:#3a2d28}.hr-svg .hr-ink-s{stroke:#3a2d28}.hr-svg .hr-star{fill:#f4c95d}'
    + '.hr-id{flex:1;min-width:0}.hr-rar{display:inline-block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--ink-soft)}'

    + '.hr-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;line-height:1.1;margin:8px 0 3px;color:var(--ink)}.hr-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.35}'
    + '.hr-score{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}.hr-score b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:34px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink)}.hr-score span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}.hr-score em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.hr-score em.up{color:var(--green)}.hr-score em.dn{color:var(--red)}'
    + '.hr-copy{margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}'
    + '.hr-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 0}.hr-stat span{width:74px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}.hr-stat b{width:16px;text-align:right;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft)}.hr-pips{flex:1;display:flex;gap:6px}'

    + '.hr-angles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:10px 0}.hr-ang{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;min-height:38px;padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}.hr-ang.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}'

  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'hair-css'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
}catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('hair patch', e); } })();
