<script>
/* ============================================================
   CYCLE 4 small things (all apps)
   1. Settings regrouped into sectors and groups (rows are moved, not rewritten, so every row still works).
   2. Sober: "Win of the day" and "Reflection" fields are gone (anything already saved stays in your data).
   3. The daily "Rate this book so far" field is gone. Books and products are rated only when finished / rebought.
   4. The floating Assist button only shows on Home, so it never sits on top of other screens.
   5. Month tab: a "Filled in from your days" card, worked out from the daily logs.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){ try{
  var E = function(s){ return (typeof esc==='function') ? esc(s) : String(s); };
  var isSober = (typeof BRAND!=='undefined') && /sober/i.test(BRAND.name || '');

  /* ---- 2 + 3: drop fields ---- */
  if(typeof fieldWrap === 'function'){
    var baseFW = fieldWrap;
    fieldWrap = function(label){
      if(label === 'Rate this book so far') return '';
      if(isSober && (label === 'Win of the day' || label === 'Reflection')) return '';
      return baseFW.apply(this, arguments);
    };
  }

  /* ---- 1: Settings in sectors and groups ---- */
  var PLAN = [
    { sector:'My setup', groups:[
      { name:'Your day', re:/^(Timetable|Boxes & fields|Daily Hobbies|Business lane|Lifestyle & look)$/i },
      { name:'Libraries', re:/^(Book vault|Library|Workout presets|Products & Perfume Vault|Vision Board|Milestone Vault)$/i },
      { name:'This month', re:/^(Bucket List|Income Streams|3 Objectives|Wins & Reflections|Hair Log)$/i } ] },
    { sector:'Look & feel', groups:[ { name:'', re:/^(Appearance|Assist Mode)$/i } ] },
    { sector:'Your data', groups:[
      { name:'Backup', re:/^(Download backup|Restore from backup)$/i },
      { name:'Careful', re:/^Erase all data$/i } ] },
    { sector:'More', groups:[ { name:'', re:/./, rest:true } ] }
  ];
  function regroup(){
    if(document.querySelector('#app .c4-set')) return;
    var body = document.querySelector('#app .page-body');
    if(!body || !body.querySelector('.settings-row')) return;
    var rows = [].slice.call(body.querySelectorAll('.settings-section:not(.test-time-section) .settings-row'));
    var file = body.querySelector('#import-file-input');
    body.querySelectorAll('.settings-section:not(.test-time-section)').forEach(function(s){ s.parentNode.removeChild(s); });
    var left = rows.slice(), html = document.createElement('div'); html.className = 'c4-set';
    PLAN.forEach(function(sec){
      var sh = document.createElement('div'); sh.className = 'c4-sector';
      var any = false, cont = document.createElement('div');
      sec.groups.forEach(function(g){
        var mine = left.filter(function(r){ var n = r.querySelector('.sr-name'); return n && (g.re.test(n.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' '))); });
        if(!mine.length) return;
        mine.forEach(function(r){ left.splice(left.indexOf(r),1); });
        any = true;
        if(g.name){ var h = document.createElement('div'); h.className = 'settings-heading c4-group-h'; h.textContent = g.name; cont.appendChild(h); }
        var card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'settings-section c4-group'; mine.forEach(function(r){ card.appendChild(r); }); cont.appendChild(card);
      });
      if(!any) return;
      sh.innerHTML = '<span>'+E(sec.sector)+'</span>';
      html.appendChild(sh); html.appendChild(cont);
    });
    if(file) html.appendChild(file);
    body.appendChild(html);
  }
  /* ---- 4: remember which screen we are on so CSS can hide the floating button elsewhere ---- */
  if(typeof render === 'function'){
    var baseR = render;
    render = function(){ try{ document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-view', (typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.view) || ''); }catch(e){} var out = baseR.apply(this, arguments); try{ if(typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.view==='settings') regroup(); }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c4 regroup', e); } return out; };
  }

  /* ---- 5: Month tab: "Filled in from your days" ---- */
  function monthCard(mk){
    var ds = (typeof datesInMonth==='function') ? datesInMonth(mk) : [];
    var logged = 0, wo = 0, mins = 0, pg = 0, money = 0, rs = 0, rn = 0, steps = 0, per = {}, upto = 0, today = (typeof todayStr==='function') ? todayStr() : '9999';
    ds.forEach(function(d){
      if(d <= today) upto++;
      var day = DB.days[d]; if(!day || !day.pages) return;
      var has = false;
      for(var pid in day.pages){ var p = day.pages[pid]; if(p && p._touched){ has = true; per[pid] = (per[pid]||0)+1; } }
      if(has) logged++;
      var w = day.pages.workout; if(w && w._touched){ wo++; mins += parseFloat(w.duration)||0; steps += parseFloat(w.steps)||0; }
      var r = day.pages.reading; if(r && r._touched) pg += parseFloat(r.pagesToday)||0;
      var dsh = day.pages.dashboard; if(dsh && dsh.rating){ rs += +dsh.rating; rn++; }
      try{ if(typeof laneValueForDay==='function') money += laneValueForDay(d)||0; }catch(e){}
    });
    if(!logged) return '';
    var chips = [ [logged+'/'+upto,'days logged'] ];
    if(wo) chips.push([wo,'workouts'], [Math.round(mins),'min moved']);
    if(pg) chips.push([Math.round(pg).toLocaleString(),'pages read']);
    if(steps) chips.push([Math.round(steps).toLocaleString(),'steps']);
    if(money) chips.push([Math.round(money).toLocaleString(),'money moved']);
    if(rn) chips.push([(Math.round(rs/rn*10)/10),'avg rating']);
    var cust = [];
    try{ bxCustomBoxes().forEach(function(b){ if(per[b.id]) cust.push(b.name+' '+per[b.id]+'d'); }); }catch(e){}
    return '<div class="in-card"><div class="in-title">Filled in from your days</div><div class="in-sub">You did not type any of this. It adds up on its own.</div>'
      + '<div class="in-chips">'+chips.map(function(c){ return '<div class="in-chip"><b>'+E(c[0])+'</b><span>'+E(c[1])+'</span></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      + (cust.length ? '<div class="in-note">Your boxes: '+E(cust.join(' · '))+'</div>' : '') + '</div>';
  }
  if(typeof renderTrackerOverview === 'function'){
    var baseTO = renderTrackerOverview;
    renderTrackerOverview = function(mk){ var h = baseTO.apply(this, arguments), c = ''; try{ c = monthCard(mk); }catch(e){} return c + h; };
  }

  var css = '.c4-sector{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:26px 2px 6px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.c4-sector:first-child{margin-top:6px}'
    + '.c4-group-h{margin-top:12px}.c4-group{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 70%,transparent);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;margin:0 0 4px !important}'
    + '.c4-group .settings-row{border:0 !important;border-radius:0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;background:transparent;margin:0 !important;width:100%}.c4-group .settings-row + .settings-row{border-top:1px solid var(--line) !important}'
    + '.c4-set{padding-bottom:12px}'
    + '@media (max-width:899px){.assist-toggle{display:none !important}}';
  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
}catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c4 patch', e); } })();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   CYCLE 5 (all apps)
   A. SUGGESTED FIELD NAMES, per lifestyle. When you pick a field kind in "Add a field", the name box is filled with a name that
      fits that kind and your lifestyle (Clean, Reading, Sober, Hustle, or Canvas = the lifestyles you turned on).
      Pick List and it says "Groceries". Tap another idea and it swaps. Clear it and type your own whenever you like.
   B. LINK A BOX. At the bottom of every daily box: "Link to another box". Choose the box, today or tomorrow, and what to carry.
      It shows as a tickable card at the top of that box (and on Home when that box is in focus). Remove it from either end.
      Saved as DB.links = [ { id, from, to, ds, text, done } ]  (ds = the day it shows on). Old backups just have no links.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){ try{
  var E = function(s){ return (typeof esc==='function') ? esc(s) : String(s); };

  /* ---------------- A. suggested names ---------------- */
  function families(){
    var n = (typeof BRAND!=='undefined' && BRAND.name) || '';
    if(/clean/i.test(n)) return ['clean'];
    if(/reading/i.test(n)) return ['reading'];
    if(/sober/i.test(n)) return ['sober'];
    if(/hustler/i.test(n)) return ['hustler'];
    if(/canvas/i.test(n)){
      var p = (DB.life && Array.isArray(DB.life.packs)) ? DB.life.packs : [], m = { clean:'clean', reading:'reading', sober:'sober', hustle:'hustler' };
      var f = p.map(function(x){ return m[x]; }).filter(Boolean); return f.length ? f : ['gen'];
    }
    return ['gen'];
  }
  /* kind -> ideas. A name can carry its options after a "|" (choice / pick several, one per "/") or a unit after a "~" (number). */
  var SUG = {
    gen:     { number:['Glasses of water~glasses','Pages read~pages','Coffees~cups'], duration:['Deep work','Meditation','Time outside'], money:['Money spent today','Tips earned','Added to savings'], percent:['Plan completed','Focus level','Battery left'], time:['Bedtime','Wake-up time','First meal'], scale:['Energy','Stress','Focus'], mood:['How the day felt','Mood after training','Mood at night'], toggle:['Took vitamins','Made the bed','No sugar today'], choice:['Sleep quality|Poor/Okay/Great','Weather|Sunny/Cloudy/Rainy','Energy|Low/Medium/High'], multi:['What I ate|Rice/Eggs/Fruit/Salad','Where I went|Home/Work/Gym/Cafe','Who I saw|Family/Friends/Colleagues'], todo:['Errands','Tomorrow prep','Things to reply to'], list:['Groceries','People to call','Packing list','Things to buy'], short:['Song of the day','One word for today','Best meal'], long:['What I learned','Gratitude','Ideas'], photo:['Meal','Outfit of the day','Progress shot'] },
    clean:   { number:['Glasses of water~glasses','Protein shakes~shakes','Cups of coffee~cups','Fruit servings~servings'], duration:['Stretching','Warm-up','Meditation','Cold plunge / sauna'], money:['Grocery spend','Supplements','Skincare spend','Gym / classes'], percent:['Skin clarity','Energy level','Meal-prep done','Hydration goal'], time:['Bedtime','Wake-up time','First meal','Last meal'], scale:['Energy','Soreness','Skin today','Cravings'], mood:['Mood after training','Morning mood','Mood after a meal'], toggle:['Took vitamins','Skincare done','No sugar today','Cold shower','Made the bed'], choice:['Skin today|Clear/Oily/Dry/Breakout','Hair day|Great/Okay/Bad','Sleep quality|Poor/Okay/Great'], multi:['What I ate|Rice/Eggs/Fruit/Salad/Chicken','Skincare used|Cleanser/Serum/Moisturiser/SPF','Supplements|Protein/Creatine/Vitamin D/Omega 3'], todo:['Prep tomorrow\'s meals','Laundry','Pack gym bag'], list:['Groceries','Meal prep','Skincare to rebuy','Gym bag'], short:['Meal of the day','Fit of the day','Song for the workout'], long:['Skin notes','What worked today','Body notes'], photo:['Meal','Fit check','Progress shot'] },
    reading: { number:['Pages read~pages','Chapters finished~chapters','Words looked up~words','Books on hold~books'], duration:['Reading time','Audiobook time','Note-taking','Reading aloud'], money:['Book spend','Library fines','Added to book fund'], percent:['Book progress','Focus level','Goal for the month'], time:['Reading start','Bedtime','Last page'], scale:['Focus','Enjoyment','Understanding'], mood:['How the book made me feel','Mood after reading'], toggle:['Read before bed','Phone in another room','Took notes','Finished a chapter'], choice:['Where I read|Home/Cafe/Commute/Library','Format|Paper/E-book/Audio','Pace|Slow/Steady/Fast'], multi:['Genres today|Fiction/Self-help/History/Science','Format today|Paper/E-book/Audio','Where I read|Bed/Sofa/Cafe/Commute'], todo:['Books to buy','Quotes to save','Library returns'], list:['To-read list','Quotes to remember','Library holds','Words to look up'], short:['Favourite line','One word for the book','Book of the day'], long:['Thoughts on the chapter','Quotes and notes','What I learned'], photo:['Page I loved','Reading nook','Book haul'] },
    sober:   { number:['Cravings today~cravings','Glasses of water~glasses','Meetings attended~meetings','Calls to support~calls'], duration:['Time outside','Meditation','Exercise','Time with people'], money:['Money saved today','Money not spent','Added to savings'], percent:['Confidence','Urge strength','Day went to plan'], time:['Bedtime','Craving hit at','Wake-up time'], scale:['Craving strength','Stress','Energy'], mood:['How I feel','Mood tonight','Mood this morning'], toggle:['Stayed clean today','Called my support','Went to a meeting','Slept 7h or more'], choice:['Craving level|None/Mild/Strong','Biggest trigger|Stress/Boredom/People/Place','HALT check|Hungry/Angry/Lonely/Tired'], multi:['Triggers today|Stress/Boredom/People/Place','Coping I used|Walk/Call/Gym/Breathe','Who I talked to|Family/Friend/Sponsor/Group'], todo:['People to call','Meetings to attend','Things to avoid'], list:['Reasons I stay clean','People to call','Triggers to avoid','Replacement activities'], short:['One word for today','Song for today','Thing I did instead'], long:['What triggered me','Gratitude','Note to future me'], photo:['Sunset','Milestone','Something I made'] },
    hustler: { number:['Outreach sent~messages','Leads~leads','Deals closed~deals','Calls made~calls'], duration:['Deep work','Calls','Learning','Admin'], money:['Revenue','Ad spend','Expenses','Invested'], percent:['Goal progress','Pipeline filled','Day went to plan'], time:['Work start','Last email','Shutdown'], scale:['Focus','Confidence','Stress'], mood:['Mood at close','Mood after a call'], toggle:['Hit my 3 priorities','Posted content','Followed up','Reviewed numbers'], choice:['Day quality|Slow/Steady/Strong','Main channel|Email/DMs/Calls/Ads','Cash flow|Down/Flat/Up'], multi:['What I worked on|Sales/Content/Ops/Learning','Tools used|Sheets/CRM/Email/Notes','Who I met|Clients/Partners/Mentors'], todo:['Follow-ups','Invoices to send','Tomorrow prep'], list:['Leads to contact','Business ideas','Expenses to log','Clients'], short:['Biggest lesson','Best idea','Quote I used'], long:['What I learned','Post-mortem','Plan for tomorrow'], photo:['Receipt','Whiteboard','Product'] }
  };
  var CUR = [];
  function ideas(type){
    var fs = families(), out = [], seen = {};
    fs.forEach(function(f){ ((SUG[f]||{})[type]||[]).slice(0, fs.length>1 ? 2 : 4).forEach(function(s){ if(!seen[s]){ seen[s] = 1; out.push(s); } }); });
    if(out.length < 3) ((SUG.gen||{})[type]||[]).forEach(function(s){ if(out.length<4 && !seen[s]){ seen[s] = 1; out.push(s); } });
    return out.map(function(s){ var o = { name:s, opts:'', unit:'' }, i; if((i = s.indexOf('|'))>=0){ o.name = s.slice(0,i); o.opts = s.slice(i+1).split('/').join('\n'); } if((i = o.name.indexOf('~'))>=0){ o.unit = o.name.slice(i+1); o.name = o.name.slice(0,i); } return o; });
  }
  /* tapping an idea fills the name (and the options / unit that go with it). Nothing is filled until you tap one. */
  function applyIdea(i){
    var F = (typeof BX_FORM!=='undefined') ? BX_FORM : null, s = CUR[i]; if(!F || !s) return;
    var nm = document.getElementById('bx-f-label'); if(nm){ nm.value = s.name; try{ bxRefreshIconPreview(); }catch(e){} }
    var unit = document.getElementById('bx-f-unit'); if(unit && F.type==='number') unit.value = s.unit || '';
    var op = document.getElementById('bx-f-mopts') || document.getElementById('bx-f-opts');
    if(op && s.opts && (F.type==='choice' || F.type==='multi')) op.value = s.opts;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.bx-sug button'), function(b, k){ b.classList.toggle('on', k===i); });
  }
  window.bxFxSug = applyIdea;
  if(typeof bxShowFieldForm === 'function'){
    var baseForm = bxShowFieldForm;
    bxShowFieldForm = function(f){
      baseForm.apply(this, arguments);
      try{
        var F = (typeof BX_FORM!=='undefined') ? BX_FORM : null, nm = document.getElementById('bx-f-label'); if(!F || !nm || f) return;
        CUR = ideas(F.type); if(!CUR.length) return;
        var box = document.querySelector('.bx-sug');
        var html = '<div class="bx-sug"><span>Ideas for you</span>' + CUR.map(function(x,i){ return '<button type="button" onclick="bxFxSug('+i+')">'+E(x.name)+'</button>'; }).join('') + '</div>';
        if(box) box.outerHTML = html; else nm.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', html);
        /* only a hint in the empty box: no text is put in it, and the keyboard is NOT opened */
        if(!nm.value && CUR[0]) nm.setAttribute('placeholder', 'e.g. ' + CUR[0].name);
      }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c5 name ideas', e); }
    };
  }

  /* ---------------- B. link a box ---------------- */
  function links(){ if(!Array.isArray(DB.links)) DB.links = []; return DB.links; }
  function ymd(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
  function shift(ds, n){ var d = new Date(ds+'T00:00:00'); d.setDate(d.getDate()+n); return ymd(d); }
  function boxName(id){ try{ return bxBoxName(id); }catch(e){ return id; } }
  function boxesNow(){ try{ return ACTIVE_BOXES(todayStr()).filter(function(b){ return b.id!=='setup' && b.id!=='library'; }); }catch(e){ return []; } }
  function dayWord(ds){ var t = todayStr(); return ds===t ? 'today' : ds===shift(t,1) ? 'tomorrow' : ds===shift(t,-1) ? 'yesterday' : ds; }
  function purge(){
    var L = links(), keep = shift(todayStr(), -3), n = L.length;
    DB.links = L.filter(function(x){ return x && x.ds >= keep; });
    if(DB.links.length !== n){ try{ saveDB(); }catch(e){} }
  }
  /* the card at the top of the target box */
  function cardHtml(ds, id){
    var mine = links().filter(function(x){ return x.to===id && x.ds===ds; });
    if(!mine.length) return '';
    return '<div class="lk-card"><div class="lk-h">'+icon('link',14)+' Linked in</div>' + mine.map(function(x){
      return '<div class="lk-row'+(x.done?' done':'')+'"><button type="button" class="lk-tick" data-lk="tick" data-id="'+E(x.id)+'" aria-label="'+(x.done?'Untick':'Tick')+'">'+icon('check',15)+'</button>'
        + '<div class="lk-t"><b>'+E(x.text)+'</b><small>from '+E(boxName(x.from))+(x.srcDs && x.srcDs!==ds ? ', '+E(dayWord(x.srcDs)) : '')+'</small></div>'
        + '<button type="button" class="lk-x" data-lk="rm" data-id="'+E(x.id)+'" aria-label="Remove link">'+icon('close',13)+'</button></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  /* the little list at the bottom of the source box, plus the button */
  function footHtml(ds, id){
    var out = links().filter(function(x){ return x.from===id && x.srcDs===ds; });
    return '<div class="lk-foot">' + out.map(function(x){
      return '<div class="lk-out"><span>'+icon('link',12)+' '+E(x.text)+' <i>to '+E(boxName(x.to))+', '+E(dayWord(x.ds))+'</i></span><button type="button" data-lk="rm" data-id="'+E(x.id)+'" aria-label="Remove link">'+icon('close',12)+'</button></div>';
    }).join('') + '<button type="button" class="lk-add" data-lk="add" data-ds="'+E(ds)+'" data-box="'+E(id)+'">'+icon('link',15)+' Link a reminder to another box</button><div class="lk-help">Pins a short note from this box onto another box for today or tomorrow. You will see it at the top there, and can tick it off.</div></div>';
  }
  /* THE LINK SHEET, in plain words:
     A link pins a short note from THIS box onto another box (or onto this same box tomorrow). When you open that box on that day, the note
     is waiting at the top with a tick circle. Three questions, in the order you think about them:
       1. When should it show up?  Today or Tomorrow
       2. Which box?               a box that exists on that day (today: any other box; tomorrow: any box, including this one again)
       3. What should it say?      one tap from what you typed here, or a ready phrase, or your own words
     The big button at the bottom reads back the whole sentence, so you see exactly what you are about to make. */
  function optsFor(ds, id, day){
    var tds = day==='Today' ? ds : shift(ds, 1), list = [];
    try{ list = ACTIVE_BOXES(tds).filter(function(b){ return b.id!=='setup' && b.id!=='library'; }); }catch(e){ list = boxesNow(); }
    if(day==='Today') list = list.filter(function(b){ return b.id!==id; });
    return list.map(function(b){ return { id:b.id, label: b.id===id ? boxName(b.id)+' (this box again)' : boxName(b.id) }; });
  }
  function openSheet_(ds, id){
    if(!window.LISTS || !LISTS.openLS) return;
    if(!optsFor(ds, id, 'Today').length && !optsFor(ds, id, 'Tomorrow').length){ try{ flashSaved('Add another box first'); }catch(e){} return; }
    /* ideas for what to write: short things already typed in this box today, then ready phrases */
    var pg = getPage(ds, id), sug = [];
    Object.keys(pg).forEach(function(k){ var v = pg[k]; if(k.charAt(0)!=='_' && typeof v==='string' && v.trim() && v.length<=40 && v.indexOf('\n')<0 && sug.length<3 && sug.indexOf(v.trim())<0) sug.push(v.trim()); });
    ['Do this again','Follow up on this','Check how it went','Remember this'].forEach(function(t){ if(sug.length<6 && sug.indexOf(t)<0) sug.push(t); });
    var me = boxName(id), exo = optsFor(ds, id, 'Tomorrow').filter(function(o){ return o.id!==id; })[0], exBox = exo ? exo.label : me;
    LISTS.openLS({ title:'Link a reminder', needs:true,
      intro:function(){ return 'A link <b>pins a short note from '+E(me)+'</b> onto another box. Open that box on that day and the note is waiting at the top with a tick circle. Example: from <b>'+E(me)+'</b>, pin <i>Do this again</i> onto <b>'+E(exBox)+'</b> tomorrow.'; },
      secs:[ { id:'day', label:'1. When should it show up?', opts:['Today','Tomorrow'], sel:['Tomorrow'], other:false },
             { id:'to', label:'2. Which box should show it?', opts:function(st){ return optsFor(ds, id, st.day[0] || 'Tomorrow').map(function(o){ return o.label; }); }, sel:[], other:false },
             { id:'txt', label:'3. What should the note say?', opts:sug, sel:[], other:true } ],
      onChange:function(st, secs){ var ok = optsFor(ds, id, st.day[0] || 'Tomorrow').map(function(o){ return o.label; }); secs[1].sel = secs[1].sel.filter(function(v){ return ok.indexOf(v)>=0; }); },
      count:function(st){ var ok = st.to.length && optsFor(ds, id, st.day[0] || 'Tomorrow').some(function(o){ return o.label===st.to[0]; }); return (ok && st.txt.length) ? 1 : 0; },
      cta:function(st,n){ return n ? 'Pin “'+String(st.txt[0]).slice(0,28)+'” on '+st.to[0].replace(' (this box again)','')+' · '+(st.day[0]||'Tomorrow').toLowerCase() : 'Pick a box and what the note says'; },
      done:function(st){
        var day = st.day[0] || 'Tomorrow', hit = optsFor(ds, id, day).filter(function(o){ return o.label===st.to[0]; })[0]; if(!hit || !st.txt.length) return;
        var tds = day==='Today' ? ds : shift(ds, 1);
        links().push({ id:'lk'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.floor(Math.random()*1e3), from:id, to:hit.id, ds:tds, srcDs:ds, text:String(st.txt[0]).slice(0,80), done:false });
        saveDB(); try{ flashSaved('Pinned on '+boxName(hit.id)+' ('+day.toLowerCase()+')'); }catch(e){} render();
      } });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-lk]') : null; if(!b) return;
    var a = b.getAttribute('data-lk'), id = b.getAttribute('data-id');
    if(a==='add'){ e.preventDefault(); return openSheet_(b.getAttribute('data-ds'), b.getAttribute('data-box')); }
    var x = links().filter(function(y){ return y.id===id; })[0]; if(!x) return;
    if(a==='tick'){ x.done = !x.done; saveDB(); render(); }
    if(a==='rm'){ DB.links = links().filter(function(y){ return y.id!==id; }); saveDB(); render(); }
  });
  /* draw it: on each daily box page (card on top, button above Finish) and under the box shown on Home */
  var baseR = render;
  render = function(){
    var out = baseR.apply(this, arguments);
    try{
      if(typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && DB.onboarded && ROUTE.view==='page'){
        var id = ROUTE.pageId, ds = ROUTE.date || todayStr(), isDaily = boxesNow().some(function(b){ return b.id===id; });
        var pb = document.querySelector('#app .page-body');
        if(pb && isDaily && !pb.querySelector('.lk-card,.lk-foot')){
          purge();
          var top = cardHtml(ds, id); if(top) pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', top);
          var fin = pb.querySelector('.fin-bar'), foot = footHtml(ds, id);
          if(fin) fin.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', foot); else pb.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', foot);
        }
      }
    }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c5 links', e); }
    return out;
  };
  if(typeof bxFocusBody === 'function'){
    var baseFocus = bxFocusBody;
    bxFocusBody = function(id, ds){ var h = baseFocus.apply(this, arguments); try{ return cardHtml(ds, id) + h; }catch(e){ return h; } };
  }
  window.BOXLINKS = { list:links, cardHtml:cardHtml };

  var css = '.lk-help{margin:7px 4px 0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}.lk-card{background:var(--accent-soft);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,transparent);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;margin:0 0 14px}'
    + '.lk-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}'
    + '.lk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 0 3px}.lk-row+.lk-row{border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent);margin-top:6px}'
    + '.lk-tick{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 30%,transparent);background:var(--surface);color:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}'
    + '.lk-row.done .lk-tick{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.lk-row.done .lk-t b{text-decoration:line-through;opacity:.55}'
    + '.lk-t{flex:1;min-width:0}.lk-t b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.lk-t small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}'
    + '.lk-x{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}'
    + '.lk-foot{margin:16px 0 4px}.lk-out{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 8px 6px 12px;margin-bottom:6px}.lk-out i{color:var(--muted);font-style:normal}.lk-out button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}'
    + '.lk-add{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:46px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft);font:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}';
  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'c5-css'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
}catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c5 patch', e); } })();
</script>
<script>
/* =====================================================================================================
   CYCLE 6 (all apps)
   1. The Workout Presets and Book Library tiles are gone from Home (Hustler's and Canvas had them as "setup boxes").
      They live in Settings only. The pages themselves still open from Settings.
   2. Hustler's and Canvas: Income Streams is now LIVE-linked to the Business lane.
      Every time you save the lane log, the month's money is added up and written into an "auto" income stream. A card at the top of
      Income Streams shows this month's total, progress to your target, the best day, the average, a projection for the month end and a bar per day.
      The Business lane page shows the same total and opens Income Streams in one tap.
   3. Every app: a "From your days" strip at the top of the monthly pages (Vision Board, Vault, Objectives). It is worked out from the daily
      logs, nothing to type (days logged, pages read, workouts, clean streak, products used, hair days, money...).
   4. Habit Tracker: a habit whose name matches a daily box (Movement, Reading, Journal, Meditate, Skincare / Hair care, Plan tomorrow...)
      is ticked for you on the days that box was done. You can still untick it, and it stays unticked.
   Nothing here changes how data is saved: new keys are optional and old backups import as before.
   ===================================================================================================== */
(function(){ try{
  var E = function(s){ return (typeof esc==='function') ? esc(s) : String(s); };
  var NAME = (typeof BRAND!=='undefined' && BRAND.name) || '';
  var HUST = /hustler|canvas/i.test(NAME), CLEAN = /clean/i.test(NAME), READ = /read/i.test(NAME), SOB = /sober/i.test(NAME);
  function money(n){ n = Math.round((+n||0)*100)/100; return (n<0?'-$':'$') + Math.abs(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
  function todayS(){ return (typeof todayStr==='function') ? todayStr() : ''; }

  /* ---- 1. libraries are Settings-only ---- */
  try{ if(typeof SETUP_PAGES!=='undefined'){ for(var i = SETUP_PAGES.length-1; i>=0; i--){ if(SETUP_PAGES[i].id==='workoutPresets' || SETUP_PAGES[i].id==='library') SETUP_PAGES.splice(i,1); } } }catch(e){}

  /* ---- shared month numbers, all worked out from the daily logs ---- */
  function monthNumbers(mk){
    var ds = (typeof datesInMonth==='function') ? datesInMonth(mk) : [], t = todayS(), r = { days:0, upto:0, wo:0, woMin:0, pages:0, readDays:0, readMin:0, rating:0, ratingN:0, money:0, moneyDays:0, best:0, hair:0, shower:0, products:{} };
    ds.forEach(function(d){
      if(d<=t) r.upto++;
      var day = DB.days[d]; if(!day || !day.pages) return; var pg = day.pages, any = false;
      for(var k in pg){ if(pg[k] && pg[k]._touched){ any = true; break; } }
      if(any) r.days++;
      if(pg.workout && pg.workout._touched){ r.wo++; r.woMin += parseFloat(pg.workout.duration)||0; }
      if(pg.reading && pg.reading._touched){ var n = parseFloat(pg.reading.pagesToday)||0; if(n>0){ r.pages += n; r.readDays++; } r.readMin += parseFloat(pg.reading.minutes)||0; }
      if(pg.dashboard && +pg.dashboard.rating){ r.rating += +pg.dashboard.rating; r.ratingN++; }
      if(pg.shower && pg.shower._touched){ r.shower++; for(var i2=0;i2<8;i2++){ var p = String(pg.shower['product'+i2]||'').trim(); if(p) r.products[p] = (r.products[p]||0)+1; } }
      try{ if(window.HAIR && HAIR.daysOf){ if(HAIR.daysOf(mk)[d]) r.hair++; } }catch(e){}
      try{ if(typeof laneValueForDay==='function'){ var v = laneValueForDay(d)||0; if(pg.lane && pg.lane._touched){ r.money += v; if(v!==0) r.moneyDays++; if(v>r.best) r.best = v; } } }catch(e){}
    });
    return r;
  }
  function chips(list){ return '<div class="c6-chips">'+list.filter(Boolean).map(function(c){ return '<div class="c6-chip"><b>'+E(c[0])+'</b><span>'+E(c[1])+'</span></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'; }
  function strip(pid, mk){
    var r = monthNumbers(mk), list = [], sub = 'Worked out from your daily logs. Nothing to type.';
    list.push([r.days+'/'+r.upto, 'days logged']);
    if(pid==='income' && CLEAN){
      var top = Object.keys(r.products).sort(function(a,b){ return r.products[b]-r.products[a]; }).slice(0,3);
      list.push([r.shower, 'hygiene days']); if(r.hair) list.push([r.hair, 'hair days']); list.push([Object.keys(r.products).length, 'products used']);
      return '<div class="c6-strip"><div class="c6-h">From your days</div><div class="c6-s">What you actually used this month, taken from Shower & Hygiene.</div>'+chips(list)
        + (top.length ? '<div class="c6-note">Most used: '+E(top.map(function(p){ return p+' ('+r.products[p]+'x)'; }).join(' · '))+'</div>' : '')+'</div>';
    }
    if(SOB){ try{ if(window.SOBER && SOBER.streak){ var s = SOBER.streak(), n = (typeof s==='object' && s) ? (s.days!==undefined ? s.days : s.current) : s; if(n!=null) list.push([n, 'day streak now']); if(SOBER.best){ var b = SOBER.best(); if(typeof b==='number') list.push([b,'best streak']); } } }catch(e){} }
    if(r.wo) list.push([r.wo,'workouts'], [Math.round(r.woMin),'min moved']);
    if(r.pages) list.push([Math.round(r.pages).toLocaleString(),'pages read'], [r.readDays,'reading days']);
    if(r.moneyDays || r.money) list.push([money(r.money),'money moved']);
    if(r.ratingN) list.push([(Math.round(r.rating/r.ratingN*10)/10),'avg rating']);
    if(CLEAN && r.hair) list.push([r.hair,'hair days']);
    return '<div class="c6-strip"><div class="c6-h">From your days</div><div class="c6-s">'+sub+'</div>'+chips(list)+'</div>';
  }

  /* ---- 2. Hustler's / Canvas: Income Streams <-> Business lane ---- */
  function laneName(){ try{ var l = (typeof LANES!=='undefined' ? LANES : []).filter(function(x){ return x.id===DB.lane; })[0]; return l ? l.name : ''; }catch(e){ return ''; } }
  function laneMonth(mk){
    var ds = datesInMonth(mk), t = todayS(), rows = [], tot = 0, best = 0, bestDs = '', logged = 0;
    ds.forEach(function(d){
      var day = DB.days[d], ln = day && day.pages && day.pages.lane, v = 0;
      if(ln && ln._touched){ v = laneValueForDay(d)||0; logged++; }
      if(d<=t) tot += v;
      rows.push({ ds:d, v:v, future: d>t });
      if(v>best){ best = v; bestDs = d; }
    });
    tot = Math.round(tot*100)/100;
    var elapsed = ds.filter(function(d){ return d<=t; }).length, proj = null;
    if(mk===t.slice(0,7) && logged>=3 && elapsed>0) proj = Math.round(tot/elapsed*ds.length);
    return { total:tot, rows:rows, logged:logged, best:best, bestDs:bestDs, avg: logged ? Math.round(tot/logged*100)/100 : 0, proj:proj, elapsed:elapsed, days:ds.length };
  }
  function autoStream(mk, create){
    var pg = getMonthlyPage('income', mk); if(!Array.isArray(pg.streams)) pg.streams = [];
    var name = laneName(); if(!name) return null;
    var s = pg.streams.filter(function(x){ return String(x.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase(); })[0];
    if(!s && create){ s = { name:name, current:'', target:'', next:'', status:'Active', auto:1 }; pg.streams.push(s); }
    return s || null;
  }
  /* write the month's lane total into the auto stream (quiet: no toast) */
  function syncIncome(mk){
    try{
      if(!HUST || typeof laneValueForDay!=='function' || !DB.lane) return;
      var m = laneMonth(mk), s = autoStream(mk, m.total!==0 || m.logged>0); if(!s) return;
      var cur = String(m.total); if(s.current!==cur){ s.current = cur; s.auto = 1; saveDB(); }
    }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c6 income sync', e); }
  }
  if(HUST && typeof markTouched==='function'){
    var _mt = markTouched;
    markTouched = function(ds, pid){ var out = _mt.apply(this, arguments); try{ if(pid==='lane') syncIncome(String(ds).slice(0,7)); }catch(e){} return out; };
  }
  function incomeCard(mk){
    var name = laneName(), href = "nav('page','lane')";
    if(!name || !DB.lane) return '<div class="c6-inc"><div class="c6-h">Live from your Business lane</div><div class="c6-s">You have not picked a Business lane yet. Pick one and log money in it: this page fills itself.</div></div>';
    var m = laneMonth(mk), s = autoStream(mk, false), target = s ? (+s.target||0) : 0, all = (getMonthlyPage('income', mk).streams||[]).reduce(function(a,x){ return a + (+x.target||0); }, 0);
    var pct = target ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(m.total/target*100))) : 0, max = Math.max.apply(null, m.rows.map(function(r){ return Math.abs(r.v); }).concat([1]));
    var h = '<div class="c6-inc"><div class="c6-h">Live from your Business lane <small>'+E(name)+'</small></div>'
      + '<div class="c6-big">'+E(money(m.total))+'<span>this month</span></div>';
    if(target) h += '<div class="c6-bar"><i style="width:'+pct+'%"></i></div><div class="c6-s">'+pct+'% of your '+E(money(target))+' target'+(m.proj!=null ? ' · on pace for about '+E(money(m.proj)) : '')+'</div>';
    else h += '<div class="c6-s">Set a target for this lane and see how far you are:</div><div class="c6-q">'+[500,1000,2500,5000,10000].map(function(v){ return '<button type="button" data-c6="target" data-v="'+v+'">'+E(money(v))+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      + (m.proj!=null ? '<div class="c6-s" style="margin-top:6px">On pace for about '+E(money(m.proj))+' this month.</div>' : '');
    h += chips([[m.logged+'/'+m.elapsed,'days logged'], [m.best>0 ? money(m.best) : '–','best day'], [m.logged ? money(m.avg) : '–','avg per day logged'], [m.proj!=null ? money(m.proj) : '–','month-end pace']]);
    h += '<div class="c6-days" aria-label="Money per day">'+m.rows.map(function(r){ var hgt = r.v ? Math.max(8, Math.round(Math.abs(r.v)/max*100)) : 4; return '<i class="'+(r.future?'f':r.v<0?'n':r.v>0?'p':'')+'" style="height:'+hgt+'%" title="'+E(r.ds.slice(8)+': '+money(r.v))+'"></i>'; }).join('')+'</div>'
      + '<button type="button" class="c6-link" onclick="'+href+'">Open your Business lane</button></div>';
    return h;
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-c6]') : null; if(!b) return;
    if(b.getAttribute('data-c6')==='target'){ var mk = currentMonthKey(), s = autoStream(mk, true); if(s){ s.target = String(b.getAttribute('data-v')); saveDB(); render(); } }
  });
  if(HUST && typeof incomeBody==='function'){
    var baseIB = incomeBody;
    incomeBody = function(monthKey){ var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey(); syncIncome(mk); var h = baseIB.apply(this, arguments); try{ return incomeCard(mk) + h; }catch(e){ return h; } };
  }

  /* ---- 4. Habit Tracker: tick the habits whose daily box was done ---- */
  var HAB = [ [/workout|exercise|movement|cardio|gym|stretch|walk/i,'workout'], [/read/i,'reading'], [/journal|gratitude/i,'journal'], [/meditat|breath|mind|focus/i,'mindfocus'],
              [/skin|shower|hair|floss|sunscreen|hygiene|cleanse/i,'shower'], [/sleep|bed|lights|wind|plan tomorrow/i,'night'], [/deep work|outreach|ship|finance/i,'lane'] ];
  function habPid(name){ for(var i=0;i<HAB.length;i++){ if(HAB[i][0].test(name)) return HAB[i][1]; } return ''; }
  function autoHabits(mk){
    try{
      if(typeof habitsPage!=='function') return 0;
      var pg = habitsPage(mk), t = todayS(), changed = 0; if(!pg.auto) pg.auto = {};
      var onPids = {}; try{ CORE_PAGES.forEach(function(c){ onPids[c.id] = 1; }); }catch(e){}
      datesInMonth(mk).forEach(function(d){
        if(d>t) return; var day = DB.days[d]; if(!day || !day.pages) return;
        (pg.names||[]).forEach(function(nm, i){
          var pid = habPid(String(nm||'')); if(!pid) return; var key = d+'|'+i; if(pg.auto[key]) return;
          var p = day.pages[pid], fin = DB.finished && DB.finished[d] && DB.finished[d][pid];
          var hairOk = (pid==='shower' && /hair/i.test(nm)) ? !!(window.HAIR && HAIR.daysOf && HAIR.daysOf(mk)[d]) : true;
          if(((p && p._touched) || fin) && hairOk){ if(!pg.marks) pg.marks = {}; if(!pg.marks[d]) pg.marks[d] = {}; if(!pg.marks[d][i]) { pg.marks[d][i] = true; changed++; } pg.auto[key] = 1; }
        });
      });
      if(changed) saveDB();
      return changed;
    }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c6 habits', e); return 0; }
  }
  if(typeof habitsBody==='function'){
    var baseHB = habitsBody;
    habitsBody = function(monthKey){ var mk = monthKey || currentMonthKey(); autoHabits(mk); return baseHB.apply(this, arguments); };
  }
  function habitStrip(mk){
    if(typeof habitsPage!=='function') return '';
    var names = (habitsPage(mk).names||[]), links = names.map(function(n){ var p = habPid(String(n||'')); return p ? n : ''; }).filter(Boolean);
    return '<div class="c6-strip"><div class="c6-h">Ticks that fill themselves</div><div class="c6-s">'+(links.length ? 'These habits tick on their own on days you did the matching daily box: <b>'+E(links.slice(0,6).join(', '))+'</b>. Untick one and it stays unticked.' : 'Name a habit like Movement, Reading, Journal, Meditate or Skincare and it will tick itself on the days you did that box.')+'</div></div>';
  }

  /* ---- draw the strips: monthly pages and the Business lane page ---- */
  var baseR = render;
  render = function(){
    var out = baseR.apply(this, arguments);
    try{
      if(typeof ROUTE!=='undefined' && ROUTE.view==='page' && DB.onboarded){
        var pb = document.querySelector('#app .page-body'), id = ROUTE.pageId, mk = currentMonthKey();
        if(id==='lane' && HUST && DB.lane && !document.querySelector('#app .c6-laneline')){
          /* the Business lane page has no .page-body: the lane picker comes first, so the strip goes right above it */
          var anchor = pb || document.querySelector('#app .lane-picker'), m0 = laneMonth(mk); syncIncome(mk);
          if(anchor) anchor.insertAdjacentHTML(pb ? 'afterbegin' : 'beforebegin', '<button type="button" class="c6-laneline" onclick="nav(\'page\',\'income\')"><span><b>'+E(money(m0.total))+'</b> this month</span><i>Goes into Income Streams · open</i></button>');
        }
        if(pb && !pb.querySelector('.c6-strip,.c6-laneline')){
          if(id==='habits') pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', habitStrip(mk));
          else if(id==='income' && !HUST) pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', strip('income', mk));
          else if(id==='objectives' || id==='bucket') pb.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', strip(id, mk));
        }
      }
    }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c6 strips', e); }
    return out;
  };
  window.C6 = { monthNumbers:monthNumbers, laneMonth:laneMonth, syncIncome:syncIncome, autoHabits:autoHabits, habPid:habPid };

  var css = '.c6-strip,.c6-inc{background:var(--accent-soft);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 28%,transparent);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;margin:0 0 14px}'
    + '.c6-h{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink)}.c6-h small{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-left:6px}'
    + '.c6-s{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:3px}.c6-s b{color:var(--ink)}.c6-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px}'
    + '.c6-chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(86px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:11px}.c6-chip{background:var(--surface);border-radius:14px;padding:9px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0}.c6-chip b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.c6-chip span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}'
    + '.c6-big{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;font-size:38px;line-height:1.05;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 8px}.c6-big span{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-left:8px}'
    + '.c6-bar{height:12px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden}.c6-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent)}'
    + '.c6-q{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.c6-q button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;min-height:38px;padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}'
    + '.c6-days{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:64px;margin-top:12px}.c6-days i{flex:1;min-width:0;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;background:var(--accent)}.c6-days i.f{background:var(--line);opacity:.5}.c6-days i.n{background:#c0463c}.c6-days i:not(.p):not(.n):not(.f){background:var(--line)}'
    + '.c6-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:42px;margin-top:12px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft);border-radius:14px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}'
    + '.c6-laneline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;background:var(--accent-soft);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 28%,transparent);border-radius:16px;padding:11px 14px;margin:0 0 14px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);touch-action:manipulation}.c6-laneline b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:18px}.c6-laneline i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}';
  var st = document.createElement('style'); st.id = 'c6-css'; st.textContent = css; document.head.appendChild(st);
}catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('c6 patch', e); } })();
</script>
<script>
/* ============================================================
   BOOT (Cycle 5). This script is always the LAST one.
   Why: the original app drew the first screen before any of the add-on scripts had loaded, so the first screen you saw was the
   OLD version (old icons, old boxes) until your first tap forced a redraw. Now the first draw is skipped in the base code
   (build.py removes it) and done here, once, with everything loaded. It also redraws when the app comes back from the
   background, from the back-forward cache, or after midnight, so a stale screen cannot be left sitting there.
   ============================================================ */
(function(){
  var typing = function(){ var a = document.activeElement; return !!(a && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(a.tagName)); };
  var drawnDay = null;
  function today(){ try{ return todayStr(); }catch(e){ return ''; } }
  function draw(){
    try{ render(); }catch(e){ if(window.console) console.error('boot render', e); }
    try{ if(typeof LAYOUT_MQ !== 'undefined' && LAYOUT_MQ && typeof applyLayoutMode === 'function') applyLayoutMode(LAYOUT_MQ.matches); }catch(e){}
    drawnDay = today();
  }
  draw();
  window.__booted = true;
  /* coming back: redraw if the day changed, or if it has been a while; never while you are typing */
  var hiddenAt = 0;
  function back(force){
    if(typing()) return;
    if(force || today() !== drawnDay || (hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt > 60000)){
      try{ if(typeof SELECTED_DATE !== 'undefined' && drawnDay && today() !== drawnDay && SELECTED_DATE === drawnDay){ SELECTED_DATE = today(); } }catch(e){}
      draw();
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ if(document.hidden){ hiddenAt = Date.now(); } else { back(false); hiddenAt = 0; } });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', function(e){ if(e && e.persisted) back(true); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
